tei:div.tei:p: kyi ༄tswa/6)/dri zhe spring/7ldi ༷

'dul ba/ spyo|lji (3)0001 'dul ba ga'i// 3sum bcu so bdun pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i le'u/(smad) 3nor can sogs bstan pa/ 30sde'i sde tshan/ 53nad bu can sogs bstan pa/ 53ke na'i bu yis btung ba blangs pa bstan pa/ 80ka shi'i tshong rdal nas nas thug blangs pa sogs bstan pa/ 106gos kyi gzhi 'chad ba/ 117'tsho byed kyi sde tshan/ 117gso ras kyi sde tshan/ 212kha tshar ring po'i sde tshan/ 216dbyar ral bar ni rig bya dang zhes pa'i sde tshan/ 229shi ba'i dus kyi sde tshan/ 2361

nye dga'i sde tshan/ 240nad pa'i sde tshan/ 251sra brkyang gi gzhi 'chad ba/ 275gnas bcas kyi sde tshan/ 275rdol pa'i sde tshan/ 285glings pa'i sde tshan/ 285dus kyi sde tshan/ 286gang zag ma mo'i gzhi'i sde tshan/ 286nyi shu'i sde tshan/ 289bcu gnyis kyi sde tshan/ 294sku shāsbyi'i gzhi 'chad ba/ 296las kyi gzhi 'chad pa/ 321dmar ser can gyi gzhi 'chad pa/ 336dmar ser can gyi sde tshan/ 336legs ldan gyi sde tshan/ 344'gro mgyogs dang dab so'i sde tshan/ 349chu stod kyi sde tshan/ 353'dun pa'i sde tshan/ 362'chi ltas kyi sde tshan/ 365'char ku'i sde tshan/ 68gang zag gi gzhi 'chad pa/ 398'char ku'i sde tshan/ 398btus pa'i sde tshan/ 402mtha'i sde tshan/ 4092

gzhan gyis dang zhes pa'i sde tshan/ 420dzdza ba'i gzhi 'chad pa/ 425gso rgyung bzhag ba'i gzhi 'chad ba/ 437gnas mal gyi gzhi 'chad pa/ 4gortsod ba'i gzhi 'chad ba/ 536dge 'dun dbyen gyi gzhi 'chad ba/ 615mang pos bkur ba la sogs pa'i sde tshan/(stod) 615bsdur mchan/(703) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(819)
dzo//ṭā/ phye/kṣiṃ 4du4tsho//lha

༄༅gi /'dul ba gzhi/ bam po lnga bcu lnga ②pa/ thun mong ma yin pa gang zhe na/ dge slong dag sngon byung ba bā rā ṇa sri'i dugrong khyer du rgyal po tshangs sbyin zhes bya ba rgyal srid byed du 'jug ste du'abyor pa dang zhes ②rgyas par bya ste/ de'i tshe smad 'tshong dum bzang mo zhes bya ba dang / skyes bu g.yon can pad ma'i rtsa lag ces bya ba zhig gnas so/ /des de la ⑦dga' mgur duspyad pa'i phyir gos dang / rgyan rnams bskur ba dang / des gos dang rgyan rnams bgos ⑨nas song ba las/ skyes pa gzhan zhig kyang dong tshe lnga brgya thogs te 'ongs nas/ bzang mo dga' mgur spyad kyis 0tshur shog ces smras so/ /des bsams (sprepa/ gal te song na ni dong tshe lnga brgya yang mi 'thob tho)la/khyim du 'ongs pa bor te gzhan du 'gro ba 'di ni gsol ka mi yang bar yang 'gyur ro snyam nas/ des bu mo mngag gzhug ma la smras pa/ song la pad ma'i rtsa 3—3

lag la jo bo ①re zhig ②bdag gis sta gon ma bgyis kyis ③slad kyis mchi'o zhes zer ro zhes smros shig /de de'i gan du song nas smras so/ /skyes pa de yang bya ba mang po zhig pas dga' mgur spyad nas srod nyid la phyir song ngo / /des bsams pa/ thun mong 0du yod pas bdag gis de'i sems kyang bsrung dunas so snyam nas/ des yang bu mo de la smras pa/ song la pad ma'i rtsa lag dul jo bo sta ①gon bgyis lags na/ skyed ②mos tshal gang du mchi shig ces mchi'o zhes smros shig /des ⑨de'i drung du song nas smras pa dang / des smras pa/khyod ⑩kyi jo mo skad cig 0gis ni sta gon byas/ skad cig gis ni sta gon ma byas/bu mo de yang de dang rigs 8mi 'phrod pa zhig 0pas des smras pa/ rje'i sras des sta 8gon ma 8bgyis te/ 'on kyang khyod kyi gos yidang rgyan rnams kyis skyes pa gzhan dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad ⑩do/ /de 'dod chags kyi 8kun nas dkris pa gang yin pa de dang ni 7bral/ gnod sems kyis kun nas dkris pa ni skyes par gyur te/ de mi bzod pa skyes nas smras pa/ bu mo bzang mo'i drung du song la/ pad ma'i rtsa lag dun re skyed mos tshal ⑥ga ge mo zhig tu shog shig ces zer ro zhes smos shig /des 6)song nas bzang mo la smras pa dang /de nas de skyed mos tshal der song ba dang / skyes bu 0g.yon can pad ma'i rtsa lag gis smras pa/ khyod kho bo'i gos dang rgyan gyis gzhan dang lhan cig dga' mgur ④yongs su spyad pa ji ga rigs sam des smras pa/ rje'i sras 'di ni bdag gis nongs lags te/ 'on kyang bud med ni rtag par duskyon can lags kyis ⑪bzod pa tshumadzod cig /de nas des mi bzod pa skyes nas/ ral gri shubs ⑫nas phyung ste srog dang phral 0lo/ /de nas bu mo des jo mo bsad do jo mo bsad 3—4

do zhes ku co'i sgra chen po bton ①pa de skye bo'i tshogs chen pos thos nas brgyugs ②so/ /de tsam na skyed mos tshal ③de na rang sangs rgyas legs smon zhes bya ba bsam gtan byed do/ /de nas skyes bu dugayon can pad ma'i rtsa lag de ⑤spag pas ༷ral gri khrag can rang sangs rgyas legs smon gyi mdun ⑦du bor nas skye bo'i tshogs chen po de nyid kyi nang du zhugs so/ /skye bo'i tshogs chen pos ral gri khrag can mthong nas rab tu byung ba 'dis ni dubazang mo'i 0srog dang phral 0lo zhes de nas rang sangs rgyas de kun nas bskor nas mi bzod pa bskyed de smras pa/kye rab tu byung ba drang srong gi rgyal mtshan bsrel nas 'di 'dra ba'i las byed dam/des smras pa ci zhig byas/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ khyod kyis bzang mo dang ⑪lhan cig dga' mgur spyad nas de srog dang phral lo/ /des smras pa/ rnas ⑫mi bzod pa de 4)nga ni las 'di mi byed do/ /des rnas 8mi bzod pa'i tshig smras kyang / skye bo'i tshogs chen po des lag pa phying 4)ka log tu (9dam du bcings nas rgyal po la phul te/ lha rab tu byung ba 'dis ⑩bzang mo dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad nas des 8srog dang phral yilags so/ /rgyal po dag ni 0mi rtog pa yin pas des smras pa/ gal te de lta na rab tu byung ba 'di ngas spangs kyis deng 0la sod ducig /de nas de'i mgul par dume tog ka tsor bī byara'i phreng bas dubatags nas gshed ma gos sngon po byon pa mtshon thogs pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor nas lam po che dang / tshong dus dang / bzhi mdo dang /sum mdo rnams su bsgrags te/ grong khyer nas skyed mos tshal logs su khrid do//de nas skyes bu 6)g.yon can pad ma'i rtsa lag gi 4)blo skyes pa (trerab tu byung ba dka' thub can skyon med pa nyes pa mi byed pa 'di la yang dag pa ma yin 3—5

pas skur pa ①btab pas da 'di gsad pa la thug na/ bdag gis 'di ②yal bar dor ba ni bdag gi cha ma yin no snyam du bsams nas slar log ste/ rgyal po'i drung du song nas rkang pa gnyis la gtugs ②te smras pa/ lha rab tu byung ba 'dis duni las 'di ⑤ma bgyis te/ sdig pa'i las 'di ni bdag gis bgyis kyis durab tu byung ba 'di gtang ⑦bar gsol/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/de'i tshe de'i dus kyi skyes bu lagayon can pad ma'i rtsa lag gang yin pa de ni kyang nyid yin te/ ngas rang sangs rgyas la yang dag par byam yin pas skur yipa btab pa gang yin pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas nga 8lo mang po dang zhes bya ba nas/ sems can dmyal ba rnams su btsos tsoso zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /las kyi lhag ma de kho nas da ltar nga mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa na yang bram ze'i bu mo rtswa ④mis yang dag pa ma yin pas skur 8pa btab stega'adi ni thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis phrin ⑩las ci zhig mdzad na8/ phrin las de'i rnam par smin pas yul dgra mthar dge slong gnyis kyis lnga brgyar ma tshang ba'i dge slong rnams dang thabs cig nas rul gsol layi/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ⑥ri'i bu dang / mod gal ⑥gyi bu gnyis ni lha'i zhal zas la longs spyod dulags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis sngon gyi tsotshe rabs gzhan rnams su las rnams byas shing bsags pa ④zhes bya ba nas/ 'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba skye dgu ⑫rnams kyi 0tshe lo brgyad khri thub pa na 'jig rten du ston pa rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba zhig byung nas zhes bya ba nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes ⑥bya 3—6

ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de ①'khor drug lakhri dang ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na/ rgyal po'i pho brang bshes ②ldan du byon to④/ /bshes 0ldan de'i bram ze zhig bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya la bram ze rnams kyi dugasang tshig klog tu 'jug go/ /des yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs 'khor lnga brgya dang ⑦mthong nas/ des bram ze'i khye'u rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag dge sbyong ⑧mgo reg 'di dag lha'i zhal zas la longs spyad ⑨pa'i 'os ma yin gyi/ nas rul pa za ba'i 'os yin no/ /de rnams kyis kyang rjes su yi rang ba byas te/mkhan po de mad de/ dge stong mgo reg 'di dag ni lha'i zhal zas la longs spyad ⑩pa'i 'os ma lags kyi nas rul pa 'tshal yiba'i 'os lags so/ /de na ⑫yang bram ze'i khye'u dkar po can gnyis shig gis smras pa/ mkhan pos ni ma legs pa zhig gsungs te/ bdag nyid chen po 'di dag ni lha'i zhal zas la longs spyod pa'i 'os lags so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi bram ze lnga brgya can gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin te/ ngas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la ngag gi las rtsub mo 0phyung ba gang yin pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas nga 8lo mang po dang / lo brgya phrag mang po dang / lo stong phrag mang po dang / lo brgya stong phrag mang por nas rul pa zos so/ /las kyi lhag ma de kho nas da ltar mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa na yang dgra tsomathar dge slong gnyis kyis lnga brgyar ma tshang ba'i dge slong rnams dang thabs cig nas rul pa la longs spyad do/ /bram ze'i khye'u gnyis po gang yin pa de ni dge slong shā tsori'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu 'di dag nyid yin no/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 3—7

'das kyis phrin las ci zhig mdzad na phrin las de'i rnam par smin pas lo drug tu dka' ba spyad par gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan rnams su las rnams byas shing bsags pa dag ni zhes bya ba nas/ 'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o①/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba ljongs kyi grong rdal bee sgyi snying gi ②zhes bya ba 'byor pa dang rgyas pal/ bde ba dang / lo legs pa/ skye bo dang / mi mang pos rab tu gang ba zhig yod de / dge slong dag ljongs kyi grong rdal bee sgyi ṭing gi na rdza mkhan dga' skyong zhes bya ba sangs rgyas la mngon par dad pa/ chos dang dge 'dun la mngon par dad pa/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song ba/ chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su song ba/ sangs rgyas la gcig tu byed pa/ chos dang dge 'dun la gcig tu byed pa/ sangs rgyas la yid gnyis dang the tshom dumed pa/ chos dang dge 'dun la yid gnyis dang the tshom med pa/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung dang / 'gog pa dang / lam la yid gnyis dang the tshom med pa/bden pa mthong ba/ 'bras bu thob pa/ lo ma dang / gtun spangs pa zhig byung ste/ de gang na chus brkos rjopa'am/ byi brun ma gtogs pa rang gi lag gis sa ⑥mi rko ༅zhing skur mi 'jug dugo/ /de nas rang gis sa blangs nas srog chags med pa'i chus sbrus te snod rnams byas nas mtha' gcig tu bzhag ⑨ste/'di skad ces 'phags pa'am/ bzhin bzangs tho)dag 'dir til lam/'bras sam/ sran mud tho)ga tshal tshol 'dag mtha' gcig tu zhog la/ khyed cag las gang zhig snod gang dgos pa de de long la deng 4)shig ces smras nas/3—8

de nas pha ma long ba gnyis gso zhing dus dus ①su yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la bsod snyoms 'bul lo/ /bram ze'i khye'u bla ma'i grogs po dang / snying du sdug pa dang / ne'u zla yang yin no/ /dge slong dag ljongs kyi grong khyer labee sgyi ṭing gi na bram ①zi shing sā dul chen po lta bu n+ya gro dha zhes bya ba phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba zhig byung ste/ bee sgyi snying gi rgyas pa/ 'du thang dang bcas rtswa ②shing dang 'bab chur bcas pa/ rgyal po kṛ kris 0bram ze'i sbyin par byin pa la yongs su longs tshuspyod do/ /bram ze shing sā ⑧la ①chen po lta bu n+ya gro dha'i slob ma bram ze'i 0khye'u bla ma zhes bya ba pha dang ma'i ⑪rigs dang ldan pa/ mo phyogs nas dag pa/ mes po'i phyogs dang ⑫/ phyi mo'i phyogs zung bdun rgyud kyi 'bar gyis 8bzung ste/ rigs la gtam gyis ma phog pa/ klog tu 'jug pa/ gsang 0tshig 'dzin pa/ rig byed gsum po sgra nges par sbyar tsob dang / shes gsal dang bcas pa'i yi gī rab tu 'byed pa dang bcas pa dang / lnga pa de lta bu byung ba can rnams kyis pha 0rol tu phyin cing lung 8ston par byed pa/ gzugs bzang ba/ blta yin sdug pa/ mdzes pa zhig yod de/ bram ze gu shing tsā 0la chen po lta bu n+ya gro dha'i bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya tsam la bram ze rnams kyi gsang tshig klog tu 'jug go/ /rdza mkhan dga' skyong gi grogs po dang / snying du sdug pa dang ne'u zla yang yin no/ /de nas rdza mkhan dga' skyong yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gang dun ba der 4)song ste phyin pa dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung ⑥gi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung shyi3—9

gis rdza mkhan dga' skyong la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod ①par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug② /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo / /de nas rdza mkhan dga' skyong yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung ②gis gsungs 0pa la mngon par dga' ste rjes su yi rangs ⑤nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te stan las langs nas dusong ngo / /de'i tshe bram ze'i khye'u bla ma ⑦rta rgod ma dang ldan pa'i shing rta thams cad nas dkar ba'i nang du zhugs te/gser gyi ril ba dang / dbyug pa thogs nas bram ze'i khye'u'i latshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing / bram ze'i khye'u'i ①tshogs kyis mdun du bdar nas/bee gi ṭing gi phyi rol du bram ze tho)rnams klog tu 'jug par 'dod nas/ bee sgyi ṭing gi nas skyebyung ba dang bram ze'i khye'u bla mas rdza mkhan dga' skyong thag ring po kho na nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di skad ces smras so/ /des pa dga' skyong khyod tsod gzod ga las 'ongs/ des pa bla ma kho bo ni 'o ni nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung tsol bsnyen ④bkur byed du 'gros ⑫des pa bla ma tshur shog /bdag cag yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la bsnyen 0bkur byed du 'dong ngo / /des pa dga' skyong yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la bsnyen ⑩bkur byed pa thong 8shig /dge sbyong mgo reg de la byang chub ga la yod/ byang chub ni mchog tu dka' ba yin no//3—10

des pa bla ma dge sbyong mgo reg de la byang chub ga la yod/ byang chub ni mchog tu dka' ba'o ①zhes de skad ma smra zhig /'on kyang bcom ldan 'das de nyid sangs rgyas yin te/ 'dis chos thams cad sangs rgyas so/ /des pa bla ma tshur bdag cag yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la bsnyen bkur byed du 'dong / bram ze'i khye'u bla mas lan gnyis ②lan gsum du yang rdza mkhan dga' skyong la 'di skad ces smras so/ /des pa dga' skyong thong ②shig /sangs rgyas 'od srung zhes bya ba nas/ byang chub ni dumachog tu dka' ba'o ⑤zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /rdza mkhan dga' skyong gis kyang lan gnyis lan gsum du bram ze'i khye'u bla ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /des pa bla ma khyod de skad ma smra bar zhes bya ba nas/ bsnyen bkur byed du zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /de nas rdza mkhan dga' skyong gis bram ze'i khye'u bla ma'i shing rta dul 'dzegs nas bram ze'i khye'u bla ma'i co to nas bzung ste/ 'di skad ces smras so//des pa bla ma ༅tshur yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung ⑧la bsnyen bkur byed du 'dong / de nas bram ze'i khye'u bla ma 'di snyam du sems te/ e ma'o sangs rgyas ni mchog ma yin pa ma yin zhing chos bstan pa yang mchog ma yin pa ma yin pas da ①ltar rdza mkhan dga' skyong yun ring po nas gtum po ma yin/gzu lums can tho) ma yin/ brlang po ma yin bsri ba med pa ma yin pa des bdag gi yispa rnams 8bzung bar gyur to snyam du rig nas/ rdza mkhan dga' skyong la 'di skad ces smras so/ /des pa dga' skyong de tsam bya ba la thug gam/des pa 8de tsam bya ba la thug ces 8so/ /des pa dga' skyong de lta na thong 8shig dang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la bsnyen bkur byed du 3—11

'dong ngo / /de nas rdza mkhan dga' skyong dang bram ze'i khye'u bla ma shing rta gcig gi nang du zhugs ①nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gang na ba ②der dong ste/ de gnyis kyis 0ji tsam bzhon pa'i sa'i bar ༷du bzhon ⑤pas song nas bzhon pa las babs te/ rkang pa kho nas kun dga' ra ba'i nang du zhugs te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gang na ba der phyin pa dang / de nas rdza mkhan dga' skyong gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /bram ze'i khye'u bla mas 0ni bcom ldan 'das dang lhan cig mngon du yang dag par dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / yang dag par mgu ⑦bar 'gyur ba'i gtam rnam pa sna tshogs byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas rdza mkhan dga' skyong gis thal mo sbyar ba btud de ⑧yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gang na ba de logs su ⑨'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bram ze'i khye'u bla ma 'di sangs rgyas la mngon par ma dad cing chos dang dge 'dun la mngon par ma dad lags na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar bram ze'i khye'u bla ma 'di sangs rgyas la mngon par dad cing chos dang dge 'dun la mngon par dad par 'gyur ba'i chos ()de lta bu (sprelegs par bshad du gsol/ de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis 'bram ze'i khye'u bla ma la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/ rnam grangs 'du mar chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstanatso/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang 3—12

dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo / /de nas bram ze'i khye'u bla mas rdza mkhan dga' skyong la 'di skad ces smras so/ /des pa dga' skyong khyod chos 'dul ba 'di lta bu thos na ①ci'i phyir dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu mi 'byung ②/des pa bla ma kho bo 'di ltar pha ma long ba gnyis gso ba dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la dus dus su bsod snyoms du'abul ba khyod kyis mi shes sam/ des pa bla ma khyod rab tu byung ④shig /kho bo ni re zhig rab tu mi 'byung ngo / /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la rdza mkhan dga' skyong gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bram ze'i khye'u bla ma 'di legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa ⑤dge slong gi dngos po 'thob 0pa lta na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑦thugs brtse ba ninye bar bzung ste/ rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ bram ze'i khye'u bla mas legs par gsungs ⑨pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ⑩ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po thob par gyur to/ /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis bram ze'i khye'u bla ma rab tu phyung ⑩zhing bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad nas/ bee nyi snying gir ji tsam bzhed kyi bar du bzhugs nas bā rā ṇa sī gang na ba der rgyu zhing gshegs te rim gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa dang bā rā ṇa srir byon to/ /rgyal po kṛ khris yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung yul ka shi tsonas ljongs ⑫rgyu zhing gshegs pa dang bā rā ṇa sīr gshegs te④/ bā rā ṇa sī'i 'drang srong smra ba ri dgas ⑩kyi nags na bzhugs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang yang dag 3—13

par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gang ①na ba der song ste/ phyin pa dang ②yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi ①zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis rgyal po kṛ tī la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/ rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcugaX / yang dag par gzengs bstod/⑤ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas ducang mi gsung ngo / /de nas rgyal po kṛ tī stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus ⑦mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs ②te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gang na ba de 0logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig la sang bdag gis gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis rgyal po kṛ tī la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo ⑩/ /de nas rgyal po kṛ khris yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung cang mi ⑪gsung bas gnang bar rig nas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te stan las langs nas 8song ngo / /de nas rgyal po kṛ khris de nyid kyi nub mo nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang / bca' ba rnams sta gon byas nas nang par sngar ()langs te gdan 3—14

bshams/ nor bu'i chu snod bzhag nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la dus tshod gsol pa/ btsun pa gdugs tshod bshams ①lags shing mchis na bcom ldan 'das da ②de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol/ de nas ③yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung 0snga dro na bza' sham thabs mnabs lhung bzed dang chos gos bsnams te/ dge slong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing / dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis mdun du ⑤bdar te/ rgyal po kṛ gri'i bkad sa gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi rjogung la gdan ⑦bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po kṛ kris sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bde bar bzhugs zin par rig nas gtsang zhing bsod ⑧pa'i bza' ba dang / bca' ba rnams kyis rang gi lag nas stobs shing 0tshim par byed de/ gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba rnams kyis rang gi lag nas bstabs shing tshim ⑩par byas te⑩/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis gsol zin nas phyag bcabs te/lhung bzed gyu bar rig 8nas stan ches dma' 8ba zhig blangs te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung 8gi spyan sngar gsol ba btab pa bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun byadang thabs cig la bdag gis dgung ⑩zla gsum du na bza' chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / gzims cha dang / snyun ⑩dpyad kyi rkyen sman gyi yo byad rnams 'bul phyezhing / bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑥slad du gtsug lag khang lnga brgya tsam brtsig 0cing khri dang khri'u dang /stan nang tshangs can dudang / sngas nang tshangs can dang / gor bu lnga brgya tsam dbul duzhing 'bras sgrubs su smin pa de lta bu du'adis bcom ldan 'das dge 3—15

slong gi dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur bgyid lags na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/rgyal po chen po ji tsam sems mngon par dad par byas pa de tsam gyis byas zin gyis ①chog go/ /lan gnyis lan ②gsum du yang sridag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la rgyal po kṛ khris 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig la zhes bya ba nas/ bdag la gnang bar mdzad du gsol zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /lan gnyis lan gsum du yang yang rjodag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis rgyal po kṛ tī la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po ji tsam sems mngon par dad par byas pa de tsam gyis byas zin gyis chog dugo/ /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la rgyal po kṛ kris 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das la bsnyen ༷bkur bgyid pa/ dper na da ltar gyi bdag 'dra ba gzhan ༷'ga' lta mchis lags sam/ rgyal po chen po khyod nyid kyi niyul na bai gi snying gi zhes bya ba'i grong ⑨yod de/ de na rdza mkhan dga' skyong zhes bya ba sangs rgyas la mngon par dad pa zhes bya ba 0nas gnas so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /des pha ma long ba gnyis gso zhing dus dus su nga la yang bsod snyoms kyis stobs 0par byed de⑩/ rgyal po chen po dus gcig cig na nga bai bhi ṭing gi'i ljongs kyi grong rdal na nye bar bsten 4)cing bzhugs nas snga dro sham thabs mnabs ④te lhung bzed dang chos gos bsnams tsonas/ bai rnyi ṭing ⑫gi ljongs kyi grong rdal du bsod snyoms la zhugs 0te/ ngas bai bhi snying gir bsod snyoms spyod cing rdza mkhan dga' skyong gi khyim gang na ba der gshegs pa dang / de'i tshe rdza mkhan dga' skyong dgos pa zhig la phyi logs su song nas/3—16

ngas ཿrdza mkhan dga' skyong gi sgo 'phar la rim gyis dal bu ②dal bus brdungs pa las rdza mkhan dga' skyong gi pha dang ①mas sgo 'phar la brdungs pa'i sgra thos so//thos nas kyang 'di skad ces smras duso/ /'phags pa 'di su zhig bzhin bzangs 'di su zhig rdza mkhan dga' skyong gi sgo 'phar la rdung ⑤/ de gnyis la ngas 'di skad ces smras te/ nga ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung yin te bsod snyoms bzhed do/ /de gnyis kyis du'adi skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa nang du spyon cig /bzhin bzangs nang du spyon cig /khyod la rim gro ⑦bgyid pa ni slad rol du mchis kyis ②phu ba ⑨na zan dron 0dang rje'u yin sran tshod mchis kyis 8nyid kyis bzhes te longs spyad du gsol/ rgyal po chen po ngas 0byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi dus byin gyis brlabs nas phru ba na zan dron dang /rje'u na sran tshod yod pa de ④nyid kyis blangs nas longs spyad ⑩do/ /de nas phyi zhig na rdza mkhan dga' skyong 'ongs nas phru ba na zan dron dang rdze'u na 0sran tshod yod pa zos par mthong nas pha ⑩ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /yab yum phru ba na 8zan dron dang rje'u'i yisran tshod su zhig gis 'tshal lags/ de gnyis kyis 'di skad ces smras so/ /dga' skyong khyod 'di nas phyir byung ba na bdag cag gis 0sgo 'phar la rdung ba'i 0sgra zhig thos so/ /thos nas ⑤'di skad ces smras so / /'phags pa 'di su zhig bzhin bzangs 'di su zhig sgo 'phar la rdung /des 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /nga ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung yin te bsod snyoms bzhed do/ /de la bdag cag ()gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /'phags pa nang du spyon cig /bzhin bzangs nang du spyon cig /khyod la rim gro bgyid pa ni slad rol du mchis kyis 'phru ba na zan dron 3—17

dang / rje'u na sran tshod mchis kyis ①nyid kyis bzhes la longs spyad du gsol/des de dag longs spyad par gyur lato/ /de nas rdza mkhan dga' skyong 'di snyam du sems te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis bdag gi khyim du shin tu bag phab cing 'dris par gyur pa ni bdag gis rnyed pa legs par rnyed do snyam nas dga' ba dang rab tu dga' bas skyil mo krung ②bcas te zhag bdun 'das par byas so/ /zla ba phyed kyi bar du yang de'i lhan cig ldan pa'i dga' ba lus dumi 'dor zhing de rtag tu lus la bar chad med par 'dug go/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / lha rnams kyi lha'i mthus zhag bdun gyi bar du pha dang ma gnyis kyi ⑤phu ba'i zan dron dang rje'u'i rjosran tshod kyang de bzhin du 'dug go rgyal po chen po dus gcig ⑦na nga bee bhi snying ⑧gi ljongs kyi 0grong rdal du nye bar brten te dbyar gnas par dam bzhes pa dang /nga'i ⑩gtsug lag khang du char 'bebs pa'i lhas thog mar char phab par gyur to/ /de'i tshe rdza mkhan dga' skyong gi las byed pa'i khang pa rtswa sar 7pas g.yogs so/ / nga'i zhabs 8'bring byed pa tsodage slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed cag deng tsol rdza mkhan dga' skyong gi las byed pa'i khang pa'i g.yogs mas nga'i gtsug lag khang g.yogs shig /btsun 8pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes dge slong de rnams kyis nga las mnyan yinas/ rdza mkhan dga' skyong gi las byed pa'i khang pa'i g.yogs ma 'chu bar byed pa na/ de'i tshe rdza mkhan dga' skyong dgos pa 'ga' zhig la phyi rol tu song ngo / /rdza mkhan dga' skyong gi pha dang ma gnyis kyis las byed pa'i khang pa'i g.yogs ma ⑩'chu ba'i sgra thos so/ /thos nas kyang 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa 'di su zhig bzhin bzangs 3—18

'di su zhig las byed pa'i khang pa'i ①g.yogs ma 'chu/ de rnams kyis 'di skad ces smras so/ /kho bo cag ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi zhabs ②'bring ba'i dge slong dag yin te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi gtsug lag khang du char 'bebs pa'i lhas thog mar char phab pas kho bo cag gis 'di bshus te de g.yogs sol/ /de gnyis kyis 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyed la rim gro bgyid pa ni slad rol du mchis kyisadu/'phags pa dag snoms shig /bzhin bzangs dag snoms sheg /de nas dge slong de rnams kyis las byed pa'i khang pa bshus ⑤nas nga'i gtsug lag khang g.yogs so/ /de nas phyi zhig na rdza mkhan dga' skyong 'ongs nas rdza mkhan dga' skyong gis las byed pa'i khang pa'i g.yogs ma bshus pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang pha dang ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /yab yum las byed pa'i khang pa du'adi su zhig gis bshus de gnyis kyis 'di ⑦skad ces smras so/ /'di nas khyod phyi logs su song ba na bdag cag gis las byed pa'i khang pa'i ⑧g.yogs ma 'chu ba'i ①sgra thos so/ /thos nas kyang 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa 'di su zhig bzhin bzangs 'di su zhig las byed pa'i khang pa 'chuyi/de rnams kyis ⑩'di skad ces smras so/ /kho bo cag ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi zhabs 'bring chub dge slong dag yin te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi gtsug lag khang du char 'bebs 8pa'i lhas thog mar char phab 8pas kho bo cag gis 'di bshus la de g.yogs sobya/ /de rnams la bdag cag gis 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyed cag la rim gro bgyid pa ni slad rol du mchis kyis ⑩'phags pa dag snoms ⑩shig /bzhin bzangs 3—19

dag snoms ①shig /de rnams kyis las byed pa'i khang pa ②de bshus so/ /de nas rdza mkhan dga' skyong 'di snyam du sems te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis ③bdag gi khyim du shin tu bag phab cing 'dris par gyur pa ni bdag gis ༷rnyed pa legs par rnyed do zhes bya ba nas zhag bdun du zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang lha rnams kyi lha'i mthus rdza mkhan dga' skyong gi pha ma'i dbyar gyi gnas der las byed pa'i khang par char pa thigs pa gcig kyang ma bab dubo/ /rgyal po chen po khyod ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung zla ba gsum du na bza' chos gos dang / bsod snyoms rjodang / gzims cha dang /snyun dpyad ⑦kyi rkyen sman gyi yo byad rnams 'bul na ma gnang ngo / /zhes khyod kyi sems gzhan du 'gyur gyi②/ dga' skyong ni las byed pa'i khang pa'i g.yogs ma bshus kyang sems gzhan du ma gyur to/ /btsun pa rdza mkhan dga' skyong gis ni 8thob pa legs par thob ( )lags te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i sdum ⑪par shin tu bag phab cing 'dris par gyur lags so/ /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis rgyal po kṛ khri'i sbyin pa de la rjes su yi rang ba 'dis rjes su yi rang bar mdzad de/ sbyin sreg tsomachod sbyin rnams kyi mchog / bde sbyor tsomachog ni nyi ma'i lha/ / mi yi tsomachog ni rgyal po ste/ /rgya mtsho chu bo rnams 8kyi mchog /zla ba rgyu skar rnams kyi gtso/ /nyi ma snang byed rnams kyi gtso/ /steng dang 'og dang thad kur yang / /'gro ba'i 'gro ba ji snyed pa/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /smra ba'i mchog ni rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung tu)gis 3—20

rgyal po kṛ tī la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas gdan las bzhengs ①te gshegs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gshegs nas ring po ma lon par rgyal po kṛ kris mi zhig la smras pa/ kwa'i nang rje khyod song la sbubs su smin pa'i 'bras kyis shing rta lnga brgya tsam khong ②la/ rdza mkhan dga' skyong gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / de la ①'di skad ces des pa dga' skyong rgyal po kṛ kris khyod la sbubs su smin pa'i 'bras kyis bkang ba'i shing rta lnga brgya tsam po 'di dag bskur gyis du'adis khyod kyi pha ma long ba gnyis dugaso ba dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la dus dus su bsod snyoms dbul 0ba dang / bdag nyid kyang legs par bde bas tshim par byos shig /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes mi des rgyal po kṛ khri las mnyan nas sbubs su smin pa'i 'bras kyis shing rta lalnga brgya tsam bkang ste/ rdza mkhan dga' skyong gang na ba der song nas phyin pa dang / rdza mkhan dga' skyong la 'di skad ces smras so/ /des pa dga' skyong rgyal po kṛ khris khyod dul sbubs su smin pa'i 'bras kyis bkang ba'i shing rta lnga brgya tsam po 'di dag bskur gyisal/ 'dis khyod kyi pha ma long ba gnyis gso ba dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la bsod snyoms dbul ba dang /bdag nyid kyang legs par bde bas tshim par byos shig ces gsung ngo / /kye nang rje rgyal po kṛ tī ni dgos pa mang zhing bya ba mang ba yin la/ bdag ni dgos pa nyung zhing bya ba nyung ba yin no zhes smras nas ma blangs so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi bram ze'i khye'u bla ma gang yin pa de 3—21

ni nga nyid yin te/ ngas gang zag la skur ①gyi byang chub la ma yin pa gang yin pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas byang chub kyi snying por dka' ②ba lo drug spyad do//gal te ngas byang chub la bskur ②bar gyur na/ ngas slar yang bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du byang chub kyi ched du bdag nyid shin tu dub par 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis phrin las ci zhig mdzad na/ phrin las de'i rnam par smin pas mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa dun yang bcom ldan 'das la 'khru ba'i snyan gyis thebs ⑤lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan rnams su las 'di dag dubyas shing bsags pa zhes bya ba nas/ 'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin no/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba ri 'or ⑦zhig na sman pa zhig yod pa las de na khyim bdag cig gi bu nad kyis thebs nas/des sman pa de bkug ste dris nas des de la sman byin pas sos par gyur na/khyim bdag des de la rngan pa ma byin no/ /khyim bdag gi bu de lan gsum gyi bar du nad kyis thebs te/ sman pa des lan gsum gyi bar du sos par byas kyang des de la rngan pa ma byin nas de nas sman pa de kun nas dkris pa drag pos mi ⑧bzod par gyur nas bsams pa/ khyim bdag gi bu 'di bdag gis lan gsum gyi bar du dpyad byas kyang ⑨'dis cung zad kyang lan du phan ma btags kyis0/ da ni brgya yil nad kyis thebs par gyur 8dang / de la sman ma yin pa gang zhig gis de'i nang grol rnams dum bu dum bur 'dzag par 'gyur ba de lta bu sbyin no snyam pa las ji tsam na khyim bdag de'i bu ma bde ste 0slar na bar gyur pa dang ⑫/ sman pa des mi bzod pa skyes pasabya/ de la sman ma yin pa byin 3—22

nas des ①nang grol rnams dum bu dum bur ②zags so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi sman pa gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin te/ngas ngan sems kyis dukhyim bdag gi 0bu la sman ma yin pa byin pas ⑤des nang grol rnams dum bu dum bur zags ①pa gang yin pa de'i las de'i ⑦rnam par smin pas lo mang po zhes bya ba nas/ sems can dmyal ba rnams su btsos so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /las de'i lhag ma de kho nas da ltar mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa ⑧na yang 'khru ba'i snyan gyis thebs so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis phrin las ci zhig mdzad na/ phrin las de'i rnam par smin pas shākya rnams bkum pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu snyun rab tu drag pos thebs par gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis sngon gyi 0tshe rabs gzhan rnams su 'di dag byas shing bsags pa zhes bya ba nas/ 'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba chu bo gnyen ldan gyi 'gram na nya pa lnga brgya rten ⑩cing gnas te⑩/ de rnams kyis nya shin tu che ba gnyis 0shig ji 0ltar gnyen ldan gyi nang du zhugs te nyal ba zin pa dang /de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ gal te 'di gnyis bsad na sha lom par mi 'gyur zhing rul bar 8'gyur ro snyam nas de rnams kyis de gnyis phur pa la btags nas bzhag go/ /gang gi tshe lan 'ga' zhig ⑩nyo bar tso'ongs pa de'i tshe bcad cing bcad cing sbyin par byed do/ /de gnyis kyi ⑦lus la gcod pa na sdug bsngal gyi tshor bas nyen pas rdzirang gi 8ris mthun 0pa'i skad 'byin pas 'bo 0sgra 'don par byed do/ /de na nya pa'i khye'u gcig cig de gnyis kyi sha 3—23

gcod pa na yang dang ①yang du 'bo ⑤sgra 'don pa la dga' bar gyur to/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi nya pa'i khye'u gang yin pa de ni nga yin te/ ngas nya gsod par byed pa dul dga' ba bskyed 0pa gang yin pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas nga lo mang po zhes bya ba nas/ klad ⑤pa na bar gyur to zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /las kyi lhag ma de kho nas da ltar mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa dun yang shākya rnams bsad pa na klad ⑦nad rab tu drag pos thebs par gyur to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis phrin las ci zhig mdzad na/ phrin las de'i rnam par smin pas mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa ⑧na yang bcom ldan 'das kyi 0sku rgyab bser ma'i snyan gyis thebs par gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa nyid ⑩kyis sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan rnams su las 'di dag byas shing bsags pas ⑩zhes bya ba nas/ 'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba gyad gcig gis yul ljongs kyi rgyad thams cad brdabs nas rgyal po'i pho brang du phyin pa dang /rgyal po'i pho brang de na rgyal po'i gyad stobs dang pha rol gnon pa 'thub rlag (nyepa zhig yod de/ de de dang lhan cig rgyal mtshan gyi phyir stobs 'gyed pa la zhugs so/ /rgyad de dag gi kun tu spyod pa ni lag pa nas bzung ba kho yinas gyad kyis rgyad shes pa yin pas/ de nas rgyal po'i gyad des yul ljongs kyi gyad 'di ni bdag pas stobs che'o zhes bya bar shes nas des ⑩smras pa/ ne'u zla bdag gi 'di ni rigs kyi rgyud ⑩kyis 'ongs pa yin gyis0/ khyod bdag nyid 'gyel bar byos shig dang / bdag la ni 8grags par zad la ru mtshon ni khyod kyi yin 3—24

par 'gyur ro/ /des khas blangs pa dang / des de mnan nyuto/ /des ru mtshon blang bar ②brtsams pa dang / des smras pa/ ne'u zla sgyu'am ③mthus rgyal ba don du gnyer ba yin pa las khyod ngas sgyus dubaslus na/ ci'i phyir ru mtshon sbyin bdag nyid chen po de nga rgyal bcom pa zhig pas lan gsum gyi bar du rgyad ⑤de dang lhan cig 'gyed par duzhugs pa na yang de la bslu bar brtsams pa na ne'u zla khyod la ru mtshon ⑦gyis ci zhig bya bdag gi sring mo phyugs chung ma khyim thab la ma song ba zhig yod pa de khyod la sbyin gyis ⑧bdag nyid 'gyel bar byos shig /bslus pa de de'i chung mas thos nas des smras pa/ rje'i sras snga ma'i gleng gzhi ⑨dag dgongs sam/ de nas de'i 0chung mas nga rgyal bskyed nas kun nas dkris pa drag pos de bteg ste/ brdabs pas de sgal ⑩tshigs chag nas shi'o/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi yul ljongs kyi gyad gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin te/ ngas ngan sems bskyed nas kun nas dkris 8pa 'drag pos rgyal po'i gyad sgal ④tshigs bcag 8pa gang yin pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas nga lo mang po dang / lo brgya phrag mang po dang / lo stong phrag mang po dang / lo brgya stong phrag mang po rnams su sems can dmyal ba rnams su btsos so/ /las kyi lhag ma de kho nas da ltar mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa yin yang nga'i 0skal tho)tshigs rlung nad kyis thebs par gyur to/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag pa rnams dang zhes bya ba nas brtsal bar tsobya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis ༷de lta bu la bslab par bya'o zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin no 0// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po lnga bcu ( )drug pa/ thams cad zil gnon 3—25

thams cad gzigs/ /thub pa 'jig rten kun la sman/ /sred pa thams cad zad pa brnyes/ /sbyor ba kun gyi mthar phyin mdzad/ /thams cad mkhyen cing thams cad rig /thub chen thams cad mngon par mkhyen/ /'khon ①dang 'jigs pa kun las 'das/ /chos kun gyi ni pha rol gshegs/ /bsam pa kun la mkhas pa po/ /sred ②pa thams cad rab tu bcom/ /sems can kun la phan dgongs pa/ /mdud pa thams cad rab tu grol/ /bag la nyal kun bcad nas ni/ /'ching ba thams cad yang dag bcad/ /sems can kun gyi mchog rab ste/ /thub pa chos rnams ston par mdzad/ /sems can ③chen po shes rab che/ /brtson 'grus chen po grags pa che/ /chos chen 'od ni chen po pa / /chos chen don gyi pha rol gshegs/ /klu chen seng ge chen po pa/ /dge slong chen po drang srong che/ /shes rab chen po'i dural gri mtshon/ /nyon mongs chen po rab tu bcom/ /stobs dang brtson 'grus rab tu che/ /brtan ⑤pa chen po pha rol gnon/ /byang chub chen po brnyes pa gang / /dgra chen rnams las rnam par rgyal/ /nad chen po yi dpyad mdzad pas/ /bcom ldan sman pa chen po lags/ /'dod chags chen po zil gnon la/ /sman chen po ni stsol ba po/ /'khor ba chen po'i btson dur na/ /'ching ba chen pos bcings rnams la/ /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas/ /'ching ba kun las grol bar mdzad/ /skyes bu chen po lha chen po/ /tshogs rnams kyi ni tshogs chen ldan/ /sbyin pa'i mchog ni sbyin chen po/ /zhi ba chen po'i 0go 'phang reg/sems can mchog ste drang srong mchog /de bzhin rnam par 'dren mchog brnyes//nyan thos mchog ni phun sum tshogs/ /chos kyi mchog ni rab ston pa/ /shin 3—26

tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i mchog /yon gnas rnams kyi mchog tu 'os/ /rnam par grol ba rnams kyi mchog /mtshan ni mchog rab kun dang ldan/ /bcom ldan srid las rab tu grol/ /srid pa'i dga' ba las 'phags pa/ /srid pa'i 'dod chags kun nas bcad/ /srid pa'i sred pa rab tu bcom/ /chos chen po ni bsgoms pas ①na/ /'jigs dang 'jigs su rung ba spangs/ / klu yi ②rgyal po rnams kyi gnas/ /ma dros pa yi ②mtsho chen du/ /thams cad bya ba byas pa yi/ /nyan thos rnams kyi dumadun byas te/ /lnga brgya rnams dang thabs cig tu/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni mkha' las ⑤gshegs/ /chu bo de yi 'gram dag tu/ /smra ba'i mchog ni bzhugs nas ni/ /rjes su brtse ba thugs rje can/ /lus can kun la phan mdzad pas/ /mtsho la gzigs nas dge slong la/ /'di skad ces ni bka' stsal to/ /ngas ni sdig pa gang byas dang / /nga yi tshig 'di mnyan ༷par gyis/ /ngas ni sngon gyi tshe rabs su/ /g.yon can pad ma'i rtsa lag gyur/ /rang sangs rgyas ni legs smon te/ /skyon med la ni skur btab nasargya/ /skye bo'i tshogs chen lhags ⑧nas su/ /thub pa chos kyi yon tan dga'/ /bcing ba dam pos de bcings nas/ /grong khyer nas ni phyung ba dang / /dge sbyong bcing bas dam bcings pasal/ /sdug bsngal gyur de ting yis mthong / /de la snying rje bskyed nas kyang / /nga nyid kyis ni thar bar byas//las kyi rnam par smin pa des/ /dmyal ba rnams su yun rings 0'phangs/ /slar yang mir ni 'ongs pa na/ /ngas ni skur pa thob par gyur/ /de nas las kyi lhag mas kyang / /nga yi yang srid tha ma la/ /mu stegs rnams kyis mdzes ma'i phyir/ /yang dag ma yin skur pa btab/ /nga sngon bram zer gyur pa na/ /3—27

gsang tshig 'dzin cing mang thos pa/ /bram ze lnga brgya rnams la ni/ /tshal na gsang tshig brjod pa'i tshe/ /mngon shes lnga ldan rdzu 'phrul che/ /byin can ①drang srong der 'ongs pa/ / bkur ste ②byed pa ngas mthong nas/ /skyon med la ni skur ③pa btab/ /drang srong 'di ni 'dod spyod ces/ /ngas ni bram ze'i khye'u la smras/ /bram ze'i khye'u rnams nga yi tshig /thos nas rjes su yi rang zhing / /de nas bram ze'i khye'u rnams kyis/ /khyim dang khyim du slong ba na/ /drang srong 'di ni 'dod spyod ces/ /skye bo mang po dag la smras/ /las kyi rnam par smin pa des/ /dge slong lnga brgya dudag dang yang / /mdzes ma dukho na'i rgyu las ni/ /skur pa dag ni thob par gyur/ /sangs rgyas thams cad zil non gyisaX / /nyan thos gyur pa gnas 'jog bu/ /de tshe dge sbyong de la ni/ /ngas ni mi bden skur ⑦pa btab/ /sdig pa'i las de byas pas na/ /mi bzad ngan 'gror song nas ni/ /sems can dmyal ba rnams su skyes/ /sdug bsngal tshor ba nyams su myong / /de nas las kyi lhag mas ni/ /nga la bram ze rtsa dumis 'dir / /skye bo'i tshogs ni 'dus pa na/ /yang dag ma yin skur pa btab/ /nor gyi phyir ni skyon med par/ /ngas ni g.yas khyim nu bo ni/ /ri yi gseb tu bcug ⑨nas su/ /ngas ni rdo ba dag gis bsnun/ /las kyi rnam par smin pa des / /dmyal ba dag tu yun rings ⑩'phangs/ /rab tu tsha dang thig nag gi/ /sdug bsngal tshor ba myong bar gyur/ /de nas las kyi lhag mas ni/ /lha sbyin gyis ni rdo 'phangs te/ /nga yi zhabs kyi mthe yibo ni/ /rdo ba'i dum bus rma yang phyung / /rgya mtsho yi ni gru bo chesatso/ /rgya mtsho la ni 'gro ba na/ /gru na 'dug pa'i tshong pa ni/ /mdung thung rnon pos bsad par gyur/ /las kyi rnam 3—28

par smin pa des/ /dmyal ba rnams su yun rings ①'phangs/ /de yi las kyi lhag mas nga'i/ /zhabs la tshal pas zug ②par gyur/ /sngon ni nya pa'i grong khyer gyi/ /nya pa'i bur ni gyur pa na/ /nya rnams gsod ②par byed pa dang / /yid dga' ba ni skyes par gyur/ /las kyi rnam par smin pa des/ /nga ni dmyal bar yun rings du'aphangs/ /rab tu tsha dang thig nag dang / /sdug bsngal mang po myong bar gyur/ /de nas las kyi lhag mas ni/ /gang gi tshe na 'phags skyes pos⑤/ /shākya rnams ni gsod pa na/ /klad 0pa mi bzad nad kyis thebs/ /rnam par gzigs kyi gsung rab ⑦kyi/ /nyan thos yongs su smad byas te/ /khyed ni nas dag za bar 'osal/ /khyed la 'bras ni mi rigs zhes / /ngag gis 0nyes par spyad pa dang / /las kyi rnam par smin pa des/ /dmyal ba ⑨ thig nag rnams su ni/ /sdug bsngal mang po nyams su myong / /de nas las kyi lhag mas ni/ /dgra mthar dbyar ni gnas bcas te/ /bram ze yis ni spyan drangs tshe/ /zla ba gsum du nas dag 0zos/ /nga ni sman par gyur pa na6)/ /tshong dpon bu pho 'khrur 'jug tshe/ /nad kyis 0sdug bsngal gyur pa la/ /sman ma yin pa ngas byin no/ /las kyi rnam par smin pa des / /sdug bsngal mang po nyams su myong ⑫/ /de nas las kyi lhag mas ni/ /de 'dra'i 'khru ba'i nad kyis thebs/ /sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan rnams su/ /nga ni mthu can gyad gyur tshe/ /stobs dag 'gyed par byed pa na/ /ngas ni 8rgyad kyi bu zhig bsad(9/ /las kyi rnam par smin pa des/ /sdug bsngal mang po nyams su myong ⑩/ /de nas las kyi lhag mas ni/ /'di na nga yi rgyab bsnyung 8ngo / /sngon ni ngan spong 0bur gyur pa/ /dga' skyong la ni smras pa ni/ /mgo reg 3—29

ngas mthong ci zhig bya/ /'di la byang chub yod ma yin/ /ngag gis ①nyes par spyod pa dang / /las kyi rnam par smin pa des/ /'dir yang mir ni 'ongs pa na / /khyim med par ni rab byung nas/ /byang chub mchog ni 'dod pa'i phyir//lteng rgyas 'gram du lo drug tu/ /mchog tu dka' ba spyad pa ngas/ /sdug bsngal mang po nyams su myong / /sems can kun gyi rab mchog gis/ /chos kyi dam pa thugs chud nas/ /sdig pa'i las ni gang mdzad pa/ /tshogs kyi mchog la bka' stsal to/ /thams cad zil gnon stobs brnyes kyis/ /dge slong dge 'dun gung bzhugs nas/ /ma dros pa yi mtsho chen du/ /nyid kyi phrin las lung bstan to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i le'u'o// //sdom ni/ gnas 'jog ②sbyang rtsi can dang ni/ /rgyu can kauṇḍi ③rgya nye ba rjo'akhor/ /'od byed dang ni nam gru ste/ /phyi ma rgyabade bar gshegs pa yin/ /ma dros pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'o//de nas bcom ldan 'das dgra bcom pa lnga brgya dang thabs cig tu mtsho chen po ma dros par phrin las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan nas ma dros pa nas mi snang ①bar mdzad de/ mnyan yod kyi ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma'i sngon gyi kun dga' ra ba'i khang bzangs na bzhugs so/ /ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma sa gas/ bcom ldan 'das mtsho chen po ma dros pa nas mi snang bar mdzad de/ mnyan yod du gshegs nas mnyan yod kyi bdag gi khang bzangs kho na na bzhugs so zhes thos sol/ /thos nas kyang mnyan yod nas byung nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste zhes bya ba nas rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo zhes 3—30

bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin do①/ /de nas ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma sa ga stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de ②logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mtsho chen po ma dros par rang rang gi las kyi rgyu ba lung bstan pa'i dgra bcom pa lnga brgya gang dag lags pa dang thabs cig tu sang bdag gi sdum ③par gdugs tshod dusbyor zhing mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma sa gas gnang bar rig nas zhes bya ba nas/ bcom ldan 'das ⑤gsol zin nas phyag bcabs te lhung bzed gyu bar rig nas zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs nas chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 0ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma sa ga la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/yang dag par 'dzin du bcug⑦ /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas gdan las bzhengs nyute gshegs nas gtsug lag khang du byon pa dang dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma sa ga la ma rdzogs pa ⑨yod de/ des dge slong gi dge 'dun spyan drangs te gdugs tshod gsol na/'on kyang dge 'dun gyi ched du yon ma phul lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ko sa la'i 0ljongs rgyu zhing yigashegs pa na/ grong khyer thigs 8pa can du byon nas/grong khyer thigs pa can gyi byang phyogs kyi grong 8shing sha pa'i tshal na bzhugs so/ /grong khyer thigs pa can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das 3—31

ko sa la nas zhes bya ba nas shing sha pa'i tshal na bzhugs so zhes thos so ①bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /thos nas kyang tshogs nas tshogs dang khyu nas khyur phrad ②cing 'dus te grong khyer thigs pa can nas byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste lhags pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas ③te zhes bya ba nas yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas grong khyer thigs pa can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams stan las langs te④/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu sang bdag cag gi sdum 0par gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na duganang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis grong khyer thigs pa can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas grong khyer thigs pa can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas tshuganang bar rig nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas dong ngo / /de nas yi dgas rus gong sgrol ba bsgreng ba lta bu rang gi skras yog ⑧pa lto ri rab 0tsam/kha khab kyi mig tsam 'bar rab tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu 'bar te/ me lce gcig tu gyur pa lnga brgya bcom ldan 'das ga la ⑩ba der dong ⑩ste lhags pa dang /bcom ldan 'das la kun nas yongs su bskor te 'dug nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das grong khyer thigs pa can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag 'di dag ni bdag cag gi nye dur gyur pa lags na/ kye ma bcom ldan 3—32

'das kyis thugs brtse ba nye bar bzung ste/ bdag cag kho na'i ming nas yon bsngo ①ba mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ngas dam zhig bcas te②/ gal te khyed cag cha byad 'di nyid kyis yon sngo ③ba byed pa'i tshe 'ong na ni khyed cag gi ming nas yon bsngo bar dubya'o/ /de rnams kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das g.yar tsha lags na ji ltar mchi lags/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pas bka' stsal pa/ ngo tsha med la ngo tsha byed/ /ngo tsha ba la ngo mi tsha/ /'jigs pa med la 'jigs par lta/ /'jigs pa la ni mi 'jigs lta/ /log pa'i lta ba blangs pas na/ /sems can rnams ni ngan 'gror 'gro/ /ngo tsha ba la ngo tsha dang / /ngo tsha med la ngo mi tshal/ /mi 'jigs ༷pa la mi 'jigs lta0/ /'jigs pa la ni 'jigs lta ba'i//yang dag lta ba blangs pa yis/ /sems can rnams ni bde 'gror 'gro/ /de rnams kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te de lta ⑦na mchi lags so/ /de nas grong khyer thigs pa can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis de nyid ༷kyi nub mo nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag sta ①gon byas nas zhes 0bya ba nas/ stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /yi dgos lnga brgya po de dag 'ongs pa dang / de nas grong khyer thigs pa can gyi bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams kyis yi dgas rnams mthong nas 'bros par brtsams pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shes ldan dag ci'i phyir 'bros/ de rnams kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das yi dgas 'o ni dag mchis yilags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshur shog 3—33

'di dag ni khyed cag gi nye du yin no/ /gal te khyed cag gis ①gnang na ngas 'di rnams kyi ②ming gis yon bsngo'o/ /de rnams kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rung lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ②yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i gsung dbyangs kyis de rnams kyi duming nas yon bsngo ba mdzad de/sbyin pa 'di yi ⑤bsod nams gang / /de ni yi dgas rjes 'gro zhing / /'di dag yi dgas 'jig rten ni/ /mi bzad pa nas myur ldang shog /'di ༷yis gos dang skom dang zas/ /gnas mal rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /dus kun tu ni mi zad ⑦par/ /de rnams la ni grub par shog /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis grong khyer thigs pa can gyi bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas gdan las bzhengs te gshegs so/ /de nas grong khyer thigs pa can gyi bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams rtog khang du lhags shing tshogs nas 'di lta bu'i skabs kyi gtam dag gleng bar byed de/ kye dge sbyong gi ②ta ma ni 'dod zhen che zhing de'i nyan thos rnams kyang 'dod zhen che ba yin no/ /kha cig gis smras pa/shes ldan dag dge sbyong gi ta ma ni 'dod zhen chung zhing de'i nyan thos rnams kyang 'dod zhen chung ste/ mu stegs can rnams ni de lta ⑨ma yin no/ /de'i tshe bram ze smra 'dod kyi ⑩seng ge zhes bya ba 'khor de nyid du 'dus shing 'dug par gyur to//de nas bram ze smra 'dod kyi seng ges grong khyer thigs pa can gyi bram ze dang /khyim bdag rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge sbyong gi ta ma 'dod zhen che'am 'dod zhen chung ba dang / de'i nyan thos rnams 'dod zhen che'am/3—34

'dod zhen chung ba ngas khyed cag yid ches par bya'o/ /de nas bram ze smra 'dod kyi seng ges ①bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang /ci bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /shes ldan ②go ta ma dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig la bdag gis ②bca' ba bu ram zhig 'bul zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze smra 'dod kyi seng ge la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas bram ze smra 'dod kyi seng gis bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag bram ze dusmra 'dod kyi seng ge klan ⑤ka tshol bas sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams bca' ba bu ram la spyan drangs kyisaX/ khyed cag las gang gis ji tsam yog ⑦pa des de tsam zhig blang bar bya'o/ /bram ze smra 'dod kyi bu duseng ge la bu ram 'tshong ba'i khang pa lnga brgya yod pa nas des bu ram gyi khang pa re re nas bu ram gyi snod blangs te/ bu ram gyi snod lnga brgya khyer nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /shes ldan 0go ta ma bu ram bsdogs (sprelags (spen/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu bzhugs te/ longs spyad 8du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag dang lhung bzed bcabs 8nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas bram ze smra 'dod kyi seng ges bu ram gyi snod cig blangs te brim par brtsams pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi bar du brims kyang lhag pas thams cad de kho na bzhin du 'dug 3—35

pa de ltar byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas bram ze smra 'dod kyi seng ge mngon par dad par gyur to/ /de nas de dad pa skyes nas phyogs mtha' dag tu sgra bsgrags ①pa/ shes ldan dag dge sbyong ②gi ta ma ni 'dod zhen chung zhing de'i nyan thos rnams kyang 'dod zhen chung ba yin no/ /de nas des mu stegs can rnams bu ram la longs spyod du gzhug ③pa'i phyir mgron 0du bos pa dang / de rnams kyis bu ram bag med par blangs nas kha cig gis ni longs spyod dudo/ /kha cig gis ni snod bkang nas bor zhing khyer te dong ༷ngo / /de nas bram ze smra 'dod kyi seng ges smras pa/ skyes bu blun po khyed cag kho na 'dod zhen che ba yin la dge sbyong gau ta ma ni 'dod zhen chung zhing de'i nyan thos rnams kyang 'dod zhen chung ba yin no zhes ⑦smras nas/ bcom ldan 'das la lhag par yang mngon par dad par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das dang lhan cig mngon du zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la bdag ces bya ba nas tshangs par spyad par bgyi'o zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong 0tshur shog ces bya ba ⑨nas dge slong tshur shog tshangs par spyad pa spyod cig ces gsungs pa 0 zhes bya ba nas/ sangs rgyas dgongs pas lus gzugs bkab (sprepar gyur ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na rjes su gnang ste/ dus sam dus ma yin pa'am/ na ba'am mi na bas/ bu ram la longs spyad ⑩par bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par ni mi bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa smra 3—36

'dod kyi seng ge ro myags pa'i dri mi zhim pas sems rtse gcig pa nyid ma thob nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ dge slong smra 'dod kyi seng ge ni/srid pa ①tha ma ②yin na ci'i phyir bden pa ma mthong snyam du dgongs na/ lus rul pa'i dri mi zhim pa las gyur par gzigs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la dge slong smra 'dod kyi seng ge'i gtsug lag khang dri dang me tog gi phreng ba dang /bdug pa dang / phye ma rnams kyis gtor la gnas mal la yang bdug pas bdug cing me tog dri zhim pos brgyan pa'i me tog gi gdugs bres ②shig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi rjoltar mnyan to/ /ji tsam na de bsod snyoms la song ba de'i bar du de'i gtsug lag khang du song nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa ⑤bzhin thams cad byas so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa smra 'dod kyi song ge bsod snyoms la brgyus nas gtsug lag khang du 'ongs pa dang lha'i 'byor pa mthong nas/ de nas dga' ba'i yid kyis bsod snyoms la longs spyad dude zas kyi bya ba byas nas gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol du rkang pa gnyis bkrus te gtsug lag khang du zhugs nas/ skyil mo krung bcas ⑦te lus drang por bsrang dunas dran pa mngon du phyogs par der ⑨bzhag ste 'dug pa dang / dri zhim po mnam nas de'i sems mnyam par bzhag par skyes so/ /de nas des nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te / dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas nas zhes bya ba nas/ mngon du smra bar gyur to zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag nga'i dge slong dang nga'i 3—37

nyan thos sdug pas rnam par grol ba rnams kyi mchog ni 'di lta ste/ dge slong smra 'dod kyi seng ge 'di yin no/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa lasangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa dge slong gzhan rnams ni mi sdug pas rnam par grol na/ tshe dang ldan pa smra 'dod kyi seng ge sdug pas rnam par grol ba la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag 'di ni tshe rabs lnga brgya btud ②mar sum bcu ②rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams nas shi 'phos shing de nyid du skyes te/ da ltar gyi srid pa tha ma mi rnams rjosu skyes pa na ⑤yus rul ba'i dri mnam ①pas sems rtse gcig pa ma grub pa'o/ /dri zhim po'i dri mnam pa dang ⑦/ sems mnyam pa thob nas sdug pas ⑧rnam par grol bar ⑨gyur to/ /gal te 'di la thabs 'di ma byas par gyur na/ dro bar gyur pa 4)yang 'dis bskyed 0par mi 'gyur ro/ /de lta bas na rjes su gnang ste/ gzhan gang zhig sdug pa 'di lta bus rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba des rim pa de lta bu bya 0ste/ 'di la 'gyod par ni mi bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yul spong byed nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs te yangs pa can du byon nas/ yangs pa can gyi spre'u rdzing gi 'gram na khang pa brtsegs pa'i gnas na bzhugs so/ /yangs pa can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das yul spong byed nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs te yangs pa can du byon nas yangs pa can gyi spre'u rdzing gi 'gram na khang pa brtsegs pa'i gnas na bzhugs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang gcig tu 'dus nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag bcom ldan 'das yul spong byed nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs te yangs pa can du byon nas yangs pa can gyi spre'u rdzing gi 'gram na khang pa brtsegs pa'i gnas na 3—38

bzhugs so zhes grag gis①/ gal te bdag cag re re nas bcom ldan 'das spyan drangs te gdugs tshod gsol na ni/ bcom ldan 'das slar gshegs dang /gzhan gyi ②skabs mi rnyed par 'gyur bas ③de la khrims shig bcas teX/ ci nas kyang tshogs shing 'dus pa kho nas bcom ldan 'das khrugadugs tshod gsol gyi mi gcig pus ni ma yin no zhes de rnams kyis khrims su bca' ba dag byas nas bzhag go/ /de'i tshe yangs pa can gyi dubasod nams chen po dang ldan pa bzhi zhig ⑦gnas te/ nor can dang / nor can gyi chung ma dang / nor can ⑧gyi bu dang / nor can gyi mna' ⑨ma'o/ /de dag gi khyim du ni lha dang mi rnams kyi g.yang babs par gyur to/ /de rnams kyis khrims su 0bcas pa de ma thos par khyim bdag nor can gyis bcom ldan 'das yiyul spong byed nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs te yangs pa can du byon nas8/ yangs pa can gyi spre'u rdzing gi 'gram na khang pa brtsegs pa'i gnas na bzhugs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang yangs pa can nas byung nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste zhes bya ba nas yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas khyim bdag nor can stan las langs te/bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar tsonas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu sang bdag gi sdum ⑫par gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas khyim bdag nor can la gnang ngo / /de nas khyim bdag nor can gyis bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas 3—39

bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /de nas yangs pa can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams yangs pa can nas byung nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste zhes bya ba nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams dang thabs cig tu sang bdag cag gi sdum ①par gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas 'jog gi bu dag nga sngar khyim bdag nor can gyis ②spyan drangs zin to/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyim bdag nor can gyis ni tshogs kyi khrims bcas pa las 'das par byas so/ /kha cig dag ①gis smras pa/ ci ste de 'das par byed/ gdon mi za bar des khrims bcas pa ma thos so/ /'on kyang bdag cag pas de ni skyes bu dam pa yin pas gdugs tshod gsol du chug bdag cag gis ni gnangs gdugs tshod gsol lo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo nang par sngar langs te/ lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs nas/ khyim bdag nor can gyi khyim gang na ba der song ste phyin nas shar sgo nas zhugs pa dang / ji tsam na gdan ma dubashams shing zhal zas rnams sta ⑤gon ma byas pa mthong nas/ de nas khyim bdag nor can la 'di skad ces smras sol/ /khyim bdag khyod kyis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams spyan drangs nas snying las chung ngus gnas sam/ des smras pa/'phags pa kun dga' bo ci ste de skad gsung / khyim bdag gdan ma bshams shing zhal zas rnams sta gon ma byas pa mthong ngo / /'phags pa khyod chab nyusgo gang nas zhugs khyim bdag shar nas so/ /'phags pa lho nas zhugs shig /3—40

des ②zhugs pa las ji tsam na lha'i gdan bshams shing lha'i zhal zas rnams sta ②gon byas pa yang mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang shin tu ngo mtshar skyes par gyur to//de nas khyim bdag nor can gyi spyan 'dren ③gyis bcom ldan 'das la dus tshod gsol pa/ btsun pa gdugs tshod bshams lags 0shing mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das da de'i dus la bab par mkhyen par mdzad du gsol zhes bya ba nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsol zin nas phyag bcabs te lhung bzed gyu ①bar rig nas / stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas nor can gyi chung ma stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de 0logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams ⑦dang thabs cig tu sang bdag gi sdum ⑧par gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas nor can gyi chung ma la gnang ngo / /gnang nas kyang khyim bdag nor can la chos bshad pa mdzad nas gdan las bzhengs te gshegs so/ /nor can gyi chung mas kyang zhal zas rnams sta gon byas so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo nang par sngar langs te lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs nas khyim bdag nor can gyi khyim gang na ba der song ste phyin nas lho sgo nas zhugs na ⑨gdan ma bshams shing zhal zas rnams kyang sta gon ma byas par mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang nor can gyi chung ma la 'di skad ces smras so//khyim bdag gi chung ma sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun spyan drangs nas ci snying las 0chung ngus gnas sam des smras pa/ 'phags pa ci ste de skad 3—41

gsung gdan ma bshams shing zhal zas rnams kyang sta gon ma byas pa ①mthong ngo //'phags pa khyod ②chab sgo gang nas zhugs lho nas so/ /'phags pa shar nas zhugs shig /ji tsam na gdan bzang po bshams shing gzhal zas bsod pa sta ④gon byas pa yang mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang shin tu ngo mtshar skyes par gyur to//de nas nor can gyi chung ma'i spyan 'dren gyis bcom ldan 'das la dus tshod gsol pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das ⑤gdugs tshod bshams tshulags shing mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das da de'i dus la bab par mkhyen par mdzad du gsol zhes bya ba nas phyag bcabs te lhung bzed gyu bar rig nas/ stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te chos mnyan ⑦pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas nor can gyi bu stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ⑧ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu sang bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas nor can gyi bu la gnang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑨rnar can gyi chung ma la chos bshad pa mdzad nas gshegs so/ /nor can gyi bus kyang gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag sta gon byas so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo nang par sngar langs te 0lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te nor can gyi khyim gang na ba der skyesong ste phyin nas lho sgo nas zhugs na 'gadan ma bshams shing zhal zas sta gon ma byas pa 0mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang nor can gyi bu la 'di skad 3—42

ces smras so/ /khyim bdag gi bu sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun ①spyan drangs nas ci snying las chung ngus gnas sam/ des smras pa/ 'phags pa ji ②ste de skad gsung / gdan ma bshams shing zhal zas sta gon ma byas pa mthong ngo / /'phags pa khyod ②chab sgo gang nas zhugs lho nas so/ /'phags pa nub nas zhugs shig /ji tsam na gdan rjobazang po bshams shing zhal zas bsod ⑤pa sta gon byas pa yang mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang shin tu ngo mtshar skyes par gyur to/ /de nas nor can gyi bu'i spyan 'dren gyis bcom ldan 'das la dus tshod gsol pa/ btsun pa gdugs tshod bshams dulags shing mchis na bcom ldan 'das da de'i dus la bab par mkhyen par mdzad du gsol zhes bya ba nas phyag bcabs te lhung bzed gyu bar rig nas/ stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas nor can gyi mna' ⑦ma stan las langs te ⑧bcom ldan 'das ga la ⑨ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu sang bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas nor can gyi mna' ⑩ma la gnang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis nor can gyi bu la chos bshad pa mdzad nas gshegs so/ /de nas yangs pa can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste lhags pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi 7zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas 0te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig 0tu 'dug pa dang / bcom ldan 'das 3—43

kyis yangs pa can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis zhes bya ba nas cang mi gsung ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas yangs pa can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de ①mogs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu sang bdag cag gi sdum par gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas 'jog gi bu dag nga sngar nor can gyi mna' ②mas spyan drangs zin to/ /de nas yangs pa can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams rngam nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag nor can gcig pu la nor yod kyi ③bdag cag la med dam ci na/ des sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun nyi ma re re gdugs tshod sbyor ༷zhing ⑤bdag cag kho nas skabs ma thob par gyur to0/ /de la ji ltar bsgrub par bya/ gzhan dag gis smras pa/gang gi tshe sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs tshod gsol zin nas gshegs par gyur pa de'i tshe de'i khyim rdo ba re re nas bkogs ⑦te gzhig nigo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo nang par sngar langs te lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs nas khyakhyim bdag nor can gyi khyim gang na ba der song ste phyin nas nub sgo nas zhugs na ⑩gdan ma bshams gyishing zhal zas kyang sta gon ma byas pa humathong ngo / /mthong nas kyang nor can gyi mna' ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /nor can gyi mna' ma sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams spyan drangs nas ci snying las chung ngus gnas sam/ des smras 3—44

pa/ 'phags pa ci ste de skad gsung / gdan ma bshams shing zhal zas rnams kyang sta gon ma byas pa ①mthong ngo / /'phags pa chab sgo gang nas zhugs nub nas so/ /'phags pa byang nas zhugs shig /des ②byang nas ②zhugs na ji tsam na lha'i gdan bshams shing lha'i zhal zas sta gon byas pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang shin tu ngo mtshar skyes par gyur toX/ /de nas nor can gyi mna' ma'i spyan 'dren gyis bcom ldan 'das la dus tshod gsol pa/ btsun pa gdugs tshod bshams lags 0shing mchis na bcom ldan 'das da de'i dus la bab par mkhyen par mdzad du gsol zhes bya ba nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o//de nas yangs pa can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag duthams cad 'dus nas khyim bdag nor can gyi sgo na 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag nor can la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyim bdag yangs pa can gyi tshogs rngam nas sgo na 'dug ste de dag gis khyed ༷cag ⑧la gnod pa byas par 'gyur du 'ong gis song ⑨la bzod par gsol 0cig /de 7phyir byung nas bzod par ⑫gsol bar brtsams pa dang de rnams kyis smras pa/ khyim bdag ci khyod gcig pu la nor yod dam/ gang gi phyir khyod kyis nyin re zhing sangs rgyas la sogs 0pa dge slong gi dge 'dun 8gdugs tshod gsol te tsokho bo cag gis skabs mi rnyed ⑫par byed/ des smras pa/ shes ldan dag bdag gis tshogs kyi khrims su bcas pa ma thos kyis0/ de bas na tshogs kyis 8bzod par bya ba'i rigs so/ /gzhan dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag skyes bu 'di ni dam pa yin pas 'di la bzod par bya'o zhes de 4)rnams bzod par gyur pa dang / des smras pa/3—45

gal te de lta na nang du zhugs shig de rnams khyim du zhugs pa dang / gdan bzang po bshams shing zhal zas bsod pa ①sta gon byas pa yang mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang shin tu ngo mtshar skyes par gyur nas smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod ②'ba' zhig sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun ②gdugs tshod gsol bar 'os kyi/ kho bo cag ni ma yin no/ /des de rnams la rin po che dag byin pa dang de rnams kyis ma blangs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa dang rjo/ rin po che 'di dag ni rnyed par dka' ba yin gyis long ⑤shig /de rnams kyis blangs pa las gang gis ci 'dra ba blangs pa de'i kha dog de 'dra ba kho nar snang bar gyur to/ /de nas nor can gyi mna' mas sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bde bar bzhugs par rig nas/ gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag gis zhes bya ba nas phyag bcabs te/lhung bzed dugyu bar rig nas stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis nor can dang / nor can gyi chung ma dang /nor can gyi bu dang / nor can gyi mna' ma rnams kyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen ⑦nas gang thos na nor can dang / nor can gyi chung ma dang / nor can gyi bu dang / nor can gyi mna' ma rnams kyis ⑧'jig tshogs la lta ba ⑨ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste0/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas pa de lta bur 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams 0so sor rtogs par byed pa'i chos bshad pa mdzad de/ de rnams kyis bden pa mthong nas lan gsum du 8ched du brjod pas 3—46

ched du brjod pa zhes bya ba nas/ bdag cag ni mngon par 'phags so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /bdag cag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi lags kyis①/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag dge bsnyen du gzung ②du gsol/ ji srid 'tsho ba'i ②bar du srog dang yang bsdos te skyabs su mchi bar dumangon par dad lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan ⑤'das kyis nor can dang / nor can gyi chung ma dang /nor can gyi bu dang / nor can gyi mna' ma rnams la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstanaX/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug⑦ /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas gdan las bzhengs te gshegs so// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po lnga bcu ⑧bdun pa/ dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom ⑨thams cad gcod 0pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa btsun pa nor can dang / nor can gyi mchis 'brang yidang / nor can gyi bu dang / nor can gyi mna' ma rnams kyis las ci zhig bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba'i rigs su skyes shing lha dang mi rnams kyi dpal nyams su myong bar gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di rnams kho nas las rnams byas shing bsags pa tshogs rnyed pa zhes bya ba nas/ 'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin no/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bā rā ṇa sī na me tog phreng rgyud tsomakhan zhig yod pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs te/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed dga' bar byed dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /de 3—47

dang ⑦lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las khye'u zhig btsas so/ /des de ②yang rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs sol/ /de rjodus phyi zhig na bkren zhing shin tu bkren ⑤par gyur teX/de dang / bu dang / chung ma dang / mna' mas brtson pa chen pos 'bad pas ras ⑦yug gcig cig grub nas/ de nas me tog phreng rgyud mkhan yang de bgos nas/ rgyal po la me tog du'abul ⑨me tog phreng rgyud mkhan gyi 0chung ma yang de nyid bgos nas btsun mo la 'bul/ me tog phreng rgyud mkhan gyi bu yang de nyid bgos nas gzhon nu rnams la 'bul/ me tog phreng rgyud mkhan gyi mna' ma yang de nyid bgos nas rgyal po'i mna' ma rnams la me tog phreng 'bul bar byed do/ /sangs rgyas rnams 'byung (nyeb med pa na 'jig rten du rang sangs rgyas dman pa dang / ngan pa la snying brtse 8ba dang ⑫/ gnas mal bas mtha' tsol brten 8pa/ 'jig rten gyi yon gnas gcig pu dag 'byung bar 'gyur bas ji tsam na rang sangs rgyas shig ljongs 8rgyu zhing 'gro ba na nyi ma nub ku'i dus su bā rā ṇa sīr phyin nas me tog phreng rgyud mkhan de'i khyim grong khyer gyi sgo na 'dug pa de'i ldum rar nub mo gnas btab ste 4)me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas me tog phreng rgyud mkhan des me'i phung po 'bar ba lta bur mthong nas de dad pa skyes te chung ma la smras pa dang de yang dad par gyur to/ /des bu la smras pa dang de yang dad par gyur to/ /des mna' ma la smras pa dang de yang dad par gyur to/ /de nas de rnams kyis gros bya bar brtsams pa()/ bdag cag sang zan ma zos kyang bla 'dus la rab tu byung ba yizhi ba'i bdag nyid can 'di yi bshos gsol lo/ /de nas nam nangs tshunas de 3—48

rnams kyis de la bsod snyoms phul lo/ /me tog phreng rgyud mkhan gyis smras ①pa/bzang mo kho bo'i ras kyi bgo skal ②gang yin pa de ni rab tu byung ba 'di la 'bul ②lo/ /des smras pa/ rje'i sras bdag gi yang dbul lo/ /bus smras pa/ bdag gi yang dbul lo/ /mna' mas smras pa/ bdag gi yang dbul lo / / de nas dude rnams 'dus nas de la ras bskon to/ /bdag nyid chen po de dag ni lus kyis chos ston gyi tshig gis ma yin pas de nas bdag nyid chen po de de 0rnams la snying brtse ba'i phyir nam mkha' la 'phags nas 'bar ba dang /gsal ba dang / char 'bebs pa dang / glog 'byin pa'i cho 'phrul dag bya bar brtsams so/ /so so'i skye bo rnams ni rdzu 'phrul la myur du sems gtod pa yin pas shing rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te smon lam gdab par brtsams pa/ bdag cag gis yon gnas dam pa 'di lta bu la bya ba byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag cag phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba'i rigs su skye zhing bdag cag gi khyim du lha dang mi'i g.yang 'bab par gyur cig /'di lta bu'i chos rnams kyang thob nas 'di bas khyad ①par du ⑦'phags pa'i ston pa mnyes par byed kyi/ mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig ces byas so/ /de nas rang sangs rgyas kyis de rnams la snying brtse bar durdzu 'phrul byas nas rgyal po'i khab kyi steng nas ①phar chas te song ba dang / de'i grib ma ⑩rgyal po'i steng du bab (sprepa las ()de gdong bstod 4)de blta (stebar brtsams pa dang /bdag nyid chen po de mthong nas des bsams pa/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis yang su zhig gi bkren 8pa'i rtsa ba 0phyung bar 'gyur snyam 0mo/ /me tog phreng rgyud mkhan de rgyal po la me tog 'bul ba'i dus gang yin pa de las theg gi 8tsam 3—49

zhig yol lo/ /rgyal po yang me tog la sdod cing 'dug go/ /de nas me tog phreng rgyud mkhan de rgyal po'i zho shas 'tsho ba rnams kyis bkug pa dang rgyal pos de la smras pa/ ci'i phyir khyod kyis me tog de ring dus las yol des ji ltar gyur pa rgyas par smras pa dang ①/ de nas rgyal pos ②ji snyed gyon pa byin no/ /de bzhin du me tog phreng rgyud mkhan gyi chung ma la ni btsun mo rnams kyis ji snyed gyon pa byin no/ /me tog phreng rgyud mkhan gyi bu la ni gzhon nu rnams kyis so/ /me tog phreng rgyud mkhan gyi mna' ma la ni rgyal po'i mna' ma rnams kyis te/ de mthong ③ba'i chos de nyid la nor gyi me tog mngon par grub par gyur te dbul ba med par gyur to/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi me tog phreng rgyud mkhan gang yin pa de ni nor can 'di nyid yin no/ /me tog phreng rgyud mkhan gyi chung ma duni nor can gyi chung ma yin no/ /me tog phreng rgyud mkhan gyi bu ⑤ni nor can gyi bu yin no/ /me tog phreng rgyud mkhan gyi mna' ma ༷ni gnor can gyi mna' ma yin te/ 'di dag gis rang sangs rgyas la bya ba byas shing smon lam btab pa gang yin pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin ⑧pas phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba'i rigs su skyes nas/ khyim du lha dang mi'i g.yang babs par gyur to/ /nga'i spyan snga nas kyang bden pa mthong bar byas te/ nga rang sangs rgyas bye ba brgya stong bas khyad ⑨par du 'phags pa'i ston pa 'di dag gis mnyes par byas kyi mi mnyes par ⑩ma yin no/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag 0pa rnams kyi ni ⑩zhes bya ba nas brtsal bar 0bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis 8de lta bu la bslab par bya'o zhes bya ba'i ⑫bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas yangs pa can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag 3—50

rnams lhag par yang mngon par dad par gyur nas stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun ①dang thabs cig la bdag cag gis dgung zla gsum du na bza' chos gos dang bsod snyoms dang / gzims cha dang / snyun dpyad kyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad rnams 'bul zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas yangs pa can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la gnang ngo / /de nas yangs pa can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag ②rnams bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas stan las langs te dong ngo / /de nas yangs pa can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis de nyid kyi nub mo nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag sta gon byas te zhes bya ba nas/ phyag bcabs te lhung bzed gyu bar rig nas stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te/chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yangs pa can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan②/yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas gdan las bzhengs te gshegs so/ /de bzhin 0du nyi ma gnyis sam gsum gyi bar du 'das so/ /yangs pa can gyi bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyi 'khor rgya ②chen po mu ge dang bcas pa'i dus byung nas 0de rnams kyi nye du dag zas kyi phyir nyi ma re re zhing 'ong bas de dag gis 3—51
