gtses ①par gyur nas dge slong rnams la smras pa/ 'phags pa dag mu ge dang bcas pa'i dus byung bas bdag cag gi nye du dag skrur mchis te de rnams la bdag cag gdugs gcig bzhin du ②stsol bas khyed cag ①dang de rnams la khyad dupar rngo mi thog dun/ kye 'phags pa dag bdag cag gis yo byad rnams dbul gyis zhal ta 0kho na mdzod cig /dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/bcom ldan 'das la zhus te bya'o zhes dge slong rnams kyis skabs de bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta ⑦bas na rjes su gnang ste dge slong rnams kyis zhal ta bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams kyis zas kyi zhal ta bya'o zhes gsungs pas de rnams kyis ⑧zhal ta bya bar brtsams te ji tsam na steng g.yogs med par ⑨thug pa 'tshed pa'i zhal ta byas pa las () lhas char phab pas de 0ma rung bar gyur pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/steng g.yogs med par btso 8bar mi bya'o/ /sgo khang dang khyams su 'tshed par byed pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sgo khang dang khyams su btso bar mi bya'o/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na rung ba'i gnas kyi gzhir mi rung ba ni 4)bcu po 'di dag ste/ 'di rnams su zas kyi zhal ta mi bya'o/ /bcu gang zhe na/ steng g.yogs med pa dang / sgo khang dang / khyams tsodang /bsro gang tsodang / khrus khang dang / rgyal po'i gnas dang / mchod rten gyi gnas dang / mu stegs can gyi gnas dang / khyim bdag gi gnas dang /dge slong ma'i dbyar ⑩khang ngo / /gzhi 0bcu po 'di dag ni rung ba ma yin pa'i ⑫gnas kyi gzhi yin te/ de rnams su dge slong gis zas kyi zhal ta mi bya'o/ /3—52

zhal ta byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro// // sdom ni/ nad bu can dang zas dag dang / /g.yar tshus lhag pa dag dang yang / /tshal gyi 'bras bu chu skyes dang / /pad ma'i rtsa dang lug dag go/ /gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /mnyan yod na dge slong nad bu can zhig yod pa ①des sman pa la dris pa②/ bzhin bzangs dag ③kho bo la sman ston cig /des nad kyi gzhi dris nas smras pa/ 'phags pa thug pa gsol cig dang sos par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs dubacom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /sman pas smras pa/ 'phags pa khyod kyi ston pa thugs rje can yin pas 'di nyid kyis rkyen byas nas gnang bar 'gyur ba'i gnas de 0yod do/ /des skabs de dge slong rnams la'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis ni dubacom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te sman pas ⑦thug pa 'thung ⑧shig ces zer na sman pas bsgo ba bzhin thug pa btung bar bya ste de la 'gyod pa ①mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sman pas bsgo ⑩ba bzhin thug pa btung bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / de'i nad g.yog gis thug pa grang mo zhig khyer te byin no/ /de nas sman pas yi'ongs nas dris pa 'phags pa khyod bde'am/ des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs mi hubade'o/ /ci khyod kyis thug ⑫pa ma gsol tam/ 'thungs so/ /ci 'dra ba zhig /grang mo'o/ /'phags pa ma legs pa zhig bgyis so/ /sang ni dron mo gsol cig /de nas tsond g.yog gis blangs tsonas grang mo kho na rnyed nas des de la ⑩bsros te byin no/ /de nas sman pa 'ongs te de bzhin du dris pa dang des smras pa/ mi bde'o/ /ci thug 3—53

pa ma gsol tam/ 'thungs so/ /ci 'dra ba zhig /grang ①mo zhig bsros nas so/ /'phags pa ma legs pa zhig bgyis so/ /de grangs te ②bsros pa lags kyis sang ②ni rang bzhin gyis dron por dumadzod la ⑤gsol cig /de nas de'i nad g.yog gis 'bras dang snod sta gon byas nas gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol gyi shing drung zhig tu btso bar brtsams pa las de nas khu'i durtug pas de ma rung bar byas pas dge slong de phongs par gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams la'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis ni bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang ⑦/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na rung ba'i gnas bsko bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rung ba'i gnas bsko bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis ci ⑧'dra ba dang ji tsam pa ma shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rung ba'i gnas lnga ste/rtsom pa'i mtha' can dang / sems gtod pa'i mtha' can dang / ba 0nyal ba lta bu dang / stong pa'i gnas dang / bskos pa'o/ /de la rtsom ⑩pa'i mtha' can ni 'di lta ste/ dge slong lag gi blas gnas rtsom 0pa na der thog mar gzhi 'di ni dge 'dun gyi 8rung ba'i gnas su 'gyur ro zhes sems bskyed cing tshig tu smras pa ste/ 'di ni rung ba'i gnas rtsom 8pa'i mtha' can zhes bya'o/ /sems gtod ④pa'i mtha' can gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dge slong lag gi blas der thog mar gzhi ⑫ rdo ba 'dren ⑩pa na nye 'khor gyi dge slong rnams la smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa dag gzhi 'di ni dge 'dun gyi rung ba'i gnas su 'gyur bar shyinges par zung 8shig nges par zung ⑩shig ces bya ⑥ste/ 'di ni sems gtod pa'i mtha' can zhes bya'o/ /ba nyal ba lta bu gang zhe na/ gang la sgo tha ⑥dad 3—54

par ①gses pa ste/ 'di ni ba nyal ba lta bu zhes bya'o/ /gnas stong pa gang zhe na/ spangs pa'i gnas te ②'di ni gnas stong pa zhes bya'o/ /bskos pa gang zhe na/ gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las kyis ②bskos pa'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis ji ltar bsko ba ma shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gnas gang zhig thams cad zin par byas pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa la dge 'dun gyis 'dod na de bsko 0bar bya'o/ /bsko ba yang 'di ltar bya ste/ gnas mal bshams la gaṇḍi dubardungs te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo la/ dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing mthun par gyur pa dudang / dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gnas thams cad lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi rung ba'i gnas su bsko ⑦na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi ⑧dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis ⑨gnas thams cad lags pa nang mtshams 0phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi rung ba'i gnas su bsko'o/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gnas thams cad lags pa nang mtshams yidang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di ()dge 'dun gyi rung ba'i gnas su bsko bar bzhed de/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis gnas thams cad lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di yidage 'dun gyi rung ba'i gnas su bsko na/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams las (stegang dag gnas 3—55

thams cad lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di ①dge 'dun gyi rung ba'i gnas su bsko bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung ②shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung ②shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis gnas thams cad bgyis dulags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi rung ba'i gnas su bskos ⑤lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /gang du dge 'dun gyi rung ba'i gnas su bskos ①pa der gnyis skabs dbye ste/ mtshams kyi nang du btsos pa dang / mtshams kyi nang du zhag lon pa'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can gyi spre'u rdzing gi 'gram na khang pa brtsegs pa'i gnas na bzhugs so/ /yangs pa can na sde dpon seng ge zhes bya ba zhig gnas te/ de'i nye 'khor ⑦na gnas pa rnams kyis de'i khruched du sha khyer te 'ongs nas de yang za bar byed do/ /gang gi tshe des bcom ldan 'das las bden pa mthong ba de'i tshe mi za bas khyer te 'ongs nas ⑨yang dge slong rnams la sbyin par byed do/ /dge slong rnams kyis kyang de dag zos pa dang mu stegs can rnams smod par byed/ gzhogs ⑩'phyas byed/ kha zer ⑩bar byed de'i / shes ldan dag sde dpon seng ge'i ched du byas te 0sha khyer te 'ongs na ni des (stede dag ma zos la/ shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams la byin pa dang /shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong rnams kyi (nyeched du byas pa'i sha ni zos so zhes pa'i (9skabs de ⑩dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ngas gnas gsum gyis rung ba ma yin pa'i sha 3—56

bza' bar mi bya'o zhes gsungs pa gsum gang zhe na/ bdag ①gi ched du byas par mngon ②du mthong ba rung ba ②ma yin pa'i sha bza' bar mi bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / yid ches pa las khyod kyi ched du byas pa yin no zhes ④thos pa rung ba ma yin pa'i sha bza' bar mi bya'o zhes gsungs pa ⑤dang / rang nyid kyi blo la 0rnam par rtog pa skyes pa tshul las 'di ni bdag gi ched du byas pa yin no snyam du ⑦rung ba ma yin pa'i sha bza' bar mi bya'o zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /dge slong dag ngas gnas gsum gyis rung ba'i sha bza' bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa gsum gang zhe na/ 'dis bdag gi ched du byas ⑧par mngon sum du ma mthong ba rung ba'i sha bza' bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / yid ches pa las 'dis khyod 0kyi ched du byas pa ma yin no zhes thos pa rung ba'i sha bza' bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / bdag nyid kyi blo la rnam par rtog pa skyes pa 0tshul las 'di ni 4)bdag gi ched du byas pa yin no snyam pa ma skyes pa rung ba'i sha bza' bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa yin no//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /mu ge dang bcas pa'i dus byung nas dge slong dag ltogs par gyur pas de rnams glos phab ste 'dug pa dang bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag gcig tu brtson par bya ba'i phyephyir tsobastan pa la ci'i slad du glos phab ste bzhugs shing dge ba'i phyogs la brtson par mi mdzad/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ mu ge dang bcas pa'i dus byung bas bsod snyoms lto 'grangs ④par mi rnyed pas kho bo cag ltogs te nyam chung bas des na glos phab ste 'dug go/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ ci ste zhal tshus mi gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang ngo / /khyod kyi ston pa ni 3—57

thugs rje can yin pas gnang bar 'gyur ba gang yin pa'i gnas de yod do zhes bya ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de'i phyir rjes su gnang ste/mu ge'i sdug bsngal dgon pa 'di lta bur dge slong rnams kyis g.yar tshus bza' bar bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /mu ge dang bcas pa'i dus byung nas dge slong rnams la bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis smras pa/'phags pa dag 'di nyid du zas kyi bya ba mdzod cig /de rnams kyis zas kyi bya ba byas nas bsod snyoms sngar rnyed pa khyer nas gtsug lag khang du song ste/ de rnams kyis mu ge'i skyon gyis de yang bza' bar 'dod na 'on kyang 'gyod pas ma zos pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das nyul gsol pa dang ②/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de'i phyir rjes su gnang ste/ mu ge'i sdug bsngal dgon pa 'di lta bur 'dod na sngar blangs zin to snyam du soms rgyal sngar rnyed pa yang bza' bar bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /mu ge dang bcas pa'i dus byung nas bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can durnams kyis dge slong rnams khyim gyi nang du zas la mgron ⑤du bos nas de rnams kyis zos pa dang bca' ba las lhag ma zhig lus sol/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag khyed kyi ched du sta gon bgyis pa lags kyis snoms ①te bzhud la phyis gsol cig /de ⑦rnams kyis khyer te dong ngo / /dong nas de yang za ⑧bar 'dod na ⑨'gyod pas ma zos pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /3—58

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de'i phyir rjes su gnang ste/ mu ge'i sdug bsngal dgon pa 'di lta bur 'di dag ni byin pa yin no snyam du bsams nas bza' bar bya ste/ 'di ①la 'gyod par mi bya'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /mu ge dang bcas pa'i dus byung ba na ②bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis dge slong rnams zas ③la mgron 0du bos te/ de rnams kyis zos nas bca' ba la sogs pa cung zad cig lhag ste / dge slong rnams dong ba dang bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis smras pa/'di ni bdag cag gis 'phags pa dag kho na la yongs su btang ba lags te/ 'tshal te mchis la khyod dukho na la dbul lo zhes de rnams kyis khyer te 'ongs pa dang / dge slong rnams de la duza bar 'dod na ⑦'gyod pas ma zos pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de'i phyir rjes su gnang ste/ mu ge'i dgon pa sdug bsngal ⑧'di lta bur sngar yongs su btang ba'o snyam du bsams nas bza' bar bya ste/ 'di ⑨la 'gyod par () mi bya'o/ /gleng gzhi ni mnyan yiyod na'o/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis nub phyogs kyi tshal na yod pa'i 'bras bu rnams grub nas de rnams kyis bsams pa/ 'di dag ni rnyed dka' ba yin pas 'phags pa rnams la 'bul 8lo zhes de dag gis dge slong rnams zas zos nas spang ba 0byas pa rnams la de dag byin pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis spang ba ④byas zin no byazhes 'gyod pas ma zos pa dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du ma byung ba de'i tshe mu stegs byacan rnams la yon 3—59

gnas bgyid pa las/ da ni bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung nas khyed rnams kyang da ni yon gnas su gyur pa ①lags na/ gal te khyed ②kyis ma bzhes na ci bdag cag gi ③dge ba'i shul 0rgyags dang bral te/ 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol du mchi bar bgyi'am/ de lta bas ⑤na thugs brtse rjobs bzhes shig pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de'i phyir rjes su gnang ste/rnyed par ⑦dka' ba yin no snyam dunas bza' bar bya ste/ 'di khyal 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /de la tshal na yod pa'i 'bras bu ni 'di dag yin te/ rgyan 'brum ⑩dang / bal po se'u dang / 'bra yigo dang / sta rga tsodang / yon tshe dang /shing tog u ra ma na dang / shing tog u ru ma yi ka dang ⑫/ shing tog ni ko ⑫tsa dang / shing tog ba bhu dang / shing tog sin tsi ku'o/ /gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis dge slong rnams zas zos zin pa dang / chu nas bskyes pa dag phul ba dang / dge slong rnams 'dod kyang spang ba ⑩byas zin to zhes 'gyod pas ma zos pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rnyed par skyodaka' ba yin no snyam du bsams nas bza' bar bya ste/ de 8la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /de la chu nas skyes pa yini 'di dag yin te/ utpa la'i rtsa ba 0dang / pad ma'i rtsa ba dang / ku mu da'i (nyes bon dang / pad ma'i sa bon no//gleng gzhi ni mnyan ()yod na'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu khams ma snyoms pas khrag dang bad kun 'khrugs par gyur to/ /de'i ⑥rim gro byed pa tshe 3—60

dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bsams pa/ bdag rang gi blos ①ni tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la lan mang du rim gro byas kyi lan 'ga' yang sman pa la ma dris kyisal/ ma la bdag gis dri'o snyam nas des sman pa la dris pa/ bzhin bzangs tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu khrag dang bad kun 'khrugs par gyur na de'i sman ston cig /des smras pa 'phags pa pad ma'i rtsa ba'i 'o ma stsol cig dang sos par 'gyur ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bsams pa/ gal te bdag gis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la pad ma'i rtsa ba phal pa'i 'o mas rim gro bya ba ni bdag gi cha ma yin no snyam du bsams nas ji ltar sems mnyam par bzhag pas mnyan yod nas mi snang bar gyur te/ dal gyis 'bab ces bya ba'i 'gram du phyin par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa dang /klu'i rgyal po rab brtan ①gyi gnas dang nye bar gyur pa dang / de nas klu'i rgyal po rab brtan ༷gyis mthong nas smras pa/ 'phags pa dgos pa ci zhig gi duphyir byon/ des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu khrag dang bad kun 'khrugs nas de la sman pas pad ma'i rtsa ba'i 'o ma bstan to/ /klu'i rgyal po rab brtan rjogyis smras pa/ 'phags pa gal te de ltar dun re zhig gzhes ⑧shig /de dal gyis 'bab kyi nang du zhugs nas ①mi'i tshad tsam gyi ⑩pad ma'i rtsa ba dag bton ⑫cing 8pad ma'i rtsa ba'i 'o ma pad ma'i 'dab ma'i skyo rar gzar nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i lhung bzed bkang ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos pad ma'i rtsa ba gshegs 8pa la lta tsobar brtsams pa dang de nas klu'i rgyal po rab brtan 8gyis smras pa/ 'phags pa ci gzigs pad ma'i rtsa ba dag gsol bar bzhed dam/ de cang mi smra bar 'dug pa dang smras patunye/3—61

'phags pa bzhud cig dang bskur ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu ①chen pos pad ma'i rtsa ba'i 'o mas lhung bzed bkang ba khyer nas dal gyis 'bab kyi 'gram nas mi snang bar byas te mnyan yod kyi rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra bar phyin to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus sman pas bstan pa bzhin pad ma'i rtsa ba'i 'o ma 'thungs pas sos par gyur to / /klu'i rgyal po rab brtan ⑤gyis kyang glang po che nag po'i cha byad 'chang la pad ma'i rtsa ba khur cig bkur ②nas mnyan yod kyi rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du song la gtsug lag khang gi khyams kyi dumadun du zhog la shog shig⑤ /de rlung gi shugs ltar mgyogs ①pa'i mthus ⑦mnyan yod kyi rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi ⑧gtsug lag khang du 'ongs nas pad ma'i rtsa ba rnams khyams kyi mdun du bzhag nas slar log pa las lam gyi phyed na tshal gyi bal glang mo zhig yod pa dang lhan cig 'dus par gyur to0/ /dus gzhan zhig na bal glang mo de las bal glang phrug gu cig 4)'brangs te 'brangs pa'i mod la seng ge'i sgra 'byin to/ /de nas bal glang mo de skrag pas gcin rtug shor yinas bal glang phrug 'gu bor te bros so/ /de nas rgyal po'i khab na gnas pa'i shing mkhan zhig shing gi ched du tshal du song ba las bal glang phrug 'gu de mthong nas 8khyim 'du blangs te bsnun ⑫gsos bskyed de/ nor gyis bskyangs pas ming nor skyong nor skyong zhes bya bar grags so/ /kha cig ni rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis rgyal po gzugs can snying po la nor skyong skyes su bskur ba las0/ de mnyan yod kyi yul na gnas pa'i ⑩skye bos nor gyis bskyangs pas yin nor skyong 0zhes 'don to/ /pad ma'i rtsa ba kha cig ni tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos zos/ kha cig ni tshe dang ldan pa 3—62

shā ri'i bus/ kha cig ni dge 'dun la brims pa las 'on kyang lhag par gyur to//de nas dge slong rnams kyis spang ba ①byas nas kyang za bar ②'dod na bdag cag gis spang ba byas so ②zhes ma zos pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mi rnams kyis lha'i pad ma'i rtsa ba rnyed par dka' bas de'i phyir rjes su gnang ngo / /pad ma'i rtsa ba rnyed par dka' ba yin no snyam du bsams nas bza' bar bya ste/ de la 'gyod par mi bya'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /de'i tshe grong khyer bzang byed na bsod nams chen por shes par ①bya ba drug gnas te/ khyim bdag lug ces bya ba dang / lug gi chung ma dang / lug gi bu dang / lug gi mna' ma dang /lug gi bran pho dang / lug gi bran mo'o/ /khyim bdag lug bsod nams che bar ⑤ji ltar shes zhe dun/ gal te bang mdzod stong pa rnams la bltas na mthong ma thag kho nar dgang ⑦bar 'gyur ②te/ de ltar na 0khyim bdag lug bsod nams che bar shes so/ /lug gi chung ma ji lta bu zhe na/ des gcig gi don du snod du btsos pa ni brgya stong gi bza' ba 'byung ste/ lug gi chung ma ni de lta bu yin no/ /lug gi bu ⑩ji lta bu zhe na/ de'i rked pa la 0lnga brgya pa'i snod btags te 'dug la/ des gang gi tshe brgya'am stong yongs su btang ba de'i tshe de bzhin du gang bar 'dug ste/ yongs su zad par mi 'gyur te/lug gi bu ni de lta bu yin no/ /lug gi mna' ma ji lta bu zhe na/ des gcig gi don du dri sbyar na brgya stong khyed par 'gyur te/ lug gi mna' ma ni de lta bu yin no/ /lug gi bran pho ⑩ji lta bu zhe na/ des gang gi tshe zhing la rol gcig 3—63

smos pa de'i tshe zhing la rol bdun rmos par 'gyur te/ ①lug gi bran pho ni de lta bu ②yin no/ /lug gi bran mo ni ①ji ltar ④bsod nams che bar shes zhe ⑤na / de gang gi tshe 'bras gtun dugang tsam drus pa de'i tshe bdun tsam du skyes par 'gyur te/ de ltar na lug gi bran mo bsod nams che ba yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag lug ⑦gdul ba'i dus mkhyen nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la dge slong rnams la dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa ni ljongs rgyu zhing grong khyer bzang byed du gshegs kyisal/ khyed cag las gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa dang thabs cig tu ljongs rgyu zhing grong khyer bzang byed du 'dong bar spro ba de ni chos gos rnams ṇilong ⑩shig ces sgo ⑩zhig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes nas ⑫tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan tsonas dge slong rnams la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das ljongs rgyu zhing grong khyer bzang byed du gshegs kyis(ste/ khyed cag las gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa dang thabs cig tu ljongs rgyu zhing grong khyer bzang byed du 'dong bar spro ba de ni chos gos rnams long 0shig /tshe dang ldan pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes dge slong de rnams kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo las mnyan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dul ba/ 'khor dul btu)/ zhi ba/ 'khor zhi ba/dgra bcom pa/ 'khor dgra bcom pa dang ljongs rgyu zhing grong khyer bzang byed du gshegs so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis 0mnyan yod du cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa de'i tshe mu stegs can rnams mtha' 'khob tu dong ba las de nas kha cig grong khyer bzang byed du dong nas gnas pa de rnams kyis dge sbyong gi ta 3—64

ma 'ong ngo zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang rod rod por gyur nas bdag cag sngon ni ①dge sbyong gi ta mas yul dbus nas spyugs so/ /de gal te 'dir 'ongs na/gdon mi za bar bdag cag 'di nas kyang lasgyugs par 'gyur gyis ②de la thabs shig bsham par bya'o snyam mo/ /de rnams rigs kyi khyim dag tu dong nas smras pa/chos thob par gyur cig /chos thob par gyur cig /'phags pa dag de ci lags / shes ldan dag bltas zin gyis du'agro'o/ /ci'i slad du re zhig khyed cag gi 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa ni kho bo cag gis mthong gis 0ji srid rgud pa ma mthong ba de'i bar du 'dong ngo / /'phags pa dag bdag cag la rgyad pa ci zhig 'byung bar 'gyur lags/ shes ldan dag dge sbyong gi ta ma spu gri'i ser ba 'bebs shing du ma zhig bu med pa dang / khyim thab ༷med par byed cing 'ong ngo //'phags pa dag gal te de lta na gang gi dus kho nar gzhes ⑦par bgyi ba de kho na'i dus su bdag cag spang bar bgyi'am/ bzhugs shig ma bzhud cig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ bdag cag ci ste 'dug khyed cag kho bo cag gi nyan du ⑧mi btub bo/ /'phags pa dag gsung 0shig mnyan par bgyi'o/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag grong khyer bzang byed kyi nye 'khor gyi skye bo'i tshogs thams cad gnas nas phyung la grong khyer bzang 0byed kyi nang du tshud cig rtswa sngon po rnams 0rngos shig /'dug gnas rnams ni shig 8cigatso /me tog dang 'bras bu'i shing rnams ni chod cig /chu rnams ni dug lugs ④shig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag bzhugs 8shig dang thams cad bgyi'o// de nas ⑩de rnams kyis grong khyer bzang byed kyi nye 'khor gyi skye bo'i tshogs thams cad gnas nas bton nas grong khyer bzang byed kyi nang du btsud de/ rtswa sngon 3—65

po rnams ni ①bangs/ 'dug gnas rnams ni bshig /me tog dang 'bras bu'i shing ②ni ③bcad/ chu rnams ni dug blugs so/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das la bkur ste ma yin pa byed pa yal bar dor ba ni bdag gi chu ma yin te/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis bskal 0pa grangs med pa gsum du dka' ba brgya stong du mas pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pas bla na med pa'i ye shes brnyes pa'i bcom ldan 'das de 'jig rten thams cad med pa'i yul stong ⑤rgyu zhing gshegs par rjobya 'am/ ma la bdag gis bcom ldan 'das nyan thos ⑦kyi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu bde ba la reg ⑧par bya ba'i phyir 'bad par ⑨bya'o snyam nas des rlung gtong ⑩ba'i lha'i bu la bsgo yib/ song la chu dug can rnams skoms shig /char tho)'bebs pa'i lha'i bu la bsgo ba/ 'di rnams kyis bskams 0pa dang /khyod kyis chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pas khong ④shig /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams la yang bsgo ba/ khyed kyis grong khyer bzang byed kyi nye 'khor du gnas thob shig /de nas rlung gtong ba'i lha'i bus ni chu dug can rnams bskams so/ /char tso'abebs pa'i lha'i bus ⑩ni der yang chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pas bkang ngo / /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi ⑩lha rnams kyis kyang grong khyer bzang byed kyi nye 'khor du gnas btab nas ljongs 8rnams 'byor cing rgyas par gyur to/ /mu stegs can rnams kyis grong khyer na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs rnams bsogs yinas de rnams kyis rtog 0chen dag mngags te ljongs rnams 0ci 'dra ltos shig /de rnams dong ba las ljongs rnams lhag par yang 'byor cing rgyas par gyur pa mthong nas slar 'ongs te smras pa/ shes ldan dag ljongs 3—66

rnams ①'di lta bur 'byor cing rgyas pa ni sngon lan 'ga' yang bdag cag gis ma mthong ngo / /mu stegs can rnams kyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed ②kyis mthong ngam/ re zhig gang zhig sems med pa'i dngos po rnams kyang sgyur ②bar byed pa des/ khyed cag sgyur dubar mi byed pa de lta srid re skan/ khyed cag rnam pa thams cad du bltas zin te/ blta ba'i tha dum byas nas 'gro'o/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag bzhugs shig /khyed cag la dge sbyong go ta mas ci zhig bgyir mchis/ de yang rab tu byung 0ba lags la/ khyed kyang rab tu byung ba slong zhing 'tsho ba lags na/ ci des khyed cag gi slong ba bkag par 'gyur snyam mamatshu/ mu stegs can rnams kyis smras pa/ dam zhig bcas te dugal te khyed cag sus kyang dge sbyong gau ta ma la blta ⑨bar 'gro bar 4)mi bya zhing gang zhig 'gro ba de la chad par kār ṣā pa ṇa 0drug bcus gcad 8par khrims 'cha' na 'dug go/ /de rnams kyis kyang khas blangs tshunas khrims su bcas so//de nas bcom ldan 'das ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs te rim gyis grong khyer bzang byed du gshegs nas bzang byed kyi lho phyogs kyi gnas shig na bzhugs so//de'i tshe ser skya'i gzhi'i bram ze'i bu mo grong khyer bzang byed du bag mar btang ba de ra ba'i kha na 'dug pas bcom ldan 'das mun khung skyon bzhugs pa mthong nas des bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das 0shākya'i rigs dga' bar mdzad pa/shākya'i rigs kyi rgyal po spangs nas rab tu byung ba de ni 'di yin te/ gal te 'di la them skas shig yod par gyur na bdag mar me thogs la 'babs ⑩pa zhig/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa thugs su chud nas them skas zhig 3—67

sprul to/ /de nas de snying dga' ba dang mgu ba dang / rab tu dga' bas mar me thogs te them skas las babs nas bcom ldan 'das nyugang na ba der song ②ste phyin pa dang / ①bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar dumar me bzhag nas zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang /rang bzhin mkhyen nas de dang mthun pa'i 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi so sor rtogs par 'gyur ba'i chos bshad pa mdzad do 0zhes bya ba nas/ skyabs su mchi bar mngon par dad lags so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bu mo de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /bu mo khyod tshur hrikhyim bdag lug gang na ba der song la phyin pa dang de la nga na re nad med par gyur cig ces spros la 'di skad ces kyang smros shig /khyim bdag khyod kyi ched kho nar nga 'dir 'ongs na ༷khyod sgo bcad ⑧nas 'dug pas 0glo bur ba la ji ltar khyod byed pa de lta bur bya ba de ci yig rigs sam/ gal te tshogs kyis khrims su bca' ba ⑩byas so zhes smras pa dang ⑫/ khyod kyi bu'i rked pa la lnga brgya pa'i snod btags te 'dug pa des gal te brgya'am stong 'ged tho)par btang yin yang gang ba nyid du 'dug cing yongs su zad par mi 'gyur na khyod kār ṣā pa ṇa 0drug bcu byin nas 'ong mi nus sam zhes smros shig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bu mo des bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan tsonas chas ⑩pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar sus kyang mi tshor ba de ltar byin gyis brlabs nas khyim bdag lug gi gan du song ste phyin pa dang smras pa/ khyim bdag bcom ldan 'das khyod la nad med par gyur cig ces gsung ngo ⑫/ /3—68

des smras pa/ bu mo sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyim bdag① /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyod kho na'i ched du nga ②'dir gshegs na khyod sgo bcad nas 'dug pa glo bur ba la ji ltar khyod byed pa de lta bur bya ba ci ③ga rigs sam/ des smras pa/ bu mo tshogs kyis chakhrims su bca' ba rjosus kyang dge sbyong gi ta ma la blta bar bya ༷ba'i phyir 'gro bar mi bya'o/ /gang zhig 'gro na de tshogs kyis kār ṣā pa ṇa drug bcu'i ⑦chad pas gcad ⑧do zhes dam bcas 0so/ /khyim bdag⑩ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyod kyi bu'i rked pa la 0lnga brgya pa'i snod 8btags 0te 'dug pa des cigal te brgya'am stong 'ged 8par btang na yang tsogang ba kho nar 'gyur zhing yongs su zad par mi 'gyur na kār ṣā pa ṇa drug bcu byin nas khyod 'ong bar mi nus sam zhes gsung ngo / /des bsams pa/ 'di ni sus kyang mi shes na bcom ldan 'das de ni thams cad mkhyen pa yin pas 'gro'o snyam nas/des kār ṣā pa ṇa drug bcu sgor bzhag nas bram ze'i bu mos bstan pa'i them skas las babs te4)/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyi 8zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas yite/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 0khyim bdag lug gi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal 0dang / khams dang /rang bzhin mkhyen nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi so sor rtogs phyopar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bshad pa mdzad de/ khyim bdag lug gis de thos nas zhes bya ba nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin no( nye/ /des bden pa mthong nas gsol pa(ste/ bcom ldan 'das 3—69

bzang byed na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs 'di dag gis kyang ci ①ga 'di lta bu'i chos rnam pa sna tshogs 'thob ②par 'gyur ③lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag khyod las brten dunas phal cher kun gyis 'thob dupa kho nar 'gyur ro/ /de nas khyim bdag lug gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ste/de khyim du phyin nas grong khyer gyi nang du kār ṣā pa ṇa'i phung po bcer 0te tshigs su bcad ⑦pas smras pa/ gang zhig rgyal ba 'dod chags skyon bcom ⑧cod med pa / /mtshungs pa med pa gser gyi mdog can lta ⑨'dod pa/ /de ni 'jigs med snying gis shin tu nges byos la/ /myur ⑩du dengs shig de yi nor ni kho bos gzhal/ /skye bo'i tshogs kyis smras pa/ khyim bdag dge sbyong gi ta ma mthong na dge bar 'gyur ram/ des smras pa/ dge bar 'gyur ro/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ gal te de lta bas yin tshogs kho nas khrims su bcas pa tshogs kho nas bshig tu zad mod/ 'di la 'gal ba ci zhig yod/ de (sprernams kyis khrims su bcas pa bshig nas 'byung bar btsams so/ /de nas phan tshun sdos 0pas 'byung bar ma nus pa dang gnod sbyin lag na rdo rjes 'dul ba'i 4)skye bo la snying brtse 4)ba'i phyir rdo rje 'phangs 4)pas ra ba dral nas srog chags brgya stong phrag ⑩du ma kha cig ni ya mtshan skyes/ kha cig ni sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa chos yang dag par bskul nas byung ngo / /de nas skye bo'i tshogs chen po 'dus pas bcom ldan 'das kyi nye 'khor dpag tshad gcig tshun chad 'khor bar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor de rnams zil gyis mnan te ⑫dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs nas sems 3—70

can du ma dag gi rgyud la dge ba'i rtsa ba skyed par byed pa'i chos bshad pa mdzad de/ de thos nas kha cig gis ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas so zhes bya ba nas/ kha cig ①ni skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi rnams blangs so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po lnga bcu ②brgyad pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis yun ring po ③zhig tu chos bshad pas gdugs tshod kyi dus las yol bar gyur to//khyim bdag lug gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das zhal zas kyi mdzad pa mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag zas kyi ༷dus las yol bar gyur to/ /des gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das dus ma lags par rung ba ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mar dang /bu ram dang / hwags dang / sha kha ra dang / btung ba dag go/ /de nas khyim bdag lug gis dugayos mkhan dag bkug ste smras pa/ shes ldan dag dus ma yin pa'i bca' ba rnams myur du sta gon gyis shig /de rnams kyis dus ma yin pa'i bca' ba rnams sta dugon byas so/ /de nas khyim bdag lug gis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la dus ma yin pa'i bca' ba dang /dus ma yin pa'i btung ba rnams kyis tshim par byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag lug 'khor dang bcas pa yang bden pa rnams la so sor bkod/ ri 'or ⑦na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs de yang skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du btul te gshegs pa na khyim bdag lug ⑤gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ⑨shul 0gyi snyun rgyags kyi zong kār ṣā pa ṇa dag bzhes shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ blang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kār ṣā pa ṇa 3—71

blang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis su zhig gis blang bar bya ba ma shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rung ba ①byed pas so/ /rung ba byed pa med nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge tshul gyis so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ②'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis dge tshul gyi bslab pa'i gzhi bcu par gser dngul ②len par dugasungs la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge tshul gyis blang bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa de ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nye ba du'akhor ngas 'chang bar byed pa las dgongs te gsungs kyis dumi blang ba ni ma yin te/ de bas na dge tshul gyis blang bar bya'i blangs nas bdag gir ni mi bya'o/ /khyim bdag lug gis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das bu ram dag bzhes shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / blang bar bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis su zhig gis ji ltar blang bar bya ba ma shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim pa'am dge tshul med na/ dge slong gis zhag bdun par byin gyis brlabs nas rang nyid kyis bkur bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag ⑦gis ji ltar byin gyis brlab par bya ba ma shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' dustsal pa/ lag pa gnyis bkrus nas byin 0len byas te lag pa g.yon pa'i steng du bzhag la lag pa g.yas pas bkab nas dge slong ⑨ gi mdun du 'dug nas tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi 0ba'i sman 'di bdag 8dang 0tshangs pa mtshungs ④par spyod pa rnams kyi phyir zhag bdun par byin gyis brlab bo zhes de skad lan gnyis lan gsum du brjod par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan 3—72

pa nye ba ①'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bu ram zhag bdun par byin gyis brlab par bya'o zhes gang gsungs pa su zhig gis 'tshal bar bgyi ②lags/ nye ba ni'akhor gang zag lnga rnams kyis te/ lam du zhugs pa dang smyung ba byas pa dang / nad pa dang / dge skos byadang / lag gi blas so/ /dge slong ljongs rgyur chas pa rnams kyis 'bras dang phye dag gi nang du bu ram bcug pa las lam gyis ngal nas bza' bar 'dod na ⑤'gyod pas ma zos pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag zas de ༷zas kyi bya ba byed mi nus pas 'bras dag gi nang du bcug pa gang yin pa de sprugs nas bza' bar bya'o/ /phye ⑦rnams kyi dugang yin pa de ni 0chus bkrus nas bza' bar bya'o//kha cig zhu bar gyur pa de bkrur ma rung ste zas dang bcas pa nyid du gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ smyug ⑩ma'i tshal pas bzhar la chus bkru bar bya'o/ /'on kyang zas med par bya yim nus nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ legs par bsal 8te/ chu'i nang du mnyes la btung bar byas nas de tshags kyis btsags la btung bar bya ste/ de la 'gyod par mi bya'o / /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa(spre/ khyim bdag lug dang / lug gi mchis 'brang tsodang / lug gi bu dang / lug gi mna' ma dang / lug gi bran pho dang / lug gi bran mos las ci zhig bgyis na/des na de drug bsod nams chen por gyur cing / bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bden pa mthong nas 'di dag gis bcom ldan 'das byamanyes par bgyis kyi 3—73

ma mnyes par ni ma lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di dag nyid kyis las rnams byas shing bsags pa tshogs rnyed pa zhes bya ba nas 'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bā rā ṇa sī'i grong khyer du rgyal po tshangs pas byin ①zhes bya ba rgyal srid byed du 'jug go/ /de'i tshe bā rā ṇa sī'i grong khyer du ltas mkhan rnams kyis lo bcu gnyis su char ②mi 'bab ②pas thur mas 'tsho ba'i mu ge chen po 'byung rjobar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /mu ge rnam pa gsum ni za ma tog dang / rus gong dkar po dang / thur mas 'tsho ba'o/ /de la za ma tog ces bya ba ni za ma tog de'i nang du mi rnams kyis 'bru dag blugs te/ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams kyi ched du bzhag nas bdag cag shi nas ⑤'bru 'dis mi de dag gi bya ba byed par 'gyur ro snyam pa ste/ 'di ni za ma tog dang 'brel pas za ma tog ces bya'o/ /rus gong dkar po gang zhe na/ dus de na mi rnams kyi 0rus pa dag bsdus nas re zhig btsos ⑦te/ ji tsam na rus pa de ⑧dkar por gyur pa ⑨dang / de nas de'i khu ba 'thung ba ste/ 'di ni rus gong dkar po dang 'brel bas rus gong dkar po zhes bya'o/ /thur mas 'tsho ba gang zhe na/ dus de na mi rnams kyis g.yul gyi ser ga nas 'bru'i 'brum bu dag thur mas ⑩byas nas chu mang po'i snod du btsos nas 'thung ba ste/ 'di ni thur ma dang 'brel pas thur mas 'tsho ba zhes bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po tshangs pas byin ⑪gyis bā rā ṇa sīr dril sgrogs su 8bcug pa/ bā rā ṇa sī na gnas pa'i shes ldan grong khyer pa dag nyon cig /ltas mkhan rnams kyis 0lo bcu gnyis su char mi 'bab pas za ma tog dang / rus gong dkar po dang / thur mas 3—74

'tsho ba'i mu ge 'byung bar lung bstan gyisal/ khyed las gang dag lo bcu gnyis kyi bza' ba yod pa de rnams ni 'khod cig /gang dag la med pa de dag ni gar dga' bar deng ②la mu ge med cing lo legs par gyur nas slar gshegs ②shig /de'i tshe na bā rā ṇa sī na khyim bdag phyug cing ④nor mang ba longs spyod che ba/ 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba zhig yod de/ des mngan ①bkug ste smras pa/ kye nang rje kho bo 'khor dang bcas pa'i lo bcu gnyis kyi bza' ba yod dam / des smras pa/ dpon po mchis so/ /de de nyid na gnas pa las mu ge de dubargyud ⑦ma kho nar byung bas de'i bang mdzod rnams yongs su zad pas 'khor gyi skye bo thams cad shi bar gyur te bdag nyid dang drug cig lus so/ /de nas khyim bdag des bang mdzod rnams phyags pa las/ 'bras bre'u chung gang zhig byung nas/ de'i ⑤chung mas snod du blugs te btsos so/ /sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ba med pa na rang sangs rgyas zhes bya ba nas/ 'jig rten gyi yon gnas gcig pu dag 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ba ⑨zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /ji tsam na rang sangs rgyas zhig ljongs rgyu zhing song ba dang bā rā ṇa sbor 0phyin nas snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te bā rā ṇa sīr bsod snyoms la zhugs pa na khyim bdag des kyang bza' ba bsdogs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas de yang rim ⑩bzhin du bsod snyoms la brgyus tshunas de'i khyim du phyin to/ /khyim bdag des de lus mdzes 4)shing sems dang ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bsams pa/ 'di bdag gis zos kyang gdon mi za bar srog dang 'bral bar 'gyur gyis8/ ma la bdag gi 8skal ba rab tu byung ba 'di la sbyin no snyam nas des chung ma la smras pa/ bzang mo kho bo'i skal ⑫3—75

ba ni rab tu byung ba 'di la dbul lo/ /des bsams pa/ bdag gi khyim thab ①mi za na bdag gis ci ste bza' snyam nas/ des smras pa/ rje'i sras bdag gi skal ba yang 'di la dbul ②lo/ /de bzhin du bu dang / mna' ma dang / bran pho dang / bran mos kyang dpyad nas rang rang gi skal ③ba yongs su btang ste/ de nas de thams cad 'dus nas rang sangs rgyas la bsod snyoms phul lo/ /bdag nyid chen po de dag ni lus kyis chos ston gyi 0tshig gis ni ma yin pas des ngang pa'i rgyal po 'dab ma brkyang rjob ltar steng gi nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags nas 'bar ba dang / gsal ba dang / char 'bebs pa dang / glog 'byin pa'i cho 'phrul dag bya bar brtsams so/ /so so'i skye bo dag ni rdzu 'phrul la myur du sems gtod 0pa yin pas shing rtsa ba nas bcad de 'gyel ⑦ba bzhin du rkang pa gnyis la gtugs ⑧nas smon lam ci 'dod pa ⑨gdab par rtsom ste/ khyim bdag gis smon lam btab ⑩pa/ bdag gis yon gnas dam pa 'di lta bu la bya ba byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin pa 'dis bdag gis gal te bang ba dang humadzod stong pa dag la bltas tson mthong ba de'i mod la gang bar gyur cig /'di lta bu'i chos rnams kyang thob nas 'di bas khyad par du 'phags pa'i ston pa rnams mnyes par bgyid cing mi mnyes par mi bgyid par gyur cig/chung mas smon lam btab pa/ bdag gis tsoyon gnas dam pa 'di lta bu la bya ba byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin pa 'dis bdag gis 8gal te gcig cig 8gi don du snod du btsos ⑩pa de brgya'am stong gis zos kyang ji srid bdag gis sbyor ba ma btang ba'i bar du ⑩yongs su zad par mi 'gyur zhing / 'di lta bu'i chos rnams kyang thob nas 'di bas khyad par du 'phags pa'i ston pa rnams mnyes 3—76

par bgyid cing mi mnyes par mi bgyid par gyur cig /bus smon lam btab pa/bdag gis ①yon gnas dam pa 'di lta bu la bya ba byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin pa 'dis bdag gi 0rked pa la lnga brgya pa'i snod btags te 'dug pa gal te brgya'am stong 'ged ②par btang 0yang gang ba nyid du 'dug ste yongs su zad par mi 'gyur zhing / 'di lta bu'i chos rnams kyang thob nas 'di bas khyad ⑤par du 'phags pa'i ston pa rnams mnyes par bgyid cing mi mnyes par mi bgyid par gyur cig /mna' mas smon lam btab pa/ bdag gis yon gnas dam pa 'di lta bu la bya ba byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin pa 'dis/bdag gis gal te gcig gi phyir dri rnams sbyar na des brgya'am stong byugs kyang ji srid 0sbyor ba ma btang gi bar du zad par mi 'gyur zhing / 'di lta bu'i chos rnams kyang thob nas 'di bas khyad ⑦par du 'phags pa'i ston pa rnams mnyes par bgyid cing mi mnyes par mi bgyid par gyur cig /bran pos smon lam btab pa/ bdag gis yon gnas dam pa 'di lta bu la bya ba byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin pa 'dis bdag gis gal te zhing rol gcig rmos na rol bdun rmos par 'gyur zhing / 'di lta bu'i chos rnams kyang thob nas 'di bas khyad par du 'phags pa'i ston pa rnams mnyes par bgyid cing mi mnyes par mi bgyid par gyur cig /bran mos smon lam btab pa/ bdag gis ②yon gnas dam pa 'di lta bu la bya ba byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin pa 'dis bdag ①gis gal te snod gang tsam drus ⑩pa gang yin pa des snod bdun tsam du 'phel bar ⑩'gyur zhing / 'di lta bu'i chos rnams kyang thob nas 'di bas khyad par du 'phags pa'i ston pa rnams mnyes par bgyid cing mi mnyes par mi 3—77

bgyid par gyur cig /de rnams kyis de lta bu'i smon lam btab nas rang sangs rgyas bdag nyid chen po de de rnams la snying brtse ba'i phyir rdzu 'phrul gyis chas pa dang ji tsam na rgyal po tshangs byin ①steng gi khang bzangs kyi rgyagazhir song ste 'dug pa las/ nirdzu 'phrul gyis song ba'i grib ma rgyal po tshangs byin ༷gyi steng du babs ⑤nas/ des gyen 0du blta bar brtsams pa las rang sangs rgyas de mthong nas de 'di snyam ⑦du bdag nyid chen po 'di'i rdzu 'phrul gyi gshol ⑧chen pos ⑨yang su zhig gi bkren pa'i drungs 0phyung bar gyur 0snyam mo/ /de nas khyim bdag de re ba chen pos mdzod dang bang mdzod tsornams la bltas pa ⑫dang / ji tsam na gang bar mthong ngo / /des chung ma la smras pa/ re zhig kho bo'i smon lam ni rdzogs par gyur gyis sked khyed cag gi byabalta'o/ /de nas bran mos 'bras snod gang tsam drus tson bdun tsam du 'phel bar gyur 0to/ /chung mas gcig gi don du snod du btsos pa la 8de dag thams cad kyis zos kyang de kho na bzhin du 'dug /nye 'khor gyi srog chags yistong phrag du mas zos kyang de kho na bzhin du 'dug go/ /de nas khyim bdag des bā rā ṇa srir dril sgrogs su 0bcug pa/ shes ldan dag khyed cag las su zhig ci don du gnyer ba de 0shog shig /bā rā ṇa sīr 6)sgra gsal ba dang sgra chen por byung ba rgyal pos thos nas des smras pa/ shes ldan dag sgra gsal ba dang / sgra chen po 'di ci zhig yin/ blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha khyim bdag che ge mo zhig ces bya dubs mdzod dang bang ba rnams phye ba lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gang gi tshe 'jig rten thams cad shi zin pa de'i tshe khyim bdag des mdzod dang bang ba rnams phye'am/ shes ldan dag khyim bdag de khug shiga' /de rnams kyis bkug 3—78

pa dang / de nas rgyal pos smras pa/ khyim bdag gang gi tshe 'jig rten thams cad shi zin pa de'i tshe khyod kyis ①mdzod dang bang ba rnams phye'am/ lha su'i mdzod dang bang ba rnams phye/ 'on kyang de ring kho nar ②sa bon stsal ba'i 'bras bu de ②nyid du grub lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ de ji lta bu zhig /des skabs de rgyas par smras pa dang rgyal pos smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod kyis bdag nyid chen po de la bsod snyoms phul lam/ lha bdag gis phul lo/ /de yang lhag par dad par gyur dunas/ tshigs su bcad ⑤pas smras pa/ kye ma'o yon tan las byung ba'i/ /skyon kun rnam par spangs pa'i zhing / /de la dus bon btab pa yi/ /'bras bu de ༷nyid thob par gyur/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ khyim bdag dang / khyim bdag gi chung ma dang / khyim bdag gi bu dang / khyim bdag gi mna' ma dang / khyim bdag gi bran pho dang /khyim bdag gi bran mo gang yin pa de ni khyim bdag lug dang / dulug gi chung ma dang / lug gi bu dang / lug gi mna' ma dang / lug gi bran pho dang /lug gi bran mo 'di dag nyid yin no/ /'di dag gis rang sangs rgyas la bya ba byas shing smon lam btab pa gang yin pa de'i ⑨las kyi rnam par smin pas drug char ⑩yang bsod nams 0chen por gyur cing nga'i spyan sngar bden pa mthong zhing /rang sangs rgyas bye ba brgya stong bas ches khyad par 4)'phags pa'i ston pa nga mnyes par byas kyi0/ mi mnyes 8par ni byam yin no/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na/ las gcig tu gnag pa rnams kyi ⑩rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag pa yin la/ gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi ni gcig tu dkar ba yin pas ⑩zhes bya ba nas brtsal tsobar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis de lta bu la bslab 3—79

par bya'o zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o// //sdom ni/ ke na'i bu yis btung ba blangs/ /ka shi'i tshong rdal nas thug dang / /sdig can du ni bca' ba dang / /'gyod dang sbyar ba'i zas dag go/ /bcom ldan 'das yul a ①du ma'i gnas na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe drang srong ke ②na'i bu gnas ni ②yul a du ma dun 'dug go/ /nyin ⑤par ni rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab kyi 'gram na gnas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ngas gang du 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi rnams la chos bshad na der ngas tshegs chung ngus drang srong ke duna'i bu thul bar 'gyur snyam pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ ma la ngas rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab kyi 'gram du bshad na der thul bar 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed de chos nyid kyis gang gi ①tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ②kyis 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa de'i tshe brgya 0byin dang tshangs pa la 6)sogs te lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs ⑩pa sems kyis shes par 'gyur bas rgyal po chen po tho)rnam thos kyi bus bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ci zhig gi phyir 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa tsomadzad pa byabaltas na/bdag cag 'jig rten skyong byab bzhi rnams kho na la chos bshad par bzhed do snyam du rig nas/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lngas rtsen la bsgo ba lngas rtsen spre)song la rdzing bu dal gyi 0'bab kyi 'gram du bcom ldan 'das kyi gdan shoms te/ 'dus 8pa chen po 'dus pa na sus kyang de'i thamadangs 'phrogs ⑥par mi 'gyur bar drang srong ke na'i bu'i srung 0ma gcig kyang skos shig /des 3—80

rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab kyi 'gram du drang srong ke na'i bu'i srung ①ma bzhag nas gnas shom par rtsom pa na de na skye bo'i tshogs chen po'i ca co'i sgra byung ba dang /de nas drang srong ke na'i bu ca co'i sgras ②langs nas srung ②ma de la dris pa/ ca co'i 0sgra 'di ci zhig des smras pa/ gdan shom par byed pa'i'o⑤/ /ci kho bo'i phyir ram/ khyod kyi phyir ni ma yin mod kyi 'on kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir yin no/ /khyod 'di na ci zhig la sdod/ khyod kho na srung ༷ngo / /ci'i phyir 'byung po mang po 'du bar 'gyur bas so/ /des smras pa/ dge sbyong gi ta ma de su zhig gis gsung bar byed par 'gyur/ des smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das de la su zhig srung / bcom ldan 'das de nyid ni 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa'i srung ⑧ma mdzad do zhes byas pa dang drang srong ke na'i bus thos nas cang mi smra'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro ①sham thabs mnabs 4)lhung bzed dang chos gos bsnams nas a ⑩du mar bsod snyoms la zhugs te/ a ⑫du mar bsod snyoms spyad nas zas kyi bya ba mdzad de/ zas phyi ma'i bsod snyoms spangs nas ji ltar thugs mnyam par bzhag na dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu a ()du ma nas mi snang 8bar gyur te/ rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab kyi 'gram du byon par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms 8par zhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor skyong dri za du ma'i 'khor dang / dri za brgya phrag du ma'i 'khor dang / dri za stong phrag du ma'i 'khor dang / dri za brgya stong phrag du ma'i 'khor dang / lha'i nor bus thu ba ⑩bkang ste/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song nas phyin pa 3—81

dang / bcom ldan 'das la lha'i nor bu rnams kyis gtor nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ①zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la mdun gyis bltas nas shar phyogs su brten te 'dug go/ /rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po yang grul bum du ma'i 'khor dang / grul bum brgya ②phyag du ma'i 'khor dang / grul bum stong phrag du ma'i 'khor dang /grul bum brgya stong phrag du ma'i 'khor dang / lha'i mu tig gis thu ba ②bkang ste/bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song nas phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la lha'i mu tig gis gtor nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas ༷te/ bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la mdun gyis bltas nas lho phyogs su brten te 'dug go/ /rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang yang klu du ma'i 'khor dang / klu brgya phrag du ma'i 'khor dang / klu stong phrag du ma'i 'khor dang / klu brgya stong phrag du ma'i 'khor dang / lha'i me tog utpa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da ⑤dang / pad ma dkar po dang / man dā dur ba rnams kyis thu ba bkang nas ⑦bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la lha'i me tog utpa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da ⑧dang / pad ma dkar po dang / man dā ra ⑨ba rnams kyis gtor nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 0zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la mdun gyis bltas nas nub phyogs su brten te 'dug go/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu yang yiganod sbyin du ma'i 'khor dang / gnod sbyin brgya phrag du ma'i 'khor dang / gnod sbyin stong phrag du ma'i 'khor dang / gnod sbyin brgya stong phrag du ma'i 'khor dang /3—82

lha'i dbyig dang / gser gyis thu ①ba bkang ste/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song nas phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbyig dang /gser gyis gtor nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas ②te/ bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la ②mdun gyis ༷bltas nas byang phyogs su brten te 'dug go/ /de la dbus pa'i rigs ni gnyis 0te/yul 'khor skyong dang / 'phags skyes po'o/ /mtha' 'khob pa'i rigs ni gnyis te/ mig mi bzang dang / rnam thos kyi bu'oyi/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ gal te ngas dbus pa'i tshig gis chos bshad na gnyis kho nas shes par 'gyur gyi gnyis kyis ⑦ni mi shes la/ gal te mtha' 'khob pa'i tshig gis bshad na gnyis kho nas shes par 'gyur gyi gnyis kyis ni mi shes pas ma la ngas gnyis la ni dbus pa'i tshig gis chos bshad do/ /gnyis la ni mtha' 'khob pa'i tshig gis chos ⑧bshad do snyam du dgongs nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor skyong la bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po 'di ltar lus zhig pa dang / tshor ba bsil ⑨bar gyur pa dang / 'du shes 'gags ()pa dang /'du byed rnams nye bar zhi ba yidang / rnam par shes pa nub par gyur pa de nyid sdug bsngal gyi mtha' yin no/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bka' stsal pa na rgyal po chen po yul 'khor skyong dang / de dang skal ba mnyam pa'i dri za brgya stong phrag du ma chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba skyes so//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po la bka' stsal pa/rgyal po chen po de la khyod kyis mthong ba la mthong ba tsam dang / thos pa dang /rtogs pa dang / rnam par shes pa la rnam par shes pa tsam du gyis shig /chos 3—83

kyi rnam grangs 'di bka' stsal pa na rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po dang / de dang skal ba mnyam pa'i grul bum brgya stong phrag du ma chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba skyes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang la bka' stsal pa/ de ltar na rgyal po chen po e ne me ne/dab be0)/ da ḍab phe 'di nyid sdug bsngal gyi mtha' yin no/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bka' stsal pa na ②rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang dang / de dang ③skal ④ba mnyam pa'i klu brgya 0stong phrag du ma chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba skyes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu la bka' stsal pa/ de ltar na rgyal po chen po mā 60/ tu ṣā/sang shā mā/ sarba tra bi rā ḍi 'di nyid sdug bsngal gyi mtha' yin no/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bka' stsal pa na/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu ⑦dang de dang skal ba mnyam pa'i gnod sbyin brgya stong phrag du ma chos rnams ⑧la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba skyes so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/da ni bdag yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dus la khad kyis nye na/ su la bstan pa gtad ⑨nas yongs su mya ngan ⑩'da'/ gal te lha rnams la ⑩ni lha rnams bag med pa la dga' ba mang bas yun ring du gnas par mi 'gyur ro/ /'on te mi rnams la ni mi ⑩ni tshe thung ba yin pas de bzhin du yun ring du gnas par mi 'gyur gyi8/ ma la ngas lha dang / mi rnams dang / dge slong 'od srung la gtad nas yongs su mya ngan las 'da'o snyam du dgongs nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor skyong la bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyis nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i bstan pa shar phyogs nas bsrung 8ba byos shig /rgyal po 3—84

chen po 'phags skyes po la bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyis kyang lho phyogs nas bsrung ①ba byos shig /rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang la bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyis kyang nub phyogs nas bsrung ②ba byos shig /rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu la bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po khyod kyis kyang byang phyogs nas bsrung ba ①blos shig /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi rab tu dga' ba'i yid kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' ji skad stsal pa de bzhin du bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis bsrung rjobar bgyi lags so zhes gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das las bden pa mthong nas zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas ⑤te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas dong ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung 0chen po la bstan pa mtha' dag gi bya ba rnams gtad nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la yang bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis kyang bstan pa'i don gyi bya ba la brtson par gyis shig /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/btsun pa rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams kyis las ci zhig bgyis na/ las de'i rnam par smin pas rgyal po chen po ⑦bzhir gyur cing / bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bden pa mthong bar bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' ⑧stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di dag nyid kyis sngon gyi ①tshe rabs gzhan rnams su las rnams byas shing bsags pa tshogs rnyed pa zhes bya ba nas/ 'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu ⑩rnams kyi 0tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na ston 3—85

pa zhes bya ba nas/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ngo / /zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de'i tshe rgya mtsho chen po ①na klu gnyis shig gnas te rgyadabugs 'byin dang / dbugs cher 'byin no/ /shing shal ma brtsegs pa na yang nam mkha' lding gnyis shig ①yod pa 'gro ba'i dbang phyug dang / gtsug gi dbang phyug go/ /gang gi tshe dbugs 'byin dang dbugs cher 'byin gnyis la de gnyis gnod pa byed pa de'i tshe de gnyis sa'i 'og tu 'gro bar byed do/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na dbugs 'byin dang / dbugs cher 'byin gnyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi spyan sngar skyabs su song zhing bslab pa'i gzhi rnams blangs pa dang / de gnyis la nam mkha' lding gis gnod pa dubya bar brtsams pa las/ ri rab la rlung dang chu'i shugs bzhin du rdugs nas slar logs ⑤pa dang / de gnyis kyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag sngon ni kho bo cag gis khyed cag duganod pa byas na sa'i 'og tu 'gro na/ da gang gis na kho bo cag khyed dang phrad ⑦nas ri rab la rlung dang chu ⑧bzhin du rdugs nas phyir ldog pa 'di la rgyu ci zhig yod/ dbugs ⑨'byin dang dbugs cher 'byin gyis ⑫smras pa/ bdag cag gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi spyan sngar skyabs yisu 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi rnams blangs so/ /de gnyis kyis smras pa/ gal te de lta na 8bdag cag gis kyang blang ngo zhes de gnyis de dag dang lhan cig 'grogs te yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi spyan sngar dong nas de dag phyin pa dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi spyan snga nas 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi po dag gis chos 'thos nas dong 3—86

ba de dag de gnyis kyis mthong nas/ nam mkha' lding de gnyis kyis ⑨klu dbugs 'byin ②dang / dbugs cher 'byin gnyis la dris pa/ 'gro ba pha bi ③dag su dag 0yin/ de gnyis kyis rgyas par smras pa dang ⑤/ nam mkha' lding gnyis kyis smras pa/ gal te de ltar dubadag cag gis kyang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi spyan sngar skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi rnams blangs la lasmon lam gdab po zhes de gnyis kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung las skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi rnams blangs so/ /dbugs 'byin dang dbugs cher 'byin gnyis ni sngar ⑧blangs so//de nas lhan cig 'dus nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi zhabs gnyis la gtugs nas smon lam btab pa/ ji ltar 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi po 'di dag gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi spyan sngar chos mnyan nas bden pa mthong ste rang gi gnas su mchis ⑨pa de bzhin du bdag cag kyang ()dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis 'jig rten skyong ba bzhir gyur cing /bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis 0bram ze'i khye'u bla ma zhes bgyi ba gang lags pa de la bram ze'i khye'u khyod ⑩skye dgu ⑩rnams kyi 8tshe lo brgya thub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa'i bcom ldan 'das des kyang de bzhin du rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab kyi 'gram du bdag cag la chos bshad de bdag cag gis chos de thos nas bden pa mthong ste/ 'di bzhin du rang gi gnas su mchi bar gyur cig ces byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ klu dang nam mkha' lding bzhi po gang dag tsoyin pa de dag ni 3—87

'jig rten skyong ba bzhi po 'di ①dag nyid yin te/ de'i tshe de'i dus na ②dbugs 'byin gang yin pa de ni yul 'khor skyong 'di nyid yin no/ /dbugs cher 'byin gang yin pa de ni 'phags skyes po yin no/ /'gro ba'i dbang phyug ni mig mi bzang yin no/ /gtsug gi dbang phyug ni rnam thos kyi bu yin te/de'i tshe de'i dus na 'di dag gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi spyan sngar skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi rnams blangs shing smon lam btab pa gang yin pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas 'jig rten skyong ba bzhir gyur cing nga'i ②spyan sngar bden pa mthong bar byas nas rang gi gnas su song ngo //chos bshad pa de 0drang srong ke duna'i bus thos nas mchog tu dga' ba skyes 0te/bcom ldan 'das la mngon par dad par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas gang thos nas mod la drang srong ke na'i bus 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams mngon par rtogs nas phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas pa de lta bu'i chos bshad pa mdzad do/ /de nas de rtogs pa'i dad pa dang ldan par gyur nas/ btung ba brgyad po tso tsa'i btung ba dang / chu shing gi 'bras bu'i btung ba dang / rgya shug gi btung ba dang / a shwattha'i ⑦btung ba dang /u dum bā ⑧ra'i btung ba dang / rtsub 'gyur gyi btung ba dang / 'bra go'i btung ba dang / rgyan gyi btung ba khyer te ⑨bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa btung ba brgyad po 'di dag ni sngon gyi tho)drang srong rnams kyis bstod cing bsngags pa lags kyis0/ bcom ldan 'das thugs brtse ba nye bar bzung ste 3—88

bzhes su gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis drang srong ke na'i bu la thugs brtse ①bar dgongs nas btung ba brgyad po dag bzhes so/ /bzhes nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag btung ba brgyad po 'di dag dus su byin ②len byas/ dus su mnyes③/ dus su btsagasaX/ dus su byin gyis brlabs na dus su longs spyad par bya zhing dus ma yin par yang ⑤mongs spyad par 0bya la/ nam gyi thun dang po thal nas ni ⑦mongs spyad par mi ⑧bya'o/ /btung ba brgyad po 'di dag dus su byin len byas la dus ma yin par mnyes/dus ma yin par btsags/ dus ma yin par byin gyis brlabs pa ni 0longs spyad 4 )par mi bya'o/ /btung ba brgyad po 'di dag dus su byin len byas/dus su mnyes la(spre/ dus ma yin par btsags dus ma yin par byin gyis brlabs 8pa ni longs spyad 0par mi bya'o/ /btung ba brgyad po 'di dag dus ma yin par byin ④len byas8/ dus ma yin par mnyes/ dus ma yin par btsags pa ni zas kyi 'og tu yang longs 8spyad par mi bya la/ nam gyi cha stod 'das na yang longs spyad 4)par mi bya'o/ /de nas drang srong ke na'i bu stan ⑫las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar yinas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu sang bdag gis gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/bcom ldan 'das kyis 0drang srong ke na'i bu la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas drang srong ke na'i bu bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas stan las langs te song ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyang 0rdzing bu dal gyis ⑫3—89

'bab kyi 'gram nas mi snang ①bar mdzad de dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu a ②du mar gshegs so/ /de nas drang srong ke na'i bu nam ma langs par langs nas nang mi ③rnams la smras pa/ 'phags pa dag bzhengs 0shig /bzhin bzangs dag longs shig /shing dag gshegs shig /me bus shig /zhal zas dag brim par 0gyis shig /bkad dus dag ⑦gyi dor gyis shig /de'i tshe drang srong ke na'i bu'i nisring mo'i bu drang srong ri bo zhes bya ba gnas ⑨de nyid du nub mo gnas btab ⑩pa las/ drang srong ri bos drang srong ke na'i bu nam ma langs par langs nas nang mi rnams la smra ba 0thos so/ /thos nas kyang drang srong ke na'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /drang srong ci khyod tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams mgron 8du bos sam/ yul ma ga dma'i 8rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po'am/ pho brang 'khor na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs sam/ drang srong gi chos ji ltar 'dod pa yongs su rdzogs pa'amatso/ des smras pa/ ri bo kho bo ni tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams mgron 'du bos pa yang ma yin/ yul ma ga dma'i ⑩rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po yang ma yin/ pho brang 'khor na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs kyang ma yin/ drang srong gi chos ji ltar 'dod pa yongs su rdzogs pa yang ma yin mod kyi0/ 'on kyang kho bos sangs rgyas la 8sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs tshod la spyan drangs so/ /des yisangs rgyas zhes 0bya ba'i sgra sngon ma thos pa thos nas ba spu 0thams cad zing zhes byed nas gus pa dang bcas pas dris pa/ drang srong sangs rgyas zhes bya ba de ci zhig yin/ ri bo dge sbyong gi ta ma shākya'i sras shākya'i rigs las skra dang kha spu bregs nas dugos ngur smrig bgos 0te dad pa ④yang dag pa kho 3—90

nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung nas de 7bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa zhig yod de/ ri bo sangs rgyas zhes bya ba ni de yin no/ /ri bos smras pa/ drang srong dge 'dun zhes bya ba 'di ②ci zhig yin/ drang srong ke na'i bus smras pa/ ri bo rgyal rigs kyi rigs kyi ③bu rnams las kyang spa dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig bgos 0te dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim dumed par rab tu byung ba yang yod/ bram ze'i rigs dang / rje'u'i ༷rigs dang / dmangs ⑦rigs kyi rigs kyi ③bu rnams las kyang zhes bya ba nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab tu byung ba de nyid kyi rjes su rab tu byung ba yod de zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste / ri bo 'di ni dge 'dun zhes bya'o⑨/ /ri bo dge 'dun 'di dang byasngar smos pa'i sangs rgyas te sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i yidage slong gi dge 'dun 'di kho bos gdugs tshod la spyan drangs so/ /de nas drang srong ri bos sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i dran pas nang par 4)sngar langs te 'khor lnga brgya dang bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song 8ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas 0te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas drang srong ri bos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la bdag rab tu 'byung ⑫ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa ()dge slong gi dngos po thob pa lta na/ bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar tshangs par spyad par bgyi'o/ /drang srong ri bo dang ⑩'khor lnga brgyas legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba 3—91

dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa ①dge slong gi dngos po thob par gyur to// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po lnga bcu dgu ②pa/ de nas drang srong ke na'i bus de nyid kyi nub mo nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag ces bya ba nas bstabs ②shing tshim par byas so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /des dusangs rgyas la dusogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs tshod gsol ba na ri bo rab tu byung ba mthong nas des smras pa/ ri bo khyod rab tu byung ngam/ rab tu byung ngo / /legs par byas so/ /shin tu legs par byas so/ /kho bo yang sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun dugadugs tshod gsol zin nas rab tu 'byung ⑤ngo / /de nas drang srong ke na'i bus sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la rnam grangs du mar gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag ⑧rang gi lag nas bstabs shing tshim par byas so//bcom ldan 'das kyis gsol zin nas phyag bcabs te/ lhung bzed gyu bar rig nas stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de la yon bsngo ba ⑨dang chos bshad pa mdzad nas gshegs so/ /de nas drang srong ke na'i bus rgyu lhag de dag thams cad btang ⑩ba'i chos byas nas 'khor lnga brgya dang bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas 0te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas drang srong ke na'i bus bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa legs par gsungs pa'i 8chos 'dul ba la bdag rab tu 'byung 0ba dang bsnyen 8par rdzogs pa tsodage slong gi dngos po ⑩thob pa lta na/ bcom ldan 3—92

'das kyi spyan sngar ②tshangs par spyad ②par bgyi'o/ /drang srong ke na'i bu ②'khor lnga brgya dang legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po thob par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong stong po de dag rjodang / 'bab chu rab tu bzang po'i ⑤'gram du a mra'i tshal gdugs lta bur dbyar gnas par zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa bram ze ka pi dun la dge slong lnga brgya gtad ⑦do/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la nyis brgya lnga bcu gtad do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i ③bu la nyis brgya lnga bcu gtad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa bram ze ka pi ⑨nas gdams ngag phog pa gang 0yin pa de dag ni nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas so/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i gang dag yin pa de dag ni lan gcig 0phyir 8'ong ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i gang dag yin pa de dag ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tsobacom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i byabu ni shes rab che ba rnams dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ni mthu che ba dang / rdzu 'phrul che ba rnams kyi mchog tu bstan 4)lags na/ 'on kyang tshe dang ldan pa bram ze ka pi tsonas gdams ngag phog pa gang dag 0lags pa de dag ni dgra bcom pa/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i gang dag lags pa de dag ni lan gcig tsophyir tho)'ong ba'i 'bras bu/tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i 0 bu'i gang dag lags pa de dag ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 3—93

'bras bu mngon sum du bgyis pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ltar du ma zad ji ltar 'das pa'i dus na yang ka pi na'i gdams ①ngag phog pa gang dag ②yin pa de dag ni gzugs med pa'i khams la rab tu bkod/ mod gal gyi bu'i ③gang dag yin pa de dag ni gzugs kyi khams dang / shā ri'i bu'i gang dag yin pa de dag 0ni mngon par shes pa lnga la rab tu bkod pa de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba dgon pa'i gnas zhig na drang srong gnyis shig gnas te so sor 'khor lnga brgya lnga brgya yod do/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na de gnyis las ⑤gcig shi nas de'i bram ze'i khye'u rnams bla ma dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal ba rjodang / yid mi bde bas gdungs nas phan tshun 'phyan 'phyan nas drang srong cig shos de'i drung du 'ongs pa dang /des de rnams mig mchi mas gang ba mthong nas dris pa/ bram ze'i khye'u dag khyed ⑦kyi mkhan po de gar song / gum mo/ /⑧des bsams pa/ bdag 'das na bram ze'i khye'u rnams 'di 'dra ba'i gnas skabs su 'gyur gyisal/ma la bdag gis 'di dag bsdu bar bya'o snyam nas des de rnams dbugs 0phyung ste bsdus so/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na drang srong de yang nad kyis thebs par gyur nas/ de'i slob ma mchog gsum yod pa la des gcig la ni (7lnga brgya/gnyis pa la ni ④nyis brgya lnga bcu/ gsum pa la ni nyis brgya lnga bcu gtad tsodo//de ni 'chi ba'i chos dang ldan par gyur to/ /de la lnga brgya gtad pa gang yin pa des ④ni ji ltar gzugs med pa'i khams la bkod pa de ltar gdams ngag phog go//nyis brgya lnga bcu gtad pa gang yin pa des 0ni ji ltar gzugs kyi khams la bkod pa de ltar gdams ngag phog go/ /nyis brgya lnga bcu log pa cig shos kyis 3—94

ni ji ltar mngon par ①shes pa lnga la bkod pa de ltar gdams ngag phog go/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi drang srong bram ze'i khye'u ②lnga brgya gzugs med pa'i khams la 'god pa gang yin pa de ni dge slong ka pi rgyan 'di nyid yin no/ /nyis brgya lnga bcu gzugs kyi khams la rab tu 'god pa gang yin pa de ni dge slong mod gal gyi bu 'di nyid yin no/ /cig shos kyis nyis brgya lnga bcu mngon par shes pa lnga la rab tu dkod ༷pa gang yin pa de ni dge slong shā ri'i bu 'di nyid yin no/ /'on kyang dge slong ka pi ⑤nas gdams ngag phog pa gang yin pa de ①ni dbang po rnon po yin no/ /mod gal gyi bu'i gang ⑦yin pa de dag ni dbang po 'bring po yin no/ /shā ri'i bu'i ⑧gang ⑨yin pa de dag ni dbang po rtul 0po yin no/ /gal te shā ri'i bus gdams ngag yiphog par ma 'gyur na de dag gis dro bar gyur pa yang rtogs 8par mi 'gyur ro/ /ke na'i bu ni ral pa can/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas bsngags ④brjod pa/ /rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis ni/ /thams cad mthun par mnyan 8par gyisatso/ /ke na'i bu yi khyim du ni/ /dus gcig cig na tho)ston pa po/ /dpa' chen nyan thos thabs cig tu/ /gdugs tshod la ni spyan drangs so/ /ke na'i bu yi 8khyim du ni/ /zas kyi zhal ta ()byed pa dag /bram ze ri bos mthong gyur te/ /mthong nas ke na'i bu la dris/ /bag ma len tam 'on te ci/ /rgyal po yul 'khor mgron rjobos sam/ /khyod kyi mchod sbyin che dus sam/ /dris pa de ni bdag la sgros 0/ /bdag ni bag ma mi len la/ /rgyal po'am yul 'khor mgron ⑤ma bos/ /bdag gis rdzusangs rgyas sems dpa' mchog /gdugs tshod la ni spyan drangs so/ /ri bos rdzisangs rgyas sgra thos nas/ /yid skyo ba ni skyes gyur 3—95

te / /sangs rgyas de ci ke na'i bu/ /dris pa de ni bdag la smros①/ /shākya'i rigs las ②skyes pa yi/ /ston pa gang zag zla med yod/ /de ni chos kun blo ldan pas/ /de bas sangs rgyas zhes bya'o/ /'dus byas 'jig par ③'gyur ba'i chos/ /'das pa dusangs rgyas kyis gzigs la/ /de bzhin ma 'ongs pa gzigs shing / /da ltar byung ba rnams kyang gzigs/ /mngon shes bya ba ji snyed pa/ /de kun rtogs pas thams cad rig /thams cad mkhyen cing thams cad gzigs/ /de bas sangs rgyas zhes bya'o/ /mngon par shes bya mngon shes byas/ /bsgom ⑤par bya ba rnams kyang bsgoms/ /spang bar bya ba rjospangs pas na⑦/ /de bas sangs rgyas zhes bya'o/ /gang zhig bltams ⑧par gyur pa na/ /rgya mtsho ⑨ri bor bcas pa yi/ /sa 'di rab tu g.yos ⑩mdzad pa//de la thal sbyar phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis yibadud dang nag po yiX/ /rtsa lag bzhin tibacas bcom nas ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kyi stobs thob pa/ /de la thal sbyar phyag 'tshal lo/ /bā rā ṇa sī'i ④grong bzhud nas/ /gang gis rnam pa bcu gnyis pa'i/ /chos kyi bya'akhor lo de bskor ⑩ba/ /de la thal sbyar phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis 'dod chags bcing bas ⑩bcings/ /'dod chags zhe snang gis gdungs 8pa'i/ /sems can mang po grol mdzad pa'iyi/ /de la thal sbyar phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan dugang zhig na tshu/ /rnam 'dren de ni ji srid na/ /shākya'i 3sras po 'od mdzad la/ /de ring nyid nas duskyabs su 'gro / /tshal sdug yid du 'ong ba de/ /gang na ba ⑥ni bram ze'i chos/ /dri za'i ⑥rgyal po lta bu yi/ /sangs rgyas bla med mthong bar gyurakya/ /na bza' ngur smrig 'od ldan de/ /gser mdog 0nyi ma'i 'od zer can/ /de bzhin 3—96

gser ni btso ①ma yi/ /gser las gzugs ni byas pa bzhin/ /sā rgyal shing gi me tog dang / /kur ni ka ra'i me tog 'dra/ /rin chen sna tshogs spras pa yi//rin chen mchod sdong ji bzhin no/ /n+ya gro dha ③lta bur ni/ /chu duzheng gab par gyur pa dang / /khor yug 'dom gang 'od kyis duni/ /kun nas snang ba dag tu mdzadaX/ /rgyal srid rgyas ⑦dang nye dur bcas/ /'dod pa kun dga' spangs nas ni/ /rab tu byung bar mngon byung ba'i/ /thub ⑧pa dben pa rnams la dgyes/ /spos ngad ldang ba'i ⑨seng ge ni/ /nags su 'jigs pa med pa ltar/ /seng ge lta bur bsnyengs med gsung ⑩/ /bram ze sangs rgyas mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhal 'dzum 'jam pa'i gsung dang ni/ /tshangs pa'i gsung dang snyan pa'i gsung / /rnga yi sgra yi gsung lta bu'i/ /sangs rgyas bram ze mthong bar 'gyurayi/ /zla ba dag pa nam mkha' la/ /rgyu skar rnams kyis yongs bskor tsoba'i/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bu yi8/ /sangs rgyas bram ze mthong bar 'gyur/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer dang ldan pa/ /nam mkha'i ngos la mdzes lta yi8/ /sangs rgyas mun pa 'bral gyur cing / /mdzes pa byabram ze mthong bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar khyu ⑩ba'i khyu mchog ni/ /nog dang ldan pa mi g.yo gnas(nye/ /skyes bu khyu mchog stobs bcu ldan/ /sangs rgyas bram ze mthong bar 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho dag ni gting zab pa'i/ /chu chen tshad gzung ⑥med lta yi0/ /sangs rgyas bsam gtan pa yi mchog /bsam gyis mi khyab bla med mthong / /nag po'i phyogs las nges byung ba'i/ /nyi ma mkha' la gsal ba dang / / me yi 0phung po 'bar ba lta'i/ /gi tam sangs rgyas mthong bar 'gyur / /ji ltar 'khor los dusgyur rgyal po/ / zhabs 'bring bye bas ③yongs 3—97

bskor ltar/ /de bzhin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /dgra bcom rnams kyis mdun byas mdzes/ /'dod pa rnams la dbang sgyur dang / /ji ltar tshangs chen dbang phyug ltar/ /stong gsum gyi ni 'jig rten khams/ /thub pa dbang ni sgyur bar mdzad/ /gang thos nye bar zhi 'gyur zhing / /sdug bsngal mtsho chen las sgrol ba/ /sdug bsngal rnam pa du ma dang / /sdug bsngal kun 'byung gang yin dang / /sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba dang / /lam ni yan lag bzhi tshan ①gnyis/ /sbrang rtsi ma bskol ②ro lta bu'i/ /bden pa dag ni rab tu 'chad①/ /nor med rnams la nor sbyin zhing / /nad pa rnams kyi rjodapyad kyang mdzad/ /gnod pa rnams kyi skyabs gyur pas/ /skye dgu dusdug bsngal grol bar mdzad/ /mun par gyur pa'i sems can dang / /blun po lam gol ①rgyu ba dang / /bde ba mya ngan 'das 'gro ba'i/ /lam ni ⑦drang po rab tu ston/ /'dod chags zhe sdang kun 'bar zhing ⑧/ /gti mug rab 'bar skye dgu rnams/ /ji ltar sprin chen char 'bebs ltar/ /thub pa chen pos zhi bar mdzad/ /gzugs dang kha dog stobs ldan pa⑨/ /de dang 'dra ba yod ma yin/ /sku mkhregs shyistobs mchog ldan pa ni/ /ri bo bzhin du ⑩shin tu gnas/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed bde sdug dang / /smad pa dang ni bstod pa dang / /grags pa dang ni ma grags pas / /chu yis pad ma bzhin ma gos/ /srog gcod pa ni rnam 8spangs te/ /ma byin pa la dga' mi byed/ /bden pa gsung 8zhing tshangs par spyod/ /de ni phra ma spangs pa yin/ /tshig rtsub dag ④ni mi gsung zhing / /dus su bab pa 'jam por gsung ⑫/ /de ni 'dod la brnab sems med/ /skye bo rnams la de sems byams/ /yang dag lta ba phun byasum tshogs/ /ting nge 'dzin stobs 3—98

spyod yul ba/ /bsam gtan chen po mngon shes drug /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni mkha' la gshegs/ /lha dang mi yi ①sgra dag ni/ /gang yin rnam pa sna tshogs gsan / /nyon mongs can nam ②dge yang durung / /pha rol gyi ni sems kyang mkhyen / /gang dang gang du sngon gnas pa/ /sngon gyi gnas la mkhas pa dang //sems can 'gro dang 'ong ba yi/ /'chi 'pho dang ni skye ba mkhyen/ /zag pa zad cing mi ldan pas/ /nyer zhi shin tu mya ngan 'das/ /dbang po zhi zhing thugs zhi ba/ /mtsho ni gang ba bzhin du gnas/ /pad ma'i rdzing na glang po che// dam pa 0drug bcu lon pa ltar/ /mthong na ngoms ni mi shes pas/ /bram ze dga' ba thob par 'gyur/ /ri bo bcom ldan 'di 'dra ste/ /de yi sku ni skyes chen gyi/ /sum bcu rtsa gnyis mtshan mnga' zhing / /gzi brjid me yi ⑤phung po bzhin/ /gang gis lo brgya tshang bar ni/ /skyob pa'i bsngags 0pa brjod byas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa tshad med pas/ /des ni mthar phyin mi 'gyur ro//bram ze gang gis de mthong ba/ /de yi rnyed pa bla na med/ /gang gis mthong bas skyabs ⑦song ba/ /de yi rnyed pa de bas 'phags/ /bram ze ri bos ⑧thub chen gyi/ /bsngags pa thos nas skyo bar gyur/ /dben pa'i sems kyi rtog ⑨pa yis/ /ke na'i bu la 'di skad smras/ /mir ⑩gyur pa la bdag gis ni/ /de 'dra'i bsngags 0pa thos ma myong / /ke na 'chad pa dang sbyar na/ /de ni 'jig rten kun gyi tsogatso/ /tshong pa nor dag don gnyer ltaratso/ /khyod kyis nga rgyal rgyal mtshan spongs/ /de la bkur ste gus byos dang / /bram ze dga' ba thob ④par 'gyur/ /bram ze tsokhye'u ni 8lnga brgya yis0/ /slob ma dag gis mdun bdar te/ /sangs rgyas bzhugs pa bzang po der8/ /bram ze ri bo 3—99

song bar gyur/ /lha rnams kyi ni dga' tshal ①ltar/ /me tog shing ni phun sum tshogs/ /rnam par dben zhing ③sgra med cing / /bya yi tshogs kyis bsten ③gyur pa/ /mi min gdug pa mi 0rgyu ba/ /shākya'i sras kyis bsten ⑤pa yi/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i gnas su ni/ /de nas bram zes zhugs par gyur/ /ma dul 'dul ba kha lo sgyur/ /skyes bu dam pa mthong nas ni/ /ri bo 0yis ni tshig gsol pa/ /shes ldan ci ⑦ga snyun mi mnga'amani/ /ka la ping ku'i ①sgra dbyangs can/ /sangs rgyas snyan cing gsal ba'i bkas/ /ri bo la ni slar gsungs pa/ /nga la nad ni yod min te/ /nyes pa med cing sdig 0pa med/ /the tshom thams cad rnam par chad0/ /rnam par grol zhing mi ldan pa/ /nga ni zag med tha ⑩ba med/ /'jig rten na ni rdul med rgyu/ /gtsang zhing dag la dri nga med/ /des na bram ze nga gtsang ste/ /khon tsodang 'jigs pa kun las rgal(ste/ /ri bo khyod kyang 'ongs pa ⑩legs/ /stan 'di la ni legs par 'dug /bram ze ci ga ⑩bde 'am khyod/ /lus ni ngal bar ma gyur mod/ /dpa' bo chen po khyod mthong bas/ /thub pa chen po da ⑩ltar bde/ /rgyan rnams kyis ni brgyan pa ltar/ /yid ni rab tu dga' ba yis/ /de dang rjes su 'tsham pa'i gtam/ /rim pa bzhin du byas nas ni/ /de nas bram ze 'dzem pa dang / /dman pa'i yid kyis 'dug par gyur/ /klog pa dang ni gsang tshig 'dzin/ /rig byed gsum gyi rig tsomathar phyin/ /bram ze ri bo 'dug nas ni/ /thub pa'i mtshan la rtog ⑥par byed/ /'jig rten gyi ni mgon po yi/ /sku la mtshan ni sum bcu mthong / /ljags srab mdoms sba byasbubs nub pa/ /gnyis la ri bo the tshom za/ /thub pa chen po'i mtshan 3—100

rnams la/ /the tshom yid gnyis gyur nas ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi ma'i rigs / /bden pa'i mtshan la yongs zhus pa/ /thub pa chen po'i mtshan rnams ni/ /sum bcu rtsa gnyis thob pa gang / /gi tam khyod kyis ①sku dag la/ /gnyis ni g.yar sngar ma bab bo/ /mi yi dam pa mdoms ②kyi ni/ /sba ba sbubs su nub lags sam/ /ljags bzang zhes ni bgyi ba yang / /ci ②ga thung ba ma lags grang / /thub chen bdag gis ci nas kyang / /ljags ring glo rjobar chud 'gyur bdu/ /ljags srab myur du brkyang rjomadzad de/ /bdag gi the tshom bsal du gsol/ /rnam par 'dren rnams 'jig rten du/ /brgya lam na ni lan 'ga' ⑦'byung / /u dum bā ri'i ⑧me tog bzhin/ /thub pa chen po dkon pa lags/ /sos ka skom pa chab dang ni/ /bkres pa la ni g.yar zas dang / /nad pa sman la ji lta bar/ /ston pa la ni bkur ste ⑨bgyid/ /ka la ping ku'i ⑩sgra dbyangs can/ /sangs rgyas snyan cing gsal ba'i bkas/ /ri bo la ni slar gsungs pa/ /bram ze the tshom spang bar (nyegyis/ /ljags kyis ⑫spyan dang snyan dag ni/ /rab tu khebs par ljags ring gis/ /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor khebs par mdzad/ /rdzu 'phrul bzhi la mkhas pa yis0/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis kyang bstan mdzad pas/ /thub pa'i mdoms ④spa sbubs nub pa/ /bram ze ri bos mthong bar gyur/ /thub pa chen pos tsomatshan rnams la/ /the tshom med cing zug rngu phyung / /sems kyi rtog pa rab dga' nas/ /ri bo yis ni tshig gsol pa/ /sum bcu gnyis dang dpe byad rnams/ /bdag gis gsang tshig las thos pa/ /de kun khyod kyi sku 'di la/ /yongs su rdzogs te ma tshang med/ /dge dang ldan pas tshuspyod pa bzang / /legs par 'khrungs pas blta ⑫3—101
