na sdug /nyan thos dge 'dun dbus na ni/ /gdugs bdal ba ni lta bur mdzes/ /dam par bsngags pa khyod la ni/ /dge sbyong dngos pos ci zhig bgyi / /mi yi khyu mchog khyod lta bu/ /dpung gi yan lag bzhi dag dang / /rin chen bdun dang ldan pa mi①/ /'khor los sgyur ②ba'i rgyal por 'os /sa bdag rgyal po ①mdzad nas ni/ /sa steng du'akhor los sgyur bar rjomadzod0/ /ri bo nga ni rgyal po ste/ /chos kyi rgyal chen bla na med/ /nga ni sa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /chos kyi 'khor lo skor ⑦bar byed/ /nga yi rigs ni rgyal rigs te/ /nga ni dge ba'i rigs las 'khrungs/ /bdud dpung bcas par bcom nas ni/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub dam pa thob/ /bram ze nga'i ②dran 'khor lo ste/ /nga yi shes rab blon po yin/ /brtson 'grus shugs mgyogs rta pho 0ni/ /btang na dang la 'byung ba yin0/ /nga yi nor bu dam pa niyi/ /ting 'dzin mun pa gsal byed yin/ /btang snyoms glang chen dam pa ste/ /bskul na dang la tsosmyug pa yin/ /chags bcas bud med 'dod pa ltar/ /bram ze nga'i tsodaga' 'dod pa yin/ /bram ze nga yi 8khyim bdag ni/ /shin tu sbyangs nor dam pa yin/ /nga yi byang chub yan lag bdun/ /'jig rten kun 'das rin chen des/ /long bar gyur cing gnyid log pa'i/ /skye dgu 'di dag sad par bya/ /phyogs rnams kun nas nga rgyal bas/ /nga la sngo byaba'i dgra yod min/ /nyon mongs tshogs rnams 'joms pa yi/ /'khor bzhi po dag nga yi sras/ /rdzu 'phrul kun dga' phun sum tshogs/ /lam gyi ⑩bzhi mdor sprul pa byas/ /mdo sde skyes pa'i rabs dag bkram/ /skyes bu chen po rnams kyis sten0/ /rnam thar gsum gyi 8sgo mo can/ /dran pa'i srung tsom rnams kyis 3—102

bsrungs/ /ngo tsha khrel ①yod kyis g.yogs ②pa'i/ /grong khyer sngon gyi sangs rgyas kyis/ /bsten ③pa dag tu de bzhin gshegs/ /rgyal po nga ni bzhugs nas su/ /nga yi chos kyi dugayul sprad de/ /chos kyi rnga bo che rjobardungs nasaX/ /bdud rnams mtha' dag bcom byas te/ /nga ni byang chub phyir dbang bskural/ /tshad med pa dag rab bsgoms pa/ /nga yi rgyan du bdog pa yin/ /tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi po yis/ /nyon mongs pa dag rab tu bzlogani /pha rol rab tu rgol bcom ste/ /rnam par bcom zhing theg med byas/ /srog chags rnams la 'jig rten 'dir/ /snang ba sbyin zhing yang dag spyad/ /nga ni bde bar ⑨gnas bcas nas/ /ye shes kyi ⑩ni mtshon gyis bcad0/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa gnas yin te/ /zhi gnas dag ni 'dzin stangs yin/ /tshul khrims shing rta sgra snyan la/ /nga yi lhag mthong kha lo sgyur/ /bzod dang des pa'i go bgos nas/ /lam bsgoms pas na g.yul ngor ni/ /gang gis sgrib pa 'joms pa yi/ /dbang po lnga yi dong ba dang / /gang gi 4)nyon mongs thag ⑫'jud pa'i/ /yang dag spong ba bzhi po yis/ /ngas ni dpa' bo tsogayul sprad debya/ /chos kyi rnga bo che brdungs nas/ /bdud dpung bcas par bcom byas te/ /nga ni tsobyang chub dbang bskur ro⑩/ /rig pas ma rig bcom nas ni/ /phung po skye zhing 'jig 8pa can/ /g.yul gyi rtse mo rgal 8te nga / /skye dgu byang chub phyir sangs rgyas/ /gang gi duskye dgu gnod byed pa/ /'jig rten chom rkun chen po gsum/ /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug rnams/ /de kun nga yis bcom pas na tī/ /mngon shes kun gyi stobs byung bas/ /nga ni dgra bcom yon gnas 'os/ /zhing gshin pa la zhugs pa yi3/ /sbyin sreg ⑫3—103

rnams kyang len pa yin/ /brtson 'grus dam pa brtsams nas ni/ /ngas ni zag pa rnams bcom mo/ /chu bo che las rgal ①nas ni/ /bsgral ba'i phyir ni gnas pa yin/ /ji ltar seng ge mche ba'i stobs/ /nags su srog chags dang phrad ②nas/ /chung dang 'bring dang chen po'ang rung / /de la mtshungs par ①snun pa ltar/ /mi yi seng ge rnam 'dren pa/ /rdzogs sangs de bzhin 'jig rten ni/ /byis pa'am 'bring ngam 0chen po la/ /mnyam por ⑤chos ni ston par mdzad/ /gi tam khyod kyis 'di ru ni/ /nad pa bdag ni ༷the tshom sol / /zug rngu ⑦'byin pa rnams dang ni/ /mig mkhan rnams kyi mchog khyod lags / /khyod kyi the tshom bsal ⑧bar byas/ /bram ze khyod ni 'dun par gyis / /grags ldan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mthong ba rnyed par dka' ⑨ba ste/ /gang zhig 'di na rnyed dka' ba/ /brgya lam na ni lan 'ga' ⑩'byung / /bram ze rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nga / /chos kyi rgyal po bla med yin/ /de bzhin gshegs la ris gsol ba/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes bka' stsal te/ /ma 'dres 'khor lo skor ⑩mdzad na/ /gi tam ji skad gsung ba 8bzhin/ /khyod kyis 'khor lo bskor ba gang / /rjes su mkhas par tsobaskor bgyid pa/ /stong 8pa nyid 'khrungs nyan thos ni/ /sde dpon dag tu su 'gyur lags/ /bram ze nga la nyan thos ni/ /shes rab mtshungs pa'i sras yod pa/ /nye rgyal zhes ni grags pa po'/ /mang du thos pa shā ri'i bu/ /mdud pa kun las rnam ⑫grol ba/ /nyer zhi zag pa med yod de/ /ngas ni 'khor lo gang bskor yib/ /mkhas pa rjes su skor bar 8byed/ / e ma'o sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /⑩e ma'o nyan thos phun sum tshogs/ /e ma'o rin chen dam pa gsum0 / /'jig 3—104

rten byung ①ba ngo mtshar che/ /bzang po khyod kyi nyan thos su/ /bdag gis g.yar gyis blang ②bgyis la/ /kye ma'o chos kyi bcud 'tshal nas/ /shin tu mya ngan 'das par bgyi/ /sems rtog ③rab tu dga' gyur nas/ /de nas bram ze skyo gyur te/ /dben pa 'dod pa'i sems kyis ni/ /'khor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /nags na seng ge sgra 'byin ltar/ /bsam gtan chen po'i rjozug rngu ⑤'byin/ /spyan dang ldan pas ci gsungs pa/ /'di ni shes ldan dag nyon cig /gang dag 'dod pa rjes su song / /gang dag mi 'dod de dag deng rjo/ /shes rab ⑦mchog gi bstan pa la/ /de ring kho na durab 'byung ngo / /tshangs spyod 'di la legs spyad cing / /lam nyid shin tu goms byas na⑨/ /bag yod pa la gnas pa yi/ /rab 0byung 'bras bu bcas par 'gyuraskye/ /gal te khyed cag rab 'byung zhing / /bsnyen par rdzogs par 'dod na ni/ /bram ze ral pa 'di 'bregs te/ /bdag cag rab tu 'byung bar bya/ /sems rtog tsorab tu mgu gyur pas8/ /sor mo bcu yi 8thal sbyar te/ /bla gos phrag pa gcig gzar nas/ /bram ze ri bo des tsogasol pa/ /bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya po//'di dag thal sbyar 'khod pa ni/ /thub chen rab tu 'byung ba dang / /bsnyen par rdzogs pa 0thob par 'tshal/ /de nas ston pa thugs rje can/ /drang srong chen po thugs brtse tsobs/ /dge slong tshur shog bka' stsal pas/ /de dag bsnyen par rdzogs par gyur/ /shes 4)rab chen po shā ri'i 0bu/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa mod dugal dang / /dga' yod gnas brtan ka pi na()/ /spobs pa rtogs par khong du chud/ /chu bo bzang po'i 'gram du ni/ /yid du 'ong ba'i tshal khrod du/ /spobs pa byang ba'i gnas brtan gyis/ /de dag la ni gdams du3—105

ngag phog /der ni de las ①chos kyi gtamal/ /rjes su mthun pa ②de shes nas//ring po rjom thogs rnam grol te/ /dam pa'i don la rab tu bkod/ /de dag mthong thob bde gyur pas/ /mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan 'das/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'dren pa la/ /rab tu mgu bas phyag byas so/ /dam pa'i chos dang tshogs gtso dang / /rgyal bas bsngags pa'i bslab pa dang / /ting nge 'dzin dang bged 0pa dang / /bag yod pa la phyag byas so/ /de bas bdag la phan 'dod pa'am/ /bdag nyid chen po mngon 'dod ༷pas/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /bkur ste byos rgyal skyabs su deng ⑧/ /'di ni ⑨de nyid gzigs pa yis/ /'jig rten na ni skyabs su bsngags/ /gnod pa rnams kyis skrag pa la/ /bde ba kun ni rab sbyin mdzad/ /chos kyi rgyal po nyi ma'i ⑩gnyen/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa chos kyi ni/ /bdag nyid chen por ⑩mchog gyur la/ /thar pa 'dod pas rtag tu bstenati/ /ke na'i bu'i tshigs su bcad 8pa rdzogs so8// //de nas bcom ldan 'das yul ka shi nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs te/ ka shi'i tshong rdal du byon to/ri /ka shi'i tshong rdal de na sngon 'dreg 8mkhan byed byed pa rab tu byung ba pha spad tsoganyis shig ⑩yod pa las/ bus smras pa/ pha bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu yul ka shi'i 0ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs nas yigatsug lag khang du byon pa bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gi dge 'dun sku mnyel gyisabya/ ma la bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi ⑥dge 'dun dang bcas pa nas thug la spyan drang dun/ de la ci 0khyod thug 3—106

pa sta gon byed dam/ 'on te dge slong gi dge 'dun spyan 'dren/ des smras pa/ khyod song la dge slong gi dge 'dun spyan drongs shig /nga ni thug pa sta ①gon byed do/ /des dge slong gi dge 'dun spyan drangs so/ /de yang me long zhig thogs nas tshong dus su song ba las/ des de na tshong dpon zhig skra dang kha spu ring ba mthong nas/ des de la me long bstan pa dang / des smras pa/ 'phags pa 'di lta bu'i mkhyen pa yang mnga' 'am/ des smras pa yod do/ /gal te mnga' na bregs ②shig /des breg par brtsams pa dang khyim bdag gnyid log nas bregs zin pa dang sad do/ /des smras pa/ 'phags pa bregs lags lasam/ khyim bdag bregs zin to/ /de mgu nas smras pa/'phags pa bdag lhag par glo ba dga' bas 0khyod mchog ci bzhed 0pa don rjoto//des smras pa/ kho bos sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi ⑦dge 'dun nas thug la spyan drangs kyis ⑧nas thug byin cig /des smras pa/ 'phags pa nas thug lta khyod ①ci rung bza' ba dang bca' ba bsod pa dag 'bul gyis 0bzhud la spyan drongs shig /nad med par gyur cig ces smras nas de song ngo / /de nas khyim bdag des gtsang zhing 0bsod pa zhes bya ba nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan 0bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bza' ba dang bca' ba bsod pa dag brims 4)pa na/dge slong rnams kyis bsams pa/ bdag cag ngan pa la mgron tsodu bos na kha zas bsod pa 'di bdag cag gis ji ltar blang 8zhes de rnams kyis ma 0blangs pa'i skabs de/ dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te ngan pa la mgron ⑩du bos la ⑫3—107

kha zas bsod pa rnyed na longs spyad par bya ste/ de la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ nyes pa gang ①byung ba de ni dge slong dag rigs dang mthun pa'i snod thogs pa las gyur gyisal/ de lta bas na dge slong gis charang gi bzo bstan 0par mi bya/ rigs dang mthun pa'i snod kyang bsrel bar mi bya'o/ /srel dun 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /sngon sman pa yin na gtsa' khab kyi snod srel ba rjodang / sngon yi ge pa yin na ram phyis srel ⑦ba dang / bzo ⑧mkhan rab tu byung na 0khab ral srol ⑩ba ni ma gtogs 0so//bcom ldan 'das gyad yul nas ljongs rgyu zhing chagashegs te sdig can du byon nas sdig can na srin bu pad pa'i tshal 0stug po na bzhugs so/ /sdig can na 8tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo'i zhang 8po gyad sna chen po la gtogs pa 'od ldan zhes bya ba zhig gnas pa de shin tu ma ⑩dad pa zhig ste/ bcom ldan 'das sdig can gyi gyad yul nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs te/ sdig can du byon ⑩nas sdig can na ⑫srin bu pad pa'i yitshal stug po na bzhugs ⑥so/ /zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang gros bya bar brtsams pa/ shes ldan dag bcom ldan 'das gyad yul nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na sdig can du byon nas/ sdig can na srin bu pad pa'i 0tshal stug po na bzhugs so/ /zhes thos kyisaphyo/ gal te bdag cag re res sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs tshod gsol na gzhan gyis skabs mi rnyed par 'gyur bas ye ()khrims zhig bca' bar bya ste/bdag cag sus kyang gcig pus sangs rgyas la sogs 0pa dge slong gi byadage 'dun gdugs tshod gsol bar mi bya zhing bdag cag 'dus pa kho nas gdugs tshod gsol bar bya'o/ /bdag cag las gang zhig gcig pu kho nas gdugs 3—108

tshod gsol na/ de la tshogs kyis kār ṣā pa ༅ṇa drug bcu'i chad pa gcad ②do//de nas sdig can gyi gyad thams cad 'dus nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste lhags pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis sdig can gyi gyad rnams la zhes bya ba nasal/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas sdig can gyi rgyad rnams stan rjolas langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ⑤ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nasadu/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu ⑦sang bdag cag gi sdum par gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sdig can gyi gyad rnams la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas sdig can gyi gyad rnams kyisaX/ bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga' ste/ rjes su yi rangs ⑨nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi (sprezhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te stan las langs te song ngo / /0gyad sna chen po la gtogs pa 'od ldan ni de nyid na tso'adug pa dang / de la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos smras pa/ 'od ldan ci (sprekhyod dad par gyur tamathoste/des smras pa/ bdag dad par ni tsom gyur mod kyi tso'on kyang tshogs kyi khrims su bcas pa zhes bya ba nas/ kār ṣā pa ṇa drug bcu'i chad pas gcad ⑩do zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /khyod chad pas 'jigs nas bcom ldan 3—109

'das la blta ba'i phyir 'ongs pa lta zhig /btsun pa de lta lags so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos gyad sna chen po la gtogs pa 'od ldan khrid de bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song nas phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa/ gyad sna chen po la gtogs pa 'od ldan 'di ni sangs rgyas la mngon par ma dad/ chos la ma lags/ dge 'dun la ma lags na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar 'di sangs rgyas la mngon par dad cing chos dang dge 'dun la mngon par dad par 'gyur ba de ltar chos legs par bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ①tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gyad sna chen po la gtogs ②pa 'od ldan ③gang thos pas gyad sna chen po la gtogs pa 'od ldan sangs rgyas la mngon par dad/ chos dang dge 'dun la mngon par dad par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bshad pa mdzad do/ /de nas gyad sna chen po la gtogs pa 'od ldan stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de 0logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de ⑤bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu sang bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ 'od ldan nga sngar sdig can gyi gyad rnams kyis spyan drangs zin to/ /bcom ldan 'das gnang bar mdzod cig dang /ji ltar sdig can gyi gyad rnams btub pa de ltar bdag bgyid do/ /'od ldan gal te sdig can gyi gyad rnams btub na de bzhin du ngas khyod la gnang ngo / /de nas gyad sna chen po la gtogs pa 'od ldan gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi duzhabs 3—110

gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas ①nas stan las langs te chas nas sdig can gyi gyad rnams gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / sdig can gyi gyad rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /shes ldan dag re zhig sdod cig bdag gis ②thog mar bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs tshod ③gsol nas/ de'i 'og tu khyed cag gis kyang bcom ldan 'das dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs tshod gsol na dka' bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ kho bo cag gis sngar sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun spyan drangs zin pas kho bo cag mi nyan to/ /des smras pa/ ji ste mi btub ④na bca' ba dang btung ba re re zhing brim mo/ /de na ma dad pa gang yin pa de dag gis smras pa/mi gnang ngo / /dad pa can gang yin pa de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'di dad pa med pa zhig las/ 'dis dge 'dun mnga' ba'i yon dag ⑤'bul bar 'gyur bas gnang ngo zhes de rnams kyis de la gnang ngo / /de nas des g.yos mkhan dag bkug ⑥ste bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag kho bos yo byad thams cad sbyar gyis ⑦bca' ba gcig pu gang kho nas 'grangs ⑧par 'gyur ba de lta bur stista gon gyis shig /des dri zhim po sna tshogs kyi 0rdzas la sogs pa dang ldan pa'i yo byad rnams phog pa dang / de rnams kyis dri zhim po sna tshogs kyis yongs su rgyas pa re res re re 'grangs ⑩par 'gyur ba'i bca' ba gang yin pa dag byas so/ /de nas sdig can gyi gyad rnams kyis de nyid kyi 8nub mo nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i zhes bya ba nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas gyad sna chen po la gtogs pa 'od ldan gyis bca' ba dang btung ba brim ⑫3—111

par brtsams pa dang / dge slong rnams 'gyod pas longs ma spyad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ yon bdag la blta bar bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis sdig can gyi ②gyad rnams la bltas pa dang de rnams kyis smras pa/'phags pa dag gyad sna chen po la gtogs pa 'od ldan gyis bdag cag bslus lags kyis ②bzhes shig /de nas rgyad sna chen po la ③gtogs pa 'od ldan gyis bca' ba brims pa dang de kho nas dge slong rnams 'grangs ༷te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis yon bsngo ba mdzad de gshegs pas sdig can gyi 0gyad rnams kyi zas de dag longs ma spyad par gyur duto/ /nyi ma gzhan zhig la dge slong rnams bsod snyoms la zhugs pa dang bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis smras pa/sangs rgyas tshur spyon/ chos tshur spyon/ dge 'dun tshur spyon 'di dag snoms shig /dge slong rnams 'gyod pas ma blangs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ci kho bo la sbyin nam/ 'on te bcom ldan 'das rkang gnyis rnams kyi ⑦mchog gang yin pa de la dbul zhes dri bar ⑧bya'o/ /gal te bcom ldan 'das rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog gang yin pa de la'o zhes smra na bdag gir yo)mi bya'o/ /'on te bdag cag gi sangs rgyas ni khyod nyid lags so zhes smra na blang bar 4)bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /de bzhin du chos 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog gang yin pa de la'am zhes brjod par bya zhing / dge 'dun tshogs rnams kyi 0mchog gang yin pa de la'am zhes rgyas par sbyar bar bya'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /khyim bdag cig gis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bsro khang la spyan drangs so/ /de'i tshe tshe dang 3—112

ldan pa sa ri zhes bya ba gzhon nu thor bu lang tsho ①la bab pa ②rab tu byung nas ring po ma lon pa/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas ring po ③ma lon pa/ chos 'dul ba 'dir 'ongs nas ring po ma lon pa/ des bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gang gis nyung ngu byin dupa dang gang gis mang du byin pa dang / gang gis bzang po byin pa dang / gang gis yid dga' bas las byas pa dang /gang gis rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis rjes su yi rang ba de dag thams cad ni bsod nams kyi skal ba can du 'gyur ro zhes gsungs kyis0/ ma la bdag gis kyang las shig bya'o snyam nas des shing gshag 0par brtsams pa las ji tsam na shing rul pa zhig gi ser ka nas sbrul gdug 0pa zhig byung nas rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthe bo la zin pa dang / de dug gi shugs kyis brgyal nas sa la 'gyel te dbu ⑧bar skyug cing bzhin yang gyur/ mig kyang gyur te/ de de ltar sdug bsngal ba bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'di 0khyim bdag su zhig gi bu yin/ gzhan dag gis smras pa/ che ge mo zhig gi'o/ /de dag gis smras pa/ dge sbyong shākya'i sras mgon med pa rnams kyi nang du rab tu byung gi gal te rab tu ma byung bar gyur na nye du rnams kyis 'di la khyadapyad byas ⑩pa zhig ces bya ba'i 8skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman pa la ⑫dris la dpyad 0byos shig /dge slong dag gis sman pa la dris pa dang / des smras pa/ 'phags pa sbyar ba'i zas gsol cig pa'i skabs de 8dge slong dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/sman pas bstan na sbyin par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis 0zas sbyar ba ⑩ji lta bu 3—113

yin pa ma shes nas/ de rnams kyis sman pa la dris pa dang / des smras pa/'phags pa dag khyed ①nyid kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das ni thams cad mkhyen pa thams cad gzigs pa kho na nyid ②yin te/ de nyid mkhyen to zhes pa dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das ③kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag zas sbyar ba ni rtsi ba dang / gcin dang /thal ba dang sa'o/ /de la lci ba ni byung nas ring po ma lon pa'i be'u rnams kyi'o//gcin yang de dag dukho na'o/ /thal ba ni shing lnga po kun tsa na'i ⑤dang / ka pi dha ༷ka'i dang / a shwattha'i ⑦dang / u dum bā ⑧ra'i dang / n+ya gro ṇidha'i'o//sa ni sa las sor bzhi'i 'og nas phyung ba'o/ /'di ni sbyar ba'i zas yin no/ /de nas dge slong rnams kyis 0tshe dang ldan pa sa ri la zas sbyar ba byin na/'on kyang sos par ma (7gyur pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis nga las rma bya chen mo'i rig sngags bzung nas kun chub par byas te/ dge slong sa ri la bsrung 8ba dang / yongs su bskyab tho)pa dang /yongs su gzung (steb dang / dug gzhil ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang /dug gsad 8pa dang / mtshams gcad 0pa dang / sa bcing bar nus sam/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal du gsol mnyan 0te bgyi'o// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po drug bcu pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe rma bya tsochen mo'i rig ⑩sngags 'di rdzibaka' stsal to/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di lta ste/ a ma le/ bi ma le/ nir ma le/ maṅga phye0/ hi ra rtse/ hi 3—114

ra rtse/ gasgo/ bha dre/ su bha dre/ sa manta/ bha dre/ shrī ②bha dre/ sarba sarba sā dha ni/ pa ②ra mār tha sā nidha ni/ sarba a nar tha pra sha ma ni④/ sarba mang ga la sna 0dha ni/ mā dun si༅/ mā na sil/ ma 0hā mā na si0/ a tsu 0te/ad bhu 8te/ ad byan bhu 0te/ mug ④te/ mo tsa ni/ mokṣa ni8/ a ra dze/ bi ra dze/ a ma re/ a mṛ te⑩/ a ma ra ṇi0/ bra smre/ bra rmā snyog re/ sru ra ṇi/ sru ra ṇa yim no ra the/ mug te/ dzī ban te0/sa ri'i (spreganod pa dang / 'jigs pa dang / nad thams cad las srungs shig ṭwā hā/ btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas rma bya chen mo'i rig sngags blangs nas/ dge slong sa ri la bde legs su 'gyur ba ⑥byas pas dug med nas sngon gyi ji lta ba bzhin du gyur to/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji tsam du bcom ldan 'das kyis rma bya chen mo'i rig sngags sman pa dang / gces spras bgyid pa ngo mtshar che lags so/ /dge slong dag da ltar 'ba' zhig tu dum yin tedu/ ji ltar 'das pa'i dus na yang nga log par lhung ba'i lus mi khom par gyur pa na rig sngags kyi rgyal mo tsorma bya chen mos 0phan pa dang gces spras byas pa de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba ⑥ri'i rgyal po gangs ri'i lho phyogs kyi ngos la rma bya'i rgyal po gser du snang ba zhes bya ba zhig gnas te/ de nang par rma bya chen mo'i rig sngags 'dis bde legs su 'gyur ba byas te nyin 9mo bde legs su gnas/ nub kur bde legs su 'gyur ba ⑥byas te mtshan mo bde legs su gnas so/ /de dus gzhan zhig na 'dod pa'i 'dod chags la 3—115

lhag par chags/ 'dod pa rnams la zhen/ 'chums①/ brgyal myos/ rab tu rmongs/ rab tu brgyal te/ bag med pas nags kyi rma bya chen ②mo rab tu mang po rnams dang lhan cig tu kun dga'i ra ba nas kun dga'i ra ba dang /skyed mos tshal ②nas skyed mos tshal dang / ri'i ngos nas 0ri'i ngos su rgyu ba las ji tsam na ri'i ser ga zhig tu zhugs pa dang / de der yun ring du phyir rgol ba/ dgrar gyur pa/ 'tshe bar gyur pa/ glags lta ba rnams kyis rma bya'i rnyis rjobazung ste/ de dumi mdza' ba'i nang du son pa dang / rab tu rmongs pa las ⑦dran pa rnyed nas rma bya chen mo'i rig sngags ⑧'di kho na yid la byas so/ / 'di lta ste/⑨ ma ma le/ bi ma le/ nir ma le/ mang ga gye/ nyi ra rtse0/nyi ra rtse/ garbha/ bha dre/ su bha dre/ sa manta bha dre/ shrī ⑩bha dre/ sarba arba sā tsodha ni / pa ra mār tha sā tsodha ni/ sarba a nar tha bra sha ma ṇiñtsa/ sarba mang ga la sā ⑫dha ni/ mā na si mā na si(9/ ma 0hā mā tunyen siyi/ a tsu ⑥ te/ ad bhu 0te/ad byan 6)byu te/ mug ( )te mo tsa ni/ mokṣa ṇiñtsa/ a ra dze/ bi ra dze/a ma re/ a mṛ 0te/ a ma tsor ṇi0/ bra smre0/ bra dmā ⑥su re/ sru ra ṇi/sru ra ṇa ⑥ma no ra the/ mug 0te/ ṭī ban tidu/ bdag gnod pa thams cad las srungs shig dug hā/ des durma bya'i rnyi 9chad nas bros so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi rma bya'i rgyal po gser du 0snang ba zhes bya ba gang yin pa de ni nga yin te/ de na yang nga la rma bya chen mo'i rig sngags kyis phan pa dang gces 0spras byas so/ /da ltar tson yang nga'i 0rma bya bya chen mo'i rig sngags kyis phan pa dang gces spras byas so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi shyirig sngags kyis dge slong sa ri la ji 9tsam pa rgyabade legs su byas par gyur pa 93—116

la gzigs/ dge slong dag da ltar 'ba' zhig ma yin gyi ji ltar 'das pa'i de yang nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bā rā ṇa sri'i grong khyer na sbrul sngags mkhan zhig yod do/ /rgyal rigs kyi khye'u zhig sbrul gyis zin nas de shi ba dang /sbrul sngags mkhan gyis rig sngags kyis de sos par byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi sbrul sngags mkhan gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus kyi khye'u gang yin pa de ni dge slong sa ri yin no/ /sman gyi gzhi rdzogs so༅// //gos kyi gzhi'i bsdus pa'i sdom ni/ 'tsho byed dang ni gso ras dang / /de bzhin kha tshar ring po dang / /dbyar ral bar ni rig bya dang / /shi ①ba'i dus dang nye dga' dang / /tha ma dag ni nad pa yin/ /bsdus ③pa'i sdom ni/'tsho byed dang ni gsum 'dral dang / /dbyar gyi ras chen gding ①ba dang / /g.yan ༷pa bde gshegs mon dar dang / /bal dang sha na 0zar ma'i ras/ /sdom la/ dum bu sa skyong seng ge dang / /de bzhin yangs par song ba dang / /sems 'phrog drang srong sa 'tsho dang / /a mra skyong dang 'jigs med dang / /tshong dpon chung ma rigs skyes dang / /sman pa yi ni lung dang ni/ /rdo 'jog dang ni bzang byed dang / /u dum bā dur gzhal ba dang / /bskyed dang rgyal rigs ⑦skyed mos tshal/ /bcom brlag gyad dang bud med sbrul/ /ya mu na dang dur khrod dang / /yangs pa mig dang srin gyi med/ /rgyal po'i khab bdun bzhi ⑧lnga dang / /'tsho byed sde tshan ⑨bsdus pa yin/ /lus 'phags na rgyal po ⑩'phags skyes po zhes bya ba 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde 3—117

ba dang / lo legs pa/ skye bo ①dang mi mang pos gang ba na rgyal srid byed du 'jug go/ /de'i blon po dum bu la sogs pa lnga brgya yod pa las blon po'i mchog dum bus chos dang mthun par ②rgyal srid ②byed du 'jug ste/ tha snyad du bya ba yang rigs pas lta bar byed do/ /des na skye bo'i 0tshogs thams cad de'i ngor bltas shing ⑤'dug go/ /des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs te/de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed de de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las khye'u zhig btsas te/ de'i btsas ston nyi ma bdun gsum nyi shu ⑥gcig tu zhes bya ba nas sa skyong zhes bya bar btags ⑦so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o / /de yang rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las khye'u zhig btsas te gong ma bzhin du rgyas par sbyar te/ de ni ⑧song ge zhes bya bar btags so/ /sa skyong dang seng ge rim 0gyis gzhon nur gyur ⑩na yang blon po'i mchog tu yidum bu ni thog ma nyid nas dpa' zhing pha rol gnon pa gnas lnga la byang ba yin te/ des na blon po rnams kyi mchog tu gyur to/ /gang gi tshe bu'i mthu skyes pa de'i tshe/ lhag par yang blon po thams cad zil gyis mnan te 'dug go/ /de nas blon po de rnams ⑫ zil gyis 0non pas mi bzod pa skyes nas phan tshun du gros byas te rgyal po'i drung du dong ngo / /de nas skabs la bab par rig nas rgyal po la smras pa/ lha rgyal po su lags/ des smras pa/shes ldan dag gis brtag tu ci yod rgyal po lha nga tsoyin mod/ gzhan su zhig yin/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha rgyal po ni dum bu lags kyis 0lha ma lags so/ /gal te de 'tshal 0bar gyur na lha rgyal srid las phyung nas rang nyid 3—118

cod ①pan bcings te/ rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang bgyid par 'gyur ro//rgyal pos bsams pa/ des 'di dag thams cad zil gyis mnan pas des na dbyin ②byed do snyam mo/ /re zhig dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po blon po'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor te 'dug pa dang / blon po'i mchog dum bu rgol ba dang phyir rgol ba brgyad ②stong gis yongs su bskor nas rgyal po'i 0pho brang du zhugs te/rgyal po'i pho brang de gang bar byas nas 'dug go⑤/ /gang gi tshe rgyal srid kyi bya ba byas nas phyir dubyung ba de'i tshe yang rgyal po'i pho brang de stong par 'dug go/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag skye bo'i tshogs thams cad phyir byung bar gyur tam / blon po rnams kyis glags rnyed nas ⑦de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha ⑧gang gi slad du snyan du gsol pa 0spyan sngar bab lags mod/ gal te dum 0bu 'tshal bar gyur na lha rgyal srid las phyung nas rang nyid 0cod pan bcings te rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po rnams ⑩khu ltar khum 'phrig 8za ba yin pas des bsams pa/ 'di rnams kyis ji skad smras pa de bzhin du gdon mi za'o snyam nas de de la klan 8ka tshol bar gyur to/ /'jig rten na byamadza' ba dang / mi mdza' ba dang / bar ma yod pas ji tsam na gzhan dag gis dum bu la smras pa/ khyod la rgyal po klan ka tshol zhing 'dug gis tsothabs legs par soms shig /de rtog 0pa skyes shing de dpyod pa la zhugs pa gang du 'gro/ gal te mnyan yod du song na ni mnyan yod de yang rgyal po'i mnga' ris yin pas nyen 8'di nyid yod do/ /de bzhin du bā rā ṇa sī dang / rgyal po'i khab dang / tsam pa yang gcig gi dbang du gyur pas nyen 'di nyid yiyod do/ /yangs pa can ni tshogs kyi dbang yin te/ bcu dga' 3—119

ba gang yin pa de la ni nyi shu mi dga' bar 'gyur ba yin pas ye ①yangs pa can du 'gro'o snyam nas des ②yangs pa can gyi litstsha bī ①rnams la bdag ni khyed cag gi dpung gi phag na 'dug par 'dod do zhes pho nya btang ngo / /de rnams kyis gus pa'i tshul gyis lan spring ba/ yangs pa can 'dir byon pa legs kyis ⑦spyon cig /de nas blon po'i mchog dum bus nye du rnams bos te smras pa/shes ldan dag rjobadag ni yangs pa can du chas kyis byakhyed cag las gang dag 'dir dga' ba de dag ni 'dug shig /gang dag mi 'dod pa de ⑦dag ni sta gon gyis shig dang 'dong ngo / /ba lang rdzi dang phyugs nirdzi rnams la bsgo ba/khyed cag gis ba lang dang ma he yangs pa can gang na ba ⑨der skyongs shig /zho shas 'tsho ba rnams la bsgo ba yangs pa can du 'dong gis ⑩go gyon cig /de nas skye bo'i tshogs de ltar yis gon byed du bcug nas/ rgyal po'i drung du song ste rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te smras pa/ lha bgyi ba cung zhig mchis te/ skyed mos tshal du mchi na gzigs su gsol/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ de bzhin byas song 4)shig /des skyed mos tshal byi dor byas nas nor gces pas shing rta bkang ste/ steng bza' ba dang bca' bas 0g.yogs nas song ngo / /blon po rnams kyis dum bu bros so zhes tsothos nas/ de rnams rings pa rings par rgyal po'i drung du song tsonas smras pa/ lha dum bu ni bros so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/deng tunyel slar khug shig /de rnams kyis dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa go bskon nas bsnyags 0te smras pa/ dum bu lhas bka' stsal gyis 8slar log shig/des smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed cag gis yun ring mo zhig nas kye ma'o dum bu shi'am bros par gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam du bsams pa de tshegs chung ngus 3—120

grub kyis deng ①shig /kho bo ni bros pa yin no/ /de rnams kyis ②rgyal po'i sems bsrung ③ba'i phyir mda' dang mda' dag 'dres par byas nas log ste rgyal ci po la smras pa/ lha blon po'i mchog dum bu ni bros so/ /rgyal pos dum legs so snyam du bsams nas cang mi smra ⑤bar 'dug go/ /dum bu yang rim gyis rjoyangs pa can du phyin to/ /de'i tshe yangs pa can na ris phyogasum du gnas te/ris ⑧dang po na ni khang pa rtseg ⑨ma bdun stong ba gam gser las byas pa'o⑩/ /ris bar ma na ni khang pa rtseg byam khri bzhi stong ba gam dngul las byas pa'oti/ /ris tha ma na 0ni khang pa rtseg ④ma nyi khri chig 8stong ba gam zangs las ⑩byas pa ste/de rnams na ⑩mi dam pa dang / bar ma dang / phal pa rnams ci rigs par gnas so/ /yangs pa can gyi tshogs kyis 8khrims su bcas te bzhag pa ni ris dang por bu mo btsas pa gang yin pa de ni ris dang po nyid du gtong bar byed kyi bar mar ma yin/ tha mar ma yin no/ /bar ma'i yigang yin pa de ni ris dang po dang bar ma la gtong bar byed do/ /tha ma'i gang yin pa de ni ris gsum char du gtong bar byed do( ) / /bud med rnams ni yangs pa can ma gtogs ⑥par gzhan du mi gtong zhing mi 'byin to/ /bud med rin po che ni su la yang mi gtong bar tshogs spyi'i yongs su longs spyad pa kho nar byed do/ /dum bu ni skyes bu dam pa yin no zhes te ris dang por khang pa byin nas/ de na gnas par brtsams pa las gang gi tshe tshogs ( nye'adus pa de'i tshe de bos kyang 'dur ma btub nas/ de la yangs pa can gyi litstsha bī rnams kyis smras pa/dum bu khyod ci'i phyir mi 'du/ des ⑤smras pa/ 'du ba kho na las bdag la nyes dmigs byung bas bdag mi 'du'o/ /yangs pa can pa tsornams kyis smras 3—121

pa/ dum bu 'dus shig /'dir ①nyes dmigs ci zhig 'byung des 'du bar ②brtsams nas blo gros ma byin no/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ dum bu blo gros byin cig /des smras pa/ gang gi phyir blo gros kho nas bdag la nyes dmigs byung bas na blo gros ni mi sbyin no/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ blo gros byin cig 'dir nyes dmigs ci zhig 'byung / de tshogs dang ③lhan cig 'dus nas blo gros kyang byin nodu/ /sngon yangs pa can gyi litstsha bī rnams ⑤gang su la yang rung yi ge spring bar byed na rtsub 0po dang bcas par yi ge rgyaspring bar byed do//gang gi tshe dum bus blo gros byin pa de'i tshe 'jam po dang bcas par yi ge spring bar byed do/ /gang dag la 'jam po dang bcas par ⑧yi ge 'ongs par gyur pa de rnams phan tshun du gros byas pa/ shes ldan dag gang gis na yangs pa can gyi tshogs sngon rtsub pa dang bcas par spring bar byed pa las/ de 'jam po dang bcas par ⑨gyur pa la rgyu ci zhig yod/ gzhan dag gis smras pa/ khyad par yod de lus 'phags kyi rgyal po'i blon po'i ⑩mchog dum bu der 'ongs nas/ de dag de'i blo gros bzhin byed de/ des na da ltar 'jam po dang bcas par spring bar byed do/ /dum bus sa skyong dang seng ge khyim phub nas seng ge rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las bu mo zhig btsas te/ de'i btsas ston rgya cher byas nas gos can zhes bya bar btags so//de ⑩ltas mkhan rnams kyis mthong nas khye'u zhig btsa' bar ⑩'gyur te/ des pha srog dang phral nas rang nyid cod pan bcings te rgyal srid byed par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /de yang rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las bu mo zhig btsas te/ de'i btsas ston yang 0rgya 3—122

cher byas nas nye gos can zhes bya bar btags so/ /de yang ltas mkhan rnams kyis mthong nas bu mtshan rdzogs pa zhig btsa' bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /sa skyong gdug pa rtsal che ba zhig pas ①yangs pa can gyi litstsha bī rnams kyi skyed mos tshal rnams ma rung bar byas pa dang / skyed mos tshal sung ba rnams kyis smras pa/ yangs pa can gyi litstsha bī rnams ni gdug pa rtsal po che yin gyis ②de dag gi skyed mos tshal rnams ma rung bar ma bya shig ②ces des slar bzlog kyang ma btub nas skyed mos tshal srung ba rnams kyis dum bu la smras pa/ khyod kyi bus yangs pa can gyi dulitstsha bī rnams kyi skyed mos tshal rnams ma rung bar byas te/ litstsha bī 'di dag rnams ⑤gdug pa rtsal po che yin pas 'di la gnod pa dubyas su 'ong gis ⑦'di slar zlog nicig /des de bkug nas smras pa/ bu yangs pa can gyi litstsha bī rnams ni gdug pa rtsal po che yin gyis ⑨'di dag gi skyed mos tshal ma rung bar ma bya zhig /de dag gis gnod par byas sa re/ des smras pa/ yab 'di dag la ni skyed mos tshal mchis na bdag cag la ni (me ma mchis so/ /des smras pa/ bu skyed mos tshal gyi don du tshogs la gsol ba gdab bo/ /des tshogs la gsol ba btab yipa/ shes ldan dag bdag gi bu gnyis la skyed mos tshal ma mchis kyis 4)bdag la skyed mos tshal zhig thugs dpag mdzad pa'i rigs so/ /de rnams kyis de dag la skyed mos tshal rnying 8pa zhig byin pa las/ de na shing sā la chen po zhig yod de/ de la gcig gis bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i gzugs brnyan 8byed du bcug go/ /cig shos kyis ni zhal sros byas so/ /de bzhin du gnas brtan ⑩rnams kyis kyang mdo sde'i nang du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yangs pa can na sa skyong dang seng ge'i shing 3—123

sā la'i tshal na bzhugs so zhes brjod do/ /sa skyong gis bya ba ma yin pa stong phrag dag byas pas litstsha bī rnams smod par byed/ gzhogs ①'phyas byed/kha zer bar byed do②/ /de nas dum bus ③bkug ste bsgo ba/ bu khyod tshogs 'khrug par ma byed par ri 'or ③che ge mo zhig tu song la der rang gi zhing las kyi ⑤mtha' rnams la zhal ta byed cing 'dug ①shig /de der song nas rang gi zhing las ⑦kyi mtha' rnams la zhal ta byed par ⑧brtsams so ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na yangs pa can gyi sde dpon shi nas de rnams kyis ①blon po'i mchog 0dum bu 0sde dpon du bcug pa las des kyang dus thung ngu zhig tu chos dang mthun pas sde dpon byas nas shi'o/ /yangs pa can gyi tshogs 'dus nas su zhig sde dpon du gzhug ces byas pa dang / de nas 4)kha cig gis smras pa/blon po'i mchog dum bus tshogs yongs su bskyangs 0pas na de nyid kyi bu gzhag go④/ /kha cig gis smras pa/ de'i bu sa skyong ni gdug 8pa rtsal tsopo che zhig ste / gal te de tho)sde dpon du bcug phyin gdon mi za bar tshogs phye 4)bar 'gyur ro( spre/ /de'i nu bo seng ge gang yin pa de ni des pa 'grogs na bde ba tshogs kyi sems mgu bar byed nus pa zhig 0pas/ gal te tshogs 'dod na de phyesde dpon du gzhug go⑤/ /thams cad dga' bas de rnams 'dus nas seng ge'i gan du song ste/ seng ge khyod la sde dpon sbyin no/ /des smras pa/ sa skyong ni bdag gi phu bo yin pas de sde dpon du chug shig /de rnams kyis smras pa / seng ge sde dpon khyod kyi rigs brgyud kyis ⑥rim pas 'ongs pa yin nam ci tshogs gang la 'drang ba des sde dpon bya bar zad mod/ gal te khyod mi 'dod na kho bo cag gis gzhan zhig sde dpon du gzhug tsogo/ /des bsams pa/3—124

gal te bdag gi khyim nas sde dpon gzhan du shor na de ni ma 'os pas ye bkur ①ro snyam nas des khas blangs pa dang / de rnams kyis bkur ste ②chen pos sde dpon du bcug go/ /yangs pa can pa ②rnams sngon gang la yi ge spring ba de la dum bu la sogs pa tshogs kyis bka' stsal pa zhes 'dri dubar ⑤ byed pa dulas/gang gi tshe seng ge sde dpon du gyur pa de'i tshe seng ge la sogs pa tshogs kyis bka' stsal pa zhes 'dri 0bar byed dodu/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na ri 'or ⑨na sa skyong rang gi zhing blas ⑩kyi mtha' rnams la zhal ta byed pa'i ri 'or ba yigang yin pa der spring ba 'ongs pa dang / sa skyong gis phye ste bklags tsonas des smras pa / shes ldan dag sngon ni yangs pa can gyi tunyetshogs dum bu la sogs pa'i tshogs kyis bka' stsal pa zhes 'dri tshun/ da ni seng ge la sogs pa tshogs kyis bka' stsal pa zhes 'dri (nyen/ ci kho bo'i pha shi'am/ de rnams kyis smras pa shi'o / /de mi bzod pa skyes nas yangs pa can du song ste smras pa/ phu bo nga 'dug bzhin du khyod kyis sde dpon bya ba ci tsog rigs sam/ seng ges 4)ji ltar gyur pa de la smraso pa dang / de yangs pa can gyi litstsha bī rnams la mi bzod pa skyes nas bsams pa/ bdag la yangs pa can pa 8rnams kyis bkur sti yim yin pa byas kyis () rgyal po'i khab tu 'gro'o snyam nas/ des rgyal po gzugs can snying po la bdag lha'i btsan nyephag na mchis par 'tshal lo zhes pho nya btang ngo / /des dude la spring ba 'ong ba 0legs kyis 9shog shig ces spring ngo bya/ /de rgyal po'i khab tu 'ongs pa dang / de nas rgyal po gzugs can snying pos blon po'i mchog tu bcug go/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i btsun mo dam pa shi nas de 'gram pa la lag pa gtad 0de sems khong du ⑥3—125

chud cing 'dug pa de sa skyong gis mthong nas smras pa/ lha ①ci'i slad du zhal la phyag gtad ②de thugs mi dgyes ①shing bzhugs/ des smras pa/ nga'i btsun mo dam pa shi na ci'i phyir sems khong du 0chud cing mi 'dug /lha ༷thugs ngan ma mdzad cig /bdag dugi nu bo la bu mo ⑦gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa lha kho na la 'os pa gnyis mchis na/ de la gcig la ni pha 'gums ⑧pa'i bu zhig btsa' bar 'gyur/ cig shos la ni mtshan phun sum tshogs pa zhig ⑨btsa' bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan () na lha'i ched 4)du de gang khrid de mchi/ bu mtshan phun sum tshogs pa btsa' bar 'gyur ba ⑩zhes lung bstan pa gang yin pa de'o/ /de nas sa skyong gis seng ge la spring ba rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i btsun mo dam pa shi nas khyod kyi nye gos can tshur bkri 0zhig dang btsun mo dam par 'gyur ro/ /des de ④la yi ge ⑩lan spring ba/ gar ⑩bskor kyang khyod kho na la bdag 'dri bar zad de0/ khyod kyis byas pa gang yin pa de ni tshad ma'i mchog yin pas khyod nyid shes so/ /ji ltar tshogs kyis khrims su bcas pa yangs pa can las gzhan du bu mo mi gtong 8ngo zhes bcas mod kyi/ 'on kyang khyod nyid thorngos te skyed mos tshal du sdod ⑩cig dang / kho bos de skyed mos tshal du phyung ba ⑥dang khyod kyis khrid de song ⑥shig /de nas sa skyong gis rgyal po la mchi phyag byas nas shing rtar duzhugs te yangs pa can du song ba las rim gyis phyin nas skyed mos tshal du bsdad dudo/ /de'i tshe yangs pa can gyi sgo srung byazhig shi nas mi ma yin pa rnams su skyes pa des yangs pa can pa rnams la bstan pa/bdag ni mi ma yin pa rnams su skyes kyis tsobadag gi gnod sbyin gyi gnas byos la mgul pa la 0dril dpyangs 0shig dang gal te yangs pa can rnams la phyir rgol 3—126

ba 'ga' zhig 'ongs na bdag gis ji tsam du zin pa'am/ 'bros par gyur pa de lasrid du dril gyi sgra bsgrags ②par bya'o/ /de rnams kyis gnod sbyin gyi gzugs brnyan byas nas mgul pa la dril ③btags te/ gar dang / glu dang /rol mo'i sgra dang / gtor ma dang / me tog phreng gi 0yo byad kyis sgo khang du bzhag go/ /sa skyong gis seng ge la spring ba/ kho bo skyed mos tshal na sdod kyis byung ⑤shegadu /des yangs pa can gyi tshogs la brtags ⑦nas khyim du song ste nye gos can la smras pa/ khyod rgyal po gzugs can snying po la byin gyis ①rgyan rnams thogs la skyed mos 0tshal du byung shig /des ⑩rgyan rnams thogs ⑩par brtsams pa dang / gos can gyis mthong nas des smras pa/ ci zhig gi phyir rgyan thogasaphye/ kho mo bag mar btang ngo / /su zhig la/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po la'o/ /des smras pa/ kho mo phu mo yin na khyod ci ste bag mar gtang ⑫/ gal te de lta ④na khyod rgyan thogs shig /de yang smra ba las dril gyi sgra byung ngo / /yangs pa can gyi tshogs rod rod por gyur tebya/ bdag cag gi mi mdza' skyab zhig yangs pa can du zhugs so/ /seng ge sngangs ⑩pas nye gos can yin no snyam nas gos can khrid de myur ba myur bar phyir byung ba dang / sa skyong yang sngangs 8pas gos can shing rtar bcug ste song ngo / /yangs pa can gyi tshogs kyis phyi bzhin bsnyags yinas/ de dang de rnams su lhan cig 'thab par brtsams ⑥pa dang / de gnas lnga rnams la byang ba yin pas des litstsha bī lnga brgya'i gnad du bsnun nas des smras pa/ shes ldan dag ngas khyed 0cag las lnga brgya gnad du bsnun zin gyis 0lhag ma rnams srog bskyab kyis 0slar deng tsoshig /de durnams kyis smras pa/ nged cag las sems can gcig kyang bsad 3—127

pa med do/ /go phud cig de rnams kyis go phud pa dang lnga brgya sa la 'gyel nas srog dang bral bar gyur to/ /de nas de rnams kyis mi 'di ni srin po yin no snyam nas skrag ste bros ①so/ /yangs pa can du lhags nas gros bya bar brtsams pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag gi dgra ②'di ③la gzugs can snying po'i bu rnams lan glon du gzhug gis 0glegs bu la yi ger bris te sgrom bur bcug nas rgya skyegs ⑤la rgyas btab dunas gzhag go zhes de rnams kyis de bzhin du byas nas bzhag go/ /sa skyong yang rim gyis rgyal po'i khab tu phyin nas smras pa/nye ༅gos can bobs shig /des smras pa/ khu gu bdag ni nye gos can ma lags te/ bdag ni gos can lags so/ /khyod kyis ci'i phyir bdag la ma smras / de cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /de nas de sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde bas rgyal po'i drung du song ba rgyal pos mthong nas smras pa/ sa skyong 'ongs sam 'ongs pa legs so/ /lha bdag mchis lags so/ /nye nigos can khrid de 'ongs sam/ lha khrid de mchis kyang mchis la khrid de ma mchis kyang ma mchis so//ci zhig zer/ nye ①gos can lags snyam nas gos can khrid de mchis so/ /bltas 0khrid de shog shig /de nang du khrid pa dang rgyal pos ⑩lhag par tsogazugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa mthong nas bud med kyi yul gyis srogs 0pas mthong ma thag kho nar rgyal po chags par gyur nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag bu pha gsod pa gang yin pa de ni rgyal srid kyi phyir yin pas gal te nga la bu yod par gyur na de btsas ma thag tu ngas cod pan gyis bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas de dpal gyi 'byor pa chen pos bag mar blangs te/ yul lus 'phags nas 'ongs pas tson lus 'phags ma zhes bya bar grags so/ /de de dang lhan cig rtse bar 3—128

byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /re zhig dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po gzugs can snying po ri dgas kyi phyir byung ba na bste gnas shig na drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa zhig gnas so/ /ji tsam na ri dgas mda'i long la ①btags pas skrag pa zhig drang srong de'i bste ②gnas su zhugs ②shing byung dub rgyal po'i mdas gnad du bsnun to/ /de nas drang srong de khros nas smras pa/ 'thab krol can gyi rgyal po bdag gi bste gnas gcan gzan dugadug pas kyang gzem par bya bar ri dgas skyabs su 'ongs pa khyod kyis gsod rjodam zhes drang srong de rgyal po la de skad du kha zer ba dang / dpung gi tshogs 'ongs nas smras pa/ lha 'di su la g.yar mchi ⑦rgyal pos smras pa/ nga la yin na/ shes ldan dag rgyal po la kha tshas zer ba gang yin pa de la chad pa ci yod/ lha de'i chad pa dgum pa lags so/ /gal te de lta ⑧na ngas drang srong 'di ⑨yongs su spangs so/ /de gsad par brtsams te de tho) gsod pa na smon lam log par btab pa/ rgyal po 'thab krol can 'dis bdag nyes pa med cing gnod pa mi byed pa gsad ⑩par bkris8/ gang du skyes pa der 'di srog dang bral bar byed par gyur cig /yang bsams pa/ rgyal po 'di dag ni shin tu sbas pa/ shin tu bsrungs tunyepa/ shin tu btsas pa 8yin pas gal te gzhan du skye ba blangs na lan 'ga' yang skabs rnyed par mi 'gyur gyis4)/rnam pa thams cad du ⑩bdag 'di'i btsun mo dam pa'i mngal du skye bar ⑩gyur cig ces byas so/ /de 7smon lam log par btab pas ⑩gos can gyi mngal du skyes so/ /gang gi tshe 0nyi ma kho na la nying mtshams sbyor ba blangs pa de 0nyid kyi nyi ma la khrag gi char bab bo/ /gos can 'dod pa skyes pa/ e ma'o bdag 3—129

gis lha'i rgyab kyi sha bcad cing bcad ①cing zos kyang ci ma rung snyam mo/ /de ltar gyur pa rgyal po la smras pa dang ②/ rgyal pos ltas mkhan rnams bkug nas smras ①pa las/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha 'di ni btsun mo'i rum du sems can zhig zhugs pa gang lags pa de'i mthu lags so/ /rgyal po sems khong du rjochud cing ⑤'dug nas/ 'di'i 'dod pa ci zhig gis dusel bar 'gyur snyam mo//mkhas pa'i rang bzhin can gzhan dag gis smras pa/ lha ras kyi bar stsang shas bltams par ⑦bgyis te gsol la nyid btsun mo la stobs ⑧mdzod cig /de nas rgyal pos ras kyi bar shas gang bar byas pa bgos nas bdag nyid gos can la bstabs ⑨pa dang / des rgyab 0kyi sha yin no snyam nas zos so/ /de nas de'i 'dod pa gang yin pa de dang bral bar gyur to/ /yang de'i 'dod pa skyes pa/kye ⑩ma'o bdag gis lha'i khrag kho na 'thungs kyang ci ma rung snyam pa 8de yang rgyal po la smras pa dang / de nas rgyal pos yan lag lnga'i rtsa gtar nas khrag blud pas de 'dod pa 8de dang byabral bar gyur to8/ /ji tsam na zla ba dgu 'tshang ba dang / khye'u gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa blta na sdug pa zhig btsas so/ /btsas te gang gi 0nyi ma la btsas pa de nyid kyi nyi ma la yang khrag gi char bab bo/ /rgyal pos yang ltas mkhan rnams bkug nas rmas 8pa dang / de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha bstan bcos las ji ltar gda' ba tho)ltar na gdon mi 'tshal shyibar khye'u 'dis lha sku tshe dang phral nas durang nyid cod pan bcings te rgyal srid bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal pos bsams ⑤pa/ rnam pa thams cad du rgyal srid kyi ched 'du 'dis srog dang bral bar byed kyis tso'adi la bdag nyid kyis rgyal srid byin na duci'i phyir bdag srog dang bral bar byed snyam mo de'i tshe yangs 3—130

pa can na litstsha bī ming chen zhes bya ba zhig gnas te/ de'i skyed mos tshal na a mra'i tshal yod pa las der glo ①bur du chu shing gi sdong po zhig skyes pa kun dga'i ra ba srung bas ②mthong ngo / /de ma thag kho nar ③me tog chags pa dang / de ngo mtshar skyes nas ming chen la smras pa dang / des ltas mkhan rnams bkug nas dris pa dang de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha de srung 0du gsol cig dang dgung ⑤bdun gyi nyin par gas par 'gyur te/ de'i nang nas bu mo zhig 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /khyim bdag ming chen gyis thos nas lhag par yang ngo mtshar skyes par gyur te/ skyed mos tshal der kun nas srung ༷ma'i mi rnams bkod nas nyi ma bgrang ⑦ba la zhugs so/ /ji tsam na zhag bdun lon pa dang skyed mos 0tshal de rdo ba dang / gseg ma dang / gyo mo rnams bsal ⑨nas tsan dan gyi chus chag chag btab/ shin tu dri zhim po'i 7pog por yidag bshams/ dar gyi chun 'phyang 'amang po bres/ me tog sil mas bkram/ glu dang rol mo'i sgra rnam pa du ma dag dang / mdza' bo dang / gnyen bshes 8kyi skye bos yongs su bskor nas dpal gyi 'byor pa chen pos chung ma dang lhan cig byung nas skyed mos tshal de na de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed dga' mgur spyod par 8byed pa las chu shing gi sdong po gas nas bu mo gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa blta na sdug pa yan lag thams cad dang ldan pa zhig byung ngo / /de nas ming chen gyis chung ma dam pa la gtad 8pa dang / des smras pa/ lha 'di'i ming gdags su gsol/ ming chen gyis ⑩smras pa/ bu mo 'di ni a mra'i tshal nas rnyed pa yin pas 'di'i ming a mra skyong ma zhes bya'o0/ /ji 8tsam na khyim bdag ming chen skyed mos tshal nas rang gi khyim du song ste bu mo a mra skyong ma bskyed bsrings 3—131

te zhes bya ba nas chen mor gyur to①/ /zhes bya ba'i ②bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de slong ba'i phyir yul krung krung pa rnams dang / shākya rnams dang / gzhan yang yul sna tshogs na gnas pa'i rgyal po'i bu dudang / blon po'i bu dang /tshong pa dang / tshong dpon dang / ded dpon du ma dag 'ongs pa dang /khyim bdag ming chen gyis bsams pa gang kho na la ma byin pa de dag dus na sdang ⑤bar 'gyur na 'on kyang tshogs kyis 0khrims su bcas pas re zhig tshogs la brtag go snyam nas/ des yangs pa can gyi tshogs bsdus te/ shes ldan ①bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams nyon cigadu /bdag gis skyed mos tshal nas bu mo zhig rnyed pa de bdag gis bsnun bstod de bskyed nas/ de bdag 0gis rang gi rigs rgyud yidang 'tsham par 'ga' zhig la chung mar byin yin tshogs kyis ltos shig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ khyim bdag sngon tshogs kho nas khrims su bcas pa/ bud med rin po che ni ⑩mi gtang ⑩ste tshogs kyis 8spyad do/ /zhes bcas pa yin gyis 8re zhig bu mo de ci 'dra ba zhig bltas 8khrid de shog shig/ des de tshogs kyi nang du khrid de 'ongs pa dang / gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa mthong nas tshogs thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur pa'i ()mig bgrad 8de kun tu brtags ⑩par brtsams nas smras pa ⑦/ khyim bdag 'di ni bud med rin po che yin pas tshogs kyis spyad kyis ⑥su la yang mi sbyin no/ /de nas khyim bdag ming chen yid mi bde zhing rang gi khyim du song nas de 'gram pa la lag pa gtad nas ( )sems khong du 6)chud cing 'dug pa (ste.a mra skyong mas mthong nas dris pa/ yab ci'i slad du thugs mi dgyes/ bu mo 'khyod bud med rin po che yin no zhes tshogs kyis spyad par gyur te/ bdag gi yid la re 3—132

ba ma rdzogs so/ /yab ci khyod gzhan gyi dbang du gyur tam/ bu mo sngon tshogs kyis chakhrims su bcas pa bud med rin po che ni tshogs kyis spyad do zhes bcas la/ khyod kyang bud med rin po che yin pas de'i phyir bdag la dbang med do/ /des smras pa/ dam zhig bca' ste ②gal te bdag la tshogs kyi ③dam pa lnga zhig stsal na/ bdag dutshogs kyis spyad par bgyi ste/ ris dang po'i ⑤khang pa stsal 0ba dang / skyes pa gcig nang du zhugs pa na cig shos nang du mi 'jug pa dang / nang du 'jug pa gang yin pa de yang kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya 'tshal te mchi ba dang / gang gi tshe khyim nyul ba de'i tshe bdag gi khyim zhag bdun na byul ba dang ⑦/ bdag gi khyim du mchi ba rnams kyi phyir 'byung ba dang /nang du 'jug pa la ⑧mi brtag ⑨pa'o/ /ming chen gyis a mra skyong ma'i spring ba bzlas ⑩pa dang / tshogs kyis smras pa/ de bzhin du byas teyi/ ris dang po'i khang pa zhes gang smras pa la ris dang po'i khang pa ni bud med rin po che 'di ⑫kho na la 'os so/ /gcig nang du zhugs pa na cig shos nang du mi 0'jug ⑫par bya'o zhes gang ⑫ smra ba ⑩de yang bden te sha khon rnams las tunyeni 'di lta ste/bud med kyi sha khon tha chad 8yin pas gal te gcig nang du zhugs pa na ⑩cig shos kyang nang du zhugs na gdon ma zos par ()gcig la gcig gsod par 'gyur ro/ /nang du 'jug pa des kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya thogs te nang du 'jug par bya'o zhes gang smras pa de yang bden te/ gdon mi za bar de'i gos dang rgyan du dgos 0so/ /zhag bdun lon pa na dukhang pa byul bar bya'o zhes gang dusmras pa de yang bden te/ sngar ram phyis byas kyang rung de la 'gal ba ci zhig yod / skyes pa rnams kyi ④phyir 'byung ⑤ba dang nang du 'jug pa la mi brtag go 3—133

zhes gang smras pa de yang bden te/ 'di smad 'tshong ma ①yin pas gal te mi rnams kyi phyir 'byung ba dang nang du 'jug pa brtags na su zhig de'i khyim du 'ejug /de nas tshogs kyis de la mchog lnga byin nas tshogs kyis spyad par gyur to/ /yangs pa can gyi litstsha bī rnams kyis dga' mgur spyad ②pa'i phyir de'i khyim du 'jug par brtsams pa las/ de na kha cig ni yul la chags ches ③pa'i phyir mthong ma thag kho nar ④'dod chags dang bral bar gyur to/ /kha cig gis ni reg pa kho nas te/ de la 'gas kyang skyes pa'i bya ba ma byas so/ /des bsams pa/ 'di dag ni skyes pa ma yin gyis ⑤thabs shig bshams 0par bya'o snyam nas/ des yul sna tshogs na gnas pa'i ri mo mkhan rnams bkug nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag gang na rgyal po'am blon po'am phyug po'am/ tshong dpon nam/ tshong pa'am/ ded dpon ci 'dra ba zhig ⑦mthong ba de 'dra ba dag rtsig pa la bris shig /de rnams kyis ji ltar mthong ba bzhin dubris pa dang /de nas a mra skyong ma rgyan sna tshogs 0kyis brgyan nas ri mo'i las rnams la so sor brtags te dris pa/ shes ldan dag 'di ⑩gang zhig 'di yini rgyal po rab snang 8ngo / /gzhan 'di gang zhig /ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal lo/ /gzhan 'di gang zhig pad sa la'i 8rgyal po 'char byed do/ /gzhan 'di gang zhig /ma ga dma'i 4)rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po'o/ /des de bzhin du 'dris pa dang de rnams kyis kyang thams cad smras so/ /de nas des thams cad la brtags pa dang gzugs can snying po la mig chags nas des bsams pa/ skyes bu 'di ltar ()chu zheng gab pas ni bdag dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad par nus so 0snyam mo8/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na ma ga 3—134

dma'i ①rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po steng gi khang bzangs kyi ②gzhir song nas ①blon po'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor 0te 'dug nas tshul ma yin pa'i gtam smras pa/ shes ldan dag sus smad 'tshong ⑤ma ji lta bu mthong / sa skyong gis smras pa/ lha re zhig gzhan lta zhogadu /yangs pa can na smad 'tshong ⑦ma a mra skyong ma zhes bgyi ba shin tu gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa sgyu rtsal ⑧drug bcu rtsa bzhi 'tshal ba lha kho nas spyad du rung ba zhig mchis so/ /des smras pa/ sa skyong gal te de lta na yangs pa can du 'dong ⑨/ de dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad 0do/ /des smras pa/ yangs pa can gyi litstsha bī rnams ni yun ring po nas gnod pa bgyid pa slar rgol ba dgra bo lags pas khyod la gnod pa bgyid du 0mchi'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag mi rnams ni skyes bu'i dpa' snying can yin pas 'dong ngo / /des smras pa/ lha gal 7te don ma mchis pa la gtsigs che bar 8mdzad na gshegs tsomod/ de shing rtar zhugs nas sa skyong dang lhan cig yangs pa can du chas te/ rim gyis yangs pa can du phyin nas sa skyong ni skyed mos tshal na sdod do/ /rgyal po ni a mra skyong ma'i khyim du zhugs pa dang / ji tsam na dril gyi sgra byung ngo / /yangs pa can gyi litstsha bī rnams rod rod por gyur nas shes ldan dag bdag cag gi mi mdza' 8ba zhig nang du zhugs pas dril 'khrol lo zhes sgra gsal ba dang / sgra chen po byung ba dang / rgyal po gzugs can snying pos a mra skyong ma la dris pa/ bzang mo 'di ci zhig yin/ lha sdum pa 0nyul bar bgyid do/ /ci zhig gi phyir/ lha'i slad du'o/ /ji ltar bya/ ci 'bros sam/ lha mi dgyes pa ⑩ma mdzad cig/lha dgung bdun lon pa phyedang bdag gi sdum pa 7nyul bar bgyid pas re zhig 3—135

dgung bdun du rol bas dgyes ①par mdzod/ dgyes dgur mdzod la dgung bdun lags dang dus mkhyen par bgyi'o/ /de ②de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las ji tsam na a mra skyong ma sems can dang ldan par gyur nas des rgyal po gzugs can snying po la smras pa/lha bdag la sems can zhugs lags ①so/ /des rjode la seng ras shig dang sor gdub rgya dubyin nas smras pa/ gal te bu mo zhig yin na khyod nyid kyi yin no//'on te khye'u yin na seng ras 'di skon dul sor gdub kyi rgya mgul tu thogs te nga'i drung du bkri rgyashig /de byung ste shing rtar zhugs te sa skyong dang lhan cig chas pa dang dril bu ⑧'khrol bar 'dug go/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag dgra bo byung gis 7rjes bzhin du 4) btsal lo zhes litstsha bī skyin gor (nyegyi mda' rtsibs can lnga brgyas rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i phyi bzhin bsnyags 8pa dang sa skyong gis mthong nas des smras pa/ lha yangs pa can gyi litstsha bī rnams mchi na/ lha ci 'di dag dang lhan cig 'thab tsomo bgyi'am/ 'on te shing rta bda'abya/ des smras pa/ nga ni dub pas shing rta ded kyis 'khyod kho nas 'di dag dang lhan cig 'thab mo khyes ⑩shig /des de rnams dang lhan cig 'thab mo 'gyed par brtsams pa las yangs pa can rnams kyis ngo shes nas de rnams kyis ⑩smras pa/ shes ldan dag mi'i srin po de nyid 'di yin gyis 8slar ldog 0go//de rnams slar log nas yangs pa can du 'ongs te 'dus nas yang khrims su ⑥bcas pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag gi dgra 0'di la yang gzugs can snying po'i bu rnams sha glon tsodu gzhug 'go zhes bcas so/ /ji tsam na zla ba 'dagu 'das pa dang a mra skyong ma la khye'u gzugs bzang la 'amadzes pa blta tshun sdug pa 3—136

zhig btsas so/ /btsas nas zhes bya ba ①nas bsrings bskyed de chen por gyur to zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /de yangs pa can pa'i ⑤litstsha bī'i khye'u rnams dang lhan cig rtse bar byed pa las/ de rnams kyis mi dga' ba'i tshig gis ②smras pa/ bran mo'i bu 0khyod brgya stong phrag du ma zhig las ni skyes na pha su yin/ de dungus nas ①ma'i drung du song ba dang des smras pa/ bu ci'i phyir du ⑦bu / des thams cad rgyas par smras pa dang / des smras pa/⑧ du gal te yang 'dri ba ⑨dang nga'i pha lta bu ni khyed cag gcig la yang med do zhes smos shig /gal te su yin zhes smra dang ⑩/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po yin no zhes smros shig /ji tsam na de de rnams dang lhan cig yang rtse 0bar byed pa las de rnams kyis de la de bzhin du smras pa dang / des smras pa/ nga'i pha lta bu ni khyed cag gcig la yang med do//su yin/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po yin no/ /de rnams kyis shes ldan dag bdag cag gi dgra gang yin pa de ni 'di'i pha yin no zhes lhag par yang brdegs ⑫so/ /des ngus nas ji ltar gyur pa rnams ma la smras 4)pa dang / des bsams pa/ yangs pa can gyi litstsha bī rnams ni gdug pa rtsal po che yin te/gal te 'di bsad (9par 'gyur ba'i gnas de yod do snyam mo/ /de de lta bu sems shing 'dug pa dang tshong pa rab tu mang po zong thogs nas 8rgyal po'i khab tu 'dong ba de dag ⑩des mthong nas smras pa/ sor gdub kyi rgya 0'dis snod rgyas tsothob la deng yishig dang sho zhugam mi gcod par 'gyur ro/ /khye'u 'di yang rgyal po'i pho brang du khrid la sor gdub 0kyi rgya 'di 'di'i mgul du thogs te rgyal po'i khab kyi sgor duzhog cig /de rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du bya'o zhes khas blangs so/ /bu la yang mu tig gi do shal cig byin nas smras pa/ bu rgyal po 3—137

dgos ①pa'i ched du 'dus ②dang mu tig cigi do shal rkang pa'i steng du zhog la 'dzegs te pang ①du 'dug shig /gal te 'ga' zhig khye'u 'di 'jigs mi shes pa zhig dugo zhes smra ⑤dang de la yang dubu phas 'jigs pa 'ga' yod dam zhes smos ④shig /de tshong pa rnams dang lhan cig tu rim gyis rgyal po'i khab tu phyin nas/ de rnams kyis khrus byas te sor gdub kyi rgya btags nas rgyal po'i pho brang gi sgor bzhag pa dang / de rgyal po gang na ba der song ste phyin nas mu tig gi do shal rkang pa la bzhag nas 'dzegs te pang ⑧du 'dug go/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag khye'u 'di ni 'jigs mi shes pa zhig go/ /des smras pa/yab bu phas 'jigs pa 'ga' mchis lags sam/ de nas rgyal pos 'jigs pa med pa'i sgra kun tu smras pas rgyal bu gzhon nu 'jigs med rgyal bu gzhon nu 'jigs med ①ces bya bar grags so// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po drug bcu gcig pa/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po gzhan gyi bud med la lhag par chags pas glang po che la zhon nas grong khyer gyi srang rnams su song nas mig phan tshun du lta zhing 'khyam par byed do/ /de'i tshe rgyal po'i khab na tshong dpon phyug pa nor mang ba longs spyod che ba zhig yod pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas 4)zhes bya ba nas dga' mgur spyod par byed do zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de ⑩dus gzhan zhig na chung ma la smras pa/ bzang mo thong thogs nas 0yul gzhan du 'gro'o/ /des smras pa/ rje'i sras de bzhin du mdzod cig /de thong thogs te yul gyi mthar song ngo 4)/ /de yang kha zas zhim po dang gos kyis nyon mongs pas gdungs par gyur pa las/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po glang po che la zhon nas 3—138

de'i khyim drung nas song ba dang / des kyang skar khung du 'dug nas rgyal po la me tog gi phreng ba bor ro/ /de nas rgyal pos mthong nas smras pa/ mar shog/des smras pa/ lha g.yar tsha lags kyis ①khrod nyid nang du gshegs shig /de nas rgyal po nang du zhugs nas ②de de dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las/ de ②yang de'i tshe rung zhing zla mtshan dang ldan pas sems can chags par gyur nas des rgyal po la smras pa/ lha bdag duni sems can dang ldan par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal pos ⑤de la yang sor gdub kyi rgya dang duseng ras khra bo byin nas smras pa/ gal te re zhig khye'ur gyur na seng ras 'di skon ⑦la sor gdub kyi rgya yang mgul du thogs te nga'i drung du bkri ⑧shig /'on te bu mo yin na ni khyod nyid kyi yin no zhes smras nas rgyal po song ngo / /ji tsam na ded dpon de don rnams grub ste rgyal po'i khab dang nye ba zhig tu phyin nas/ des chung ma la bzang mo dga' ba skyed cig /kho bo don grub nas bde bar 'ongs te/zhag 'di tsam kho na na phyin par 'ong ngo / /⑨sring ba des thos ⑩nas bdag gis ni bya ba ma yin pa 'di lta bu byas la/ de yang 'ong yin de la ji ltar bsgrub par bya snyam du phongs ⑩par gyur nas/ des de ⑩ltar gyur pa rnams rgyal po la rig par byas pa dang / de nas rgyal pos slar spring ba/ bag ma tsha bar 'dug shig ci tsonas kyang myur du mi 'ong ba 8de ltar ngas bya'o⑩/ /rgyal pos de la pho nya btang ba/ ded dpon nga (sprel rin po che che ge mo dang che ge mo dag cig dgos kyis 8de med par khyod 0'dir ma 'ongs ⑥shig /de rin po che de rnams kyi phyir lam ring por song ngo / /de yang zla ba dgu 'das nas btsas pa dang khye'u gzugs bzang ba ⑥mdzes pa/ blta dun sdug pa zhig btsas so ma 3—139

bslabs ①kyang bud med la shes nyen yod pas des ②mar dang sbrang rtsis de 'grangs ②par bstod nas sor gdub ①kyi rgya mgul 0du btags te seng ras kyis bkris dunas sgrom ⑦bu'i nang du bcug ste bu mo mngag gzhug ma la bsgo ba/song la sgrom bu 'di khyer te rgyal po'i pho brang gi sgor khyod kyi ⑧dkyil 'khor byos ⑨la me mar bus te phyogs gcig tu ji srid 'ga' zhig gis blangs kyi bar du sdod cig /des de bzhin byabyas pa dang ji tsam na rgyal po steng gi khang bzangs kyi shyigazhir song nas rgyal po ()gzhon nu 'jigs med dang lhan cig 'dug 0pa las/des rgyal po'i pho brang gi sgo na mar me mthong ngo / /de nas zho shas 'tsho ba rnams ⑫la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag rgyal po'i pho brang gi sgo na mar me 'bar ba 'o ni ci yin ltos shig /8de dag gis bltas nas smras pa/ lha sgrom bu zhig mchis so /des smras pa/ long ⑩shig /rgyal bu gzhon nu 'jigs med kyis smras pa/ lha sgrom bu de na ci mchis pa 4)de bdag la stsal bar 8ci gnang / rgyal pos de bzhin yibya'o zhes khas blangs so/ /ji tsam na sgrom bu 0blangs nas rgyal po la phul ba dang / rgyal pos smras pa/ kha phye dushig /kha phye ba las khye'u zhig byung ngo / /rgyal pos smras pa/ 'di ci gson nam/ 'on te shi ba zhig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha gson lags so/ /de nas rgyal pos sor gdub kyi ⑫rgya dang seng ras ngo shes nas rgyal bu 6)gzhon nu 'jigs med la byin pa dang /des de bsnun bstod bskyed de ⑥rgyal pos gson nam zhes tshig tu byung ba dang /rgyal bu rdzigazhon nu 'jigs med kyis gsos pas/ 'tsho byed gzhon nus gsos zhes bya bar grags so/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na 'tsho byed gzhon nus (9gsos chen por gyur to/ /de cha'ajigs med dang lhan cig bre mo phyogatam zer 3—140

zhing 'khod pa①/ 'jigs med gzhon nu ma skyes dgra ②ni ma btsas pa kho na nas rgyal po nyid du lung bstan gyis ②bdag cag gis dubazo cung 0zad bslabs te / des dun bdag cag gi phyi dus kyis ⑦'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /de gnyis kyis de ltar gros byas pa lasal/ shing rta mkhan gos dkar po gon ⑨pa mi gos dkar po gon ⑩pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor nas rgyal po'i pho brang du zhugs pa dang / de rgyal bu ⑩'jigs medam gzhon nus tsomathong nasa'/ des rgyal po'i ⑫mi gzhan dag la dris tunyepa/ 'di su zhig yin/ de rnams kyis smras pa/shing rta mkhan lags so/ /'dis ⑩ci 'thob/ 'tsho ba'o⑩/ /des bsams pa/ bdag gis kyang lha la brtags nas 8shing rta ⑩mkhan bslab bo snyam nas/de rgyal po'i drung du song nas smras pa/ lha bdag kyang shing rta mkhan bslab bo/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ bu khyod ci du'adis 'tsho bar 'gyur ram/ yab rgyal po'i bus ni bzo thams cad la bslab 0par bgyi ba lags so/ bu gal te de lta na khyod shing rta dumakhan slobs 0shig /des bslab par brtsams so/ /'tsho byed kyis kyang sman pa gos dkar po gon ④pa mi gos dkar po gon byapa rnams kyis yongs su bskor nas rgyal po'i pho brang du zhugs pa tsomathong nas/ des gzhan dag la dris pa/ 'di su zhig yin/ de dag gis smras pa/ sman pa lags so//'di 0ci zhig byed/ dpyad bgyid do/ /ci thobatso/ gal te nad pa zhig sos na rngan pa thob 6)bo/ /'on te gum na mi 'tshol ( )mi 'dri'o/ /des bsams pa/ sman dpyad ⑥bslab bo snyam nas/ de pha'i gan du song ste dusmras pa/ lha gnang bar mdzod cig /sman dpyad bslab lags so/ /bu khyod rgyal po'i sras yin no/ /khyod la sman dpyad kyis ci bya/ lha rgyal po'i bus ni 3—141

bzo thams cad la ①bslab par bgyi ba lags so/ /bu gal te de lta na slobs shig /des ②sman dpyad bslab par brtsams pa dang / des sman dpyad ni lobs na des klad ③pa'i thod pa dbye ba'i dpyad ma shes nas/ des rdo 'jog na sman pa'i rgyal po rgyun shes kyi bu zhes bya ba yod de/ des klad ༷pa'i thod pa 'byed pa'i dpyad shes so zhes thos nas/ de rgyal po'i drung du song ste smras pa/lha rdo 'jog tu mchi'o/ /ci zhig gi phyir de na sman pa'i rgyal po rgyun shes kyi bu zhes bgyi ba mchis te/ de klad ⑤pa'i thod pa 'byed pa'i dpyad 'tshal bas 0de slob tu mchi'o/ /bu khyod 'dis 'tsho'am/ lha yang na ni ⑦dpyad mi bslabadu/yang na ni legs par bslab par bgyi'o/ /bu gal te de lta na song ①shig /des ⑩rgyal po pad ma'i snying po la spring ba/ bdag gi bu 'di sman dpyad slob tu rgyun shes kyi bu'i drung du 'ong gisayi/ 'di'i dgos pa thams cad khyod kyis sbyor cig /de rim gyis rdo 'jog 0tu phyin pa dang / pad ma'i snying pos kyang spring yig bklags 0te rgyun shes kyi bu la gtad nas rgyal po'i bu 'di khyod kyi drung du ched du 'ongs kyis 8'di la sman dpyad slobs shig /rgyun shes kyi bus de la ston par byed pa na/ des nyung zad bstan pa dang 'tsho byed kyis tsokhyad par dang bcas pa lobs so(9/ /rgyun shes kyi bu'i kun tu spyod pa ni gang gi tshe nad pa la ltar 0'gro ba'i tsotshe bram ze'i khye'u zhig phyekhrid de 'gro ba yin pas de dus gzhan zhig na 'tsho byed khrid de song nas des nad pa'i sman bstan pa 'di dang 'di dag ni 0byin cig ces smras nas byung ngo / /'tsho byed kyis bsams pa/'di ni mkhan pos nyes te/ gal te 'dis sman 'di zos na 'di deng nyid 'chi bar 'gyur te/ mkhan pos bstan pa ni legs pa ma 0yin gyis duthabs shig 3—142

bya'o snyam nas de rgyun shes kyi bu dang lhan cig tu byung nas slar nang du zhugs te smras pa/ mkhan po 'di skad ces gsung ngo / /kho bos sman bstan pa gang yin pa de ma sbyin ①par 'di dang 'di dag byin cig ces zer ro②/ /des de bzhin du byas pas sos par gyur to/ /ji tsam nyi ma gzhan zhig la rgyun shes kyi ③bu yang de'i drung du song nas dris pa/ na ba ji lta 0sos par gyur to/ /sang yang de nyid byin cig /ci snga ma lags sam/ 'on te slad kyis bstan pa lags/ ci bdag gis sngar bstan tam/ 'on te phyis bstan/ de dag gis smras pa/ 'di dag ni khyod kyis mngon sum du bstan to/ /'di ni 'tsho byed la phrin du spring ba yin no/ /des bsams pa/ bdag gis ①nyes kyis rjo'atsho byed ni shes rab can yin no snyam bsams nas smras pa/ 'tsho byed kyis bstan pa gang yin pa de byin cig /rgyun shes kyi ⑦bu 'tsho byed la dga' ba skyes pas de gang du 'gro bar ⑧der 'tsho byed 'khrid ①do/ /bram ze'i khye'u gzhan rnams kyis smras pa/ mkhan po khyod rgyal po'i bu'o snyam nas 'di la ni spro bas ⑩ston par mdzad kyi/ bdag yicag la ni mi mdzad do/ /des smras pa/ 'tsho byed ni shes rab can yin pas ngas bstan pa gang yin pa de rang gis rnam par 'byed nus kyi khyed ⑩kyis ni de lta ma yin no/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ mkhan pos ji ltar mkhyen/ gal te de lta na 4)ngas khyed cag gi mngon sum du bya'o/ / des bram bze'i khye'u byarnams la khyod kyis ni rdzas che ge mo zhig gi rin dris shig/khyod kyis kyang che ge mo zhig gi'o zhes thams cad tshong dus su btang 0ngo / /'tsho byed kyang khyod kyis kyang che ge mo zhig gi'o zhes bsgo'o/ /bram ze'i khye'u rnams kyis 4)ji skad bstan pa kho na bzhin byas so/ /'tsho byed kyis kyang 'ji skad 3—143

bstan pa bzhin byas nas bsams pa/ gal te mkhan po rdzas gzhan gyi ①rin 'dri bar byed na bdag gis ji skad brjod par byasal/ thams cad du rdzas thams cad kyi rin dri'o ③snyam moX/ /de dag thams cad mkhan po'i drung du song nas ji skad bstan pa de ⑤bzhin smras so/ /rgyun shes kyi bus ma bstan pa'i rdzas kyi rin dri bar brtsams te0/ bram ze'i khye'u rdzas che ge mo zhig gi rin ji tsam/ des smras pa/ ma 'tshal to/ /gzhan dag la dris pa dang / smras pa/ ma 'tshal lags so/ /'tsho byed la dris pa dang des rdzas thams cad kyi rin smras so/ /rgyun shes kyi bus smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u dag khyed 0kyis thos sam thos lags so/ /ngas du'atsho byed ni shes rab can yin te/ cung zad bstan na yang de la rang gis rnam par 'byed nus so zhes smras pa ni don de yin no/ /gzhan yang mngon sum du bya'o zhes ⑨de rnams la smras pa/ zeng shing can gyi ri la deng tshul sman ma yin pa dag khyer te shog shig /de dag dong nas de dag las gang zhig gis gang sman ma yin par shes pa de de yidag gis blangs so/ /'tsho byed kyis bsams pa/ sman ma yin pa ni cung zad kyang med do snyam nas/des 'dam bu mda' rgyu'i rtsa ba dang / rdo ba'i dum bu zhig blangs so/ /ji tsam na 'tsho byed kyis lam gyi phyed na phyugs rdzi mo zhig zho'i bum pa dang phrum tshud khyer nas rgyun shes kyi bu'i drung du song ba las de shin tu mig na ba des mthong nas des dris pa gang du 'groX/ des smras pa0/ des de la gnas de nyid kyi drung na yod pa'i sman zhig bstan pa las des byas pa dang mod ④la sos par gyur to / /de dga' ba skyes nas smras pa/ zho'i bum pa dang 'phrum tshud 'di khyod ⑫snoms shig /des phrum tshud blangs te/ zho'i bum pa ni de nyid la byin nas de 3—144

phrum tshud khyer te song ba las/ ji tsam na bram ze'i khye'u rnams kyis lam gyi dbus na glang ①po che'i rjes zhig mthong nas②/ de rnams kyis de la brtag ③par brtsams pa dang 'tsho byed kyang 'ongs nas des smras pa/ 'di ci yin/glang po che'i rjes so/ /'di ni glang po che'i rjes ma yin gyidu/ 'di ni bal glang dumo'i rjes yin te/ de yang mig g.yas pa zhar ba de ring kho nar glang po che'i phrug 0gu 'byung bar 'gyur ba zhig yin la/ de la zhon pa ni bud med yin la/de yang mig g.yas pa zhar ba sbrum pa de ring nyid du bu pho btsa' bar 'gyur ba zhig yin no/ /ji tsam na rgyun shes kyi bu'i drung du 'ongs rgyanas gang gis gang khyer te 'ongs pa des de bstan to/ /rgyun shes kyi bus smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u dag 'di thams cad ni sman yin te/ re zhig 'di ni duche ge mo zhig gis ⑨nad che ge mo zhig yin la de bzhin du gzhan yang ⑨ gzhan dag kyang yin no/ /'tsho byed la dris pa khyod kyis ci khyer te 'ongs/ des smras pa/ mkhan po thams cad sman lags te0/ sman ma lags pa ni ci yang ma mchis so/ 'on kyang bdag gis 'dam bu mda' rgyu'i rtsa ba dang / rdo'i dum bu tsodang / phrum tshud cig 'tshal te mchis so/ /'di dag ci dgos sdig pas zin pa las sngona'adam bu mda' 4)rgyu'i rtsa ba'i dud pas bdug go/ /phrum tshud kyis ni glan ⑫par bgyi'o/ /rdo'i dum bus ni ston ku'i ⑩dus na zhi'i bum pa 'chag ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /rgyun shes kyi bus 8'dzum phyung ba dang / bram ze'i khye'u yirnams kyis dubasams pa/ mkhan po ni 'di la khros so snyam nas de rnams kyis smras pa/mkhan po ji spre'adi gcig pur bas snyam mam 3/ bdag cag mchi ba na lam gyi dbus su glang po che'i rjes shig mthong ba na 'di'i mchid nas 'di ni bal glang du3—145

mo'i rjes yin te/ de yang mig g.yas pa zhar ba ①skum pa de ring kho nar glang po che phrug ②gu 'byung bar 'gyur ba zhig yin la/ de la zhon ③pa ni bud med yin la de yang mig g.yas pa zhar ba sbrum pa de ring nyid du bu pho btsa' bar 'gyur ro zhes mchi'o/ /rgyun shes kyi bus dris pa/ 'tsho byed bden nam/mkhan po mad rjodo/ de glang po che'i rjes sam/ bal glang dumo'i rjes yin pa ji ltar shes/ des smras pa/ mkhan po bdag ni rgyal po'i rigs las chen por gyur pa lags na ci ste ma du'atshal/ glang po che'i rjes ni zlum mo/ /bal glang ⑦mo'i rjes ni chur ②ring ngo / /mig g.yas pa zhar bar ji ltar shes/g.yon phyogs su ran 'tshal zhing mchis pa las 0so/ /sbrum par ji ltar shes/rkang pa gnyis gnon cing mchi ba las 0so/ /deng kho nar 'brang yibar 'gyur bar ⑩ji ltar shes/ gcin be'u snabs dang bcas par 'byung bas so/ /glang po che'i phrug 'gu phor 'brang bar 'gyur bar 0ji ltar shes/ rkang pa g.yas pa lhag par gnon cing mchi bas 0so/ /de la bud med zhon par (9ji ltar shes/babs nas rkang pa'i bar du gcis pa las so/ /de yang mig g.yas pa zhar bar ji ltar shes/ g.yon phyogs su me tog thu ⑩zhing mchi bas 8so/ /de yang sbrum par ji ltar shes/ de'i rkang pa'i rting pa phal cher gnon cing mchis pas ⑥so//deng kho nar btsa' bar du'agyur bar ji ltar shes/ gcin ljan ljin dang bcas te 'byung ba las so/ /de lta lags kyis kyang gal te mkhan po thugs mi ches na 'gron pa duganas pa'i phyogs der bram ze'i khye'u 'ga' zhig mngag tu gsol/des bram ze'i khye'u zhig btang ba dang / 'tsho byed kyis ji skad smras pa de thams cad de bzhin du gyur to/ /rgyun shes kyi bus bram ze'i khye'u rnams la smras pa/3—146

bram ze'i khye'u dag khyed ①kyis thos sam/ 'tsho byed ni de 'dra bar shes rab can ②rna/ /'tsho byed kyis klad ②pa'i thod pa 'byed pa'i dpyad ma gtogs ①pa thams cad bslabs sol/ /ji tsam na mi zhig klad dund kyis thebs nas rgyun shes kyi bu'i drung du song ste smras pa/ rgyun shes kyi bu ⑦bdag la dpyad ⑧mdzod cig /des smras pa/ kye nang rje re zhig de ring dong rkos ⑨la rtsi ba dag sta gon kyigyis shig dang sang bdag gis khyod kyi dpyad 0bya'o/ /'tsho byed kyis thos nas de de'i phyi bzhin song ste/ kye nang rje bdag gis cung zad bslabs 0pa gang yin pa de thams cad ni sems can la phan pa'i phyir yin na/ bdag gis klad 8pa'i thod pa dbye 8ba ma bslabs kyisabya/ khyod kyis bdag dben par tsozhog zhig dang / khyed kyi ⑩las ji ltar byed pa blta'o0/ /des smras pa/ de bzhin du bgyi'o/ /des de phyogs dben pa zhig tu bzhag go/ /de nas rgyun shes kyi bu 'ongs nas mi yide dong du bcug ste thod pa zhudabye ba'i dpyad kyis thod pa phye nas de 0skam pas srog chags de blang bar brtsams pa dang 'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ mkhan po gzu lums su dum blangs 0shig /rigs kyi bu 'di deng nyid tso'agum par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ 'tsho byed 'ongs sam/ smras pa/mkhan po bdag mchis so/ /kho bos srog chags 'di ji ltar blang bar bya/mkhan po skam pa tsha bar mdzod (nyede rgyab tu reg nas rkang lag 'khyams (nyepar gyur pa dang de nas 'or cig /0des de bzhin du byas nas sos par gyur to/ /rgyun shes kyi bus smras pa/ 'tsho byed kho bo shin tu mgu bar gyur gyis dukhyod khrus byos la 0shog shig dang klad ⑥pa'i thod pa 'byed pa'i 0dpyad sbyin no/ /des khrus byas nas/ 'ongs pa dang des de la klad 9pa'i thod pa dbye ba'i dudapyad 3—147

byin ①nas smras pa/ 'tsho byed bdag cag ni 'dis 'tsho ba yin gyis②/ yul 'dir khyod kyis ma bya zhig /mkhan po de bzhin ③bgyi'o zhes 'tsho byed kyis rgyun shes kyi bu la phyag byas nas rgyal po pad ma'i snying po'i drung du song ste 0phyag byas nas / bdag gis sman dpyad bslabs ⑤lags kyis dumachi'o/ /de'i tshe rgyal po pad ma'i snying po dang mi mthun pa mtha' 'khob pa ⑦ skya bseng ⑧zhes bya ba dag cig yod de①/ des smras pa/ 'tsho byed bdag dang mi mthun pa mtha' 'khob pa 7skya bseng ⑩zhes bya ba dag cig yod kyis ⑩'di ltar khyod ni shes rab can nus pa yin pas re zhig de phob tshul phyis song ④shig dang / de lta na bdag cag gis 'jig rten gyi tshul byas par 'gyur ro/ /des de la khas blangs pa dang de nas des dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa bsdus te btang ba las des (smematha' 'khob pa skya bseng ⑩de rnams phab ⑩nas gte'u bzung dpya 8blangs te slar bde bar 'ongs nas khyer te 'ongs pa de bzhin du rgyal po la phul ba dang /de shin tu dga' nas de nyid la rjes su yi rangs nas ⑩des kyang rgyun shes kyi bu la byin no/ /de nas 'tsho byed rim gyis grong khyer bzang byed du phyin nas de nyid du dbyar gnas te/ de nas 0des 'byung po thams cad kyi skad ces bya ba'i bstan bcos bslabs nas grong khyer bzang byed nas chas pa dang mi zhig shing khur khyer nas grong khyer du 'jug pa/ rus pa dang pags ①pa'i lhag ma lus pa/ lus kun nas 'dzag pa 'tsho byed kyis mthong nas/ de la smras pa/kye nang rje ci zhig gis gnas skabs 'di lta bur gyur/ des smras pa/ bdag gis kyang mi shes na 'on kyang bdag gis shing khur 'di khyer nas bdag kyang 'di 'dra ba'i gnas skabs su gyur to/ /de shing brtag dupa la byang ba duyin pas 3—148 ska

smras pa/ kye nang rje ci shing khur 'di 'tshong ①ngam/ 'tshong ngo / /rin ji tsam / kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya'o/ /des de nyos nas de nas bltas na ②'byung po thams cad dad par ③byed pa zhes bya ba'i nor bu mthong nas de'i mthu ni 'di 'dra ste/ gang gi tshe nad pa'i mdun du bzhag pa de'i tshe mar mes stikhyim na yod pa'i rdzas bzhin du nad ji lta ba bzhin du snang ngo / /de rim gyis yul u dum bā ⑤rar phyin pa dang / de na mi bres du'ajal ba zhig yod pa des bre bos ⑦gzhal nas bre mgo la snun pa 'tsho byed kyis mthong nas smras pa/ kye nang rje ci'i phyir de ltar byed/ bdag gi klad 0pa lhag par g.ya'o⑨/ /tshur shog blta'o zhes des de bsnyal nas klad ⑩pa bltas te/ de nas 'tsho byed kyis 'byung po thams cad dad par yibyed pa'i nor bu de'i klad 8pa'i steng du gzhag pa dang / ji tsam na srin gyi med 0cig snang ngo / /de nas des smras pa/ kye nang rje khyod kyi ⑫klad ⑩pa la srin gyi med ⑩yod do/ /des rkang pa gnyis la gtugs 0te smras pa/bdag la dpyad mdzod cig /des khas blangs so/ /'tsho byed kyis bsams pa/mkhan pos ji skad bstan pa de tsobazhin du yi'adi'i dpyad bya'o snyam nas/ des de la smras pa/ kye nang rje re duzhig de ring dong rkos dul lci ba dag sta gon byos shig dang sang dpyad bya'o/ /des rkang pa gnyis la gtugs dunas song ngo / /'tsho byed kyis de'i phyi de nyin ()'ongs nas de dong du bcug ste klad ④pa'i thod pa 'byed pa'i dudapyad kyis klad 0pa'i thod pa phye nas skam pa tsha bas srin gyi med kyi rgyab la reg pa 0byas te des rkang lag 'khums pa dang / de nas des skam pas blangs te bor bas sos par gyur to/ /des de la kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya byin pa dang des kyang rgyun shes kyi bu la bskur dur/ /de nas 'tsho byed yul ro nyi ta 3—149

ka zhes bya bar phyin pa dang / yul ro nyi ta ka na khyim bdag cig la skyed mos tshal ①me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / chu phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod de/ de de ②la lhag par chags pa las shi nas de nyid du mi ma yin ①rnams su skyes so/ /de'i bu ni khyim gyi dpon por gyur nas des skyed dumos tshal der srung ⑤ma'i mi bzhag pa dang / de mi ma yin pa des bsad do/ /gnyis pa bzhag pa dang /de yang bsad dunas khyim bdag gi bu des skyed mos tshal de bor ro/ /ji tsam na mi dmu 3chus gang ba sman pa thams cad kyis spangs pa zhig skyed mos tshal der song nas nub mo 'brang ⑧btab ste 'dug nas/ kye ma'o bdag ni mi ma yin pas bsad kyang ci ma rung snyam mo/ /de nyid du 'tsho byed kyang nub mo 'brang ⑨btab ste 'dug go⑩/ /ji tsam na mi ma yin pa des dmu chu can de bsdigs par brtsams pa dang / dmu chu'i nad de byung nas smras pa/ 'di bdag gis sngar bzung na ci'i phyir 'di bsdigasayi/ khyod la ra spu'i dud pas bdug ⑫pa 'ga' 0yang med pa lta/ des ni khyod dpag tshad bcu gnyis su 'bros ④par 'gyur ro/ /des kyang ⑩smras pa/ khyod la yang la phug gi sa bon mar phyung ba'i dar ba dang btags te sbyin pa 'ga' yang med pa lta/ des ni khyod dum bu dum bur 'dzag ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /thams cad 'tsho 0byed kyis thos nas de nang par sngar langs te khyim bdag de'i drung du song nas des ⑩smras pa/ khyim bdag skyed mos tshal me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / chu phun sum yitshogs pa ci'i phyir dor/ khyim 0bdag gis de la ji ltar gyur pa rnams smras pa dang / des smras pa/ khyim bdag ra spu'i dud pas bdugs 0shig dang du/ mi ma yin pa dpag tshad bcu gnyis su 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /khyim bdag gis ra spu'i dud du3—150

pas bdugs pa dang mi ma yin pa de dpag tshad bcu gnyis su bros ①par gyur to//khyim bdag des kyang 'tsho ②byed la kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya byin pa dang / des de yang rgyun shes kyi bu la bskur ro/ /de nas 'tsho byed kyis dmu chu can la dris pa/nang rje khyod ci'i phyir mi ma yin pas gnas btab pa'i skyed mos tshal du 'dug /des de la ji ltar gyur pa dag smras pa dang / 'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ la phug ③gi sa bon mar phyung ba'i dar ba dang btags pa 'thung 0shig dang sos par 'gyur ro/ /des 'thungs nas ⑤sos par gyur 0te/ mi des kyang 'tsho byed la kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya byin pa dang ⑦/ des kyang ①rgyun shes kyi bu la bskur ro//de nas 'tsho byed rim gyis bcom brlag tu phyin nas bcom brlag gi phyi rol na shing zhig gi drung du ngal so 0zhing 'dug go/ /ji tsam ⑩na gyad kyis gyad gcig ⑪brdabs pas de'i nang grol rnams 8'khrugs nas de shi'o zhes phyi rol tu phyung ngo //shing de la yang bya rgod mo phrug 0gu dang bcas pa zhig 'dug pa las de la phrug rkyigu de rnams kyis smras pa/ ma sha byin cig /des smras pa/ bu sha ga la yod/de rnams kyis smras pa/ ma gyad kyis gyad 'di brdabs te shi nas phyung ba yin no//bu 'dir sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho 'byed 'ongs nas tsodes 'di sos par byed pa'i gnas de yod do/ /ma 'di ci zhig gis sos par 'gyur/ gal te de'i nang grol rnams phye mas reg par byas na'o/ /de thams cad 'tsho byed kyis thos so/ /de nas de langs te ro'i ⑩drung du song nas dris pa shes ldan dag 'di ci zhig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ gyad kyis gyad brdabs 0pas shi ba yin no/ /'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ zhog zhig dang blta'o/ /de rnams kyis bzhag pa dang de nas yi'atsho byed kyis 'byung po thams cad dang bar byed pa'i 0nor bu klad 0par 3—151
