bzhag nas brtags na/ ji tsam na nang grol rnams 'khrugs par byas pa mthong nas des sgyug ma'i sbubs su phye ma blugs te khas bus pa dang phye mas nang grol rnams la reg nas sos par gyur to/ /des kyang 'tsho byed la kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya byin pa dang / des kyang de ①rgyun shes kyi bu la bskur ro/ /bcom brlag na khyim bdag cig yod pa de'i chung ma gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa yin pas de de la lhag par chags shing 'dug pa las shi nas de nyid kyi mo mtshan gyi srin bur skyes par gyur te②/ de gang dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyod pa de shi bar byed do/ /de nas de dang 'ga' yang lhan cig dga' mgur spyod par ①mi byed do/ /des sman pa 'tsho byed der 'ongs so zhes thos nas de de'i drung du song ste smras pa/ 'tsho byed bdag la bro nad mchis kyis dudapyad mdzod cig /'tsho byed kyis de mthong zhing smra ba'i tshig thos nas chags pas smras pa/ dam zhig bca' ste/ gal te bdag dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad pa lta na dpyad bya'o/ /des smras pa/ g.yar tsha lags so/ /des dusmras pa/ khyod kyis rjodapyad gzhan ni med do/ /bdag las phangs pa gzhan med pas des khas ⑦blangs so/ /de ninas des sgren mor phyung ⑨ste bzo bcos byas nas mo mtshan gyi sgor sha'i dum bu zhig bzhag pa las/ de nas srin bu de de la chags pa dang des de blangs nas bor te sos par gyur to0/ /de 'dod pa'i 'dod chags la lhag par zhen pas brda 0zhig byas pa tsodang des yin ba gnyis bkag ste smras pa/khyod kho bo'i sring mo dang 'dra ste khyod kyi dpyad de yin pas kho bos de ltar byas par zad do/ /des kyang de la kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya byin pa dang / des de yang rgyun shes kyi bu la bskur ro/ /de nas 'tsho byed 8rim gyis chu bo byaya mu 3—152

na'i 'gram du phyin pa dang / des de na mi ro zhig yod pa de'i bting ①pa'i phyogs na rgyus pa'i breng ②yod pa nya rnams kyis drangs pa las de'i mig 'byed pa dang 'dzums ③pa mthong nas/ 'tsho byed kyis de thams cad brtags ༷te/ji ltar rgyus pa dang long gemo la sogs pa'i tshigs kyi 'brel thabs ni de yikho na ltar 'dug go snyam nas/ de rim gyis yangs pa can du phyin pa dang / ji tsam na gyad kyis gyad gcig thal mos bsnun ⑦pas mig gi 'bras bu 'phags pa dang / 'tsho byed de'i drung du song nas/ des rting 0pa'i rgyus pa'i breng nas drangs pa dang slar tshud par gyur to/ /des de la kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya byin pa dang / des 'jigs med kyi ma ⑨la byin no/ /yangs pa can na mi zhig yod pa de'i rna bar srin gyi med zhugs te/ der de las phrug 0gu bdun brgya byung bas de rna ⑩ba'i nad kyis nyen par 0gyur nas 'tsho byed kyi drung du song ste smras pa/ dpyad mdzod cig /'tsho byed kyis bsams pa/ sngar ni bdag gis mkhan pos bstan pas 0las byas kyis 0da ni rang gi blos las 8bya'o snyam nas/ des mi de la bsgo ba/ kye nang rje song la lo ma'i spyil po 0byos te 0ras sngon pos g.yogs la de'i 'og tu rnga zhig zhog 8ste sa tho)yang dron por ①gyis shig /des ji skad bstan pa bzhin du methams cad byas so/ /de nas 'tsho byed kyis mi de sa la bsnyal nas sa de chus chag chag btab nas de nas ( )rnga brdungs pa dang srin gyi ⑫med kyis dbyar gyi dus la bab bo snyam nas phyir byung ngo / /de nas 'tsho byed kyis ④rna ba'i drung du sha'i dum bu cig bzhag pa dang / de yang slar zhugs te phrug ( nyegu rnams khrid de byung nas phrug nu)gu rnams dang lhan cig sha'i dum bu la chags pa dang / de nas 'tsho byed kyis de'i mod la sha'i dum bu bor ba dang mi 3—153

de sos par gyur to/ des kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya byin pa dang des 'jigs med kyi ma la byin no/ /de rim gyis rgyal po'i khab tu phyin pa dang / rgyal po gzugs can snying pos 'tsho byed ji ltar 'ongs pa thos nas/ des gzhon nu ma skyes dgra la bsgo ba/ bu khyod kyi phu bo bya'ongs kyis bsur song ②shig /de bsur ⑧song ba dang 'tsho byed kyis gzhon nu ma skyes dgra ji ltar bsur du'ong ba thos nas des bsams pa/ gal te bdag gis des bsu ba rang ⑤gir byas pa rjoni nam rgyal por gyur pa de'i tshe bdag la gnod pa ⑦byed par 'gyur ro snyam nas/de slar log ste sgo gzhan zhig nas zhugs so/ /dus gzhan zhig na 'tsho byed skye bo'i tshogs chen pos yongs su bskor te sems g.yeng gzhing song ba dang ⑨/ ji tsam na bram ze zhig mig nad kyis thebs nas 'tsho byed kyi ⑩drung du song ste bdag la sman ston cig /tshig pa zos nas smras pa/ thal bas thob cig /de ⑪drang po zhig pas thal bas btab pa dang sos par gyur to/ /mig nad kyis thebs pa gzhan zhig yod pa de yang 'tsho byed kyi drung du song ba de 'bram ze des mthong nas dris pa/ kye nang rje gang du 'gro0/ des 8ji ltar gyur pa smras pa dang des smras pabya/ khyod la 'tsho byed ci dgos/ des 'kho bo la gang bstan pa de byos shig /de yid ches par gyur nas des thal bas 0btab pa dang long bar gyur to/ /dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po gzugs can 8snying po'i spyi bor phol mig byung ngo / /des blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag sman pa rnams khug shig /blon po rnams kyis sman pa rnams bkug ⑥pa dang / rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag nga'i spyi bor phol mig byung gis tshudapyad byos shig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha sman pa chen po 'tsho byed mchis na bdag cag gis ⑥3—154

bgyi ba ①ci 'tshal/ rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'tsho byed khug shig /de rnams kyis ②bkug ③pa dang / rgyal pos smras 0pa/ 'tsho byed dpyad byos shig /'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ lha dam zhig bca' ste/ gal te lha la bdag nyid kyis khrus bgyid du gnang na bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gyis shig⑤ /de nas 'tsho byed kyis skyu ru ras bskus shing dusmin par 'gyur ba'i gardzas dag btab nas dusmin par 'gyur ba'i rdzas rnams dang bsres ⑨pa'i chu bum pa lnga brgya blugs pa dang ⑩/ gang gi tshe smin ⑩pa de'i tshe na ma tshor bar 8spu gris reg par byas pa dang rdol to/ /de nas 'tsho bar 'gyur ba'i rdzas dag btab ste 0'tsho bar 'gyur ba'i rdzas rnams dang bsres pa'i chu bum pa lnga brgya blugs pa dang /rma de sos shing pags ④pa dang 8'dra ba dang skra yang mnyam par gyur to/ /rgyal pos 0khrus byas ma thag tu smras pa/ 'tsho byed dpyad byos shig /des smras pa/lha re zhig bshos gsol cig /rgyal pos zan zos nas 'tsho byed dpyad byos shig lha bgyis lags so/ /de yid ma ches nas lag pas byugs na phyogs gang na rma yod par ⑩ma shes so/ /me long 8blangs te bltas na 'on kyang ma mthong ngo / /btsun mo la dris na des kyang phyogs gang na rma yod par ma shes sotso/ /rgyal po mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes nas blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'tsho byed sman pa'i rgyal por dbang skur 0cig /mi long ba des smras pa/ lha ci sras la byams pas sam/ 'on te sman mkhas pas dbang bskur bar (tremadzad/rgyal pos smras pa/ sman mkhas pas so/ /des smras pa/ gal te dude lta lags na ()'dis bdag ni sos par ma bgyis 0so/ /'tsho byed kyis smras pa/kye nang rje bdag gis khyod mthong yang ma mthong na sos par lta ga la byas/ des 3—155

smras pa/ de ni mad na 'on kyang khyod kyis gang la bstan pa des bdag la bstan to / /ci zhig bstan/ che ge mo zhig go/ /'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ de'i khams kyang gzhan la khyod kyi khams kyang gzhan yin gyis①/ da 'di dang 'di dag byos shig dang sos par 'gyur ro/ /des byas nas sos par gyur pa dang smras pa/ lha 'di sman pa'i rgyal por ②dbang bskur ①bar mdzad du gsol/de glang po che la bskyon dunas dpal gyi 'byor pa chen pos sman pa'i rgyal por dbang bskur tsoto/ /rgyal po'i khab na khyim bdag cig yod pa skran dund kyis thebs nas/ sman pa thams cad kyis spangs pa dang / des bsams pa/'tsho byed kyi drung du 'gro'o/ /gal te dpyad cig byas na ni de ⑦lta na lalegs/gal te ma byas na ⑨bdag nyid 'chi bar bya'o snyam nas/ de 'tsho byed kyi drung du song nas 'tsho byed bdag gi dpyad ⑩mdzod cig /des smras pa/ kye nang rje khyod kyi sman 'di ni rnyed par dka'o/ /des bsams pa/ 'tsho byed kyis kyang bdag spangs na ⑩'di la ci byar yod/ dus la bab kyis 8bdag ni 'chi'o snyam nas de dur khrod du song ngo / /de na ro sreg 8pa'i me 'bar bar ne'u le gdug pa zhig dang srog chags go dhā 8tsan dan zhes bya ba 'thabs te 0lhung ba dang de bkres pas nyen pas de gnyis ka 0zos te/ lhas dur khrod du char phab pa'i 'od pa'i 0chu de la phye'athungs nas dur khrod dang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig na gnag lhas yod pa der song ste/ ko dra'i chan dang mar phyung ba'i zho 'thungs pas skran rdol te ⑥yar slon mar 'khrus nas dusngon 0ji lta ba bzhin du gyur to/ /dus gzhan zhig na lus 'phags mo'i mdoms ⑤kyi phyogs su phol mig byung ngo / /des rgyal po la smras pa dang rgyal pos 'tsho byed la bsgo ba/ ma yar mo'i dpyad 3—156

byos ①shig /des khas blangs so/ /de nas zan byas te ma ma la byin nas khyod kyis 'di'i steng ②du 'dug tu chug cig /des de 'dug tu bcug pa'i zan 'tsho ①byed kyis mthong nas bsams pa/ phyogs che ge mo zhig na'o snyam mo/ /de nas smin 0par 'gyur ba'i rdzas dag btab ste/ smin par shes nas zan gyi nang du gtsags ⑤du sbas te ma ma la bsgo ba/ khyod kyis de 'di la 'dug tu chug la btsun mo 'dug nas slar slong shig /des de bzhin byas pa las gtsags ༷bus reg ma thag tu sol mig rdol bar gyur to/ /de nas 'tsho bar 'gyur ba'i rdzas dang bsres ⑦pa bska ⑧ba'i chus bkrus te 'tsho bar ⑨'gyur ba'i rdzas rnams btab pas sos par gyur to/ /'tsho byed rgyal po'i drung du song ba dang rgyal pos smras pa/ 'tsho byed khyod tho) kyis ma yar mo'i dpyad byas sam/lha bgyis so/ /khyod kyis sgren 4)mor phud de 4)ma bltas 0grang / lha ma bltas so/ /ji ltar byas/ des ji ltar gyur pa rnams smras pa dang rgyal po mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes nas/ des blon po rnams la smras pa/ 'tsho byed la ⑫lan gnyis su sman pa'i rgyal por dbang skur 8cig /mi skran can la 'tsho byed kyis sman rnyed par dka'o zhes smras pa gang yin pa des smras pa/ lha ci sras la sdug pas sam/ 'on te sman mkhas pas dbang bskur ⑩bar mdzad/ rgyal pos smras pa/ sman mkhas pas so/ /gal te de lta lags na 'dis bdag ni sos par ma bgyis so/ /'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ kye nang rje ngas khyod la dpyad ni ma byas kyi/ 'on kyang ngas khyod kyi sman ni rnyed par dka'o zhes smras so0/ /des smras pa/ bdag gi sman ji lta bu dag tunyeyin/ 'tsho byed kyis smras pa/gal te zla ba mar gyi ngo yitshes bcu bzhi la mi ser skya zhig shi nas de dur khrod du 3—157

sreg pa na ne'u le gdug pa dang srog chags go dhā tsan dan 'thabs ①nas mer lhung ba dang de gnyis khyod kyis zos la/ dbang phyug chen po'i lhas dur khrod du char phab ②pa'i 'od pa'i chu de la 'thungs la/ ko dra'i chan zos shing mar phyung ba'i zho 'thungs na de lta na khyod ②sos par 'gyur te/ bdag gis de las rjobasams nas sman rnyed par dka'o zhes smras pa yin no/ /des smras pa/ shin tu legs par shes te/ de bzhin du bdag gis zos so/ /de nas dga' bar gyur ⑤nas smras pa/ lha 'dis sman pa'i rgyal po'i ༷rngo thog gi ⑦ dbang bskur bas ⑧dbang bskur du gsol/ lan gnyis su yang sman pa'i rgyal por dbang bskur to/ /gang gi tshe mi dge ba'i grogs po lhas byin gyis ma skyes dgra bslus ⑨nas pha chos kyi rgyal po chos dang ldan pa srog dang phral ba de'i tshe de la skran gyi nad kyis thebs par gyur to/ /des sman pa rnams la smras pa/ nga kyil dpyad gyis shig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha lha'i gcen sman pa'i rgyal yipo bla na med pa 8'tsho byed 'di na mchis bzhin du bdag cag gis dpyad bgyid rngo ga la thogatso /des blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'tsho byed khug shig/de rnams kyis bkug pa dang / 'tsho byed nga la skran rdzind byung gis byadapyad byos shig /lha bgyi'o/ /des bsams pa/ rgyu gnyis ⑩kyis skran rdol bar 'gyur te/ lhag par dga' ba'am/ lhag par khros pas yin na sems can sdig pa byed pa ⑩'di lhag par dga' bar ga la 'gyur gyis8/ rnam pa tsothams cad du khros par bya'o snyam du bsams nas smras pa/ lha dam zhig bca' ste/gal te gzhon nu 'char byed bzang po'i sha gsol ba lta 6) na dpyad bgyi'o/ /rgyal pos thos nas khros te smras pa/ legs so ngas ni pha srog dang phral/ khyod 3—158

kyis kyang 'char byed bzang po srog dang phrol/ nga yang rang nyid nad kyis shi nas khyod ni rgyal ①por 'gyur mod des smras pa/ lha dpyad ni 'di lags te/gzhan gyis sos par rngo mi thog lags sol/ /bdag dang 'dra ba'i phangs pa med pas des khas blangs so/ /de ②nas 'tsho byed kyis gzhon nu 'char byed bzang po rgyan thams ducad kyis brgyan dunas rgyal po la phul te0/ lha gzhon nu 'char byed bzang po la legs par gzigs pa de ltar mdzad du gsol/phyis gzigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas des ⑦bstan nas khyim du khrid nas bzhag go/ /de nas 'tsho byed sha'i don du bsil ⑧ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du song ba las bsil khyaba'i tshal gyi dur khrod ni shi ba'i ros stong pa ma yin pas de nas ⑩ro'i sha blangs te yo byad kyi khyad par dag dang g.yos byas nas rgyal po'i yidro la bab pa'i dus su bstabs so/ /de nas rgyal po ma skyes dgras sha khu'i phor ba blangs nas za bar gzas 8pa dang 'tsho byed kyis phrogs tsonas klad du bsnun te sdig pa byed pa khyod kyis pha chos dang ldan pa 8chos kyi rgyal po srog dang phral la ⑫bu'i sha yang za bar byed dam/ des tshurngams nas smras pa/ gal te de lta na ci'i phyir gsad ⑩ces mi bzod pa skyes pas 8de'i skran rdol nas yar slon mar 'khrus yite/ kha nas khrag dang bcas par byung ba de mthong nas brgyal te sa la 'gyel to/ /de nas chu gtor ⑥ nas dbugs slar byung ba dang khrus byas te 'phrod pa'i zas byin pas sngon gyi ji lta ba bzhin 0gyur to/ /de nas 'tsho byed kyis gzhon nu 'char byed bzang po rgyan thams cad kyis dubargyan nas dukhrid de rgyal po'i drung du song nas rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te smras pa/ lha gzhon nu 'char byed bzang po 'di lags te/ bdag srog chags grog spur yang srog dang 3—159

'bral bar bgyid mi phod na ①gzhon nu lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ 'on kyang thabs 'dis lha 'tsho bar 'gyur bas bdag gis thabs bshams ②par bgyis par bas ①so/ /rgyal po mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes nas des blon po rnams la bsgo ba / 'tsho byed sman pa'i rgyal por dbang skur 0cig /blon po rnams kyis glang po che la bskyon nas dpal gyi 'byor pa chen pos lan gsum du yang sman pa'i rgyal por dbang bskur bas dbang bskur to/ / de nas ⑤'tsho byed dregs pa skyes nas 0bdag dang mnyam pa'i sman pa ⑦'ga' yang yod pa ma yin te/ bdag ni lus kyi dpyad byed pa rnams kyi ⑧mchog yin la/ bcom ldan 'das ni sems kyi dpyad mdzad pa rnams kyi mchog yin no snyam mo/ /des dus gzhan zhig na bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan 0sngar song ba las de dregs ⑩pa'i snyems pas bden pa rnams ma mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed na ci'i phyir bden pa rnams ma mthong bar gyur snyam na/ dregs 0pa'i snyems 8pa las gyur par gzigs nas de'i dregs 0pa spang bar bya'o snyam nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed la bka' stsal pa/ 'tsho byed khyod kyis ri'i rgyal po gangs can mthong ngam/ btsun pa ma mthong lags so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i na bza' chos gos kyi ④mtha' nas zung ⑩shig /des bzung ba dang de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed khrid nas ri'i rgyal po (9gangs can gang na 0ba der gshegs pa dang de na sman rnam pa sna tshogs sgron ma phyebazhin 'bar ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'tsho byed sman ji tsam 'dod pa long yishig /bcom ldan 3—160

'das 'jigs lags so/ /de nas ①bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje song la 'tsho byed la bsrung ②ba byos shig/de dang song nas ②sman rnam pa sna tshogs dag blangs nasaX/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'tsho byed sman 'di'i duming ci yin/ des gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das che ge mo lags te/ cho ga 'dis nad che ge mo zhig zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ni che ge mo zhig lags te nad che ge mo zhig rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan rnams kyi ni ming yang mi shes so/ /ma shes pa gang ༷yin pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'tsho byed 'di ni che ge mo ste ⑦cho ga che ge mos nad che ge mo zhig rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /'di yang che ge mo zhig ces nibya'o/ /'tsho byed kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sman ⑨dpyad kyang mkhyen pa lta/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed la bka' stsal pa/ 'tsho byed sman pa zug rngu 'byin pa yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa ni rgyal po la 'os pa/ rgyal po la mkho ba/ rgyal po'i yan lag gi grangs su 'gro'o// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po drug bcu gnyis pa/ bzhi gang dag ⑫ ce (nyen/'di la sman pa zug rngu 'byin pa nad la mkhas pa yin/ nad kun nas slong ba la mkhas pa yin/ nad byung ba spong 8ba la mkhas pa yin/ spangs pa phyis mi 'byung ba la mkhas pa yin te/ nad la mkhas pa ji lta bu zhe na/ 'di la sman pa 0zug rngu 'byin pa nad shes shing nad 'di ni 'di lta bu dang 'di lta bu yin no zhes de ltar nad la mkhas pa yin no/ /nad kun nas 8slong ba la mkhas pa ji lta bu zhe na/ 'di la 0sman pa zug rngu 'byin pa nad shes shing nad tso'adi ni ⑫3—161

rlung gis kun nas bslang ba'am/ mkhris ①pas kun nas bslang ba'am/bad kun gyis kun nas bslang ba'am/ bdag las gyur pa'am/ gzhan las gyur pa'am/ 'dus pa las gyur pa'o zhes de ltar nad kun nas slong ba la mkhas pa yin no/ /nad byung ba spong ba la mkhas pa ji lta bu zhe na/ 'di la sman pa zug rngu 'byin pa nad shes shing ②nad 'di ni mig sman nam/ sku ③mnye'am/ skyug 0sman nam/ bkru sman nam/ snar blugs 0pa'am/ du bas bdug pa'am/ nan rtsi'i las kyis spang rjobar 'gyur ro zhes de ltar nad byung ba spong ba la ⑦mkhas pa yin no/ /nad nispangs pa ①phyis mi 'byung ba la mkhas pa ji lta bu zhe na/ 'di la sman pa zug rngu 'byin pa nad shes shing nad 'di ni 'phrod pa'i cho ga 'di lta bu dang 'di lta bu dag byas te spangs na phyis mi 'byung ngo zhes de ltar nad spangs pa 0phyis mi 'byung ba la mkhas pa yin te/ de ltar na 0sman pa zug rngu 'byin pa yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa rgyal po la 'os pa yin/rgyal po la mkho ⑩ba yin/ rgyal po'i yan lag gi grangs su 'gro ba yin no/ /de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa yang sman pa zug rngu 'byin pa bla na med pa zhes bya'o/ /'tsho byed bzhi gang dag ce tson/ 'di la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni 'di ni sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'o zhes 0yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu byamakhyen toskye/ /'di ni sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni sdug bsngal 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa'o zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to/ /'tsho byed sman pa zug rngu 'byin pas ni 3—162

skye ba'i rtsa ba can gyi sdug bsngal ①rnams spang ②ba'i sman mi shes so/ /rga ba dang /na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang /sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug ③pa'i rtsa ba can gyi sdug bsngal rnams spang duba'i sman mi shes so/ /'tsho byed de bzhin gshegs pas ni ⑤skye ba'i rtsa ba can gyi sdug bsngal rnams spang ba'i 0sman mkhyen to/ /rga ba dang /na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang /sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug ⑦pa'i rtsa ba can gyi sdug bsngal rnams spang ⑧ba'i sman mkhyen to/ /de lta bas na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni sman pa zug rngu ⑨'byin pa bla na med pa zhes bya'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na 'tsho byed gzhon nus bskyed chos rnams la yichos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba skyes so/ /de nas 'tsho byed gzhon nus bskyed kyis chos mthong ba dang / chos thob pa dang /chos rig pa dang / chos kyi gting slebs ⑩pa dang / som nyi las rgal rlub dang / the tshom las rgal spre)ba dang / gzhan 0gyi dring mi 'jog pa dang /gzhan gyis mi bkri ba dang / ston pas bstan pa'i chos rnams la mi 'jigs pa thob nas stan las tsolangs nas 0bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ⑩ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa 8bdag ni 'phags so/ /mngon par 'phags so/ /yibacom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi dun/ bdag ⑥dge bsnyen du gzung 'du gsol/ deng slan 6)chad ji srid 'tsho ba'i (stebar du srog dang bsdos 0te skyabs su mchi bar 3—163

mngon par ①dad lags so/ /de nas sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi ①zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /ri'i rgyal po gangs can kha bas yog ③ste rtag tu rjolhags pa che bas bcom ldan 'das grang nad kyi snyan gyis thebs 0pa dang sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed kyis bsams pa/ dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po la bya ba bzhin bdag nyid kho nas bcom ldan 'das la rim gro bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas 'tsho byed kyis me tog utpa la sum bcu rtsa gnyis rjodang bkru ⑦sman gyi rdzas dang dusbyar nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phul te/ bcom ldan 'das 'di rnams shangs kyis bsnam du gsol①/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bsnams ⑩pa las thang sum bcu rtsa yiganyis kho na 'khrus par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci tho)ga 4)legs par 'khrus 4)lags sam/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'tsho byed skyon gang dag g.yos la ma 'khrus pa de dag kyang yodabya/ 'khrus la ma g.yos pa yang ⑩yod⑩/ 'khrus la g.yos pa yang yod/8 ma 'khrus la ma g.yos pa yang yod do/ /'tsho byed kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te de lta na bu ram dang a ru ra gsol la khu ba'i rim pa yang mdzod cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin du mdzad nas snyun 4)gdangs par gyur to/ /'tsho byed kyi kun tu spyod pa ni rgyal po'am/blon po gang sum̐ )su'i dpyad byas kyang rung ste/ des de la grong ngam/ grong mchog sbyin par byed pa yin no/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na 'tsho byed kyis ⑥lus 'phags kyi rgyal po la 'dapyad byas pa las des de la brgya stong ri ba'i gos be'u ras yug po che zhig byin pa dang / des de blangs nas bcom ldan 'das 3—164

gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas 'tsho byed gzhon nus bskyed kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag gi kun tu spyod pa ni rgyal po'am/ blon po gang bu'i dpyad bgyis kyang rung ste/ des bdag la grong ngam/ grong mchog stsal ①ba lags pas bdag gis lus 'phags kyi rgyal po la dpyad bgyis pa dang des bdag la brgya stong ri ba'i ras ②zhig stsal ba 'di bcom ldan 'das la bdag 'bul zhing mchis na/bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs brtse ba ①nye bar bzung ste 'di bzhes su gsol/bcom ldan 'das kyis 'tsho byed gzhon nus bskyed las brgya stong ri ba'i gos be'u ras yug po che bzhes so/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das kyi snam byalogs na bsil yab thogs te bcom ldan 'das la g.yob cing 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo brgya stong ri ba'i gos be'u ras yug po che long ⑤la nga'i ched du gris yidros shig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos blangs te sa phyogs gsal la g.yangs par song nas gzhal bar brtsams pa las chos gos mang du ldang bar dumathong ngo / /de nas des ⑨bcom ldan 'das kyi na bza' chos gos gsum dang bdag nyid kyi bla gos mthang gos dang bcas pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa sgra can zin 0gyi ral chung dpung chad cig byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dbyar gyi gnas der ras lnga brgya brnyes shing dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis kyang du ma zhig rnyed na dge slong rnams kyis ji ltar bsgrub par bya ba tsom shes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis ()gsol pa dang /3—165

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de'i phyir rjes su gnang ste/ dge slong rnams kyis khyim pa'i gos gris dras ①te kha dog ngan par byas pa bcang bar bya'o / /rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i kun tu spyod pa ni dge slong ngam dge slong ma mthong na glang po che rgyalas babs nas rkang pa la phyag byed pa yin no/ /de ②dus gzhan zhig na glang po che la zhon nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te/ phyogs gcig tu 0song ba las/ ji tsam na lam gyi dbus nas 'tsho ba pa ⑤zhig mthong nas de de la gus pa bskyed de glang po che la babs dunas rkang pa gnyis la gtugs ⑦so/ /de na ma dad pa gang yin pa de dag gis bsams pa/ lha ni ⑧dge slong 'ba' zhig la mngon par dad pa ma yin no/ /dad pa can gang yin pa de dag gis bsams pa ni gdon mi za bar lhas dge slong yin snyam ste/ de 0gus pas glang po che las babs nas rkang pa gnyis la gtugs 0so snyam nas de rnams 0yid gnyis su gyur te rgyal po la smras pa/ lha 8su la phyag bgyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos la'o/ /lha de ni bcom ldan 'das kyi 8nyan thos ma lags te/ 'tsho ba pa tshulags so/ /de nas rgyal po gzugs can snying pos 8'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi ⑩don 'di kho na gsol lo snyam nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go⑩/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas ma ga ṅgā'i 8rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag gi kun tu spyod yipa ni dge slong ngam dge slong ma mthong na glang po che la dubabs nas de'i rkang pa la phyag bgyid pa lags pas0/ de ring bdag 3—166

gus pa skyes nas ①glung po che las ②babs te dge slong lags snyam nas 'tsho ba ③pa'i rkang pa la dugatugs lags kyis⑤/ kye ma'o bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs brtse 0ba nye bar bzung ste/ 'phags pa rnams kyi chos gos rnams la mtshan ma cung zad cig rgyagadab tu gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po gzugs can snying po la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas rgyal po gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang ⑧bar rig nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑨zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te song ngo / /de na ⑩bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'tsho ba pa gang gis bden pa mthong ba las ⑩phyag bdag gir 8byas pa ni 8nyams te ma 0rung ngo //de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das kyi snam 8logs na bsil yab thogs te/ bcom ldan 'das la g.yob cing 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis lus 'phags kyi ri bo mthong ngam/ btsun pa ma mthong lags so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i na bza' chos gos kyi mtha' nas zung ⑩shig /des bzung ba dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po'i khab nas mi snang bar mdzad pas ⑩de nyid nas rdzu 'phrul gyis steng gi nam mkha' las tsogashegs nas lus 'phags kyi ri bo la bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe ma ga dma'i yimi rnams kyi zhing mnyam zhing nye 'khor mnyam pa rnang 0gi khyad par sna tshogs dag rnang sgal ⑥gyis 'brel cing mdzes pa dag gzigs nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis phyezhing mnyam zhing nye 'khor mnyam la rnang dugi khyad par sna tshogs pa chadag rnang sgal dugyis 'brel par mdzes pa de dag mthong 3—167

ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo de lta bas na dge slong rnams kyis 'di lta bur chos gos dag ②dras te drub par bya'o/ /gnas brtan kun dga' bos dge slong rnams la smras pa/ khyed kyis 'di lta bur ②chos gos rnams dros la drubs ①shig /dge slong rnams kyis chos gos dag dras te drub par brtsams pa dun snam ⑤du rnams kha phyogs dugacig tu bstan pas mi mdzes nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑦bka' ma 0stsal mod kyi0/ 'di kho nas rkyen byas nas gnang bar 'gyur ba'i gnas 8de yod do snyam nas des snam bu rnams kha phyogs gnyis kur bstan na ⑪'on kyang mtha' skor med pas mdzes par ma gyur nas mtha' skor byas so/ /de nas byas shing zin pa dang bcom ldan 'das la phul lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo legs so legs so/ /ngas gang gi 8phyir bka' stsal pa/ de khyod kyis shes te/ de lta bas na dge slong rnams kyis ⑫'di lta bur chos gos rnams dras la drub par bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis chos gos dras shing drubs pa re re bcangs nas lhag ma ni ma dras so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yul ma ga dma'i 0ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs te/ 'brog gnas su byon nas 'brog 4)gnas na 'brog gnas kyi tshal na bzhugs so/ /'brog gnas 'bab chu dang nye bar ⑩gang zhing rlung ldang bar ⑩gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis thun dang po la mthang gos tsogasol to/ /thun bar pa ⑩la bla gos gsol to/ /thun tha ma la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo nga la snam sbyar gyis g.yogs shig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos lag pa gnyis bkrus nas snam sbyar gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi steng du 3—168

g.yogs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis na bza' chos gos gsum gyis mtshan mo de 'das par mdzad do/ /de nas nam nangs nas ①dgongs pa 'jig rten na shin tu skyid ②pa bde ba ②'dod pa gang yin pa su yang rung ༷de rnams kyi mchog ni nga yin te/ nga yang chos gos dugasum gyis 'tsho bar spyad dun nga'i nyan thos rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos snyam du dgongs nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa⑦ / dge slong dag de lta bas na dge slong rnams kyis dras pa'i chos gos gsum bcang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dras pa'i chos gos gsum bcang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal na⑧/ dge slong zhig la chos gos gsum pa ⑨med nas des 0phying pa zhig rnyed nas des de 0dra bar brtsams so bcom ldan 'das kyang phyogs der gshegs nas smras pa/ dge slong 'di ci yin/btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams kyis dras pa'i chos gos gsum ⑫bcang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal na/ bdag la chos gos gsum pa 0ma mchis nas btsal ba las/ bdag gis phying pa 'di rnyed 8de dras nas chos gos bgyi'o//dge slong 'di ni dra ba'i 'os ma yin no/ /'on kyang lhan thabs kyis glan 8pa'i 'os yin pas lhan thabs kyis glan tsonas bcang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas gshegs 0te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdus nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan 0bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong che ge mo zhes bya ba la chos gos yimed nas 0phying pa la 0'dra bar byed kyisaX/ dge slong dag de lta bas na mi dra ( )ba ni lnga ste/ phying pa thams cad dang / snam bu thams cad dang / be'u ras thams cad dang / seng ras thams cad dang /3—169

klam ①thams cad de/ lhan thabs kyis glan nas bcang bar bya'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /ko ②sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi blon po'i mchog ③ri dgas 'dzin ces bya ba des rigs mnyam ༷pa las chung ma blangs te de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed de/ de rtse bar byed dga' bar byed dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las khye'u zhig btsas so zhes bya ba nas ⑤de bzhin du khye'u bdun btsas te/de la drug gi ming ni ci dga' bar btags so/ /tha chungs dugang yin pa de'i ming ni sa ga zhes bya bar btags so/ /ji tsam na ri dgas 'dzin gyi chung ma shi nas/ des bu drug gi tshukhyim phub pa dang de rnams rang rang gi chung ma rnams dang lhan cig byi dor lhur len cing khyim gyi ⑧'tsho nam mi sems par 'dug go/ /khyim bdag ri dgas 'dzin 'gram pa la lag pa gtad ⑨nas sems khong du 0chud cing 'dug go/ /de'i grogs ⑩bshes bram ze zhig yod pa de bya'ongs nas des de sems khong du 0chud pa mthong nas 0smras pa/ khyim bdag ci'i phyir sems khong du 8chud/ bdag gi tsobu 'di dag rang rang gi chung ma dang lhan cig byi dor lhur len cing 0khyim gyi 'tsho nam mi sems par 'dug pas khyim zhig par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ ci'i phyir sa ga la 'khyim mi dbub yigal te na ⑥yang lhag par phung krol 0byed kyang sus shes/ gal te na du'adi lhag par legs par 0byed kyang sus shes/ gal te khyod dad na bu mo zhig btsal lo de bzhin du gyis shig /de tshol zhing rim gyis yul tsam par phyin to/ /tsam pa na khyim bdag stobs kyi bshes gnyen zhes bya ba yod de'/ de'i bu mo sa ga ma zhes bya ba gzugs bzang ba/ dar la bab pa/ tshul dang dul ba dang ldan pa/3—170

mkhas pa/ g.yer ba zhig yod pa de bu mo yid 'phrog ma gang 'dod pa rnams dang lhan cig tu skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir chas pa dang bram ze de yang phyogs der phyin te/ des bu mo rnams mthong nas des bsams pa①/ 'di rnams kho na la re zhig brtag par bya'o snyam nas de brtag pa lhur len cing dal bus 'jab ②cing de rnams kyi phyi bzhin du dusong ngo / /bud med ni phal cher yang ba'i rang bzhin can 0yin pas de rnams las kha cig ni bang rgyug /kha cig ni mchong bar ⑤byed/ kha cig ni 'greX/ kha cig ni dgodal/ kha cig ni lus sgyur bar byed/ kha cig ni glu len par byedal/ 'di dag dang gzhan yang spyod tshul ngan pa dag byed do/ /dul ba phun sum tshogs pa de ni gom pa dal gyis ⑨de dag dang lhan cig ⑩'gro'o/ /ji tsam na skyed mos tshal du phyin pa dang bu mo de rnams ni 0rdzing gi 'gram du gos rnams bzhag nas mod skyel zhugs te rtse bar brtsams 0so/ /de ni ji tsam ji tsam chur nub pa 8de tsam de tsam du gos dag rje 4)zhing 'jug la/ ji tsam ji tsum ldang ba de tsam (9de tsam du gos dag 'bebs shing ldang ste/ de lta bur spyod lam zhi ba yin no/ /de nas khrus kyi ⑩brtson pa byas nas gnas gcig tu 'dug pa dang / bu mo de rnams ni thog mar rang zas zos nas de'i 'og tu 'khor gyi skye bo la sbyin par rtsom 8mo/ /de ni 'khor gyi skye tsobo la sngar 0byin nas de'i 'og tu rang za bar rtsom mo/ /de nas zos shing 'thungs nas skyed mos tshal gyi bde ba nyams su myong 0bar byas nas dong ngo / /ji tsam na dulam kur duchu rgal bar byed pa na bu mo de rnams ni mchil lham chaphud nas rgal dulo/ /de ni mchil lham dang chabacas pas dong ngo ⑥/ / yang dong ste( nye/ de dag kun dga'i ra bar zhugs pa dang des ni gdugs 3—171

thogs te a mra'i tshal nas ①byung ngo / /gzhan dag gis gdugs rnams bor rol/ /de nas rlung dang char pa ⑧bab nas de'i tshe ①bu mo rnams ༷lha khang du zhugs nas ⑤'dug go/ /de ni bla gab med pa na'oX/ /bram ze de yang de'i rjes bzhin du song ba las des de'i mtshan nyid dang spyod tshul de lta bu mthong nas/ de nas ngo mtshar skyes ⑦te bu mo de la dri bar brtsams pa/ bu mo khyod bu'i stobs kyi ⑧bshes gnyen gyi bu mo'o/ /bu mo khyod la cung zad cig dris ⑨ma khro zhig /des 'dzum pa sngon du btang nas smras pa/ khu gu 'di la khror ci mchis dris shig /bu mo 'di dag thams cad ni rgyug pa dang / mchong ba ⑩dang / 'gre yib dang / lus sgyur bar byed pa dang / glu len par byed cing ⑫'di dag dang gzhan yang spyod tshul ngan pa byed cing 'gro na/ khyod ni tshul dang dul ba phun sum tshogs pas dal bus rgyu zhing de rnams dang lhan cig skyed mos tshal du 'gro bar byed do/ /des smras pa bu mo thams cad ni pha dang mas btsong ⑫ba'i rdzas yin na0/ gal te bdag gis mchongs sam 'gres 8nas rkang pa'am lag pa chag ⑩par gyur na/ bdag la su zhig slong bar 'gyur te/ nges par bdag ji srid 'tsho ba'i ⑩bar du pha dang ma kho na'i gson mar tso'agyur ro/ /bu mo legs te/ de ni khong du chud do/ /gzhan yang 'di dri huste/ bu mo 'di dag ni gos rnams mtha' gcig tu bzhag nas 0gos gcig kyang med par med la zhugs nas rtse bar rtsom 0la/ khyod ni ji tsam ji tsam du duchur nub pa de tsam de tsam du gos rje dubar byed do/ /khu gu bud ⑥med ni ngo tsha shes pa dang khrel yod pa dang ldan par bya dgos pas gal te bdag gi dugos phud pa 'ga' zhig gis mthong na/ mi rigs par 'gyur ro/ /bu mo khyod la de na su zhig lta/3—172

khu gu re zhig khyod kho nas kyang bdag mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /bu mo legs te/de yang khong du chud do/ /gzhan yang 'di dri 6)ste/ bu mo 'di dag ni rang sngar zos nas de'i 'og tu 'khor gyi skye bo la zan sbyin par byed la/ khyod ni 'khor gyi skye bo la sngar zan byin nas de'i 'og tu rang za bar byed do/ /khu gu bdag cag ni bsod nams kyi 'bras bus 'tsho ②bas bdag cag la rtag tu dus ston mchis la/ 'di dag ni tshegs 'byung ba'i 'bras bus ⑧'tsho ba lags④/brgya lam na lan 'ga' rgya chen por ⑤'thob pa'i phyir ro/ /bu mo legs te de yang khong du chud do/ /gzhan yang 'di dri ⑥ste/ 'jig rten thams cad ni skam la mchil lham gyon la khyod ni chu la gyon pa de ci/ khu gu 'jig rten blun mod / chu kho na la mchil lham bgo 'tshal ⑦te/ ci'i slad du zhe na/ thang la ni ②sdong dum dang / tsher ma dang / rdo ba dang / zug rdo dang / nya phyis kyi dum bu dang / srin kog gi dum bu rnams mngon la/ chu la ni de dag mi mngon pas des na 0chu kho na la mchil lham ⑩bgo bar bgyi'i 0thang la ni ma lags so/ /bu mo legs te de yang khong du chud rdo/ /gzhan yang 'di dri 8sto/bu mo de dag ni nyi ma la gdugs thogs na0/ khyod ni kun dga'i tsor ba'i shing gi grib ma la thogs par 8byed na/ 'di la 0rigs pa ci zhig yod/ khu gu 'jig rten blun mod kun dga' ⑩ra ba kho nar gdugs bcang tso'atshal te/ de yici'i slad du zhe na/ kun dga' 0ra ba ni rtag tu spre'u dang 0bya rnams kyis gang bas bya rnams ni gcin rtug 'thor zhing rus pa'i dum bu dag 'thor ()ro /spre'u rnams kyang bshang ba dang gci ba byed cing 'bras bu'i za 'phro dag 'thor bar byed la/ rang bzhin gyis rgod bag can yin pas phan tshun yal ga gzhan 3—173

du 'gro bar byed pa na shing ①dum dag lhung bar byed do/ /bla gab ②ma ③mchis pa la ni de dag ma mchis so/ /brgya dul mchis na yang de res 'ga' zhig 'bab par bas ⑤te/ des na kun dga' ra ba kho nar gdugs bcang bar bgyi'idu/ bla gab ma mchis par ni ma lags so/ /bu mo legs te de yang khong du chud do/ /gzhan yang 'di dri ⑤ste bu mo 'di dag ni rlung dang char pa byung na lha khang ⑧du 'jug na khyod ni bla gab med par 'dug go/ /khu gu bla gab ma mchis pa kho nar gnas par bgyi'i/ lha khang ①du 'jug par ⑩ni ma lags so/ /bu mo 'di la rigs pa ci yod/ /khu gu lha khang stong pa 'di dag ni rtag tu dwa ⑫dang / nal phrug dang / g.yon can rnams kyis mi stong lags te/ gal te bdag zhugs pa'i yan lag dang nying lag dag la 'ga' zhig gis reg na/ de lta na bdag gi pha ma dag la mi snyan par mi 'gyur ram/ nyis na bla gab med par srog dang phral 8ba ni bla'i/ lha khang stong par ni 0mi 'jug go/ /de nas bram ze de de'i spyod tshul gyis rangs shing yid bde ba skyes nas khyim bdag stobs kyi bshes gnyen gyi khyim du zhugs te bu mo thob par 'dod pa'i spro ba dang bcas pas bde legs su gyur cig /bde legs su gyur cig ces smras pa chadang / khyim 'khor gyi skye bos smras pa/ bram ze re zhig bslang ba'i dus ni ma yin na/ ci zhig slong / bu mo slong ngo / /su zhig gi ched du/ mnyan yod na blon po'i mchog ri dgas 'dzin ces bya ba de'i bu sa ga zhes bya ba'i'o/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ de dang 8bdag cag ni rigs mnyam pa yin na0/ 'on kyang yul ha cang yang 0thag ring ches so/ /des smras pa/ ring po kho na la bu mo sbyin par bya'o / /8ci'i phyir zhe na/ nye na re zhig gal te bde bar gyur pa thos yin 3—174

dga' ba skyed par zad/ nye na sdug bsngal bar gyur na sbyin pa dang mchod pa dang / bkur ste ①bya bas dub par 'gyur zhing nor 'ged par ②yang 'gyur ro//de rnams kyis smras pa/ gal te de lta na sbyin no/ /de nas bram ze de ②bde legs su gyur cig ces smras nas song ste rim gyis mnyan ④yod du phyin nas lam gyis dub pa bsal te ①blon po'i mchog ri dgas 'dzin gyi drung du song nas/de nas bu mo'i za ba dang / gnas pa'i spyod tshul dang / gzugs bzang zhing dar la bab pa dang / mdzes pa dang mkhas pa dag ji lta ba rjobazhin du bsnyad nas smras pa/ bdag gi ༷nyon mongs pa chen pos yul dang tshong rdal sna tshogs su brgyus ⑧pas sdug bsngal gyis de rnyed kyis ⑨da ni song la long 0shig /de nas blon po'i mchog ri dgas 'dzin gyis nyi ma dang tshes grangs dang / yud tsam dang rgyu skar dag bstun nas tsam par 'ongs te/ dpal gyi 'byor ba chen pos sa ga'i chung ma blangs so/ /de mi 0yul du 'gro ba'i tshe mas bslabs 8pa0/ bu mo khyod kyis nyi ma dang zla ba gnyis la rtag tu phyag bya/ me ④la bsnyen bkur bya/me long dri ma phyi byabar bya/ gos dkar po bgo bar bya/ blang bar bya'i sbyin par ⑩mi bya/ tshig bsrung ⑩bar bya/ langs nas su la yang stan bstab par mi bya/ zhim po bza' bar bya/ bde bar nyal bar bya/ them skas gzugs par bya'o/ /de nas ri dgas 'dzin gyis thos nas des bsams pa/ bu mo 'di lta ba log par 'dzin du bcug ste/ bdag gis 'di lta ba log pa dang phral la yang dag pa'i lta ba 'dzin du gzhug tsogo snyam du bsams nas de blangs te chas sol/ /de nas de'i ma sdug pas snying dkrugs ⑩shing mig mchi mas gang bas mgul nas 'khyud nas ngu bzhin gyi zhung ros smras pa/ bu mo khyod mthong ba'i tha 3—175

ma ①ni 'di yin no/ /des ②de la shes par bya ba'i phyir smras pa/ yum re zhig khyod 'dir 'khrungs sam/ 'on te nye du'i khyim du bu mo nye du'i khyim du'o/ /khyod kyis ①khang pa de yin nam/ 'on te 'di yin 'di yin no/ /bdag kyang 'dir skyes la der bdag gnas par bsal du'adu ba ⑤mchis na gdon mi za bar mthar du'abral bar 'gyur na/ bshams su ci mchis cang ma gsung 0shig /de nas ri dgas 'dzin ni thang la song ngo / /sa ga ma ⑧ni khyim thab dang /rang gi khyim nas thob pa'i 'khor gyi skye bo dang lhan cig tu grur dong ba las ⑨de na 0rta rgod ma rte'u smad byung nas ring po ma lon pa zhig grur gzhug 0par byas pa dang / rte'u thang la mi dga'o 8snyam nas bsgrims kyang 'jug tu ma btub 0pa dang ku co byung bas (sres ga mas thos nas des smras pa/ ci'i phyir ku co 'di byung de rnams kyis ji ltar gyur pa rnams smras pa dang / sa ga mas smras pa rte'u sngar chug cig dang rang nyid 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /de rnams kyis de bzhin byas pa dang zhugs (nyeso/ /de nas ri dgas 'dzin gyis de rnams la dris pa/ci'i phyir khyed cag ring zhig lon tsonas 'ongs/ rta rgod ma grur mchong du ma btub lags 0so/ /'o na ji ltar mchongs0 tsam pa mos yithabs bshams pa zhig bstan te/ rte'u sngar bcug ⑥pas so/ /tsam pa mo ni mkhas pa yin no//ji tsam na 'gron pa 0rnams lam kur ⑥nub mo 'brang dubatab ste gnas pa las tsori dgas 'dzin gyi mal bya skyibs 0shig tu bcas pa sa ga mas mthong tsonas dris pa/ 'di bu'i mal/ ri dgas 'dzin gyi'o/ /spos shig /ci'i phyir gal te gnyid kyis log pa la bya skyibs steng du rdib na tsogadon mi za bar non pas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ bdag la gang zhig blangs tson gyos po khyim du ma phyin par lam 3—176

kur ①shi ba 'di lta bu'i bu mo bag mar blangs ②zhes ji srid 'tsho ba'i ③bar du dumi snyan pa ⑤'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mal de yang spos pa las gad pa zhig pa dang / skye bo'i tshogs chen pos khyim bdag non to zhes kun dubargyugs ⑦pa dang khyim bdag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag bdag 'di na 'dug gis ⑧ma skrag par mal 0rtogs shig⑩ /mal spos so/ /sus/ sa ga mas so/ /tsam pa mo yini mkhas pa yin no/ /yang skyed mos tshal rnying pa zhig tu nub mo 'brang ⑩btab ste 'khod pa las ri dgas 'dzin gyi mal lha khang stong pa zhig tu bcas pa dang tsos ga mas mthong nas dris pa/ 'di su'i mal/ dpon po'i'o/ /spos shig /ci'i phyir gal te lha khang rdib ste/ des ④non na shi bar 'gyur te/ bdag la zhes tunyebya ba nas mi snyan pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o / /mal de yang spos pa las lha khang zhig pa dang skye bo'i tshogs chen pos brgyugs pa dang zhes bya ba nas tsam pa mo yini mkhas pa yin no zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /ji tsam na rim gyis mnyan yod du phyin nas lam gyis dub pa bsal te mdza' bshes dang / nye du dang gnyen gyi skye bo spras ⑩nas sa ga ma rang gi rigs dang 'tsham pa'i khyim gyi las dag 8byed do/ /ri dgas 'dzin gyi mna' ma drug gis re mo re ⑥mes ⑥ khyim mi'i 0zan sbyor ba las sa ga ma la yang de bzhin du bsgo ste/ khyod kyis du)res kyang zhag bdun pa (nyel sbyor cig /de'i res la bab byatu nye ba dang / gyos phyepo dang / sgyug tsomo dang / khyim bdag rnams kyi dri'i lhag ma gang yin pa de dag ril bur ⑥byas nas nyi ma re re zhing skems tsoso/ /nyi ma re re zhing nod pa'i phye gang yin pa de ⑥las kyang bre kha phri ste bzhag la/ lhag ma mar dang bsres 0pas de dang tshad mnyam par gyur to//3—177

sang lta bu res bab pa ①na chang btung la rag ②par bya ba dang / khyim thab ②dang rang gi me tog gi phreng ba rnying ༷pa gang yin pa de dag bsil bar bzhag nas/ji tsam na nam nangs ⑤pa dang / las byed pa rnams la skyur rjortsi dang / dri dang / me tog dang / zas dang / chang dag byin no/ /de rnams shin tu mgu nas bdag cag ring zhig lon nas khyim bdag gi chung ma rnying pas bzhin bltas so zhes de rnams kyis de'i nyin par las nyis 'gyur du ③byas so/ /ji tsam na ri dgas 'dzin gyis duphyi dro'i dus su las kyi mtha' la bltas pa na las mang du zin pa ⑨mthong nas des dris pa/ ci khyed cag gis gla ⑩mi gzhan dag cig bkug gam/ sus kyang ma bkug go/ /gang gis na las nyis yi'agyur du byas pa 'di la rgyu ci zhig yod/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ dpon po zas ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i las bgyid do/ /de ji 0lta bu yin/ de rnams kyis ji ltar gyur pa rgya cher smras pa dang / ri dgas 'dzin gyi bu rnams kyis rang rang gi chung ma la smras pa las de rnams kyis smras pa/ sa ga mas ji ltar bgyis ⑩pa rkyibazhin du gal te bdag cag gis kyang khyim nas brkus khrul gla ⑩mi rnams dga' bar bgyis pa dang / bdag la yang jo ⑩bo dang khyed 8gla mi rnams dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas ri dgas 'dzin gyis sa ga ma la dris pa/ bu mo khyod kyis kha zas rnams ji ltar bshams/ des rgyas par smras pa dang ri dgas 'dzin mgu nas des de kho na khyim gyi bya ba rnams byed du bcug ste/ nang mi thams cad la smras pa/ khyed cag las gang zhig yis ga mas byin pas mgu ba ni des gnas par bgyis dul de dang rjes su mthun par yang gyis ⑥shig /ji tsam na de dukhyim gyi phyedapon mor gyur nas spyod tshul dang / gnas pa dang / des 3—178

pas ①nang mi thams cad dga' bar gyur to/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na sa ga ma'i khyim steng nas ngang pa rnams kyis byang gi sgra mi snyan ②gyi gling nas ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sā lu dag khyer nas dong ba las rgyal po'i khab na 'dug pa'i ngang pa des ③de dag mthong nas skad phyung 0ba dang de rnams kyis kyang skye gnas mthun pa'i gcugs ⑤pas mnags dum thub ste skad phyung ba dang rgyal po'i khab kyi khang thog tu 'bras kyi snye ma rnams ①lhung bar gyur to⑤/ /de nas rgyal pos blon po rnams la re re byin pa dang ri dgas 'dzin gyis rang gi skal ba sa ga ma ⑨la byin no/ /des za ma tog gi nang du bcug ste zhing pa rnams la bsgo ba dang /de rnams kyang snyen tu mgu ste/ de rnams kyis zhing chung ngu zhig legs par bstan nas dus ⑩shes par byas 0te btab pa las ⑩lhas dus bzhin du char phab pas sa bon dang mthun par phun sum tshogs par skyes so/ / phyi de lo la ni rab tu mang por skyes par gyur to/ /0yang phyi de lo la ni de bas kyang mang por gyur te(ste/ de bzhin du ji tsam na bang ba thams cad ngang pas khyer 0te 'ongs pa'i tso'abras sā lus gang bar gyur to/ /ji tsam na ko sa la'i ⑩rgyal po gsal rgyal nad kyis thebs nas des sman pa rnams bkug ste dris pa dang / de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha gal te ngang pas 'tshal phyete mchis pa'i sā lu brnyes yin de la/'jams dubasgral nas gsol cig dang / sos par 'gyur lags so/ /rgyal pos blon po rnams bkug nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed la 0ngang pas khyer te 'ongs pa'i sna lu'i ste ma byin pa de dag khyed kyis cir ⑥byas/ de nas0kha cig gis smras pa/ lha bdag cag gis ni lha khang du phul lo/ /gzhan dag gis smras pa/ bdag cag gis me'i nang du stsal tsoto/ /gzhan dag gis smras 3—179

pa / bdag ①gis sgo khang ⑤du btags so/ /ri dgas 'dzin gyis smras pa/lha bdag gis sa ga ma la stsal na re zhig des cir bgyis rma bar 'tshal lo/ /des sa ga ma la dris pa dang / des smras pa/ jo bo ci ngang pas 'tshal te mchis pa'i sā lu 'tshal ba zhig mchis samani/ rgyal po snyun gyis thebs pa la sman pa rnams kyis dungang pas khyer te 'ongs pa'i sā lu bstan to/ /de nas sa ga mas gser snod kyi nang du ngang pas khyer te 'ongs pa'i 'bras kyis bkang ⑤nas rgyal po la bskur dub las rgyal pos zos nas sos par gyur to/ /dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po la ljongs kyi mi rnams kyis rta rmurgod ⑧ma smad gnyis shig phul ba las de la ma ni gang yin/ rte'u ni ⑨gang yin pa 'gas 0kyang ma shes nas rgyal pos blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag legs par rtogs la nga la gsol cig /blon po rnams kyis nyin thog 0thag tu dpyad na dub ste gtan la ma phebs so/ /ri dgas 'dzin tsophyi dro khyim du song ba dang sa ga mas rkang pa gnyis la gtugs tsunyenas smras pa/ jo bo ji thosteste de ring ring zhig lon nas gshegs/des ji ltar gyur pa rnams rgyas par smras pa dang sa ga mas smras pa/ jo bo 'di la dpyad du ci zhig mchis/ de gnyis chas mnyam par stsal dang bu gang lags pa de 8ni myur du 'tshal nas ma'i skal ba la 'tshal lo/ /ma gang lags pa de ni mi 'tshal bar mgo ste ga ge mchis te/ rtags ni de lags so/ /ri dgas 'dzin gyis blon po rnams la smras nas de rnams kyis kyang ji skad bstan pa bzhin brtags nas ⑩de nas nam nangs ⑩pa dang rgyal po la smras pa/ lha 'di ni ma lags so/ /'di ni bu lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ khyed cag gis ji ltar shes/ lha 'di lta bu dang 'di lta bu lags 8so/ /khar rtsang yici ste ma shes/3—180

lha bdag cag gis 'tshal bar rngo ga la thog① /sa ga mas de skad bstan lags ②med/ rgyal pos smras pa/ tsam pa mo ③ni mkhas pa yin no/ /mi zhig chu 'gram du lham 0bzhag nas khrus byed pa dang / mi gzhan zhig 'ongs nas des lham des dumago la dkris dunas de nyid na ༷khrus bya bar btsams ⑧so mi de khrus byas nas langs nas lham ⑨de ma mthong ngo / /mi des smras pa/ kye nang rje ci 0tshol lham 0mo/ /khyod kyi lham tsog la yod/ gal te khyod la lham ⑫yod par gyur na/ ji ltar ngas mgo la dkris tsonas zhugs pa de bzhin du khyod kyis kyang lham 8gyis mgo la dkris tsonas zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/'o ni 0nyid kho bo'i lham tsoyin no/ /de gnyis khyod kyi yinga'i zhes rtsod () par gyur nas/ de gnyis rgyal po'i drung du song ngo / /rgyal pos blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag legs par rtogs la gang gi yin pa de la byin cig /de rnams kyis brtag par brtsams yinas gcig la dris pa dang / des smras pa/bdag gi lags so/ /cig shos la yang dris pa dang / des ⑤smras pa/ bdag gi dulags so/ /zhes khyod kyi chadang nga'i zhes pa la nyi ma 'das te blon po rnams dub nas dgongs 0ka gtan phyal ma phebs pa 0bzhin du khyim du dong dungo / /sa ga mas ri dgas 'dzin gyi zhes bya ba nas dris te zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ des ji ltar gyur pa rnams smras pa dang / sa ga mas smras pa/jo bo 'di la dpyad du ci zhig mchis/ de gnyis la gcig kyang phyed khyer cig /cig shos kyang phyed khyer cig ces gsung 0shig dang / gang gi lags 0pa de'i mchid sgronas ni 6ci'i phyir bdag gi lham dral zhes dumachi'o/ /gang cham lags pa de'i glo ba ⑥ni re zhig bdag gis phyed thob na yang der zad 'dir bdag la ci 3—181

zhig 'ged ⑨snyam ste de ltar brtag par bgyi'o/ /ri dgas 'dzin song nas blon po rnams la smras nas zhes bya ba nas rgyal pos smras pa/ tsam pa mo ②ni mkhas pa yin no zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /rgyal po la tshong pa gru bas tsandan gyi sdong dum zhig skyes su phul ba dang / de'i mgo gang yin mjug ②gang yin pa ④ma shes nas rgyal pos blon po rnams la bsgo ba ji lta bu yin rtogs shig /de rnams kyis ༷nyin thog thag dpyad na ma 0shes nas dgongs 0ka khyim du dong ngo / /sa ga mas zhes bya ba nas ri dgas 'dzin gyis dris pa zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /des ji ltar gyur pa rnams rgya cher smras pa dang /sa ga mas smras pa/ jo bo 'di la dpyad du ci mchis chab tu 'or cig dang rtsa ba gang yin ⑧pa de ①ni 'bying bar ⑩'gyur ro/ /thor to yigang lags pa ⑩ni steng du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de la brtag 8pa ni de lags so/ ci /ri dgas 'dzin gyis blon po rnams la smras nas zhes bya ba nas rgyal pos smras pa/ tsam pa mo ⑫ni mkhas pa yin no zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /ri thor tshun khyim bdag cig yod pa des ⑩de dang 0rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs pa las de la 'bu pho yang med/ bu mo yang medayi/ de bu mngon par 'dod pas chun shyim zhig blangs pa dang / de la 0chung ma chen mo 0shos rang bzhin gyis duphrag dog can zhig pas de'i mngal ma rung bar bya ba'i sbyor ba zhig byas pa las de'i mngal shin tu rnam par dag pas ④sems can dang ldan par gyur nas ji tsam na ⑥zla ba dgu 'das pa dang / khye'u zhig btsas so/ /des bsams pa/ sha khon rnams la ni 'di lta ste/ chen chun 'di tha chad yin pas gdon mi za bar ma yar mos thabs cigang yang ⑦rung ba zhig gis gsod ②par 'gyur na/ bdag 3—182

gi lakhyim thab bamal/ bdag gis ③ci byar yod/ bdag gis nam du ni srung ye de kho na la sbyin par bya'o snyam nas de dang khyim thab lhan cig gros byas te rung nas chen ma shos la smras pa/ che zhe bdag gi ༷bu 'di khyod la byin gyis ⑤gsos shig /des bsams pa khyim 0ni gang la bu yod pa de kho na'i yin par zad ⑦pas khyim gyi bdag mor gyur pas gso'o lasnyam nas/ des de gsos ⑨pa las de'i pha yang shi bar gyur tormya/ /de gnyis khyim gyi phyir rtsod yipar gyur nas gcig gis smras pa/ 'di kho mo'i bu yin no/ /cig shos kyis smras pa/ 'di ni 8kho mo'i bu yin no/ /rgyal po'i drung du song ba dang / rgyal pos blon po rnams la bsgo ba shes ldan dag deng 0la gang yin pa rtogs shig /de rnams kyis dpyad pa las nyi ma 'das kyang gtan rkyil ma phebs nas/ dgongs 8ka khyim du dong ba dang / sa ga mas 0ri dgas 'dzin la dris te zhes bya ba nas 'di la dpyad du ci mchis zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ de gnyis la kho bo cag gis cigang gi bu yin pa mi shes kyis8/ khyed cag yiganyis las gang stobs che ba de khyer la song 0shig ces gsung 0shig dang / lag pa gnyis nas bzung nas 0'dren par bgyid de/ de sdug bsngal gyis ngu bar gyur pa dang de'i ma gang lags pa de ni brtse ba ()mchis pas 'di gson yin nam zhig na tsomathong bar 'gyur grang snyam nas gtong chabar bgyid do/ /cig shos ⑥ni brtse ba ma mchis pas gang gi tshe mi gtong ba de'i tshe ⑥de la lcag gis gzhus ⑥shig dang ji ltar gyur pa smra bar 'gyur te/ 'di la brtag ⑥pa ni 'di lags so/ /ri dgas 'dzin gyis blon po rnams la smras pa dang zhes bya ba nas rgyal pos smras pa/tsam pa mo (nyeni mkhas pa yin no zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dus 3—183

gzhan zhig na ri dgas 'dzin nad kyis thebs nas de la sman pas nyi ma gcig sman byin pa las theg gi bar gyur to/ /phyi de nyin par sman ma yin pa byin pas nad la bab par ①gyur to/ /sa ga mas bsams pa/ jo bo ji'i ②slad du nyin gcig ni theg gi bar gyur la/ nyin gcig ni na bar ①gyur ④snyam nas des sman gang dag gis theg gi bar gyur pa'i rtags de dag bzung nas/ de nas des ༷sman pa rnams sgo nas slar bzlog dunas rang nyid kyis dpyad ⑦pa las sos par gyur to/ /ri dgas 'dzin gyis bsams pa/ gang gis na bdag nyin gcig ni theg gi 0nyin gcig ni na ba las ⑨gang gi 0tshe sman pa mi 'ong ba ⑪de'i 'theg gi ba 'di la rgyu ci 0zhig yod snyam ste/ des sa ga ma la dris pa zhes bya ba nas tsam pa mo ④ni mkhas pa yin no zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi glang po che'i bla dpal skyed ces bya ba de la dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po gshe bar gyur to/ /zhes sa ga mas thos nas des tsori dgas 'dzin tsol smras pa/ jo bo blon po thams cad la mthar gyis bka' bab ⑩par 'gyur gyisatso/ dpal skyed la lha bzod pa mdzad du stsal ba'i rigs so/ /des smras pa/ bu mo bzod pa byed du gzhug yigo/ /de nas ⑥des rgyal po la smras pa/ lha dpal skyed ni lha la glo ba nye ba lags na de la bzod pa mdzad du gsol/ rgyal pos smras pa/ bzod par bya'o/ /lha gal te bzod par mdzad na ⑥de'i dbang thang de dag stsal 0du gsol/ de bzhin du sbyin no/ /dpal skyed kyis ji ltar sa ga mas bdag la rgyal po bzod pa byed du bcug pa shes nas de dude la lan glan pa'i bsam pas gnas so/ /dus gzhan zhig na ri dgas 'dzin pho mtshan la nad byung ste/ de'i rim gro ⑤sa ga ma byabyed pa las de 3—184

'dzem ①par gyur to/ /des smras pa/ jo bo 'di la 'dzem ②du ci mchis/ci ②pha'i rim gro ༷bu 0mo dumi bgyid dam/ 'on kyang de 'dzem ⑦par gyur to/ /des bsams pa 'di bdag rjogis rim gro byar ni 0mi btub pas de'i chung ma zhig blang ngo snyam pa tsonas de dpal skyed kyi khyim du song ba dang / des 'ongs pa legs so zhes bya ba'i tshig smras nas stan bstabs 0te 'dug go/ /dpal skyed la bu mo zhig yod pa de 8des de la smras pa/ bu mo sa ga ma'i 8rkang pa gnyis la zung (nyeshig /sa ga mas smras pa/ bdag gis 'di'i rkang pa la gzung skebar 'gyur ba'i gnas gang lags pa de ni mchis so zhes smras nas yang smras pa/ bkra shis par gyur cig /bkra shis par gyur cig /dpal skyed kyis smras pa/ ci zhig slong / bu mo slong ngo / /su zhig gi ched du/ des smras pa/ gyos po'i ched du'o/ /de cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /dpal skyed kyi chung mas smras pa/ dgog cig na de la ci ste sbyin/ sa ga mas smras pa/mi rnams kyi lang tsho ⑩ni nor yin pas yidapyad du ci yod byin cig /dpal skyed kyis smras pa/ bzang mo bdag cag la sa ga mas phan btags kyis 8byin cig/gal te de 0lta na sbyin par bya'o( )/ /de nas ri dgas 'dzin gyis dpal gyi 'byor ba chen pos bag mar blangs rjonas/ de de'i rim gro byed par gyur te sa ga ma ni de ltar mi byed do/ /ri dgas 'dzin gyis ⑤smras pa/ bu mo bdag la tshig byin cig /des smras pa/ jo bo cung zad nyams par ma gyur tam/ bu mo khyod la mas bslabs dupa gang yin pa de cung zad blangs te mi gnas sam/ jo bo thams cad blangs lags te/ nyi ma dang zla ba gnyis la phyag byos shig ces mchi ba gang lags pa ni mna' byama'i nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu ni gyos sgyug khrulags pas re zhig 3—185

bdag gis phyag bgyis lags so/ /me la bkur ste ①bya'o zhes mchi ba gang lags pa ni bud med kyi khyim thab ni ②me lta bu lags te/ khyim thab la ha cang bsnyen par mi bgyi ②/ ha cang bsring bar duyang mi bgyi ste bdag ni khyim thab la ⑤me lta bur bsnyen bkur 0bgyid do/ /me long phyi ⑦bar bya'o zhes mchi ③ba gang lags pa ni sdum pa ni me long lta bu lags pas rtag tu zhal zhal bgyi zhing phyag dar bgyi ba lags te⑨/ sdum pa de la bdag gdugs ⑩gcig bzhin du byi dor bgyid lags so/ /gos dkar po bgo yibar bya'o zhes mchi ba gang lags pa ni khyim gyi las bgyid pa na gos gzhan dag kho nas so/ /lha mchod pa dang khyim thab kyi drung du mchi ba na 0ni gos dkar po rnams bgo bar bgyi ba ste/ de yang bdag ⑫bgyid lags so/ /blang bar bya'i sbyin par mi bya'o zhes mchi 8ba gang lags pa la ci zhig blang bar bgyi zhe na/ 'jig rten las tshig ngan pa smras pa'o/ /tshig ngan pa ni su la yang smra bar mi bgyi ba ste/ de ⑩yang bdag gis yang dag par blangs 8te gnas lags so/ /tshig bsrung bar bya'o zhes mchi ba gang lags pa ni gsang ba'i tshig mi 'phel bar bgyi ba ste/ bdag la ngag bsdam pa ⑩mchis lags so / /langs nas su la yang stan bstab par mi 8bya'o zhes mchi ba gang lags pa ni de 'di skad ces khyod rigs kyi mna' ⑩ma yin pas khyod gnas dben pa na 'dug par bya'o zhes mchi ba lags te/ bdag dben pa kho na na dumachis lags so//zhim po bza' bar bya'o zhes mchi ba gang lags pa ni shin tu bkres nas bza' bar bgyi ba ste/ bdag ni rtag tu khyim gyi skye bo zas 'tshal ba'i 'og tu 'tshal lo//bde bar nyal bar bya ⑥zhes mchi ba gang lags pa ni mtshan mo khyim gyi dgos pa thams cad bgyis nas snod tsobartul te ci nas kyang 9ldang ⑥mi dgos par khyod 3—186

nyal bar bya'o zhes bgyi ba lags te/ 'di ni legs par bzhag pa'o/ /'di ni nyes par bzhag pa'o zhes bdag de kho na bzhin du bgyid do①/ /them skas bca' bar bya'o zhes mchi ②ba gang lags pa ni 'di skad ces khyod sngon dge ba ③bcu'i las kyi dulam dang ldan pa des lha'i 'gro ba thob nas 'dir mi'i 'jig rten du skyes pa 'di ni las kyis ⑤yin pas 'dir yang khyod kyis sbyin pa dag byinaX/bsod nams dag byas ⑦te sdig pa mi ⑧bya'o/ /'di ni dbyig gi ya ⑨gad mtho ris kyi them skas lta 0bu yin no 0zhes bgyi ba lags te de yang bdag rngo ci thog gis 8bgyid do/ /sa ga ma legs so legs so/ /khyod kyi ma mkhas pa yin na/gang gi 0phyir mas ldem tsopor smras pa rtogs ⑩pas na/ khyod ni lhag par yang tsomakhas pa yin no// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po drug bcu gsum pa/ de nas ri dgas 'dzin 'di snyam du sems te/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na sa ga ma la shyibadag gis ma zhes bod tsodo snyam nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs yiganyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun 0pa mna' byam la ⑫ma zhes bod 0du rung lags sams/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gal te chos lnga dang ldan na ste/ lnga gang zhe na nad g.yog byed pa dang / thab rir bab pa'i chung ma len pa dang / srog gi skyabs byed pa dang / nor srung byab dang / shes rab kyi bgo bsha' byed pa'o// // bar sdom 0la/ nad g.yog dang ni chung ma dang / /srog dang nor ni sbyin pa dang / /shes rab sgrub par 0byed pa dang / /lnga po 'di dag mar 3—187

bshad do/ /de nas ri dgas 'dzin ko sa la'i ①rgyal po gsal rgyal gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / rgyal po gsal rgyal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha bdag ni sa ga ma la ma zhes ②bod ③par 'tshal lo/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ sa ga mas nga la yang rim gro byas pas/ phyi mo la dris la ngas kyang de la sring mo zhes bod rjodo/ /des phyi mo la dris pa dang / des smras pa/ khyod kyis bos kyang rung ma bos kyang rung / de ni khyod kyi sring mo kho na yin no/ /ring du 'phur latshangs sbyin mngag gzhug ma'i bu mo dang 'dus pa las de las bu pho zhig btsas te de'i ming stobs kyi bshes duganyen du btags ⑦pa las de rgyal po mes kyis ②nyes pa 'ga' zhig gi phyir snags pa las tsam par song nas gnas pa de'i bu mo ni 'di yin pas ⑨des na khyod kyi sring mor 'ong ngo / /de nas rgyal pos ⑩glang po che la zhon nas dril sgrogs su 0bcug pa/ sa ga ma 'di ri dgas 'dzin gyi ni ma rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi ni sring mo yin no/ /des sngon gyi kun dga' ra bar gtsug lag khang brtsigs nas 'phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la phul ba dang / de bzhin du gnas brtan rnams kyis kyang mdo sde'i nang du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma sa ga ma'i sngon gyi kun dga' ra ba'i khang bzangs na bzhugs so zhes gdags pa byas so/ /dus gzhan zhig na sa ga ma las 0sgo nga sum bcu rtsa gnyis byung ngo / /zhes ri dgas 'dzin gyis thos nas lag pa 'gram pa la gtad tsonas sems khong du 8chud cing 'dug ste/ yul gyi bzang mo la phung ba ⑩ci 'dra ba ⑩dag byung 8bar gyur snyam nas ri dgas 'dzin gyis dor bar brtsams pa dang / sa ga mas smras pa/ jo bo ma dor bar bcom ldan 'das la zhus shig / de nas yibacom ldan 'das la 3—188

gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ma dor bar gzeb ①sum bcu rtsa gnyis gyis ②la shing bal gyis khong ①ste/ gzeb bu rnams kyi nang du sgo nga re re zhog la sa ga mas dus gsum du lag pas byugs 0shig ces sgo ⑤zhig dang / de nas nyi ma bdun pa lags nas gzhon nu sum bcu rtsa gnyis 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /des de bzhin du byas pa las nyi ma bdun pa lags pa dang / gzhon nu sum bcu rtsa gnyis byung nas bsrings ༷bskyed ⑦de nar son ⑧pa dang rtsal po che thub rlag pa 0sha stag 0tu gyur to/ /dus gzhan zhig na de rnams shing rtar (nyezhugs te phyir byung nas slar 'jug pa dang / mdun na 'don gyi 'bu shing rtar tsozhugs nas phyir 'byung ④ba dang 'ji tsam na phan tshun shing rta'i mda' gnyis thug tho)pa dang / mdun na 'don gyi bus smras pa/zur cig /de rnams kyis ⑩smras pa/ khyod nyid zur cig /mdun na 'don gyi bus mjal phyeto zhes byas nas tshig rtsub po smra bar brtsams tho)pa dang / de nas sa ga ma'i bu rnams kyis shing rta'i mda' nas bzung ste 'phangs pas phyag dar gyi phung po'i steng du brdab 0bsnun to tī/ /de de nas gos kyis mgo bsgyur te pa'i drung du song nas mig mchi dums gang bas smras pa/ yab sa ga ma'i bu rnams kyis bdag du'adi 'dra ba'i gnas skabs su bgyis so/ /bu ci'i phyir/des rgyas par smras pa dang / des smras pa( ste/ bu gal te de lta na thabs shig bsham par dubyas la de rnams mthar gyis kha gdag gis samya ngan ma byed cig/de de rnams la klan 0ka tshol ba lhur len cing gnas so/ /dus gzhan zhig na ko sa la'i ⑥rgyal po gsal rgyal la ri 'or ⑦ba log par gyur nas/ rgyal pos de la dudamag kha chen cig bkye (nyeb las jugs durab tu rdugs 9nas slar log go/ /3—189

de bzhin du lan bdun gyi bar du dmag kha chen po ①bkye ba las rdugs ②rab tu rdugs te slar log rgyanas rgyal po rang nyid dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang byung ba dang sa ga ma'i bu nang du 'jug pa de rnams kyis de dumathong nas smras pa/lha gang du gshegs ri 'or ⑤ba 0rnams 'bebs su'o/ /lha bzhugs shig bdag cag mchi'o⑦/ /de bzhin du gyis shig /des de rnams la dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa gtad ⑧nas de rnams dong ste ri 'or ⑨ba rnams phab nas gte'u bzung dpya blangs te/ slar bya'ongs pa dang mdun na 'don gyis smras pa/lha 'di dag ni 'phags par yirtsal po che dag cig ste/ re zhig lha'i dka' bas bsgrub 0pa gang lags pa de ni 'di dag gis 'bring gis bsgrubs kyis 0lhas 'di la dgongs shig /rgyal po rnams ni khum phrig ④can yin pas snying la bzhag ste slar mdun na 'don la 8dris pa de la ji ltar bsgrub par bya8/ des smras pa/lha de la ji ltar bsgrub ⑩par bgyi/ gal te de dag 'tshal bar gyur na/ lha rgyal srid nas 8phyung nas rang nyid rgyal srid bgyid par ⑩'gyur ro/ /rgyal po je 0mi dga' nas bsams pa/ de ltar 'gyur srid kyis nyeji ltar gsad dupar bya zhe na/ thabs bsham 0pa sems shing gsang 'phel du dogs pas su la yang mi 'dri bar de bdag ④nyid kyis dpyad pa las blo skyes pa 'di kho nar mgron dudu bos la bstungs 0te gtang 0ngo snyam nas des sa ga ma la spring ba/ che zhe'i 'bu rnams sang 'dir zan zo shig /des ⑥bsams pa/ sang ni bu rnams zhang po'i der za bar 'gyur gyis0/ bdag gis kyang sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs ⑥tshod gsol lo snyam du bsams nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis 3—190

la mgo bos phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma sa ga ma la ①chos dang ldan pa'i gtam ②gyis zhes bya ba nas yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma sa ga ma stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu sang ②bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas duri dgas 'dzin gyi ma sa ga ma ⑤la gnang ngo zhes bya ba nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan ༷bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /rgyal po'i pho nya de rnams kyis ①drung du 'ongs nas khye'u shog shig ces bos ⑧so/ /de nas rgyal pos dug ha la ha la dang zas su sbyar bas rmongs par byas nas mgo rnams bcad de/ de nas gzeb bkang nas steng du phu bo lashos kyi mgo bzhag ste rgya skyegs la rgyas btab ⑫nas sa ga ma la bskur 0ba dang sa ga mas bsams pa/ gdon mi za bar lhas ⑫sring mo'i bu rnams la bgo 0ba zhig bskur ba yin gyis(ste/ bdag gis kyang sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la bgo bar dbul 8lo snyam nas/de nas sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams bde bar bzhugs ⑫par rig nas gtsang ⑩zhing bsod pa'i bza' 8ba dang bca' ba rnams kyis zhes bya ba nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsol zin nas phyag bcabs te lhung bzed gyu ()bar rig nas zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /gzeb kha dbye 03—191

bar brtsams ①pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ gal te sa ga mas bden pa ma ②mthong bar bu bsad ①pa mthong na bden pa rnams kyi snod du mi 'gyur ba'i gnas gang yin pa de yod do snyam du dgongs nas dus ga ma la bka' stsal pa/ re zhig 'dug la chos nyon la phyis ci dga' ba gyis shig /des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas chos mnyan pa'i phyir spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑤de'i bsam pa dang /bag la nyal ba dang khams dang rang bzhin mkhyen nas zhes bya ba nas bden pa mthong bar mdzad do zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bden pa mthong nas gzeb kha phye ba dang bu'i mgo rnams mthong nas/ de nas gsol paX/bcom ldan 'das 'du byed thams cad ni 'di ltar mi rtag pa lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis sa ga ma'i bu rnams bstungs ① pa ni nyes so/ /gal te ma bstungs ⑧par gyur ⑨na 'di rnams kho nas grogs byas pas de'i lag mthil du sa mtha' dag 'jog par 'gyur ba zhig /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal lus rdul gyis yog ⑩cing bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der yisong ste phyin pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis ko sa la'i tu)rgyal po gsal rgyal la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po khyod lus rdul gyis yog 0cing gang nas 'dir 'ongs/ btsun pa rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur (sreb yul gyi dbang phyug dang mthu dang /brtson 'grus thob pa/ sa'i dkyil 'khor chen po legs par phab ste gnas pa 3—192

rnams kyis rgyal po'i bgyi ba dang / rgyal po'i sgrub ①pa tha dad pa gang dag lags pa de dag bdag gis bgyis te/ yongs su rdzogs nas lus rdul gyis yog ②cing nga ②mchis pa lags so/ /rgyal po chen po de'i phyir khyod nyid la dri bar byasaX/ khyod kyis ji ltar bzod pa de lan thob cig /rgyal po chen po dper na khyod la 'dir shar phyogs nas mi yid duches pa yid brtan du rung ba/brtan pa/ 'jig rten la mi slu ba zhig 'ongs nas/ de ༷'di skad ces lha bdag da gzod ⑦'di nas shar phyogs su mchi dumachi na/ de nas bdag gis ri brag chen po ma chag pa/ ser ka ma mchis pa/ phrag ma mchis pa/ shin tu mkhregs ⑨pa/ gcig tu sdug ⑩pa zhig sa'i bar dang nam mkha'i bar gyi sems can thams cad dang / srog chags thams cad dang / 'byung po thams cad dang / rtswa dang / shing dang / yal ga dang / lo ma dang / 'dab 0ma ji snyed pa thams cad phye mar rlog 4)cing mchi ba mthong gis yilha khyod kyi 8bgyi ba'am / bsgrub ⑩pa gang lags pa de mdzod cig ces zer la de bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs nas mi zhig 'ongs te zhes ⑩bya ba nas bgyi ba'am bsgrub ⑩pa de mdzod cig ces 'azer te/ rgyal po chen po 'jigs pa chen po'i yang chen po mi bzad ⑩par byed pa mi bzad 0pa de lta bu nye bar gnas na mi nyid thob pa ni rnyed ( )par dka' na/ khyod kyis ⑤ci zhig bya/btsun pa 'jigs pa chen po'i yang chen po mi bas par bgyid pa mi bzad 0pa de lta bu nye bar gnas na mi nyid thob ④pa rnyed par dka' ba lags pas byadon spyod tsopa dang / chos spyad 0pa dang / bsod nams spyad ⑥pa dang / dge ba spyad ⑥pa dang / bzang po spyad du )pa dang / sangs rgyas rnams ⑥kyi bstan pa la brtson ri3—193

par bgyi ba ①ma lags par gzhan ci ②zhig bgyir mchis/ rgyal po chen po khyod ci'i phyir 'di skad ces btsun pa 'jigs pa chen po'i yang chen po de lta bu ③zhes bya ba nas sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa la brtson par bgyi zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /btsun pa rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ sa'i dkyil 'khor chen po legs par phab ste gnas pa de rnams kyis ④thang po che rnams dang glang ①po cher 'gyed ①pa dang / rta pa rnams dang rta par 'gyed pa dang / shing rta ⑦pa rnams ⑧dang shing rta par 'gyed pa dang / dpung bu chung rnams dang dpung bu chung du 'gyed ⑨pa dang / gsang tshig mkhan rnams dang gsang tshig mkhan du 'gyed pa dang /nor rnams kyis nor du rgyal ba 0tha dad pa gang dag skyelags pa de dag thams cad de'i tshe 'gyed pa'i mthu tsom mchis pa dang stobs ma mchis pa dang / pha rol gnon 0pa ma mchis pa lags pas de'i slad du bdag 'di skad ces btsun pa 'jigs pa chen po'i yang chen po de lta bu nye bar gnas na zhes bya ba nas sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa la brtson par bgyi ba ma khrulags par gzhan ci zhig bgyir mchis byazhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /rgyal po chen po de bzhin du srog chags 'di dag kyang rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad (9par rga ba dang /'chi bas 'joms pa yin no/ /rgyal po chen po de ltar rga ⑩ba dang 'chi bas 'joms pa na skyes pa 4)gang dag gis 4)don spyad pa dang zhes bya ba nas/sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa la brtson par bya ba ma yin par gzhan ci zhig byar yod ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pas dubaka' stsal pa/ ji ltar che zhing rgya che ba'i 0 ri bo 3—194

nam mkha' las 'ong ba①/ snye /kun nas yang dag 'ong ba ②yis/ /sa ni phye mar rlog ③pa na/ /de la glang po ches mi rdzi/ /dpung bu chung dang shing rta dang / /rtas min gsang tshig mkhan dang ni/ /nor gyis 'gyed pas rgyal mi 'thobarjo/ /de bzhin rga dang 'chi ⑤ba yis/ /mi rnams 'joms par byed pa na//rgyal rigs bram ze rje'u 0rigs dang / /dmangs 0rigs gdol pa g.yung po dang / /tshul khrims 'chal dang tshul khrims ldan/ /khyim pa de bzhin brtul ⑧zhugs can/ /lang tsho nyid dang rgan po dang / /de bzhin bar ma'i mi rnams la0/ /cung zad kyang ni 'dzem 0med par/ /thams cad mngon du 'joms par byed/ /de lta bas na mkhas pa'i mi/ /bdag gi don la blta skyeb yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ /bla med dag tsol dad bya zhing / /lus dang ngag dang yid dag gis/ /dam pa'i chos ni spyad byas na/ /'di na smad par mi 'gyur zhing / /mtho ris song nas dga' bar 'gyur/ /de nas ko sa la'i 8rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa la mngon par dga' ste rjes su yi rangs 8nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 8zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te stan tshulas langs nas song ngo / /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pas/btsun pa ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma sa ga mas 8las ci zhig bgyis na/ las de'i rnam par smin pas sgo nga sum bcu rtsa gnyis byung ba yide rnams las kyang bu pho sum bcu rtsa gnyis byung ste rtsal dupo che thub rlag ⑥pa sha stag tu gyur dulags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ smon lam gyi dbang gis so/ /gang du smon lam btab lags/ dge slong dag sngon byung ba bā rā ṇa sī'i grong khyer du khyim 3—195

bdag cig gi bu shi nas de'i chung ma de rtag tu bu ①mngon par 'dod par gyur to//gang gi tshe ②yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung ③gis sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag mdzad nas shing zad pa'i me bzhin du phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i ④dbyings su yongs su ①mya ngan las 'das pa de'i tshe bā du'o ṇa sīr rgyal po kṛ tī zhes bya ba byung ste/ des meyang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi mchod rten ③rin po che sna bzhi las brtsigs so/ /de nas bud med 0bu med pa 0bu mngon par 'dod pa gang yin pa de yang rgas par gyur nas mchod rten de la byi dor byas nas 'dug go/ /des 'dun pa'i slong ()mo byas nas mchod rten de (sprel mchod par spre)byas te smon lam btab pa/bdag gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi mchod rten la bya ba byas pa gang yin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des bdag bu mang por gyur cig ces byas te song nas grong khyer du zhugs so/ /de na bud med cig bu (stend kyi sdug bsngal gyi tshor bas nyen nas ngu ba dang des gzhan zhig la dris pa/ ci'i phyir 'di ngu bar gyur des ji ltar gyur pa rnams smras pa dang des bsams pa/ gal te bdag kyang bu byung 8bar gyur ⑩na/ bdag kyang sdug bsngal 'di lta bu nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro snyam pa las/ ci 0tsam na sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyi dga' tso'adun gyis yimachod rten de la mchod pa byed pa na bud med de yang de dang ha cang ⑥mi ring ba zhig na 'dug go/ /de rnams kyis mchod pa byas nas smon lam btab pa / dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag cag tshan po che chen po'i stobs dang ldan par gyur cig ces byas so/ /des 0de rnams la dris pa bu dag khyed kyis smon lam ci zhig btab/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ yum 'di dang 'di dag go/ /3—196

des smras pa/ bu dag gal te de ltar ①na khyed cag gi ②mar bdag kho na gyur cig /yum de bzhin du gyur cig ces smras nas de rnams dong ngo / /des bsams pa/ re zhig bud med de lan gcig btsa' ③na yang sdug bsngal gyi tshor bas nyen nas de ltar ngu na/ bdag la lan sum bcu rtsa gnyis btsa' na ji ltar bya zhes 0de de ltar rnam par rtog pa na/ mchod rten dudang nye ba na bya gag mo zhig yod pa sgo nga 'byung bar dude de rgyathang cig tsam gyis sgo nga sum bcu rtsa gnyis byung la smre sngags kyang mi 'don to⑤/ /des bsams pa/ 'byung ba'i thabs 'di ni 0rung ba yin no snyam du rig nas mchod rten de la dad pa drag pos smon lam gdab par brtsams pa/ ji ltar bya gag mo 'di thang cig tsam gyis sgo nga sum bcu rtsa gnyis byung ba de bzhin du bdag gi bu 0sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyang cig car sgo nyungar 'byung bar gyur cig ces byas so/ /dge slong dag 'ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi 'bud med rgan mo gang yin pa de ni byas ga ma 'di nyid yin no/ /sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyi dga' 8'dun gang yin pa de ni sa ga ma'i bu 'di rnams kho na yin te⑩/ 'dis de na smon lam btab pa gang yin pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas sgo ⑩nga sum bcu rtsa gnyis byung ngo / /btsun pa/ sa ga ma'i bu rnams kyis las ci zhig bgyis tson las de'i rnam par smin pas nongs pa ma bgyis shing skyon yim mchis par rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bkum ⑥nas de rnams kyi dumagos gzeb bkang ste sa ga ma la bskur dulags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di dag kho nas las rnams byas shing bsags pa dag ni zhes bya ba nas lus can rnams la 'bras bur 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba ri 'or duzhig 3—197

na chang 'tshong ①zhig gnas so/ /chom rkun ②pa rab tu mang po chang tshol zhing de'i drung du 'ongs nas dris pa/ chang yod dam/ chang 'tshong ②gi chung mas smras pa/ yod do zhes de rnams la 0chang blud na 'dzar ⑤ba med nas des glang zhig bstan de du'adi sod cig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ mtshon cha med do/ /des gta' blangs ⑦nas mtshon lacha byin pa dang / de rnams kyis de bsad ⑨par brtsams so0/ /de gsod 0pa na sems la bdag gsod pa gang yin pa 'di dag thams cad ni chang 'tshong 8gi chung ma 'di yin gyis8/ /bdag gang du 'di rnams kyi mgo bcad nas gzeb bkang ste 'di la bskur bar 'gyur ba der skye bar gyur cig ces bsams sobya/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi glang gang yin pa de ni ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal 'di nyid yin no/ /chom rkun 8pa gang yin pa de rnams ni sa ga ma'i bu 'di dag nyid tsoyin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus kyi chang 'tshong ⑦gi chung ma gang yin pa de ni sa ga ma 'di nyid yin no zhes rgyas par bya'o// ci sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ku'i 8gnas yin bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa'i bste gnas ⑥shig yod de0/ de de na 'chag ⑥pa las bste gnas dang ha cang yang mi ring ba'i sa rdzab can gyi phyogs shig 0tu gcin khu chu dang bcas pa zhig gcis so/ /glo bur du ri dgas mo skom phyopas nyen pa zhig phyogs der 'ongs te/ de sgom pas nyen pas de 'thungs dunas mo'i dbang po la bsnams so//sems can rnams kyi las kyi 0rnam par smin pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab pas sems can dang ldan par gyur 0to/ /ji tsam na tsodus gzhan zhig na phyogs de nyid du 3—198

'ongs nas khye'u zhig byung ba dang / des de bsnams ①na skal ba mi mthun pa'i sems can yin nas bor te song ngo / ji tsam na drang srong de ②bste gnas de na 'chag ②pa las khye'u de mthong nas/ 'di bu'i bu yin zhes de dubasam pa la ⑤zhugs pa las/ ji tsam na bdag gi yin par mthong nas des de bste gnas su bzhag ste bsnun bstod bskyed nas de'i mgo ri dgas kyi 'dra dubs ri dgas mgo ri dgas mgo ⑦zhes bya bar grags so/ /dus gzhan zhig na drang srong shi nas ri dgas mgos klad ⑧pa'i thod pa rdob pa'i rig pa bslabs te/ des ⑨thod pa brdabs nas thams cad lung ston par byed dokyi/ /gal te re zhig sgra drag por gyur na gyen du 'gro ba lhar skye bar 'gyur bar lung ston par byed do/ /'on te 'bring du gyur na gyen du 'gro ba mir skye bar 'gyur bar 7lung ston par byed de/ de ni bde 'gro'i rtags so/ /ngan 'gro'i rtags ni gal te re zhig sgra mi gsal bar gyur na 'og tu 'gro ba sems can dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur bar lung ston par byed do/ /'on te sgra 'bring du gyur 4)na 'og rtu 'gro ba dud 'gror skye bar 'gyur bar lung ston par byed do/ /'on te sgra chung bar gyur na 'og tu 'gro ba yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i 0'dul ba'i dus mkhyen nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan gcig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang /tso dgra bcom pa'i mgo bzhi khyer cig /btsun pa bka' skyibazhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das las tsomanyan nas mgo bzhi khyer te drang srong de'i drung du song nas khyod kyis 0lung ston cig /des rgyun du zhugs pa'i thod pa la brdabs ⑫3—199

nas smras pa/ 'di ni lha rnams su skyes sol/ /lan gcig phyir 'ong ba ②yang de bzhin no/ /phyir mi 'ong ba'i yang de bzhin no/ /dgra bcom pa'i thod ③pa la dubardabs na ma shes rnam par ma shes nas ngo tsha bas de 'di snyam du sems te/gang phyir 'di yi ⑤'gro ba ma shes pa/ /bdag ci ༷bstan pa de las nyams gyur tam / /'on te slob dpon rigs las ma skyes sam/ /'on te rtags rnams de 'dra ma yin nam/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos smras pa/ gang phyir 'di yi 'gro ba ma shes pa/ /khyod kyis ④rig pa kun legs goms nim byas/ /re zhig rig pa mtha' dag rtogs byos la/ /khyod kyis phyi ⑨nas 'jig rten lung ston cig /ri dgas mgos smras pa/ khyod kyis 0rig pa thams cad la byang ba 'ga' mthong ngam 0mthong ba yod dam/ des smras pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /de nas ri dgas mgo bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song nas phyin pa dang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dud 'gro yi dgas dmyal ba lha mi skye bo'i 'gro 'tshal na/ /rig pa'i skyon gyis sems can spyod pa drug pa ma 'tshal gyis0/ /gtso bo srid pa gsum gyi mtsho chen pha rol byon pa po0/ /pha rol smra kun las rgyal drug pa ma 'tshal de ci gsungs8/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mer 8bsregs pa yi yilcags kyi me/ /lcags kyi tho bas brdungs byas nas/ / rim gyis tshunye bar zhi ba yi/ /'gro ba ji ltar mi mngon pa/ /de bzhin 'dod pa'i 'dam tshogs las/ /gal 8te yang dag rnam grol ba/ /mi g.yo go 'phang thob yirnams kyi/ /'gro ba gdags ⑥su yod ma yin/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la ri 3—200

dgas mgos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ①ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po thob pa lta na/ bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar tshangs par ③spyod pa ②spyad par bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rab tu phyung bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad deX/ de rab tu phyung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad nas rgyal po'i khab tu ji tsam bzhed kyi bar du bzhugs nas mnyan yod gang na ba der rgyu zhing gshegs 0te/ rim gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa dang mnyan yod du byon nas mnyan yod kyi 0ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma'i sngon gyi kun dga' ra ba'i khang bzangs na bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das bla gab med pa na 'chag cing rgyu skar rnams gyur pa gzigs so/ /gzigs nas ①tshe dang ldan pa ri dgas mgo la bka' stsal pa/ ri dgas mgo ji srid cig na lhas char 'bebs par 'gyur soms shig /des bsams nas ⑧btsun pa 'jig rten 'di ma rung 'di rab tu ma rung lags te/ rgyu skar rnams ji ltar gnas pa dang sbyar na lo bcu gnyis su char mi 'bab lags so0/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyirgyu skar rnams mthun par byin gyis brlabs nas bka' stsal pa/ yang shes par gyis shig /des gsol pa/ lo drug tu lags so/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyis yang smras pa dang / gsol pa/ lo 0lngar lags so/ /de bzhin du zhag bdun gyi bar du'o/ /de nas tsobacom ldan 'das kyis tshudage slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gnas mal rnams skyabs yod par spos ④shig /de ring kho nar lhas phye ma'i tsotshogs lta bu'i char 'bebs ⑩par 'gyur te / de la khrus byed pa gang yin pa de rnams la 'bras dang phol mig 'byung 3—201
