bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ri dgas mgo de ltar na rgyu skar rnams ni 'gyur ba g.yo ba mi brtan pa yin te/ srog kyang g.yo ba mi brtan pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang ①/ ri dgas mgo mngon par dad par gyur to/ /de ltar mngon par dad par gyur pas dgra bcom pa mngon sum ②du byas so/ /de nas rnam par grol ba'i dga' ba rab tu myong nas tshigs su bcad pas smras pa/ ri dgas rnams ni nags khrod rten/ /'dab ②chags rnams ni mkha' la rtenaX/ /rnam par sgom pa chos la rten⑤/ /dgra bcom mya ngan 'das la rtenaX/ /ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma rgyas ga mas/ bcom ldan 'das ko sa la'i ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs te mnyan yod du 0byon nas mnyan yod na ⑨bdag kho na'i kun dga' ra ba yin bzhugs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu ⑩'dug pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 8ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma sa ga ma la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan ces bya ba nas yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung 0ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma sa ga ma stan 0las langs te/bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu sang bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tunyes ga ma la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo zhes bya ba nas nor bu'i chu snod bzhag ste/ bcom ldan 3—202

'das la bu mo mngag gzhug ①ma dus tshod gsol ba dus tshod gsol du bcug go//ji tsam na bu mo mngag gzhug ②ma de sngon gyi kun dga' ra bar song nas sgo gseb nas bltas na dge slong rnams sgren mor khrus byed pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bsams pa/ gdon mi za bar 'phags pa rnams ni bzhud la/ 'tsho ba pa nal phrug 'di dag gis gtsug ②lag khang 'dir btab bo snyam nas/ de rings pa rings pas ༷'ongs te smras pa/ jo mo mkhyen par mdzod cig /'phags pa rnams ni bzhud la 'tsho ba pa nal phrug rnams kyis gtsug ⑤lag khang 'dir btab lags so/ /sa ga mas bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas/ gdugs tshod ma gsol bar bzhud par gyur pa dugang yin pa de ni gnas ma yin zhing ⑦skabs med deni/ gdon mi za bar 'dis dge slong sgren mo rnams mthong ngo snyam nas/ des dus tshod ⑨gsol ba'i ⑩skyes pa gzhan zhig btang ste/ des btsun pa gdugs tshod lags shing mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das da yide'i dus la bab par mkhyen par mdzad du gsol zhes bya ba nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis gsol zin nas phyag bcabs te lhung bzed gyu bar rig nas zhes bya ba'i bar gong 4)ma bzhin du ste/ rgan pa'i mthar 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag ni sbyin pa chen po brgyad bca' bar 'tshal te/ glo bur ba la stsal 0ba dang / 'chi tsobar chas pa la stsal ba dang / bro 'tshal 0ba la stsal ba dang / bro tsogayog la stsal ba dang / stsang nas ⑩kyi 'jams nar ma dang / sman nar ma dang / dge slong rnams la dbyar gyi tsogos ras chen dang / dge slong ma rnams la khrus ras so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sa ga ma khyod kyis yon tan ci 3—203

zhig mthong na glo ①bur du 'ongs pa la sbyin pa sbyin/ btsun pa glo bur du mchis pa'i dge slong ni spyod yul ②mi mkhas pa dang / lam srang ③mi mkhas pa lags pas des bdag dugi bsod snyoms la longs spyad na spyod yul la mkhas pa dang ⑤/lam srang la mkhas par 'gyur lags so/ /sa ga ma de thugs su chud de legs so legs so/ /don gyi dbang ci zhig mthong na 'gro bar chas pa la sbyin pa sbyin/btsun pa dge slong mchi rjobar chas pa bsod snyoms tshol du mchis dun 'gron pa ⑧rnams dang bral bar 'gyur zhing tshogs dang bral na phongs par 'gyur bas des bdag gi ⑨bsod snyoms la longs spyad ⑩na tshogs dang 'bral yibar mi 'gyur lags so/ /sa ga ma de yang thugs su chud de legs so legs so/ /don gyi dbang ci zhig mthong na nad pa la sbyin pa sbyin/ btsun pa dge slong bro 'tshal ba bsod snyoms tshol du mchis na nyon mongs pa'am 'gum par tso'agyur bas des bdag gi 0bsod snyoms la longs spyod tson bro nad las ldang ba dang bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur lags so/ /sa ga ma de yangathugs su chud de legs so legs so/ /don gyi dbang ci zhig mthong na nad g.yog la sbyin pa sbyin/btsun pa dge slong bro g.yog bgyid pa rang gi ched du bsod snyoms tshol du mchis na 8bro 'tshal ba'i bgyi ba nyams par 'gyur bas des bdag gi skyabasod snyoms la longs spyad ⑩na 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /sa ga ma de yang thugs su chud de legs so legs so/ /don gyi dbang ci zhig mthong na dge 'dun la nas thug nar ma sbyin/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos rnams la drod chung ba yang mchis/ drod che ba yang mchis te/ de la re zhig drod chung ba gang lags pa de rnams ni nas thug 'tshal na drod skye bar 'gyur la/ drod che ba gang 3—204

lags pa de rnams ni nyam ⑦skye bar 'gyur ②lags so/ /sa ga ma de yang thugs su chud de legs so legs so/ /don gyi dbang ci zhig mthong na dge 'dun la sman nar ma sbyin/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos rnams las labro nad mang ba dudang bro nad nyung ba mchis te/ de la bro nad mang po gang lags pa de rnams la ni re zhig 'tshal ches/ bro nad nyung ba gang lags pa de rnams kyis longs spyad na lhag par yang bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur lags so//sa ga ma de yang thugs su chud de legs so legs so/ /don gyi dbang ci zhig mthong na/ dge slong rnams la dbyar gyi gos ras chen sbyin/ btsun pa de ring kho na bdag gis 0bu mo mngag gzhug 0bgyid pa dus tshod gsol bar btang ba las/ des dge slong rnams sgren mor khrus byas ⑦pa mthong nas/ de slar mchis te bdag la 'phags pa rnams ni bzhud la 'tsho ba pa nal phrug rnams kyis gtsug lag khang du btab bo zhes mchi bas de rnams dbyar gyi gos ras chen gyis bkab par 'gyur lags so/ /sa ga ma de yang thugs su chud de legs so legs so/ /don gyi dbang ci zhig mthong na dge slong ma rnams la khrus ras sbyin/btsun pa dus 'di gcig na khyim pa mo rab tu mang po dag dge slong ma rab tu mang po rnams chu bo gnas ldan la sgren mor khrus bgyid pa las khyim pa mo de rnams kyis bgad cing bgad ⑧nas mdzub ⑨kar gyis dge slong ma rnams kyi mdoms 0nye bar ston te/ de dag gis nye bar bstan pa rnams bag 'khums ⑫par gyur pas de rnams bdag gi khrus ras kyis bkab nas khrus bgyid par 'gyur lags so/ /sa ga ma legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po brgyad ⑩smras pa gang yin pa de dag ni 0rdzas las byung ba'i bsod 3—205

nams bya ba'i dngos po bdun rnams la yang dag par snang zhing 'di dag ni rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po bdun po gang dag la bsod nams sam/ bsod nams kyi 'bras bu'am/ bsod nams kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa 'di tsam mo zhes tshad gzung ①bar mi nus kyi 'on kyang bsod nams mang ba'i phyir bsod nams kyi phung po chen po zhes bya bo'i grangs su 'gro ba rnams kyi nang du 'dus so/ /btsun pa bdag gis 'di skad ces bcom ldan 'das kyis ②dge slong che ge mo de snga nas rgyadage slong 'di yang kun tu sbyor ba gsum spangs nas rgyun du zhugs pa rnam par mi nyung ba'i chos can rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ④nges par gzhol ba/ re ltar thogs na srid pa lan bdun par 'gyur te/ lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du lan bdun du nying mtshams sbyor zhing 'khor nas sdug bsngal gyi mthar byed par 'gyur ro ⑤zhes lung bstan pa thos te/ de mnyan yod du res 'ga' mchi 0zhing slar yang mchi ⑦bar 'gyur la/ des bdag gi glo ⑧bur du mchi ⑨ba'i zas zhes bya ba nas/ dbyar gyi gos ras chen dang / dge slong mas khrus ras longs spyod par 'gyur ⑩lags so zhes bya ba'i bar de 0thos nas kyang dga' ba dang rab tu dga' ba rgya chen po dge ba nges par 8'byung ba dang ldan pa thob par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 0dge slong che ge mo de byadage slong 'di ni kun tu sbyor ba gsum spangs nas 'dod chags dang /zhe snang dang / gti mug bsrabs 8pa'i phyir lan gcig phyir tso'ong bar 'gyur te / 'jig rten 'dir lan gcig 'ongs nas sdug bsngal gyi mthar byed par rkyi'agyur ro zhes lung bstan 8pa de yang mnyan yod du res 'ga' mchi bzhing slar mchi dul/ des bdag gi glo 0bur ba'i zas zhes bya ba nas dbyar gyi gos ras 3—206

chen dang / dge slong mas khrus ras zhes ①bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin te/thos nas kyang dga' ba dang rab tu rgyadaga' ba rgya chen po dge ba nges par 'byung ba dang ldan pa thob par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong che ge mo de ②dge slong 'di ni tha ma'i cha dang mthun pa'i kun tu sbyor ba lnga spangs pas phyir mi 'ong bar 'gyur te/ 'jig rten 'dir phyir mi 'ong bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa de yang res 'ga' mnyan yod du mchi zhing slar mchi la/des bdag gi glo bur ba'i zas zhes bya ba nas dbyar gyi gos ras chen dang /dge slong mas khrus ras zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ thos nas kyang dga' ba dang rab tu dga' ba rgya chen po dge ba nges par du'abyung ba dang ldan pa thob par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong 0che ge mo de rjodage slong 'di ni nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa mngon sum ⑦du byas nas phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su 'jug par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa de yang nires 'ga' mnyan yod du mchi 0zhing slar yang mchi tshul/ des bdag gi 0glo bur ba'i zas zhes bya ba nas dbyar gyi gos ras chen dang / dge slong mas khrus ras zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ thos nas kyang dga' ba dang rab tu dga' ba rgya chen po dge ba nges par 'byung byab dang ldan pa thob par 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ri dgas 'dzin gyi ma sa ga ma la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam 0gyis yang dag par bstan yang dag par 'dzin du bcugatso /yang dag par gzengs bstod/yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad tsonas gdan las bzhengs te gshegs so//de nas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod du ji tsam tshubazhed kyi bar du bzhugs nas 3—207

yangs pa can gang na ba der rgyu zhing gshegs te/ rim gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa na yangs pa can du byon nas yangs pa can gyi spre'u rdzing gi 'gram gyi khang pa brtsegs pa na bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro na bza' sham thabs mnabs ①chos gos dang lhung bzed bsnams nas yangs pa can du bsod snyoms la zhugs so/ /de'i tshe dge slong rab tu mang po kun dga' ra ba'i sgo na gnas mal mi gtsang bas gos pa rnams 'khru ba dang / skems ②pa dang / 'dings par ③byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rab tu mang po kun dga' ra ba'i sgo na gnas mal mi gtsang 0bas gos pa rnams 'khru ba dang /skems ⑤pa dang / 'dings par dubyed pa gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang yang 'di snyam du dgongs te/ bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag pags ⑦pa dang / sha dang / khrag zad zad du sbyin pa ⑧btang zhing bsod nams byas pa gang yin pa de la ⑨dge slong rnams bag med cing ma brtags par spyod par byed do snyam du dgongs nas yangs pa can du bsod snyoms spyad de/ zhal zas kyi bya ba mdzad nas zas phyi ma'i bsod snyoms spangs shing lhung bzed dang na bza' chos gos mkhos su phab ⑩nas zhabs bsil te nang du yang dag 'jog la gtsug lag khang du zhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yidagongs trika nang du yang dag 'jog las bzhengs nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'dir nga 0snga dro sham thabs bgos byalhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te yangs pa can du bsod snyoms la zhugs pa las ngas dge slong rab tu mang po dag kun dga' ra ba'i sgo na gnas mal mi 3—208

gtsang ①bas gos pa rnams 'khru ba dang / skems ②pa dang / 'dings par ③byed pa ④mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du dgongs te/ bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can dag pags ⑤pa dang / sha dang khrag zad 0zad du sbyin pa ⑦btang zhing bsod nams byas pa gang yin pa de la dge slong rnams bag med cing ma brtags ⑧par spyod par ⑨byed do/ /dge slong dag dad pas byin pa la bag yod pas 0spyod pa dang / dus su spyod pa dang / skabs skabs su spyod pa dang / brtags 0te spyod pa dang / cung zad spyod pa ni legs so legs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dad pas byin pa la bag yod pas spyad par bya ba'i bsngags pa gsungs nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na dge 'dun gyi gnas byamal la gding ba med par longs spyad par mi bya'o / /gnas mal ()mi gtsang bas gos na de'i mod kho na la bkru bar bya ste/gzhan du na 'gal tshabs ④can du 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro na bza' sham thabs mnabs 0lhung bzed dang chos gos ⑩bsnams yinas zhabs 'bring byed pa'i dge slong tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang / yangs pa can du bsod snyoms la zhugs pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mi rgyab nag por gyur pa zhig rgyang 8ring po kho na tho)nas gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis mi rgyab nag po pha bi mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /kun dga' bo mi pha bi 0ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi 0gsung rab la rab tu byung ⑥bar gyur te/ de nas 'dis dge 'dun gyi gnas tsomal la ming tsam gyi gding ba dang / dri ma can gyi gding ba dang / shur bu dang / rgya cang phyedang / lhug ri 3—209

gu'i ①gding bas bting nas longs spyad ②pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas tshe rabs lnga brgyar ②rgyab nag por gyur to/ /da dung yang 0rgyab nag por gyur to zhes rig par mdzad nas yangs pa can du bsod snyoms mdzad do zhes bya ba nas nang du yang dag ⑤'jog las bzhengs nas zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan dubashams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de ring nga snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te yangs pa can du bsod snyoms la zhugs pa las/ de na ngas ⑦mi rgyab nag por 'dug pa zhig mthong ste/ de ni yang dag par nirdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi gsung rab la dge slong du gyur pa las de na ⑨des dge 'dun gyi gnas mal la ming tsam gyi gding ba dang zhes bya ba nas tshe rabs lnga brgya'i bar du rgyab nag por gyur to zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na dge slong rnams kyis deng phyin chad ⑩ming tsam gyi gding ba dang / dri ma can gyi gding bas dge 'dun gyi gnas mal la longs spyad par mi bya'o/ /longs spyad na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang gding ba gnyis kyis longs spyad par bya ste/ stug na ni rim gcig gis so/ /seng ba zhig na yirim gnyis kyis so/ /dge slong rnams gding ba bkra zhing bkra ba kha tshar ma bcad pa dag 'chang bar byed pa bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas smod par byed/ gzhogs 4)'phyas byed/ kha zer bar byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sngon po'am/ 'dam ku'am0/kha bsgyur byaba'i gding ba gris dras 8pa bcang bar bya ste/ gzhan du na 'gal 3—210

tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong zhig g.yan pa'i nad kyis nyen ①pas de'i chos gos rnams rnag dang khrag gis reg nas dri mi zhim la ③sprang ma rnams 'du zhing de bsod snyoms la zhugs pa de ③bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas smod par byed gzhogs du'aphyas byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na rjes su gnang ste g.yan pa dgab pa bcang dubar bya ste/ zhag lnga'am/ drug lon nas bkru bar bya'o0/ /gzhan du na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong marje'i ⑦nad kyis nyen pa dag dge 'dun gyi gnas mal dang / khyams dang / rdzing dang / sgo khang dang / bang rim dang / 'chag sa rnams dang / shing drung gi gnas rnams na ⑧dri mi zhim pa dang / sbrang ma rnams 'khor ⑨bas gnas shing longs spyad ⑩ par byed 0pa de dag bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas smod par byed/ gzhogs ⑫'phyas byed/ kha zer bar byed ⑩pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong mdze thostend kyis thebs pa rnams kyi phyir ngas kun tu spyod ⑫pa'i chos dag bca' bar bya ste/ dge slong mdze nad kyis thebs pas dge 'dun gyi gnas mal dang / gnas khang la longs spyad par mi bya/ khyams rnams dang / ji skad du bsgrags pa'i khyams tshul sogs par gnas par mi bya/dge 'dun gyi chab khung 0dang / snam phyi sar 'jug par mi bya ste'u/ dge 'dun gyis de la gnas dben pa byin yinas rim gro 0bya'o/ /dge slong mdze nad kyis thebs pas kun tu spyod ⑥pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa bzhin yang dag 3—211

par blangs te 'jug par mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro // //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po drug bcu ①bzhi pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ②'khor gyis ②zhus pa/ btsun pa bde bar gshegs pa'i na bza' chos gos lhag par bcang du rung lags sam/ nye ba 'khor dumi rung ngo / /btsun pa mon dar gyi chos gos la duchos gos gsum du byin gyis brlabs nas chos gos lhag par byin gyis brlabs te bcang du rung lags sam/ nye ba du'akhor ci dgar zad de/ de bzhin du 'dod pa bzhin du bal dang sha na'i ras la yang rung ngo // //sdom la/ gso ma skra yi chos gos dang / /gcer bu skra 'bal lo ma'i gos/ /mthang gos can ⑦dang g.yang gzhi dang / /gso ras seng ras pa char 0sngo/ /gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /dge slong zhig bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑨zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la dge slong des 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag gso ma'i chos gos 'chang bar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/skyes bu gti mug 'di lta ste/ gso ma'i chos gos 'di ni mu stegs pa'i rtags yin no/ /de lta bas na ⑩dge slong gis gso ma'i chos gos bcang bar mi bya'o/ /bcangs na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /yang dge slong zhig 'ongs nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag rka/)skra'i chos gos bcang 4)bar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/3—212

skyes ①bu gti mug 'di ni mu stegs pa'i rtags so ②zhes bya ba nas 'gal tshabs can ①du 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /yang dge slong zhig gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag gcer bu dubagyid par 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skyes bu gti mug 'di lta ste/ gcer bu 'di ni mu stegs pa'i rtags yin no/ /gzhan yang ngas chos gos gsum rjes su gnang na ci'i phyir khyod gcer bu byed/ de lta bas na dge slong gis gcer bu mi bya'o/ /byas na nyes pa sbom por 'gyur ro/ /0de nas dge slong de gcer bu ma gnang ba dang bslab pa rnams spangs te nyams par gyur to/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa dge slong 'di gcer bu ma gnang ba dang bslab 0pa rnams spangs te nyams par gyur pa la gzigs/bcom ldan 'das kyis bkal stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ltar ⑦'ba' zhig tu ma zad de/ ji ltar 'das pa'i dus na yang 'di nyid ngo tsha med pa'i skyon gyis chung ma ma thob pa de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba ngang pa'i rgyal po yul 'khor skyong zhes bya ba byung ste/ de'i bu mo rang khyim thab dutshol lo zhes yul phyogs sna tshogs na gnas pa'i bya rnams kyis thos nas 'dus par gyur te ⑨so so nas bsams pa/ de'i khyim thab 0tu bdag 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /des rma bya zhig mthong nas des smras pa/ 'di ni bdag gi khyim thab tu 'gyur ro/ /de la gzhan dag gis 'dis khyod khyim thab tu bdams so tho)zhes smras pa dang /8des mjug ()ma bsgrengs byanas gar byed par brtsams 8pa de 0yul 'khor skyong gis mthong nas smras pa/ 'di 0ci zhig gi phyir gar byed/ gzhan dag gis 3—213

smras pa/ 7khyod kyi bu mo'i khyim thab tu gyur pas so/ /des ②smras pa/ ngo tsha dang khrel dang mi ldan pas ③'di la bdag gi ༷bu mo mi sbyin no zhes pa rma bya des thos nas yul 'khor skyong gi drung du song ste latshigs su bcad pas ༷smras pa/dbyangs snyan ⑦yid 'ong kha dog mdzes pa dang / / 'dab ma 'dom ⑧gang tshad ldan mgrin ⑨pa ni/ /nor bu bee ḍūrya 0dang 'dra gyur na/ /ci slad khyod kyi sras mo bdag mi stsal/ /yul 'khor skyong gis smras pa/ dbyangs snyan yiyid 'ong kha dog mdzes pa dang / /'dab 8ma 'dom gang tshad ldan mgrin 0pa ni/ /nor bu bee ḍūrya chadang 'dra gyur kyang / /'dzem med skyon 8gyis khyod la mi sbyin no//dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi rma bya gang yin pa de ni dge slong 'di nyid de0/ de na yang 'di ngo tsha med pa'i skyon gyis chung ma ma thob nas sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde nas bya'i tshogs kyi nang nas byung ngo / /da ltar ⑩yang 'dis gcer bu ma gnang nas sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde bas dge slong gi tsotshogs kyi yinang nas byung ngo / /yang dge slong zhig gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag skra 'bal bar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ngas 'dreg 0par rjes su gnang na ci'i phyir khyod spa 'bal/ skyes bu gti mug 'di lta ste/ skra ⑥'bal ba tso'adi ni mu stegs pa'i brtul zhugs ⑥yin no/ /de lta bas na dge slong gis blaskra 'bal bar mi bya'o/ /'bal na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /yang dge slong zhig gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag lo ma'i bgo ba 'chang bar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dubaka' stsal pa/skyes bu gti mug 'di ni mu stegs pa'i brtul zhugs yin no zhes bya ba nas 'gal 3—214

tshabs can du 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /yang dge slong zhig gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag 7bla gos mthang gos dang bcas pas 'tsho bar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skyes bu gti mug ngas chos gos gsum rjes su gnang na ci'i phyir khyod bla gos mthang gos dang bcas pas 'tsho bar byed/ de lta bas na dge slong gis ③bla gos mthang gos dang bcas pa'i chos gos kyis 'tsho bar mi bya'o/ /'tsho bar byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /yang dge slong zhig gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag g.yang gzhi 'chang bar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gti mug 'di ni mu stegs pa'i rgyal mtshan yin no zhes bya ba nas 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /yang dge slong zhig gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag gso ma'i seng ras kyi chos gos 'chang bar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'di ni mu stegs kyi ③rgyal mtshan yin no zhes bya ba dunas 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /yang dge slong zhig gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to⑤/ /btsun pa bdag pa char 'chang bar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skyes bu gti mug 'di lta ste/ pa char du'adi ni khyim pa'i chos yin te zhes bya ba nas 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /yang dge slong zhig gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag chos gos thams cad sngon por 'chang bar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 3—215

bka' stsal pa/ 'di ni khyim pa 'chang bar byed do/ /de lta bas na dge slong gis chos gos thams cad sngon por bcang bar mi bya'o zhes bya ba nas 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de bzhin du thams cad ser ba'am/ thams cad dmar ba'am/ dkar ba ni rung ba ma yin pa nyid do// //sdom la/ kha tshar ring dang gdengs ka dang / /ral ka ①gtsug tor thod dang ni/ /ra ②bal gos dang rnga bal tham/ /mchin nad kun dga' mthang gos bcas/ /yang dge slong zhig gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag kha tshar ring po'i ①chos gos 'chang bar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'di ni mu stegs pa'i rtags yin no/ /zhes bya ba nas 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o//yang dge slong zhig gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag kha tshar dugadengs ka lta bu'i chos gos 'chang bar 'tshal lo bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skyes bu gti mug 'di ni mu stegs pa'i rtags yin no zhes bya ba nas 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /yang dge slong zhig gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /btsun pa bdag ral ka ⑤'chang bar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skyes bu gti mug 'di ni khyim pa'i rtags yin no zhes bya ba nas 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'oX/ /yang dge slong zhig gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa 3—216

bdag gtsug tor ①bgyid par 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skyes bu gti mug 'di ni rgyakhyim pa'i rtags yin no zhes bya ba nas 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /yang dge slong zhig gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces ②gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag thod 'ching dubar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skyes bu gti mug 'di ni khyim pa'i rtags yin no zhes bya ba nas 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /yang dge slong zhig gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag ra bal gyi gos bcang bar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skyes bu gti mug 'di ni khyim pa'i rtags yin no/ /zhes bya ba nas 'gal tshabs can 0du 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /yang dge slong zhig gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag rnga bal gyi klam 'chang bar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skyes bu gti mug 'di ni khyim pa'i rtags yin no zhes bya ba nas 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' mchin nad can dge slong med pa'i gnas sgo 'phar ⑥med pa zhig tu dbyar gnas par dam bcas te snam sbyar med par 0de phyi rol du byung ba dang / de'i snam sbyar rkun pos khyer ro zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ de'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong gis dge slong med pa'i gnas sgo 'phar med par dbyar gnas par ⑧dam mi bca' zhing snam sbyar med par gang du yang 'gro bar mi bya'o/ /song na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' pho mchin ⑨nad 3—217

can na ba ①de'i nad g.yog tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo byed pa ③las char bab pa dang de snam sbyar gyon te 'gro ba'i spro ba med nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mthang gos dang ③bla gos su bcas pas 'gro bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang snam sbyar gzhag tu rung ba ni lnga ste/ dge slong dang bcas pa'i gnas sgo 'phar dang bcas pa dang / char bab pa dang du/ char 'bab tu dogs pa dang / 'bab chu'i pha rol tu 'gro bar 'dod pa dang / sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas dang / dge 'dun gyis gnang ba byin par gyur pa'o/ / //bar sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa/ dbyar dang dge tshul nyid dag gi/ /byung ⑤ba gnyis po dag dang ni/ /rnyed 0pa chung dang 'gyod pa dang / /dge 'dun rnyed dang de de'i ⑦yin/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams kyi ⑧chos gos kyi rnyed pa sbyin par bya'o zhes gsungs na/ dge slong rnams kyis dgag dbye byas pa'i mod kho na la ljongs rgyur dong ba dang de rnams kyi rnyed pa sus kyang ma blangs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de'i rnyed pa len du gzhug pa'i phyir dge slong la bcol nas 'gro bar bya'o/ /ma bcol ba'i dge slong gzhan dag gis blangs pa dang / dge slong rnams phan tshun rtsod par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ma bcol ba'i dge slong gis rnyed pa blang bar mi bya'o/ /blangs na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcol ba'i dge slong gzhan dag gis ma blangs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de rnams kyis thams cad mnod ⑨par bya'o/ /dge tshul rnams dong nas sus kyang rnyed pa ma blangs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 3—218

stsal pa/ de rnams kyi mkhan po dang slob dpon dag gis blang bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag rnyed pa chung ngu dag 'gyed par byed pa na rnyed pa chung ngu ①yin no snyam ②nas/ dong ba rnams kyi ma byin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang la bcol ba de rnams kyis blang bar bya'o/ /gzhan dag gis ma bcol bar dong ba dang de rnams kyi ①bus kyang ma blangs la/ dge slong rnams kyis kyang 'gyod pas ma blangs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ blang bar bya ste/ de la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /rnyed pa chung ngu gzhan dag bgor dumachog nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gzhan dag dang bsres ⑤la gtsug lag khang na gnas pa rnams kyis bgo bar bya ste/de la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /bcol bas rnyed pa chung ngu ma blangs na ma sha ka lnga'i rin yan chad ni nges par bda' bar bya'o/ /ri 'or 0zhig na khyim bdag cig yod pa des gtsug ⑦lag khang duzhig brtsigs nas/ de na ⑨gal te dge slong brgya gnas na ras yug brgya 'bul lo/ /de bzhin du dge slong gcig gnas na yang ras yug brgya kho na 'bul lo zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na gtsug lag khang de nyid du 0rgan zhugs gnyis shig dbyar gnas pa las khyim bdag des ras yug brgya bskur thab de gnyis kyis blangs nas phan tshun ⑫dpyad nas gcig gis smras pa/ rnyed pa tso'adi ni dge 'dun gyir 'gyur ro/ /cig shos kyis smras pa/ bdag cag kho na yir bya'agyur ro/ /gal te de lta na long byashig /des smras pa/ phan tshun rtsod par mi 'gyur grang / ji tsam na gcig gis kyang ma blangs nas tsode gnyis kyis yang dpyad pa/ de la ji ltar bsgrub ⑩par bya/ gcig gis smras pa/ dge slong rnams bos khrul de rnams 3—219

dang lhan cig bgo'o①/ /cig shos kyis smras pa/ de bzhin du bya ②na su 'gro/gang gzhon pa'o/ /gos rnams sus bsrung ②gang gzhon pas so/ /de ltar mi nus kyis dugang gzhon pa ni 'gro'o/ / gang rgan ⑤pa des ༷ni gos rnams bsrung ༅ngo / /de bzhin du bya'o zhes gzhon pa shos dge slong rnams bod ⑧pa'i phyir mnyan yod du song ngo / /drug sde ⑨rnams kyi kun tu spyod pa ni drug sde tho)rnams kyis rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi 0sgo re mos re tsomos 8mi stong 8par byed pa yin pas nye dga' rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi 8sgo na ⑩'dug pa des rgyang ring po kho na nas mgo spra ba'i me tog ltar skya ba smin ma ⑩'phyang ba zhig mthong nas bsams pa/ dge slong gnas brtan 8'di 'ga' zhig 'ong gis ⑩de bsur ⑥'gro'o snyam nas gnas brtan gnyebyon pa legs so byon pa legs so/ /slob dpon phyag 'tshal lo/ /des bsams pa/ 'di ni slob dpon yang mi shes/mkhan po yang mi shes te/ 'di ni rgan zhugs zhig yin no snyam du rig nas smras pa/ rgan 3zhugs khyod gang nas 'ongs/ ri 'or 0che ge mo ④zhig nas so/ /ci de na gtsug lag khang yod dam/ gtsug lag khang yod do/ /ci de gtsug lag khang yin nam/ 'on te phongs byapa yin/ des dzu nyeji ltar gyur pa rgyas par 0smras pa dang / khyod don ci zhig la 'ongs/ dge slong rnams dang bgo phyeba'i phyir ro/ /gal te de lta ()na nga kho nas khyod la snying brtse rgyaba'i phyir 'gro bar bya'o/ /slob dpon legs so/ / nye dga'as 0bsams pa/ gal te 'di bdag gi thad nas gzhan du song na skye bo'i tshogs chen pos shes par 'gyur gyisadu/ legs par bdag gis dubasrung bar bya'o snyam nas/ des de ngal sor (stebacug ste/ dus ma yin pa'i btung ba dag blud nas ci dunas kyang bre 3—220

mo gtam gyis ①nam sros kyi ②bar du brongs nas mal bzang po bshams te rkang ③pa bkru ba dang / rkang pa bsku ba byin nas ji tsam gnyid log par gyur pa de srid du bsdad do/ /de nas nye dga' gsang 'phel bar mi 'gyur grang snyam pa'i 'tsher bas mtshan mo de 'das par byas sobya/ /de nas de nang par sngar langs te / rgan zhugs de 0khrid nas rings pa rings par song ste/ rim gyis ri 'or 0du phyin ⑦pa dang / de nas gtsug lag khang na ⑧gnas pa'i rgan zhugs cig shos des 'ongs pa legs so zhes kun dga' bar gyur pa'i 8tshig smras nas de gnyis ngal sos ⑩pa dang khong gsum char 0yang gnas gcig tu 'tshogs nas/nye dga'as smras pa/ rnyed pa bgos 8shig /gnas brtan bgo'o/ /nye ⑫dga'as rgan zhugs gcig la smras pa/ rgan zhugs khyod kyis bgos shig /gnas brtan 8bdag ni mi 'gyed de'/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bdag la nyes pa byung na mi rung ngo / /cig shos la yang smras pa/ rgan zhugs khyod kyis bgos (9shig /des kyang de bzhin du smras pa dang / nye dga'as smras pa/khyed ⑩ni nyes pa byung bas 'jigs kyi/ nye dga' ni spyi'u tshugs su sems can dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur bar 4)'dod dam ci/ nye dga'as bsams pa/rgan zhugs hu'adi gnyis bsdong gis ⑥ dbyin bya'o snyam nas de nas de gnyis kyi rgyun du rung ba'i las byed pa'i g.yog po mthong nas gcig gi ⑥drung du song ste dris pa/ rgan zhugs khyod kyis 'dir ci dag byas/ gnas brtan ⑥bdag gis gtsug 6)lag khang ( nyedu rtag par (nyechag chag dang (9/ phyag dar dang /ba'i rtsi ba 'jam pos byug pa byas so/ /rgan zhugs gal te chag chag dang phyag dar byas pa kho nas rnyed pa thob pa 0na lta nye dga'as dugatsug lag khang thams 3—221

cad chag chag dang phyag dar bya'o/ /'on kyang 'dir rnyed pa byung ba gang yin pa de ni rgan zhugs cig shos de'i mthu ①yin te/ de gtsug lag khang du dus ②dus su chos 'don pa'i sbyin pa byed pas chos 'don pa don du gnyer ba'i lha spro ba dang ldan par gyur ②te/ des na rnyed pa rnyed par gyur gyisaX/ 'dis ci byin pa de blang ⑤bar bya ste 'khang bar mi bya'o/ /des de gnad la phab 0pas skyengs sgronas cang mi smra nibar 'dug go/ /de nas cig shos kyi drung du song nas smras pa/ rgan zhugs khyod kyis 'dir ci dag byas/ gnas brtan bdag gis 'dir 0dus dus su chos bsgrags pa'i sbyin pa byas so/ /rgan zhugs gal te chos bsgrags pas rnyed pa thob na lta nye dga'as 'greng ba dang / 'gro ba dang /'dug pa dang / nyal bas ⑩dus thams cad du chos bshad do/ /rnyed pa gang chung 4)zad grub pa de thams cad ni rgan zhugs cig shos de'i mthus yin te/des gtsug lag khang 'dir chag chag dang / phyag dar dang / ba'i rtsi ba 'jam pos 'byug pa byas pas 0so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag dar byed pa la yon tan lnga yod de/ lnga gang zhe na/ bdag nyid kyi 0sems dang bar 'gyur ba dang / gzhan gyi sems dang bar 'gyur ba dang / lha rnams yid dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / mdzes par 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba sogs ⑫par 'gyur ba dang / lus zhig nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten gyi lha rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro zhes bka' stsal to/ /de lta bas na gtsug lag khang phyag dar byas pas yon bdag mngon par dad par gyur la/ lha yid dga' bar gyur te/ des na der rnyed pa byung skyabar gyur to/ /de bas na de'i mthus 'dir rnyed pa byung bas des ci byin pa de blang ⑩bar bya ste 'khang bar mi bya'o/ /3—222

de yang gnad la phab pas skyengs nas cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /de gnyis spobs pa med par byas nas smras pa/ rgan zhugs dag bcom ldan 'das kyis gsol ba'i las mi 'khrugs ①pa gsungs pa'i thabs gzhan yod pas gsol ba byas la bgo'o/ /de gnyis kyis sngar sma ②phab pas smras pa gnas brtan ci dgyes ③pa de bzhin du mdzod cig /de nas nye rjodaga'as cha gsum du byas te/cha gnyis kyi bar rjodu ni rang nyid 'dug go/ /de gnyis kyi bar du ni cha gcig bzhag nas dugasol bar ①bya bar brtsams ⑧pa/ rgan zhugs khyed nyon cig⑨ /khyed gnyis dang 'di gcig /'di gnyis dang kho bo gcig ste/ de ltar na gsum gsum mo/ /'di ⑩ni gsol ba'o/ /de nas yicha gnyis ni bdag nyid kyis blangs so/ /cha gcig ni de gnyis la byin pa dang de gnyis kyis smras pa'/gnas brtan 'di kho na las bdag cag gnyis rtsod 8par 'gyur gyis8/ khyod kho nas bdag cag la bgos shig /des bgo tsobar brtsams nas 8de nas ras yug gcig kha khyer tho)du 'dug pa 4)de yang blangs nas ras rnams bam por bcings te song ngo / /de nas rim gyis mnyan yod du phyin pa dang de dge slong rnams kyis mthong nas smras pa/ btsun pa nye dga' khyod yikyis su zhig shi ba mthong ( )/ des ji ltar gyur pa rgyas par smras pa dang de rnams kyis smras pa/khyod 0de ltar byed pa brtags pa yin nam/ mi mdza' ba rnams kyi mgrin ⑥pa rdog pas mnan nas so/ /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs padu/ nyes dmigs gang ci byung ba ni dge slong rnams gzhan gyi rnyed pa la thob rgyal byed pa las gyur gyisatso/de lta bas na dge slong gis chagazhan gyi rnyed pa la thob rgyal mi bya'o/ /thob rgyal 3—223

byed ①na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas/the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa nye dga'as rgan zhugs de gnyis chos kyi sgo nas bslus pa la gzigs / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ltar 'ba' zhig tu ma zad de/ 'das pa'i dus na ji ltar 'dis rgan zhugs gnyis bslus pa de nyid ②nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'bab chu'i ngogs shig na sram gnyis shig gnas pa las de gnyis gang gi tshe chu'i nang du zhugs pa na nya skam la thon par 'gyur zhing gang gi tshe skam la dong ba de'i tshe chu'i nang du dong nas cung 0zad kyang ma rjornyed do/ /de nas de gnyis kyis gros byas pa/ bdag cag las gcig ni chu'i nang du 'gro'o/ /cig shos kyis ni skam la ste/ rnyed pa gang yin pa de ni spyir bya'o/ /de na dugacig ni chur song ngo /cig shos kyis 0ni skam la ste/ de la chur zhugs pa gang yin pas nya rnams bskyogs ⑦te skam la bton ⑧nas de rnams skam la gnas pas bsad do/ /chu la gnas pa ①ni chu la gnas pa nyid kyis so/ /ji tsam na nya'i phung po chen por gyur pa dang gcig gis smras pa/ khyod kyis bgos shig /cig shos kyis smras pa / bdag mi bgod do/ /ci'i phyir bdag la nyes pa byung na mi rung ngo / /des kyang smras pa/ gal te de lta na bdag la yang nyes pa 'di nyid yin no/ /de gnyis sems khong du 0chud cing 'dug pa las/ ji tsam na wa bzhin rgyas zhes bya ba de gnyis kyi drung du 'ongs nas des smras pa tsha bo dag ci ste sems khong du 4)chud cing 'dug /zhang po tho)bdag cag ni nya rnyed pas so/ /ci ste mi 'gyed(spre/ zhang po nyes pas 'jigs so/ /khyod (nyeni nyes pas 'jigs pa ⑫3—224

bzhin rgyas ni rkang pa spyi'u ②tshugs su sems can dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur bar 'dod dam ci/ bzhin rgyas kyis bsams pa/ 'di gnyis bsdong gis ②dbye bar bya'o snyam nas/ de nas de gnyis kyi rtag tu g.yog byed pa rus ①sbal zhig mthong nas gcig gi drung du song ste dris pa/ tsha bo khyod kyis 'dir ci dag byas / zhang po bdag chur zhugs te/ bdag chur zhugs nas nya rnams bskyogs 0te skam ⑤la 'thon 0pa dang 'dis bsad do/ /tsha bo gal te chur zhugs pas cung zad thob na lta bzhin rgyas rtag tu chu'i ⑦nang du 'gro'o/ /skam la 'gro ba de ⑧ni sdong dum gyis ⑨'jigs pa dang / tsher mas ⑩'jigs pa dang /gcan gzan gyis ⑩'jigs pa dang / me'i 8'jigs pa dang / ngam grog gi 'jigs pa yod do/ /gzhan yang gal te des ma bsad na/ khyod kyis bskrogs 8kyang ci phan/ mdor na 'dis 8nya rnyed pa gang yin pa 8de rnams ni de'i mthu yin pas 'dis ci byin pa de blang bar bya ste 'khang ⑩bar mi bya'o/ / de des chagand chal phab pas skyengs nas cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /de nas cig shos kyi ⑩drung du song nas smras pa/ tsha bo khyod kyis 'dir ci dag byas tshu/zhang po bdag gis skam la song ste bdag gis skam la thon pa'i nya rnams bsad do//tsha bo gal te skam la song bas cung 0zad thob na lta bzhin rgyas rtag tu skam la 'gro'o/ /chur 'gro ba ⑥de ni phyedaba' glong gis bu'ajigs pa dang / rus ⑫sbal gyis (9'jigs pa dang / chu srin byis pa gsod kyis du'ajigs pa dang /chu srin kum bi dura'i 'jigs pa dang / chu'i 'jigs pa yod do/ /gzhan yang gal te des ma bskrogs yin khyod kyis ji ltar gsadabya/ mdor na 'dir nya rnyed pa gang yin pa de rnams ni de'i mthu yin pas des 0ci byin pa de blang bar 3—225

bya ste 'khang ①bar mi bya'o/ / de des ②gnad la phab pas skyengs nas cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /bzhin rgyas kyis smras pa/ tsha bo dag 'di la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis mi g.yo bar bgo ba'i thabs yod do/ /de sngar sma phab pas smras pa/ zhang po ci dgyes ①pa dubazhin du mdzod cig /bzhin rgyas kyis cha gsum du ⑤bgos te/ nya'i mjug dum rnams gcig tu byas/ mgo bo rnams gcig tu byas/ bar gyi cha rnams gcig tu byas nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ thang la rgyu bas mjug ⑦ma ste/ /gting du rgyu bas mgo bo'o/ /bar gyi lus ni gang yin pa/ /de ni chos la gnas pas bkur/ /bzhin rgyas kyis bsams pa/ 'di gnyis bslus pas bdag rnyed pa dang ldan no snyam nas/des nya chen po zhig gi rked pa khyer te ma'i 0drung du song ba dang / de nas de'i ma mgu nas tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis ⑨dris pa/ bzhin rgyas khyod ni gang nas 'ongs/ /mgo yang med cing mjug med pa'i/ /nya bo che zhig thogs nas ni/ /shin tu don grub ga las 'ongs/ /des smras pa/ gang phyir blun po rtsod ⑩gyur cing / /chos dang chos min mi shes pa'iyi/ /rgyal po'i mdzod ni 'phel ba ltar/ /des ni chog 0shes 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /des kyang tshigs su bcad pas 0smras pa/ rgyas pa blta tson sdug pa khyod/ /pha rol mnan pa shin tu legs/ /de gnyis kyang ni mgu gyur la/ /khyod 8kyang rnyed pa phun sum tshogs/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems de'i tshe de'i dus kyi wa bzhin rgyas gang yin pa de ni nye dga' 'di nyid yin no/ /sram gnyis po ⑩gang yin pa de ni rgan zhugs 'di gnyis yin te/ de na yang de gnyis 'dis bslus la da ltar yang de gnyis bslus so//3—226

gling gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /ri 'or ①zhig na khyim bdag cig yod pa des gtsug lag khang zhig brtsigs ②nas der dge slong brgya dbyar gnas par dam bcas so/ /khyim bdag de'i blo skyes pa/ ras yug brgya bsgrubs te dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs ①tshod gsol nas/ dge slong re re la yang ras yug re re bskon no snyam mo/ /ji tsam na nye rjodaga'as khyim bdag che ge mo zhig gis dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs tshod gsol te/ re re la yang ras yug re re bskon no zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang bsams pa/ gal te de las ras yug gcig ma grub na bdag nye dga' ma yin no snyam ⑤nas de mgron rjodu ma bos bzhin du song ngo / /khyim bdag gis dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs tshod gsol nas ras rnams 'brim ⑦pa na⑧/ nye dga'as ras yug ⑨gcig blangs nas myur ba 0myur bar song ngo / /ji tsam na dge slong gcig gi ras chad do/ /khyim bdag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa ⑩bdag gis ras brgya legs par bgrangs te 'tshal te tsomachis na 'phags pa 'ga' zhig gis ras yug gnyis bsnams par ma gyur grang / dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ khyim bdag de lta 4)su zhig byed/ 'on kyang btsun pa nye dga' khyod kyis spyan drangs sam/'phags pa dag bdag gis spyan ma drangs so/ /des ras de khyer nas song ngo / /de nas khyim bdag de smod par brtsams pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis (sredagongs pa/nyes dmigs gang ci byung ba ni dge slong dag mgron 8du ma bos par gzhan gyi rnyed pa la thob rgyal byed ṅge las gyur gyis0/ de lta bas na dge slong gis mgron ⑫du ma bos par gzhan gyi rnyed pa la thob rgyal mi bya'o/ /thob rgyal byed na 'gal 3—227

tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' g.yar ma drangs par gzhan gyi rnyed pa la thob rgyal bgyid pa la gzigs/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ltar 'ba' zhig tu ma zad de/ ji ltar 'das pa'i dus na yang nye dga'as mgron ①du ma bos par ⑧gzhan gyi rnyed pa la thob rgyal byas pa de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba ri 'or ③zhig na bram ze 'khor la dbang sgyur dub zhig yod deX/ des bram ze'i khye'u brgya zla ba gsum ⑥mgron ⑦du bos te zan byin nas de'i blo skyes pa/ bram ze'i khye'u re re la yang ras yug re re bskon duno snyam mo/ /de dang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig na bram ze rgan po zhig yod ⑨pa des thos nas de rgan pa'i ⑩mthar 'dug ste/ thog mar zos nas ras yug gcig khyer nas song ngo /bram zes ras rnams 'brim 0par byed pa na/ ji tsam na bram ze'i khye'u gcig gi tsunyeras chad nas des dris pa/ shes ldan dag bdag gis ras yug brgya legs par bgrangs te 'ongs na bram ze'i khye'u 'ga' zhig gis ras yug gnyis blangs par ma gyur grang / de rnams kyis smras pa/ de ltar su zhig bgyid/'on kyang khyod kyis bram ze rgan po mgron 'du bos sam/ bdag gis mgron ④du ma bos so/ /des ras yug de thog mar blangs nas song ngo / /bram ze des smad par brtsams 8so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na ⑩byam ze rgan po gang yin pa de ni nye dga' 'di nyid yin te/ de na yang de mgron ⑩du ma bos so/ /da lta na yang ngo //gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod tsona'o/ /ri 'or yizhig na khyim bdag cig yod 3—228

pa des gtsug lag khang zhig brtsigs nas der ①dge slong gcig dbyar gnas par dam bcas pa las de ldang ②ba phun sum tshogs pa zhig pas/ des nyi ma re re zhing gtsug lag khang byug pa dang phyag dar byed do/ /gtsug lag khang de ni sa phyogs dben zhing bzang ba'i phyogs su brtsigs la/ shing sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang / rma bya dang / ne tso ③dang / ri skegs dang / khu byug rnams skad 'byin pa/ me tog dang 'bras bu sna tshogs kyis dumadzes par byas pa yin no/ /ji tsam na ded dpon 'byor pa rgya chen po dang ldan pa zhig gtsug lag khang der dgongs btab pa las/des dugatsug lag khang de mdzes pa dang / nye ba'i tshal mdzes pa dag mthong nas mngon par dad par gyur te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun ma mthong yang de'i ched du rnyed pa phal mo che zhig bskur nas de nang par sngar langs te song ngo /dge slong de 'dzem dubag can zhig pas rnyed pa 'di ni dge 'dun gyi yin no zhes 'gyod pas ⑦ma blangs par bgo ba'i phyir dge slong rnams tshol bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te dge slong gis ba'i rtsi ba'i khang par dbyar gnas par dam bcas par gyur kyang / der gal te bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis dge 'dun gyi ched du rnyed pa nyung ngu'am phal mo cher phul na/de na gnas pa gcig gam/ gnyis sam/ rab tu mang po gang yin pa de rnams kho na'i ste de la 'gyod par mi bya'o// //sdom la/ bye khyab rnams la skal ba ni/ /sbyin dang drang srong rgyu ba las/ /3—229

dge 'dun gyi ①ni chos gos kyi/ /rnyedu pa brgyad du bya ba'o/ /gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /sangs rgyas bcorme ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ②'khor gyis zhus pa/ ri btsun pa dbyar gyi nang logs su dge 'dun bye ②bar gyur na rnyed pa stsal dubar bgyi'am mi stsal bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nye ba ⑤'khor kha cig la ni sbyin no/ /kha cig la ni mi sbyin no//gang la stsal 0bar bgyi/ chos dang mthun pa'i phyogs la'o/ /btsun pa dbyar gyi nang logs su dge slong ⑦gis bslab ⑧pa phul te nyams par gyur na rnyed pa stsal ⑨bar bgyi'am/ mi stsal bar bgyi/ nye ba ⑩'khor kha cig la ni sbyin no/ /kha cig la ni mi sbyin no/ /gang la stsal bar bgyi/ gang yun ring du gnas pa la'o / /btsun pa dbyar gyi nang logs su dge slong gum par gyur na rnyed pa stsal 0bar bgyi'am/ rnyed pa stsal tshubar mi bgyi/ nye ba 0'khor kha cig la ni sbyin no/ /kha cig la ni mi sbyin no/ /gang la stsal bar bgyi/ gang yun ring du gnas pa la'o/ /ri 'or byazhig na khyim bdag cig yod pa des yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i gtsug lag khang zhig brtsigs 8so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu ljongs rgyu zhing song ba las gtsug lag khang ⑩der phyin pa dang khyim bdag des zas byin nas ras yug lnga brgya byin pa dang / des ras yug lnga brgya po de rnams gtsug lag khang de nyid du phul nas song ngo / /ji tsam na de'i lhan cig gnas pa drang srong len byadang / drang srong byin gnyis ljongs rgyu zhing song 8ba las ri 'or ⑩de nyid du 0phyin nas khyim bdag des de gnyis kyang 0zan byin nas ras yug lnga brgya dubyin no/ /dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed kyi 4)mkhan pos khyim bdag de las (steras yug lnga brgya thob pa de 3—230

rnams bdag cag kho na la bgos kyis ①de ring gi rnyed pa 'di rnams bdag cag ②kho nas thob par 'gyur ro/ /de gnyis kyis smras pa/ mkhan po ni bsod nams che ba shes rab dang ldan pa yin te/ des lan 'ga' khyed cag la byin par zad do/ /de rnams kyis slar ②lan glan par brtsams pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rnyed pa brgyad po 'di dag ste/ brgyad gang zhe na/mtshams kyis thob pa'i rnyed pa dang / khrims kyis thob pa'i rnyed pa dang / rten gyis thob ༷pa dang / dge 'dun phyir brtags ⑤pa dang / dge slong gir brtags rjopa dang / dbyar gyi dang / mngon sum ⑦dang / so sor bstan ⑧pa'o/ /mtshams kyis thob pa'i rnyed pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gnas gnyis ⑨la gso sbyong gcig pa ⑩ste/ gtsug lag khang de gnyis kyi yirnyed pa gang yin pa de ni gtsug tshulag khang de gnyis ku'i 0gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge slong rnams kyi yin no/ /de la gzhug mar gnas pa'i dge slorngo rnams kyis brgya tshul gso sbyong tha dad par dbyar gnas par byadam bcas na de la rnyed pa grub pa gang yin pa de ni gtsug lag khang de nyid du sbyin no0/ /gso sbyong tha dad pa nyid kyis de'i gnyug ⑩mar gnas pa'i dge slong rnams kyis longs spyad par bya ste/ 'di ni mtshams kyis thob pa'i rnyed pa zhes bya'o/ /khrims kyis thob pa'i 8rnyed pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dge slong rnams kyis 'di lta bu'i khrims su bca' ba khyed kyi ni khyim che ge mo zhig go/ /kho bo cag gi ni khyim che ge mo zhig go/ /lam chen po yidang / tshong dus dudang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo ni spyi'i yin no/ /zhes bya ba nas dbyar gnas par dam bcas pa las gal te bram ze 3—231

dang khyim bdag de rnams kyis dam bcas pa rnams kyi ①gnas su dam bcas pa dang / dam ma bcas pa'i dge slong rnams zan byin nas dam bcas pa rnams la rnyed pa phul la dam ma bcas pa rnams la chu drangs na/ rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur zhe na dam bcas pa rnams kho na'o/ /dam bcas pa rnams kyi gnas su dam bcas pa dang / dam ma bcas pa'i dge slong rnams zan byin nas dam bcas pa rnams la chu drangs la/ dam ma bcas pa rnams la rnyed pa phul na rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur zhe na/ dam bcas pa rnams ②kho na'o// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po drug bcu ②lnga pa/ dam bcas pa rnams kyi gnas su dam bcas pa dang / dam ma bcas pa'i dge slong rnams zan byin nas dam bcas pa rnams la rnyed pa phul la/ dam ma dubacas pa nyid dul chu drangs na rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur zhe na/ dam bcas pa rnams kho na'o/ /dam bcas pa rnams kyi gnas su dam bcas pa dang / dam ma bcas pa'i dge slong rnams zan byin nas rgan pa'i mthar rnyed pa phul la/ dam bcas pa rnams la chu drangs na rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur zhe na/ dam bcas pa rnams kho na'o/ /dam bcas pa rnams kyi gnas su dam bcas pa dang / dam ma bcas pa'i dge slong rnams zan byin nas dam bcas pa rnams la rnyed pa phul la/ rgan pa'i mthar chu drangs na rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur zhe na/dam bcas pa rnams kho na'o/ / dam bcas pa rnams kyi gnas su rjodam bcas pa dang / dam ma bcas pa'i dge slong rnams zan byin nas rgan pa'i mthar ⑦rnyed pa phul la/ dam ma bcas pa rnams la chu drangs na rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur zhe na/ dam ⑧bcas pa rnams kho na'o/ /dam bcas pa rnams kyi 3—232

gnas su dam bcas pa dang / dam ma bcas pa'i dge slong rnams zan byin nas rgan pa'i mthar 'dug la/ dam bcas pa rnams la rnyed pa phul la/①dam ma ②bcas pa rnams la chu drangs na rnyed ①pa gang dbang bar 'gyur zhe na/dam bcas pa rnams kho na'o/ /dam bcas pa rnams kyi gnas su dam bcas pa dang / dam ma bcas pa'i dge slong rnams zan byin nas dam ma bcas pa rnams la rnyed pa phul la rgan pa'i mthar chu drangs dun rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur zhe na/ dam bcas pa rnams kho na'o/ /dam bcas pa rnams kyi gnas su dam bcas pa dang / dam ma bcas pa'i dge slong rnams zan byin nas rgan pa'i mthar rnyed pa phul ladu/ rgan pa'i mthar chu drangs na rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur zhe na/ dam bcas pa rnams kho na'o/ /ji ltar dam bcas pa rnams kyi duganas su dam bcas pa dang / dam ma bcas pa'i dge slong rnams zan byin nas zhes bya ba rnam grangs dgu ⑦yin pa de bzhin du dam ma bcas pa rnams kyi gnas su dam bcas pa'i dge slong rnams zan byin nas zhes bya ba rnam grangs dgu'o/ /gal te bram ze dang khyim bdag de rnams kyis lam po che dang /tshong dus ⑧dang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo rnams su dam bcas pa dang /dam ma bcas pa'i dge slong rnams zan byin nas dam bcas pa rnams la rnyed pa phul la/ dam bcas pa rnams kho na la chu drangs na rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur zhe na/ gnyi ga'o/ /lam po che dang / tshong dus ⑨dang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo rnams su dam bcas pa dang / dam ma bcas pa'i dge slong rnams 0zan byin nas dam bcas pa rnams la rnyed pa phul la/ dam ma bcas pa rnams la zlu drangs na rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur zhe na/ gnyi ga'o⑩/ /3—233

lam po che dang / tshong dus ①dang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo rnams su dam bcas pa dang / dam ma bcas pa'i dge slong rnams ②zan byin nas dam ma bcas pa rnams la rnyed pa phul la/ dam ③bcas pa rnams la chu drangs na rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur zhe na/ gnyi ga'odu/ /lam po che dang /tshong dus ⑤dang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo rnams su dam bcas pa dang /dam ma bcas pa'i dge slong rnams zan byin nas dam ma bcas pa rnams la rnyed pa phul la/ dam bcas pa rnams kho na la chu drangs na rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur zhe na/ gnyi ga'o0/ /lam po che dang / tshong dus ⑦dang /bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo rnams su dam bcas pa dang / dam ma bcas pa'i dge slong rnams zan byin nas rgan pa'i mthar rnyed pa phul la/ dam bcas pa rnams la chu drangs na rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur zhe na/ gnyi ga'o⑧/ /lam po che dang / tshong dus ⑨dang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo rnams su dam bcas pa dang / dam ma bcas pa'i dge slong rnams 0zan byin nas dam bcas pa rnams la rnyed pa phul la/ rgan pa'i mthar chu drangs yin rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur zhe na/ gnyi ga'o/ /lam po che dang / tshong dus tsodang /bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo rnams su dam bcas pa dang / dam ma bcas pa'i dge slong rnams zan byin nas rgan pa'i mtha' logs su rnyed pa phul la/ dam ma bcas pa rnams la chu drangs na rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur zhe na/ gnyi ga'o/ /lam po che dang / tshong dus tsodang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo ⑫rnams su dam bcas pa dang / dam ma bcas pa'i dge slong rnams zan byin nas/ dam ma bcas pa rnams la rnyed pa phul la/ rgan pa'i mthar chu 3—234

drangs na rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur zhe na/ gnyi ga'o/ /lam po che dang /tshong dus ①dang / bzhi ②mdo dang / sum mdo rnams su khas dudam bcas pa dang / dam ma dubacas pa'i dge slong rnams zan byin nas rgan pa'i mthar rnyed ①pa phul la/ rgan pa'i mtha' 0nyid du chu drangs na rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur zhe na/ gnyi ga'o/ /ji ltar ⑦dam bcas pa rnams la rnam pa dgu yin pa de bzhin du dam ma bcas pa rnams la yang brjod par bya ste/ 'di ni khrims kyis thob pa'i rnyed pa zhes bya'o/ /rten gyis rnyed pa gang zhe na/ dge slong skyes pa'am/ bud med dam/ ma ning gang la brten ⑤te dbyar gnas par dam bcas pa des rnyed pa byin pa gang yin pa de ni de 0kho na'i yin te/'di ni rten gyis ⑩thob pa'i rnyed pa zhes bya'o/ /dge 'dun gyir brtags ⑩pa'i rnyed pa gang zhe na/ rnyed pa gang zhig nges la dmigs kyis phye ba ste/ 'di ni dge 'dun gyir brtags 8pa'i 8rnyed pa zhes bya'o/ /dge slong gir brtags ⑫pa'i rnyed pa gang zhe na/ rnyed pa gang zhig nges la dmigs kyis phye nas gnas khang pa'i'o/ /yang thog pa'i'o/ /khang pa brtsegs pa'i'o zhes brtags 8pa ni de na dge slong gnas pa gang yin pa de kho na'i ste/ 'di ni dge slong gir brtags ⑩pa'i rnyed pa zhes bya'o/ /dbyar gyi rnyed pa gang zhe na/ rnyed pa gang zhig dbyar gnas pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la sbyin bdag rnams kyis ⑩bcas pa ste/ 'di ni dbyar gyi rnyed pa zhes bya'o/ /mngon sum gyi rnyed pa gang zhe na/ rnyed pa gang zhig ma nges la dmigs kyis ma phye ba 8ste/ 'di ni mngon sum gyi rnyed pa zhes bya'o/ /so sor bstan pa'i rnyed pa gang zhe na/ rnyed pa gang zhig bltams 0pa dang / byang chub pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo dang /3—235

yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa la phul ba ste/ gal te mchod rten chen po bzhir khyer ①mi nus na mchod rten gcig kho na la dbul gyi ②gzhan la ni ma yin pa ste/'di ni so sor bstan pa'i rnyed pa zhes bya'o// //sdom la/ gnas nas phyung dang shi ba dang / /bgo ba dang ni bsre ba dang //gnas nas phyung dang dge tshul dang / /dbyung ba gsol dang shi ba'o/ /gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ②'khor gyis 0zhus pa/ btsun pa 'di ltar gnas gcig na gnas nas phyung ba rab tu mang po dang / rang bzhin du gnas pa rab tu mang po mchis pa la/de rnams las gnas nas phyung ba zhig gum pa de'i yo byad gang dbang bar 'gyur lags/ nye ba ⑤'khor rang bzhin du gnas pa rnams so/ /btsun pa gnas nas phyung ba ni gnyis mchis la rang bzhin du gnas pa ni rab tu mang 0po lags na/ gnas nas phyung ⑦ba zhig gum na rnyed pa ⑧gang dbang bar 'gyur lags/ rang bzhin du gnas pa rnams kho na'o/ /gnas nas phyung ba ni rab tu mang po zhig mchis la/ rang bzhin du gnas pa ni nyung ba las gnas nas khyaphyung ba zhig gum ⑩lags na rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur lags/ rang bzhin du gnas pa rnams kho na'o/ /btsun pa 'di ltar gnas gcig na gnas nas byung ba rab tu mang po dang rang bzhin du gnas pa rab tu mang po mchis pa la / de rnams las rang bzhin du gnas pa zhig gum lags na rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur lags/ rang bzhin du gnas pa rnams so/ /gnas nas phyung ba rab tu mang po zhig mchis la rang bzhin du gnas pa gnyis mchis pa las/3—236

rang bzhin du gnas pa zhig gum ①lags na gum pa de'i yo byad gang dbang bar 'gyur lags/ rang bzhin du gnas pa cig shos so/ /gnas nas phyung ba ni rab tu mang la rang bzhin du gnas pa ni gcig mchis pa ②gum na rnyed pa gang dbang bar 'gyur lags/ gnas nas phyung ba rnams las thog mar sdig pa'i lta bar song ba spangs pa gang yin pa'o/ /dam bcas pa rnams kyi gnas su dam ma bcas pa'i dge tshul 'ongs nas shi na dam bcas pa rnams kyis dam ma bcas pa rnams la khyed kyi dge tshul shi yis ①de'i chos gos dang lhung bzed long ༷shig ces pho nya gtang dubar bya'o/ /dam bcas pa rnams 'ged ①par byed na ma bgos pa nyes par ⑦bgos pa yin no/ /dam ma bcas pa rnams 'ged ①par byed na bgos pa legs par ⑨bgos pa yin no/ /bsres ⑩nas 'ged 0par byed na ma bgos pa nyes par bgos 0pa yin no/ /phyogs bzhi'i tsodage slong gi dge 'dun la sngo ba 0byed na legs par bsngos ༅pa yin no/ /dam bcas pa rnams kyi gnas su dam ma bcas pa'i dge tshul 'ongs nas 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag drang du gsol/ dam bca' bar bgyi'o zhes smra ba las de yang ma phyung skyabar shi nas 0dam bcas pa rnams kyis dam ma bcas pa rnams la khyed kyi dge tshul shi yis 8de'i chos gos dang lhung bzed long ⑩shig ces pho nya gtang dubar bya'o/ /dam bcas pa rnams 'ged par byed na ma bgos pa nyes par bgos pa yin no/ /dam ma bcas pa rnams du'aged par byed na bgos pa legs par bgos phyopa yin no/ /bsres te 'ged 0par byed na ma bgos pa nyes par bgos pa yin no/ /phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la sngo ④bar byed na legs par bsngos pa yin no/ /dam bcas pa rnams kyi gnas su dam ma 3—237

bcas pa'i dge slong zhig 'ongs nas shi na dam bcas pa rnams kyis dam ma bcas pa rnams la khyed kyi tshangs pa mtshungs ①par spyod pa shi yis ②de'i lhung bzed dang ②chos gos long 0shig ces pho nya gtang ⑤bar bya'o/ /khas blangs pa rnams 'ged 0par byed na ma bgos pa nyes par bgos ⑦pa yin no/ /dam ma bcas pa rnams 'ged par byed na bgos pa legs par bgos pa yin no/ /bsres ⑤te 'ged par byed na ma bgos pa nyes par ⑨bgos pa yin no/ /phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la sngo 0bar byed na legs par bsngos pa yin no/ /dam bcas pa rnams kyi gnas su dam ma bcas pa'i dge slong 'ongs nas skye'adi skad ces tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag drang du gsol/ dam bca' bar bgyi'o zhes zer ba las de yang ma byung 8ba nyid du shi na dam bcas pa rnams kyis dam ma bcas pa rnams la khyed kyi tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa shi yis ⑫de'i lhung bzed dang chos gos long ④shig ces pho nya gtang 8bar bya'o/ /khas blangs pa rnams 'ged 0par byed na ma bgos pa nyes par ⑩bgos pa yin no/ /dam ma bcas pa rnams 'ged 8par byed na bgos pa legs par bgos pa yin no//bsres nas 'ged par byed yin ma bgos pa nyes par bgos pa yin no/ /phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la sngo 0bar byed na legs par bsngos pa yin no/ /dam ma bcas pa rnams kyi gnas su dam bcas pa'i dge tshul 'ongs nas shi na dam ma bcas pa rnams kyis dam bcas pa rnams la khyed kyi dge tshul shi yis ⑥de'i lhung bzed dang chos gos long ⑥shig ces pho nya gtang 0bar bya'o/ /dam ma bcas pa rnams 'ged par byed na ma bgos pa nyes par bgos pa yin no/ /dam bcas pa rnams 'ged par byed na bgos pa legs par bgos pa yin no/ /3—238

bsres te 'ged par byed na ma bgos pa nyes par bgos pa yin no/ /phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la sngo ①bar byed na legs par bsngos pa yin no/ /dam ma bcas pa ②rnams kyi laganas su dam bcas pa'i dge tshul 'ongs nas 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag drang du gsol/ dam ma bcas par bgyi'o zhes zer ba las de yang ma phyung dubar shi na dam ma bcas pa rnams kyis dam bcas pa rnams la khyed kyi dge tshul shi yis ⑤de'i lhung bzed dang chos gos long rjoshig ces pho nya gtang ⑦bar bya'o/ /dam ma bcas pa rnams 'ged par byed na ma bgos pa nyes par ⑧bgos pa yin no/ /dam bcas pa rnams 'ged ⑨par byed na bgos pa legs par bgos pa yin no/ /bsres te 'ged par byed na ma bgos pa nyes par bgos pa yin no/ /phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la sngo ()bar byed na legs par bsngos pa yin no/ /dam ma 4sprebacas pa rnams kyi gnas su dam bcas pa'i dge slong 'ongs nas ⑩shi na dam ma bcas pa rnams kyis dam bcas pa rnams la khyed kyi tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa shi yis tsode'i lhung bzed dang chos gos long 8shig ces pho nya gtang tunyebar bya'o / /dam ma bcas pa rnams 'ged par byed na ma bgos pa nyes par bgos pa yin no/ /dam bcas pa rnams 'ged par byed na bgos 0pa legs par bgos pa yin no/ /bsres te 'ged 0par byed na ma bgos pa nyes par bgos pa yin no/ /phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la sngo tsobar byed na legs par bsngos pa yin no/ /dam ma yibacas pa rnams kyi gnas su dam bcas pa'i dge slong 'ongs na me 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag drang du gsol / dam ma bcas par bgyi'o zhes smra ba (sprelas de yang ma phyung slebar 3—239

shi na dam ma bcas pa rnams kyis ①dam bcas pa rnams la khyed kyi tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa shi yis ②de'i lhung bzed dang chos gos long ②shig ces pho nya gtang rjobar bya'o/ /dam ma bcas pa rnams 'ged par byed na ma bgos pa nyes par bgos pa yin no/ /dam bcas pa rnams 'ged par byed na bgos pa legs par bgos pa yin no/ /bsres te 'ged par byed na ma bgos pa nyes par bgos pa yin no/ /phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la sngo ⑤bar byed na legs par bsngos pa yin no// // sdom ni/ nye dga' dang ni byin gyis brlabasaX/ /bar ma sbyin dang blang ②bya dang / /bdag shi sbyin pa med pa dang / /spang ba dang ni mi gsum mo/ /gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /nye dga'i spyi bor phol mig cig byung nas de sman pa'i gan du song nas bzhin bzangs kho bo la sman ⑤ston cig /des smras pa/ 'phags pa mar khu gsol cig dang sos par 'gyur ro/ /nye dga'as bsams pa/ gal te de ring kho na 'thungs na ⑨de ring nyid du sos par 'gyur ⑩na/ sang mar dang gos bslang bar ⑩ji ltar rung bar 'gyur gyisagare zhig bslangs tshul phyi (stenas btung tunyebar tsobya'o snyam du shes nas/ bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa des lhan cig gnas pa dang nye gnas ⑩rnams kun tu mngags pa dang / de rnams kyis mar gyi bum pa dang rma g.yogs 8pa'i gos phal mo che bslangs yiso/ /phyi de nyin par sman pas dris pa/ 'phags pa khyod snyan gdangs sam/ khyod kyis mar gsol tam/ bzhin bzangs ma 'thungs dusol/ /'phags pa ma legs pa zhig bgyis kyis (7deng nyis 'gyur 'du gsol 3—240

cig /des lhan cig gnas pa dang nye gnas rnams la smras pa/ sman pas ji skad smras pa thos sam/ mkhan po thos ①lags so/ /kho bo'i nad 'di ni cher skyes par gyur te/ mar dang rma g.yogs pa'i ②gos mang du dgos kyis 7slongs shig /de rnams kyis mar dang gos phal mo che bslangs so/ /de sang 0gi thabs la chags par gyur pas nyi ma de la yang ma 'thungs pas de'i nad rab tu skyes par gyur to/ /ji tsam na yang sman pa 'ongs nas dris pa/ 'phags pa mar gsol tam/ bzhin bzangs ma 'thungs duso/ /'phags pa ma legs pa zhig bgyis so/ /des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs de ring ni sum 'gyur ⑦tu btung ngo / /sman pas smras pa/ 'phags pa gal te mar gyi sgrom gyi nang du nub par gyur nyukyang da ni khyod la srog ma mchis so/ /des smras pa/ gshin rje'i g.yog 'dra ba khyod kyi mgul pa rdog pas mnan la mar 'thungs dang sos par 'gyur ro/ /sman pa des mjal duto zhes byas nas khros te song ngo de nas nye dga'as mar khus lhung bzed bkang ste 'thungs pa las ma zhu nas shi'o/ /de la gser mang du yod de/ cha gcig ni chos gos las so/ /cha gnyis pa ni nad kyi rkyen sman las so/ /cha gsum pa ni rdungs su ⑨byas pa dang ma byas pa las te/ gser srang sum 0khri byung ngo zhes blon po rnams kyis thos nas rgyal po la smras pa/ lha 'phags pa nye dga' gum pa las de la gser mang du byung ste/gser srang sum khri mchis kyis 0de la bka' stsal pa'i rigs so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gal te de lta na deng tsol de'i gnas khang rgyas thob shig /dge slong rnams de khyer 0te sreg tu dong ngo / /de rnams kyang lhags nas gnas khang rgyas btab bo/ /dge slong rnams kyis de 8dur khrod du bsregs tsonas 3—241

gtsug ①lag khang du 'ongs pa na gnas khang rgyal po'i rgyas btab pa mthong snonas/skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / de nas ②bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo dusong la nga'i tshig gis rgyal po gsal rgyal la nad med par gyur cig ces byos la/ 'di skad ces rgyal po chen po gang gi tshe khyod rgyal po'i bya ba byed pa de'i tshe khyod kyis dge slong nye dga' la bltas sam/ 'on te gang gi tshe khyod bag ma gtong ba'am bag ma len pa de'i tshe nye dga' la lan 'ga' khyod kyis ji srid 'tsho ba'i 0chos gos dang bsod snyoms medang gnas mal dang / na ba'i rkyen rtsi dang / yo byad rnams kyis bstabs sam/ 'on te na ba la ④rim gro byas sam zhes gyis shig gal te ma bgyis so zhes smra na/ de la rgyal po chen po khyim pa rnams kyi khyim gyi bya ba dang / rab tu byung ba rnams kyi tha dad pas sems las chung ngus gnas par gyis shig /rnyed pa 'di ni tshangs pa dumatshungs par spyod pa rnams dbang bar 'gyur bas gtogs 'dod thong 0shig ces smros shig /btsun 0pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi 0ltar mnyan nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ ji skad bka' stsal pa bzhin smras 8pa dang / rgyal pos smras pa/ btsun pa kun dga' bo 0bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' ji skad stsal pa de ④bzhin du bgyi ⑩ste/ bdag gtogs 'dod mi bgyid do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos rgyal pos tshulan gsol paX/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 4)dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed tho)kyis dge slong nye dga' shi ba'i yo byad 3—242

bgos shig /dge slong rnams kyis dge 'dun gyi dbus su phyung ste bsgyur ①nas bgos so/ /gnas bcas kyi dge slong rnams kyis nye dga' shi nas de la gser mang du byung ste/ gser srang sum khri dge slong rnams kyis bgos ②so zhes thos nas de rnams myur bar mnyan yod du lhags nas smras pa/ bdag cag kyang btsun pa nye dga'i tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa yin pas bdag cag kyang de'i rnyed pa la dbang bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong rnams kyis bsdus te de dag dang lhan cig yang bgos so/ /yangs pa can pa ③dang / bā rā ṇa sī ba dang /rgyal po'i khab pa dang / tsam pa pa'i dge slong rnams kyis kyang yang dang yang bsdus nas bgos te/ de ltar grong khyer chen po drug na gnas pa'i dge slong rnams 'dus so/ /dge slong rnams sdud 0cing 'ged pa na lung nod pa dang /klog pa dang / 'don pa dang / yid la byed pa bor ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rnyed pa bgo 0ba'i rgyu ni lnga ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ gaṇḍi dudang /rgyud chags gsum dang / mchod rten dang / tshul shing dang / lnga pa ni gsol ba'o/ /shi ba'i gaṇḍi rdung ba dun 'ongs pa gang yin pa de la rnyed pa sbyin te/ rgyud chags gsum 'don pa dang / mchod rten la phyag byed pa dang /tshul shing 'brim 0pa dang / gsol ba byed pa na yang de bzhin no/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na shi ba'i yo ⑨byad thams cad gsol bar ⑩byas te bgos na mi 'khrug ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar yang bya huste/ gnas mal bshams la zhes bya ba nas dge 'dun thams cad tshogs shing mthun par gyur pa 0dang zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin no(ste/ /shi ba'i yo byad rgan pa'i mthar bzhag ste/3—243

dge slong gcig gis rgan pa'i mthar 'dug la gsol ba ①bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gnas 'dir dge slong nye dga' gum ste/gum pa de'i yo byad gda' ba dang mi gda' ba mchis pa 'di lags te/ gal te dge 'dun gyi ②dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / 'di ltar dge 'dun gyis dge slong nye dga' gum pa'i yo byad kyi durdzas gda' ba dang mi gda' ba la gum pa'i yo byad du byin gyis brlab bobya/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge slong dag 'di ni shi ba'i yo byad bgos zin pa ste/'di lta ste gsol ba'o/ /gsol ba byas nas dge slong ⑤'ongs pa gang yin pa de la ni rnyed pa mi sbyin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa nye ba du'akhor gyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa gang na ⑦dge 'dun mi mthun pas gsol ba ⑧bgyid pa ma mchis pa der gum pa'i yo byad bgo bar bgyi'am/ bgo bar mi bgyi ⑨lags/ nye ba ⑩'khor thog ma dang tha ma 0byas nas bgo bar bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis thog ma dang tha ma ma shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ yo byad gcig bsgyur tho)te de las cung zhig dge 'dun gyi ()rgan pa dang / dge 'dun gyi yigazhon pa la byin nas ci dga' bar bgo bar bya ste/de la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /gsol ba'am thog ma dang tha ma ma byas pa'i shi ba'i ⑫yo byad kyi rnyed pa ni sangs rgyas kyi slob ma thams cad dbang bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' ma 'os ⑩pa'i chags pas gum par gyur pa (sprel gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag da ltar 8'ba' zhig tu ma zad de/ ji ltar 'das pa'i dus na 3—244

yang ma 'os par nyuchags pas shi ba de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba rngon pa zhig gis mda' dug can gyis glang po che'i gnad du bsnun pa dang / de nas de gnad la bab pa'i tshor bas nyen cing mda'i phyi rjes bzhin du song nas rngon pas ②de srog dang phral lo/ /ji tsam na ma stes te chom rkun pa ②lnga brgya ri 'or duzhig bcom nas phyogs der phyin pa dang / de rnams kyis glang po che de mthong ngo / /mu ge dang bcas pa'i dus byung bas de rnams kyis smras pa/shes ldan dag sha 'di rnyed kyis ⑤nyis brgya lnga bcus ni ༷glang po che'i sha bcad la btso'o/ /nyis brgya lnga bcus ni chu blang ①ngo / / de na 0glang po che'i sha gcod ⑨cing 'tshed ⑩pa gang yin pa de rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ shes ldan dag bdag cag 'di 'dra ba'i las byas pas rkun 0rdzas rab tu mang po 'di grub kyis ⑫de dag la ci'i phyir sbyin/ sha las ci yog pa zos la lhag ma dug gis tsogadab bo//de dag gis sha dug can zos pa tsodang 'chi bas rkun tunyerdzas bdag gir 'gyur ro zhes de rnams kyis ci yog pa'i sha zos nas lhag ma dug gis btab bo/ /gang dag chu la dong ba de rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du dpyad nas chu ci yog pa 4)'thungs nas lhag ma ⑩dug blugs te 'ongs nas gang dag gis ni 8sha zos pa de rnams kyis kyang chu 'thungs layi/ gang dag ⑥ chu 'thungs pa de dag gis kyang sha zos nas thams cad shi bar gyur to/ /ji tsam na wa zhig dus kyi zhags pas bcings nas phyogs der 'ongs nas des ro de dag thams cad mthong ngo / /de nas chags pas bskyed pa'i yid bde bas bsams pa/ bdag la rnyed pa phal mo che yod kyis 0rim bzhin du bya'o snyam nas/ des gzhu mchog khar bcug ste gzhu rgyud dukyi rtod pa rgyus pa bca' bar 0brtsams te/ de nas rgyus pa chod pa ④3—245

dang mchog mas rkan ①la zug nas shi bar gyur to/ /lhas tshigs su bcad pas smras pa/ bsags ③par yang ni bya ba ste/ /lhag par bsags ②par mi bya'o/ /sogs khal chags pa'i wa long ba/ /gzhu yis bsad par gyur la ltos/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi wa gang yin pa de ni nye dga' 'di nyid yin te/ de na yang 'di ③lhag par ༷chags pas shi'o/ /da ltar yang 'di dulhag par chags pas shi bar gyur to//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /de'i tshe dge slong nad kyis thebs pa sdug bsngal ba nad tshabs che ba zhig yod pa de ⑧dge slong gis rim gro byas na ⑨'on kyang shi bar gyur nas de'i 0lhung bzed dang chos yigos rgan pa'i tsomathar khyer ba dang / de nas chos gos gcig bshang gci yidag gis 'bags shing sbrang ma rnams 'du bar gyur to/ /de nas gos 'ged pas rim gro byed pa de la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyis rgyud ngan pa ④byas te chos gos ma bkrus kyis 'khrus shig /des smras pa/ yo byad ni khyod 'ged tson kho bo 'khru'amacha/khyod nyid 8kyis khrus shig /skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nad g.yog la yo byad drug byin la lhag ma dge slong gis bgo bar bya'o/ /gal te nad g.yog mang 4)bar gyur na thams cad kyi spyir yo byad drug bgo bar bya'o/ /dge slong shes nyen dudang bsod nams chen po dang ldan pa gzhan dag cig shi nas ⑥de rnams kyi yo byad dang / dge tshul gyi yo byad dang 'tsho ba'i yo byad mang po rgan pa'i mthar spungs 0pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dund g.yog gis ④yo byad drug bkur bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal to zhes des bdams shing bdams rdzi3—246

shing bzang po rnams blangs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/bzang po rnams las sbyin par mi bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis ngan pa las byin nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ngan pa rnams las sbyin par mi bya ste / 'on kyang bar ma rnams ①las sbyin par bya'o/ /nad pa ma tshor bar dge 'dun gyi gnas mal kho na la shi bar gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nad g.yog gis nad pa'i rtags la mkhas par bya ste/ myur ba myur bar brtag ②par bya'o/ /de'i bya ba nyams par mi bya ste/ lus kyi gnas skabs shes nas gang zag gi gnas mal la bsnyal bar bya'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /dge slong nad pa zhig yod pa des lus kyi gnas skabs la brtags nas dge slong zhig la smras pa/ re zhig kho bo ji tsam 'tsho'i bar du ③rim gro gyis shig /kho bo'i lhung bzed dang chos gos ni kho bo shi nas khyod ci bder gyis shig /des de'i rim gro bya bar brtsams pa las ji tsam na dge slong de shi'o/ /de nas gos 'ged pas de la 0smras pa/ dge slong de'i lhung bzed dang chos gos bgo dgos kyis duphul cig /des smras pa/des kho bo dul ci bder byed du bcug go zhes pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag de gson pa'i tsotshe nyid na ma byin na shi nas sbyin pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ bdag shi nas 'di'i yin no zhes bya ba'i sbyin pa 'di ni med pa yin pas blangs ⑤te bgos la dge slong de'i rang gi skal ba sbyin par bya'o/ /de'i tshe dge slong nad kyis thebs pa sdug bsngal ba nad tshabs che ba zhig yod pa de shes pa chung bas de'i sman med nas des ①lus kyi gnas ⑩la brtags te rim gro yibyed 3—247

pa la smras pa/ bdag la ci yang med kyis ①bdag gi ched du mchod pa gyis shig/des khas lablangs pa las de shi nas ngan song rnams su skyes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong shi ba gang yin pa des rim gro byed pa la ji skad smrasal/ de rnams kyis ji ltar gyur pa ④gsol ba dang / dge slong dag dge slong de log par nyung ngo / /gal te tshangs pa ⑤mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyis de'i ched du dkon mchog gsum la mchod par dubyas par gyur dang dad pa skyes ⑦pas log par lhung bar mi 'gyur ba duzhig /de lta bas na dge slong gis tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa na ba ⑨yal bar mi bzhag ste/ nad g.yog sbyin par bya'o/ /des de la dris te/ gal te de la sman med na yon bdag la bslang ⑩bar bya'o/ /gal te grub na de lta na legasayi/ ji 8ste ma grub na dge 'dun gyi las sbyin no/ /ji ⑫ste de ④yang ma grub na de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten nam/ dri gtsang khang ⑫gi gdugs sam/ rgyal mtshan nam/ rgyan gang yin pa de dge 'dun gyis phog la sbyin par tho)bya zhing rim gro byed pas bsgyur nas rim gro dang ston pa mchod par bya'o/ /sos par gyur na de la 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi yin te khyod kyi yo byad du spyad ⑩do zhes brjod 8par bya'o/ /gal te de la 'byor pa yod na des 'bad de bsab par bya'o/ /gal te med na de ni spyad yipa legs par spyad pa yin te/ pha'i la bu bzhin du rigs pa yin pas de la 'gyod par mi bya'o//gleng gzhi ( )ni mnyan yod na'o/ /dge slong nad kyis thebs pa sdug bsngal ba nad tshabs che ba tshor bas nyen pa zhig yod pa de la lhung bzed 0bzang po zhig yod de/ de de la lhag par chags nas rim gro byed pa la smras pa/3—248

kho bo'i lhung bzed 'on cig /des ma byin pa dang de de la ngan sems skyes shing lhung bzed la lhag par chags pas ①shi nas de lhung bzed de nyid du sbrul zhig tu skyes so/ /dge slong rnams kyis de sreg tu khyer nas bsregs te gtsug lag khang du lhags nas dge slong gi dge 'dun 'dus so/ /gos 'ged ②pas shi ba'i yo byad rgan pa'i mthar spungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la dge slong rnams la dge slong sus kyang de'i lhung bzed gzhag pa'i snod ma dbye zhig /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis 'byed par 'gyur ro zhes sgo ③zhig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos dge slong rnams la bsgo'o④/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nyid 0kyis phye ba dang sbrul zhig mgo'i gdengs ka cher byas nas 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis se gol gyi sgras bslang gyenas bka' stsal pa/ mi gti mug can lhung bzed 'di spongs la song 0shig /dge slong rnams kyis 'ged par 'gyur ro/ /de 'khrugs nas ci dga' ba'i spyod lam gyis song ste nags stug po zhig tu zhugs nas/ des der dukhros pa'i me sbar pas nags de rab tu 'bar te de nyid du tshig nas dge slong rnams la ngan sems skyes pas dmyal ba rnams su skyes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag srid pa thams cad la po)skrag par gyis shig /srid pa'i yo byad gang gi phyir sems can gcig gi lus de gnas gsum po nags stug por bros ⑩pa'i me dang /dmyal bar sems can dmyal ba'i (spedang / dur khrod 'du me phal pas sreg par 'gyur ba 'thams cad las yid byung bar bya'o/ /de lta bas na dge slong gis yo byad la lhag par chags pa bskyed par mi bya zhing gang la skye ba de yongs 3—249

su spang bar ①bya'o/ /ma spangs na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang gal te nad pa rang gi yo byad slong na rim gro byed pas myur ba myur bar sbyin par bya'o/ /ma byin na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /de'i tshe dge slong nad pa zhig gnas khang du shi nas mi ma yin pa rnams kyi nang du skyes so/ /gos 'ged pas lhung bzed dang chos gos bgo'o zhes dge slong de'i gnas khang du 'jug par brtsams ②pa las/ de kun nas dkris ③pa drag pos dbyug 0pa blangs te langs nas des smras pa/ re zhig kho bo dur khrod du yang ma phyung bar lhung bzed dang chos gos 'ged par byed dam/de sngangs dunas bros pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ re zhig thog mar dge slong gi ro phyung nas phyi nas de'i dulhung bzed dang chos gos bgo bar gyasto /gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /de'i tshe dge slong zhig shi nas dge slong rnams kyis de phyung ste/ dur khrod du de bzhin du bor nas gtsug lag khang du lhags te/gos 'ged pas chos gos dang lhung bzed bgo'o zhes de'i gnas khang du zhugs pa ⑦dang de mi ma yin pa rnams su skyes pas dbyug pa blangs te langs nas/des smras pa/ re zhig kho bo'i ro la mchod pa yang ma byas par chos gos dang lhung bzed 'ged par byed dam zhes pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rnams kyis sngar de'i ro la mchod pa byas la de'i 'og tu lhung bzed dang chos gos bgos dang nyes dmigs 'dir mi 'gyur ro/ /gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'ol/ /de'i tshe dge slong nad pa zhig gnas khang du shi nas de dge slong rnams 3—250

kyis dur khrod du khyer te ro la mchod pa byas bsregs nas de nas gtsug lag khang du lhags pa dang / gos 'ged pas de'i gnas khang du zhugs pa las des dbyug pa blangs te langs nas re zhig bdag gi ched du chos bsgrags pa ma byas ①par chos gos ②rnams 'ged par byed dam zhes pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de'i ched du chos bsgrags pa dang / de'i ched du yon bsngo ①ba byas nas chos gos rnams bgo bar bya'o// //sdom la/ nad pa dang ni tshong dpon dang / /dngos po'i skyin pa lag gi bla/ /mtshams bzhi rjodag tu bya ba dang / /pho nya brgyad du bya ba'o/ /gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /de'i tshe khyim bdag cig gis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun khyim du gdugs tshod la spyan drangs pa las dge slong gi dge 'dun niXlhags so/ /bcom ldan 'das ni rdzas kyis bsgrubs ①pa na bzhugs nas bsod snyoms kyi sku skal bzhes so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rgyu lngas rdzas kyis bsgrubs pa na bzhugs nas bsod snyoms kyi sku skal bzhes te lnga po gang gis ⑦zhe na/ nang du yang dag 'jog par bzhed pa dang / lha rnams la chos 'chad par bzhed pa dang / gnas mal la gzigs par bzhed pa dang / nad pa la gzigs par bzhed pa dang / nyan thos rnams 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bzhed pa ste/ skabs 'dir ni nad pa la gzigs pa dang / bslab pa'i gzhi bca' ⑧bar bzhed ⑨nas/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rdzas kyis bsgrubs pa na bzhugs nas bsod snyoms 3—251

kyi sku skal bzhes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gi dge 'dun dong nas ring po ma lon par mkhyen nas lde mig bsnams te kun dga' ra ba nas kun dga' ra ①ba dang / gtsug lag khang nas gtsug lag khang dang / spyil bo nas spyil bo dang / 'chag sa nas 'chag sa rnams su 'chag cing gshegs pa na gtsug lag khang ②chen po gang na ba der byon ③pa dang / de na dge slong nad tshabs che ba shes pa chung ba rang gi gcin ④dang ngan skyugs kyi nang du nub pa zhig gis bcom ldan 'das mthong nas bcom ldan 'das bdag la mgon ma mchis so//bde bar gshegs pa bdag la mgon ma mchis so/ /zhes skad ngan bton pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong nga khams gsum gyi mgon po'i rjes su khyod rab tu byung na ci'i phyir de skad du bcom ldan 'das bdag la mgon ma mchis so/ /bde bar gshegs pa bdag la ⑤mgon ma mchis so zhes ngu skad ༷'don/ btsun pa bdag la tshangs pa mtshungs par ⑦spyod pa 'ga' yang rim gro bgyid pa'am lta ba ma mchis so/ /dge slong khyod kyis tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod ⑧pa 'ga' la ⑨rim gro dang lta ba byas pa yod dam/btsun pa ma mchis lags so/ /de bas na 0khyod gnas skabs 'di lta bur gyur tol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kye ma'o lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis mtsho chen po ma dros pa nas chu khyer te 'ong zhing ri spos kyi ngad ldang las sa khyer te 'ong bar gyur cig ces 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa mdzad do/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed par 0mdzad pa de'i tshe brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs te lha rnams kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs sems kyis shes so/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis mtsho 3—252
