chen po ma dros pa nas yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus gser gyi ril ba bkang ste ri spos kyi ngad ldang ①las sa blangs nas myur ba myur bar bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'ongs te 'dug nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bzhugs shig dang de'i rim gro bdag gis bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau ②shi ka 'di nikhyod kyi duphyir rab tu byung ba ma yin gyi/'on kyang nga'i phyir yin no/ /gzhan yang khyod kyis 'di sngon ma mthong la lha rnams ni gtsang sbra la dga' ba yin pas 'dug cig /ngas ni du'adi'i rim gro bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis na bza' chos gos brjes nas phyag 'khor lo dang / bkra shis dang / g.yung drung 'khyil pa can bsod nams brgya phrag du mas bsgrubs dupa/ skrag ⑦pa rnams la dbugs 'byin par mdzad pas dge slong de bzung ste gcin dang ngan skyugs nas phyung nas mtha' gcig tu bzhag ste/ sgyug gi tshal pas bzhar dunas sa dkar pos dril phyis byas te bkrus so/ /de nas skyil mo krung ⑨'char bcug ste0/ de'i chos gos rnams bkrus te/ phyogs de yang ba'i lci ba 'jam pos byug pa mdzad do/ /de nas phyag dang zhabs bsil nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin la nad pa la yirim gro bya ba sngon du 'gro ba'i chos bshad pas yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug nas gtsug lag khang du zhugs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bsod snyoms kyi sku skal gyi tsobasod snyoms khyer te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ngo / /chos nyid kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bsod snyoms nod tsonas khyer te 'ong ba'i dge slong la so so yang dag par dga' bar mdzad pa 'dis so so yang dag par dga' bar mdzad de8/ dge slong ci tsog 3—253

dge slong gi dge 'dun kha zas bsod pas legs par tshim par byas sam zhes yang dag par rab tu dga' cibar mdzad pa yin pas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo ci ga ①dge slong gi dge 'dun kha zas bsod pas legs par tshim par byas sam/ btsun pa de bzhin du zhal zas bsod pas dge slong gi dge 'dun legs par tshim par bgyis ②lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bsod snyoms kyi phyed bzhes ③te tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la gtsug dulag khang che ge mo zhig dun dge slong nad tshabs che ba zhig yod pa de la bsod snyoms phyed po 'di khyer la zos nas 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyi rim gro ston pa nyid kyis mdzad de/ bsod snyoms yiphyed ⑦kyi bgo bsha' yang mdzad do zhes gyis shig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi niltar mnyan nas bsod snyoms kyi phyed khyer te/ de la bsod snyoms byin ⑨nas ji skad bka' stsal pa yang smras so// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po drug bcu ⑨drug pa/ de nas dge slong de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag ni khams gsum gyi bla ma nyid kyis rim gro mdzad de⑩/ bsod snyoms kyi phyed kyang gnang gis tsobadag dad pas byin pa longs spyad yinas le los dus 'das par byed pa ni bdag la rigs tho)pa ma yin pas/ma la bdag nam gyi cha stod ṇa/nyedang (9cha smad la mi nyal bar sbyor ba la brtson par gnas par bya'o snyam nas/ des ⑩nam gyi cha stod dang cha smad la mi nyal bar sbyor ba la brtson par gnas pa na 'khor ba'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa g.yo ba dang mi g.yo ba 'di nyid 4)rig ste/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad nyams pa dang /3—254

ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos nyid du zil gyis mnan nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom par gyur to①//dgra bcom par gyur nas khams gsum gyi 'dod chags dang bral ba/ bong ba dang gser du mnyam ②pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil ③du mtshungs pa'i sems tsan dan dang ste'ur mnyam pa/ ma rig pa'i sgo nga'i sbubs dral dubar gyur cing rig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa dang / 'dod pa'i rnyed pa dang bkur sti ⑤la rgyab kyis phyogs pa dang / dbang po dang nye ba'i dbang po dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis dumachod par bya ba dang / rjed ⑦par bya ba dang / mngon du smra bar bya bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag nad pa 'di dag la ni tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa khyed cag kho na ma gtogs par ma med/ pha med/ rtsa dulag gzhan med do/ /de lta bas na tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyis phan tshun du rim gro bya ⑨ste/ mkhan pos ni lhan cig gnas pa'i'o/ /lhan cig gnas pas ni mkhan po'i'o4)/ /slob dpon gyis ni nye gnas kyi'o/ /nye gnas kyis ni slob dpon gyi'o/ /mkhan po gcig pas ni mkhan po gcig pa'i'o/ /slob dpon gcig pas ni slob dpon gcig pa'i'o/ /gtam 'dres pas ni gtam 'dres pa'i'o/ /phebs par smra bas ⑩ni phebs par smra ba'i'o/ /smos 'drin gyis ni 7smos 'drin gyi'o/ /'khor dang bral ba shes pa chung ba gang yin pa de ni dge 'dun gyis nad kyi gnas skabs la brtags nas rim gro ba gcig gam/ gnyis sam/ mang po sbyin te mthar na dge 'dun kun tigyis kyang rim gro bya'o/ /dge slong rnams the 3—255

tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod ①pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis dge slong de'i lus kyi rim gro mdzad nas des dgra bcom pa mngon sum ②du bgyis pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ltar 'ba' zhig tu ma zad de/ji ltar 'das pa'i dus na yang ngas 'di'i rim gro byas nas des ①mngon par shes pa lnga mngon sum dudu byas pa de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bste gnas me tog dang / 'bras bu ⑤dang / chu phun sum tshogs pa/ shing sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa zhig na drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa zhig gnas so/ /des slob ma'i rim gro byas nas sos pa dang / de nas des mngon par shes pa lnga mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/de'i tshe de'i dus kyi drang srong gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin no/ /drang srong de'i slob ma gang yin pa de ni dge slong 'di nyid yin te/ de na yang ngas de'i rim gro byas so/ /da ltar yang byas so/ /gzhan yang dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das lhag par yang dund pa rnams la byams par mdzad pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ltar 'ba' zhig tu ma zad de/ ji ltar 'das pa'i dus na yang nga lhag par nad pa rnams la byams par byed pa de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba yul shi bi'i ⑦dbyangs kyi rgyal po'i pho brang na rgyal po shi bi ⑧zhes bya ba ⑨'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang bde ba dang lo legs pa skye bo dang mi mang pos rab tu gang ba na rgyal srid byed du 'jug ste/ de tislong ba pa rnams la mi gtong ba cung zad kyang med de/ nad pa rnams la ni khyad par du byed do//3—256

ji tsam na khyim ①bdag nad pa sman pa thams cad kyis spangs pa zhig rgyal po'i drung du song nas lha bdag la dpyad ②mdzod cig /rgyal pos sman pa rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag dpyad byos shig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha 'di'i sman ni dkon lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ dkon pa de dag ci 'dra ba zhig yin/ lha gang zhig btsas tshun chad sngon lan 'ga' yang su la yang khro ③ma myong ba de'i khrag las nas thug bgyis te zla ba drug tu stsal dun de lta na 'di sos par 'gyur lags kyi gzhan gyis ⑤ma lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/de'i sman dkon pa ni bden no/ /de nas bdag nyid kyi spyod pa la brtag 0par brtsams na bdag ①nyid kyi spyod pa la brtag ⑧par dka' bar gyur nas des ma ma la dri bar ⑨brtsams pa/ ma ma nga dus 'di srid kyi bar du sngon lan 0'ga' yang 0khros pa yod dam gzhon nu khyod gang gi tshe bdag gi pang tsodu byon pa de nas bdag kyang sngon su la yang tshulan 'ga' yang khro ma myong na/ khyod lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ de nas ma'i drung du song nas smras pa/ yum bdag dus 'di srid kyi bar du sngon su la yang 'ga' la 8khros pa mchis sam/ gzhon nu khyod gang gi tshe bdag gi rum du zhugs pa de nas bdag kyang byasu la yang khro ma myong na khyod lta smos kyang ci dgos/ des bsams pa/ sman rnyed do snyam du rig nas des tsosman pa rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag ngas rang la brtags na nga sngon su la yang khro ⑩ma myong bas nga'i 8yan lag lnga'i rtsa gtor cig /lha bdag cag ni mi phal pa zhig gi don du lha'i sku la mtshon mi 'debs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni bzo'i yiganas dang las kyi gnas de dang de rnams la mkhas pa yin pas rgyal po rang nyid kyis durtsa gtar te/ khrag des 0zla ba drug tu nyi ma re re 3—257

zhing de la nas thug blud pas sos par gyur to/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/de'i tshe de'i dus na ①rgyal po gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin te/ de na yang nga ②nad pa rnams la byams par byed na/ da lta lta zhig smos kyang ci dgos/gzhan yang ②shi bi'i 0bu gzhogs 0phyed skams ༷par gyur nas rgyal pos sman pa rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag gzhon nu'i dpyad gyis shig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha bcud thams cad mar dang chasgrol cig /lo bcu gnyis su bcud thams cad bsogs dun 'di'i yang shang shang te'u'i 0sha ma rnyed do/ /sman pa rnams kyis bya ba rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag me long dang bya gag khyer te rgya mtsho'i 'gram du deng tshul der rnyi 0tshugs te bya gag gi mdun du me long zhog cig dang / bya gag rang gi gzugs brnyan mthong nas 'di bya gag yin no snyam ste/ skad phyung ba dang / shang shang te'u yis bya gag gi 8skad thos nas ngo mtshar che bas bya gag gi drung du 'ong bar 'gyur te/ de bzung 8ba'i thabs ni 'di yin no/ /de rnams kyis de bzhin du byas pa las ji tsam na las kyi zhags pas zin pa'i srog chags shang shang te'u thogs nas de rnams kyis de khyer te dong 8ngo / /'di ni chos nyid yin te/ 'jig rten gnas pa chags nas ring po ma lon pa'i tshe dud 'gro rnams kyang smra shes pas srog chags shang shang te'u yis ⑩smras pa/ bdag gar bkri/ de rnams kyis ⑩ji ltar gyur pa smras pa dang / des smras pa/ thong shig / thong shig /⑩sha'i mthu yod par byed pa zhes bya ba'i sman dang rin po che rnams smra'o/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ re zhig khyod kyis 4)sman de dag ci 'dra ba bltas tunyeston cig /des smras pa/bdag gi ( )khrus byas pa'i chu ni sha'i mthu yod pa yin gyis 0de khyer la dengs 33—258

shig rin po che ①'di dag yin no/ /de dag rgyal pos 'jigs pas rin po che rnams bor te shang shang te'u de nyid khyer te dong ba las rim gyis yul shi bi'i ②dbyangs kyi rgyal po'i pho brang du phyin nas de rnams kyis srog chags shang shang te'u rgyal po la phul te/ des bstan pa'i sman gang yin pa de yang smras so/ /de nas rgyal pos shang shang te'u la dris pa dang smras pa/ lha bdag bkrus pa'i chab sha stobs can du bgyid pa lags so/ /rgyal pos chu snod bdun chu bzang pos bkang bar bzhag go/ /ji tsam na de de ⑧dag tu ji srid legs par ngal sos pas ④de srid du ༷khrus byas nas/ de nas lus kyi stobs shes pa dang med la 'phur te khang pa'i steng du 'dug nas 'jigs pa dang bag tsha ba dang bral nas rjotshigs su bcad pas smras pa/ re zhig thog ma bdag blun te/ /phyi nas bya ba 'di dag go/ /de nas rgyal po blun ⑦pa ste/ /blun po'i dkyil 'khor legs par rdzogs/ /zhes smras nas song ngo / /de nas rgyal pos sman pa rnams bkug ste dris pa/ shes ldan dag shang shang te'u'i dukhrus byas pa'i chu de sha'i mthu yod par byed pa ⑨bden nam/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha mad lags kyis ⑩mar dang sgrol cig /de rnams kyis bcud thams cad mar dang btsos te rgyal po'i bu la blud par yizhugs so/ /ji tsam na gangs ri'i sul zhig na rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya gnas pa las de na gcig gzhogs (ste phyed skams 4)par gyur te4ste/de la rang sangs rgyas de rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa ljongs su song la sman pa la smos tunyete sman sten tunyecig dang sos par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa dag skye bo mang po la mi sdug pa/ skye bo 0mang po mi 'dod pa/skye bo mang po mi dga' ba/ skye bo mang po'i 8yid du mi 'ong ba sems can thams 3—259

cad kyi thun mong gi ①chos 'di lta ste/ 'chi ba zhes bya ba gang yin pa de 'ong ste/bdag nad dang bcas te khyer ②bar gyur na ci'i phyir grong khyer gyi ②mthar 'gro de rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa de lta mod kyi 'on kyang ji tsam du skyes bu gang zag tshul khrims dang ldan pa yun ring du 'tsho dub rjode tsam du bsod nams mang po sogs soX/ /ji tsam du bsod nams mang po bsags pa de tsam du mtho ris ⑦bu yun ring du dga' bar 'gyur ro zhes de de rnams kyis skul ma btab nas ljongs su babs te/ rim gyis yul shi bi'i ⑧dbyangs kyi rgyal po'i pho brang du phyin to/ /de nas lam gyis dub pa ngal sos nas sman pa'i drung du song ste/bzhin bzangs kho bo 'di 'dra ba'i nad kyis thebs kyis 0sman ston cig /des smras pa/ 'phags pa khyod kyi snyan yind 'di ci 'dra ba kho na rgyal po'i sras kyi yang de kho na 'dra nas lo bcu gnyis kyis bcud thams cad mar dang btsos pa ⑪mchis kyis bzhud (sprel slongs shig dang / gal te skal ba'i khyad par can ⑫gyis bcud de thob na des na khyod 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /de rgyal po'i pho brang du song nas sgo kur ④bsdad de8/ rgyal po de'i kun tu spyod 0pa ni slong ba po'i skye bo sgron du gzhug ⑩pa'i phyir sgor rgyun du dril 'dogs te/ gang gi tshe slong ba po sgo na 'dug pa de'i tshe de dkrol 8bar byed do/ /ci 0tsam na rang sangs rgyas 'ongs nas dril te dkrol rgu to/ /de nas rgyal po'i bus 0pha dang ma la smras pa/ yab yum slong ba po duzhig mchis kyis ()ci zhig slong smros shig /de gnyis kyis smras pa/ bu bdag cag gis lo bcu gnyis su rdzas rnams bsogs ⑤te btsos nas byas pa'i bcud 'di re zhig 'thung phyesheg dang / phyi nas ②slong ba po nang du bkug la ci slong ba smra'o0/ /de ngo mtshar dang bkra shis dang bde 3—260

legs su gyur pa dag byas nas mar 'thung bar 'dod na slong ba po'i skye bo'i re bas lus kyi gnad du phog nas mar de ma 'thungs par smras pa/ yab yum re zhig slong ba po nang du ma ①bkug gi bar du mi 'tshal lo/ /rgyal pos sgo ba la bsgo ba/ slong ba po nang du thong ②shig /de nang du zhugs pa dang rgyal po'i bus lus mdzes pa dang / sems dad pa dang / spyod lam zhi bas zhugs pa mthong nas des smras pa/ 'phags pa ci zhig bzhed/ des rgyas par smras pa dang / des smras pa/ 'phags pa bcud ni khyod kho na la 'os kyi bdag la ma lags kyi dbul gyis ②bzhes shig /des lhung bzed bzed ①pa dang / rgyal po'i bu bsam pa drag pos lhung bzed der bcud blugs so/ /bdag nyid chen po des kyang rgyal po'i bu la sems can thams cad la phan pa dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa dang / tshul khrims dang ldan pa'i smon lam ni 'grub par 'gyur la/de yang tshul khrims rnams rnam par dag pa'i phyir gnyis ka yang sos par gyur to//dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi phyirgyal bu dugazhon nu ⑦gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin te/ de na yang nga nad pa rnams la byams par byed na da lta lta smos kyang ci dgos/ btsun pa rgyal bu dang rang sangs rgyas des las ci zhig bgyis na/ des na gnyis ka ⑧mnyam du bros thebs la mnyam du sos par gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di gnyis kho nas sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan rnams su las tshogs rnyed ⑨pa/ rkyen ⑩yongs su bsgyur (spreb/ 'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa gdon mi za bar gnas pa ⑩'byung bar 'gyur ba'i las dag byas shing bsags pas 'di gnyis nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa gzhan su zhig gis so sor myong bar 'gyur/3—261

dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur gyi/ 'di ltar las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams ①la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang 0tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ③ba bā rā ṇa sī'i grong khyer du rgyal po tshangs byin 0zhes bya ba byung ste/ de la bu gnyis yod pa las nu bo shos gang yin pa de rgyal srid la dga' bar gyur to/ /mdun phyin 'don dul yang bu gnyis yod pa las nu bo shos gang yin pa de mdun ⑦na 'don 'dod par gyur te/sems can rnams ni khams kyi sgo nas shed 'phrod pa yin pas de gnyis ②phan tshun du yid gcugs ⑨par gyur tsonas rgyal bus smras pa/ thabs ci zhig byas na des na nga rgyal por 'gyur/ des smras pa/ khyod kyis gal te bdag mdun na 'don du gzhug yin ni thabs mchis kyis 0snyan du gsol bar bgyi'o/ /des smras pa/ de ltar bya ste gzhug gis 0smos shig /des smras pa/ bdag gis khyod kyi gcen zha bor bgyis dang khyod rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /des ④rjes su yi rang ngo / /de nas des 8rgyal bu phu tsobo shos de ⑦sman ma yin pa byin nas zha bor gyur to/ /dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po shi nas blon po rnams kyis de ni zha bor gyur to snyam nas nu bo shos rgyal por dbang bskur to/ /des kyang mdun ⑫na 'don gyi ⑩ nu bo shos gang yin pa de mdun yin 'don du bcug go/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po ( nyemadun na 'don dang 0lhan cig tu bre mo gtam smra 3—262

zhing 'dug pa las rgyal pos phu bo zha ba de mthong ngo / /des de mthong nas 'gyod par gyur te①/ bdag gis ②rgyal po'i 0srid kyi phyir phu bo zha bar 0byas pa gang yin pa de ni ma legs pa zhig byas so/ /lha bdag kyang 'gyod par gyur gyisadu/ gal te lha dgyes yin 'di phyir sngon gyi ji lta ba bzhin du bgyi'o/ /des smras pa/ gnang gis 0byos shig /des de la sman byin nas sos par gyur to / /de nas de gnyis kyis rang sangs rgyas shig la bya ba byas nas smon lam gdab par brtsams pa/ gang yang bdag cag ④gis yon gnas dam pa 'di lta bu la bya ba byas pa'i las 'di'i rnam par smin pas phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba'i rigs su skye zhing zha bor byas pa'i sdig pa'i las 'di'i rnam par smin pa stinyams su mi myong bar gyur cig ⑩byas 0so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/de'i tshe de'i dus kyi rgyal po'i bu gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin no0/ /mdun na 'don gyi bu gang yin pa de ni rang sangs rgyas de 0nyid yin no/ /de gnyis kyis gros byas nas rgyal bu tsogazhon nu la sman ma yin pa byin pa gang yin pa des na mnyam du zha bor ⑩gyur to/ /yang 'gyod par gyur pas de gnyis kyis gros byas te slar sman byin pa gang yin pa des na mnyam du sos par gyur to/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag (9pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag ⑩pa yin la/ gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi ni tsogacig tu dkar ba dang 'dren yim rnams kyi ni 'dren zhum ste/ dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag (sprepa rnams dang / 'dren ()ma rnams ni spangs la/ las gcig tu dkar ba rnams la brtsam par dubya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis de lta bu la bslab par bya'o//3—263

gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /de'i tshe mnyan yod na khyim bdag tshong dpon zhes bya ba phyug cing nor mang ba longs spyod che ba yongs su bzung ba yangs shing rgya che ba rnam ①thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu la nor gyis 'gran pa zhig gnas so/ /des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas de bu med cing bu mngon par 'dod pas zhi ba dang chu lha dang / lus ngan ②dang /brgya byin dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa la gsol ba 'debs shing lha'i bye brag gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ kun dga' ra ba'i lha dag dang / tshal gyi lha dag dang / bzhi mdo'i lha dag dang / sum mdo'i lha dag dang / gtor ma len pa'i lha dag ③dang / lhan cig skyes pa dang / chos mthun pa'i lha dag dang /rtag tu rjes su 'brang ba'i lha dag la yang gsol ba 'debs so/ /'jig rten na gang dag gsol ba 'debs pa'i rgyu las bu pho dang bu mo dag skye'o ༷zhes bya ba'i gtam de lta bu yod de༅/ de ni de lta ma yin te/ gal te de ltar gyur du zin na re re la yang 'di lta ste/ dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po bzhin du bu yistong yod par 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang gnas gsum po dag mngon sum ⑦du gyur pa las bu pho dang bu mo dag skye bar 'gyur te/ gsum po de dag gang zhe na/pha dang ma gnyis chags par gyur cing 'dus pa dang / ma dus la bab cing zla mtshan dang ldan pa dang / dri za nye bar gnas par gyur pa ste/ gnas gsum po de ⑧dag mngon sum ①du gyur pa las bu pho dang bu mo dag skye bar 'gyur ro/ /des gang gi tshe lha rnams la gsol ba byas kyang bu pho dang bu mo med pa de'i tshe lha thams cad spangs te bcom ldan 'das la mngon par dad par gyur to/ /ji tsam na dge slong zhig gi drung du song ste/ 'phags pa legs par gsungs pa'i 3—264

chos 'dul ba la bdag rab tu 'byung ①bar 'tshal lo/ /bzhin bzangs de bzhin du gyis ②shig ces des de rim gyis skra bregs nas bslab pa'i gzhi rnams sbyin par brtsams pa las rims chen pos thebs nas rab tu 'byung ③ba'i bar chad du gyur pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ re zhig sos 0kyi bar du bslab pa'i gzhi rnams mi sbyin zhing de'i rim gro bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i rim gro bya'o zhes bka' stsal na/ dge slong rnams kyis sus bya ba ma shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rnams dang sman pas so/ /sman pa rnams kyis ⑤nyin par sman byas na dumatshan mo nad la phan ⑦par gyur to/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa 'di'i dpyad ⑧bdag ⑨gis gdugs tshul bgyis na mtshan mo bro la phan ⑩par gyur gyisatso/ gal te 'di khyim du bskyal na bdag cag gis nyin mtshan du 'di'i dpyad bgyi'o zhes pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim du skyol 0la der yang de'i rim gro byed pa ⑫sbyin par bya'o/ /de'i nad de yun ring por gyur nas de'i 8skra ring po ring por skyes pas 4)khyim bdag de khyim bdag mgo reg ces par 4)grags so/ /de gang gi tshe 8rtsa ba dang / sdong bu dang / 'dab hum dang / me tog dang 'bras bu'i sman gyis bsnyen bkur byas pa lasaX/ slar lan par gyur pa de'i tshe des bdag ni 'chi'o zhes bya bar rang gi 0cha chod nas/ de na des 'chi ku'i phyetshe rang gi nor thams cad glegs bu la bris te rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du bskur rol/ /de ni shi'o/ /blon po rnams kyis ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la smras 3—265

pa / lha khyim bdag mgo reg bu ma mchis par gum ste/ de la dbyig dang /gser dang / glang po che dang / rta dang / ba lang dang / ma he dang /go cha la sogs te phal mo ①che zhig mchis pa de thams cad glegs bu la bris nas ②rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la phul lo/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ 'phags pa nye dga' dbang ba glegs bu la lam bris pa yang ngas dum thob na glegs bu la bris pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ 'on kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang ba gang yin pa de long 0shig pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de la ci dag yod// //bar sdom la/ gzhi dang gnas mal gos dang ni/ /lcags nag lcags dang lham mkhan dang / /rdza dumakhan 'dreg dumakhan shing mkhan sogs/ /tshon ⑧rtsi mdung ①shing bar bur dang / /rkang gnyis rnams dang rkang bzhi dang / /zas dang btung (3 ba sman dang ni/ /bran dang gding ba dpang rgya dgayi /ci rigs par ni bgo bar bya/ /dbyig rnams dang ni gser rnams dang / /gzhan yang rdungs byas rdungs tsom byas/ /dge 'dun 'dus nas bgo 'o zhes/ /drang srong chen pos bka' stsal to/ /dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang ⑫/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ci rigs par bgo bar bya ste/ de la zhing gi gzhi dang / khyim gyi gzhi dang / tshong khang gi gzhi dang / gnas mal dang / lcags nag gi mgar ④ba'i lag spyad dang / lcags mgar 8gyi lag spyad dang / rdza ⑩mkhan gyi lag spyad dang / shing mkhan gyi lag spyad dang / smyug ma mkhan gyi lag spyad dang / bran pho dang / bran mo dang /3—266

las byed pa dang / zho shas 'tsho ba dang / kha zas dang / btung ba dang /'bru rnams ni mi bgo ①bar phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi phyir spyir gzhag par bya'o/ /ras yug dang / ras yug chen dang / ko sgro dang /mchil lham dang / 'bru mar gyi snod dang / ril ba dang / bya ma bum rnams ni dge 'dun tshogs pas bgo bar bya'o/ /mdung shing ring po gang yin pa de dag ni 'dzam bu lta bu'i sku'i gzugs brnyan gyi rgyal mtshan gyi shing bya'o/ /thung ngu gang yin pa de dag ni khar gsil ②gyi yu bar byas la dge slong rnams la sbyin par bya'o/ /khye'u dang bu mo ni dge 'dun gyis mi bsgyur te ci rigs pa zhig blangs nas ci bde bar gtang ③bar bya'o/ /rkang bzhi pa rnams las glang po che dang / rta dang / rnga mo dang / bong bu dang / dre'u rnams ni rgyal po la dbul bar bya'o/ /ba lang dang / ma ho dang / ra dang /lug rnams ni phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi phyir spyir gzhag ste mi bgo'o / /'thab stan dang / go cha ④dang / gzhan yang rgyal po la 'os pa gang yin pa ༷thams cad ni rgyal po la dbul bar bya'o/ /mtshon cha rnams rjobazhag la de rnams gre'u rjodang / khab dang / khar gsil ༷du brdungs ①te dge 'dun la brim par bya'o/ /tshon tu)rnams las tshon rtsi chen po gang kus ⑫dang / mtshal dang / mthing 0shing la sogs pa gang yin pa 8de dag ni sku'i gzugs brnyan gyi phyir 8dri gtsang 'khang du gzhag par bya'o/ /thod lo 8kor dang / btsag ⑩dang / rams ni dge 'dun gyis bgo bar bya'o/ /chang ni yongs ()blugs las yidong du gzhug par bya ste/ tshur 0gyur na longs spyad par bya'o/ /tshwar byam gyur dun dor bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag nga ston pa yin 3—267

par khas len pa rnams kyis ⑨chang mi sbyin zhing tha na rtswa ②mchog gis kyang mi btung ngo / /sman rnams ni nad khang rung bar gzhag par bya zhing de nas dge slong nad pa ③rnams kyis longs spyad par bya'o/ /rin po che rnams las ༷mu tig ma gtogs 0par nor bu dang / bee ḍūrya rjodang / dung g.yas su 'khyil pa la sogs pa ni cha gnyis su byas te/ gcig ni chos la'o/ /cig shos ni dge 'dun la'o/ /chos kyi gang yin pa des ni sangs rgyas kyi gsung bri bar bya'o / /seng ge'i khri brgyan ⑦par bya'o/ /dge 'dun gyi gang yin pa de ni dge slong rnams kyis bgo bar bya'o/ /glegs bam rnams las dusangs rgyas kyi gsung rab kyi glegs bam rnams ni mi bgo bar phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi ched du spyir mdzod du gzhug ⑨par bya'o/ /phyi rol pa'i bstan bcos ⑩kyi glegs bam rnams ni btsongs (sprel bgo bar bya'o/ /chags rgya ni myur du 'grub par nus pa gang yin pa de 0ni rdzas 'ged pa'i tshe dge slong rnams kyis ⑫bgo bar bya'o/ /mi nus pa gang yin pa de ni phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi ched du spyir mdzod du gzhug thostepar bya'o/ /gser dang / dbyig dang / gzhan yang rdungs su byas pa dang / rdungs su ma byas pa gang yin pa de ni cha gsum du byas te/ gcig ni sangs rgyas la'o/ /gnyis pa ni chos la'o / /gsum pa ni dge 'dun la'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi gang yin pa des ni dri gtsang khang dang dbu skra dang tsosen mo'i mchod rten gyi tshural ba dang 'brums 0pa slar tsobacos par bya'o/ /chos kyi gang yin pa des ni sangs rgyas kyi gsung bri bar bya'o/ /seng ge'i khri brgyan yipar bya'o/ /dge 'dun gyi gang yin pa de ni dge slong rnams kyis bgo bar bya'o//3—268

gleng gzhi ni mnyan ①yod na'o/ /gang gi tshe ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis chu bzangs kyi ②dus ston btsugs pa de'i tshe de na/ dge slong dang /dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen ③dang / dge bsnyen dum rnams mang du tshogs par dugyur to/ /de'i tshe dge slong khrums stod dge slong mas bkur ba yin pas chu bzangs kyi ༷dus ston btsugs pa'i dge slong ma rab tu mang pos tshe dang ldan pa khrums stod la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa chu bzangs kyi ⑦dus ston la spyan 'dren gyis dugashegs so/ /des smras pa/ bdag gi chos gos dang lhung bzed phyir su la bcol/ dge slong ma bcu gnyis sde rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa thugs las chung ngur mdzod cig dang ⑨/ bdag cag gis gzhag par bgyi'o/ /des de rnams la gzhag pa dang de rnams kyis ⑩skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo la gtad do(spre/ / skye dgu'i bdag mo 8chen mos kyang tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos kyang gtsug ⑫lag khang zhig tu gzhag go/ /de nas 8tshe dang ldan pa khrums stod chu bzangs kyi ⑫dus ston 0la 'ongs pa dang / de na de ⑩dge slong ma rnams kyis mgron 'du bos pa yin pas gcig gis smras pa/ 'phags pa deng bdag gis zhal tshus bgyi'o / /gzhan dang gzhan dag gis kyang g.yar tshus la bos so/ /gzhan dag tho)gis smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag gi cigadugs tshod gsol cig /de bzhin du gzhan dang zhugazhan dag gis kyang smras so/ /gzhan zhig gis smras pa/'phags pa bdag gi dudus ma lags pa'i btung ba gsol cig /de bzhin du gzhan dang gzhan dag gis kyang smras nas des de rnams kyi sems bsrung duba'i phyir g.yar tshus rnams las cung zad cung zad blangs ④de 'bazhin du dro yang zos/3—269

dus ma yin pa'i btung ba blud ①pa yang 'thungs ②pa dang de ③ tseg tseg 0pa yor langs nas/ de yang lam gyis dub pa des ⑤mang por zos pa des dum zhu bar gyur te gsud 0de shi'o/ /de ⑧dge slong rnams kyis dur khrod du bsregs ⑨nas chos bsgrags pa byas nas rim gyis gtsug lag khang du lhags so/ /gos 'ged pas nad g.yog la smras pa/ de'i lhung bzed dang chos gos 'on cig /des smras pa/ des bcu gnyis sde rnams kyi lag tu bzhag go/ /de rnams la dris pa dang / smras pa ⑩bdag cag 0gis skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo'i lag tu bzhag go/ /de nas skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mos smras pa/ bdag gis 'phags pa kun dga' bo la gtad do/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos smras pa/bdag gis gtsug lag khang che ge mo zhig tu bzhag go zhes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shi ba'i yo byad kyi skyin 8par dge slong kun dga' bo 4)byin gyis brlab 4)par bya'o/ /byin gyis brlab pa yang 'di ltar bya ste/ gaṇḍi brdungs la dge 'dun thams cad tshogs shing mthun par gyur pa dang / dge slong gcig gis gsol bar 4)bya'o/ /'di ltar bya ste/ gnas mal bsham par tsobyas la gaṇḍi brdungs 4)te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bgo tsol/ dge 'dun thams cad 7tshogs shing mthun par gyur pa dang dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gnas 'dir dge slong khrums tsu )stod gum na de'i lhung bzed dang chos gos/ gos 0dang dugos kyi rin dang bcas pa kun dga' bo'i sug pa na mchis kyis ( )gal te dge 'dun gyi ④dus la bab cing bzod na dge 3—270

'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / 'di ltar dge 'dun gyis dge slong khrums nyustod gum pa'i yo byad lhung bzed dang chos ②gos dang gos kyi rin du bcas pa'i dngos po'i skyin ③par dge slong kun dga' bo byin gyis brlab par bgyi'oX/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ⑤'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa dge slong yang gzhan du gum/lhung bzed dang chos gos kyang gzhan na mchis/ dngos po'i skyin pa yang gzhan na mchis na de'i chos gos dang lhung bzed gang dbang bar 'gyur lags/ nye ba du'akhor dngos po'i skyin pa'i dge slong ngam khyim ⑦gang na yod pa'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /de'i tshe dge slong lag gi bla zhig shi'o/ /dge slong rnams ②de'i lhung bzed dang chos gos la 'gyod pas ma bgos pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun thams cad bsogs la ci 'dres sam ma 'dres par gyur pa de brtag ⑨par bya'o/ /gal te 'dres te dge 'dun gyi ni mchod rten gyir byas la/ mchod rten gyi 4) ni dge 'dun gyir gyur na/de lta bu chos dang mi mthun pa yiyin pas de'i lhung bzed dang chos gos dang gos kyi rin dang bcas pa la 'cha gsum du byas te/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun no/ /dge 'dun gyi ni dge slong rnams kyis bgo bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni sangs rgyas la mchod pa dang / dri gtsang khang dang mchod rten gyi lag gi bla'i tsosar spyad par bya'o/ /dam pa'i chos kyi ni sangs rgyas kyi gsung bri bar bya'o8/ /seng ge'i khri brgyan 8par bya'o/ /gal te 'dres par ma gyur na thams cad dge slong rnams kho nas bgo bar bya ste/ de la 'gyod par 3—271

mi bya'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /de'i tshe dge slong rab tu mang po dag ljongs rgyu zhing dong ba las rim gyis mnyan yod kyi ༅grong khyer dang nye ba zhig tu phyin pa dang de rnams kyi nang nas dge slong cig shi'o/ /de rnams kyis bsams pa/ gtsug lag khang na 'dug pa'i tshangs pa ②mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyang skal ba 'dod par 'gyur du 'ong gis②/ /gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol tu bgo bar bya'o snyam pa las/ mnyan yod de na gnas pa'i ba lang 0rdzi dang / phyugs rdzi dang / rtswa thun dang / shing thun dang / lam rjogyis 'tsho dub dang / lam gol bas 'tsho ⑦ba'i mi rnams kyis kun nas gang zhing de rnams gang dang gang du 'dug nas 'ged par byed pa de dang der skye bo'i tshogs chen pos duyongs su bskor bar gyur nas de rnams kyis bsams pa/ gtsug lag khang dang nye ba zhig tu bgo'o snyam nas/ de rnams kyis gtsug lag khang dang nye ba zhig tu bgo bar brtsams pa dang dge skos ①kyis mthong nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ci zhig byed/ de rnams kyis ji ltar gyur pa bzhin ⑩smras pa dang / des smras pa/ bdag kyang mtshams su 'ongs pa yin na zhes des 'khangs kyang de rnams kyis ma byin pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mtshams ⑫kyi nang la mtshams kyi nang du 'du tsoshes te shi ba'i yo byad 'ged par byed na ma bgos pa nyes par bgos pa yin te/ slar yang mtshams na 'dug pa rnams dang lhan cig bgo bar bya ste/ gzhan du na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du mtshams kyi nang la yid gnyis kyis 'ged par byed na ma bgos pa 3—272

nyes par bgos pa yin te①/ slar yang mtshams na 'dug pa rnams dang lhan cig bgo bar bya ste/ gzhan du na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /mtshams kyi phyi rol la mtshams kyi nang gi 'du shes kyis 'ged ②par byed na ma bgos pa nyes par bgos pa yin te/ slar yang mtshams na 'dug pa rnams dang lhan cig bgo bar bya stel/ gzhan du na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /mtshams kyi phyi 0rol la yid gnyis kyis ⑤'ged par byed na ma bgos pa nyes par bgos pa yin te/ slar yang mtshams dun 'dug pa rnams dang lhan cig bgo bar bya ste/ gzhan du na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /de'i tshe dge slong gis ⑦dge slong la dge slong gi lag nas chos gos dag bskur ba na dge slong des gang gis bskur ⑧ba de la yid gcugs ⑨pas spyad pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong des yid gcugs ⑩par bya ba ma yin pa la yid gcugs par 0bskyed de/'di ltar chagang gis bskur ba de la yid gcugs pas 8spyad do/ /'on kyang dge slong gis dge slong la dge slong gi lag nas chos gos dag bskur ba na gang la bskur ba de la yid gcugs 4)pas spyad na legs ()par spyad pa yin no/ /gang gis bskur ba de la yid gcugs ⑩pas spyad na nyes par spyad pa yin no/ /dge slong gis dge slong la chos gos dag skur bar 0byed tson gang la bskur ba de ⑪ni shi la gang gis bskur ba de la yid gcugs pas 0spyad na nyes par 0spyad pa yin no/ /gang la bskur slob de'i shi ba'i yo byad du rung bar byin gyis rlob par byed na legs par byin gyis brlabs 0pa yin no/ /dge slong gis dge 3—273

slong la chos gos dag skur ①bar byed pa na gang gis bskur ②ba de ni shi la gang gis bskur ba de'i shi ba'i yo byad du rung bar byin gyis rlob par byed na nyes par byin gyis brlams ③pa yin no/ /dge slong gis dge slong la chos gos dag skur dubar byed pa na/ gang la bskur ⑤ba des ༷slar bzlog latshu/ gang gis bskur nib de la yid gcugs ⑨pas spyad na legs par spyad pa yin no/ /gang la bskur ⑩ba de la yid gcugs 0pas spyad na nyes par spyad pa yin no/ /dge slong gis dge slong la chos gos dag skur 8ba na gang la bskur tsob de ni shi la gang la bskur 8ba de'i 8shi ba'i yo byad du rung bar byin gyis rlob par phyebyed na legs ⑩par byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ /gang gis bskur 4)ba de'i shi ba'i yo byad du byin gyis rlob par byed na nyes par byin gyis brlabs yipa yin no//dge slong gis dge slong dul chos gos dag skur ⑥bar byed pa na gang la bskur ⑫ba des slar bzlog dul gang gis bskur rdzib de yang shi nas gang la bskur tsob de la yid gcugs 0pas spyad tshun nyes par spyad pa yin no/ /gang la bskur ba de'i 0shi ba'i yo byad du 0rung bar byin gyis rlob par byed na legs par byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ /dge slong gis dge slong la chos gos dag skur 0bar byed pa na gang la bskur (spreb des slar bzlog nas de shi la/ gang gis skur 9bar byed pa de yang shi na/ de ⑥shi ba'i yo byad du rung bar byin gyis rlob par byed na nyes par byin gyis brlabs ⑥pa yin no/ /gang gis bskur ba de'i shi ba'i yo byad du rung bar byin gyis rlob par byed na legs par byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ /gos kyi gzhi rdzogs sos // //3—274

sra brkyang gi gzhi'i sdom ni/ gnas bcas pa dang kha cig dang / /rdol ba dang ni glings ①pa dang / /dus dang gang zag ma mo'i gzhi/ /nyi shu dag tu byas pa dang / /dgos ②pa dag ni ①bcu gnyis te/ /gnas bcas dbyar gnas dam bcas pa/ /ston pa lta bar ༷'dod pa naX/ /'dam rdzab 0kyis ni ngal gyur pa/ /de la der ni chos gos gnang / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon 0med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra bar ⑧dbyar bzhugs par zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de'i tshe dge slong rab tu mang po dag gnas bcas su dbyar gnas par dam ⑨bcas te dbyar gyi zla ba gsum po dag 'das nas chos gos byas pa dang ldan chos gos zin pa dang ldan nas lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te/ rtswa stug po dang rdzab chen por tsha bas ngal bar gyur cing rngul gyis lus yog 4)bzhin (spemanyan yod gang na ba der rgyu zhing song ste/rim gyis rgyu zhing song ba dang mnyan yod du phyin to/ /de nas dge slong rab tu mang po dag gis chos gos dang lhung bzed mkhos su phab nas rkang pa bkrus te/bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong nas lhags pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /chos nyid kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni glo 8bur du lhags pa'i dge slong rnams la so so yang dag par dga' bar mdzad pa 'dis so so yang dag par dga' bar mdzad de/ dge slong dag khyed da gzod 0ga nas 'ongs/ gnas gang du dbyar gnas gnas/ btsun pa bdag cag ni gnas bcas nas da gzod (stemachis lags te/ bdag cag gnas bcas na dbyar phonyemachis lags so/ /dge slong dag khyed cag gnas bcas su ci ga bde ba tshul reg 3—275

par dbyar gnas sam/ bsod snyoms kyis brel bar ma gyur mod/ btsun pa mad ①par gsol te/ bdag cag gnas bcas su rgyabade ba la reg par dbyar gnas shing bdag cag bsod snyoms kyis kyang brel ba ma mchis lags so/ /'on kyang bdag cag lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te/ rtswa stug po dang rdzab chen por tsha bas ngal bar gyur cing rngul gyis lus yog ①pas ljongs rgyu zhing mchis te/ rim gyis rgyu zhing mchi dub na tshegs 0chen pos 'dir mchis pa dulags so// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po drug bcu ⑦bdun pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ kye ma nga'i nyan thos rnams lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te rtswa ⑧stug po dang rdzob chen por tsha bas ngal bar gyur cing / lus rngul gyis yog ⑨pas ljongs rgyu zhing 'gro ba ni nyon mongs kyis0/ ma la ngas dge slong rnams ⑪reg par gnas par bya ba'i phyir dang ⑫/ sbyin pa po rnams kyi sbyin pa'i chos longs spyad 8par bya ba'i phyir dge slong rnams la sra brkyang gnang bar bya'o/ /'di ltar sra brkyang bting tson phan yon lnga yod de zhag bcu las thal na ma yin pa dang / zla ba las thal na ma yin pa dang / nub mo bral na ma yin pa dang /bla gos mthang 4)gos dang bcas pa'i chos gos kyis ljongs rgyur 'gro ba dang /chos gos rung ba ma yin pa ji tsam 'dod pa 'chang ba na ma tho)yin pa'o/ /gzhan yang phan yon lnga yod de/ tshogs shing za na ma yin pa dang / yang yang za yin ma yin pa dang / khyim rnams su mgron 'du ma bos par 'gro na ma yin pa dang / ji tsam 'dod pa'i 0chos gos btsal ba dang / ston zla 'bring po nas dpyid zla tshur ba'i bar gyi nang der sra brkyang bting ba rnams kyi rnyed pa 3—276

yin no snyam du dgongs nas①/ dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na ngas rjes su gnang ste/ dge slong rnams bde ba la ②reg par gnas par bya ba'i phyir dang / sbyin pa po rnams kyi sbyin pa'i chos longs spyad ②par bya ba'i phyir dbyar gnas pa'i dge slong rnams kyis dusra brkyang gding ⑤bar bya'o / /'di ltar sra brkyang la phan yon lnga yod de/ zhag bcu thal na ⑥ma yin pa dang zhes bya ba nas sra brkyang bting ba rnams kyi rnyed pa yin no zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o⑦/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sra brkyang gding ⑧bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal na/ dge slong rnams kyis sra brkyang ji ltar gding ba ma shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi chos gos kyi rnyed pa yod pa gang yin pa de las gding bar bya'o/ /gding ba ni 'di ltar bya ste/ re zhig thog mar mthun pa'i go bar bya ⑨ste/chos gos 'di ni dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi 0chos gos kyi rnyed pa byung ba lags te/ gal te dge 'dun bzhed (nyen chos gos 'dis dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang gding 8bar bgyi'o0/ /de nas phyi de nyin gnas mal bshams nas gaṇḍi ④brdungs te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo la/ dge 'dun thams cad tshogs shing mthun par gyur pa dang / dge slong gcig gis gsol yib byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/chos gos 'di ni dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi chos gos kyi rnyed pa byung ba lags te/ dge 'dun gyi chos gos 'dis sra brkyang bgyis (nyenas sra brkyang gding bar bzhed na/ des na sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chas pa la chos gos rnying 4)pa rnams 4)dang 'bral 4)ba yang mi 'byung na/ gsar pa rnams ( spre3—277

dang lta smos kyang ci 'tshal bar gal te dge 'dun gyi ①dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / 'di ltar dge 'dun gyis ②chos gos 'di sra brkyang du mdzad deni/ chos gos 'dis dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang 'dings sodu/ /des na sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chas pa la chos gos rnying pa rnams dang 'bral ba yang mi 'byung na/ gsar ⑤pa rnams dang lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ 'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las 0ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ chos gos 'di ni dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa byung ba lags la/ dge 'dun yang sra brkyang bgyi bar bzhed de/ dge 'dun gyis chos gos 'di sra brkyang du mdzad pas chos gos 'dis dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang 'dings so0/ /des na sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chas pa la chos gos rnying pa rnams dang 'bral ba yang mi 'byung na/gsar 0pa rnams dang ①lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams las gang dag chos gos 'di sra brkyang du bgyi zhing chos gos 'dis dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang bting ste/ des na sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chas pa las chos gos rnying pa rnams dang 'bral tshub yang mi 'byung na/ gsar yipa rnams dang lta smos kyang ci 'tshal bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung 8shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung 8shig /dge 'dun gyis chos gos 'di 8sra brkyang du mdzad nas chos gos 'dis dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang 'dings 8te/ des na sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chas pa la 4)chos gos rnying pa rnams dang 'bral 4)ba yang mi 'byung na/ gsar 8pa rnams dang lta smos kyang ci 'tshal bar dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /3—278

de'i 'og tu sra ①brkyang 'dings ②pa'i dge slong bsko bar bya ste/ chos lnga dang ldan pa'i dge slong ni sra brkyang 'dings par ma bskos pa ni bsko bar mi bya zhing bskos pa ni dbyung bar bya'o/ /lnga dugang zhe na/ dbyar gyi ma yin pa dang /dbyar ral ba dang / dbyar phyi mar gnas par dam bcas pa dang / dbyar tha dad par gnas pa rjodang / bslab pa byin pa'o/ /gzhan yang chos lnga dang ldan na bsko bar mi bya ste/ spo ba pa rjodang / gzhi nas spo ba pa dang /mgu bar bya ba spyod pa dang / gzhi nas mgu bar bya ba spyod pa dang / gnas nas phyung ba'o/ / gzhan yang 0chos lnga dang ldan na bsko ⑦bar mi 0bya ste/'dun pas 'gro ba dang / zhe snang gis 'gro ba dang / gti mug gis 'gro ba dang / 'jigs pas 'gro ba dang / sra brkyang bting ba dang ma bting ⑨ba mi shes pa'o/ /yang chos lnga dang ldan pa'i dge slong ⑨ ni sra brkyang 'dings par ⑨ma bskos 8pa ni bsko 'bar bya zhing bskos pa ni dbyung bar mi bya'o/ /lnga gang zhe na / 'dun pas mi 'gro ba dang / zhe sdang gis mi 'gro ba dang / gti mug gis mi 'gro ba dang / 'jigs pas mi 'gro ba dang / sra brkyang bting ba dang ma bting thosteb shes pa'o/ /bsko ba ni 'di ltar bya ste/ gnas mal bshams te zhes bya ba nas/ dge 'dun thams cad tshogs shing mthun par gyur pa dang zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ re zhig thog mar spro bar bya ste/ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang 'dings par spro'amatso/ gal te spro na des spro'o zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu dge slong gcig gis gsol bar ⑩byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun ⑩pa rnams gsan du gsol/sra brkyang 'dings pa'i dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi sra 3—279

brkyang 'dings par spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi ①dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / 'di ltar dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba sra brkyang ②'dings par bskos ③te/ sra brkyang rjo'adings pa ming 'di 0zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang 'dings par 'gyur rol/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ sra brkyang 'dings pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di rjodage 'dun gyi sra brkyang 'dings par spro na/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba sra brkyang 'dings par bskos te/ sra brkyang 'dings pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang 'dings ⑦par 'gyur na/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams las gang dag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba sra brkyang 'dings par bsko ⑧bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung 0shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de tshudag ni gsung ⑩shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis 8sra brkyang 'dings pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang 'dings par bskos te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas 8de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /de nas gsol bas sra brkyang 'dings pa'i dge slong la sra brkyang sbyin par bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge 'dun gyis chos gos 'di ni sra brkyang du mdzad lags ④la/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di yang sra brkyang 'dings par bskos lags te/ gal te dge 'dun gyi 8dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / 'di ltar dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la chos gos 'di sra brkyang gi slad du stsal tsoto//'di ni gsol ba'o/ /ngas dge slong sra brkyang 'dings pa'i kun tu spyod pa'i 3—280

chos dag bca' bar bya ste/ dge slong sra brkyang 'dings ①pas sra brkyang la thams cad du thog mar 'gro bar bya ste/ bkru'o/ /brkyang ngo / /dra'o/ /drub bo/ /kha bsgyur ②ro/ /chung ngu na khab kyis srubs ③gnyis sam/gsum yang btsem par bya'o/ /lan gnyis sam dugasum du sems bskyed par bya'o / /de nas ston zla ⑤'bring po zla ba yar dugyi ngo'i tshes bco lnga la go bar bya ste / tshe dang ldan pa dag sang kho bo sra brkyang 'dings kyis tsokhyed cag so so'i chos gos ⑤sngags phyung shig /de nas sra brkyang 'dings pa'i dge slong gis sra brkyang dri dang me tog gis ⑨gtor zhing dri zhim po'i bdug pas bdugs nas gnas mal bshams te gaṇḍi skyabardungs nas dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo la/ dge 'dun thams cad tshogs shing mthun par gyur pa dang rgan pa'i mthar gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas rgan pa'i mthar 'dug nas sra brkyang blangs 0te/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams 4)gsan du gsol/ dge 'dun gyis chos gos 'di ni sra brkyang du mdzad la/ bdag dge slong ming ⑫'di zhes bgyi ba yang sra brkyang 'dings par bskos te/ sra brkyang 'dings pa bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas chos gos 'dis dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang 'dings par 'gyur ro/ /gding ngo / /bting ngo / /de skad lan gnyis lan gsum du brjod par bya'o/ /de nas bting nas dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyi mdun du 'dug ste 'di skad ces gnas brtan dgongs su gsol/ chos gos 'di ni dge 'dun gyis sra brkyang ④du mdzad la/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang sra brkyang 'dings par 8bskos pa lags te/ bdag 8gis chos gos 'dis dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang bting lags so zhes brjod par bya'o/ /des legs par 3—281

bting ngo / /shin tu bting ste/ 'di la rnyed pa dang phan yon yod pa gang yin pa de ni bdag cag gi yin no zhes brjod par bya zhing de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du dge 'dun gsar bu'i bar du thams cad kyis legs par bting ngo / /shin tu bting ste/ 'di la rnyed pa dang phan yon yod pa gang yin pa ①de ni bdag cag ②gi yin no zhes brjod par bya'o/ /sra brkyang 'dings pa'i dge slong gis sra brkyang thogs te chab khung sar ma yin/ snams ③phyi sar ma yin te/ tshang bang ༷du 'jug par mi bya'o/ /mtshams kyi phyi rol tu 'gro bar mi bya'o/ /gal te song na der gnas par mi bya'o/ /sra brkyang 'dings pa'i dge slong gis kun tu spyod pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa bzhin yang ⑤dag par blangs te 'jug par mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /de nas sra brkyang 'dings pa'i dge slong gis dpyid zla ra ba ༷yar gyi ngo'i ⑦tshis bco lnga la yang go bar bya ste/ tshe dang ldan pa dag sang kho bo sra brkyang 'byin gyis ⑧khyed cag so so'i chos gos rnams byin gyis rlobs shig /de la rnyed pa byung ba gang yin pa de ni dge 'dun gyis bgo ⑨bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ⑩'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa du zhig gi ⑩sra brkyang ma bting lags/ nye ba 8'khor lnga'i ste/ dbyar gyi ma yin pa dang /dbyar ral ba dang / dbyar phyi mar gnas par dam bcas pa dang / dbyar tha dad par gnas par dam bcas pa dang / sra brkyang de 'dings pa na mngon sum du ma gyur pa'i'o0/ /gzhan yang 'di lnga'i ma bting ba yin te/ spo ba pa dang / spo byab spyad zin pa dang / mgu bar bya ba spyod pa dang /bya mgu bar bya ba spyad zin pa dang / bslab pa byin pa'i'o⑩/ /btsun pa du zhig gi 3—282

rnyed pa mchis la phan yon ma mchis lags/ nye ba ①'khor lnga'i ste/ dbyar gyi ma yin pa dang / dbyar ral ba dang / dbyar phyi mar gnas par dam bcas pa dang / dbyar tha dad par gnas par dam ②bcas pa dang / sra brkyang de 'dings pa na mngon sum ③du ma gyur pa'i'o/ /gzhan yang lnga po 'di dag gi ste/ spo ba pa dang / spo ba spyad zin pa dang / mgu bar bya ba spyod pa dang / mgu bar bya ba spyad zin pa dang / bslab pa byin pa'i'o/ /btsun pa du zhig gi rjornyed pa yang ma mchis la phan yon yang ma mchis lags/nye ba ⑤'khor lnga'i ste/ ma mthong bas gnas nas phyung ba dang / phyir mi byed pas gnas nas phyung ba dang / sdig pa'i lta bar song ba ma bor bas gnas nas phyung ba dang / dbyar tha dad par gnas pa dang / dge 'dun bye yin chos ma yin pa'i phyogs pa'i'o/ /dge slong rab tu mang po dag ༷ljongs rgyu zhing dong ⑧ba na chom rkun pa rnams kyis bcom nas de dag rim gyis mnyan ⑨yod du phyin pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis mthong nas tshe dang ldan pa dag 'ongs pa legs so//'ongs pa legs so/ /ji ga bde bar spyad dam/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bde bar spyad pa ni ci 'dra ba zhig /bdag cag ni chom rkun pa rnams kyis bcom mo//tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag cag la rnyed pa mang du byung ste/ gal te sra brkyang phyung na khyed la chos gos kyi bgo bsha' bya ba zhig ces pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na ngas tho )rjes su gnang ste/ chom rkun pa dag yigis bcom pa'i dge slong rnams kyi phyir sra brkyang dbyung bar bya'o/ /dbyung ba ni 'di ltar bya ste/ gnas mal bshams la gaṇḍi tsobardungs te dris pa'i tshig gis 3—283

dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo la/ dge 'dun thams cad tshogs shing mthun par gyur pa dang / dge slong gcig gis gsol ba ①byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ /gnas 'dir dge 'dun mthun pas 'di srid du sra brkyang bting ba las/ dge slong rab tu mang po chom rkun pa dag gis bcom nas lhags na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi ②dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / 'di ltar dge 'dun gyis dge slong chom rkun gyis bcom pa rnams kyi slad du sra brkyang 'byin par ③mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gnas 'dir dge 'dun mthun pas 'di srid du sra brkyang bting ba las/ dge slong rab tu mang po chom rkun pa dag gis bcom nas lhags te/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong chom rkun dupa dag gis bcom pa rnams kyi slad du sra brkyang 'byin par mdzad na/ tshe dang ldan pa dag las gang dag dge slong chom rkun pa dag gis bcom pa rnams kyi phyir sra brkyang 'byin par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung 0shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung 0shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong chom rkun pa dag gis bcom pa rnams kyi slad du sra brkyang 'byin par mdzad de / gang gi slad du ⑦mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /de nas rnyed pa byung ba ⑧gang yin pa de bgo bar bya ste/ bgos nas gang 'dod pa des rang gi skal ⑨ba las chom rkun pa dag gis bcom pa'i dge slong rnams la bgo bsha' bya'o / / // 3—284

sdom la/ rdol ①ba dang ni sril zos dang / /mtha' skor lhan rlo lhan rings ②dang / /gso ma'i seng ras zegs ②pa dang / /rnyings ④dang spangs dang dengs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ⑤'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa chos gos rdol dubs sra brkyang gding du rung lags samatshu/ nye ba ⑧'khor mi rung ngo / /btsun pa chos gos srog chags kyis 'tshal ba dang / chos gos cha ga btab pa dang / chos gos lhan pa rlo bos btab pa dang / chos gos lhan rings nyucan dang / gso ma'i seng ras kyi chos gos dang / chos gos zegs pa dang / chos gos rnyings ⑩pa dang /chos gos spangs pa dang / chos gos dengs 4)pas sra brkyang gding du rung lags sam/ nye ba 8'khor mi rung ngo // //sdom la/ glings dang dus ma yin pa dang / /gang zag gi 8ni chos gos gsum/ /mi rung ba dang ma dras dang / /khru lngar ma chog ④mi bya dang / /blo ⑫mthun min dang mi gding dang / /mtshams kyi phyi rol mi skye'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba skye'akhor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa glings pa'i chos gos kyis sra brkyang ⑩gding du rung lags sam/ nye ba 8'khor mi rung ngo / /btsun pa dus ma lags pa'i yichos gos dang / gang zag gi snam sbyar dang / bla gos dang mthang gos dang / mi rung ba'i chos gos dang /ma dras pa dang / khru lngar dum mchis pa dang / blo mthun par ma bgyis pa'i chos gos dang / sra brkyang 'dings pa ⑥ma bskos pa dang / mtshams kyi slad rol tu blo mthun par bgyis pa'i chos gos kyi sra brkyang dang / mtshams kyi slad 3—285

rol tu bskos pa'i sra brkyang ①'dings pas sra brkyang gding ②du rung lags sam/nye ba ③'khor mi rung ngo // //sdom la/ dus kyi nang duni zla ba gsum/ /gsar ⑤pa dang ni brtags pa nyid/ /phongs pa dang ni gso ma'i ras/ /gang zag gi ni chos gos gsum/ /btsun pa dus kyi chos gos kyis dge 'dun gyi sra brkyang gding du rung lags sam/ nye ba du'akhor rung ngo / /btsun pa dgung ⑦sla gsum 'das nas dge 'dun gyi chos gos kyi rnyed pa gang lags pa des sra brkyang gding du rung lags sam/ nye ba ⑧'khor rung ngo / /chos gos sar ⑨pa rung ngo / /sar ⑩pa brtags pa rung ngo / /phongs pa'i chos gos rung ngo / /gso ma'i seng ras snam sbyar mi rung ngo / /btsun pa gang zag gi snam sbyar gyis sra brkyang gding du shyirung lags sam/ nye ba 'khor tsogal te dge 'dun la phul bar gyur na rung ngo / /bla gos dang mthang 0gos kyang de bzhin no// //sdom la/ gang zag gi dang khyim pa'i byadang / /khru 8lnga pa dang khru lnga'i lhag /blo mthun byas pa'i gding ba dang / /mtshams kyi nang nyid skye ba'o/ /btsun pa gang zag gi chos gos kyis 8sra brkyang gding du rung lags sam/ mi rung ngo / /gal te dge 'dun la phul bar gyur na'o/ /khyim pa'i gos kyis mi rung ngo / /gal te dge 'dun la phul bar gyur na rung ngo / /khru lnga pas rung ngo / /khru lnga las lhag pa 0rung ngo / /blo mthun par byas pa'i sra brkyang gi chos gos dang / sra (nyebarkyang 'dings pas 4)rung ngo / /mtshams kyi nang du blo 3—286

mthun par byas pa'i sra brkyang gi chos gos kyis rung ngo / /mtshams kyi nang du sra brkyang 'dings pa bskos ①pas rung ngo / /ma mo brgyad kyi gzhis sra brkyang phyung bar gyur ②te/ brgyad gang zhe na/ song ba dang / rdzogs pa dang /nges pa dang / nyams pa dang / thos pa dang / mtshams 'das pa dang /re thag chad pa dang / brgyad pa ni sra brkyang phyung ba nyid de/ song ba'i mtha' can gyis dusra brkyang phyung ba dang / rdzogs pa'i mtha' can dang /nges pa'i mtha' can dang / nyams pa'i mtha' can dang / thos pa'i mtha' can dang / mtshams 'das pa dang / re thag chad pa dang / brgyad pa ni sra brkyang phyung zin pa nyid yin no/ /song duba'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par chos gos dang lhung bzed ⑤blangs te/ phyir mi 'ong bar mtshams kyi phyi rol du song ba de'i ni song ba'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /rdzogs pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song dunas phyir 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o snyam pa las de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag slar mi 'ong ste 'on kyang chos gos bya'o snyam pa ⑦de'i ni rdzogs pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ⑧ba yin no/ /nges pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong 0zhing chos gos bya'o snyam pa las de 'di snyam du sems te/ slar mi 'ong zhing chos gos kyang mi bya'o snyam pa de'i ni nges pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang 3—287

phyung ba yin no/ /nyams pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba gang zhe na/'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas ①chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o snyam pa las de 'di snyam du sems te slar yang mi 'ong la chos gos kyang mi bya'o snyam nas/des de rtsom ②zhing brtsams pa dang / nyams pa de'i ni nyams pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /thos pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba gang zhe na / 'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ongs te chos gos bya'o snyam pa las/ dge 'dun mthun pas sra brkyang phyung la des dge 'dun mthun pas sra brkyang phyung ngo zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang legs par phyung ngo / /shin tu phyung ngo zhes rjes su yi rang ba byas pa de'i ni thos pa'i mtha' can gyi ③sla brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /mtshams 'das pa pa'i sra brkyang phyung ba gang zhe na/'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par duphyir 'ong ngam ⑤mi 'ong snyam pa las/ mtshams kyi phyi rol tu song ba de'i ni mtshams 'das pa pa'i sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /re thag chad pa pa'i sra brkyang phyung ba gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong 0zhing chos gos bya'o snyam pa las/ de'i chos gos re ba gang yin pa de ⑦thams cad du chad pa de'i ni re thag chad pa pa'i sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /brgyad pa sra brkyang phyung ba nyid gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song 3—288

ba las de yang slar 'ongs shing sra brkyang phyung ba nyams su myong ba de'i ni brgyad pa sra brkyang phyung ba nyid yin no// //sdom la/ ma byas pa ni nyi shu dang / /brtsams pa dag ni nyi shu dang / /re ba yod pa nyi shu dang / /re ba med pa nyi shu yin①/ /'di lta ste/ dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams ②kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o snyam pa las de 'di snyam du sems te/ slar mi 'ong mod kyi 'on kyang chos gos bya'o snyam pa de'i ni rdzogs pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste/ dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o snyam pa las de 'di snyam du sems te/ slar mi 'ong zhing chos gos kyang mi bya'o snyam pa de'i ni nges pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o snyam pa las des de rtsom zhing de'i brtsams pa nyams pa ③de'i ni nyams pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no//'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi ༷rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o snyam pa las dge 'dun mthun pas sra brkyang phyung la/ des dge 'dun mthun pas sra brkyang phyung ngo zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang legs par phyung ngo / /shin tu phyung ngo zhes rjes su yi rang ba byas pa dude'i ni thos pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang 3—289

phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o snyam pa las/ de der song nas ①'di snyam du sems te/ slar mi 'ong zhing 'on kyang chos gos ni bya'o snyam pa de'i ni rdzogs pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o snyam pa las de der song nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ slar mi 'ong zhing chos ②gos kyang mi bya'o snyam pa de'i ni nges pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o snyam pa las/ de der song nas rtsom zhing de'i brtsams pa nyams pa ①de'i ni nyams pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o snyam pa las/ dge 'dun mthun pas sra brkyang phyung la des ④dge 'dun mthun pas sra brkyang phyung ngo zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang legs par phyung ngo / /shin tu phyung ngo zhes rjes su yi rang ba byas pa de'i ni thos pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong ⑤su brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 6)'ong zhing chos gos bya'o zhes sems la bzhag pa las de 'di snyam du sems te/ slar mi 'ong zhing 'on ④kyang chos gos bya'o snyam pa de'i ni rdzogs pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /3—290

'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas ②slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o zhes sems la bzhag pa las/ de der song nas 'di snyam du sems te/ slar mi 'ong zhing chos gos kyang mi bya'o snyam pa de'i ②ni nges pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ①ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o zhes sems la bzhag pa las des de rtsom duzhing de'i brtsams pa nyams pa de'i ni nyams pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o zhes sems la bzhag pa las/ dge 'dun mthun pas ⑤sla brkyang phyung la des dge 'dun mthun pas sra brkyang phyung ngo zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang legs par phyung ngo / /shin tu phyung ngo zhes rjes su yi rang bar ⑥byas pa de'i ni thos pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o zhes sems la bzhag pa las/ de der song nas 'di snyam du sems te/ slar mi 'ong ste 'on kyang chos gos bya'o snyam pa de'i ni rdzogs pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o zhes sems la bzhag pa las/ de der song nas 'di snyam du sems te/ slar mi 'ong zhing chos gos kyang mi bya'o snyam pa de'i 3—291

ni nges pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol tu song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o zhes sems la bzhag pa las/de der song nas rtsom zhing de'i brtsams pa nyams pa de'i ni nyams pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang ①bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o zhes sems la bzhag pa las/ dge 'dun mthun pas sra brkyang phyung la ②des dge 'dun mthun pas sra brkyang phyung ngo / /zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang legs par phyung ngo / /shin tu phyung ngo zhes rjes su yi rang ba ①byas pa de'i ni thos pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /du'adi lta ste/ dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par ci slar 'ong ngam 'on te slar mi 'ong zhes sems la the tshom za bzhin mtshams kyi phyi rol du song ba tshulas/ de 'di snyam du sems te/ slar mi ⑦'ong ste 'on kyang chos gos ni bya'o/ /snyam pa de'i ⑦ni rdzogs pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste/ dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par ci slar 'ong ngam 'on te slar mi (kye'ong zhes sems la the tshom za bzhin stimatshams kyi phyi rol du song ba las/de 'di snyam du sems te/ slar mi 'ong zhing chos gos kyang mi bya'o snyam pa de'i ni nges pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste/ dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par ci slar 'ong ngam 'on te slar mi 'ong zhes sems la the tshom za bzhin mtshams kyi phyi rol 3—292

du song ba las①/ des de rtsom ②zhing de'i brtsams pa nyams pa de'i ni nyams pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par ci slar 'ong ngam 'on te slar mi 'ong zhes sems la the tshom za bzhin mtshams kyi phyi rol du song ba las/ dge 'dun mthun pas sra brkyang phyung la des dge 'dun mthun pas sra brkyang phyung ngo / /zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang legs par phyung ngo / /shin tu phyung ngo zhes rjes su yi rang ba byas pa de'i ni thos pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ②ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas zhes bya ba thams cad brjod par bya'o/ /'on kyang snga ma'i nyi shu la ni chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par zhes bya'o/ /'dir ni chos gos ma zin pa ④zhes bya ba bor te/ chos gos brtsams pa zhes bya ba bcug ste rnam pa 'dis ⑤nyi shu pa gzhan dubya'o/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par mtshams kyi phyi ④rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o snyam pa'i re ba yod pa las de 'di snyam du sems te slar mi 'ong ste 'on kyang chos gos ni bya'o snyam pa de'i ni rdzogs pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin te/ re ba yod pa zhes bya ba'i khyad par 'dis snga dum bzhin du nyi shu pa gzhan bya'o/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ⑨ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o snyam pa'i re ba med par mtshams kyi phyi rol du song ba las de 'di snyam du sems te/ slar mi 'ong zhing 'on kyang chos gos ni bya'o/ /snyam pa de'i ni 7rdzogs pa'i mtha' can 3—293

gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin te/ re ba med pa zhes bya ba'i khyad par 'dis snga ma bzhin du nyi shu pa gzhan bya'o// //sdom la/ bya ba dag ni bcu gnyis dang / /btsal ①ba dang ni de bzhin gzhan/ /yul la lngar ②ni bya ba ste/ /gnas la ③yang ni lnga yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par bya ba zhig la mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o snyam pa las de 'di snyam du sems te/ slar mi 'ong ste 'on kyang chos gos ni ④bya'o snyam pa de'i ni rdzogs pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par bya ba zhig la mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o snyam pa las de 'di snyam du sems te/ slar mi 'ong zhing chos gos kyang mi bya'o snyam pa de'i ni nges pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par bya ba zhig la mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o snyam 0pa las / des de rtsom zhing de brtsams pa las 0nyams pa de'i ni nyams pa'i ⑦mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par bya ba zhig la mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos 0bya'o snyam pa las dge 'dun mthun pas sra brkyang phyung la des dge 'dun mthun pas sra brkyang phyung ngo zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang legs par phyung ngo / /shin tu phyung ngo zhes rjes su yi rang ba byas 3—294

pa de'i ni thos pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang ①bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par bya ba zhig la mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o snyam pa las/de der song nas 'di snyam du sems te/ slar mi 'ong ste 'on kyang chos gos ni bya'o snyam pa de'i ②ni rdzogs pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /der song nas zhes bya ba'i khyad par 'dis rdzogs pa'i mtha' can ②gsungs pa ji lta ba bzhin du dunges pa'i mtha' can dang / nyams pa'i mtha' can dang /thos pa'i mtha' can yang de bzhin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par bya ba zhig gi ched la mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas ci slar 'ong ngam 'on te slar mi 'ong zhes sems la the tshom za ba las/ de 'di snyam du sems te slar mi 'ong ste 'on kyang chos gos bya'o snyam pa de'i 0ni rdzogs pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /sems la the tshom za bas rdzogs pa'i mtha' can gsungs pa ②ji lta ⑦bar nges pa'i nimatha' can dang / nyams pa'i mtha' can dang / thos pa'i mtha' can yang de bzhin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par btsal ⑨ba zhig la mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas slar 'ong zhing chos gos bya'o snyam pa las de 'di snyam du sems te/ slar mi 'ong ste 'on kyang chos gos ni bya'o snyam pa de'i ni rdzogs pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /btsal ba ⑩zhes bya ba'i khyad par 'dis snga ma bzhin du bcu gnyis pa gzhan no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par slar mi 'ong bar yul ltar yimatshams kyi phyi 3—295

rol du song ba de'i ni song ba'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong sra brkyang bting ba'i gnas nas chos gos ma byas chos gos ma zin par yul ltar ①mtshams kyi phyi rol du song nas ci slar 'ong ngam 'on te slar mi 'ong zhes sems la the tshom za ba las de 'di snyam du sems te slar mi 'ong ste 'on kyang chos gos ni ②bya'o/ /snyam pa de'i ni rdzogs pa'i mtha' can gyi sra brkyang phyung ba yin te/ nges pa'i mtha' can dang / nyams pa'i mtha' can dang /thos pa'i mtha' can yang de bzhin no/ /yul lta ba'i lnga ji lta bar gnas lta ba'i lnga yang de bzhin no/ /sra brkyang gi gzhi rdzogs sodu// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po drug bcu dubargyad pa/ kau shāsbyi'i dugazhi'i sdom ni/ kau shāsbyir ni 'thab grol dugyi/ /dge slong rtsorno pa sna tshogs dang / /khre'u ⑦dang rtsod ⑧par byed pa dang / /ring po len gyi spyod pa dang / /ngan spong lan tshwa khang pa ⑨dang / /srung yidang tshal stug glang chen dang / /ma 'gags ⑩pas ni nges tsobyas dang / /mnyan yod du ni zhi bar byas/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kau shāsbyi'i dbyangs ldan gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe kau shāsbyi'i dge slong gdug pa rnam par gnon pa / mdo sde 'dzin pa/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ ma mo 'dzin pa zhig yod de/ de'i grogs byed pa'i dge slong mang po yang gdug pa rnam par gnon pa/ mdo sde 'dzin pa/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ma mo 'dzin pa yin no/ /yangs pa can na yangs pa can gyi dge slong gdug pa rnam par gnon pa/ mdo sde 'dzin pa/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ ma mo 'dzin pa zhig yod de/ de'i grogs byed pa'i dge slong mang po yang gdug pa 3—296

rnam par gnon pa/ mdo sde 'dzin pa/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ ma mo 'dzin pa yin no/ /de nas yangs pa can gyi dge slong dus gzhan zhig na ljongs rgyu zhing song ba dang kau shāsbyir phyin ①te/ de lam gyis dub pa ngal bsos ②nas kau shāsbyi'i dge slong gi drung du song ste phyin ①pa dang / phan tshun so so yang dag par dga' bar byas nas mdo sde dang / 'dul ba dang / chos mngon pa rnams gtan la dbab par brtsams te/ de nas ④gcig gis smras pa/ mdo sde 'di ni 'di skad du gdon par bya ste/ mdo sde 'di'i don ni 'di yin no/ /cig shos kyis smras pa/ mdo sde 'di ni de skad du gdon par mi bya ste/ mdo sde 'di'i don ni 'di ⑤ma yin no/ /kho bo'i ni rigs so/ /khyod kyi ni mi rigs so0/ /kho bo'i ni 'brel pa yin no/ /khyod kyi ni 'brel pa stim yin no zhes de gnyis phan tshun du ma ⑧mthun par gyur nas kau shāsbyi'i dge slong gis yangs pa can gyi dge slong la klan ⑨ka btsal ( )ba lhur len cing 'dug go/ /dge 'dun gyis kyang 'di lta bu'i khrims su bca' ba byas te/ gang gis khrus kyi bum pa chu 'gribs ⑩pa dang / nyung ba dang / chu med par tsomathong ba des chus bkang ste gnas ji lta ba 8bzhin du gzhag par bya ba'am/ dge skos ④la khrus kyi bum pa stong par 'dug go zhes bsgo bar tsobya'o/ /gal te bdag nyid kyis ma bkang tshungam dge skos tshul ma bsgos par ⑩gyur na de ni ma gus pa yin te/ma gus pa'i phyir de bdag cag gis ltung byed kyi ltung ba 'chags yisu gzhug ( )go zhes byas ⑥so/ /ji tsam na khyim bdag cig gis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dudage slong gi dge 'dun khyim du gdugs tshod la spyan drangs so/ /de na dge slong kha cig ni zas la dong ngo / /kha cig ni 'gro bar chas so/ /yangs pa can gyi 3—297

dge slong khrus kyi bum pa blangs nas snam ①phyi sar zhugs pa dang / de'i lhan cig gnas pas rings rings ltar 'ongs nas sgra phyung chab/ mkhan po dge slong kha cig ni zas la dong lags so/ /kha cig ni 'dong bar chas kyis 3tshur spyon bzhud do/ /de de dang lhan cig khrus kyi bum pa gnas gcig tu bzhag ste chas so / /kau shāsbyi'i dge slong de yang phyogs de nyid du phyin pa dang / de nas yangs pa can gyi dge slong des khrus kyi bum pa blangs te gtsug lag khang du 'jug par bsams ④pa dang lhan cig gnas pas smras pa/ mkhan po gar bzhud/des smras pa/ bu kho bo la kau shāsbyi'i dge slong 'di klan ka tshol bas dukhrus kyi bum pa 'gengs 6)su 'gro'o/ /ci 'di thams cad kyi ༅thams cad du ②stong ngam/thams cad kyi thams cad du stong pa ma yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang chu 'dis chu'i bya ba byed mi nus so/ /mkhan po thams cad kyi thams cad du stong ⑨par ma gyur pas 'tshal te/ bdag cag ni mkhan po'i phyogs dang / dpung tho byedang /grogs bgyid pa lags kyis 2tshur spyon bzhud do/ /des de nyid du bzhag nas de dang lhan cig tu dong ngo / /kau shāsbyi'i dge slong gis mthong nas khrus kyi bum pa de la mnams so/ /de nas mi bzod pa skyes te mjal tho)to zhes byas nas khrus kyi bum pa bkang ste chu'i bya ba byas nas song ngo / /de nas zan zos nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gtsug lag khang du lhags pa dang / dge slong rnams la bsgrags pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag yangs pa can gyi dge slong des dge 'dun gyi nang khrims dral to/ /de nas rgan rims phonyeji lta ba bzhin du gdud ④pa byas nas rim 8gyis de'i drung du son pa dang / smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa skabs phye shig /ltung ba rigs tsolnga la skabs phye'o/ /khyod la de ring ltung ba byung gis ⑩3—298

ltung ba yang slar chos bzhin du gyis ①shig /ltung ba ma mthong ngo / /dge 'dun gyis ekhrims su bca' ba gang gis khrus kyi bum pa chu 'gribs ②pa dang /chu nyung ba dang / chu med pa mthong na bdag nyid kyis chus bkang ste/ gnas ji lta ba bzhin du gzhag par bya ba'am/ dge skos dul tshe dang ldan pa khrus kyi bum pa stong par 'dug go zhes bsgo bar bya'oX/ /bdag nyid kyis kyang ma bkang la dge skos dul yang ma bsgo na de ni ma gus pa yin te/ ci ma gus pa'i phyir de bdag cag gis ltung byed kyi ltung ba 'chags su gzhug tshugo zhes bcas pa ma yin nam/ des smras pa/ de ha cang stong pa ⑧ma yin no/ /stong par ma gyur kyang rung ste/ chu des chu'i bya ba byed mi nus so/ /des 0cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /kau shāsbyi'i dge slong ni kau shāsbyi na gnyug ma pa dang 'khor mang po ()yin pas des de la nan gyis gnas nas dbyung ba'i las byas pa dang /yangs pa can gyi dge slong rnams 'khrugs par gyur nas/ de na kau shāsbyi'i dge slong rnams dang 'thab krol dang / mtshang 'dru (spreb dang / rtsod pa dang /'gyed pa byung bar gyur te/ 'di lta ste ltung ba byung ngo zhe'am/ ltung ba ma byung ngo zhe'am/ gnas nas phyung 8ba yin no 8zhe'am/ gnas nas phyung ④ba ma yin no zhes/ gang yang ltung ba byung ba tunyedang / nyung ba med pa dang / gnas nas dbyung ba dang /⑩ gnas nas dbyung ba ma yin pa la gnas nas phyung ba gang yin pa de ⑩ni chos ma yin pa tsolas 'khrugs pa gzhag par 'os pas phyung ngo zhes pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ()gnas nas phyung ba'i dge slong dang /gnas nas phyung ba'i rjes su phyogs pa'i dge slong rnams dang / gnas nas 3—299

phyung ba'i rjes su phyogs pa'i yang rjes su phyogs pa rnams pho nyas bkug ste 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dge slong dag khyed 'thab krol dang mtshang ①'dru ba dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed ②pa byung nas/ 'di lta ste ltung ba byung ngo zhe'am zhes bya ba nas 'khrugs pa gzhag par 'os pas zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste bden nam/ btsun pa mad lags so/ /dge slong dag 'thab krol ma byed cig /mtshang ma 'dru zhig /ma rtsod ①cig /ma 'gyed cig /gzhan yang ngas gnas nas phyung ba'i dge slong gi kun du spyod ④pa'i chos bca' bar bya ste/ dge slong gnas nas phyung bas 'di snyam du sems bskyed par bya'o//gnas nas 'byin pa'i dge slong 'di ni gdug ⑤pa rnam par gnon pa/ mdo sde 'dzin pa/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ ma mo 'dzin pa yin la/ de'i grogs byed pa'i dge slong mang po yang gdug pa pha rol gnon pa/ mdo sde 'dzin pa/'dul ba 'dzin pa/ ma mo 'dzin pa yin te/ gal te bdag dugis nyung ba chos bzhin du ⑦slar ma byas na des na dge 'dun 'thab krol dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang / rtsod ⑧pa dang / 'gyed pa byung bas gnas par 'gyur gyisal/ma la bdag gis ltung ba phyir chos bzhin ⑩bya'o/ /gnas nas phyung ba'i dge slong gis 0kun tu spyod pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa bzhin yang dag par blangs te 'jug par mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ḍa/steganas nas phyung ba'i dge slong dang / gnas nas phyung 8ba'i rjes su phyogs pa'i dge slong rnams dang / gnas nas phyung ba'i rjes su phyogs pa'i yang rjes su phyogs pa rnams gzengs tsobastod nas gnas nas 'byin pa'i dge slong dang ⑫/ gnas nas 'byin pa'i rjes su phyogs pa'i dge slong rnams 3—300

dang / gnas nas 'byin pa'i rjes su phyogs pa'i yang rjes su phyogs pa'i dge slong rnams pho nyas bkug ste 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dge slong dag khyed 'thab krol dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa byung nas/ 'di lta ste ltung ba byung ngo zhe'am ①zhes bya ba nas 'khrugs pa ②gzhag par 'os pas ③zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste bden nam btsun dupa mad lags so/ /dge slong dag 'thab krol dum byed cig /mtshang ma 'dru zhig/ma rtsod cig /ma 'gyed cig /gzhan yang ngas gnas nas 'byin pa'i dge slong gi kun du spyod pa'i chos bca' bar dubya ste/ dge slong ⑦gnas nas 'byin pa ⑧'di snyam du sems bskyed ⑨par bya'o/ /gnas nas phyung ba'i dge slong 'di ni gdug pa rnam par gnon pa/ mdo sde 'dzin pa0/ 'dul ba 'dzin payi/ ma mo 'dzin pa yin la 'di'i grogs byed pa'i dge slong mang po yang gdug pa rnam par tsoganon pa/ mdo sde 'dzin pa/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ma mo 'dzin pa yin te0/ gal te bdag gis de la mi 'dod pa glengs sam(ste/dran par byas na des na dge 'dun 'thab krol dang / rtsod 4)pa dang /mtshang 'dru ba dang / 'gyed pa byung bas gnas par 'gyur gyisatso/ ma la bdag gis 'di la mi 'dod pa gleng bar mi bya dran par mi bya'o/ /gnas nas 'byin pa'i dge slong gis kun du spyod pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa bzhin ⑩yang dag par blangs te 'jug par mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal na8/ 'on kyang dge slong de rnams 'thab grol dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa byung ⑩bas gnas shing / da dung phyogaso sbyong la yang gso sbyong ma yin par byed 3—301

pa'i skabs de/ dge slong rnams kyis ①bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba dang /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas nas phyung ba'i dge slong dang / gnas nas phyung ba'i rjes su phyogs pa'i dge slong rnams dang / gnas nas phyung ba'i rjes su phyogs pa'i yang rjes su phyogs pa rnams pho nyas bkug ste 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dge slong dag khyed la ngas de skad ces bka' stsal kyang 'thab krol dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa byung bas gnas shing / da dung gso sbyong la yang gso sbyong ma yin par byed pa bden nam/btsun pa mad ②lags so/ /dge slong dag 'thab krol ma byed cig /mtshang ma 'dru zhig /ma rtsod cig /ma 'gyed cig /dge slong dag khyed cag 'thab krol dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa 'byung ③zhing gnas nas las su bya ba gang dag yin pa gso sbyong dang / dgag dbye rjodang /gsol ba dang / gsol ba dang gnyis dang / gsol ba dang bzhi'i las byas pa rnams ma byas pa ⑤dang 'khrugs par 'gyur zhing / — dge slong rjodag khyed dang dge slong de rnams su ⑦de rnams dang khyed du tha dad du duganas par 'gyur rol/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong dag gnyis po ⑨'di dag ni tha dad par gnas pa yin te/ gang zhig ⑩bdag nyid kyis bdag nyid tha dad pa'i gnas su bzhag pa dang / gang zhig dge 'dun gyis chos kyis bzhag pa'o/ /bdag nyid kyis bdag nyid tha dad pa'i gnas su bzhag pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste dge slong dge slong rnams 'thab krol dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang / rtsod pa dang /'gyed pa byung zhing phyogs dang 0phyogs gzhan du gnas pa na ched du bsams te ⑫chos kyi phyogs nas chos ma yin pa'i phyogs su 'gro ba ste/ de lta bu ni bdag 3—302
