blangs te spyad pa gang lags pa de yang dag par blangs te spyad mdzod cig /de rnams kyis ci zhig yang dag par blangs te spyad/ brtul zhugs kyi gzhi lnga'o/ /drang srong chen po brtul zhugs kyi gzhi lnga ci 'dra ba zhig lags/ rgyal po chen po de rnams ni srog chags rnams ①kyi srog mi gcod/ gzhan gyi bdog ②pa mi 'phrog /bgrod par bya ba ma yin pa dubagrod par mi byed/ /brdzun 0gyi tshig mi smra/ myos par 'gyur ba'i btung ba mi 'thung ⑤ngo / /rgyal pos smras pa/drang srong chen po gal te de lta na bdag gis 0kyang brtul zhugs kyi gzhi lnga po 'di dag layang dag par blangs te spyad par ⑧bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po des brtul zhugs kyi gzhi lnga yang dag par blangs te spyad par brtsams so/ /rgyal pos brtul zhugs kyi gzhi lnga yang dag par blangs te spyad pa dang / btsun mo rnams kyis kyang brtul 0zhugs kyi gzhi lnga yang dag par blangs te spyad par brtsams so/ / gzhon nu rnams dang /0 blon po rnams dang / khrom gyi ru pa dang / grong mi dang / yul mi rnams kyis kyang brtul 0zhugs kyi gzhi lnga yang dag par blangs te spyad par brtsams so/ /khams kyi rgyal phran rnams kyis rgyal po tshangs byin 8btsun mo dang / gzhon nu rnams dang / blon po rnams dang / khrom gyi ru pa rnams dang / grong mi dang / yul mir bcas pa'i tsobartul zhugs kyi gzhi lnga yang dag par blangs te spyod 8do zhes thos so/ /thos nas de rnams kyang btsun mo rnams dang / gzhon nu rnams dang / blon po rnams dang /khrom gyi ru pa rnams dang / grong mi rnams dang / yul mi rnams dang /lhan cig tu brtul zhugs kyi gzhi lnga yang dag par blangs te spyad par brtsams so//'dzam bu'i gling gi skye bo'i tshogs thams cad las phal cher brtul bzhugs kyi gzhi 3—461

lnga yang dag par blangs te spyad par brtsams so/ /de'i tshe 'dzam bu'i gling pa 'chi ba'i dus byed na①/ de lus zhig nas sum bcu rtsa ②gsum pa'i lha gya rnam pa rnams su skyes sol/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis lha'i 'khor rgyas par mthong nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gus bcas ༷zhe sar bcas pa dag /dka' ⑤thub tshal na gnas pa yi/ /gong ma sreg gi 0tshangs spyod dag⑦ /'jig rten so sor rab tu bstan/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag 'di ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi gong ma sreg ⑧gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin no/ /ri bong ni dge slong shā ri'i bu yin no/ /spre'u ni mod gal gyi bu yin no/ /glang po che ni kun dga' bo yin no/ /de'i tshe yang ngas rgan pa ji lta bu'i ⑨bca' ba mdzad de/ rgan pa ji lta ba de la brten nas 'dzam bu'i gling na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs phal cher sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i ris ⑩rnams su skyes so/ / da ltar ⑩yang ngas rgan pa ji lta ba'i bca' ba mdzad de/ rgan pa ji lta ba de la brten nas dge slong rnams gcig la gcig bsnyen bkur byed/ bla mar byed/ rjed par byed/ mchod par byed pas chu'i nang gi utpa la ji lta ba bzhin du dge ba'i chos kyis tso'aphel bar gyur to/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa'i gnas brtan dang /bar ma dang / gsar bu rnams la bkur sti dang bcas/ zhe sa dang bcas/'jigs pa'i dbang du 'gro ba dang bcas pas gnas par bya'o/ /dge slong dag de ci'i phyir zhe na/ re zhig dge slong de gnas brtan dang / bar ma dang / gsar bu rnams la bkur ste 0med/ zhe sa med cing 'jigs pa'i dbang du mi 'gro bas gnas tson kun du spyod pa'i chos yongs su rgyas par 'gyur 3—462

ba'i gnas 'di med do/ /kun du spyod pa'i chos yongs su ma rgyas par slob pa'i chos rnams yongs su rgyas par 'gyur ba'i gnas 'di med do/ /slob pa'i chos rnams yongs su ma rgyas par tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po yongs su rgyas par 'gyur ba'i gnas 'di med do/ /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po yongs su ma rgyas par len pa med par yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba'i gnas 'di med do/ /dge slong dag re zhig dge slong de tshangs pa mtshungs ①par spyod pa'i gnas brtan dang / bar ma dang / gsar bu rnams la bkur ste ②dang bcas / zhe sa dang bcas/ 'jigs pa'i dbang du 'gro ba dang bcas pas gnas na kun du spyod pa'i chos yongs su rgyas par 'gyur ba'i sriganas 'di yod do//kun du spyod pa'i chos yongs su rgyas na slob pa'i chos rnams yongs su rgyas par 'gyur ba'i gnas 'di yod do/ /slob pa'i chos rnams yongs su rgyas na tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po yongs su rgyas par 'gyur ba'i gnas 'di yod do/ /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po yongs su rgyas na len pa med par yongs su mya ngan las 'das par 'gyur ba'i rjoganas 'di yod do/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ gnas brtan dang / bar ma dang /gsar bu rnams la bkur sti dudang bcas/ zhe sa dang bcas/ 'jigs pa'i dbang du 'gro ba dang bcas pas duganas par bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis 3—463

de lta bu la ①bslab par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis lnga sde btul ②ba de rnams dgon pa na gnas te③/ de rnams dgon pa na gnas pa na seng ge dang / stag dang / gung dang / chom rkun pa rnams kyi 0bgrod par gyur to/bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ gang du sngon gyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos rnams kyis gnas rung bar gyur snyam na/ gtsug ⑤lag khang yin par gzigs so/ /lha rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de'i tshe bā rā ṇa sī na khyim bdag dge bzang zhes bya ba zhig gnas pa de dge ba'i rtsa bas ༷sems kyi rgyud bskul ⑦nas 'di snyam ⑧du sems te/ kye ma'o bdag gis ⑨bcom ldan 'das kyi 0nyan thos rnams kyi gtsug lag khang brtsig go snyam nas/ de nang par sngar langs te bcom ldan 'das ga la (spreb der song nas phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag dge bzang la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/ rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo / /de nas khyim bdag dge bzang stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar tsonas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 0logs su thal mo sbyar te tsobacom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gal te gnang 3wa 464

na / 'di ltar bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos rnams kyi ①gtsug lag khang brtsig ②lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag de lta bas na rjes su gnang gis rtsigs ②shig /des ci 'dra ba rtsig ①pa ma shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te gnas khang gsum brtsig ⑤na dbus su dri gtsang khang brtsig par bya zhing / g.yas g.yon du duganas khang gnyis te/ de ltar na ngos gsum pa la ni gnas khang dgu'o/ /ngos bzhi pa la ni dri gtsang khang gi thad ka dbus su sgo gsum gdod ⑦par bya zhing g.yas g.yon du ⑧gnas khang gnyis so/ /du rtseg tu ⑨bya ba ma shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong rnams kyi ⑩gtsug lag khang ni lnga rtseg tu 0bya'o/ /dri gtsang khang ni bdun rtseg tu tsobya'o/ /sgo khang steng gi bsil khang yang bdun rtseg tu 'bya'o/ /dge slong ma rnams kyi gtsug lag khang ni sum rtseg tu ④bya'o/ /dri gtsang khang ni lnga rtseg tu 0bya'o/ /sgo khang steng gi bsil khang yang lnga rtseg tu ⑩bya'o/ /de'i tshe mnyan yod na khyim bdag sbyin pa zhes bya ba phyug pa nor mang ba longs spyod che ba/ yongs su gzung 0ba yangs shing 8rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu la nor gyis 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs te/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed deyi/de rtse 0bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las dus gzhan zhig na chung ma ⑥sems can dang ldan par gyur nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu 'das nas khye'u zhig btsas te/ de'i btsas pa'i du)btsas ston nyi ma bdun gsum nyi shu ()gcig tu rgya cher byas nas ming 'dogs par byed de( ste/3—465

khye'u ming cir gdags/ nye du dag gis smras pa/ khye'u 'di khyim bdag sbyin pa'i bu yin pas/ de'i phyir khye'u'i ①ming ni bzang sbyin du gdags so zhes de'i ming ni ②bzang sbyin zhes bya bar btags te②/ khye'u bzang sbyin ma ma brgyad po pang na thogs pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun 0pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'phyi ⑤ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtsen grogs byed pa'i dum ma gnyis la rjes su gtad nas/ de ma ma brgyad po dag gis 'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi snying po dang / gzhan rdziyang yo byad kyi bye brag gtso bo gtso bo dag gis sring bar byed/ skyed par byed cing rdzing na gnas pa'i pad ma bzhin du myur du skyed par nibyed do/ /de dus gzhan zhig na rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas ma ma'i pang na ⑨'dug ste phyir byung ba dang / slong bas rgyan bslangs 0pa/ gzhon nu 0bdag la rgyan dgos kyis ⑫bdag la rgyan byin 0cig /de ④dga' ba dang mgu bas de la rgyan 'byin no/ /de khyim du zhugs pa dang de'i pas ma ma la dris pa/ gzhon nu'i rgyan ga re/des smras pa/ gzhon nus slong ba po tsol stsal to/ /de rgyan chagazhan dag gis brgyan na 8de yang byin no/ /de ⑩yang brgyan na de yang des byin nas khyim bdag des chung ma la smras pa/ bzang mo bdag cag gi bu ni bzang po zhig btsas te rtag tu sbyin pa la mngon par dga'o/ /des smras pa/ rje'i sras gal te de lta na slan chad 0rgyan de lta bu ni mi bgyid do 0/ /des smras pa/ bzang mo bdag cag la gser dang rin po che tshad med pa yod mod kyi ⑩/ rgyan brdung ba dumed pas 'di mdor rdzin phyi 0rol du gtang tsobar mi bya'o zhes de 0nang kho na na rtsen du phye'ajug go/ /ji tsam na 0dus gzhan zhig na khyim bdag sbyin pa gla mi'i ⑥ skye 3—466

bos yongs su bskor nas 'bab chu a dzir ba ②ti la khrus byed du chas pa dang khye'u bzang byin ②gyis smras pa/ yab ③bdag kyang mchi'o④/ /des de la brid par ⑤brtsams te bu 'di nyid na chu bzang po yod do/ /'bab chu ni chu srin 'dzin khris gang ba yin pas khyod 'dir ma mas khrus byos shig /des ngus so/ /de'i mas smras pa/ rje'i sras khye'u 'di ci'i slad du ngu / des ji ltar gyur pa rnams smras pa dang / des smras pa/ rje'i sras khyod kyis lhag par bsrungs par gyur dun lhan cig bzhud pa la nongs pa ⑦ci mchis/ des de khrid de 'bab chu'i ngogs dusu song nas khrus byas te chu 'gram du bzhag go/ /des smras pa / yab ci'i slad du bdag bsrung ⑨bar mdzad/ bu khyod la nyes pa yod do//yab bdag la nongs pa ci 'dra ba zhig mchis/ rgyan byin zhing byin pa dag slong ba rnams la byin ⑩pas so/ /yab ci nor don du gnyer ba ⑩lags sam/ bu su zhig don du mi gnyer/ yab gal te de lta na bdag cag 0chab tu 'jug tu stsol cig /des de chur bcug pa dang / de nas sngo)de'i lag pa gnyis chu 8nang du bcug nas/ lcags kyi bum pa gser gyis tsogang ba zhig 8phyung nas smras pa/ yab 'di las khyod ji tsam bzhed pa'i nor gyis nor gyi 4)bya ba mdzod la lhag ma 'di nyid du chug cig /bu khyod kyis ci chu nang tson yod pa'i gter mthong ngamayi/ yab chu na mchis pa 'ba' zhig tu ma bas kyi0/ thang la mchis pa dang / bdag po mchis pa dang / bdag po ma mchis pa dang / gang dag ring po na mchis pa dang / gang dag nye ba na mchis pa yang mthong ngo / /khyim tshubadag sbyin pa ngo mtshar skyes pa'i mig bgrad ⑥de bsams pa/ nor gyi bdag po 'di lta bus ni sbyin pa btang dubar nus so snyam du rig (stenas smras pa/3—467

bu gal te de lta na ci dga' bar sbyin pa byin cig /'di ni chos nyid yin te/ji tsam pha gson pa de'i bar du bu'i grags pa mi 'byung ba yin no/ /ji tsam dus ①gzhan zhig na khyim bdag sbyin pa shi nas bzang sbyin khyim gyi rje bor gyur nas/ de rtag ②tu mgon med pa rnams la zas sbyin pas kun du khyim bdag sbyin pa'i bu bzang sbyin khyim gyi rje bor gyur te/ de mgon med pa rnams ②la zas sbyin no zhes sgra grags pas de'i ming khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin zhes bya bar grags so/ /de nas des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs te/ de 0de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/dga' mgur spyod par byed de/ de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las khye'u zhig btsas so zhes bya ba nas khye'u bdun btsas so zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ des drug la dukhyim phub bo/ /bdun pa legs skyes zhes dubya ba de'i chung ma rigs mnyam pa las chung ma btsal ⑦na ma rnyed nas de 'gram pa la lag pa gtad ⑧de sems khong du 0chud cing 'dug go/ /de'i ne'u zla bram ze'i khye'u sprang rtsi'i phung po zhes bya ba des de de ltar sems khong du 0chud pa mthong nas des smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod ci'i phyir lag pa 'gram pa la gtad de sems khong du tunyechud cing 'dug /des smras pa/ bdag gis bu drug ni khyim phubs tson bdun pa legs skyes kyi chung ma rigs mnyam pa gang las 'di khyim dbub pa gang yin pa de sems med/ des smras pa/ sems las chung ngur 'dug shig dang / 'di'i chung ma kho bos rigs mnyam pa las btsal lo / /yul gang du/ des smras pa/ re zhig yul ma ga dmar tso'agro'o/ /de bzhin du 8byos shig /de rgyal po'i khab tu phyin pa dang rgyal po'i khab na khyim 3—468

bdag phyug pa nor mang ba longs spyod che ba khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dang mtshungs pa gzhan zhig gnas pa de'i khyim du zhugs nas sgo khang du 'dug ste smras pa/ bkra shis par gyur cig /khyim de'i skye bos smras pa/ bram ze ci zhig slong / bu mo slong ngo / /bu'i phyir/ mnyan yod na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi bu legs skyes zhes bya ba de'i'o/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ bdag cag rigs ni mnyam na/ nyu'on kyang kho bo cag la gnyod mang du dgos so/ /mang khyad ②ji snyed/ gangs can ②ri'i glang po che brgya/ rta brgya/ gser gyi rgyan brgya/ dre'u'i 0shing rta brgya/ tho ⑤gar yul gyi bu mo brgyadu/ bram ze'i khye'u sbrang rtsi'i ⑦phung pos khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la don de'i phyir yi ge spring ba dang / des kyang bklags ⑧nas thams cad sbyar gyis longs 7shig ces yi 0ge'i lan spring ngo / /des nyin zhag dang / tshes grangs dang / yud tsam dag bstun nas blangs pa dang / de nas des gtsang zhing bsod pa'i kha zas mang pos tshim par byas nas bram ze'i khye'u zhig 0gi khyim du song ste gnas btab pa dang / 'khru bas thebs nas bram ze 8rnams dang ngo shes 8pa ma yin pas de rnams tsomi gtsang bas skrag pas phyir phyung ste bor ba dang stes 4)te tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu gnyis phyogs der phyin pa de gnyis kyis de mthong ngo / /de nas de gnyis kyis smyug ma'i tshal bas bzhar nas sa dkar pos bskus te bkrus tshunas de la chos bshad nas dong ngo / /de 'khru ba 'chad du ma btub nas des de gnyis la sems dad pa skyed nas shi ba dang rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi ⑩lha rnams kyi nang du skyes nas/ de rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu'i drung du song ste gnas bslangs pa dang des smras pa/ khyod song la de nyid 'du lho sgor 3—469

gnas thob shig /des 0)der song ste gnyug mar gnas par gyur to②/ /lus 'phags kyi rgyal pos ②rgyal po gzugs can snying po la gangs can ④ri'i glang po che brgya skyes su bskur ba dang / des ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la kho bo la lus 'phags kyi rgyal pos gangs can gyi ri'i glang po che brgya ⑤skyes su 0bskur gyisaX/gal te dgongs ⑧par gyur na len pa thong 0shig ces spring ngo / /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gang na ba ⑩der song ste phyin pa dang / ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha bdag rgyal po'i khab tu bgyi ba cung zad cig la der mchi ste slar yimachi'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ legs kyis tsosong la de nas nga'i glang po che brgya zhig blang ⑫dgos pa de dag kyang ded de shog shig /des smras pa/ lha gal te der bdag la ④'tshal ba ma tsomachis na blangs la 'dir mchis nas lha'i thugs mnyes par bgyi'o//rgyal pos smras pa/ legs kyis 0de bzhin du byos shig /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gnyod mang du khyer nas rgyal po'i khab tu phyin to/ /de khyim bdag gang gi khyim du gnas btab pa'i khyim bdag de de 4)nyid kyi phonyamatshan mo langs te nang mi rnams la bsgo tsu)ba/ nang rje dag ( )longs shig /bzhin bzangs phyedag longs shig /shing rnams gshegs shigadu /me dag bus shig /'bras chan 0tshos shig /tshod ma tshos shig /bca' ba dag bzang du gyis shig/ bkad sa'i shustezhal ta dag gyis shig /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'di snyam du sems te/ ci khyim bdag 'di bag ma len tam/ bag ma gtong ngam/yul mi rnams 'dis zas la mgron tsodu bos sam/ tshong pa'am/ tshogs sam/'khor tam/ 'dis ma ga dma'i 'argyal po bzo 0sbyangs gzugs can snying po zas 3—470

la spyan drangs sam snyam du bsams nas/ khyim bdag de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyim bdag ci khyod bag ma len tam/ bag ma gtong ngam/ yul mi rnams khyod kyis zas la mgron ①du bos sam/ tshong pa'am/ tshogs sam/'khor tam/ khyod kyis ma ga dma'i ②rgyal po bzo ②sbyangs gzugs can snying po zas la spyan drangs sam/ des smras pa/ khyim bdag kho bo ④bag ma len pa'am/bag ma gtong ba yang med/ kho bos ⑤yul mi yang zas la ma bos tshong pa ma yin / tshogs ma yin/ 'khor dum yin/ ma ga dma'i ⑦rgyal po bzo dusbyangs gzugs can snying po yang zas la spyan drangs pa ma yin te/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs tshod la spyan drangs so/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i sgra sngon ma thos pa thos pa dang / ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas spu zing zhes byed nas/ ba 0spu zing zhes byed pas khyim bdag de la 'di skad ces smras so0/ /khyim bdag sangs rgyas zhes bya ba 'di su yin/ khyim bdag dge sbyong gi ta ma shākya'i sras shākya'i rigs las skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung nas/ de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par (nyesangs rgyas pa zhig yod de/khyim bdag de ni sangs rgyas zhes bya'o/ /khyim bdag dge 'dun zhes bya ba 'di su yin/ khyim bdag rgyal rigs las kyang rigs kyi bu spa dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig 4)bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par bcom ldan 'das de kho na tsorab tu byung ba'i rjes su rab tu byung ba dag yod/bram ze'i rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs las kyang rigs 3—471

kyi bu skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig ①bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa ②kho nas khyim nas khyim med par bcom ldan 'das de kho na rab tu byung ba'i rjes su rab tu byung ba dag yod de/ khyim bdag 'di ni dge 'dun zhes bya ba yin te/sang kho bo'i khyim du sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun de gdugs tshod la spyan drangs so/ /khyim bdag bcom ldan 'das de da lta ③gang na bzhugs/ rgyal po'i khab 'di nyid kyi dur khrod kyi bsil ba'i tshal dun bzhugs so/ /khyim bdag bcom ②ldan 'das ༷de bdag cag gis bltar rung ngam/ des ⑦'di skad ces smras so/ /khyim bdag khyod re zhig sdod cig dang / gal te 'di nyid du gshegs nas sang mthong bar 'gyur ba'i gnas de yod do/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin de'i nub mo sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i dran pas gnyid log ⑧ste/ de nam ma langs ⑨par nam langs ⑫pa'i 'du shes kyis lho sgo gang na ba der song ba dang / de'i tshe pho nya glo 0bur du 'ong ba dang 'gro ba rnams kyis 8mi thogs par bya ba'i phyir mtshan mo'i thun dang po dang tha ma gnyis la lho sgo phye ste 'jog go/ /ji tsam na 0lho sgo phye ba dang snang bas gsal bar gyur pa mthong nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar lho sgo 0phye ste 'dug pas gdon mi za bar nam langs 8so snyam du rig nas snang ba de nyid du ⑩grong khyer nas byung ba dang / de byung ma thag tu snang ba gang yin pa de med nas slar nam sros par gyur to/ /de yang 'jigs par gyur bag tsha bar gyur zhing spu zing zhes byed par gyur nas bdag mi'am mi ma yin pa'am/ g.yon can 'ga' zhig gis gtses te gnyod mang po yang ma son par phyogs 0par mi 'gyur grang snyam du bsams 8te slar ldog par 'dod pas lha'i bu sbrang rtsi'i phung po'i 3—472

'dug gnas la bskor ba ①byed cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas lha'i bu sbrang rtsi ②phung po 'di snyam du sems te/ deng nyid du khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bden pa mthong bar 'gyur ②na/ deng nyid 'di sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das spangs te lha gzhan la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba snyam du bsams nas/gang yang lho sgo nas bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod kyi bar snang ba rgya chen pos gsal bar byas nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyim bdag spyan sngar song 0shig /slar ma ldog shig /khyod spyan sngar song na legs par 'gyur gyi slar log na ni ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rta brgya dang ni gser rgyan brgya/ /dre'u'i ⑧shing rta brgya dang ni/ /sna tshogs nor gyis sbyar ba yi/ /rta rgod ma yi shing rta brgya/ /gom pa gcig cig bor ba yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /khyim bdag spyan sngar song 0shig /slar ma ldog shig /khyod spyan sngar song na legs par 'gyur gyi slar log na ni ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gangs can ri yi glang chen brgya/ /gser dang nor bus brgyan byas la/ /lus che gshol mda'i mche bar ldan/ /ma tang gar skyes stobs ⑦mo che/ /gom pa gcig cig bor ba yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do//khyim bdag spyan sngar song ⑧shig /slar ma ldog shig /khyod spyan sngar song na legs par 'gyur gyis ⑨slar log na ni ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tho gar yul gyi bu mo brgya/ /nor bu'i rna cha gdub kor ⑩thogs/ /gser gyi dpung rgyan ⑩thogs pa yi/ /mgrin 0pa rgyan 8gyis legs brgyan pa/ /gom pa gcig cig bor ba yi/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /khyim bdag spyan sngar song ④shig /slar ma ldog 8cig /khyod spyan sngar song na legs par 'gyur gyi slar log na ni 3—473

ma yin no/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis ⑦lha'i bu de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bzhin bzangs khyod su zhig /khyim bdag kho bo ni 0khyod ③kyi grogs po rnying pa bram ze'i khye'u sbrang rtsi'i phung po yin te/ kho bos dge slong shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu gnyis la sems dad pa bskyed nas shi ba dang rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams su skyes te/ lho sgo 'di nyid na gnyug mar gnas so/ /de'i phyir kho bo ni dukhyod nyid khrul 'di skad ces/ khyim bdag spyan sngar song shig /slar ma ldog cig /khyod spyan sngar song na dulegs par 'gyur gyi slar log na ni ma yin no zhes smra'o// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po bdun bcu tsolnga pa/ de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'di snyam du sems te/ kye duma'o sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni mchog ma yin pa ma yin zhing chos bstan pa yang mchog ma yin pa ma yin te/ de la da ltar lha yang brtson par byed kyis0/ bcom ldan 'das de ⑩blta thonyebar bya'o snyam du bsams nas bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod gang na ba der song ba dang / de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol bla gab med pa na 'chag cing lhag par yang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'ong ba la gzhes pa 4)khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das rgyang ring po kho na ⑫nas mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la khyim bdag gis yang dag par dgyes par 'gyur bas yang dag par dgyes par byed de/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ga bde bar mnal tam/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ gang zhig 'dod pas ma gos la/ /zag med rab tu rnam grol 3—474

ba / /mya ngan yongs 'das bram ze ni/ /thams cad du ni bde bar mnal/ /'dir ni re ba kun bcad nas/ /thugs kyi rims nad rnams ①bsal zhing / /zhi ba thob ②pa'i thugs kyis ni/ /nye bar zhi ba bde bar lamanal/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin khrid nas gtsug lag khang du zhugs te gdan ④bshams pa nyid la bzhugs ⑤pa dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas yite phyogs gcig tu 'dug go phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ⑦thog ma'i dus su chos kyi gtam mdzad pa gang yin pa 'di lta ste sbyin pa'i gtam dang / tshul khrims kyi gtam dang /mtho ris kyi gtam dang 6)/ 'dod pa rnams ni ⑨mnog chung ba byadang / nyes ⑪dmigs dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang /nges par 'byung ba dang / rab tu dben pa'i phan yon gyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos kyi gtam rgyas par yang dag par bstan to/ /gang gi tsotshe bcom ldan 'das kyis de dga' ba'i sems dang / dge ba'i sems dang / mgu ba'i sems dang / sgrib pa dang bral ba'i sems dang / skal ba dang ldan zhing yang dag phul gyi chos bshad pa kun shes par nus par phostegazigs pa de'i tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis phonyeyang dag ⑩phul gyi chos bshad pa 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po gang yin pa 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal ba phonyadang /3—475

kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang / lam rgyas par rab tu bstan to/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal ba ①dang / kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang / lam mngon par ①rtogs te/ dper na gos gtsang ma nag nog med pa tshon du gzhug par ③'os pa tshon gyi nang du bcug na legs par tshon rtsi 'jen du dubatub pa de bzhin du/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di lta ste/ sdug bsngal ba ⑤dang / kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang /lam mngon par rtogs so/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis chos mthong ba dang / chos thob pa dang / chos rig pa dang / chos kyi gting slebs dupa dang / som nyi las rgal ⑦ba dang / the tshom las rgal ⑧ba dang /ston pa'i bstan ⑨pa la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa dang / gzhan gyis mi bkri ba dang / chos rnams la mi 'jigs 0pa thob yinas stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de 8logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag ni 'phags so/ /mngon par 'phags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dang /chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la bdag skyabs su mchi lags kyi ()dge bsnyen du gzung tsodu gsol/ deng slan chad 'ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog dang yang bsdos te skyabs su mchi bar mngon par dad lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to//khyim bdag khyod kyi ming ci/ btsun pa bdag gi ming ni tsobazang sbyin lags 3—476

med kyi/ mgon ma mchis pa rnams la 'tshal ma stsol bas des na bdag la skye bo rnams kyis mgon med zas sbyin zhes bgyi bar 'tshal to/ /khyim bdag khyod kyi gnas gang yin/ btsun pa yul phra tsi na zhes bgyi ba na ko sa la rnams kyi grong rdal mnyan yod ces bgyi ba de na bdag mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod du gshegs shig dang / bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig la bdag ji srid 'tsho'i ①bar du na bza' chos gos dang /bsod snyoms dang / gzims cha dang / snyun dpyad ②kyi rkyen sman gyi yo byad rnams kyis bsnyen bkur bgyi lags so/ /khyim bdag mnyan yod na gtsug lag khang yod dam/ btsun pa ma mchis lags so/ /khyim bdag gang na gtsug lag khang yod pa der dge slong rnams 'ong ba dang / 'gro ba dang ③/gnas par sems so/ /bcom ldan 'das gshegs shig dang / bdag gis ci nas kyang mnyan yod du dge slong rnams rjomachi ba dang gzhan du mchis pa ⑤dang / mchis par sems par 'gyur ba de ltar gtsug lag khang brtsig dulags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la gnang ngo / /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /de nas des rgyal po'i khab tu bsgrub ⑦pa dang / bya ba gang yin pa de thams cad byas te grub nas slar bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi ⑧grogs dge slong zhig 0stsal du 3—477

gsol/ bdag de dang lhan cig mnyan yod du bcom ldan 'das kyi slad du gtsug lag khang brtsig ①lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa dge slong su zhig gis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa dang mnyan yod na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs 'dul bar 'gyur snyam na/ dge slong shā ri'i bus 'dul ②bar gzigs nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa dang mnyan yod na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs la soms shig/tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bcom ldan 'das la cang mi smra bas bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' mnyan duto/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu cang mi smra bas khas blangs par rig nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo //de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de nyid kyi nub mo 'das nas snga dro sham thabs dubagos chos gos dang ①lhung bzed thogs te rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la zhugs nas rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms spyad de zas kyi bya ba byas nas/ zas phyi ma'i bsod snyoms spangs te gnas mal ji ltar longs spyad pa mkhos su phab nas lhung bzed dang chos gos blangs te mnyan yod gang na ba der rgyu zhing song ngo //de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin lam rgyags dumang po khyer nas nub mo nub mo zhing mnyan yod du song ste phyin pa dang ⑦/ de mnyan yod du ma zhugs pa nyid du kun dga' ra ba nas kun dga' ra ba dang / nags tshal nas nags tshal dang / skyed mos tshal nas skyed mos tshal dang ⑧/ 'chag sa nas 'chag sa na dpyod cing 'di skad ces smras so/ /mnyan yod dang ha cang yang mi 3—478

ring la ha cang yang mi nye ba dang / nyin par lang long nyung zhing ku co nyung ba dang / mtshan mo gcom ༅chung ba dang / sgra chung ba dang / sbrang bu dang /sha sbrang dang / rlung dang / nyi ma dang / sdig sbrul gyi reg pa chung ba'i sa phyogs de gang na yod pa der ②bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir ②gtsug lag khang brtsig go zhes pa las/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis gzhon nu rgyal byed kyi kun dga' ra ba ni mnyan yod dang ha cang yang 0mi ring ༷ha cang yang dumi nye la nyin par lang long nyung zhing ku co nyung ba dang / mtshan mo gcom ༅chung ba dang / sgra chung ba dang / sbrang bu dang / sha sbrang dang /rlung dang / nyi ma dang / sdig sbrul gyi reg pa nyung bar mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/ 'dir bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir gtsug lag khang brtsig go snyam nas/ de rang gi khyim du ma song ba nyid du gzhon nu rgyal byed gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang gzhon nu rgyal byed la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gzhon nu bdag la kun dga' ra ba stsol cig /der bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir gtsug lag khang brtsig dulags so/ /des smras pa / khyim bdag de ni nga'i kun dga' ra ba ma yin te/ skyed mos tshal yin mod kyi de nga'i yin no/ /lan gnyis lan gsum du yang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis gzhon nu rgyal byed la 'di skad ces smras sol/ /gzhon nu bdag la skyed mos tshal stsal cig /bdag gis der ⑩bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir gtsug lag khang brtsig (sprelags so/ /khyim bdag kun dga' ra ba de gser bye ba gshibs kyang mi gtang 4)ngo / /yang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis gzhon nu rgyal byed la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gzhon nus kun dga' ra ba'i ⑫3—479

rin bcad zin gyis ①gser dang dbyig long ②shig /kun dga' ra ba ni bdag gi rgyalags so/ /sus rin bcad/ khyod kyis 0rin bcad mod/ de gnyis rin bcad do/ / ma bcad do ①zhes rtsod par gyur nas zhal che gcod pa'i sna chen po la gtogs ba'i mi gang na ba der dong dub dang / de'i bar du 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi 'di snyam du sems te/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir gtsug lag khang brtsig ⑦par rtsom gyis ⑧de'i grogs bya'o snyam nas/ de nas zhal che gcod pa 0sna chen po la gtogs pa'i cha byad du bdag nyid mngon par sprul nas dgon ⑩pa'i phyir 'dus so/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dang / ci gzhon nu rgyal byed gnyis zhal che gcod pa sna chen po la gtogs pa'i mi'i drung du song nas/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis zhal che gcod pa'i sna chen po la gtogs pa 0rnams la don de rgyas par smras pa dang / de rnams kyis smras pa/ gzhon nus kun dga'i 8ra ba 4)rin bcad zin gyis tsogaser dang dbyig long tunyeshig /kun dga' ra ba ni khyim bdag gi yin no/ /de cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis shing rta dang / khur dang / sgye dang /gzeb dang / rnga mo dang / glang dang / bong bu rnams la gser mang po bkal te 'ongs nas rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad bye bas gshib 0par brtsams pa dang / sa phyogs 'ga' zhig ma yog tho)pas ma bkram pa nyid du 'dug go/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin don de sems shing yud tsam 8cang mi smra bar 'dug ste/ gang gis ma bkram ⑩pa'i sa phyogs 'di bkram nas slar yang sba bar bya mi dgos pa'i gter ha cang nyung ba yang ma yin/ ha 3—480

cang mang po yang ma yin pa de gang yin snyam pa dang / gzhon nu rgyal byed kyis bsams pa/ gdon mi za bar khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin ni ci'i phyir kun dga' ra ba'i ched du 'di snyed kyi nor gyi phung po yongs su btang ①zhes 'gyod pa skyes so snyam du bsams nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyim bdag khyod gal te 'gyod pa skyes na ②gser dang dbyig khyer cig /kun dga' ra ba ni nga ③nyid kyi yin no/ /gzhon nu bdag ni 'gyod pa ma skyes te/ 'on kyang don 'di sems shing yud tsam zhig cang mi smra bar 'dug pa ni gang gis ma bkram pa'i sa phyogs 'dir bkram nas slar yang sba bar bya mi dgos pa'i gter ha cang nyung ba yang ma yin/ ha cang mang po yang ma yin pa de gang yin snyam mo/ /de nas gzhon 0nu rgyal byed 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma'o sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni mchog ma yin pa ma yin la/chos bstan pa yang mchog ma yin pa ma yin te/ de la da ltar khyim bdag 'di kun dga' ra ba'i ched ⑤du 'di snyed kyi nor gyi phung po chen po yongs su gtong ngo snyam du bsams nas/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la 'di skad ces smras so//khyim bdag ma bkram pa'i sa phyogs 'di ༷kho bo la byin cig /der kho bos bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑦phyir sgo khang brtsig ⑧par bya'o/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 0gyis gzhon nu rgyal byed (sprel ma bkram pa'i sa phyogs byin nas der gzhon nu rgyal byed kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir sgo khang rtsig 0tu bcug go/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir gtsug lag khang brtsig 8par brtsams pa dang / mu stegs can zhe snang drag pos kun nas glongs ()pa'i yid can rnams 'dus nas/ khyim bdag mgon med 3—481

zas sbyin gang na ba der dong ste lhags pa dang smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod kyis dge sbyong ①gi ta ma'i phyir gtsug lag khang ma rtsig ②shig /ci'i phyir kho bo cag gis grong khyer rnams bgos te dge sbyong ②gi ta ma'i ni 0rgyal po'i khab yin no/ /kho bo cag gi 0ni mnyan 0yod yin no/ /des smras pa/ khyed cag gis grong khyer rnams bgos ⑦kyi/ bdag gi nor ma bgos ⑧pas bdag gang la mngon par dga' ba de'i nyuchos kyi phung po brtsig go/ /de rnams rgyal po'i drung du dong ba dang / de 0yang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis pham par byas pa dang /mu stegs spyi rdol 0can mu cor smra ba rnams kyis smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod 'dod dgur tho)byed du mi gzhug ste/ dge sbyong gi ta ma'i nyan thos kyi mchog 'ongs nas/ gal te de'i shags kyis kho bo cag pham par gyur na gtsug lag khang rtsigs 0shig /des smras pa/ rung gis 8re zhig 'phags pa shā ri'i bu kho na la brtag go/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te 8phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa shā ri'i bu mu stegs can rnams (9'di skad ces/khyim bdag khyod 'dod dgur byed du mi gzhug ⑩ste/ dge sbyong gi ta ma'i nyan thos kyi mchog 'ongs nas gal te de'i shags kyis kho bo cag pham par gyur na gtsug lag khang rtsigs (nyeshig ces mchi na/ de la ji ltar bsgrub yipar bgyi/tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bsams pa/ ci 'di 0rnams la dge ba'i rtsa ba cung zad yod dam 'on te med ces bsams pa las yod par mthong ngo / /su zhig 3—482

la rag las par 'gyur snyam na/ bdag kho na ①la rag las par mthong ngo / /yang bsams pa/ ci 'di snyed cig kho na bdag la rag las pa'i tshig gis 'dul bar 'gyur ram/ 'on te gzhan yang tshig gis 'dul ba yod snyam pa las yod par mthong ngo ②/ /dus ji srid cig na tshogs par 'gyur snyam na/zhag bdun lon nas so snyam du ②bsams nas smras pa/ khyim bdag de bzhin du bya ste/ 'on kyang zhag bdun pa'i nyin par bya'o/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dga' ba dang mgu ba skyes te/ mu stegs can rnams gang na ba der song nas phyin pa dang mu stegs can rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /shes ldan dag shā ri'i bu na re rung gis 0de bzhin du ⑤bya'o/ /'on kyang zhag bdun pa'i nyin par bya'o zhes zer 0ro/ /de rnams kyis bsams pa/ 'di la ni rgyu gnyis yod par gyur ⑦te/ yang na ni ⑧ de ni ⑨'bros 'dod do/ /yang na ni de phyogs tshol 'dod do/ /de ma yin na dus der gdab ci dgos bdag cag kyang phyogs btsal 0lo zhes de rnams kyis 7phyogs btsal bar brtsams te/ de rnams kyis phyogs btsal ba dang kun du rgyu mig dmar mthong nas de rnams kyis de la smras pa/ khyod dang bdag cag ni tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa yin gyis8/dge sbyong gi ta ma'i nyan thos kyi mchog bdag cag gis brtsad 0pa'i phyir bkug na de phyogs tshol gyis 0khyod kyang bdag cag gi grogs gyis shig /dus ji tsam zhig na 'di nas zhag bdun pa'i nyin par ro/ /rung gis 4)de bzhin du bya ste/gang gi tshe khyed cag 'dus par gyur pa ⑩de'i tshe kho bo la sgron cig /mu stegs can rnams bag tsha ba dang sems khral ⑩skyes nas nyin re zhing phyogs tshol ba dang nyi ma bgrang bar byed do/ /ji tsam na zhag bdun lon pa dang / khyim bdag 3—483

mgon med zas sbyin gyis bla gab med pa'i sa phyogs yangs par stan shom du bcug go/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i ched du yang seng ge'i khri bshams so/ /yul sna tshogs na gnas pa'i mu stegs can rnams kyang 'dus so/ /mnyan yod na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dang de'i nye 'khor ①na gnas pa'i srog chags brgya stong phrag du ma dag kyang kha cig ni ngo mtshar skyes sol/ /kha cig ni sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa bas bskul dunas 'dus par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'khor dang bcas pas mdun du bdar nas rtsod pa'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs te 'dul ba'i skye bo rnams la bltas nas dran pa sngon du btang ste/ spyod lam zhi bas seng ge'i khri la 'dzegs nas 'dug pa dang / 'khor thams cad sems mi g.yeng bar 0tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la rtog cing 'dug go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus mu stegs can rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag re zhig byed dam/ 'on te 'jig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ kho bo cag gis byas 2khyod kyis shig dushig /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bsams pa/ gal te bdag gis byas na lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis kyang 'jig mi nus na kun du rgyu mig dmar gyis lta smos kyang ci dgos snyam du bsams nas/ kun du rgyu mig dmar la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyod kyis byos shig ngas bshig nyago/ /de mig 'phrul la byang ba yin pas/ des shing sa ha ka ra shin tu me tog gis rgyas ⑧pa zhig 0sprul pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus rlung dang char drag 0po phab ste/ des de rtsa ba nas phyung yinas phan tshun du 8rnam par gtor te rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi yul du yang ma gyur to/ /de nas des pad ma'i rdzing zhig sprul pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus glang 3—484

po che bzang po zhig sprul nas/ des de kun du brnal nas ming gi lhag ma zhig bzhag go/ /des sbrul mgo bdun pa zhig sprul pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus nam mkha' lding zhig sprul te/ des de blangs so/ /des ro langs shig sprul pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus sngags kyi phur pa ①btab pa las nyes par spyad pa'i ②ro langs ni bdag nyid la gsod par byed pas des de nyid la bsnyags ③pa dang / de nas de 'jigs skrag phongs shing ba spu zing zhes byed nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos dugatugs nas 'phags pa skyabs su mchi lags kyis⑤/ yongs su bskyab ༷tu gsol/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus sngags kyi phur ⑦pa byung ba dang ro langs de zhi bar gyur to/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus de la chos bshad de/ de dad pa skyes nas smras pa/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la ⑧bdag rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi ⑨dngos po 'thob pa lta na/ bdag 'phags pa shā ri'i bu'i spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bgyi'o/ /de nas 4) tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus rab tu phyung ⑪bsnyen par rdzogs par byas nas gdams ngag byin pa dang des brtson pa dang /'bad pa dang / brtsal 8ba byas pas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa mngon du byas nas dgra bcom par gyur te/ khams gsum gyi 'dod chags dang bral ba/ bong ba dang gser du mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil 0du mnyam 8pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan dang ste'ur mnyam pa/rig pas ma rig pa'i sgo byanga'i sbubs dral 4)zhing rig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / so so ⑩yang dag par rig pa thob pa'/ srid pa dang / rnyed 3—485

pa la chags pa dang / bkur ste ①la rgyab kyis laphyogs pa/ dbang po dang nye dbang po'i lha dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod par bya ba dang / rjed par bya ba dang / mngon du smra bar bya bar gyur to/ /de nas de'i 'khor rnams ngo mtshar gyi mig bgrad dunas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la mngon par dad par gyur te smras pa/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bus ④ni smra ba'i khyu mchog chen po tshar bcad do snyam du rig nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i gdong du blta ⑤bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'khor de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal rjodang khams dang / rang bzhin shes nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi so sor rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bshad pa byas so/ /de thos nas sems can brgya phrag du mas khyad par chen po thob ste/ kha cig gis 0ni nyan thos kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /kha cig gis ni rang sangs rgyas kyi 0byang chub tu'o/ /kha cig gis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu'o/ /kha cig gis ni skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi ⑨rnams blangs so/ /kha cig gis ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas so/ /kha cig gis ni lan gcig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /kha cig gis (3 ni phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /kha cig gis ni rab tu byung nas ⑩nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa mngon sum du byas so/ /'khor de phal cher yang sangs rgyas la gzhol / chos la 'babatso/ dge 'dun la bab par bkod do/ /mu stegs can rnams kyis tsobasams pa/ 'di bdag cag gis 0shags kyis tshar gcad ⑫par mi nus kyisatso/ thabs shig bsham par bya ste/ gtsug lag khang 'di nyid du gla mi'i 0las byas la/ de nas glags 8rnyed nas 'di bgags yite gsad ⑥3—486

par bya'o snyam nas thams cad 'dus te khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi drung du song nas son pa ①dang smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod kyis bdag cag gi ②'tsho ba'i gzhi thams cad bcad de/ de bas na snying brtse bar gyis shig dang /khyod kyi gtsug lag khang du gla mi'i las bya'o/ /kho bo cag 'di na ring zhig tu gnas ③pas yul bor na mi rung ngo / /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis smras pa/ re duzhig 'phags pa shā ri'i bu la brtag par bya'o zhes de tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gang dun ba der song ste phyin pa dang tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa mu stegs can rnams kyi dumachid nas/bdag cag gi 'tsho ⑦ba'i gzhi thams cad bcad de/ de bas na snying brtse bar gyis shig dang / khyod kyi gtsug lag khang du gla mi'i ⑧las bya'o/ /kho bo cag 'di na ring zhig tu gnas gnas pas yul bor na mi rung ngo zhes mchi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus ji 'di rnams la dge ba'i rtsa ba cung ⑨zad yod dam 'on te med ces bsams pa la zhugs na yod par mthong ngo / /su zhig la rag las snyam na0/ bdag kho na la'o snyam nas des bsams te smras 0pa/ khyim bdag de la 'gal ba ci yod kyis 8de bzhin du gyis shig /de rnams gtsug lag khang der gla mi'i tshulas bya bar brtsams pa na tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus lcag tsothogs kyi mi gtum po 8zhig sprul nas des de rnams las byed du gzhug par brtsams so//tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus de rnams kyi gdul ⑩ba'i dus shes nas de dang nye ba'i shing drung zhig na 'chag cing 'dug pa las de rnams kyis 4)de mthong nas de rnams kyis bsams pa/ dben pa na phye'adug pas 'di gsad 8pa'i dus ni 'di yin no snyam nas/ de rnams kyis de'i drung du dong nas bskor te 'dug go//3—487

tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bsams pa①/ 'di rnams sems ci 'dra ba zhig gis bdag gi drung du lhags snyam na/ ji tsam na gsad pa'i sems kyis yin par mthong nas de ②lhag thogs te sbad ③nas des de rnams las byos deng 0zhes thag ⑤bcug pa dang / de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu bskyab rjotu gsol/ des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa re zhig song la ngal sor chug ⑦cig /de rnams kyis bsams pa/ 'di ni 'di lta bur bdag nyid che ba yin te/ bdag cag gis ni 'di bsad ⑧par bsams na/ 'di ni bdag cag la byams par ⑨sems so snyam du rig nas dad par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus de rnams kyi ⑩bsam pa dang / bag la nyal ba 0dang / khams dang / rang bzhin shes nas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi so sor rtogs 8par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bshad pa 4)byas te/ de thos nas de rnams kyis 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo 0nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ de rnams kyis bden pa mthong ste smras pa/btsun pa shā ri'i bu'i spyan sngar 8bdag cag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po 'thob ⑩pa lta na/ bdag cag btsun pa shā ri'i bu'i spyan sngar tshangs par spyod pa ()spyad par bgyi'o/ /de rnams tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus rab tu phyung phyezhing bsnyen par rdzogs par byas nas gdams 4)ngag byin te0/ de rnams kyis brtson pa dang / 'bad pa dang / brtsal bar ⑥byas pas du'akhor ba'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa g.yo ba dang / mi g.yo ba 'di nyid rig ste/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad nyams pa dang / lhung ba dang rnam par 'thor phyob dang / rnam par 3—488

'jig pa'i chos nyid kyis ①zil gyis mnan te/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom par gyur nas khams gsum gyi ②'dod chags dang bral ba/ bong ba dang gser du mnyam pa/nam mkha' dang lag 'thil ③du mtshungs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan dang ste'ur mnyam pa/ rig pas ma rig pa'i sgo dunga'i spubs dral zhing rig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / so so ⑤yang dag par rig pa thob pa/srid pa dang / rnyed pa la chags pa dang / bkur sti dul rgyab kyis phyogs pa/dbang po dang nye dbang po'i lha dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod par bya ba dang /rjed ⑦par bya ba dang / mngon du smra bar bya bar gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus gtsug lag khang gi thig skud kyi ⑧mtha' gcig nas bzung ⑨/mtha' gcig nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bzung ba dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'dzum par brtsams so/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis smras pa/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams sam/de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos rnams 0ni rgyu med rkyen med par ⑩'dzum pa mi mdzad na/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu ci'i rgyu ci'i rkyen gyis 'dzum pa mdzad/khyim bdag de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams sam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos rnams ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi mdzad de/ khyod kyis 'dir thig skud bzung ba na dga' ldan gyi 0lha'i ris su yang gser gyi khang pa grub par gyur to/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin ngo mtshar skyes pa'i mig bgrad de smras pa/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu gal te de lta na de'i slad du yang thig skud brkyang ba dang lhag par sems mngon par 3—489

dad par bgyi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus yang thig skud de bzung ①ba dang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis lhag par dad pa drag po'i shugs kyis sems mngon par dad par byas te/ dad pa de'i mjug thogs kho nar gser gyi khang pa de rin po che 0sna bzhi las byas par gyur nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus kyang de la go bar byas so/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gong nas gong du bsod nams rab tu 'phel ba'i rgyud kyis gtsug lag khang chen po bcu drug dang / khang phran drug bcu rtsig ②tu bcug ste/ des gtsug lag khang chen po bcu drug dang / khang phran drug bcu brtsigs nas yo byad thams cad kyis ༷rgyas par byas te tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gang na ba der song nas phyin pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras sodu/ /'phags pa shā ri'i bu bcom ldan 'das gshegs pa dun shul tshad ⑦ji tsam du byon ⑧par 'gyur/ khyim bdag dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i tshad ⑨tsam mo/ /'khor los sgyur ⑩ba'i rgyal po mchi ba'i tshad ji tsam/ khyim bdag 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po ni nyi ma gcig gis rgyang grags bcu'i lam du 'gro'o / /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis gang yang mnyan yod nas rgyal po'i khab de'i bar gyi (7gshegs dgongs brtsis yinas gzhes 0sa dag byed du bcug /sbyin yigatong gi khang pa dag rtsig thonyetu bcug /dus tshod gsol ba'i mi dag bkod/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis brgyan⑩/ tsan dan gyi chus chag chag btab⑩/ shin tu dri zhim po'i pog por tsodag nye bar bkod/ rta babs dag byed du bcug /dus kyi ⑪dang thun tshod kyi 0sman dag kyang 'jog tu bcug go/ /de ltar tshogs bsags 3—490

nas mi zhig la bsgo ba/ kye nang rje tshur khyod ①bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song la phyin pa dang / kho bo'i tshig gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byos ②la/ gnod pa chung ngam/ nyam nga ba nyung ngam/ bskyod pa yang ngam/ 'tsho'am/ stobs dang bde ba la reg par gnas sam zhes zhus la 'di skad ces/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod du gshegs su gsol/bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig la bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du na bza' chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / snyun dpyad kyi rkyen sman dang yo byad rnams kyis ①bkur sti dubagyid do zhes kyang stsol ⑤cig /jo bo bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes mi des khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi ⑥ltar mnyan nas rgyal po'i khab gang na ba der chas te/ rim ⑦gyis rgyal po'i khab tu phyin pa dang / de nas lam gyis dub pa ngal sos nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal ⑤te phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas/ mi des bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces ⑨gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan ⑩'das kyi zhabs gnyis la khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis ⑩mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas zhes bya ba nas/ reg par gnas sam zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /kye mi khyod dang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin bde bar gyur cig /btsun pa khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi ⑩mchid nas/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod du gshegs su gsol/bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig la zhes bya ba nas bkur sti 8bgyid do zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin no0/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis mi de la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas mi des bcom ldan 'das 3—491

kyis cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas ①bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan ②snga nas song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das dul ba 'khor dul ba zhi ba 'khor zhi ba/ dbugs phyin pa/ 'khor dbugs phyin pa/ rnam par dul ba/ 'khor rnam par dul ba dgra bcom pa 'khor dgra bcom pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba 'khor 'dod chags dang bral ba/ dang ba 'khor dang ba/ khyu mchog ba lang gi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang / glang po che glang po che'i phrug gu'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang / seng ge mche ba can gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang / ngang pa'i rgyal po ngang pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang / nam mkha' lding bya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang / bram ze slob ③ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang /sman pa mkhas pa nad pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang / dpa' bo dmag gi ①tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang / lam mkhan 'gron 0po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang / ded dpon tshong pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang / tshong dpon skye bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang / khams kyi rgyal phran blon po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang / 'khor los sgyur ba ༷bu stong gis bskor ba lta bu dang / zla ba rgyu skar gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang / nyi ma 'od zer stong gis bskor ba lta bu dang / yul 'khor skyong dri za'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang / 'phags skyes po grul bum gyi 0tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang /mig mi bzang klu'i tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang / rnam thos kyi bu gnod sbyin gyi 0tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang / thags zangs ⑨ris lha ma yin gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang / brgya byin 4)sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i tshogs kyis 3—492

bskor ba lta bu dang / tshangs pa tshangs ris kyi ①tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu dang /rgya mtsho g.yo ba med pa lta bu dang / sprin chu dang bcas pa lta bu dang / glang po che dam pa dregs pa dang bral ba ltar dbang po rnams shin tu dul bas spyod lam gyi tshul ma 'khrugs pa/ sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis ⑧kun nas brgyan zhing / dpe byad brgyad bcus rnam par mdzes par byas pa/'od 'dom ②gang gis brgyan pa'i sku/ nyi ma'i du'od zer stong bas lhag pa'i 'od can/ rin po che'i ri bo 'gro ba ltar kun nas mdzes pa/ stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum dang / thugs rje 0chen po dang ldan pa/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa dang /mnyan yod na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dang / lha brgya stong phrag du mas zhabs rjo'abring byas nas mnyan yod kyi grong khyer du gshegs so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑦mnyan yod kyi grong khyer du gshegs nas mngon par 'du mdzad pas/grong khyer gyi sgo'i them pa la zhabs g.yas pas mnan pa de'i tshe sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos te/ sa chen po 'di dugayos/ kun du g.yos/① kun du rab tu g.yos/ ldeg rab tu ldeg /kun du rab tu ldeg ste/ shar phyogs mtho na nub phyogs dma'/ nub phyogs mtho ⑩na shar phyogs dma'/ lho phyogs mtho na byang phyogs dma'/ byang phyogs mtho na lho phyogs dma'/ mtha' mtho na dbus dma'/ dbus mtho na mtha' dma' bar gyur nas/ 'jig rten 'di thams cad 'jig rten gyi bar dang bcas te snang ba rgya 0chen pos khyab par gyur to/ /bar snang la yang lha'i rnga brdung 0zhing nam mkha'i dkyil na gnas 3—493

pa'i lhas ni steng nas lha'i me tog utpal dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po dang / a ka ru'i phye ma dang / rgya spos kyi phye ma dang / tsan dan gyi phye ma dang / gur gum ①gyi phye ma dang / ta ma la'i lo ma dang / lha'i me tog man dā ra ba dag ②'thor zhing lha'i gos rnams kyang 'thor ro/ /bcom ldan 'das grong khyer du gshegs pa na 'di dag dang gzhan yang ya mtshan 'di lta bu dag byung bar gyur to/ /gzhan yang dog pa rnams ni yangs par gyur to/ /dma' ba ②rnams ni mthon por gyur to/ /mthon po rnams ni byamanyam par gyur to/ /glang po che yang skad 'byin⑤/ rta yang skad 'byinaX / khyu mchog rnams kyang skad 'byin to④/ /khang pa na yod pa'i rol mo'i cha byad sna tshogs pa rnams kyang rang sgra 'byin to/ /long ba rnams kyis ni mig thob bo/ /'on pa rnams kyis ⑧rna bas thos so/ /lkugs pa rnams kyis ni ⑨smra nus ⑩par gyur to/ /dbang po ma tshang ba rnams ni dbang po rnams tshang bar gyur toyi/ /chang gis 8myos pa rnams ni myos pa dang bral bar gyur to/ /dug 'thungs pa rnams ni dug zhi bar gyur to/ /phan tshun khon 'byung ba rnams ni byams pa thob par gyur to/ /sbrum ma rnams ni bde bar btsas par gyur to/ /btson 8du bcings pa rnams ni bcings pa las thar to/ /nor med pa rnams ni nor rnyed de/ 'di dag dang gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das grong khyer du gshegs pa na ngo mtshar brgya stong tsodag byung bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das bkur ste tsochen po de lta bus mnyan yod du gshegs so/ /gshegs nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin mdza' bshes ⑩dang nye du dang gnyen gyi skye 3—494

bos yongs su bskor ①nas gser gyi bya ma bum blangs te chu steng bar brtsams ②pa las/ de 'dzag tu ma btub nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin yid mi bde ③ste bsams pa/ bdag gi ④las nyes pa dang bcas pa cung zad byas par ma gyur grang snyam pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag khyod kyis las nyes pa dang bcas pa cung zad kyang dubyas pa med de/ 'on kyang khyod kyis phyogs 'dir 'dug nas sngon gyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la phyogs 'di phul ba yin gyisaX/ phyogs gzhan zhig tu 'dug la stengs shig /des phyogs gzhan zhig tu 'dug ste stengs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi ⑦min lag lnga dang ldan pa'i gsung dbyangs kyis rgyal byed kyi tshal brjod ⑧par mdzad de/ rgyal byed kyi tshal brjod pa ⑨mdzad pa na gzhon nu ⑩rgyal byed kyis bsams pa/ kye ma 0bcom ldan 'das kyis der bdag gis ⑫ming thog mar smos kyang ci ma rung snyam 8pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑫gzhon nu rgyal byed kyi bsam tunyepa thugs su chud nas/ dge slong dag 'di ni rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba yin no zhes der ming thog mar yismos par 0mdzad do/ /gzhon nu rgyal byed kyis bcom ldan 'das kyis der bdag gi ming thog mar smos pa (nyemadzad pa thos nas shin tu dga' bar gyur te/ dga' ba dang rab tu dga' ba skyes pa des nor gyi rigs thams cad kyis bcom ldan yi'adas kyi dzu )phyir rin po che sna bzhi'i sgo khang byed du bcug go/ /de bzhin du sdud pa byed pa rnams kyis ()kyang mdo sde'i nang du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so zhes gdags par dubyas so/ /dge slong rnams 3—495

the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis sngon ①yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams las ③phyogs 'di sngon nam ②phul lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag sngon byung ba bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ④ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi 0rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs 0zhes bya ba du'ajig rten du byung nas/ de 'khor dge slong drug khri nyis stong dang phyogs 'dir gshegs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan yod 'dir khyim bdag rgyal zhes bya ba byung ste/ des sa phyogs 'di rgyang grags drug gser dang dbyig gshibs ⑧pas rgyal bu gzhon nu las nyos nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs la phul te/ de nyid kyi spyan sngar rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa mngon sum du byas sol/ /khyim bdag rgyal gyi tsha bo zhig des ⑨bsten pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs la shin tu dad pa skyes nas des yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyi dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten rtsig 0tu bcug ste des bsams pa/ gang gis na hubadag 8gis 'di nyin mtshan du sgrib pa med par mthong bar 'gyur ba'i thabs de ci yod snyam pa dang / de la rten 4)pa rgya mtsho'i 'gram na 'dug pa zhig gis nor bu tsorin po che 'bar ba zhig skyes su bskur (nyenas/ des de mchod rten la btags pa dang de'i mthus des dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten de nyin skyematshan du sgrib pa med par mthong ngo / /3—496

de nas dad pa skyes te lasmon lam btab pa/ ji ltar sa phyogs 'di bdag gi ②zhang pos rgyal bu ③gzhon nu las gser dang dbyig gshibs pas nyos nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la phul ba de bzhin du bdag gis kyang sa phyogs 'di gser dang dbyig gshibs pas rgyal bu dugazhin nu las nyos nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun la 'bul bar 'gyur zhing / de rnams kyi ⑤phyi ma shos gang yin pa de'i spyan sngar bdag rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa mngon sum du byas par gyur cig ces btab bo/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi khyim bdag rgyal gyi tsha bo gang yin pa de ni khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'di nyid yin no/ /de tshun chad bskal pa sum bcu rtsa gcig pa la ston pa gtsug tor 0can zhes bya ba nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung ngo / /zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste/de 'khor dge slong drug khri dang sa phyogs 'dir gshegs so/ /de'i tshe khyim bdag rgyas pa zhes bya ba byung ste/ des phyogs 'di ⑦dpag tshad phyed dang gsum nor bu gshibs ⑧pas rgyal bu gzhon nu las nyos nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gtsug tor can nyan thos kyi 'khor dang bcas pa la phul lo/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe de'i dus kyi khyim bdag rgyas pa zhes bya bar gyur pa de gzhan zhig yin snyam na khyed ①kyis de ltar mi blta ⑩ste/ 'on kyang de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'di nyid yin no/ /de'i 'og tu bskal pa sum bcu rtsa gcig pa de (nyenyid la ston pa thams cad skyob ces bya ba nas/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung ngo 4)zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma 3—497

bzhin du ste/ de ①'khor dge slong drug khri dang sa phyogs 'dir gshegs so/ /de'i tshe khyim bdag mchu zhes bya ba byung ste/ des phyogs 'di rgyang grags gnyis ②mu tig gshibs pas gzhon nu las nyos nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad skyob nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la phul lo/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe de'i dus kyi khyim bdag mchu zhes bya ba de gzhan zhig yin snyam na khyed ②kyis de ltar mi blta ste/ 'on kyang de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'di nyid yin no/ /de'i 'og tu bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid ④la ston pa 'khor ba 'jig ces bya ba ⑤nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ de 'khor dge slong bzhi khri dang lhan cig 0phyogs 'dir gshegs so/ /de'i tshe khyim bdag srid sbyin zhes bya ba byung ste/ des phyogs 'dir ⑦ba lang gis bkang bas gzhon nu las nyos te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la phul lo/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe de'i dus kyi khyim bdag srid sbyin zhes bya bar gyur pa de gzhan duzhig yin snyam na khyed kyis de ltar mi blta ste/ 'on kyang de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'di nyid yin no/ /de'i 'og tu bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu ⑨rnams kyi tshe lo sum khri thub pa na ston pa gser thub ces bya ba nas/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung ngo zhes bya ba'i 4) bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ de 'khor dge slong sum khri dang phyogs 'dir gshegs so/ /de'i tshe khyim bdag phur bu zhes bya ba byung ste/ des phyogs 'di gos bting ⑪bas gzhin nu las nyos nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser thub 3—498

nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la phul lo/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe de'i dus kyi khyim bdag phur bu zhes bya bar gyur pa ①de gzhan zhig yin snyam na khyed ②kyis de ltar mi blta ste/ 'on kyang de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'di nyid yin no/ /de'i 'og tu bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i ③tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung zhes bya ba nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'odu/ /de 'khor dge slong nyi khri dang phyogs 'dir gshegs so/ /de'i tshe khyim bdag chu stod ces bya ba dubyung ste/ des sa phyogs 'di rgyang grags phyed gser gyi nas dubakram pas gzhon nu las nyos te yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la phul lo/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe de'i dus kyi khyim bdag chu stod ces bya bar gyur pa de gzhan ⑦zhig yin snyam na ⑧khyed kyis de ltar mi blta ste/ 'on kyang de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'di nyid yin no/ /dge slong dag da ltar gyi ⑨de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lo sgyur0ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa ⑩nga yang ()'jig rten du byung nas nga 4)'khor stong nyis brgya lnga bcu dang phyogs 'dir gshegs pa na da ltar yang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis rmon pa dor bcu drug gis rmos ④pa'i khyon bye ba gshib pas gshibs 8nas gzhon nu rgyal byed las nyos te nga nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la phul lo/ /dge slong dag ma 'ongs pa'i dus na skye dgu rnams kyi tshe lo brgyad 0khri thub pa na ston 3—499

pa byams pa zhes bya ba ①'khor dgra bcom pa khrag khrig phrag dgu dang ther 'bum chen po phrag drug phyogs 'dir gshegs par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe khyim bdag nor bzangs zhes bya ba 'byung bar 'gyur te/ des phyogs 'di dpag tshad gsum gser dang dbyig gshibs pas gzhon nu las nyos nas byams pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la dbul ②bar 'gyur zhing de nyid kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ste nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe de'i dus kyi khyim bdag nor bzangs zhes bya ba 'byung bar 'gyur ba de gzhan zhig yin snyam na khyed kyis de ltar mi blta ⑧ste/ 'on kyang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'di nyid khyim bdag nor bzangs zhes bya ba yin par 'gyur ro/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis gter bdag po dang bcas pa dang / bdag po med pa dang /thang la yod pa dang / chu na yod pa dang / gang dag rgyang ring po na duyod pa dang / gang dag thag nye ba na yod pa yang mthong bas kun tu khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis gter bdag po dang bcas pa dang / bdag po med pa dang /thang la yod pa dang / chu na yod pa dang / gang dag rgyang ring po na yod pa dang / gang dag thag nye ba na yod pa yang ⑤mthong ngo / /zhes grags so/ /de'i tshe mu stegs can gyi dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / spyod pa pa dang /kun du rgyu sna tshogs rtog ༷khang du 'dus te 'khod pa rnams 'di lta bu'i skabs kyi gtam dag gleng bar byed de0/ shes ldan dag khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin mtshan gang dag dang ldan na gter bdag po dang bcas pa dang / bdag po med pa dang / thang la yod pa dang / chu na yod pa dang / gang dag 3—500

rgyang ring po na yod pa dang / gang dag thag nye ba na yod pa mthong bar gyur/de'i tshe bram ze'i khye'u phyugs sten zhes bya ba 'khor de nyid du tshogs shing 'dug par gyur nas des smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed cag sems las chung ngus 'khod cig dang / kho bos khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin mtshan gang dag dang ①ldan na gter bdag po dang bcas pa dang / bdag po med pa dang /thang la yod pa dang / chu ②na yod pa dang / gang dag rgyang ring po na yod pa dang / gang dag thag nye ba na yod pa mthong bar 'gyur ba ②brtags la khyed la smra bar dubya'o zhes de khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'gro ba dang / 'dug pa la brtag pa lhur len cing rjes bzhin ⑤'brang ngo / /ci 0tsam dus gzhan zhig na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin chu bo a dzi ra ba tir khrus byas nas ༅byung ba la des de'i rgyab tu thal mo brgyab ⑧pa dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis mthong bzhin du cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /des smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod ni mkhas pa yin zhing bzod pa dang des pa dang ldan pa yin pas des ⑨na gter bdag po dang bcas pa dang / bdag po med pa dang / thang la yod pa dang / chu na yod pa dang / gang dag rgyang ring po na yod pa dang /gang dag thag nye ba ⑨ na yod pa mthong ngo / /des mu stegs can rnams la go bar byas pa dang / mu stegs can kha ngom can rnams kyis kyang kun du smras pasayi/khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin ni bzod pa dang des pa dang ldan pas des na gter bdag po dang bcas pa dang / bdag po med pa dang / thang la yod pa dang / chu na yod pa dang / gang dag rgyang ring po na yod pa dang / gang dag thag nye ba na yod pa mthong ngo zhes kun du sgra grags pa'i skabs de dge slong 3—501

rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das ①la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa②/ dge slong dag mu stegs can brgya stong phrag bye bas kyang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin mtshan gang dang ldan na gter mthong bar 'gyur ba shes par bla ②ba ma yin no/ /'on kyang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi mig gi 'bras bu rin po che ltar bkra ba dang / dbyig gi skad yod debya/ des na ⑤gter bdag po dang bcas pa dang / bdag po dumed pa dang / thang la yod pa dang / chu na yod pa dang / gang dag rgyang ring po na yod pa dang / gang dag thag nye ba na yod pa mthong ngo // //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po bdun bcu ⑨drug pa/ dge rmeng rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis las ci zhig bgyis na/las de'i rnam par smin pas mig gi 'bras bu rin po che ltar bkra zhing dbyig gi skad dang ldan par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'di nyid kyis las tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba/ 'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i las dag byas shing bsags pas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis dumyong bar 'gyur/dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur gyi/ 'di ltar las dge ba dang 0mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams kho 3—502

na la rnam par smin par 'gyur ①te/ las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba ri 'or ②zhig na khyim bdag phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba/ yongs su gzung ③ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu la nor gyis 'gran ①pa zhig gnas te/ de sos ⑤ka'i dus la bab pa'i tshe me tog gi dushing rnams kha 'bus 0shing ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang / rma bya dang /ne tso dang / ri skegs dang / khu byug dang / shang shang te'u rnams skad 'byin pa'i nags tshal 0gyi gzhir nang mi dang lhan cig dong ngo / /sangs rgyas rnams byung ba med pa na rang sangs rgyas dman pa dang ngan pa la snying brtse ⑨ba/bas mtha'i gnas mal la dga' ba/ 'jig rten gyi 0yon gnas gcig pu dag 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur bas ji tsam na rang sangs rgyas zhig ljongs rgyu zhing song ba tunyen ri 'or 4)der phyin nas de skyed mos tshal de'i phyogs zhig na 'dug go/ /skyed mos tshal bsrung 4)ba'i mis khyim bdag de la smras pa/dpon po phyogs 'di na rab tu byung tsob zhi ba'i bdag nyid can zhig bzhugs so/ /des thos nas de yid dga' bar gyur zhing dad pa skyes te/ gang 8gi skyed mos tshal na 'di 'dra ba'i rab tu byung ba gnas pa ni bdag skal ba can yin no snyam mo/ /bdag nyid chen po de yang phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su zhugs te yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas khyim bdag des mdza' bshes ⑩dang / nye du dang / gnyen dang / nang mi rnams dang lhan cig tu bkur ste sngo 〉chen po 4)byas nas bsregs te/ me de 'o 3—503

mas ①bsad nas rus pa de ②rnams shel las byas pa'i bum pa'i nang du rin po che dang bsres te blugs pa dang rus pa de rnams 'od dang ldan zhing sgra 'byin par gyur to/ /de nas des drung du gtugs nas smon lam btab pa/ ji ②ltar rus pa 'di rnams rin po che dang bsres nas shin tu 'od dang ldan zhing sgra 'byin pa de bzhin du/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag gi mig gi 'bras bu rin po che ltar bkra zhing dbyig gi skad dang ldan par gyur cig ces byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi khyim bdag gang yin pa de dukhyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 'di nyid yin te/ 'dis rang sangs rgyas la bya ba byas nas smon lam btab ⑤pa gang yin pa dudang / khyim bdag rgyal gyi tsha bor gyur pa na des yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam ⑦par gzigs kyi dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten la nor bu 'bar ba btags pa gang yin pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas mig gi ⑧'bras bu rin po che ltar bkra zhing dbyig gi skad dang ldan par gyur to/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag pa rnams kyi ⑨rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag pa yin la/ gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi ni gcig tu dkar ba dang / 'dren ma rnams kyi ni 'dren ma yin te / de lta bas na dge slong dag 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/ las gnag pa dang 'dren ma 4)gang yin pa rnams ni spangs la/ las gcig tu dkar ba rnams la skyebartsal bar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis de lta bu la bslab par bya'o// //bar 4)sdom ni/ rgyal dang rgyas pa mchu rludang ni/ /srid sbyin dang ni phur bu dang / /chu stod tsodang ni zas byaphyin dang / /phyi ma pa ni nor bzangs 3—504

yin/ /dbyig rnams dang ni gser dang ni/ /gsum pa nor bu mu tig yin//ba dang nas dang gos ①dang ni/ /bye ba dbyig gis bsdus pa yin/ /gang gi tshe khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bye ba'i gshib ②pas gshibs rgyanas gzhon nu 0rgyal byed las nyos te sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i ⑤dge slong gi dge 'dun la phul ba de'i tshe yul sna tshogs na duganas pa'i dad pa can mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba dag mnyan yod ⑦du lhags nas/ de rnams las kha cig mngon par dad par gyur nas smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag cag gis kyang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi slad du rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du gzhi cung zad brtsig dugo/ /dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ rin gyis sa nyos la rtsigs nyushig /'phags pa rin ci0/ ji tsam stsal lags/ dbyig ⑩'di snyed do/ /'phags pa re zhig 'di snyed kyi 'byor pa lta 8bdag cag la lta ga la mchis/ de lta mod ⑩kyi gal te phyogs 'di thob na bcig go zhes pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag tsol rtogs la gal te byin na rtsigs shigatso /dge slong rnams kyis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la brtags pa dang des smras pa/ gal te bdag la brten 0te bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams dge 'dun gyi phyir bsod nams bgyi ba'i dngos po bgyid na stsal to/ /gang zag gi 0phyir bgyid na mi ⑫stsal to zhes pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na rjes su gnang ste/dge 'dun gyi phyir ni brtsig par bya'o/ /gang zag gi phyir ni yon bdag la brtags te gal te byin na brtsig par bya'o/ /ma byin na brtsig par mi bya'o/ /3—505

glo ①bur ba'i dge slong mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba dag mnyan yod du lhags pa na de rnams smos ②'drin ji lta ba bzhin dge slong rnams kyi drung du song ③ba dang /gzhan dag la smos 'drin med pa de dag phongs par gyur nas byung ba 'di la bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ glo 0bur pa rnams kyi phyir ma bgos pa'i gnas gzhag par bya'o/ /ri 'or ⑤zhig na gtsug lag khang zhig yod pa der dge slong rnams dbyar gnas par rjodam bcas pa las/ ji tsam na ri 'or der rjodabyar gyi nang logs dusu 'jigs pa byung nas/ de na gnas pa'i dge slong rnams skrag nas dgag dbye ma byas par mnyan yod du lhags pa dang /de nas ⑨dge slong rnams kyis lam gyis dub pa ngal sor bcug ( )ste/ lam gyis dub pa ngal sos nas de rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag cag la tu)gnas mal skos shig /de rnams kyis dbyar gyi nang logs yin no snyam nas ma bskos pa dang / glo 4)bur pa'i dge slong rnams 0smod par byed/gzhogs 'phyas byed/ kha zer bar byed de/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed da ltar ston pa nyid bzhugs bzhin du bstan pa nub par byed dam ci/ gal te khyed la 'gyod 8pa yod na rgan rims 'ji lta ba bzhin du gnas mal ⑩byin cig /de rnams bya'on kyang ma bskos pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba dang / byung ba 'di la bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na 8rjes su gnang ste/ 'jigs pas ral ba'i dge slong rnams kyi yiphyir dbyar gnyis par gnas par dam bca' bar bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis ma shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ zla ba gsum pa'i dgag dbye bya zhing dbyar zla ⑥tha chungs 0la dbyar phyi mar duganas par dam bca' bar 3—506

bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jigs pas ral ba'i dge slong rnams kyi phyir dbyar gnyis par gnas par dam bca' bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / ci ①tsam na 'jigs pas ral ba'i dge slong gzhan dag kyang mnyan yod du lhags pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ngas 'jigs pas ral ba'i dge slong rnams la brten ②nas dbyar gnyis par gnas par dam bca' bar ②bcas kyi dugasum pa ni ma yin no/ /'jigs pas ral ba'i dge slong rnams kyang smos 'drin ji lta ba bzhin du ngal sor dugazhug par bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis de rnams las su 0sko bar byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de rnams las su bsko bar mi bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis de rnams ⑦la rnyed pa byin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de rnams la rnyed pa mi sbyin no/ /dge slong rnams kyis kha zas kyi rnyed pa yang ma byin pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de rnams la kha zas kyi rnyed pa ni sbyin gyi gos kyi rnyed pa ni ma yin no/ /dad pa can rnams kyis gtsug lag khang mang du brtsigs pa las mnyan yod na dge slong nyung ngu zhig dbyar gnas par dam bcas te/ de rnams stong par 'dug pas sbyin bdag rnams kyi longs spyod las byung ba'i bsod nams med cing nal phrug rnams kyi gnas su gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ thams cad bgo bar bya ste/ re res kyang so sor gnyis sam/ gsum mamadu/ bzhi ci ran pa ⑨thams cad la longs spyad ⑩par bya ste/ la lar ni snga dro 'dug par bya'o/ /la lar ni nyi ma'i gung la'o/ /la lar ni phyi dro'o/ /la lar ni nub mo gnas par bya'o/ /dge slong rnams 3—507

kyis lag gi las ma byas pas de rnams 'drums par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ yon bdag la spro ba bskyed par bya'o/ /gal te grub na de lta na legs/ gal te ma grub ①par gyur na dge 'dun gyis phyir bcos par bya'o/ /gal te mi nus par gyur na ji tsam ②nus pa de tsam ③bcos par bya ste/ gzhan ni btang snyoms su gzhag par bya'o/ gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa rgyas par gyur pa de'i 0tshe dge slong mang po mnyan yod du lhags pa dang / de rnams gnas khang gis duphongs par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnyis dang gsum gyis bgo dubar bya ste/chu snod gzhag pa dang / 'dag chal ⑦dang / sman dang / so shing gzhag pa dang / phan tshun gyi them skas ma gtogs par chung ngu na 'dug pa'i tshad tsam yang thams cad kyis 'dra bar ⑧bgo ⑨bar bya ste/ nye 'khor ⑩ni spyi'i yin pa nyid pas bgo bar mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag dgon pa dang / shing drung yidang / khang stong dang ()/ ri sul dang / brag phug dang / rtswa'i stan dang / bla gab med pa dang / dur khrod dang / nags mtha' dang / bas mtha'i gnas mal 'di rnams su bsam gtan gyis shig /phyis yid la gcags 0par mi 'gyur bar bag yod par gyis shig ces dgon pa'i bsngags pa mang du gsungs pa de'i tshe dge slong kha cig dgon pa par dam bcas nas dgon pa na (steganas pa las/ de rnams de na chom rkun pa rnams kyis gtogs pur gyur to/ /gtogs nas bram ze dang khyim bdag gi khyim rnams su chos gos tshol ba'i phyir brtson par gyur pas lung mnod 8pa dang / bklag ⑩pa dang / gdon pa dang / rnal 'byor dang / yid la bya ba nyams par gyur ⑩3—508

pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / byung ba 'di la bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dgon pa pa rnams ①kyi phyir gnas gzhag par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dgon pa pa rnams kyi phyir gnas gzhag par bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis mi gsal ba zhig tu bzhag pa dang / dge slong dgon pa pa zhig gis lhung bzed dang chos gos bzhag nas sgo bcad de sde mig blangs nas song ba dang / dge slong dgon pa pa gzhan dag /phongs par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ②pa/ gnas gsal bar dge slong dgon pa pa rnams kyi ③gnas gzhag par bya'o/ /nye dga'as khyim bdag cig gtsug lag khang rtsig ⑦tu bcug ⑤nas/ de ni de na mi gnas par dge slong glo ༷bur ba gang zhig 'ongs pa de la gnas byin nas rnyed pa ni bdag nyid kyis khyer ro/ /ji 0tsam na dge slong chos gos gsum pa zhig 'ongs pa dang des gtsug lag khang dustong par mthong nas des dris pa/ 'di su'i gtsug lag khang yin/ dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ dge slong nye dga'i yin no/ /de de'i drung du song nas brnyas pa dang des smras pa/ gtsug lag khang ⑨'dir 'dug la rnyed pa gang yin pa de ni kho bo'i yin no/ /de der gnas te des gtsug lag ⑩khang de lan 'ga' yang phyag dar ma byas/ ba'i lci ba gsar tho)pa'i byug pas ma byugs so/ /de ji ⑫tsam zhig na gtsug lag khang de nas song ngo / /dge slong gzhan zhig 'ongs te des kyang nye dga' las brnyas nas gtsug lag khang der gnas pa dang tho)/gtsug lag khang de phyag dar gyi phung pos gang bar mthong nas der phyag dar byas rkyinas phyag dar bor te/ phyags ma zin 8bzhin du phyag dar gyi phung po'i drung na 3—509

'greng ba dang / ji ①tsam na dge slong gzhan zhig gis de mthong nas ②smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa khyod phyags ma lag ⑧na thogs bzhin du de nyid na 'greng ngam ci/phyags ma de dumi bzhag gam/ des smras pa/ 'di na ⑤lag pa srung ba 'ga' zhig duganas pa lta ste/ des na 0phyags ma'i rjes kyang med do/ /des smras pa/'di na dge slong chos gos gsum pa che ge mo zhig ⑧gnas ⑨gnas so/ /ji tsam na des de bsod snyoms la rgyu ba mthong nas ma nongs so/ /des smras pa/rnyed pa ni nye dga'as khyer la de'i gtsug lag khang kho bos phyag dar bya'am zhes pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rnyed pa su 'khyer 0ba des gtsug lag khang phyag dar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sbyin bdag shi ba rnams kyi ming gis yon 0bsngo bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis shi ba rnams kyi phyir tshigs su bcad pa 'don pa na/ khyim bdag cig ⑫gtsug lag khang du 'ongs na/ des de yon bsngo tib thos te 8de'i drung du song ste smras pa/ 'phags pa gal te bdag gis kyang gtsug lag khang brtsig (nyen/bdag gi ⑩ming gis kyang yon bshad pa ⑩mdzad dam/ des smras pa/ rtsigs phyeshig dang / legs par bsngo'o/ /ji tho)tsam na khyim bdag des gtsug lag khang zhig rtsig ⑥ tu bcug nas des der ci yang ma bzhag go/ /de 0stong pa nyid du 'dug pa ji 0tsam na khyim bdag des mthong nas des 0gtsug lag khang du 'ongs nas smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag gi gtsug lag khang stong par mchis na de na su yang du)mi bzhugs sam/ dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis smras pa/bzhin bzangs mi 0snum pas so/ /khyim bdag des smras pa/ 'phags pa tshwa 3—510
