sgo ①can dgon dung la ②brtsigs pa la ga la snum par 'gyur/ khyim bdag de la ③bsams nas kho bo smra ba ma yin te/ 'on kyang de na rnyed pa med do/ /des smras pa/ 'phags pa da ni dubadag gi gtsug lag khang du su bzhugs pa la ras yug chen po ⑤bskon no/ /nye dga'as rnyed pa thob ⑥bo snyam nas gral rim gyis ⑦bab pa dun rang gi ①skal ba tho )blangs nas de ni gzhan nyid na gnas te/de ni stong par 'dug go/ /ji tsam na bsod snyoms pa mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba zhig mnyan yod du 'ongs pa des gtsug lag khang stong pa de mthong nas/des dge slong dag la dris pa/ gtsug lag khang 'di bu'i yin/ de dag gis smras pa/ dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang yin mod kyi/ dge slong nye dga'i skal bar dbang ngo / /de nye dga'i drung du song nas khyod kyi skal ba'i yigatsug lag khang 'dir 'dug go/ /des smras pa/ de bzhin du 0byos shig /de de na gnas pa na bsod snyoms pa de mkhas pa snyom tsolas mi byed pa zhig yin pas des de nyi byam re rer ⑫ byug pa dang tso/ phyag dar byas so/ /phyag dar byed pa la ni phan yon lnga yod de/ 'di lta ste/ bdag nyid sems dang bar 'gyur ba dang / gzhan sems dang bar 'gyur ba dang / lha rnams yid dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / mdzes par 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba sogs 4)pa dang /lus zhig nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten lha rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gang dag gis gtsug lag khang de byug pa dang phyag dar byas pa mthong ba de dag gis 4)khyim bdag de'i drung du song ste smras pa des thos nas mchog tu dga' ba skyes so/ /ji 8tsam dus gzhan zhig na rang nyid der song na gtsug lag khang de de bzhin du byug pa dang / phyag dar byed dzu ) pa mthong nas de dad pa skyes te/3—511

des bsod snyoms pa la ras yug chen bskon ①pa nye dga'as thos nas de rings pa ②rings par song ste smras pa/ bsod snyoms pa gtsug lag khang 'di kho bo'i ③skal ba yin gyisaX/ ras yug chen po dukho bo la byin cig /bsod snyoms pas bsams pa/ chags pa'i bdag nyid can 'di la gal te bdag gis ma byin yang 'on 0kyang 'dis ⑦mthus khyer nas bdag kyang gtsug lag khang nas bskrad par 'gyur ro snyam nas des de la byin pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / byung ba 'di la bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang la dad pa skyes nas dad pa'i lhag ⑧par bya ba byas pa ni de 0kho na'i yin no/ /dbyar gyi rnyed pa ni nye dga'i yin no/ /'jig rten 0ni yon tan la dga' ba yin pas bdag nyid dang bu dang chung ma sdug bsngal bar gyur kyang yon tan dang ldan pa la tunyesbyin pa sbyin par byed de/ bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams dge slong dgon pa pa rnams zas la mgron 8du 'bod par byed do/ /dge slong dgon pa pa rnams zas la khyim rnams su dong ba dang ma byin par len pa rnams kyis gtsug lag khang nas brkus par gyur nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sgo 0bcad la lde mig blangs la dong ⑫bar bya'o/ /ma byin par len pa rnams kyis kyang 8sde mig byas te brkus nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ srung tsoma'i dge slong bzhag la dong ⑩bar bya stebya/ de la bsod snyoms kyis brel ba med par bya'o/ /ma byin par yilen pa rnams kyis dge slong gzhan khrid de 'ongs nas/ des sgo phye zhes smras nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rims dang bcas sam/rims med ces brda 6)bya'o/ /gal te rims dang bcas so zhes zer na mi 3—512

dbye'o/ /'on te rims med ces smra ①na dbye bar bya'o/ /gzhan ②yang dge slong dgon pa pas lo ma ltar mnyen pa ②gzhag par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dgon pa pas lo ma ltar mnyen pa gzhag par bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang du/ dge slong rnams kyis lo ma ltar mnyen pa ci 'dra ba ma shes nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag lo ma ltar mnyen pa ni khyi yin te/ de la lhung bzed kyi lhag dum sbyin par bya'o/ /dge slong dgon pa pa rnams kyis khyi bcangs pa las mchod rten gyi 'khor sa dang / gtsug lag khang sder mos brud cing bshang ba dang gci dubs ma rung bar byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ngas dge slong khyi srel ⑦ba'i kun du spyod pa'i chos bca' bar bya ste/ dge slong khyi srel ⑧bas nang par sngar langs la mchod rten gyi 'khor sa dang / gtsug lag khang byul ⑨bar bya ste/sder mos brud pa gang yin pa de snyoms ⑩par bya'o/ / bshang ba yidang gcis pa ⑫yang phyag par 'bya'o/ /dge slong khyi srel 8bas kun du spyod pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa bzhin yang dag par blangs te 'jug par mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' gtsug lag khang zhig gi dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan du gyur pa dang / ji 4)tsam na der ()dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gzhan zhig 'ongs nas nye dga'as bsams pa/ bdag ⑩gtsug lag khang 'di'i dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan byed byed tunyepa las gnas brtan gnyis par bya ba'am/ bdag gtsug lag khang gzhan du 'gro'o snyam yi pa las0/gtsug lag khang de nas byung ste/ de gtsug lag khang gzhan zhig tu song ba dang / dge 'dun (7de'i gnas brtan gnyis pa'i rnyed pa gang yin pa de de'i dge 3—513

'dun gyi gnas brtan gyi yin nas des bsams pa/ bdag gi rnyed pa 'di na yang der zad la bdag gi rnyed pa de na yang der zad na spogs med par dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis ci zhig bya zhes de ②slar rings pa rings pas ②gtsug lag khang de nyid du song ba dang / gnas mal phyed bskos tsam na gtsug lag khang du phyin nas des smras pa/ rgan rims ②ji lta ba bzhin du gtsug lag khang skos ④shig /dge slong rnams kyis 'das zin to zhes te ⑤ma bskos ⑥pa dang nye dga'as smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ston pa bzhugs bzhin du bstan pa nub par byed dam ci/ rgan rims ⑦ji lta ⑧ba bzhin du gtsug lag khang skos ⑨shig ces pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang zhig dge 'dun gyi'am mchod rten gyi bya ba la tunye song ba zhig yin na ⑩de'i gnas mal rgan rims ji lta ba bzhin du bsko bar bya'o/ /gzhan gyi 0ni gar bab pa bzhin du'o/ /nye dga' lhag ⑫par chags pas ④gtsug lag khang gnyis kyi rnyed pa thob 8par 'gyur ro snyam nas/gtsug lag khang gnyis su dbyar gnas par dam bcas te/ des dbyar 'das ⑫nas rnyed pa mnos pa dang / gcig nas kyang ma thob cig shos nas kyang ma thob nas / gnas mal 'gyed ⑩pa'i dge slong rnams la kha zer ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ des dbyar gnas par khas blangs pas de la 8rnyed pa byin cig/dge slong rnams kyis gtsug lag khang gnyis ka nas kyang byin pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gtsug lag khang gnyis ka nas sbyin par mi bya'o/ /gcig nas byin pa dang dge slong gzhan rnams smod par byed/ gzhogs tunye3—514

'phyas byed/ kha zer bar byed de ①gtsug lag khang gnyis kur dbyar gnas na ②ci'i phyir gcig nas sbyin/ ③bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gtsug lag khang gnyis ka nas phyed phyed sbyin par bya ste/ dge slong gis gtsug lag khang gnyis su gnas par dam mi bca'o/ /dam 'cha' ④bar byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /khyim bdag cig gis dugatsug lag khang gnyis rtsig ⑥tu bcug ste/ gcig ni dgon pa pa rnams kyi ⑦yin no/ /cig shos ni grong mtha' pa rnams kyi yin ⑧rna/ /khyim bdag de'i kun du spyod pa ni dbyar gnas pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi dge slong re re la ras yug chen re re bskon pa yin pas de ⑨ras yug chen rnams khyer te dgon pa pa rnams ()kyi gtsug lag khang du song ba dang / nye dga'as dgon pa pa rnams kyi gtsug lag khang du rnyed pa 'bul lo zhes thos nas des yidaga' bo la spring 8ba/ gal te 'di 0rnyed pa 'bul na skal ba nos shig ces smras nas/ de rings pa 8rings par dgon pa pa rnams kyi tsogatsug lag khang du song ba dang ⑩/ khyim bdag des mthong nas des bsams pa/ 'o ni gom stangs dang sbyar na dgon pa 0pa'i gtsug lag khang der song gis8/ da ji ltar byas yin rung snyam pa las re zhig grong mtha' ba'i gtsug lag khang du phul la phyis 'dir dbul 0lo snyam nas/ de nyephyir log nas ras ()yug po che brim par brtsams pa na/ dga' bos lag pa bzed pa dang khyim bdag des tshuras yug po che zhig ④byin no/ /yang bzed pa dang khyim bdag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa khyod la ras yug po che phul lags na ci yang bzhed dam/ des smras (nyepa/ khyim bdag khyod kyi gtsug lag khang du nye dga'as dbyar gnas pas de'i skal ba nod do/ /khyim bdag gis smras pa/3—515

'phags pa bcom ldan 'das kyis rang gi lag nas sbyin pa la bsngags pa mdzad pas rang gi ①lag kho na nas 'bul lo/ /de skyengs nas cang mi smra bar 'dug go//nye dga'as bsams pa/ khyim bdag de ring zhig thogs ②na grong gi mthar ma song grang snyam du bsams nas/ grong mtha' pa'i gtsug lag khang du song nas dga' bo la dris pa/ tshe dang ldan pa bdag gi ras yug po che rnams ③mnos sam/ des ji ltar gyur pa smras so/ /khyim bdag gis lam gzhan nas dgon pa pa'i gtsug lag khang du song ste ras yug po che brims nas song ngo / /nye dga'as yang slar dgon pa pa'i gtsug lag khang du brgyugs na ji tsam duras yug po che rnams dubrims zin pa dang / de dugatsug lag khang gnyis kyi larnyed pa la lhag par chags pa las rnyed pa las nyams nas mya ngan byed cing ⑧yi mug nas smre sngags 'don to/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa lasangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa nye dga' lhag par chags pas ras yug po che las nyams pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ltar 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi ⑩ji ltar 'dis 'das pa'i dus na yang lhag par yichags pas 8zas chad 0par byas pa tsode nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'bab chu'i ngos 8gnyis na gtsug lag khang gnyis shig yod de/ /gcig na ni dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa'o/ /cig shos 4)na ni bsod snyoms pa rnams kyi'o/ /ji 0tsam na khyi gaṇḍi'i sgra shes pa zhig yod de/ de gaṇḍi'i sgra thos nas dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa yod pa'i gtsug lag khang du song na/ de la dge slong kha cig gis lhung bzed kyi lhag ma byin pa dang des 8de zos nas bsod snyoms pa rnams kyi gtsug lag yikhang du song ste/ de ⑥3—516

yang lhung bzed kyi lhag ma zos na ①dga' mgur 'gro'o/ /ji ①tsam ③dus gzhan zhig na bsod snyoms pa rnams la glo 0bur gyi rnyed pa zhig byung nas de rnams kyis sngar gasnyi ⑤brdungs pa dang / khyi des gaṇḍi'i sgra thos nas chu rgal rjobar brtsams ⑦te de ⑧dbus su phyin pa dang / dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa can gyi gtsug lag khang gi gaṇḍi ⑨yang brdungs nas de spro ba med nas slar log par brtsams pa las de chu'i rgyun gyis ring du khyer nas gnyis ka las nyams par gyur to/ /dge slong dag 'di ⑩ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi khyi gaṇḍi'i sgra shes pa gang yin pa de ni nye dga' 'di nyid yin te/ de na yang 'di ⑩lhag par chags pas gnyis ka las nyams par gyur to/ /da ltar yang lhag par chags pas gnyis ka las nyams par gyur to/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na dge slong gis lhag 4)par chags par mi bya'o/ /byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro// // sdom la/ 'thab dang nad pa rdzogs pa dang / /nub mo'i dus dang ka shi dang / /shing dang gsing tsom 'dug gnas dang / /cha rnams dang ni bsgo ba'o / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba 4)'khor gyis zhus pa/ 'di ltar dge slong rnams kyis dge slong 'thab krol 4)bgyid pa/mtshang 'dru bar bgyid pa/ rtsod ⑩par bgyid pa/ 'gyed par bgyid pa/rtsod 0pa'i gzhi bgyid pa 8rnams mchi zhing / de dag ngo tsha ma mchis pas tho btsam ⑥pa'i slad du bdag cag la gleng bar bgyid dran par bgyid do zhes thos na0/ de rnams kyis de dag la ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ nye ba 0'khor dge slong gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis dge slong 'thab grol byed pa rnams du'ong 3—517

ngo zhes thos na/ gnas mal bsko ba gsum dang / gnas mal gzung ①ba drug bya'o / /gnas mal bsko ba gsum gang zhe na/ dgun ②gyi dang / dpyid ②kyi dang / dbyar gyi'o④/ /gnas mal gzung ba 0drug gang zhe na/ gtsug lag khang thams cad dang / gtsug lag khang gi ⑥nye 'khor thams cad dang /khang phran thams cad dang / khang phran gyi nye 'khor thams cad dang / kun dga'i ra ba thams cad dang / kun dga'i ra ba'i nye 'khor thams cad bsko bar bya'o/ /gal te gtsug lag khang skos gyeshig ces zer na 'di bskos zin no ⑧zhes brjod ⑨par bya zhing / gtsug lag khang gi nye 'khor skos ⑩shig zhe yin/'di yang bskos zin no0/ /khang phran skos 0shig ce tson/ 'di yang bskos zin no'i / /khang phran gyi nye 'khor skos ⑩shig ce na/ 'di yang bskos zin normya/ /kun dga'i tsor ba skos ⑥shig ce na/ 'di yang bskos zin no 0 / /kun dga'i ra ba'i nye 'khor skos 0shig ce na/ 'di yang bskos zin no ⑥zhes brjod par bya'o / /de rnams gnas med de mi gnas na gang la nyes pa skyed par 'gyur/de nas sngo 'ab rnams med/ phyir rgol ba rnams med/ mi mdza' ba rnams med nas de'i 'og tu rgan rims 0ji lta ba bzhin du gnas mal bsko bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rgan rims (steji lta ba bzhin du gnas mal bsko bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / ji tsam na dge slong nad pa gcig cig yod pa de bas ches rgan pa'i dge slong zhig 'ongs nas rgan rims (nyeji lta ba bzhin du de'i gnas khang bskos te/ de ni thams cad pas gzhin pas de'i gnas khang gzhan ni ma thob bo/ /dge slong des de la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gnas khang 'di kho bo'i yin par bskos kyis 0byung shig /des smras pa/ bdag bro 'tshal bas tso3—518

nam sos pa na'o/ /dge slong de gtum po zhig pas des phyung nas gang dgar ①bzhag go/ /ji tsam na bram ze dang khyim bdag gtsug lag khang ②lta bar 'dod pa lhags pa de rnams kyis dge slong de mthong nas de rnams kyis smras pa/'phags pa dag ②ci dge slong 'di gum lags sam/ bzhin bzangs dudag 'di shi ba ni ma yin no/ /'o na ci'i phyir 'dir bzhag /'di bas ches rgan pa'i dge slong zhig 'ongs nas/ 'di'i gnas khang de de'i yin par bskos pa dang des 'di phyung nas 'dir bzhag go/ /'phags pa ⑤bdag cag khyim pa lags kyang nang pa rjes su bsrung ba'i phyir khyim nas mi 'byin na khyed cag rab tu byung la ston pa yang thugs rje can yin na/ de ji ltar nad pa phyir 'byin par byed ces de rnams smod par byed/ gzhogs du'aphyas byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / byung ba 'di la bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na dge slong nad pa la gzhi spang ba sbyin par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong nad pa la gzhi spang ba ①sbyin par bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa nye dga'as mjal 0to zhes byas nas cang mi smra bar 'dug go/ /ji 0tsam na zhag drug gam bdun na gnas mal 'gyed par gyur pa ⑩na rkang pa rma byung ba ltar byas te gos kyis dkris yinas 'dug pa dang / gnas khang 'gyed 8pa'i dge slong rnams kyis nad pa yin no snyam nas/ de'i (sreganas mal bskos so/ /de gnas mal bskos zin nas rma'i g.yogs ma bor te 'dug go/ /nad pa thostelta ba'i dge slong rnams kyis de la dris pa/ ci gnas brtan zhabs bsnyung ba ⑫sos sam/ des ⑩smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'du byed 0thams cad ni 3—519

mi rtag pa'o zhes bka' ma stsal tam/ ci kho bo'i nad rtag par 'gyur ramanyu/de rnams kyis smras pa/ gnas brtan myur du sos par gyur pa ②na bar sgyu ni ma btab grang ①/ des smras pa/ kho bo gnas khang sgo drung du gzhag par 'dod dam ci/ dge slong don nyung ba rnams smod par byed/ gzhogs 'phyas byed/kha zer dubar byed de/ de ltar dge slong dag mi na bzhin du gnas khang spang ba rang gir 0byed pa ci'i 0tha tshig ces pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / byung ba 'di la bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ⑦pa/ dge slong dag ⑧de lta bas na sgyu 'debs ⑨pa'i nad pa la gzhi spang ba sbyin par mi bya zhing des rang gir yang mi bya'o/ /rang gir byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro// //lnga tshan rnams kyi 0bsdus pa'i sdom ni/ mdun du bdar yidang rang khrims dang / /ma chags pa dang de bzhin du/ /snang ba skyes dang byung ba dang //bar du gcod dang de bzhin du/ /phyi mar byas pa thong ba ste/ /bsdus pa'i sdom du bsdus pa yin// //bar sdom ni/ mdun du bya dang gzhan dang yang / /nang dang gzhan rnams dag dang ni/ /sems can mang po phan bya ba/ /lnga tshan dag ni dang po yin/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis lha dang mi rnams la mdo sde dang ma mo bzhag go//klu rnams la 0ni mdo sde'o/ /'dul ba ni zab pa zab par snang btso/ mthong bar dka' ba/ khong du chud par dka' ba/ dgongs pa mang ba 'jig rten gyi spyod pa byadang mthun pa yin dbya/ dge slong rnams kyis 'dul ba zab pa nyid dang / dgongs pa mang ba nyid dang / 'jig rten gyi spyod pa dang 3—620

mthun pa nyid yin pas 'don par mi spro'o/ /'di ni chos nyid yin te/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bstan pa'i yan lag gang zhig yongs su nyams pa de'i bsngags pa lhag par brjod ①par mdzad pa yin pas/ de nas ②bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag nga'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i gang zag la phan yon lnga yod de/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'khor bzhis mdun du bdar ②ba yin/ gdams dungag dang rjes su bstan pa gzhan la rag ma las pa yin⑤/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi nang gi mdzod bsrung dub yin/dge sbyong dang bram ze gzhan rnams kyi spyi bo na ⑦'dug pa yin/ dam pa'i chos gnas par bya ba'i phyir dang / bslab pa'i ched kyi phyir skye bo mang po khrul phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde bar zhugs pa yin no// //bar sdom ni/ bdag nyid khrims ldan mngon par bsu/ /'gyod ⑨pa dang ni bag tsha med/ /chos dang mthun pas byed pa ste/ /lnga tshan gnyis pa yin par bshad/ /gzhan yang 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i gang zag la phan yon lnga yod de/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'di'i rang gi tshul khrims kyi phung pos legs par bsrung ⑩zhing legs par sbas pa yin/ 'khor bzhis mngon sum du bsu 0bar bya ba yin/ gang zag 'gyod pa skyes pa rnams kyi tu)ston par gyur pa yin/dge 'dun gyi nang na bag tsha ba med pas gnas pa yin/ chos dang mthun pas phyir rgol ba tshar gcod pa yin no// //bar sdom ni/ ma 'dres don dang nges pa dang / /bslab pa yi ni gzhi dag dang / /snang ba dag ni gnyis po nyid/ /lnga 'tshan dag ni gsum pa yin//3—521

gzhan yang gang zag 'dul ba 'dzin pa la phan yon lnga yod de/ lnga gang zhe na/don ma 'dres par sel ①ba yin/ don rnam par gtan la dbab par bya ba la shin tu nges pa yin/ de'i bslab pa'i gzhi rnams legs par bzung ba yin/sems kyi snang ba skyes pas mang du gnas pa yin/ skye bo phyi ma rnams kyi snang ba byed pa yin no②// //sdom ni/ snang ba gsal ba 'od dang ni/ /sems las chung dang mi stong pa'o / /gzhan yang gang zag 'dul ba 'dzin pa la phan yon lnga yod de/ lnga gang zhe na/ phyogs gang na gang zag 'dul ba 'dzin pa gnas pa'i phyogs de ngas dusnang ba skyes pa dang / gsal ba skyes pa dang / 'od skyes par 0mthong /phyogs der nga ①thugs khral chung ngur gnasaX/ phyogs de ngas bstod ⑦pa ma yin par mthong ngo // //sdom ni/ byung dang de nas bcas pa dang / /rjes su bcas dang de bzhin du/ /bkag dang rjes su gnang ba ni/ / lnga tshan 0lnga par byas pa'o/ /gzhan yang gang zag 'dul ba 'dzin pa la phan yon lnga yod de/ lnga gang zhe na/byung ba shes/ bcas pa shes/ rjes su bcas pa shes/ bkag pa shes/rjes su gnang ba shes pa yin no// //sdom ni/ bar chad bar chad ma yin dang / /gdams nyungag dang ni rjes yi bstan dang / /slob ma'i mthu ni yod pa ste/ / lnga tshan 0drug pa dag tu bshad/ /gzhan yang gang zag 'dul ba 'dzin pa la phan yon lnga yod de/lnga gang zhe na/ bar du gcod pa rnams shes/ bar du gcod pa ma yin pa rnams shes/ 'doms 8par byed/ rjes su ston par byed/ lhan cig 3—522

gnas pa dang nye gnas rnams ①gnas 'char 'jug nus so// //sdom ni/ lhung ba dang ni ltung ba min/ /rtsi dang yang dang de bzhin du/ /so sor thar pa rgyas par yang / /gdon pa dag ni lnga tshan ②yin/ /gzhan yang gang zag 'dul ba 'dzin pa la phan yon lnga yod de/ lnga gang zhe na/ltung ba byung ba shes/ ltung ba ma byung ba shes/ lci ba shes/ yang ba shes shing / de duso sor thar pa'i mdo dugadon pa la rgyas par zhugs pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul ba'i bsngags pa ⑤gsungs pa dang / dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams spro ba dang bcas pas 'dul ba gdon par brtsams so/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa nye ba du'akhor 'dul ba'i gleng gzhi dang byung ba la mkhas pa rnams kyi mchog tu gyur nas dudage slong gnas brtan duganas brtan rnams 'dul ba kun chub par byed par 'gyur ro snyam ste/ gus pas bstan par brtsams pas de lus skya bo bseng bseng ①por gyur zhing rid pa dang /nyam chung ba dang / na bas nyam dmas par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du med par mdzad pa ste/ mkhyen bzhin du rmed kyi tu)mi mkhyen par mi med/ dus su med kyi 0dus las yol bar mi med/don dang ldan pa 8med kyi don dang mi ldan par mi ched pa ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni don dang ldan pa ma yin pa rmed pa la chu lon gyis zlog 0par mdzad pa yin no/ /de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams don dang ldan pa (ste da pa la dus mkhyen pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal tunyepa/ kun dga' bo ci'i phyir dge slong nye ba tso'akhor lus skya bo bseng bseng 0por gyur zhing rid pa dang / nyam 3—523

chung ba dang / na bas nyam ①dmas par gyur/ des gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul ba'i bsngags ②pa gsungs pa dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis de thos nas spro ba dang bcas pas 'dul ba gdon par brtsams pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ③'khor gyis dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams 'dul ba kun chub par bgyid par du'agyur ro zhes gus pas bstan par ⑤brtsams te/ des na de lus skya bo bseng bseng ༷por gyur zhing rid pa dang / nyam chung ba dang / bro 'tshal bas nyam dmas par gyur lags so/ /byung ba 'di la bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ngas lung 'bogs ⑦pa'i dge slong gi kun du spyod pa'i chos bca' bar bya ste/lung 'bogs ⑧pa'i dge slong gis spyod lam rnam bzhir lung dbog ⑨par bya ste/'chag pa dang / 'greng ba dang / 'dug pa dang / nyal ba na'o/ /lung nod pa'i dge slong gi tshuspyod lam rnam pa gsum gyis lung nod par bya ste/ gal te lung 'bogs pa'i dge slong 'chag sar (sprelung nod pa'i dge slong 'ongs la gsar bu zhig (nyeyin na des phyag byas la/ khams snyoms sam zhes dris tsonas lus btud de sems drang pos yigs pa dang bcas pas gom pa bsri zhing lung mnod 4)par bya'o/ /ji (nyeste ches rgan pa zhig yin na des khams snyoms sam zhes dris nas lus btud de sems drang por 0gus pa dang bcas pas/ gom pa bsri zhing lung mnod 8par bya'o/ /ji ⑩ste 'greng ba na 'ongs pa ⑥la gsar bu zhig yin na (nyedes phyag byas la khams snyoms sam zhes dris nas stan ches dma' ba la tsog tsog por 'dug la sems drang pos gus pa dang bcas pas lung mnod 6)par bya'o/ /ji ()ste rgan pa zhig yin na des khams snyoms sam zhes 3—524

dris la lus btud nas sems drang pos gus pa dang bcas pas lung mnod ①par bya'o/ /'greng ba la ji lta ba ②bzhin du 'dug pa dang / nyal ba la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /lung 'bogs ①pa'i dge slong gis shin tu goms pa dang /legs par byang ba dang / the tshom med par byas nas lung dbog 0par bya'o/ /lung nod pas kyang shin tu byang ba dang / shin tu zin pa dang / the tshom med par byas nas lung mnod 0par bya'o/ /lung 'bogs pa'i dge slong dang /lung nod pa'i dge slong gis kun du spyod pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa bzhin yang dag par blangs te/ 'jug par mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /drug sde'i dge slong rnams ljongs rgyu zhing dong ba na/ gtsug lag ༷khang zhig tu nub mo phyin nas de rnams 'grogs bshes ji lta ba bzhin du dge slong rnams kyis ngal sor ⑦bcug pa dang / de rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag 'dug ste ci byed gnas mal sko nib bos shig /de dag gis smras pa ci dgos/gnas mal bskor gzhug ⑨med/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ gnas mal yod kyis 0bde bar nyol cig dang / nam nangs nas bsko'oyi/ /de rnams kyis kun nas dkris pas smras pa/ ci khyed cag ston pa bzhugs bzhin du bstan pa nub par byed dam/ gal te khyed la 'gyed 8pa yod na rgan rims ()ji lta ba bzhin du gnas mal skos shig /de rnams kha stobs can yin pas gnas mal sko 8ba bred nas gnas mal bskos pa dang / drug sde de rnams kyis rgan rims 8bzhin du gnas mal mnos te nyal lo/ /ji tsam gzhon rims kyis tsobar du sko ⑩ba de'i bar du nam nangs so/ /drug sde rnams myur ba myur bar langs te smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag gnas mal sdus 8shig 'dong ngo / /dge 3—525

slong de rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed kyi ①nub gcig gi phyir dge slong gi dge 'dun mtha' dag nub mo tho btsam mamal/ kye ma'o khyed cag ③'di nyid du 'dug shig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' mnyan yod du dong dungo / /'di dag ni rlung nad can yin no zhes byas nas dong ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / byung ba 'di la bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na nub mo gnas mal bsko bar mi bya'o/ /gal te nub mo lhags na 'grogs bshes ci ⑤lta ba bzhin du so sor ngal sor dugazhug par bya'o/ /yul zhig nas dge slong mchod rten la phyag byed pa zhig mnyan yod du 'ongs na de ⑦de'i spyod yul la mi mkhas pas nang par sngar langs te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ste/bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gnas brtan ⑧gnas brtan rnams kyi rkang pa gnyis la phyag byas nas mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la zhugs sol/ /de bsod snyoms spyod pa na 0dro bab tu nye nas de nyid du ra ba zhig gi drung du 'dug nas zas kyi bya ba byed par 0brtsams so/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin yang mchod rten tsol phyag 'tshal zhing lam de nas song ba las des de mthong nas smras pa / 'phags pa kun nas mdzes pa'i bstan pa la tsorab tu byung ba yin na mi rigs pa mdzad dam ci/ des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dro la bab tu nye ba ma mthong ngam/ 'di la mi rigs pa ci zhig yod/ des smras pa/ khyod ci'i slad du bdag gi khyim du mi byon/ khyod kyi ming ci/ mgon med zas sbyin no/ /kho bos mdo sde de dang de rnams las khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin zhes thos pa zhig yod kyi/ khyod kyang mi shes la/ khyim tsoyang mi shes so/ /khyim bdag 3—526

mgon med zas sbyin gyis bsams pa/ dge slong 'di ni lam ring po nas 'ongs na rgyus ①mi shes pa zhig yin te/ gdon mi za bar bdag kyang mi shes la/bdag gi khyim yang mi shes kyis②/ 'di lta bu la ji ltar byas na ①rung ba bcom ldan 'das la zhus ladu/ gang yang mnyan yod nas rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi bar gyi bar ༷du bste gnas brtsig par bya'o snyam nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la 0ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge slong ⑦gro ③bur ba spyod yul ma 'tshal ⑨ba zhig bsod snyoms spyod pa na dro yol 0du nye nas ra ba zhig gi drung du g.yar zas kyi bgyi ba bgyid de/ ma dad pa rnams yan lag 'dis 'phags pa rnams la smod par 'gyur ro/ /gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na bdag gis gang yang mnyan yod nas rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi bar gyi (sprebar du bste gnas brtsig par bgyi ste/ gang zhig gang du dro la 8bab pa de der bsod snyoms longs spyod tipar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag de lta bas na rjes su gnang gis rtsigs 0shig /des gang yang mnyan yod nas 8rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi bar gyi bar ⑩du bste gnas dag brtsigs 0nas dge slong gang zhig gang du dro bab pa de der zas kyi bya ba byed do/ /dge slong gzhan dag chus phongs 8par gyur nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis der khron pa brkos nas tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum gyis shing rta bkang 4)ste btab pas chu de ro phun sum tshogs par gyur to zhes 'jig rten thams cad du grags pa skye bo'i tshogs kyis thos nas 3—527

lhags pa①/ dge slong rnams kyis bgags ②pa dang / mnyan yod na gnas pa rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa khyed cag la bdag cag gis yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur bgyis na/ chab 'jig rten thams cad kyi thun mong khyed 'gog par mdzad dam zhes pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bgag ③par mi bya'o / /bud med dge slong rnams la chu slong ba na dge slong rnams kyis ma byin nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sbyin par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bud med ni kun nas zhags pa ste/ bdud kyi 'ching ba yin no zhes gsungs pas dge slong rnams bud med la chu sbyin par byed pa na chags par gyur to / /ji ④tsam na bud med byad bzhin dang lang tshos ⑧rgyags pa zhig dge slong gzhon nu zhig la shin tu chags pas de la chu blangs ①pa dang / de yang de la chags pas bcings pa'i sems kyis slar log ①kyang rgyun ma bcad par blugs tegade yang de la rtog bzhin 'thungs pa la 0chu de glor song nas shi'o/ /don nyung ba'i dge slong rnams smod par byed/ gzhogs tho )'phyas byed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang /byung ba 'di la bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bud med gang zhig chags pas bcings pa'i sems kyis dge slong la chu slong ba de la hurang gis sbyin par mi bya'o/ /bud med la chu rgyun ma chad par sbyin par mi bya zhing snyim pa khong la 'thung ⑩shig ces bsgo la/ skabs skabs su bcad cing blugs par bya'o/ /gzhan du na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro// //'dul ba cigazhi/ bam po bdun bcu 0bdun pa/ de'i tshe gang dag 3—528

bsod snyoms kyi thog ma rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du dbul ba de ①rnams kyis de nyid du dbul bar brtsams pa drug sde rnams kyis thos nas de rnams ②bste gnas su dong ste 'dug nas bsod snyoms kyi thog ma ⑧khyer te 'ong ba gang yin pa de la smras0te/ gal te 'o thug yin na ni lhung bzed bzed ⑤par byed de/ci ste chu thug ༷yin na ni rdzu 'phrul chen po'i dge 'dun dang / mthu chen po'i dge 'dun la phul cig ces smra'o/ /de bzhin du hwags kyi bca' ba la sogs pa la ⑦spyar bar bya ste/ don nyung ba'i dge slong rnams smod par byed/ gzhogs 'phyas nibyed/ kha zer bar byed pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / byung ba 'di la bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gis gzhan gyi rnyed pa la kha brngam mi bya'o/ /kha brngam byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis gzhan gyi rnyed pa la 0kha brngam mi bya'o zhes gsungs 0pa dang / dge slong kha cig dgos pa zhig la gtsug lag khang gzhan du dong ste/ de rnams der phyin pa na dro la bab kyang 'gyod pas longs ma spyad pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / byung ba 'di la bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ched du bsams te 'gro bar mi bya'o/ /ma bsams par 'ong ba yilas gal te dro la bab par gyur na longs spyad par bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /phongs pa dang bcas pa'i dus byung ba na dge slong dag gtsug lag khang gzhan du dong ba las de na dge slong de rnams longs spyod pa mthong nas yang bza' bar 'dod pa las 'gyod pas 4)longs ma spyad 0pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / byung ba 'di 3—529

la bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gtsug lag khang snga mar de rnams ①la de yang gal te tshad med pa zhig tu 'brim ②na blang bar bya'o/ /ji ③ste dge slong tshad yod par byas pa zhig yin na blang bar mi bya'o/ /len na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yul ka shi'i ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na ri nag po la gshegs so/ /de'i tshe ri nag po la dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang / nab so gnyis gnas te/ de gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu yul ka shi nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs shing 'dir gshegs par 'gyur ro zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang bsams pa/ston pa'i spyan sngar dge slong ngo tsha med ①pa⑤/ 'dzem ⑥pa med pa rnams kyis bdag cag la gleng bar byed/ dran par byed par 'gyur gyisakhye/ ma la bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir gtsug lag khang chen po gcig ma gtogs pa dge slong rnams las brtsams te/ gnas mal ⑧bsko ba gsum dang / gnas mal ⑨gzung ba yang drug bya'o/ /gnas mal sngo )bsko ba gsum gang zhe na/dgun gyi dang / dpyid kyi dang / dbyar gyi'o⑩/ /gnas mal gzung chub drug gang zhe na/ gtsug lag khang thams cad dang / gtsug lag khang gi nye 'khor thams cad dang / khang phran thams cad dang / khang phran 'gyi nye 'khor thams cad dang / kun dga' ra ba thams cad dang / kun dga' ra ba'i nye 'khor thams cad bsko bar bya'o/ /gal te gtsug —lag khang skos shig ces smras pa dang 'di bskos tsozin no 8zhes brjod par bya zhing khang phran skos shig ce na/ 'di yang bskos zin no49/ /gtsug lag khang gi nye 'khor skos ⑩shig ce na/ 'di yang bskos 'azin noyi/ /khang phran gyi nye 'khor skos ⑥ shig ce na/3—530

'di yang bskos zin rnal/ /kun dga' ra ba skos ②shig ce na/ 'di yang bskos zin noni/ /kun dga' ra ba'i nye 'khor skos shig ce na/ 'di yang bskos zin no ༷zhes brjod par bya ste/ de rnams gnas dumed de mi gnas na ngo tsha med pa/ 'dzem pa med pas dubadag cag la gleng bar mi 'gyur ro snyam nas/de gnyis kyis gnas mal bsko ba ⑦gsum dang / gnas mal gzung ba drug byas so/ /ji gtsam na bcom ldan 'das ri nag po la gshegs pa ⑨na de gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi gtsug lag khang ni snga nas bsdogs zin to/ /dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag gnas mal dang gtsug lag khang skos shig /de gnyis kyis smras pa/ gtsug lag khang sngar bskos zin no0/ /khang phran skos shig /de yang bskos zin rnam/ /gtsug lag 0khang gi nye 'khor skos shig /de yang bskos zin no0/ /khang phran gyi nye 'khor skos shig /de yang bskos zin no0/ /kun dga' ra ba skos shig /de yang bskos zin no / / /kun dga' ra ba'i nye 'khor skos ⑩shig /de yang bskos zin no⑦/ /gang gi phyir de gnyis kyis gnas thams cad ma bskos pa dang de nas kun dga' ra ba'i nang du sgra mthon po dang sgra chen po byung ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du med 8par mdzad pa ste/ mkhyen bzhin du med ⑩kyi mi mkhyen par mi rmed/ dus su rmed kyi 0dus las yol bar mi med/ don dang ldan par (rmermed kyi ()don dang mi ldan par dumi med pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams don dang ldan pa ma yin pa med pa la chu lon gyis zlog ji )par mdzad pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams don dang ldan pa med pa de la dus mkhyen pa yin pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan bya'adas kyis tshe dang ldan 3—531

pa kun dga' bo la rmas ①pa/ kun dga' bo kun dga' ra ba'i nang na skye bo'i tshogs chen po'i sgra mthon po dang sgra chen por grag ②pa 'di ci zhig yin/ des gsol pa/ dge slong 'gro mgyogs dang nab so gnyis kyis gnas mal bsko ba gsum dang gnas mal gzung ba drug bgyis nas dge slong rnams kyis gnas mal ma thob par gyur te/ des na kun dga' ra ba'i nang na skye bo'i tshogs chen po'i sgra mthon po dang sgra chen po 'di grag dulags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo ngas 'thab grol dubyed pa'i dge slong rnams la dgongs nas gnas mal bsko ba gsum dang / gnas mal gzung ba drug mdzad kyis ⑤rang bzhin du gnas pa la ni ma yin pas/ de lta bas na dge slong rnams kyis durang bzhin du gnas pa'i dge slong rnams las btsams te gnas mal bsko ⑦ba gsum dang / gnas mal gzung ba drug mi bya'o/ /byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu yul ko sa la'i ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na grong med pa'i dgon pa zhig tu nub mo dgongs btab bo/ /drug sde rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir shing bzang po zhig bzhag nas shing bzang po gzhan ni rang rang gis bzung ngo / /dge slong gnas brtan ⑧gnas brtan rnams kyis ni shing khong ⑨stong dag thob bo/ /ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis thos nas dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang bcas te ⑩bsu nas 0bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos 0phyag byas nas dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams la brtags na/ ji tsam na drug sde rnams ni shing bzang po dag gi drung na gnas la/ gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyi ni shing khong stong rnams mthong 3—532

nas / des mjal nyuto zhes byas nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug ②go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ③ba gtso bo lags te/ yul mtha' dag nas 'byung ba'i rin po che rnams las thams cad kyi mchog gi dngos po gang lags pa rjode ni bdag gi lags na⑤/ lhag ma rnams las ji ltar 'tshal ba bzhin du mchis 'brang dudang / gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / khrom gyi ru pa rnams kyi lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang bla na ma mchis pa'i chos kyi rgyal po lags/ 'phags pa kauṇḍi ⑦rgya dang / shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu dang / 'od srung ⑧dang / kun dga' bo dang / nam gru la sogs pa nyan thos chen po rnams ni zhugs shing khong stong rnams kyi drung na mchis la/ drug sde rnams kyi ni zhugs shing bzang ches lags kyisal/ kye ma'o bcom ldan 'das thugs brtse ba nye bar bzung ste zhugs shing la yang rgan rims ⑩ji lta ba bzhin gyi bca' ba mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig yinas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te stan las langs nas song ngo /byung ba 'di la bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na shing rnams dang / sgang bu dang / gsing tsom rnams kyang rgan rims 'ji lta ba bzhin du bsko 8bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis shing dang / sgang 3—533

bu dang / gsing ma rnams kyang rgan rims ①ji lta ba bzhin ②bsko bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / dge slong rnams rang nyid sko bar byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas khang sko ba'i dge slong bsko bar bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis phal pa las bskos nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ chos lnga dang ldan pa'i dge slong gtsug lag khang 'ged ②par ma bskos dupa ni bsko bar mi bya'o/ /bskos pa ni dbyung bar bya'o/ /lnga gang zhe na/'dun pas 'gro ba dang / zhe snang gis 'gro ba dang / gti mug gis 'gro ba dang / 'jigs pas 'gro ba dang / gtsug lag khang bskos pa dang ma bskos pa mi shes pa ste/ chos 'di lnga dang ldan pa ni gtsug lag khang sko bar ma bskos pa ni bsko bar mi bya'o/ /bskos 0pa ni dbyung bar bya'o/ /yang chos lnga dang ldan pa ni gtsug lag khang sko bar ma bskos pa ni bsko bar dubya'o/ /bskos pa ni dbyung bar mi bya'o/ /lnga gang zhe na/ 'dun pas mi 'gro ba dang / zhe snang gis mi 'gro ba dang / gti mug gis mi 'gro ba dang / 'jigs pas mi 'gro ba dang / gtsug lag khang bskos pa dang ma bskos pa shes pa ste/ chos 'di lnga dang ldan pa ni gtsug lag khang sko ⑦bar ma bskos pa ni bsko bar bya'o/ /bskos pa ni dbyung bar mi bya'o/ /bsko ba ni 'di ltar bya ste/ gnas mal bshams la dugaṇḍi brdungs la dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo la/ ⑨dge 'dun thams cad tshogs shing mthun par gyur pa dang re zhig thog mar ⑨spro bar bya ste/ ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag ⑪khang sko ⑩bar spro'am/ de gal te spro bar gyur na des 0spro'o zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa 3—534

rnams gsan du gsol/ gtsug lag khang sko ba dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang sko bar ①spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi ⑤dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / 'di ltar dge 'dun gyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di gtsug lag khang sko bar bsko ba mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las bya ba ni/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gtsug lag khang bsko ②ba dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyis dugatsug lag khang sko bar spro nas 'di ltar dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ⑤ba 'di gtsug lag khang sko ⑥bar bskos na/tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di gtsug lag khang sko bar ⑦bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung ⑧shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung ①shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di gtsug lag khang sko bar bskos te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /gtsug lag khang 'ged ⑩pa ji lta ba bzhin du zas la bsko (nyeb dang / thug 8pa 'brim 0pa dang / bag chos ⑫'brim pa dang / phran tshegs 'brim pa dang / snod spyad 4)'drub pa dang /gos 0sped pa dang / gos ⑩'ged pa dang / dbyar gyi ras chen sbed pa dang /dbyar gyi ras chen 'ged pa dang / mngag gzhug pa dang / mdzes 'chos 8pa yang de bzhin te/ chos lnga dang ldan pa'i dge slong ma bskos pa ni bsko bar mi bya'o/ /bskos pa ni dbyung bar bya'o/ /lnga gang zhe na/ 'dun pas 'gro ba dang / zhe snang gis 'gro ba dang / gti mug gis 'gro ba dang /'jigs pas 'gro ba dang / mdzes pa dang mi mdzes pa mi shes pa steyi/ chos 3—535

'di lnga dang ldan pa'i dge slong mdzes 'chos ①par ma bskos pa ni bsko bar mi bya'o / /bskos pa ni dbyung bar bya'o/ /yang chos lnga dang ldan pa'i dge slong mdzes 'chos ②par ma bskos pa ni bsko bar bya'o/ /bskos pa ni dbyung bar mi bya'o / /lnga gang zhe na/ 'dun pas mi 'gro ba dang / zhe sdang gis mi 'gro ③ba dang / gti mug gis mi 'gro ba dang / 'jigs pas mi 'gro ba dang /mdzes pa dang mi mdzes pa shes pa ste/ chos 'di lnga dang ldan pa'i dge slong mdzes 'chos pa rjom bskos pa ni bsko bar bya'o/ /bskos pa ni dbyung bar mi bya'o/ /dugatsug lag khang dang zas ༷'ged dang / /thug pa 'brim dang bag chos dang / /phran tshegs snod spyad 7sbed pa dang / /chos gos gnyis dang de bzhin du/ /dbyar gyi ras chen sbed pa dang / /'ged pa dang ni ⑧mngag gzhug dang / /de bzhin du ni mdzes 'chos ①te/ /gang zag bcu gnyis yin par bshad/ /gnas mal 0gyi gzhi rdzogs soyi// //rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa'i gzhi'i sdom la/ 'thab dang 'gyed 7pa'i rtsod pa dang / /rtsa ba gang dang dge ba gang ⑫/ /'gyed pa yin la rtsod min dang / /'gyed pa dus ni zhi ba dang / /'gyed pa mngon sum zhi ba dang / /tshul shing dag ni blang ba 0yis/ /gdams byangag med pa mngon sum dang / /dran dang ma myos ⑩'dul 'os dang / /de yi ngo bo tshol gzhug dang / /rtswa bkram lta bur 'os pa 0yis/ /dge 'dun dag ni mthun pa yis/ /de bzhin bya ba'i rtsod pa ni/ / nye bar 8zhi bar bya'o zhes/ /drang srong chen pos rab tu gsungasal/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yul ser skya'i gzhi n+ya gro dha'i kun 3—536

dga' ①ra ba na bzhugs so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis shākya rnams bden pa la bkod pa de'i tshe de rnams bcom ldan 'das la blta ②ba'i phyir dus gsum du 'dong bar byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang de rnams la yang dang yang du chos 'chad par mdzad do/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gi kun du spyod pa ni shākya'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bcom ldan 'das la blta ①ba'i phyir dus gsum du 'gro bar byed do/ /ji ༷tsam na 0dus gzhan zhig na bcom ldan 'das 'khor brgya phrag du ma'i gung la bzhugs nas sbrang ma'i sbrang 0rtsi dngas ⑦ma lta bu'i chos bshad pa na ⑧'khor brgya phrag du ma ⑨dbang po rnams mi g.yo bas bcom ldan 'das las sngo)snyan pa snyan (sprepa'i chos nyan par byed do/ /rgyal po zas gtsang yang chos mnyan pa'i phyir rgyal po'i 'byor pa chen po dang / rgyal po'i mthu chen pos shākya'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ste/ des chos mnyan nas song ngo / /de nas shākya ming chen gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas chos mnyan te dad pa skyes nas rang gi khyim du song ste smras pa/ kye ma'o sangs rgyas/ kye ma'o chos/ kye ma'o dge 'dun/ sangs rgyas byung ba ni bdag 'bras bu dang bcas pa yin no/ /ming chen gyi chung ma dam pas smras pa/rje'i sras de ci lags/ des smras pa/ deng bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor brgya phrag du ma'i mdun du 'di 'dra ba'i chos bshad pa mdzad de/ de thos pas srog chags brgya stong phrag du mas khyad par chen po rtogs so/ /des smras pa/rje'i sras sangs rgyas byung ba ni bdag 'bras bu dang bcas pa yin no zhes gsungs pa gang lags pa de mad 8de/ sangs rgyas byung ba ni khyed cag kho na la 'bras bu dang bcas pa tshulags kyi ④bdag cag la ni ma lags so/ /ci'i phyir 3—537

'di ltar bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung ba ni skyes pa rnams kyi phyir lags kyi ①bud med rnams kyi phyir ni ma lags so/ /des smras pa/ bzang ②mo de skad ma smra shig /bcom ldan 'das ni sems can thams cad la phan pa dang /thugs brtse ba yin gyis ①song shig dang / khyod kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi rjospyan snga nas chos thos par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ lha shākya'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bcom ldan 'das la blta ⑤ba'i phyir dus gsum 0du bzhud la/lha'i mdun du mngon sum du bdag gis chos mnyan pa g.yar tsha lags so/ /'di ltar gal te lha snga dro ⑦bzhud na bdag gis kyang slad ②dro bcom ldan 'das las 0chos mnyan par bgyi'o/ /shākya kyiming chen gyis bsams pa/ lha la gsol gyis skye'agro'o snyam pa las yang bsams 8pa/ rang gi chung ma'i ched la lha la gsol ba byed 0mi phod kyisatso/ lha ni skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo la bkur sti tsomang du byed de/ de'i tshig nyan par 'gyur bas de la don 'di rig par bya'o snyam nas/ de skye tsodagu'i bdag mo chen mo gi ta sbri ⑩gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo go ta sī tho)la don de smras pa dang /des smras pa/ bka' bzhin 'tshal4)/ lha la gsol bar () bgyi'o/ /de nas shākya ming chen khyim du song nas shākya rnams kyi chung ma rnams la smras pa dang /de nas shākya rnams kyi 0chung ma dang / gzhan dag gi chung ma rnams skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gang na ba der song ste phyin nas phyi/ skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gau ta sī 6)la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gi ta sī 6)mkhyen par mdzod cig bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das 'khor brgya phrag du ma'i mdun du snyan pa snyan pa'i chos sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi dngas byam lta bu bshad pa na 'khor brgya phrag du ma'i ⑦3—538

dbang po rnams mi g.yo bas bcom ldan 'das las snyan pa snyan pa'i chos nyan to zhes thos nas bdag cag ①kyang bcom ldan 'das las chos de thos par 'tshal gyis ②bdag cag gi phyir lha la ci nas kyang lha ni snga dro bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bzhud la/ bdag cag kyang slad dro mchi bar gsol ①cig /des smras pa/phu nu mo dag khyed ༷kyis sems bskyed pa legs te/ rgyal po zas gtsang la brtag gis 0skad cig sdod cig /de nas skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gi ta sī rjo rgyal po 0zas gtsang gang dun ba der song ste phyin nas/ rgyal po zas gtsang la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha mkhyen par mdzod cig /bdag 0gis bcom ldan 'das 'khor brgya phrag du ma'i gung la bzhugs nas snyan pa snyan pa'i chos sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi dngas ma () lta bu bshad pa na 'khor brgya phrag du ma dbang po rnams mi g.yo bas bcom ldan 'das las 7snyan pa snyan pa'i chos nyan to ⑩zhes thos so0/ /shākya'i mchis 'brang ④rnams kyis kyang de skad thos nas de rnams chos nyan par 'tshal na lha ni snga dro bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar gshegs pa'i rigs so/ /bdag gis kyang shākya'i mchis 'brang 8rnams ded de bcom ldan 'das kyi 8spyan sngar slad dro mchi bar bgyi'o/ /de ci'i phyir ⑩zhe na/ snga dro ni de rnams bsdum 8pa'i bgyi ba dag bgyid pas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar mchi ba'i skabs ma mchis so/ /rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i kun du spyod pa ni gang gi tshe skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gi ta sbos ⑩tshig smras pa de'i tshe/ lus kyi ba du spu zing zhes byed nas langs te/ re zhig skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo'i tshig gi lan ma byin pa de'i bar du mi 'dug pa yin pas des mgo bos btud de 67smras pa/gau ta sbo (nyebaka' bzhin 'tshal/ de nas skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gi ta sī phya3—539

shākya'i chung ma lnga brgyas yongs su bskor te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos mnyan pa'i phyir n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra bar song ngo / /ji tsam na shākya ①ming chen gyi chung ma yang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas de dang ②lhan cig song ste / gzugs dang lang tsho ③dang ldan zhing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pas 'dod chags dang ma bral ba dag chags pa skye bar zhugs pa de tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos mthong nas smras pa/ sring mo re zhig khyod kyi durang bzhin gyi gzugs nyid kyang bzang mo blta phyin sdug pa mdzes pa yin na 0rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod rgyan gyis brgyan pa ⑦'dir 'ongs pa ⑧gang yin pa de ni ma legs pa zhig byas te/ bdag nyid chen po 'di dag ni thams cad 'dod chags dang bral ba kho na yang ma ⑨yin no zhes de la de skad ⑩smras pa dang / ngo tsha ba snying la phog pas spyi bo smad nas mtha' gcig tu song ste/rgyan rnams bkrol nas sems khong du 0chud cing 'dug pa las/ de'i 'amangag gzhug ma bu mo bskyed ma zhes bya ba dang / de lhan cig chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'ongs pas des de la bos te smras pa/ bskyed ma song la rgyan 'di dag khyim du zhog tshul shog shig /de rings par song nas des khyim du bzhag ste slar 'ongs so//de nas skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gi ta sī 8'khor lnga brgya dang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang chos bshad pa byamadzad do/ /chos bshad pa de ⑩mdzad pa de'i tshe ji tsam na shākya'i bu mo zhig mgul pa na mu tig gi do shal btags pa la myur ba myur bar lta zhing lag pas nom par byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mi rtag pa dang ldan pa'i chos bshad par brtsams so/ /'on kyang de 0chos 3—540

la mi gtod kyi ①yu tig gi do shal kho na la rtog ②par byed do/ /ming chen gyi ③chung ma dam pas shākya'i bu mo mgul pa na mu tig gi do shal btags pa la 0myur ba myur bar rtog par byed pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/nyon mongs 'di 'du byed rnams 'di ltar mi rtag par bshad na mu tig gi do shal 'di la lhag par chags te myur ba myur bar brtag ①tu ci yod/ gal te bdag gi mu tig gi phreng ba mthong na 'di'i rgyags pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro snyam du bsams nas mngag gzhug ma'i bu mo bskyed ma la smras pa/ bskyed ma song la kho mo'i mu tig gi do shal myur du khyer te shog shig /de chos nyan pa de dul sems bsdus pas de 'di snyam du sems te/ kyi ⑦tud 'di 'dra ba'i chos 'chad na bdag jo ⑧mes mngags pas chos kyi bar chad byung bar gyur te/mdor ⑨na bran gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa ni re sdug snyam du bsams nas sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde bas gdungs pas tshigs su bcad pas smras pa/ gang yang sdig pas de ring rgyal zhal blta ba dang / /bde gshegs zhal nas dri med chos mnyan mi 'thob ⑩pa/ /bran dngos gzhan hudabang sdug bsngal mang po tha chad de/ /bdag gi 'tsho tho)ba sngon byas las kyis thob pa ngan4)/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ bu mo bskyed ma 'di ni sngon 4)gyi sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par bya ba byas pa yin med kyi0/ tshe chung ⑩zhig yod pas 'di 'khor ba'i btson tshur nas dbyung bar bya'o snyam du dgongs nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyis gro ga tsol/ dge ma skye ba byung na ⑩ni/ /'jig ⑥pa yin par bsams nas su/ /ngas gsungs pa yi dge ba la/ /brtson 'grus bskyed nas mnyan par bya/ /zhes bris nas byin no/ /de nas bu mo bskyed ma dga' ba 3—641

dang / mgu ba dang / rangs pa ①dang / yid bde ba skyes nas tshigs su bcad pa ②smras bzhin sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i sems kho nas song ba dang /las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang ①tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /ces bya ba yin pas tshe chung ④zhig yod pa'i las tshogs pa rnyed pa rjode ba drus ma zhig gis bsad do/ /de sangs rgyas la sems mngon par dad par byas te shi bas sing ga la'i gling du sing ga la'i rgyal po'i btsun mo dam pa'i mngal du skyes par gyur te/gang gi nyi ma la nying mtshams sbyar dub de kho na'i nyin par mu tig gi char pa ⑦bab bo/ /rgyal pos ltas dumakhan rnams bkug ste smras pa dang / de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha 'di ni sems can zhig btsun mo'i lhums su zhugs pa ⑨de'i mthu lags so/ /ji 0tsam na mngal gyi smin par bya ba'i phyir de ⑩sgra yid du mi 'ong ba cung zad kyang mi grag yonyecing grang ba na grang ba'i yo byad dang / dro ba na dro ba'i yo byad dang / sman pas bstan pa'i kha zas ha cang kha ba ma yin pa dang / ha cang skyur ba ma yin pa dang / ha cang lan tshwa can ma yin pa dang /ha cang mngar ba ma yin pa dang / ha cang rtsub pa ma yin pa dang / ha cang bska ba ma yin pa dang / kha ba dang 4)/ skyur ba dang / lan tshwa dang /mngar ba dang / rtsub pa dang / bska ba rnams spangs pa'i kha zas kyis (srebasnyen bkur byed cing do shal dang se mo dos lus brgyan nas lha'i bu mo dga' tshal na rgyu ba bzhin du khri nas khri dang 4)/ khri'u nas khri'ur 'gro zhing 'og gi sa la 'babs (9par mi byed do/ /de zla ba brgyad dam dgu 'das nas bu mo gzugs bzang ba mdzes pa blta 0na sdug pa zhig btsas te/ gang gi nyi ma la 3—542

btsas pa de nyid kyi nyin par yang mu tig gi ⑨char bab ②nas rgyal pos bsams pa / 'di dultar bu mo'i mthus mu tig gi char 'bab 0pa ni de nyid kyi mu tig tu 'gyur ro zhes des de nyid la byin no/ /de nas nyi ma bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa ⑤gcig tu de'i dubatsas ston rgya cher byas nas bu mo'i ming cir gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed do/ /blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ gang gi phyir 'di'i mthus mu tig gi char bab pas de bas na bu mo 'di'i ⑦ming mu tig can zhes gdags so zhes de'i ming mu tig can zhes bya bar btags te/ bu mo mu tig can ma ma brgyad la gtad de/ pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'phyi ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtsen grogs ⑧kyi ma ma gnyis te/ de ma ma brgyad po dag gis 'o ⑨ma dang / zho dang /mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi snying po dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi bye brag gtso bo gtso bo dag gis sring bar byed skyed par byed cing rdzing na gnas pa'i pad ma bzhin myur du skyed par byed do/ /de gang gi tshe chen mor gyur pa de'i 0tshe rang gi rigs dang mthun pa'i spyod pa dang / gnas pas rgyal po nang mi thormedang bcas pas lhag par bkur sti 4)byed do/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na mnyan yod kyi tshong pa rnams kyis nor bsgrub 4)pa'i phyir rgya mtsho'i gru bo che bsgrubs te/ rgya mtsho chen por zhugs pa dang de rnams gru bo che phan phun med par rlung gi 0shugs kyis (nyesing ga la'i gling du phyin to/ /de nas snod rnams mkhos su phab ⑩ste/ rgyal po'i pho brang dang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig tu 'brang rkyibatab bo/ /de rnams kyis mtshan mo'i thun tha ma la ched du brjod pa dang /pha rol 'gro byed dang / bden pa mthong ba dang / gnas brtan gyi 8tshigs 3—543

su bcad pa dang / gnas brtan ma'i tshigs su bcad pa dang / ri gnas kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang / thub pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang /① don gyi tshoms kyi mdo sde rnams rgyas par 'don pa la zhugs pa mu tig can khyim gyi nang na 'dug pas skar khung nas thos nas/ de nas ②des rgyal po la smras pa/ lha yul dbus kyi ①tshong pa rnams dumachis nas mchid snyan ⑤par len to/ /rgyal pos blon po dag la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag glu mkhan rnams khug shig /de rnams bkug 0pa dang mu tig can gyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag yul dbus kyi rol mo ci 'dra ba kho mos mnyan gyis long lashig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha mo bdag cag ni rol mo mkhan ma lags te/ bdag cag ni mnyan yod kyi ⑧tshong pa rlung gi shugs kyis 'dir mchis pa lags te/ bdag cag gis mtshan mo'i thun ⑨tha ma la sangs rgyas kyi gsung bton to/ /mu tig can gyis sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i sgra sngon ma thos pa de ⑩thos nas snying dga' bas ba spu thams cad zing zhes byed de/ de ngo mtshar skyes nas dris pa/ sangs rgyas zhes bya ba 'di ci yin/ de rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i bdag nyid rgyas par ⑩smra bar brtsams te/ lha mo shākya rnams kyi gzhon nu gangs ri'i ngos dang nye ba/ chu bo skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram drang srong ser skya'i bste gnas dang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig tu byung ste/ de bram ze mtshan mkhan rnams dang / ltas mkhan rnams kyis gal te khyim pa khyim na gnas par gyur na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po mtha' bzhir rnam par rgyal ba/ chos kyi rgyal po chos dang ldan pa/ rin po che sna bdun dang ldan par 'gyur 8te/ de'i rin po che sna bdun 'di lta bu dag 'byung bar 'gyur ba 'di lta ste/ 'khor lo rin po che yidang / glang po rin po 3—544

che dang / rta rin po che dang / nor bu rin po che dang / bud med rin po che dang / khyim bdag rin po che dang / bdun pa blon po rin po che'o/ /de la bu dpa' ba①/ rtul phod pa/ yan lag mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pa/pha rol gyi sde rab tu 'joms pa stong yang tshang bar 'gyur zhing / de rgya mtsho la thug ②pa'i sa chen po ma lus pa gnod par sdo ②ba med cing 'tshe ba med pa 'di nyid chad pa med cing mtshon 0gyis bda' dub med la/ chos dang mthun zhing snyoms pas legs par phab ste gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gal te skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung bar gyur na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs 0pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya ba ⑦'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan te/ de lta bu de duni sangs rgyas zhes bgyi ba lags so//mu tig can gyis smras pa/ gang gi tshe khyed cag yul du 'dong ba de'i tshe kho mo la sgron cig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha mo bka' bzhin 'tshal/ sbran par bgyi'ol/ /ji tsam na de rnams yul du 'dong ba'i dus la bab nas de rnams kyis mu tig can la sbran pa dang / des bcom ldan 'das la yi ge gsol pa/lha dang lha min mi yis phyag bgyis pa/ /skye dang snyun dang bsnyengs las nges byung zhing / /gtso bo grags pa rgya chen ⑨rab grags pa/ /drang srong bdud rtsi'i cha las thugs rjes gnong / /zhes gsol to/ /de nas yi ge de tshong pa de rnams kyis 0khyer nas rim gyis yimanyan yod du phyin pa dang / lam gyis dub pa ngal sos nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /3—645

phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas mnyan yod kyi tshong pa rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa sing ga la'i gling na sing ga la'i rgyal po'i bu mo des mchid yi ge gsol ba 'di lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis mu tig can gyi ①'dul ba'i dus mkhyen nas nyid kyis blangs te bklags so/ /bklags rgyanas bka' stsal pa/ gang gi tshe khyed cag slar 'dong bar gyur pa de'i tshe nga'i snyan du gsol cig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes ①tshong pa rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi duzhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te dong ngo //de nas zong bsgyur te bsgyur ba'i zong thogs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ste gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag mchi na bdag cag gis mu tig can la ji skad bgyi bka' stsal par gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shin tu legs par byi dor byas pa'i ras dang ri mo mkhan dag khug shig /de rnams kyis ras dang ri mo mkhan dag bkug nas phul ba dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ras la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i gzugs brnyan bris shig /ri mo mkhan rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gzugs brnyan dubri bar brtsams pa las de bzhin gshegs pa ni bsod nams brgya phrag du mas bsgrubs pa yin pas ri mo mkhan rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi ༷sku'i gzugs brnyan bri bar ma nus nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ras ston cig dang 'od gtang ngo / /de rnams kyis ras bstan ⑦pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'od btang ba la ③ri mo mkhan rnams kyis tshon rtsi sna tshogs kyis rgyas par byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sku'i gzugs brnyan gyi 'og tu gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi ⑨lnga rnams dang /3—546

rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i yan lag bcu gnyis po lugs dang mthun pa dang / lugs dang mi mthun pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa bris so/ /gong du ni tshigs ①su bcad pa gnyis po②/ brtsam par bya zhing 'byung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya/ /gang zhig rab tu bag yod pas/ /chos 'dul 'di la spyod 'gyur ba/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas / /sdug bsngal tha mar byed par 'gyur③/ /zhes bris nas sing ga la'i rgyal po la bka' ༷yig spring parjo/ ras la ri mor dubris pa ngas ⑦yu tig can la skyes su bskur ⑧ba yin gyis0/ khyod kyis de la byas phyogs yangs shing rgya che bar sing ga la'i gling na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs bsdus la/ bkur ste 7chen pos ras 'di khrom 0shig /tshong pa de rnams la bka' stsal pa/ gal te mu tig can 'di ci yin zhes 'dri na/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das de'i sku'i gzugs brnyan yin no zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gal te 'og ma 'di ci yin zhes 'dri na de tsodag ni ④gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi lnga rnams dang /lugs dang mthun pa dang lugs dang mi mthun pa'i rten cing 'brel par 'byung bar (nye'agro bar 'jug pa dang ldog pa'o/ /'di ni bdud rtsi rtogs pa'i 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yin no zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gal te gong ma 'di ci yin zhes 'dri na spro bar bya ba yin te/ gang zhig skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi rnams blangs te/ lugs dang mthun pa dang lugs dang mi mthun pa'i rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba 'di la rtog cing brtson 'grus rtsom ⑫pa de bdud rtsi rtogs pa'i 'phags pa'i lam thob nas sdug bsngal thams cad 3—547

las grol bar 'gyur ba yin no zhes brjod par bya'o/ /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshong pa de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das las ①mnyan nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ②spyan snga nas song ②ngo / /de nas dge mtshan dang / bkra shis dang /bde legs su 'gyur ba rjodag byas te/ zong khyer nas sing ga la'i gling du song ste/ rim gyis sing ga la'i gling du phyin nas lam gyis rjodub pa ngal sos te/rgyal po'i drung du song nas rkang pa gnyis la gtugs 0te yi ge byin no/ /rgyal pos yi ge bklags te bklags ⑦nas grong khyer de rdo ba dang / gseg ma dang /gyo mo bsal nas tsan dan gyi ②chus chag chag btabal/ rgyal mtshan dang ba dan bsgreng / dar gyi 0chun 'phyang 0mang po btags/ shin byatu dri zhim po'i pog por 0nye bar bzhag /me tog sna tshogs bkram ste/ sing ga la'i gling na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs bsogs tsonas/ de nas bkur ste 8chen po byas te grong khyer gyi dbus su rin po che sna bzhi tsolas byas pa'i seng ge'i khri bshams te/ras phye ba dang skye bo'i tshogs chen pos sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas la ⑩phyag 'tshal lo zhes gsang bstod de ⑩smras so/ /de nas rgyal po'i bu mo mu tig can dad pa drag pos gtad pa'i snying gis yib spu zing zhes byed cing mig mchi mas gang bas zhabs gnyis la gtugs te tshong pa rnams la dris pa/ shes ldan dag 'di ci yin/ de rnams kyis smra bar brtsams pa/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das de'i sku'i gzugs brnyan lags so/ /'og ma 'di dag ci yin/'di ni gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi lnga rnams dang / lugs dang mthun pa dang lugs dang mi mthun pa'i rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba du'agro bar 'jug pa dang ldog pa'o/ /'di ni bdud 0rtsi rtogs pa'i du'aphags pa'i 3—648

lam yan lag brgyad pa lags so/ /gong ma 'di ci yin/ spro bar bgyi ba lags te/ gang zhig skyabs su song nas bslab pa'i gzhi rnams blangs te lugs dang mthun pa dang lugs dang mi mthun pa'i rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yan lag bcu gnyis pa ①'di la rtog cing brtson 'grus rtsom ②pa de bdud rtsi rtogs pa'i lam thob nas sdug bsngal thams cad las grol bar 'gyur ba ③lags so/ /de nas mu tig can gyis rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yan lag bcu gnyis pa ①lugs dang mthun pa dang lugs dang mi mthun pa bsam par brtsams te/ ji srid lan gsum du ⑤ma bzlas dupa de'i bar du des 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ des bden pa mthong nas tshigs su bcad pas smras pa/ring na bzhugs ⑦pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /shes rab mig ni rnam sbyangs pas/ /gang la 'di 'dra'i gsos ⑧mnga' ba/ /sman mkhas ⑨de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ring na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /lta ba'i ri bo drungs phyung ⑩ste/ /lta ba'i zung 0rngu sel mdzad pa/ /sman mkhas 8de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pas ⑩smras nas tshong pa rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /shes ldan dag khyed cag nam 'dong ba de'i tshe kho mo la sgron cigatso /de nas tshong pa rnams kyis zong rnams bsgyur te bsgyur ba'i zong rnams khyer nas mu tig can gyi drung du song ste/ lha mo bdag cag tsomachi na bdag cag 0gis ci zhig bgyi bar ⑫bka' stsal par gsol/ des smras pa/ kho mo'i tshig 8gis bcom ldan 'das kyi ()zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshol la sbyo ) gnod pa chung ngam/ku nye nyam nga ba nyung ngam/ 'tsho'am/ bskyod dupa yang ngam/ stobs dang bde ba 3—549

dang / sku nyams ①dang ldan nam ②reg par gnas sam zhes zhus la 'di skad ces/btsun pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis ①bgyi ba gang lags pa de bcom ldan 'das kyis mdzad de/ bdag gis dge ba'i bshes tshuganyen bcom ldan 'das la ⑤brten nas sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas rnams las ni rkang pa phyung du/ lha dang mi rnams su ni bzhag /'khor ba las ni rgyang ⑦bsrings/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams/ rus pa'i ri bo las ni bsgral / ngan song gi sgo ni bskumadu/ mtho ris ⑨thar pa'i sgo ni phye/ thog ma ma mchis pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi 0rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum ⑪du bgyis te/ btsun pa bdag ni 'phags so/ /mngon par 'phags so/ /bdag bcom ldan 'das dang chos dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi yis(nye / dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ deng slan chad ji srid 'tsho ba'i ⑫bar du srog dang yang bsdos de 8skyabs su mchi bar tsomangon par dad lags so/ /zhes gsol la/ mu tig bre gsum po 'di khyer la 'cha gcig ni sangs rgyas la/cha gcig ni chos la/ cha gcig ni dge 'dun la phul 0cig /de nas tshong pa de rnams kyis zong dang skyes bskur tsob yang khyer te yidong nas rim gyis mnyan yod du phyin pa dang / lam gyis dub pa ngal sos dunas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste zhabs gnyis la gtugs nyenas ji skad spring ba bzhin bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas 'di skad ces kyang gsol to/ /btsun pa skyes su phul ba'i mu tig (nyebre gsum po 'di lags te/ mu tig cha gcig ni sangs rgyas la/cha gcig ni chos la/ cha gcig ni dge 'dun la phul lags so/ /tshe dang 3—550

ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa skyes 'di gang nas mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis shākya ming chen gyi ①mngag gzhug ma bskyed ma zhes bya ba nga las chos mnyan nas song ba las/ lam kur ②ba drus mas bsad pa ③mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /des nga la sems dang ba bskyed de shi bas sing ga la'i rgyal po'i bu mo mu tig can zhes rgya bar gyur te/ bden pa mthong nas des skyes bskur ba 'di yin no/ /'di las sangs rgyas kyi skal ba rjogang yin pa des dri gtsang khang gi zhal zhal byos shig /chos kyi dugang yin pa de ni chos 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams la'o/ /dge 'dun gyi gang yin pa de ni dge 'dun gyis mnyam par bgos dushig /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa mu tig can gyis las ci zhig bgyis na des ⑦na bran mor ⑧gyur lags/ las ci zhig bgyis na des ⑨rgyal po phyug po'i rigs su skyes shing bden pa mthong bar bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mu tig can 'di nyid kyis las tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ⑩ba/ 'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa gdon mi za (nyebar 'byung bar 8'gyur ba'i las dag byas shing bsags pas mu tig can 'di nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis so sor myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/ rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur gyi/ 'di ltar las dge ba dang mi dge ba dag byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams 3—551

dang / skye mched rnams la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/ las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang ①tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na 'jig rten du ston pa rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i ②kha lo sgyur ③ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung nas/ des sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag mdzad nas bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin du bā rā ṇa sīr phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang / rgyal po kṛ khris de'i sku dri zhim po'i shing thams cad kyis spungs te/ spungs nas bkur ste ①chen pos bsregs te me de 'o mas bsad nas sku gdung de rnams gser gyi bum par blugs te / lam po che'i bzhi dumador rin po che sna bzhi las byung ba'i mchod rten kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad gcig yod la/ 'phang du dpag tshad phyed pa zhig brtsigs nas dus mchod chen po btsugs so/ /bā rā ṇa sī na tshong dpon phyug pa kyanor mang ba/ longs spyod che ba/ yongs su gzung ⑦ba yangs shing rgya che ba/rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu la nor gyis 'gran pa zhig yod pa des/ rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs te/ de ⑧de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed de/ de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed kyang de la bu pho yang med bu mo yang med nas/ de lag pa 'gram pa la gtad ⑨nas bdag gi 3—552

khyim du nor phal po che bsags kyang bdag la bu pho yang med bu mo yang med pas bdag shi nas bdog pa thams cad bu med do zhes byas te rgyal pos dbang byas ①par 'gyur ro snyam nas sems khong du ②chud cing 'dug pa de la dge sbyong dudang bram ze dang / grogs po dang mdza' bshes dang / nye du dang / ltas ④mkhan rnams kyis smras pa/ lha mnyes par byos shig dang khyod la bu yod par 'gyur ro/ /de bu med de bu mngon par 'dod pas zhi ba dang / chu lha dang /lus ngan ⑤dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa gzhan yang lha khyad par can rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di lta ste/ kun dga' ra ba'i lha dang /nags tshal gyi lha dang / bzhi mdo'i lha dang / sum mdo'i lha dang / gtor ma len pa'i lha dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i lha dang / chos mthun pa pa rjodang /rtag tu rjes su 'brang ba'i lha la yang gsol ba 'debs so/ /'di ltar gsol ba 'debs pa'i rgyus bu pho dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur ro zhes 'jig rten na de skad du grags pa yod de/ de yang de lta ma yin te/ gal te de ltar 'gyur na ni re re ⑦yang dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po bzhin du bu stong yod par 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang gnas gsum mngon du gyur pa las bu pho dang bu mo skye bar ⑧'gyur te/gnas gsum gang zhe na pha dang ma gnyis chags par gyur cing lhan cig 'dus pa dang / ma mngal rung bar gyur cing zla mtshan ⑨dang ldan pa dang / dri za nye bar gnas par gyur pa ste/ gnas de gsum mngon du gyur pa las bu pho dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur ba yin na des bu yod pa'i las ma byas pas des na de la bu pho dang bu mo med do/ /ji 4)tsam na de nad kyis thebs nas de rtsa ba (spredang /sdong bu dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu'i sman rnams kyis ⑫3—553

bsnyen bkur byas kyang de'i nad zhi bar ma gyur to/ /de nas de'i chung mas bsams pa/ bdag gi khyim na nor phal mo ①che bsags pa ni bdag la bu pho yang med bu mo yang med la/ bdag gi khyim thab 'di ni 'chi bar 'gyur gyisal/da ni gal te 'jig rten pha rol gyi lam rgyags ma blangs na nor zas 'di thams cad bdag la bu med do zhes byas nas rgyal pos dbang byas ①par 'gyur ro snyam nasaX / de'i mu tig gi do shal brgya stong ri ba mgul na thogs pa des yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi mchod rten de la dri dang byug pas byugs nas mchod pa byas te btags nas dad pa drag pos drung du gtugs te smon lam btab pa/ sbyin pa'i chos yongs su btang ba dang sems bskyed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag phyug po'i rigs su skyes shing duyon tan 'di lta bu yang thob cing ston pa 'di lta bu mnyes par byed kyi/ mi mnyes par ma gyur cig ces byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi tshong dpon gyi chung ma gang yin pa de ni mu tig can 'di nyid yin te/ 'dis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi mchod rten la bya ba byas nas/smon lam btab pa gang yin pa de'i dulas kyi rnam par smin pas phyug po'i rigs su skyes shing btsas ⑦pa na mu tig gi char bab bo/ /nga'i bstan ⑧pa la yang dad pa bskyed ⑨pas 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas so/ /gzhan yang tshong dpon nor mang du bsags pa de'i chung mar gyur pa na de na 'dis dbang phyug gi grags ⑩pas rgyags nas spyod yul yin gnas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad la tshig tu bran mo'i bu zhes 4)smras pas(nye/ de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas tshe 3—654

rabs mang por bran mor gyur to/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag ①pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag ②pa yin zhing /gcig tu dkar ⑧ba rnams kyi ni gcig tu dkar dul/ 'dren ma rnams kyi ni 'dren ma yin no/ /de bas na dge slong dag gcig tu gnag 0pa'i las rnams dang / 'dren ma rnams ni spangs la/ gcig tu dkar ba'i las kho na tshul brtsal bar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis de lta bu la bslab par bya'o//bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi cha gang ⑦yin pa de ni chos smra ba'i gang zag rnams kyi ⑧yin no zhes gsungs pa dang / de nas ⑨mdo sde 'dzin pa rnams kyis smras pa/ kho bo cag ni bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo sde mtha' dag 'dzin pas/kho bo cag chos 'dzin pa yin pas rnyed pa 'di ni kho bo cag dbang ngo / /'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyis smras pa/ kho bo cag ni bcom ldan 'das kyi nang gi mdzod srung zhing kho bo cag 'dul ba mtha' dag 'dzin pas/ kho bo cag chos 'dzin pa yin pas rnyed pa 'di ni kho bo cag dbang ngo / /ma mo 'dzin pa rnams kyis smras pa/ kho bo cag ni mdo sde dang 'dul ba'i rang gi mtshan nyid dang spyi'i mtshan nyid 'dzin pas/ kho bo cag chos 'dzin pa yin pas rnyed pa 'di ni kho bo cag dbang ngo zhes de na mdo sde 'dzin pa dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang /ma mo 'dzin pa rnams 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang / 'thab mo dang /'gyed pa byung bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ma 'thab shig /mtshang ⑩ma 'dru zhig⑩ /'thab mo ma byed cig /ma 'gyed cig /dge slong dag bzhi po 'di dag ni rtsod pa yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'gyed pa'i rtsod pa dang / gdams (sme3—555

ngag med pa'i rtsod pa dang / ltung ba'i rtsod pa dang / bya ba'i rtsod pa'o①/ /'gyed pa'i rtsod pa gang zhe na/ dge 'dun sna tshogs su smra ba/ 'gal bar smra ba / rigs mi 'phrod ②par smra ba/ mi mthun pa kun tu mi dga' ba/ rgyud gcig tu ma gyur pa gang yin pa de las ③brten te 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'bru ba dang / 'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa gang yin pa 'di ni 'gyed pa'i rtsod pa zhes bya'o/ /gdams dungag med pa'i rtsod pa gang zhe na/ dge 'dun gyi gdams ⑤ngag mi len pa dang / gdams ngag mi sbyin pa dang / gdams ngag gzhag pa gang yin pa de las dubarten nas 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang / 'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa gang yin pa 'di ni gdams ngag med pa'i rtsod pa zhes bya'o/ /ltung ba'i rtsod pa gang zhe na/ ltung ba lnga ni ltung ba'i phung po lnga zhes bya ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ phas pham pa dang / dge 'dun lhag ma dang / ltung byed dang / so sor bshags ⑦par bya ba dang / nyes byas gang yin pa de las ⑧brten nas 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru ba ⑨dang /'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa gang yin pa 'di ni ltung ba'i rtsod pa zhes bya'o/ /bya ba'i rtsod pa gang zhe na/ dge 'dun gyi bya ba gsol ba dang / gsol ba dang gnyis dang / gsol ba dang bzhi'i las gang yin pa de las brten 4) nas 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang / 'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa gang yin pa 'di yini bya ba'i rtsod pa zhes bya'o/ /dge slong dag 'gyed pa'i rtsod ⑫pa ni ci zhig gi rtsa ba can yin zhing 'gyed pa'i rtsod pa'i rtsa ba ni ci yin zhe na / 'gyed pa'i rtsa ba drug dang / 'gyed par byed pa'i gzhi tho)bcu bzhi ste/'gyed pa'i rtsa ba drug gang zhe na/ 'di ltar 'di na tshul la khro ba yin zhing khon ⑫3—556

du 'dzin pa yin te khro zhing khon ①du 'dzin pa gang yin pa de ni ston pa la bkur ste ②mi byed/ bla mar mi byed/ ri mor mi byed/ mchod par mi byed do/ /ston pa la bkur ste ①ma byas/ bla mar ma byas/ ri mor ma byas/ mchod par ma byas pas chos mi mthong ngo / /chos ma mthong bas dge sbyong gi tshul la mi lta'o④/ /dge sbyong gi tshul la mi lta na dge 'dun la 'di lta bu'i 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang / 'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa 'byin par byed do/ /'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru ⑤ba dang / 'thab mo dang /'gyed pa gang yin pa de ni skye bo mang po la phan pa ma yin pa dang / skye bo mang po la gnod pa dang / skye bo mang po yisdug bsngal ba dang / lha dang mi rnams la mi phan pa dang / gnod pa dang / sdug bsngal bar byed pa yin no/ /dge slong dag gal te khyed ⑦kyis 'gyed pa'i rtsa ba de lta bu nang gi'am phyi rol gyi yang rung ma spangs par yang dag par mthong na/ de la khyed cag lhan cig mthun zhing kun du dga' ba dang / 'gyed pa med pas 'dun pa drag po dang /brtson 'grus dang / 'bad pa dang / spro ba dang / sgrim ⑧pa dang / mi bzlog ⑨pa'i dran pa dang / shes bzhin gyis ji tsam 'gyed pa'i rtsa ba byung ba de nyid spangs kyi bar du brtson par bya'o/ /de ltar na khyed kyis 'gyed pa'i rtsa ba de yang spongs par 0'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag gal te khyed kyis 'gyed pa'i rtsa ba de lta bu nang gi yang rung / phyi'i yang rung legs par spangs par yang dag par mthong na/ de la khyed cag lhan cig mthun zhing kun du dga' ba dang /'gyed pa med pas 'dun (nyepa drag po dang / brtson 8'grus dang / 'bad pa dang / spro ba dang / sgrim tho)pa dang / mi bzlog tu)pa'i dran phonyepa dang /3—557

shes bzhin gyis ji nas kyang ①rtsod pa'i rtsa ba spangs pa de nyid phyis kyang ②mi 'byung bar brtson par bya ste/ de ltar na khyed kyis 'gyed ②pa'i rtsa ba de dag rjoyang dag par legs par bsal rjobs phyis skye bar mi 'gyur ro// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po bdun bcu dubargyad pa/ khro zhing khon du 'dzin pa ji lta ⑦ba bzhin du 'chab cing 'tshig pa dang / phrag dog byed cing ser sna can dang / g.yo byed cing sgyu ⑧can dang / ngo tsha med cing khrel med pa yang de dang 'dra'o⑨/ /gzhan yang 'di na la la rang gi lta ba mchog tu 'dzin pa yin zhing 'chal pa 0'dzin pa dang / smras pa la dngan then byed pa yin te/rang gi lta ba mchog tu 'dzin pa/ 'chal (nyepa 'dzin pa/ smras pa la dngan then 0byed pa gang yin pa de ni ston pa la bkur sti tsomi byed/ bla mar mi byed/ri mor mi byed/ mchod par mi byed do/ /de ston pa la bkur ste (stem byas/bla mar ma byas/ ri mor ma byas/ mchod par ma byas pas 8chos mi mthong ngo //chos ma ⑩mthong bas dge sbyong gi tshul la mi lta'o/ /dge sbyong gi tshul la mi lta na dge 'dun la de lta bu'i 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru yib dang / 'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa dag tso'abyin par 'gyur ro4)/ /'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru 0ba dang / 'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa gang yin pa de ⑥ni skye bo mang po la phan pa ma yin pa dang / skye bo mang po la gnod pa dang / skye bo mang po la sdug bsngal ba dang / lha dang mi rnams la mi phan pa dang / gnod pa dang /sdug bsngal bar byed pa yin no/ /dge slong dag gal te khyed kyis 'gyed pa'i rtsa ba de lta bu nang gi yang rung phyi'i yang rung ma spangs par yang dag par mthong na/de la khyed cag lhan cig mthun zhing kun du dga' ba dang / 'gyed pa med pas 3—558

'dun pa drag po dang / brtson 'grus dang / 'bad pa dang / spro ba dang /sgrim ①pa dang / mi bzlog ②pa'i dran pa dang / shes bzhin gyis ji tsam ③'gyed pa'i rtsa ba byung ba de nyid spongs pa'i dubar rdu brtson par bya ste/ de ltar na khyed 0kyis 'gyed pa'i rtsa ba de spongs par du'agyur ro/ /dge slong dag gal te khyed kyis 'gyed pa'i rtsa ba de lta bu nang gi yang rung / phyi'i yang rung /legs par spangs par yang dag par mthong na/ de la khyed cag lhan cig mthun zhing kun du dga' ba dang 'gyed pa med pas 'dun pa drag po dang /brtson 'grus dang / 'bad pa dang / spro ba dang / sgrim ⑦pa dang / mi bzlog ⑧pa'i dran pa dang / shes bzhin gyis 0ci nas kyang 'gyed pa'i rtsa ba spangs pa de nyid phyis kyang mi 'byung bar brtson par bya ste/ de ltar na khyed kyis 'gyed pa'i rtsa ba de yang dag par legs par bsal 0bas/ phyis skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'di dag ni 'gyed pa'i rtsa ba drug ces bya'o//'gyed par byed pa'i gzhi ⑩bcu bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos so zhe'am/ chos ma yin no zhe'am/ 'dul ba'o zhe'amaX/ 'dul ba ma yin no zhe'am/ nyung ba'o zhe'am ltung ba ma yin no 0zhe'am/ rtsi ba'am/ yang ba'am/ lhag ma dang bcas pa'am/ lhag ma med pa'am/ bshags par bya ba'am/ bsdam par bya ba'am/ nyes par bshad par gtogs pa'am/legs par bshad par gtogs pa ste/ 'di dag ni 'gyed par byed 0pa'i gzhi ⑫bcu bzhi zhes bya'o/ /dge slong dag 'gyed pa'i rtsod pa ni de'i rtsa ba tsoyin zhing 'gyed pa'i rtsod pa'i 0rtsa ba ni de yin no/ /dge slong dag gdams tsongag med pa'i rtsod pa ni ci zhig gi rtsa ba can yin zhing gdams ngag med pa'i rtsod pa'i rtsa 3—559

ba ni ci yin zhe na/ dge 'dun gdams ngag mi len pa dang / gdams ngag mi sbyin pa dang / gdams ngag gzhag pa gang yin pa de la brten nas 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang / 'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa gang yin pa ste/dge slong dag gdams ngag med pa'i rtsod pa ni de'i rtsa ba can yin zhing gdams ngag med pa'i rtsod pa'i rtsa ba ni de yin no/ /dge slong dag ltung ba'i rtsod pa ni ci zhig gi rtsa ba can yin zhing lhung ba'i rtsod pa'i ①tsa ba ni ci yin zhe na/ ltung ba'i ris ②lnga ni ltung ba'i ris sridang ltung ba'i phung po zhes bya ste/ lnga gang zhe na/pas pham pa dang / dge 'dun lhag ma dang / ltung byed dang / so sor bshags par bya ba dang / nyes byas so/ /gzhan yang lus kyi lhung ba yin gyi ngag gi ma yin sems kyi ma yin pa yang yod/ ngag gi yin gyi lus kyi ma yin sems kyi ma yin pa yang yod④/ lus kyi dang dusems kyi yin gyi ngag gi ma yin pa yang yod/ lus dang ngag dang sems kyi yin pa yang yod do/ /lus kyi ltung ba yin gyi ngag gi ma yin/ sems kyi ma yin pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/dge slong khyim pa'am/ bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa ①phyir ma byung bar khyim pa'am/bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa ⑦phyir byung ngo snyam nas nyal ⑧bar byed pa na/ de gnyid log pa dang / bud med nyal ba'am/ gnyid log nas khri stan chen po'i steng du bzhag pa ste/ 'di ni lus kyi lhung ba yin gyi ngag gi ma yin sems kyi ma yin no/ /ngag gi ltung ba yin gyi 0lus kyi ma yin/ sems kyi ma yin pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dge slong 0bud med la chos tshig lnga 'chad pa las ched du ma bsams par tshig drug tu thal ba'am/ tshig drug 'chad pa na ⑩tshig bdun du 0thal ba ste/ 'di ni ngag gi ltung ba yin gyi lus kyi ma yin sems kyi ⑫3—560
