ma yin no/ /lus dang sems kyi lhung ba yin gyi ngag gi ma yin pa gang zhe na/'di lta ste dge slong gis ①ched du bsams te dud 'gro'i skye ②gnas su song ba'i srog chags srog dang phral nas 'di skad ces ji ltar bdag gis bsad pa de bzhin du srog chags srog dang dbral bar bya ste/ de ltar bsad pa ni ①legs par bsad pa yin no zhes mi smra zhing ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang / myos par 'gyur ba du'athung la 'di skad ces ji ltar bdag gis 'thungs pa de bzhin du myos par 'gyur ba btung bar bya ste/ de ltar 'thungs pa ni legs par 'thungs pa yin no zhes mi smra ba ste/ 'di ni lus dang sems kyi ltung ba yin gyi ngag gi ma yin no/ /lus dang ngag dang sems kyi lhung ba yin pa dugang zhe na/ 'di lta ste dge slong gis ched du bsams te dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba'i srog chags srog dang phral dul 'di skad ces ji ltar bdag gis bsad pa de bzhin du srog chags srog dang dbral bar bya ste/ de ltar bsad pa ni legs par bsad pa yin no ⑦zhes smra zhing ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang / myos par 'gyur ba'i chang 'thung ⑧la 'di skad ces ji ltar bdag gis 'thungs pa de bzhin du 0myos par 'gyur ba btung ⑩bar bya ste/ de ltar myos par 'gyur ba 'thungs pa ni legs par 'thungs pa yin no zhes smra ba yiste/ 'di ni lus dang ngag dang sems kyi ltung ba yin te/ dge slong dag ltung ba'i rtsod pa ni de'i rtsa ba can yin zhing nyung ba'i rtsod pa'i rtsa ba ni de yin no/ /dge slong dag bya ba'i rtsod pa ni ci zhig gi rtsa ba can yin zhing bya ba'i rtsod pa'i rtsa ba ni ci yin zhe na/ dge 'dun gyi bya ba gang yin pa gsol pa dang gsol ba dang gnyis dang / gsol ba dang bzhi'i 3—561

las gang yin pa ste/ dge slong dag bya ba'i rtsod pa ni de'i rtsa ba can yin zhing bya ba'i rtsod pa'i rtsa ba ni ①de yin no/ /dge slong dag 'gyed pa'i rtsod pa ni dge ba zhes brjod par bya/ mi dge ba zhes brjod par bya/ lung du ma bstan pa zhes brjod par bya ste/ dge ba gang zhe na/ dge 'dun don sgrub cing don sems la/ dge ba'i don sgrub cing dge ba ②sems pa'i don sna tshogs su smra ba/ 'gal bar smra ba/ rigs mi mthun par smra ba gang yin pa de las ③brten te 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'bru ba dang / 'thab mo dang /'gyed pa gang yin pa 'di ni dge ba yin do④/ /mi dge ba gang zhe na/ dge 'dun don mi sgrub cing don mi sems la/ dge ba'i don mi sgrub cing dge ba mi sems pa'i don sna tshogs su smra ba/ 'gal bar smra ba/ rigs mi 'thun par smra ba gang yin pa de las ⑤brten nas 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang /'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa gang yin pa de ni mi dge ba yin no/ /lung du ma bstan pa gang zhe na/ dge 'dun don sgrub pa yang ma yin/ don ma yin pa sgrub pa yang ma yin zhing don sems pa yang ma yin/ don ma yin pa sems pa yang ma yin la/ dge ba'i dudon sgrub pa yang ma yin/ mi dge ba'i don sgrub pa yang ma yin zhing dge ba sems pa yang ma yin/ mi dge ba sems pa yang ma yin pa'i ⑦sna tshogs su smra ba/ 'gal bar smra ba/ rigs mi mthun par smra ba gang yin pa de las ⑧brten nas 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang /'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa gang yin pa 'di ni lung du ma bstan pa yin no/ /gdams ngag med pa'i rtsod pa ni dge ba zhes brjod par bya/ mi dge ba zhes brjod par bya/ lung du ma bstan pa zhes brjod par bya ste/ dge ba gang zhe na/3—562

dge 'dun don sgrub ①cing don sems la/ dge ba'i don sgrub ②cing dge ba'i don ②sems pa'i gdams ngag mi len pa dang / gdams ngag mi sbyin pa dang / gdams ngag 'jog pa gang yin pa de las brten ༷te 'thab pa ⑤dang /mtshang 'dru ba dang / 'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa gang yin pa 'di ni dge ba yin no/ /mi dge ba gang zhe na/ dge 'dun don mi sgrub ༅cing don mi sems la/ dge ba'i don mi sgrub ⑦cing dge ba mi sems pa'i gdams dungag mi len pa dang / gdams ngag mi sbyin pa dang / gdams ngag 'jog pa gang yin pa de las ⑨brten te 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang / 'thab mo dang /'gyed pa gang yin pa 'di ni mi dge ba yin no/ /lung du ma bstan pa gang zhe na/dge 'dun don sgrub yi pa yang ma yin/ don ma yin pa sgrub ⑩pa yang ma yin zhing don sems pa yang ma yin/ 4)don ma yin pa sems pa yang ma yin la/dge ba'i don sgrub 0pa yang ma yin/ mi dge ba'i don sgrub 8pa yang ma yin zhing / dge ba sems pa yang ma 8yinas/ mi dge ba sems pa yang ma yin pa'i gdams ngag mi len pa dang / gdams ngag mi sbyin pa dang / gdams ngag 'jog pa gang yin pa de las brten nas ⑩'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang / 'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa gang yin pa 'di ni lung du ma bstan pa yin no/ /ltung ba'i rtsod pa ni mi dge ba zhes brjod par bya/ lung du ma bstan pa zhes brjod par bya ste/ mi dge ba gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyis bslab pa bcas pa dang / dge 'dun gyis khrims su bcas pa las ched du bsams te 'das pa gang yin pa 'di ni mi dge ba yin no/ /lung du ma bstan pa gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyis bslab pa bcas pa dang / dge 'dun gyis 3—563

khrims su bcas pa las ched du ma bsams par 'das pa gang yin pa 'di ni lung du ma bstan pa yin no/ /bya ba'i rtsod pa ni dge ba zhes brjod par bya/ mi dge ba zhes brjod par bya/ lung du ma bstan pa zhes brjod par bya ste/ dge ba gang zhe na/ dge 'dun don sgrub ①cing don sems la/ dge ba'i don sgrub ②cing dge ba sems pa'i gsol ba dang / gsol ba dang gnyis ③dang /gsol ba dang bzhi'i las gang yin pa de las dubarten te 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang / 'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa gang yin pa 'di ni dge ba yin no/ /mi dge ba gang zhe na/ dge 'dun don mi sgrub cing don dumi sems la / dge ba'i don mi sgrub cing dge ba mi sems pa'i gsol pa dang gsol ba dang gnyis dang / gsol pa dang bzhi'i las gang yin pa de las dubarten te 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang / 'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa gang yin pa 'di ni mi dge ba yin no/ /lung du ma bstan pa gang zhe na/ dge 'dun don sgrub 0pa yang ma yin/ don ma yin pa sgrub ⑧pa yang ma yin zhing / don sems pa yang ma yin/ don ma yin pa sems pa yang ma yin la/ dge ba'i don sgrub ⑨pa yang ma 4 )yin/ mi dge ba'i don sgrub (sprepa yang ma yin zhing dge ba sems pa yang ma yin la8/ mi dge ba sems pa yang ma yin pa'i 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang / 'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa gang yin pa 'di ni lung du ma bstan pa yin no/ /'gyed pa gang yin pa de rtsod ⑫pa lags la rtsod pa gang lags pa de 'gyed pa lags sam/ bka' stsal pa0/'gyed pa yin la rtsod pa ma yin pa yang yod/ rtsod pa yin la 'gyed pa ma yin pa yang yod/ 'gyed pa yang yin rtsod pa yang yin pa yang yod/ 'gyed ⑫3—564

pa yang ma yin rtsod pa yang ma yin pa yang ①yod do/ /re zhig 'gyed pa yin la rtsod pa ma yin pa ni/ dge 'dun sna tshogs su smra ba/ 'gal bar smra ba/rigs mi mthun par smra ba gang yin pa'o/ /rtsod pa yin la 'gyed pa ma yin pa ni rtsod pa gsum po gdams ngag med pa'i rtsod pa dang / bya ba'i rtsod pa dang /lhung ba'i rtsod pa'o/ /rtsod pa yang yin la 'gyed pa yang yin pa ni dge 'dun sna tshogs su smra ba/ 'gal bar smra ba/ rigs mi 'phrod par smra ba/ mi mthun pa kun du mi dga' ba/ rgyud gcig tu ma gyur pa gang yin pa de las ②brten te ③'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang / 'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa gang yin pa'o/ /'gyed pa yang ma yin rtsod pa yang ma yin pa ni rnam pa de dag ma gtogs pa'o/ /gdams ngag ma mchis pa gang lags pa de 0rtsod pa lags ladu/ rtsod pa gang lags pa de gdams ngag ma mchis pa lags sam/bka' stsal pa/ gdams ngag med pa yin la rtsod pa ma yin pa yang yod/rtsod pa yin la gdams ngag med pa ma yin pa yang yod/ gdams ngag med pa yang yin la rtsod pa yang 0yin pa yang yod/ gdams dag med pa yang ma yin la rtsod pa yang ⑦ma yin pa yang yod do/ /re zhig gdams ngag med pa ⑧yin la rtsod pa khyam yin pa ni dge 'dun gdams ngag mi len pa dang / gdams ngag mi sbyin pa dang / gdams ngag 'jog pa gang yin pa'o/ /rtsod pa yin la gdams ngag med pa ma yin pa ni rtsod pa gsum po 'gyed pa'i rtsod pa dang lhung ba'i rtsod pa dang / bya ba'i rtsod pa'o/ /gdams ngag med pa yang yin la rtsod pa yang yin pa ni dge 'dun gdams ngag mi len pa dang / gdams ngag mi sbyin pa dang / gdams ngag 'jog pa gang yin pa de las ⑩brten te 'thab 3—565

pa dang / mtshang 'bru ba dang / 'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa gang yin pa'o①//gdams ngag med pa yang ma yin rgyal rtsod pa yang ma yin pa ni rnam pa de dag ma gtogs pa'o/ /ltung ba gang lags pa de rtsod pa lags la/ rtsod pa gang lags pa de lhung ba lags sam/ bka' stsal pa/ ltung ba yin la rtsod pa ma yin pa yang yod/ rtsod pa yin dul ltung ba ma yin pa yang yod/ lhung ba yang yin la 0rtsod pa yang yin pa yang ⑤yod/ ltung ba yang ma yin la ①rtsod pa yang ma yin pa yang yod do/ /re zhig ltung ba yin la rtsod pa ma yin pa ni ltung ba ris ༷lnga ni ltung ba'i ris ⑧dang / lhung ba'i phung po zhes bya ste/ phas pham pa dang / dge 'dun lhag ma dang / ltung byed dang / so sor bshags par bya ba dang / nyes byas yin no/ /rtsod pa yin la lhung ba ma yin pa ni rtsod pa gsum po 'gyed pa'i rtsod pa dang gdams ngag med pa'i rtsod pa dang / bya ba'i rtsod pa'o/ /ltung ba yang yin la rtsod pa yang yin pa ni ltung ba'i ris ⑨lnga po ni ltung ba'i ris ⑩dang / ltung ba'i phung po zhes bya ste/ phas pham pa dang / dge 'dun lhag ma dang / ltung byed dang / so sor bshags par bya ba dang /nyes byas gang yin pa de las yibarten te 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang /'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa gang yin pa'o/ /ltung ba yang ma yin la rtsod pa yang ma yin pa ni rnam pa de dag ma gtogs pa'o/ /bya ba gang lags pa de rtsod pa lags la/ rtsod pa gang lags pa de yang bya ba lags sam/ bka' stsal pa/bya ba yin la rtsod pa ma yin pa yang yod/ rtsod pa tsoyin la bya ba ma yin pa yang yod/ bya ba yang yin la rtsod pa yang yin pa yang yod/ bya ba yang ma yin la rtsod pa yang ma yin pa yang yod do/ /re zhig bya ba yin la rtsod pa ma yin pa 3—566

ni dge 'dun gyi gsol pa dang / gsol ba dang gnyis dang / gsol ba dang bzhi'i las gang yin pa'o/ /rtsod pa yin la bya ba ma yin pa ni rtsod pa gsum po 'gyed pa'i rtsod pa dang / gdams ngag med pa'i rtsod pa dang / ltung ba'i rtsod pa'o/ /bya ba yang yin la rtsod pa yang yin pa ni dge 'dun gyi bya ba gsol pa dang / gsol ba dang gnyis dang / gsol pa dang bzhi'i las gang yin pa de las ①brten te 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang / 'thab mo dang /'gyed pa gang yin pa'o/ /bya ba yang ma yin la rtsod pa yang ma yin pa ni rnam pa de dag ma gtogs pa'o//dge slong dag 'gyed pa'i rtsod pa la rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa'i chos du zhig gis 'dul bar bya/ zhi bar bya/ nye bar zhi bar bya zhe na/ bka' stsal pa/gnyis kyis te/ mngon sum du 'dul bar 'os pa dang / gang yang tshul shing mang po blang bas ②so/ /mngon sum du 'dul ba ni ji ltar rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa yin/ ji ltar na 'di na kha cig gi rtsod pa rnams 'di lta ste mngon sum du 'dul bar 'os pa'i rtsod pa zhi bar byed pas 'dul ③ba dang du/ zhi ba dang /nye bar zhi bar byed pa ⑤yin zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra bar dbyar bzhugs par zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de'i tshe dge slong rab tu mang po dag ljongs shig tu dbyar gnas par dam bcas pa las de rnams dbyar gyi nang logs su 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'bru ba dang / 'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa byung nasaX/ de rnams kyis ①rtsod pa de tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu la gtad pa dang / de gnyis kyis ston pa'i bstan pa'i 0chos 'dul 3wa 567

bas rtsod pa ①zhi bar byas so/ /de nas dge slong rab tu mang po ljongs su dbyar gnas pa'i dbyar gyi zla ba gsum po dag 'das pa dang / chos gos byas pa dang ldan/ chos gos zin pa dang ldan nas lhung bzed dang chos gos blangs te mnyan yod gang na ba der rgyu zhing dong nas/ rim gyis rgyu zhing dong ba dang mnyan yod du phyin to/ /de nas dge slong rab tu mang pos lhung bzed dang chos gos mkhos su phab nas rkang pa bkrus te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ②ba der dong nas lhags pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /chos nyid kyis rgyasangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni blo 0bur pa'i dge slong rnams la so sor yang dag par dga' bar mdzad pa 'dis so sor yang dag par dga' bar mdzad pa yin pas/bcom ldan 'das kyis so sor yang dag par dga' bar mdzad pas dge slong rab tu mang po la kye dge slong dag khyed cag gang nas 'dir 'ongs/ gang du khyed cag dbyar gnas/ btsun pa bdag cag ni ljongs shig nas du'adir mchis te/ ljongs shig na bdag cag dbyar gnas dulags so/ /dge slong dag khyed cag ji ga ljongs su bde ba la reg par dbyar gnas sam/ khyed bsod snyoms kyis phongs par ma gyur tam/ btsun pa mad ⑦par bdag cag ljongs su bde ba la reg par gnas pas dbyar gnas shing bdag cag bsod snyoms kyis kyang phongs par ma gyur to/ /de lta lags mod kyi bdag cag dbyar gyi nang logs su 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'bru ba dang / 'thab mo dang /'gyed pa byung nas bdag cag gis rtsod pa de ༷tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang /mod gal gyi bu la gtad pa dang / de gnyis kyis ston pa'i bstan pa ①chos 3—568

'dul bas rtsod pa de zhi bar bgyis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ kye mtho nga'i nyan thos skam la gnas pa dag gis ni ston pa'i bstan pa chos 'dul bas rtsod pa skyes shing byung ba zhi bar nus so snyam nas/dge slong dag de lta bas na skam la gnas pa'i dge slong rnams kyis ston pa'i bstan ①sa chos 'dul bas rtsod pa skyes shing byung ba zhi bar bya'o/ /dge slong rnams kyis skam la gnas pa dang ②du yin pa ma shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang dag dge 'dun la mi ltos par ①rtsod pa skyes shing byung ba zhi bar nus pa'o/ /de duyang gsum ste/ skam la gnas pa lus kyis bsdams pa ma yin zhing ngag gis kyang ma yin pa yang yod/ lus kyis bsdams la ngag gis ma yin pa yang yod/ lus dang ngag gis bsdams ①pa yang yod do/ /lus kyis bsdams pa ma yin zhing ngag gis kyang ma yin pa gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ skam la gnas pa dge slong 'thab 0par gyurardzi/ mtshang 'dru bar gyur/ 'thab mo byung ⑧/ 'gyed par gyur nas phyogs dang phyogs gzhan 0du gnas pa rnams kyi drung du bdag nyid song nas 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa dag legs so/ /rtsod pa 'di ni legs par bzung ba yin gyi 0nyes par bzung ba ma yin/ legs par sbyar ba yin gyi nyes par sbyar ba ma yin/ legs par brtags pa yin gyi nyes par brtags pa ma yin pas 'di dang 'di ni smos shig /'di dang 'di ni ma smra shig /tshe dang ldan pa dag 0pha rol po dag chom 8shig /pha rol po dag gis choms sa re/ bdag ni tshe dang ldan pa dag gi 0phyogs dang dpung dang grogs byed pa yin no zhes smra zhing / phyogs cig shos kyi drung du yang bdag nyid song nas 'di skad ces/ tshe dang ldan pa dag legs so/ /rtsod 3—569

pa 'di ni legs par bzung ba yin gyi nyes par bzung ba ma yin/ legs par sbyar ba yin gyi nyes par sbyar ba ma yin/ legs par brtags pa yin gyi nyes par brtags pa ma yin pas 'di dang 'di ni smos shig /'di dang 'di ni ma smra shig /tshe dang ldan pa dag gis pha rol po dag chom ①shig /pha rol po dag gis choms ②sa re/ bdag ni tshe dang ldan pa dag gi phyogs dang / dpung dang / grogs yin no zhes smra ba ③ste/ 'di ni skam la gnas pa lus kyis bsdams pa ma yin zhing ngag gis kyang ma yin pa'odu/ /skam la gnas pa lus kyis ⑤bsdams la ngag gis ma yin pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ skam la gnas pa'i rjodage slong 'thab ⑦par gyural/ mtshang 'dru bar gyur/ 'thab mo byung /'gyed par gyur nas gnas shing phyogs dang phyogs gzhan du gnas pa rnams kyis ⑨phyogs gcig tu bdag nyid mi 'gro mod kyi pho nya btang nas tshe dang ldan pa dag legs 0so/ /rtsod pa 'di ni legs par bzung ba yin gyi nyes par bzung yib ma yin8/ legs par sbyar ba yin gyi nyes par sbyar ba ma yin/ legs par brtags pa yin gyi nyes par brtags ⑩pa ni tsom yin pas 'di dang 'di ni smos shig /'di dang 'di ni ma smra shig /tshe dang ldan pa dag gis pha rol po dag chom 4)shig /pha rol po dag gis coms 4)sa re/ bdag ni tshe dang ldan pa dag gi phyogs dang dpung dang / grogs yin no/ /phyogs cig shos su yang bdag nyid mi 'gro mod kyi pho nya btang nas tshe dang ldan pa dag legs so/ /rtsod pa 0ni legs par bzung ba yin gyi nyes par bzung ba ma yin/ legs par sbyar ba yin gyi nyes par sbyar ba ma yin/ legs par brtags pa yin gyi nyes par brtags pa ma yin pas 'di dang 'di ni smros shig /'di dang 'di ni 3—570

ma smra shig /tshe dang ldan pa dag gis pha rol po dag chom ①shig /pha rol po dag gis ②choms dus re/ bdag ni tshe dang ldan pa dag gi byaphyogs dang /dpung dang / grogs yin no zhes zer ba ste/ 'di ni skam la gnas pa lus kyis dubasdams pa dungag gis ma yin pa yin no/ /skam la gnas pa lus dang ngag gis bsdams pa gang zhe na/ ga 'di lta ste/ skam la gnas pa dge slong 'thab ⑦par gyur/ mtshang 'dru bar gyur/ 'thab mo byung / 'gyed par gyur nas gnas shing phyogs gzhan dang dugazhan la ⑨gnas pa rnams kyis 0phyogs gcig tu bdag nyid mi 'gro zhing pho nya yang gtong bar mi byed la/phyogs cig shos su yang bdag nyid mi 'gro zhing tshig gis 0pho nya yang 8gtong bar mi byed pa'o/ /de la 8skam la gnas pa lus kyis bsdams pa ma yin zhing ngag gis kyang ma yin pa gang yin pa de lta bu'i skam la gnas pa yang ma bskos pa ni bsko bar mi bya'o/ /bskos pa ni dbyung bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/de lta bu 8skam la gnas pa la brten nas dge 'dun la rtsod pa ma byung ba rnams ni 'byung la/ byung ba rnams ni ston pa'i bstan ⑩pa chos 'dul bas myur du zhi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de la skam la gnas pa lus kyis tshubasdams la ngag gis ma yin pa gang yin pa de lta bu'i skam la gnas pa yang ma bskos pa ni bsko bar mi bya'o/ /bskos pa ni dbyung bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de lta bu'i skam la gnas pa la brten nas kyang dge 'dun la rtsod ⑩pa ma byung ba rnams ni 'byung la/ byung ba rnams ni ston pa'i bstan 8pa chos 'dul bas myur du zhi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de la skam la gnas pa lus dang ngag gis bsdams pa gang yin pa de lta bu'i skam la gnas pa ma bskos pa ni bsko bar bya'o/ /bskos pa ()ni 3—571

dbyung bar mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de lta bu'i skam la gnas pa la brten nas dge 'dun la rtsod pa ma byung ba rnams ni mi 'byung la/ byung ba rnams ni ston pa'i bstan ①pa chos 'dul bas myur du zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de lta bu'i skam la gnas pa ni ⑤rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa yin gyi/gzhan dag ni ma yin no/ /de lta bu ①skam la gnas pa rnams kyis rtsod pa skyes shing byung ba zhi bar bya ste/ de lta bu'i skam la gnas pa rnams kyis rtsod pa zhi bar byas pa ni mngon sum rjodag pa ①yin no/ /de la mngon sum duji lta bu zhe na/mngon sum ni gnyis te/ gang zag mngon sum dang / chos mngon sum mo/ /gang zag mngon sum gang zhe na/ gang dag gis rtsod pa de zhi bar byed pa dang /gang dag gis rtsod pa de zhi bar bya ba de dag thams cad 'dus par gyur cing mngon sum du gyur pa ste/ 'di ni gang zag mngon sum zhes bya'o/ /chos mngon sum gang zhe na/ ston pa'i bstan pa gang dang / chos gang dang /'dul ba gang dang ⑦gang gis rtsod pa de zhi bar 'gyur ba niston pa'i bstan pa de dang / chos de dang / 'dul ba des rtsod pa de zhi bar byed pa 'di ni chos mngon sum zhes bya'o/ /gal te dge slong skam la gnas pa dag gis rtsod pa de zhi bar byed mi nus na ⑨de rnams kyis rtsod pa de dge 'dun la gtad par bya zhing /dge 'dun gyis ston pa'i bstan pa chos 'dul bas rtsod pa de zhi bar bya'o/ /dge 'dun gyis ston pa'i bstan pa chos 'dul bas rtsod pa de zhi bar byas na legs par zhi bar byas pa'o zhes brjod par bya ste/ mngon sum dag pa yin no//de la mngon sum ji lta bu yin zhe na/ mngon sum ni gsum ste/ dge 'dun mngon sum dang / gang zag mngon sum dang / chos mngon sum mo/ /dge 3—572

'dun mngon sum gang zhe na/ mtshams na gnas pa'i dge slong bya bar la'os pa ji snyed pa de dag thams cad 'dus shing mngon sum du gyur pa dang / 'dun pa blang bar 'os pa rnams las 'dun pa blangs pa dang / dge slong rnams 'dus shing mngon sum du gyur kyang mi btub cing gshe ba gang dag gis ②gshe bar 'os pa rnams mi btub pa med cing mi gshe la las dag byed pa 'di ni dge 'dun mngon sum ③zhes bya'o/ /gang zag mngon sum gang zhe na/ gang dag gis rtsod pa de zhi bar byed pa dang / gang dag gi 0rtsod pa de zhi bar bya ba de ⑤thams cad 'dus shing mngon sum du gyur pa ste/ 'di ni gang zag mngon sum zhes bya'o/ /chos mngon sum gang zhe na/ ston pa'i bstan pa gang dang /chos gang dang / mi'adul ba gang gis rtsod pa de nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ba'i ston pa'i bstan pa de dang / chos de dang /du 'dul ba des rtsod pa de 0zhi bar byed pa 'di ni chos mngon sum zhes bya'o/ /gal te dge 'dun gyis rtsod ༷pa de zhi bar bya mi nus na de'i 'og tu dge 'dun gyis dge slong gsal ba bcu'am bcu gnyis bsko bar bya'o/ /bsko ba ni 'di ltar bya ste/ gnas mal bshams nas gaṇḍi brdungs la dris ⑨pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo la/dge 'dun thams cad tshogs shing mthun par gyur pa dang / re zhig thog mar spro bar bya ste/ sangs rgyas skyong dang / chos sbyin yidang / dge 'dun sde khyod ⑩gsal ba yin na mtshams kyi phyi logs su dong tsonas dge 'dun gyi rtsod pa zhi bar 0spro'am/ gal te spro bar gyur na de rnams kyis spro'o zhes brjod par bya'o / /de'i 'og tu dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ sangs rgyas skyong dang / chos sbyin 3—573

dang / dge 'dun sde 'di rnams gsal ba lags te mtshams kyi slad rol du mchis nas dge 'dun gyi rtsod pa zhi bar bgyi bar spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi ①dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / 'di ltar dge 'dun gyis sangs rgyas skyong dang / chos sbyin dang / dge 'dun sde gsal ba rnams bskos te/ sangs rgyas skyong dang / chos sbyin dang / dge 'dun sde gsal ba mtshams kyi slad rol du mchis nas dge 'dun gyi rtsod pa zhi bar bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las bya ba ni/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ sangs rgyas skyong dang / chos sbyin dang / dge 'dun sde 'di rnams gsal ba lags te mtshams kyi ②slad rol du mchis nas dge 'dun gyi rtsod pa zhi bar bgyi bar spro nas/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis sangs rgyas skyong ②dang / chos sbyin dang / dge 'dun sde dugasal ba rnams bskos te/ sangs rgyas skyong dang / chos sbyin dang / dge 'dun sde gsal ba rnams mtshams kyi slad rol du mchis nas dge 'dun gyi ༷rtsod pa zhi bar bgyid na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag sangs rgyas skyong dang / chos sbyin dang / dge 'dun sde gsal ba rnams bskos te/ sangs rgyas skyong dang /chos sbyin dang / dge 'dun sde gsal ba mtshams kyi slad rol du mchis nas dge 'dun gyi ༅rtsod pa zhi bar bgyi bar ⑦bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung ⑧shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung ①shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis sangs rgyas skyong dang / chos sbyin dang /dge 'dun sde gsal ba de rnams mtshams kyi slad rol du mchis nas dge 'dun gyi rtsod pa zhi bar bgyi bar bskos lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de 3—574

bzhin du 'dzin to/ /gsal ba rnams kyis ston pa'i bstan pa chos 'dul bas rtsod pa de zhi bar bya'o/ /gsal ba rnams kyis ston pa'i bstan ①pa chos 'dul bas rtsod pa de zhi bar byas na ②legs par zhi bar byas par brjod par bya ste/mngon sum dag pa yin no/ /de la mngon sum dag pa ①ji lta bu zhe na/mngon sum ni gnyis te/ gang zag mngon sum dang / chos mngon sum mo/ /gang zag mngon sum gang zhe na/ gang dag gis rtsod pa de zhi bar byed pa dang /gang dag gi ༷rtsod pa de dag zhi bar bya ba de thams cad 'dus shing mngon sum du gyur pa ste/ 'di ni gang zag mngon sum zhes bya'o/ /chos mngon sum gang zhe na/ ston pa'i bstan 0pa gang dang / chos gang dang / 'dul ba gang gis rtsod pa de zhi bar 'gyur ba'i ston pa'i bstan ༷pa de dang / chos de dang /'dul ba des rtsod pa de zhi bar byed pa 'di ni chos mngon sum zhes bya'o/ /gal te dge slong gsal ba rnams kyis rtsod pa de zhi bar mi nus na de rnams kyis dge slong gsal ba bas kyang gsal ba brgyad dam dgu bsko bar bya ste/ gsal ba bas kyang gsal ba rnams kyang ⑦ston pa'i bstan ⑧pa chos 'dul bas rtsod pa de zhi bar bya'o/ /gsal ba bas kyang gsal ba rnams kyis rtsod pa de zhi bar byas na legs par zhi bar byas par brjod par bya'o/ /gal te dge slong gsal ba bas kyang gsal ba rnams kyis rtsod pa de zhi bar bya mi nus na de rnams kyis rtsod pa de dge 'dun la gtad par bya'o/ /de nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong rtsod pa de sbed pa bsko bar bya'o/ /chos lnga dang ldan pa'i dge slong rtsod pa sbed pa ma bskos pa ni bsko ⑨bar mi bya'o/ /bskos pa ni dbyung bar bya'o/ /lnga gang zhe na/'dun pas 'gro ba dang / zhe sdang gis ⑩'gro ba dang / gti mug gis 'gro ba 3—575

dang / 'jigs pas 'gro ba dang / rtsod pa sbos ①pa dang ma sbos ②pa mi shes pa ste/ chos 'di lnga dang ldan pa'i dge slong rtsod pa sbed pa ma bskos pa ni bsko bar mi bya'o/ /bskos pa ni dbyung bar bya'o/ /chos lnga dang ldan pa'i dge slong rtsod pa sbed pa ma bskos pa ni bsko bar bya'o/ /bskos pa ni dbyung bar mi bya'o / /lnga gang zhe na/ 'dun pas mi 'gro ba dang / zhe sdang gis mi 'gro ba dang / gti mug gis mi 'gro ba dang / 'jigs pas mi 'gro ba dang /rtsod pa sbos ③pa dang ma sbos 0pa shes pa ste/ chos 'di lnga dang ldan pa'i dge slong rtsod pa sbed pa ma bskos pa ni bsko bar bya'o/ /bskos pa ni dbyung ⑤bar mi bya'o/ / bsko ba ni 'di ltar bya ste/du gnas mal bshams la gaṇḍi brdungs te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la g.yang dag par bsgo la/dge 'dun thams cad tshogs shing mthun par gyur pa dang / re zhig thog mar spro bar bya ste/ tshe dang ldan pa dukhyod dge ⑨'dun gyi rtsod pa sbed pa 0spro'am/gal te spro na des spro'o zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/rtsod pa sbed pa'i dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di yonyedage 'dun gyi rtsod pa sbed par spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi 4)dus la bab cing / bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / 'di ltar dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di 8rtsod pa sbed par bskos te/ rtsod pa sbed pa'i dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi rtsod pa sbed par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las bya ba ni/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/rtsod pa sbed pa'i dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi rtsod pa sbed 3—576

par spro nas/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rtsod pa sbed par bskos te/ rtsod pa sbed pa'i dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun gyi rtsod pa sbed par bgyi ①na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rtsod pa 0sbed par bskos te/ rtsod pa sbed pa'i dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun gyi rtsod pa sbed par bgyi bar ③bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung dushig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung dushig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong rtsod pa sbed pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun gyi durtsod pa sbed par bskos lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du du'adzin to/ /ngas rtsod pa sbed pa'i dge slong gi kun tu spyod pa'i chos bca' bar bya ste/ rtsod pa sbed pa'i dge slong gis rtsod pa de gnas brtan dang bcas/ so sor thar pa dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun la gtad par bya zhing rgan rabs ji lta ba bzhin du brjod par bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ rtsod pa 'di duganas ga ge mo zhig tu gzhi 'di las byung nas dus 'di srid cig lon te/ rtsod pa de skam la gnas pa'i dge slong rnams kyis zhi bar bgyi bar larngo ma thog yinas/ de rnams kyis dge 'dun la gtad pa las dge 'dun gyis kyang ma spyod nas/ des yigasal ba'i dge slong rnams bskos pa las dge slong gsal ba rnams kyis 0rngo ma thog yinas/de rnams kyis kyang 8dge slong gsal ba bas kyang gsal ba rnams bskos pa las dge slong gsal ba bas kyang gsal ba de rnams kyis kyang rngo ma thog tsonas/ de rnams kyis kyang ⑩dge 'dun la gtad pa dang / dge 'dun gyis kyang bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rtsod pa sbed par bskos nas/ bdag dge 3—577

slong rtsod pa sbed pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas rtsod pa 'di gnas brtan dang bcas/so sor thar pa dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun la dbul gyisal/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis 'di nas bzung ste rtsod pa 'di zla ba drug gi mtha'i bar gyis zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ gnas brtan dang bcas so sor thar pa dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun gyis ston pa'i bstan ②pa chos 'dul bas rtsod pa de zhi bar bya'o①/ /gnas brtan dang bcas/ so sor thar pa dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun gyis rjoston pa'i bstan ①pa chos 'dul bas rtsod pa de duzhi bar byas na ②legs par zhi bar byas par brjod par bya ste/ mngon sum dag pa yin no/ /de la mngon sum ji lta bu zhe na/ mngon sum ni gsum ste/ dge 'dun mngon sum dang /gang zag mngon sum dang / chos mngon sum mo/ /dge 'dun mngon sum gang zhe na/ mtshams na gnas pa'i dge slong bya bar 'os pa ji snyed pa de dag thams cad 'dus shing mngon sum du gyur pa dang / 'dun pa blang bar 'os pa rnams la ⑧'dun pa blangs pa dang / dge slong rnams 'dus shing mngon sum du gyur kyang mi btub cing gshe ba gang ⑨dag gi 4) gshe ba (spre'os pa rnams mi btub pa med cing mi gshe la/ las dag byed pa 'di ni dge 'dun mngon sum zhes bya'o/ /gang zag mngon sum gang zhe na/ gang dag gis rtsod pa de zhi bar byed pa dang / gang dag gi 0rtsod pa de zhi bar bya ba de dag tsothams cad 'dus shing mngon sum du gyur pa 'di ni gang zag mngon sum zhes bya'o/ /chos mngon sum gang zhe na/ ston pa'i bstan ④pa gang dang / chos gang dang /'dul ba gang gis tsortsod pa de zhi bar gyur pa'i thozheston pa'i bstan ⑩pa de dang /chos de dang / 'dul ba des rtsod pa de zhi bar byed pa 'di ni chos mngon sum 3—578

zhes bya'o/ /gal te gnas brtan dang bcas/ so sor thar pa dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun gyis rtsod pa de zhi bar byed mi nus na des rtsod pa de rtsod pa sbed pa'i dge slong nyid la gtad par bya'o/ /rtsod pa sbed pa'i dge slong gis mdo sde dang / 'dul ba dang / ma mo 'dzin pa'i dge slong rnams la gtad par bya zhing rgan rims ①ji lta ba bzhin la ②brjod par bya ste/ shes ldan mdo sde dang /'dul ba dang / ma mo 'dzin pa'i dge slong rnams gsan du gsol/ rtsod pa 'di ni gnas ga ge mo zhig tu gzhi 'di las byung nas dus 'di srid cig lon te/rtsod pa de skam la gnas pa'i dge slong rnams kyis zhi bar byed ma ①nus nas/de rnams kyis dge 'dun la gtad pa las dge 'dun gyis kyang ma spyod nas④/des kyang dge slong gsal ba rnams bskos pa las dge slong gsal ba rnams kyis kyang ma 0nus nas/ de rnams kyis kyang dge slong gsal ba bas kyang gsal ba rnams bskos pa las dge slong gsal ba bas kyang gsal ba rnams kyis kyang ma ①nus nas/ de rnams kyis kyang dge 'dun la gtad pa dang / dge 'dun gyis bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rtsod pa sbed par bskos te/ bdag dge slong rtsod pa sbed pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas rtsod pa 'di gnas brtan dang bcas/ so sor thar pa dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun la gtad pa las/gnas brtan dang bcas/ so sor thar pa dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun gyis ma spyod nas/ bdag dge slong rtsod pa 0sbed pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la gtad de/bdag dge slong rtsod pa sbed pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas rtsod pa 'di mdo sde dang /'dul ba dang / ma mo 'dzin pa'i dge slong rnams la gtad kyisadu/ shes ldan mdo sde dang / 'dul ba dang / ma mo 'dzin pa'i dge slong rnams kyis 3—579

'di nas bzung ste/ rtsod pa 'di lo ①gcig gi mtha'i bar gyis zhi bar mdzod cig /mdo sde dang / 'dul ba dang / ma mo 'dzin pa'i dge slong rnams kyis ston pa'i bstan pa chos 'dul bas rtsod pa de zhi bar bya'o/ /mdo sde dang /'dul ba dang / ma mo 'dzin pa'i dge slong rnams kyis rtsod pa de zhi bar byas na ②legs par zhi bar byas par brjod par bya ste/ mngon sum dag pa yin no//de la mngon sum ji lta bu zhe na/ mngon sum ni (nyeganyis te/ gang zag mngon sum dang / chos mngon sum mo/ /gang zag mngon sum gang zhe na/ gang sdog gis rtsod pa de zhi bar byed pa dang / gang dag gi ⑤rtsod pa 0zhi bar bya ba de thams cad 'dus shing mngon sum du gyur pa 'di ni gang zag mngon sum zhes bya'ol/ /chos mngon sum gang zhe na/ ston pa'i bstan 0pa gang dang / chos gang dang / 'dul ba gang gis rtsod pa de zhi bar 'gyur ba'i ston pa'i bstan ⑦pa de dang chos de dang / 'dul ba des rtsod pa de zhi bar byed pa 'di ⑧ni chos mngon sum zhes bya'o/ /gal te mdo sde dang / 'dul ba dang / ma mo 'dzin pa'i dge slong rnams kyis rtsod pa de zhi bar byed mi nus na de rnams kyis rtsod pa sbed pa'i dge slong nyid la gtad par bya'o/ /rtsod pa sped pa'i dge slong gis gnas gang na dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan gang yang rung ba'am/shes nyen can shes nyen can gang yang rung ba'am/ gtso bo ⑨gtso bo gang yang rung ba yod pa de la gtad par bya zhing rgan rims ⑩ ji lta ba bzhin la 0brjod par bya ste/ gnas brtan dag gson cig /rtsod pa 'di ni gnas ga ge mo zhig tu gzhi 'di las byung nas dus 'di srid cig lon te/ rtsod pa de skam la gnas pa'i dge slong rnams kyis zhi bar byed ma thonyenas nas/ de rnams kyis 3—580

dge 'dun la gtad pa dang / dge 'dun gyis kyang ma spyod nas/ des kyang dge slong gsal ba rnams bskos pa las dge slong gsal ba rnams kyis kyang ma ①nus nas/ de rnams kyis kyang dge slong gsal ba bas kyang gsal ba bskos pa las dge slong gsal ba bas kyang gsal ba rnams kyis kyang ma nus nas/ de rnams kyis kyang ②dge 'dun la gtad pa las dge 'dun gyis bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba rtsod pa sbed par bskos nas/ bdag dge slong rtsod pa sbed pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas rtsod pa 'di gnas brtan dang bcas/ so sor thar pa dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun la gtad pa las/ gnas brtan dang bcas / so sor thar pa dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun gyis zhi bar ma spyod dunas/des kyang bdag ④dge slong rtsod pa sbed pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la gtad nas/bdag dge slong rtsod pa sbed pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas rtsod pa 'di mdo sde dang /'dul ba dang / ma mo 'dzin pa'i dge slong rnams la gtad pa dang / mdo sde dang / 'dul ba dang / ma mo 'dzin pa rnams kyis kyang ma nus nas/ de rnams kyis kyang bdag dge slong rtsod pa sbed pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la gtad nas/bdag dge slong rtsod pa sbed pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas rtsod pa 'di gnas brtan la 'bul na/ gnas brtan gyis 'di nas bzung ste/ rtsod pa 'di ji tsam gyis mthar phyin gyi bar du zhi bar mdzad du gsol zhes brjod par bya'o//ngas ⑤dge slong gnas brtan gyi dukun du spyod pa'i chos bca' bar bya ste/dge slong gnas brtan gyis rgol ba dang phyir rgol ba'i dge slong rnams so shing stobs ⑦na bdag gir mi bya ste/ ba'i rtsi ba stobs ⑧na ma yin/ 'dag 'chal stobs ⑨na ma yin zhing / gdon pa dang 'dri ba yang byed du mi cigazhug 3—581

ste / gzhan du na mdun nam rgyab tu 'dug nas tshig 'di skad ces/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ma 'thab shig /mtshang ma 'dru zhig /'thab mo ma byed cig /ma 'gyed cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa dag rtsod pa la gnyis ka rgyal ba med kyi/ 'on kyang gcig rgyal gcig pham ①par 'gyur ro/ /'gyed pa la ②gnyis ka rgyal ba med kyi/ 'on kyang gcig rgyal gcig pham ①par 'gyur ro zhes bya zhing / dge slong gnas brtan gyis ston pa'i bstan pa chos 'dul bas rtsod pa de zhi bar bya'o/ /dge slong gnas brtan ༷gyis rtsod pa de zhi bar byas na legs par zhi bar byas par brjod par bya'o/ /dge slong dag de ltar na mngon sum du 'dul bar 'os pa ni 0rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa yin zhing / de ltar ༷kha cig gi rtsod pa rnams 'di lta ste/ mngon sum du 'dul bar 'os pa'i rtsod pa zhi bar byed pas 'dul ba dang / zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi ba yin no/ /dge slong dag gang tshul shing mang po blang ba'i 0rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa yin/ ji ltar na du'adi na kha cig gi rtsod pa rnams 'di lta ste/ gang tshul shing mang po blang ba'i rtsod pa zhi bar byed pas 'dul ⑨ba dang / zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi ba yin zhe na/ skam la gnas pa nas bzung ste gnas brtan gyi ⑩bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ gal te dge slong gnas brtan gyis rtsod pa de zhi bar byed mi nus na rtsod pa de rtsod pa sbed pa'i dge slong de nyid la gtad par bya'o/ /des kyang rtsod pa de dge 'dun la gtad par bya'o/ /dge 'dun gyis rtsod pa de gang tshul shing mang po blang ba'i rtsod pa zhi bas zhi bar bya'o/ / rgyu lngas ⑩gang tshul shing mang po len pa'i rtsod pa zhi ba ni rtsub pa dang / gdug pa dang / dam po dang /dbye ba'i bsam pa dang / sbyor 7ba gzhan du mi 'gyur ba can yin no/ /rtsub 3—582

pa ji lta bu zhe na/ rgol ba dang phyir rgol ba'i dge slong rnams kyis ①lhub po rab tu bzung ba yin te/ de ltar na rtsub po can yin no/ /gdug pa ji lta bu zhe na/ rgol ba dang phyir rgol ba'i dge slong rnams gdug pa dang / rnam par gnon pa yin te/ de ltar na gdug pa can ②rna/ /dam po ji lta bu zhe na/rgol ba dang phyir rgol ba'i dge slong rnams kyis dam por nirab tu bzung ba yin te/ de ltar na dam po can yin no/ /dbye ba'i bsam pa ji lta bu zhe na/dbye bar byed pa'i gzhi 0bcu bzhi las 'byed ⑤par byed pa'i gzhi gang yang rung ba zhig legs par shin tu rab tu bzung dub yin te/ de ltar na dbye ba'i bsam pa can yin no/ /sbyor ba gzhan du mi ⑦'gyur ba can niji lta bu zhe na/skam la gnas pa nas bzung nas gnas brtan gyi bar gyis te/ de ltar na sbyor ba gzhan du mi 'gyur ba can yin te/ chos 'di lnga dang ldan pas na gang tshul shing mang po blang ba'i zhi ba ni rtsub pa dang / gdug ⑨pa dang / dam po dang /dbye ba'i bsam pa dang ⑩/ sbyor ba gzhan du mi 'gyur ba can yin no/ /des na tshul shing 'brim pa'i dge slong bsko bar bya ste/ chos lnga dang ldan pa'i dge slong tshul shing 'brim par ma bskos pa ni bsko bar mi bya'o/ /bskos pa ni dbyung bar bya'o/ /lnga gang zhe na/ 'dun pas 'gro ba dang / zhe sdang gis 'gro ba dang / gti mug gis 'gro ba dang / 'jigs pas 'gro ba dang /tshul shing brims pa dang ma brims pa mi shes pa ste/ chos 'di lnga dang ldan pa'i dge slong tshul shing 'brim par ma bskos pa ni bsko bar mi bya'o/ /bskos pa ni dbyung bar bya'o/ /chos lnga dang ldan pa'i dge slong tshul shing 'brim par ma bskos pa ni bsko bar bya'o/ /bskos pa ni dbyung bar mi bya'o/ /lnga gang zhe na/3—583

'dun pas mi 'gro ba dang / zhe sdang gis mi 'gro ba dang / gti mug gis mi 'gro ba dang / 'jigs pas mi 'gro ba dang / tshul shing brims pa dang ma ①brims pa shes pa ste/ chos 'di lnga dang ldan pa'i dge slong tshul shing 'brim par ma bskos pa ni bsko bar bya'o/ /bskos pa ni dbyung bar mi bya'o/ /tshul shing brim ②pa ni bzhi ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sba ba dang / mngon pa dang /rna drung du gshub ③pa dang bcas pa dang / dge 'dun thams cad pa'o/ /sba ba'i tshul shing brim ④pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste tshul shing 'brim pa'i dge slong 'di snyam du sems te/ gnas 'di na dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rab tu mang po dag ni chos ma yin pa smra la/ dge slong gsar bu nyung zad cig ni chos smra bas/ gal te bdag gis tshul shing mngon par brims na rjodage slong gsar bu dge slong gnas brtan rnams kyi rjes su byed pa rnams chos ma yin pa'i 0tshul shing rab tu mang po len par 'gyur ba'i gnas gang yin pa de yod kyisanyu/ ma la bdag gis tshul shing sbas te brim mo snyam nas/ de tshul shing sbas nas 'brim pa ste/'di ni sba ba'i tshul shing 'brim pa zhes bya'o/ /mngon pa'i tshul shing 'brim pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ tshul shing 'brim pa'i dge slong 'di snyam du sems te/gnas 'di na dge slong gnas brtan rab tu mang po dag ni chos smra la/ dge slong gsar bu nyung zad gcig ni chos ma yin pa smra bas/ gal te bdag gis 0tshul shing sbas te brims na dge slong gsar bu rnams chos ma yin pa'i tshul shing len par 'gyur ba gang yin pa'i gnas de yod kyisaspu/ ma la bdag gis tshul shing mngon par brim mo/ /bdag gis tshul shing gsal bar brims na dge slong gsar bu dge slong gnas brtan rnams kyi tu )rjes su byed pa rnams mes kyi tshul 3—584

shing rab tu mang po len par 'gyur ba gang yin pa'i gnas de yod do snyam nas de tshul shing mngon par 'brim pa ste/ 'di ni mngon pa'i tshul shing 'brim pa zhes bya'o/ /rna drung du gshub ①pa dang bcas pa'i tshul shing 'brim pa gang zhe na/'di lta ste tshul shing 'brim pa'i dge slong gis rna drung du gtugs te gshubs ②la tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyi ③mkhan pos chos kyi ④tsal shing blangs kyis 0khyod kyis kyang chos kyi tshul shing long ①shig /khyod kyi slob dpon dang / mkhan po gcig pa dang / slob dpon gcig pa dang / gtam 'dres pa dang phebs par ⑦smra ba dang / smos du'adrin dang / 'grogs bshes kyis chos kyi tshul shing blangs kyis0/khyod kyis kyang chos kyi tshul shing long 4) shig ces smra ba ste/ 'di ni rna drung du gshub 7pa dang bcas pa'i tshul shing 'brim pa zhes bya'o/ /dge 'dun thams cad pa'i tshul shing 'brim pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste tshul shing 'brim pa'i dge slong 'di snyam du sems te/ gnas 'di na tsodage slong nad pa rab tu mang bas/gal te bdag gis dge 'dun ma tshogs 4)shing ma 'dus par tshul shing brims na dge slong rab tu mang pos chos ma yin pa'i tshul shing len par 'gyur ba gang yin pa'i gnas de yod kyis8/ ma la bdag gis dge 'dun thams cad tshogs shing 'dus pa dang tshul shing brim (nyepar bya'o snyam nas/ (9dge 'dun thams cad tshogs shing 'dus pa dang tshul shing 'brim pa de4)/ 'di ni dge 'dun thams cad pa'i tshul shing 'brim pa zhes bya'o/ /chos ma yin pa'i tshul shing len pa bcu ⑫dang / chos kyi bcu'o/ /chos ma yin pa'i tshul shing len pa bcu gang zhe na/chos ma yin pas 6)tshul shing len pa dang / mi mthun pas ( )tshul shing len pa dang / chung ba bas kyang chung bas tshul shing len pa dang / dbye 0ba'i bsam 3—585

pas tshul shing len pa dang / sbyor ba gzhan du ma gyur pas tshul shing len pa dang / rten kha lo sgyur ①ba dang mi stun ②pas tshul shing len pa dang / tshul shing blangs pas dge 'dun bye yang ci ma rung snyam du bsams ③pas tshul shing len pa dang / tshul shing blangs pas dge slong rab tu mang po chos ma yin pa smra bar gyur kyang ci ④ma rung snyam nas tshul shing len pa dang / tshul shing blangs pas dge 'dun 'bye bar 'gyur bar shes bzhin du tshul shing len pa dang / tshul shing blangs pas dge slong rab tu mang po dag chos ma yin pa smra bar 'gyur bar shes bzhin du tshul shing len pa'o// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po bdun bcu rjodagu pa/ chos ma yin pas tshul shing len pa ji lta bu zhe na/ 'dul ba dang mthun pa ma yin pas tshul shing len pa ste/ de lta bu ni chos ma yin pas tshul shing len pa yin no/ /mi mthun pas tshul shing len pa ji lta bu zhe na/ dge 'dun mi mthun pas tshul shing len pa ste/de lta bu ni mi mthun pas tshul shing len pa yin no/ /chung ba bas kyang chung bas tshul shing len pa ji lta bu zhe na/ bsdam par bya ba dang bshags par bya ba yin no snyam nas tshul shing len pa ste/ de lta bu ni chung ba bas kyang chung bas tshul shing len pa yin no/ /dbye yiba'i bsam pas tshul shing len pa ji lta bu zhe na/dbye ⑦bar byed pa'i gzhi ⑧bcu bzhi las dbye khyabar byed pa'i gzhi yi gang yang rung ba zhig legs par shin tu rab tu bzung ba de lta bu ni dge 'dun dbye ⑩ba'i bsam pas tshul shing len pa yin no/ /sbyor ba gzhan du ma gyur pas tshul shing len pa ji lta bu zhe na/ skam la gnas pa (nyem yin pa nas bzung nas gnas brtan gyis tsom yin pa zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ de lta bu ni ④sbyor ba gzhan du 3—586

ma gyur pas tshul shing len pa yin no/ /rten kha lo sgyur ①ba dang mi stun ②pas tshul shing len pa ji lta bu zhe na/ dge slong mdo sde 'dzin pa dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / ma mo 'dzin par gyur pa ③gang dag yin pa de dag 0ni chos 'dul ba 'di la rten dang kha lo sgyur dub zhes bya ste/ de rnams la ma brtags par tshul shing len pa ste/ 'di 0lta bu ni rten kha lo sgyur ⑦ba dang mi stun ⑧pas tshul shing len pa yin no/ /tshul shing blangs pas dge 'dun bye bar gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pas tshul shing len pa ji lta bu yin zhe na/ tshul shing blangs pas dge 'dun bye bar gyur kyang ci ma rung zhes de snyam du bsams nas tshul shing len pa ste/ de lta bu ni tshul shing blangs pas dge 'dun bye bar gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pas tshul shing len pa yin no/ /tshul shing blangs pas dge slong rab tu mang po chos ma yin par gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pas tshul shing len pa ji lta bu zhe na/tshul shing blangs pas dge slong rab tu mang po chos ma yin pa blangs nas 'jug par 'gyur yang 0ci ma rung snyam pas tshul shing len pa ste/ de lta bu ni tshul shing blangs pas dge slong rab tu mang po chos ma yin pa smra bar gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pas tshul shing len pa yin no/ /tshul shing blangs pas dge 'dun 'bye ⑩bar 'gyur bar ⑩shes bzhin du tshul shing len pa ji lta bu zhe na/ tshul shing blangs pas dge 'dun 'bye 4)bar 'gyur bar shes shing 4)de ltar bsams nas tshul shing len pa ste/ de lta bu ni tshul shing blangs pas dge 'dun 'bye bar 'gyur bar shes bzhin du tshul shing len pa yin no/ /tshul shing blangs pas dge slong rab tu mang po chos ma yin pa smra bar 'gyur bar shes bzhin du tshul shing len pa ji lta bu zhe na/ tshul shing blangs pas dge slong rab tu mang po chos ma 3—587

yin pa blangs nas 'jug par 'gyur bar shes shing de ltar bsams nas tshul shing len pa ste/ de lta bu ni tshul shing blangs pas dge slong rab tu mang po chos ma yin pa smra bar 'gyur bar shes bzhin du tshul shing len pa ste/ 'di dag ni chos ma yin pa'i tshul shing len pa bcu yin no/ /chos kyi tshul shing len pa bcu gang zhe na/ chos kyis ①tsal shing len pa dang / mthun pas tshul shing len pa dang / chung ba bas kyang chung ba ma yin pas tshul shing len pa dang / mi 'bye ②ba'i bsam ③pas tshul shing len pa dang / sbyor ba gzhan du 'gyur bas rjotshul shing len pa dang / rten kha lo sgyur ⑤ba dang stun ༷pas tshul shing len pa dang / tshul shing blangs pas dge 'dun bye ⑦bar ma gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pas tshul shing len pa dang / tshul shing blangs pas dge slong rab tu mang po chos ma yin pa dusmra bar ma gyur ①kyang ci ma rung snyam pas tshul shing len pa dang /tshul shing blangs pas dge 'dun 'bye bar (bye mi shes pas tshul shing len pa dang /tshul shing blangs pas dge slong rab tu mang po chos ma yin pa smra bar 'gyur bar mi shes pas tshul shing len pa yin no/ /chos kyi 0tshul shing len pa ji lta bu zhe na/'dul ba dang mthun pas tshul shing len pa ste/ de lta bu ni chos kyi 0tshul shing len pa yin no/ /mthun pas tshul shing len pa ji lta bu zhe na/ dge 'dun mthun pas tshul shing len pa ste/ de lta bu ni mthun pas tshul shing len pa yin no//chung ba bas kyang chung ba ma yin pas tshul shing len pa ji lta bu zhe na/ bsdam par bya ba ma yin pa 4)dang / bshags par bya ba ma yin no snyam du bsams nas tshul shing len pa ste/ de lta bu ni chung ba bas kyang chung ba ma yin pas tshul shing len pa yin no/ /mi 'bye byaba'i bsam pas tshul shing len pa ji lta bu zhe na/3—588

'bye ①bar byed pa'i gzhi bcu bzhi las 'bye ②bar byed pa'i gzhi gang yang rung ba legs par shin tu rab tu ma bzung ba ste/ de lta bu ni mi 'bye ③ba'i bsam pas tshul shing len pa yin no/ /sbyor ba gzhan du gyur pas tshul shing len pa ji lta bu zhe na/ skam la gnas pa nas bzung nas gnas brtan gyi bar gyis te/de lta bu ni sbyor ba gzhan du gyur pas tshul shing len pa yin no/ /rten kha lo sgyur ④ba dang stun ⑤pas tshul shing len pa ji lta bu zhe na/ dge slong mdo sde 'dzin pa dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / ma mo 'dzin pa gang dag yin pa de dag ni chos 'dul ba 'di la rten dang kha lo sgyur dub zhes bya ste/ de ⑦rnams la brtags nas tshul shing len pa de lta bu ni rten kha lo sgyur ⑧ba dang stun ⑨pas tshul shing len pa yin no/ /tshul shing blangs pas dge 'dun bye ⑩bar ma gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pas tshul shing len pa ji lta bu zhe na/ tshul shing blangs pas dge 'dun bye bar gyur kyang ci ma rung zhes de ltar mi sems pas tshul shing len pa ste/de lta bu ni tshul shing blangs pas dge 'dun bye bar ma gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pas tshul shing len pa yin no/ /tshul shing blangs pas dge slong rab tu mang po chos ma yin pa smra bar ma gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pas tshul shing len pa ji lta bu zhe na/ tshul shing blangs pas dge slong rab tu mang po chos ma yin pa blangs te 'jug par ma gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pas tshul shing len pa ste/ de lta bu ni tshul shing blangs pas dge slong rab tu mang po chos ma yin pa smra bar ma gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pas tshul shing len pa yin no/ /tshul shing blangs pas dge 7'dun 'bye 0bar 'gyur bar mi shes pas tshul shing len pa ji lta bu zhe na/ tshul shing blangs pas dge 'dun 'bye (sribar 'gyur bar mi shes shing de ltar mi sems pas 3—589

tshul shing len pa ste/ de lta bu ni tshul shing blangs pas dge 'dun 'bye bar 'gyur bar mi shes pas tshul shing len pa yin no/ /tshul shing blangs pas dge slong rab tu mang po chos ma yin pa ⑨smra bar 'gyur bar mi shes pas tshul shing len pa ji lta bu zhe na/ tshul shing blangs pas dge slong rab tu mang po chos ma yin pa blangs nas spyod par mi shes shing de ltar mi sems pas tshul shing len pa ste/ de lta bu ni tshul shing blangs pas dge slong rab tu mang po chos ma yin pa smra bar 'gyur bar mi shes pas tshul shing len pa ste/ 'di ni chos kyi tshul shing len pa bcu yin no/ /ngas dge slong tshul shing 'brim pa'i kun du spyod pa'i chos bca' bar bya ste/ dge slong tshul shing 'brim pas tshul shing rnam pa gnyis bsham par bya ste/ chos kyi tshul shing dang / chos ma yin pa'i tshul shing ngo / /chos kyi tshul shing rnams ni ya yo med pa/ kyag kyog med pa/ spyar kyor med pa/ kha dog bzang ba/ reg na bde bar bya'o/ /chos ma yin pa'i tshul shing rnams ni ya yo dang / kyag kyog dang / kyar kyor dang / kha dog ngan pa dang /reg na mi bde bar bya'o/ /de nas dge slong tshul shing 'brim pas lag pa g.yas pas chos kyi tshul shing rnams blangs la g.yon pas chos ma yin pa'i tshul shing rnams ⑧blangs nas dge 'dun gyis ③gnas brtan gyi mdun du 'dug ste/chos kyi tshul shing rnams kyi 0bsngags pa dang / chos ma yin pa'i tshul shing rnams kyi bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod par bya ste/ ri gnas brtan 'di dag ni chos kyi tshul shing lags te/ ya yo ma mchis pa/ kyag kyog ma mchis pa/kyar kyor ma mchis pa/ kha dog bzang ba/ reg na bde ba lags kyis ⑤bzhes shig /'di dag ni chos ma yin pa'i tshul shing lags te/ ya yo dang 3wa 590

kyag kyog dang / kyar kyor dang / kha dog ngan la ①reg na mi bde ba lags na bzhes shig /gal te chos ma yin pa'i tshul shing gang na ba de logs su lag pa bzed ②na tshig dang po la yang sbyin par mi bya/ gnyis pa la yang sbyin par mi bya/ gsum pa la ③sbyin par bya ste/ dge 'dun gyi duganas brtan gyis 'dul ba dang 'gal ba'i nyes byas kyi lhung ba bshags par bya'o/ /de bzhin du dge 'dun gsar bu'i bar gyi mdun du 'dug nas chos kyi tshul shing rnams kyi bsngags pa dang / chos ma yin pa'i tshul shing rnams kyi bsngags pa ma yin pa brjod par bya ste/ 'di dag ni chos kyi tshul shing lags te/ ya yo ma mchis pa/kyag kyog ma mchis pa/ kyar kyor ma mchis pa/ kha dog bzang ba/ reg na bde ba lags kyis dubazhes shig /'di dag ni chos ma yin pa'i tshul shing lags te/ ya yo dang / kyag kyog dang / spyar kyor dang / kha dog ngan pa/reg na mi bde ba lags na bzhes shig /gal te chos ma yin pa'i tshul shing gang na ba de logs su lag pa zed na tshig dang po la sbyin par mi bya/ gnyis pa la sbyin par mi bya/ gsum pa la sbyin par bya ste/ de bzhin du dge 'dun gsar bus 'dul ba dang 'gal ba'i nyes byas kyi ltung ba bshags par bya'o/ /gal te chos kyi tshul shing nyung bar gyur na kun shes kauṇḍi ⑥rgya'i tshul shing blang bar bya'o/ /gal te chos kyi tshul shing gcig gis lhag par gyur na yang de lta ⑦na 'di lta ste chos kyis ⑧cod pa de nye bar zhi ba ⑨yin no/ /de ltar rtsod pa de zhi bar byas pa la gal te 'ga' zhig skyo sdogs byed na ltung byed du 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du gal te chos ma yin pa'i tshul shing gcig gis lhag par gyur na yang de lta ⑩na 'di lta ste chos ma yin pas rtsod pa de zhi bar byas pa yin no/ /de ltar rtsod pa de zhi 3—591

bar byas pa la 'ga' zhig skyo sngogs byed na nyes byas su 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na gang tshul shing mang po blangs pas ①rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa yin zhing / de ltar na 'di na ②kha cig gi ①rtsod pa rnams 'di lta ste/ gang tshul shing mang po blang ba'i lirtsod pa zhi bar byed pas dul dub dang / zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi ba duyin no/ /dge slong dag 'gyed pa'i rtsod pa la ༅rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa gnyis kyis dul bar bya/ zhi bar bya/ nye bar zhi bar bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ mngon sum du 'dul bar 'os pa dang / gang tshul shing mang po blang bas so//dge slong dag gdams kyangag med pa'i rtsod pa la rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa'i chos gsum gyis dul bar bya/ zhi bar bya/ nye bar zhi bar bya'o/ /gsum gang zhe na/ mngon sum du 'dul ba dang / dran pas 'dul ba dang / ma myos pas 'dul ba'o/ /dge slong dag ji ltar na mngon sum gyis 'dul ba ni rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa yin/ ji 0ltar na ⑩'di na kha cig gi rtsod pa rnams 'di lta ste/ mngon sum du 'dul yiba'i rtsod pa zhi bar byed pas dul ba dang / zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi ba yin zhe na/ skam la gnas pa nas bzung nas gnas brtan gyi bar gyis gong ma bzhin du ste/ dge slong dag de ltar na tsomangon sum du 'dul ba ni rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa yin zhing / de ltar na 'di na kha cig gi rtsod pa rnams 'di lta ste/ mngon sum du 'dul ba'i rtsod pa zhi bar byed pas dul ba dang / zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi ba yin no/ /dge slong dag ji ltar na dran pas 'dul ba ni rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa yin/ ji ltar na 'di na kha cig ⑫rtsod pa rnams 'di lta ste/ dran pas 'dul ba'i rtsod pa ④zhi bar byed pas dul ba dang / zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi ba yin zhe na/ dper na tshe dang ldan pa 3—592

gyad bu nor la dge slong ma mdza' mos mi bden pas ①skur pa btab pa de la dge slong rnams gleng bar byed de/ gzhi des gleng ba na ngo tsha'o zhes bya ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed kyis gyad bu nor dang / gzhan yang de lta bu dang mthun pa su yang rung ba la dran pas 'dul bar 'os pa byin cig /sbyin pa ni 'di ltar sbyin par bya ste/ gnas mal bshams la gaṇḍi brdungs nas dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo la dge 'dun thams cad tshogs shing mthun par gyur pa dang gyad bu nor gyis bla gos phrag pa gcig tu ②gzar te/ rgan rims ①ji lta ba bzhin du 'dud 0pa byas la rgan pa'i mthar tsog tsog por 'dug nas thal mo sbyar te tshig 'di skad ces/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag gyad bu nor la dge slong ma mdza' mos mi bden pas skur pa btab pas bdag la dge slong rnams gzhi des gleng bar bgyid de/ bdag la gzhi des gleng bar bgyid pa dge 'dun la dran pas 'dul ba gsol na/ dge 'dun btsun pa thugs brtse ba can thugs brtse ba ⑤nye bar bzung ste/ bdag gyad bu nor la dran pas 'dul dub stsal du gsol/de skad lan gnyis lan gsum du brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/gyad bu nor 'di la dge slong ma mdza' mos mi bden pas skur pa btab pas 'di la dge slong rnams gzhi des gleng bar bgyid de/ 'di la gzhi des gleng bar bgyid pa dge 'dun las dran pas 'dul ⑦ba gsol na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi ⑧dus la bab cing bzod na ⑨dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang /3—593

'di ltar dge 'dun gyis gyad bu nor la dran pas 'dul ba stsol ①bar mdzad do//'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las bya ba ni/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol / gyad bu nor 'di la dge slong ma mdza' mos mi bden pas skur pa btab pas 'di la dge slong rnams gzhi des gleng bar bgyid de/ 'di la gzhi des gleng bar bgyid pa na dge 'dun las dran pas 'dul ba gsol te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis ②gyad bu nor la dran pas 'dul ba stsol ①bar mdzad na/tshe dang ldan pa gang dag gyad bu nor la dran pas 'dul ba stsol bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung dushig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung ⑤sheg / 'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du las brjod pa gnyis pa dang gsum gyi bar du brjod par bya'o/ /⑥dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis gyad bu nor la dran pas 'dul ba stsal lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin no⑦/ /chos ma yin pa'i dran pas 'dul ba sbyin pa gsum dang / chos kyi gsum mo/ /chos ma yin pa'i dran pas 'dul ba sbyin pa gsum gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dge slong pas pham pa'i ltung ba byung ba de la dge slong rnams gzhi des gleng bar byed cing / de la gzhi des gleng bar byed pa ⑧na/ dge 'dun las 0dran pas 'dul ba gsol te/de la dge 'dun gyis 0dran pas 'dul ba sbyin pa ni chos ma yin pa'i dran pas 'dul ba sbyin pa yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni bsnyil bar 'os pa'i phyir ro/ /'di lta ⑨ste dge slong dge 'dun lhag ma dang / ltung byed dang /so sor bshags pa dang / nyes byas kyi ltung ba byung ba tsode la dge slong rnams gzhi des gleng hubar byed cing / de la gzhi des gleng bar byed pa na dge 'dun 3—594

las dran pas 'dul ba gsol te/ dge 'dun gyis de la dran pas 'dul ba sbyin pa ni chos ma yin pa'i dran pas 'dul ba sbyin pa yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na / de ni bshags par 'os pa'i phyir ro/ /'di lta ste dge slong bye ma skyes smyos/ sems 'khrugs/ tshor bas nyen te sgren mor byung nas dge sbyong ①gi tshul ma yin pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa mang du spyad/ smras brtsal ②nas kha chu zags/ mig bgrad / bzhin gyur te gnyid kyis ma log par gnyid kyis log go snyam du shes/ pha rol gyis ma smras par smras so snyam du shes so/ /dus gzhan zhig na des rang gi sems slar sor chud pa dang / de la gzhi des dge slong rnams gleng bar byed cing / de la gzhi des gleng bar byed pa na dge 'dun las dran pas 'dul ba gsol te/ dge 'dun gyis de la dran pas 'dul ba sbyin pa ni chos ma yin pa'i dran pas 'dul ba sbyin pa yin tedu/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni ma myos pas 'dul bar 'os pa'i phyir ro/ /'di lta ste dge slong gzhi ldan dudage 'dun gyi dunang du lhung ba nyid shes pa las brjed nas phyis dran te shes pa las kyang ⑦brjed pa dang / dge 'dun gyis de la dran pas 'dul ba sbyin ⑧pa ni chos ma yin pa'i 0dran pas 'dul ba sbyin pa yin te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug ⑩par 'os pa'i phyir te(nye/'di dag ni chos ma yin pa'i dran pas tso'adul ba sbyin pa gsum yin no/ /chos kyi dran pas 'dul ba sbyin pa gsum gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gyad bu nor la dge slong ma mdza' mos mi bden pas skur pa btab pa de la dge slong rnams gzhi des gleng bar byed cing / de la gzhi des gleng bar byed pa na 0dge 'dun la dran pas 'dul ba gsol te/ dge 'dun gyis de la dran pas 'dul 3—595

ba sbyin pa ni chos kyi dran pas 'dul ba sbyin pa yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong zhig la ltung ba gzhan kho na zhig byung bar gyur pa de la dge slong rnams kyis gzhi gzhan gyis gleng bar byed cing / de la gzhi des gleng bar byed pa na dge 'dun las dran pas 'dul ba gsol te/ dge 'dun gyis de la dran pas 'dul ba sbyin pa ni chos kyi dran pas 'dul ba sbyin pa yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong zhig ltung ①ba byung bar gyur la ②des de dge slong gi mdun du bshags pa ②byin gyis brlabs par gyur pa de la dge slong rnams gzhi des gleng bar byed cing / de la gzhi des gleng bar byed pa na/ dge 'dun las dran pas 'dul ba gsol te/dge 'dun ④gyis de la dran pas 'dul ba sbyin ⑤pa ni chos kyi dran pas 'dul ba sbyin pa yin te/ gsum po 'di dag ni chos kyi dran pas 'dul ba sbyin pa yin no//dge slong dag de ltar na dran pas 'dul bar 'os pa ni rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa yin zhing / de ltar na 'di na kha cig gi rtsod pa rnams 'di lta ste/ dran pas 'dul bar 'os pa'i artsod pa zhi bar byed pas dul ⑦ba dang zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi ba yin no/ /dge slong dag ji ltar na ma smyos ⑧pas 'dul bar 'os pa⑨/rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa yin/ ji ltar na 'di na kha cig gi rtsod pa rnams 'di lta ste / ma smyos pas 'dul bar 'os pa'i rtsod pa zhi bar byed pas dul ba dang /zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi ba yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dge slong bye ma skyes smyos/sems 'khrugs/ tshor bas nyen nas sgren mor byung ste dge sbyong gi tshul ma yin pa / rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa mang du spyad/ smras/ brtsal nas kha chu zags0la/ mig gyur/ bzhin gyur te gnyid kyis ma log par gnyid kyis log go snyam du shes/ pha rol gyis ma smras par smras so snyam du shes so/ /dus 3—596

gzhan zhig na des rang gi sems sor chud pa dang / de la dge slong rnams gzhi des gleng ①bar byed de/ de la gzhi des gleng bar byed pa na dge 'dun la ma smyos pas 'dul ba gsol ba'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed kyis dge slong bye ma skyes dang / gzhan yang de lta bu dang mthun pa su yang rung ba la ma smyos pas 'dul ba byin cig /sbyin pa ni 'di ltar ②bya ste/gnas mal bshams la gaṇḍi brdungs te/ dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo la/ dge 'dun thams cad tshogs shing mthun par gyur pa dang / dge slong bye ma skyes kyis bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar ②te/ rgan pa ji lta ba bzhin du gdud ④pa byas la rgan pa'i mthar tsog tsog por 'dug ⑤ste thal mo sbyar la tshig 'di skad ces/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/bdag dge slong bye ma skyes smyos/ sems 'khrugs/ tshor bas nyen nas sgren mor byung ste dge sbyong yigi tshul ma yin pa⑦/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa mang du spyad/ smras/ brtsal nas kha chu zags/ mig gyur/ bzhin gyur te/gnyid kyis ma log par gnyid kyis log go snyam du 'tshal/ pha rol gyis ma smras par smras so snyam du 'tshal ba las dus gzhan zhig na bdag sems sor chud pa dang bdag la dge slong rnams gzhi des gleng bar bgyid cing / bdag la gzhi des gleng bar bgyid pa dge 'dun la ma smyos pas 'dul ba gsol na/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams ༷thugs brtse ba can thugs brtse ba nye bar bzung ste/bdag dge slong bye ma skyes la ma smyos pas 'dul ba stsal du gsol/ de skad lan gnyis lan gsum du brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dge slong gcig gis 3—597

gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/dge slong bye ma skyes 'di smyos/ sems 'khrugs/ tshor bas nyen nas sgren mor byung ste dge sbyong gi tshul ma lags pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma lags pa mang du spyad/ smras/ brtsal nas kha chu zags/ mig gyur/ bzhin gyur te gnyid kyis ma log par gnyid kyis log go snyam du 'tshal/ pha rol kyis ma smras par smras so snyam du 'tshal ba las dus gzhan zhig na 'dis rang gi sems sor chud pa dang 'di la dge slong rnams 0gleng bar bgyid cing / 'di la gzhi des gleng bar bgyid pa dge 'dun la ma smyos pas 'dul ba gsol na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi ②dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong bye ma skyes la ma smyos pa'i ③'dul ba stsol 0bar mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las bya ba ni/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol dge slong bye ma skyes 'di smyos/ sems 'khrugs / tshor khros nyen nas sgron mor byung ste dge sbyong gi tshul ma lags pa/rjes su mthun pa ma lags pa mang du spyad/ smras/ brtsal nas kha chu zags/mig gyur/ bzhin gyur te gnyid kyis ma log par gnyid kyis log go snyam du 'tshal / pha rol gyis ma smras par smras so snyam du 'tshal ba las dus gzhan zhig na 'dis rang gi sems sor chud ༷pa dang 'di la dge slong rnams gzhi des cigleng bar bgyid cing / 'di la gzhi des gleng bar bgyid pa dge 'dun las rjom smyos pas 'dul ba gsol te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis dge slong bye ma skyes la ma smyos pas 'dul ba stsal ⑦bar mdzad na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong bye ma skyes la ma smyos pas 'dul ba stsol ⑧bar mdzad par bzod pa de 3—598

dag ni cang ma gsung ①shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung ②shig / 'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du las brjod pa gnyis pa dang gsum gyi bar du brjod par bya'o/ /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas ③dge 'dun gyis/ dge slong bye ma skyes la ma smyos pas 'dul ba stsal lags te/'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /chos ma yin pa'i ma smyos pas 'dul bar 'os pa ④phyin pa gcig de la 0chos kyi dugacig go/ /chos ma yin pa'i gcig gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dge slong ma smyos par bdag ni smyos so/ /sems ma 'khrugs par sems 'khrugs so snyam du shes pa dang /dge 'dun gyis ⑦de la ma smyos par ⑧'dul bar 'os pa sbyin pa ni chos ma yin pa'i ma smyos pas 'dul bar 'os pa sbyin pa yin te/ 'di ni chos ma yin pa'i gcig yin no/ /chos kyi gcig gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste dge slong bye ma skyes smyos/sems 'khrugs/ tshor bas nyen nas sgren mor byung ste dge sbyong gi tshul ma ⑨yin pa/ rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa mang du spyad/ smras/ brtsal nas kha chu zags/ mig gyur/ bzhin gyur te de gnyid kyis ma log par gnyid kyis log go snyam du shes/ pha rol gyis ma smras par smras so snyam du shes pa las dus gzhan zhig na des rang gi sems sor chud pa dang / de la yidage slong rnams gzhi des gleng bar byed cing / de la gzhi des gleng bar byed pa na dge 'dun la ma smyos pas 'dul bar 'os pa gsol te/ dge 'dun gyis de la ma smyos pas 'dul bar 'os pa sbyin pa ni chos kyi ma smyos pas 'dul bar 'os pa sbyin pa ste/'di ni chos kyi gcig yin no/ /dge slong dag de ltar na ma smyos pas 'dul bar 'os pa ni rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa yin zhing / de ltar na 'di na ⑩kha cig gi 3—599

rtsod pa rnams ①dul ba dang / zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi ba yin no/ /dge slong dag gdams ngag med pa'i rtsod pa la gartsod pa zhi bar bya ba'i chos 'di gsum gyis dul bar bya/ zhi bar bya/ nye bar zhi bar bya ba ni 'di lta ste/mngon sum du 'dul bar 'os pa dang / dran pas 'dul bar 'os pa dang /ma smyos pas 'dul bar 'os pas so//dge slong dag ①lhung ba'i rtsod pa la 0rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa'i chos bzhis dul bar bya/ zhi bar bya/ nye bar zhi bar bya'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ khas blang bar 'os pa dang / mngon sum du 'dul bar 'os pa dang / de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug ⑤par 'os pa dang / rtswa dubakram pa lta bur 'os pas so/ /dge slong dag ji ltar na khas blang bar 'os pa ni rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa yin/ ji ltar na 'di na kha cig gi 0rtsod pa rnams 'di lta ste/ khas blang bar bya'os pa'i rtsod pa zhi bar byed pas dul ba dang / zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi ba yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste dge slong ltung ba byung bar gyur pa de la gzhi des glengs kyang ⑨rung ma glengs kyang 0rung / dran par byas kyang rung dran par ma byas kyang rung /dge slong zhig 0gi mdun 'du 'dug nas 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la nyung ba 'di lta bu zhig byung ba de bdag gis tshe dang ldan pa'i mdun du mthol zhing bshags par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis mthol zhing bshags na bde ba la 4)reg par 8'gyur gyi/ ma mthol ma bshags na ni ma lags so/ /des ltung ba mthong ngam zhes brjod par bya'o/ /des kyang ltung ba mthong ngo zhes zerjod par bya'o/ /snga ma shos kyis phyis sdom par byed dam zhes brjod par bya'o/ /phyi ma shos kyis bgyid do zhes brjod par bya 3—600

ste / 'di ni khas blang ba'o/ /chos ma yin pa'i khas blang ba sbyin pa bcu dang /chos kyi bcu'o/ /chos ma yin pa'i khas blang ba sbyin pa ①bcu gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ dge slong phas pham pa'i ltung ba byung ②la bdag la ma byung ngo snyam du shes pa de la dge 'dun gyis khas len du 'jug pa ni chos ma yin pa'i khas len pa sbyin pa yin no/ /dge 'dun lhag ①ma dang / lhung byed dang / so sor bshags pa dang / nyes byas kyi ltung ba byung ba la bdag la ma byung ngo snyam du shes pa de la rjodage 'dun gyis ⑤khas len du 'jug pa ni chos ma yin pa'i khas len du dusbyin pa yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong phas pham pa'i ltung ba ma byung ba ⑦la bdag la labyung ngo snyam du shes pa de la dge 'dun gyis khas len du 'jug pa ni chos ma yin pa'i khas len pa sbyin pa yin no/ /dge 'dun lhag ma dang /ltung byed dang / so sor bshags pa dang / nyes byas kyi ltung ba ma byung ba la bdag la byung ngo snyam du shes pa de la dge 'dun gyis khas len du 'jug pa ni chos ma yin pa'i khas len pa sbyin pa ste/ 'di dag ni chos ma yin pa'i khas len pa sbyin pa bcu yin no/ /chos kyi khas len pa sbyin pa bcu gang zhe na/'di lta ste dge slong phas pham pa'i ltung ba byung ⑨la bdag la byung ngo snyam du shes pa de la dge 'dun gyis khas len du 'jug pa ni chos kyi khas len pa sbyin pa yin no / /dge 'dun lhag ma dang / ltung byed dang / so sor bshags pa dang /nyes byas kyi ltung ba byung ba ⑨ la bdag la byung ngo snyam du shes pa de la dge 'dun gyis khas len du 'jug pa ni chos kyi khas len pa sbyin pa yin no/ /'di lta ste dge slong phas pham pa'i ltung ba ma byung ba yil bdag la ma byung ngo snyam du shes pa de la dge 'dun gyis khas len du 'jug pa ni chos kyi 8khas len pa sbyin pa yin no//3—601

dge 'dun lhag ma dang / lhung byed dang / so sor bshags pa dang / nyes byas kyi ltung ba ma byung ①la bdag la ma byung ngo snyam du shes pa de la dge 'dun gyis khas len du 'jug pa ni chos kyi ②khas len pa sbyin pa ste/ 'di dag ni chos kyi ②khas len pa snisbyin pa bcu yin no/ /dge slong dag de ltar ⑤na khas blang bar 'os pa ni rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa yin zhing / de ltar na 'di na kha cig gi durtsod pa rnams 'di lta ste/ khas blang bar 'os pa'i rtsod pa zhi bar byed pas dul ba dang / zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi ba duyin no//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi ⑧kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa ri dgas 'dzin gyi bu nag po yangs pa can gyi 0spre'u rdzing gi 'gram na khang pa brtsegs pa'i gnas na 'dug go/ /de tshul brten nas yangs pa can gyi litstsha bī rnams sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la lhag par bya ba byed pa dang /yangs pa can gyi dge slong rnams kyis bsams pa/ tshe dang ldan pa ri dgas 'dzin gyi bu nag po 'di gzhan nyid du btsas la gzhan du chen por gyur pa ste/mnyan yod du skyes pa de la yangs pa can gyi litstsha bī rnams lhag par dad par ⑪byed kyis8/ de la gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bya ste/ des na de la yangs pa can gyi litstsha bī rnams ma dad pa skyes par 4)'gyur ro snyam du bsams nas de la klan ka tsunyetshol bar gyur to/ /ji tsam na khyim bdag cig gis sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bsro khang tho)gi khrus la spyan drangs pa dang /dge slong rnams kyis gzar tho)thag la chos gos rnams bkal te khrus bya bar brtsams so/ /tshe dang ldan pa ri dgas 'dzin gyi bu nag pos kyang shes bzhin 3—602

gyis mtha' gcig tu chos gos bzhag nas khrus bya bar brtsams so/ /dge slong gzhan zhig gis kyang phyogs de nyid du chos gos bzhag go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa ri dgas 'dzin gyi bu nag pos khrus byas nas 'di nyid bdag nyid kyi ①chos gos yin no snyam nas dge slong de'i chos gos bgos te song ngo / ji tsam na dge slong de langs na rang gi chos gos ②mi snang nas des dge slong rnams la dris pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag kho bo'i chos gos sus brkus/ ji tsam na phyogs de na tshe dang ldan pa ri dgas 'dzin gyi bu nag po'i lhan cig gnas pa 'dug pa des thos nas des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa mkhan pos phyogs 'dir chos gos bzhag na des nor te khyer bar ma gyur grang / re zhig kho bos song la mkhan po la dri'o zhes des ②mkhan po'i drung du song ste smras pa/ mkhan po khyod kyis su zhig gi chos gos blangs/ des smras pa/ bu 0kho bo'i'o/ /mkhan po dge slong che ge mo zhig gi ⑤chos gos phyogs de nyid du bzhag pa de kha mchis dulags so//bu gal te de lta na chos gos de dag khyer te shog shig blta'o/ /des tshukhyer te 'ongs nas mkhan po chos gos 'di ngo mkhyen par mdzod cig /des ngo shes nas bu ngas nor bar khyer te 'ongs kyisal/ dge slong de'i 'di dag yin gyis ⑨skyol cig /des khyer te dge slong de'i drung du song nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa chos gos 'di dag mkhan pos nor te khyer ro/ /des smras pa/ des rku ⑩sems kyis blangs pas phas pham pa'i ltung ba byung ngo / /de nas glags tshol ba'i dge slong ⑩rnams kyis de la gleng ba ma byas dran par ma byas par mthus gnas nas dbyung ba'i las byas so/ /tshe dang ldan pa ri dgas 'dzin gyi bu nag pos bsams pa/ bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams dad pa skye bar ⑩ni dka' la ma 3—603

dad pa skye bar ni bla ①bas gal te 'dug par gyur ②na gdon mi za bar yangs pa can gyi litstsha bī rnams ma dudad pa skye bar 'gyur gyis④/ mdor na mnyan yod kho nar 'gro'o snyam nas/ des yangs pa can gyi litstsha bī rnams la ma bltas par des lhung bzad dang chos gos blangs nas mnyan yod gang na ba der rgyu zhing song ste/ rim gyis ⑤rgyu zhing song ba na mnyan yod du phyin pa dang / de dudage slong rnams kyis mthong nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa nag po 'ongs pa legs so/ /'ongs pa legs so/ /khyod mthong ba ni kho bo cag dga' na 'ongs pa dum yin no/ /ci'i phyir 'di ltar khyod la brten nas yangs pa can gyi litstsha bī rnams sangs rgyas la mngon par dad/ chos dang / dge 'dun la mngon par dad pas sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la lhag par bya ba byed do/ /des smras pa/ de ni mad med kyi 6)yangs pa can gyi dge slong rnams kyis bdag la gleng ba ⑨ma byas dran par ma byas par mthus gnas nas dbyung ba'i las byas so zhes pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong 'dug shig /khyod ngas chos kyis bslang sngo )bar bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyis bslang phonyengo / /yangs pa can gyi dge slong rnams bdag cag gis dge slong nag po skyon med pa gnod pa ma byas pa la mthus gnas nas dbyung 8ba'i las byas pa gang yin pa ni ma legs pa zhig byas so zhes 'gyod pa skyes nas/ de rnams lhung bzed dang chos gos blangs te mnyan yod gang na ba der rgyu zhing song ba las/ de rnams kyis lam kur tsodage slong zhig mthong nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod gang nas 'ongs/ mnyan yod nas so/ /khyod 3—604

kyis ri dgas 'dzin gyi bu nag po mthong ngam/ mthong ngo / /de ci bya/ kho bo cag gis de skyon med pa gnod pa ma byas pa la gleng ba ma byas/ dran par ma byas par mthus gnas nas dbyung ba'i las byas so/ /bslang zin no②/ /sus/ bcom ldan 'das kyis so/ /de na ②kha cig gis ni ①'di skad ces smras so/ /bslang dub ni ma yin gyi thag bsring bar bslang ba yin te/ 'di ltar de bdag cag gis gnas nas dbyung ba'i las byas la/ bdag cag gis ⑤mngon sum du ma gyur par de bslang ba ni rigs pa ma yin no/ /kha cig gis smras pa/ gal te bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rje/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi durjes bslang na legs par bslang ba yin no/ /de rnams rim gyis dumanyan yod du phyin pa dang lhung bzed dang / chos gos mkhos su phab nas rkang pa gnyis bkrus te/ bcom ldan 'das gang dun ba der song nas phyin pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑨zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 0 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la yangs pa can gyi dge slong rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag cag byis ⑩pa/blun pa/ mi gsal yib/ mi mkhas pa rnams kyis ri dgas 'dzin gyi bu nag po skyon ma mchis pa gnod pa ma bgyis pa la gleng 8ba ma bgyis/ dran par tsom bgyis par mthus gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bgyis pa bdag cag 'gyod pa skyes nas ri dgas 'dzin gyi bu nag po la bzod pa gsol du 'dir mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rtsod pa de de bzhin gshegs pas 'di lta ste chos kyis bslang 4)zin no/ /btsun pa bdag cag gis shul 4)kar dge slong zhig las bcom ldan 'das kyis rtsod pa de 'di lta ste/3—605

chos kyis bslang ①lags so zhes thos te/ de lta lags mod kyi bdag cag gi nang na kha cig gi ②mchid nas 'di skad ces/ bslang ③ba ma lags kyi 0thag bsring bar bslang dub lags te/ 'di ltar der bdag cag mngon sum du ma gyur to zhes mchi'o/ /gzhan dag ni gal te bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rje/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi rjes bslang ba ni legs par bslang ba lags ༷so zhes mchi'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ kye ma'o nga'i nyan thos rnams ni 'di lta ste/ ston pa'i bstan pa chos 'dul bas rtsod pa skyes ④shing byung ba zhi bar bya bar 'dod do snyam du dgongs nas/ dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag ji ltar na mngon sum du 'dul bar 'os pa ni rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa yin/ ji ltar na 'di na kha cig gi rtsod pa rnams 'di lta ste/ mngon sum du 'dul bar 'os pa'i rtsod pa zhi bar byed pas dul ⑧ba dang / zhi ba dang /nye bar zhi ba yin zhe na/ dge slong dag 'di la chos 'dul bas gang zag gis gang zag la mig bzhi mngon sum du gleng ba dang / chos 'dul bas gnyis kyis ⑨mang po dang / dge 'dun la mig bzhi mngon sum du gleng ba dang / chos 'dul bas gang zag gnyis kyis gang zag la mig bzhi 0mngon sum du gleng ba dang / chos 'dul bas gang zag gnyis kyis tunyeganyis dang mang po dang /dge 'dun la mig bzhi mngon sum du gleng ba dang ⑫/ chos 'dul bas gang zag mang pos gang zag la mig bzhi mngon sum du gleng ba dang / chos 'dul bas gang zag mang pos gnyis dang / mang po dang / dge 'dun la mig bzhi mngon sum du gleng ba dang / chos 'dul bas dge 'dun gyis gang zag la mig bzhi mngon sum du gleng ba dang / chos 'dul bas dge 'dun gyis gnyis dang 3—606

mang po dang / dge 'dun la mig bzhi mngon sum du gleng ba'o/ /chos ma yin pa'i mngon sum du 'dul bar 'os pa sbyin pa bcu drug dang / chos kyi bcu drug go/ /chos ma yin pa'i bcu drug gang zhe na/ gang zag chos dang mi mthun pas gang zag chos dang mthun pa dang / gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa gnyis kyis gang zag chos dang mthun pa dang / gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa ①mang pos gang zag chos dang mthun pa dang / dge 'dun chos dang mi mthun pas gang zag chos dang mthun pa dang / gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa gnyis kyis gang zag chos dang mthun pa dang / gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa gnyis kyis gang zag chos dang mthun pa gnyis dang / gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa gnyis kyis gang zag chos dang mthun pa mang po dang / gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa gnyis kyis dge 'dun chos dang mthun pa dang / gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa mang pos gang zag chos dang mthun pa dang / gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa mang pos gang zag chos dang mthun pa gnyis dang / gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa mang pos gang zag chos dang mthun pa mang po dang / gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa mang pos dge 'dun chos dang mthun pa dang / dge 'dun chos dang mi mthun pas gang zag chos dang mthun pa dang / dge 'dun chos dang mi mthun pas gang zag chos dang mthun pa gnyis dang / dge 'dun chos dang mi mthun pas gang zag chos dang mthun pa mang po dang / dge 'dun chos dang mi mthun pas dge 'dun chos dang mthun pa ste/ 'di dag ni chos ma yin pa'i mngon sum du 'dul bar 'os pa sbyin pa bcu drug yin no/ /chos kyis ②mngon sum du 'dul bar 'os pa sbyin pa bcu drug gang zhe na/ gang zag chos 3—607

dang mthun pas gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa dang / gang zag chos dang mthun pas gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa gnyis dang / gang zag chos dang mthun pas gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa mang po dang / gang zag chos dang mthun pas dge 'dun chos dang mi mthun pa dang / gang zag chos dang mthun pa gnyis kyis gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa dang / gang zag chos dang mthun pa gnyis kyis gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa gnyis dang / gang zag chos dang mthun pa gnyis kyis gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa mang po dang / gang zag chos dang mthun pa gnyis kyis dge 'dun chos dang mi mthun pa dang / gang zag chos dang mthun pa mang pos gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa dang / gang zag chos dang mthun pa mang pos gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa gnyis dang /gang zag chos dang mthun pa mang pos gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa mang po dang /gang zag chos dang mthun pa mang pos dge 'dun chos dang mi mthun pa dang /dge 'dun chos dang mthun pas gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa dang / dge 'dun chos dang mthun pas gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa gnyis dang / dge 'dun chos dang mthun pas gang zag chos dang mi mthun pa mang po dang / dge 'dun chos dang mthun pas dge 'dun chos dang mi mthun pa ste/ 'di dag ni chos kyi ①mngon sum du 'dul bar 'os pa sbyin pa bcu drug yin no/ /dge slong dag de ltar na mngon sum du 'dul bar 'os pa ni rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa yin zhing / de ltar na 'di na kha cig gi rtsod pa rnams 'di lta ste/ mngon sum du 'dul bar 'os pa'i rtsod pa zhi bar byed pas dul ba dang / zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi ba yin no/ /dge slong dag ji ltar na de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug ②3—608

par 'os pa ni rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa yin/ ji ltar na 'di na kha cig gi rtsod pa rnams 'di lta ste/ de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug ①par 'os pa'i rtsod pa zhi bar byed pas dul ba dang / zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi ba yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/dge slong me ②bzhi dge 'dun gyi nang du ltung ba brjed ②pa las/ brjed 0pa slar dran te shes pa las yang brjed 0pa'i skabs de dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed 0kyis dge slong me bzhi dang / gzhan yang de lta bu dang mthun pa su yang rung ba la de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug ⑦par 'os pa byin cig /sbyin pa ni 'di ltar bya ste/ gnas mal bshams la gasnyi brdungs te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo la/ dge 'dun thams cad tshogs shing mthun par gyur pa dang / dge slong me bzhis bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas durgan pa'i mthar tsog tsog por 'dug la thal ⑨me sbyar te de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug par 'os pa gsol ba bya ste(3 / dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag dge slong me bzhi dge 'dun gyi nang du ltung ba bskyud pa las/ bskyud pa slar dran te 'tshal ba las yang bskyud nas dge 'dun la bdag de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug par 'os pa gsol na/ dge 'dun btsun pa thugs brtse 0ba can thugs brtse ba nye bar bzung ste/ bdag dge slong me bzhi la de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug par 'os pa stsal du gsol/ de skad lan gnyis lan gsum du brjod par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/dge slong me bzhi 'di dge 'dun gyi nang du ltung ba bskyud pa las bskyud 8pa slar 3—609

dran te 'tshal ba dang / yang bskyud ①nas dge slong me bzhi 'di dge 'dun la de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug par 'os pa gsol na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi ②dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / 'di ltar dge 'dun gyis dge slong me bzhi la de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug par 'os pa stsol ③bar mdzad do/ 'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni du'adi ltar bya ste/dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong me bzhi 'di dge 'dun gyi nang du lhung ba bskyud pa las/ bskyud pa slar dran te 'tshal ba dang yang bskyud nas 'di ltar dge 'dun gyis dge slong me bzhi dul de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug par 'os pa stsol bar mdzad na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong me bzhi la de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug par 'os pa stsol bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung dushig /gang dag 0mi bzod pa de gyedag ni gsung 0shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du las brjod pa gnyis pa tsodang /gsum gyi bar du brjod par bya'o/ /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis dge slong me bzhi la de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug yipar 'os pa stsal lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de tsobazhin du 'dzin to/ /ngas de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug par 'os pa byin pa'i dge slong gi kun du spyod pa'i chos bca' bar bya ste/ de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug par 'os pa byin pa'i dge slong gis rab tu dbyung bar mi bya/ bsnyen par rdzogs par tho)mi bya/gnas mi sbyin/ dge tshul gzhag par mi bya/ 'dis tsolas mi bya/ las byed par bsko bar mi bya/ 'dis dge slong ma la gdams thostengag sbyin par mi bya/dge slong ma'i gdams (stongag ston par bsko bar 4)mi bya/ sngon bskos tunyen 3—610
