yang dge slong ma la gdams ①ngag sbyin par mi bya/ 'dis dge slong la tshul khrims nyams pa dang / lta ba nyams pa dang / spyod pa nyams pa dang /'tsho ba nyams pas gleng bar mi bya/ dran par mi bya ste/ 'dis gdams khrungag dbog par mi bya/ gso sbyong la ma yin/ dgag dbye la ma yin/ gsol ba la ma yin/ gsol ba dang gnyis la ma yin/ gsol ba dang bzhi'i las la ma yin zhing / gang dag 'dul ba 'dzin pa ③gzhan yod na dge 'dun gyi nang du 'dul ba gdon par yang mi bya'o/ /de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug par 'os pa byin pa'i dge slong gis kun du spyod pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa bzhin yang dag par blangs te 'jug par mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /chos ma yin pa'i dude'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug par 'os pa sbyin pa chos ma yin pa dugacig dang chos kyi gcig go/ /chos ma yin pa'i gcig gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste dge slong gzhi can dge 'dun gyi nang du lhung ba dran te shes pa las brjed pa de brjed na 0yang dran pa de la dge 'dun gyis de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug par 'os pa sbyin pa ni chos ma yin pa'i de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug par 'os pa sbyin pa ste/ 'di ni chos ma yin pa'i gcig yin no/ /chos kyi gcig gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/dge slong gzhi can dge 'dun gyi ⑦nang du ltung ba brjed pa las brjed pa slar dran te shes pa dang ②yang brjed pa de la dge 'dun gyis de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug par 'os pa sbyin pa nyuni chos kyis 0de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug par 'os pa sbyin pa ste/ 'di ni chos kyi gcig yin no/ /dge slong dag de ltar na de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug par 'os pa ni rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa yin zhing / de ltar na 'di na kha cig gi rtsod pa rnams 'di lta ste/ de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug 3—611

par 'os pa'i rtsod pa zhi bar byed pas dul ba dang / zhi ba dang / nye bar zhi ba yin no/ /dge slong dag ji ltar na rtswa ①bkram pa lta bur ②'os pa ni rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa yin/ ji ltar na 'di na kha cig gi rtsod pa rnams 'di lta ste/ rtswa ③bkram pa lta bur 'os pa'i rtsod pa zhi bar byed pas rjodul ba dang / zhi ba dang /nye bar zhi ba yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste dge slong rnams 'thab 0par gyur cing mtshang 'dru ba dang / 'thab mo dang / 'gyed par gyur nas gnas shing phyogs dang phyogs gzhan du rnam par gnas na/ phyogs gcig na dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan gang yang rung ba/ shes nyen can shes nyen ducan gang yang rung ba/gtso bo gtso bo gang yang rung ba yod pa gang yin pa des rang gi phyogs kyi drung du song ste tshig 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag cag legs par gsungs pa'i ④chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung nas 'thab ⑧par gyur cing mtshang 'dru ba dang / 'thab mo dang / 'gyed par gyur pa ni0/ bdag cag gis rnyed pa rnyed pa ma yin te/ nyes pa rnyed kyi legs pa ma rnyed pas tshe dang ldan pa dag gzhi 'di la kho bo dang khyod kyi ltung ba byung ba gang yin pa las kha na ma tho ba sbom po'am / khyim na gnas pa las 0brten pa ma gtogs par 7kho bos bdag dang khyod kyi tsoched du tshe dang ldan pa de dag gi 8drung du mi bcab par mthol zhing bshags par spro'o zhes smra bar bya'o/ /gal te dge slong de la rang gi phyogs nas dge slong gcig gis tsunyekyang smras pa ma bzlog cing mi gshe na/ de nas tsodage slong des phyogs cig shos kyi drung du song nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar tsote rgan rims yonyeji lta ba bzhin du 'dud 4)pa byas la tsog tsog por 'dug ste tshig 'di skad ces/ tshe dang ldan pa dag kho bo cag legs par gsungs pa'i 3—612

chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung nas 'thab ①par gyur cing mtshang 'dru ba dang /'thab mo dang / 'gyed par gyur pa ni kho bo cag gis rnyed pa rnyed pa ma yin te/nyes pa rnyed kyi legs pa ma rnyed pas gzhi 'di la kho bo dang tshe dang ldan pa de dag gi ltung ba byung ba gang yin pa las kha na ma tho ba sbom po'am/ khyim na gnas pa las ②brten pa ma gtogs par ②kho bos bdag dang tshe dang ldan pa de dag gi ched du khyed kyi drung du mi bcab par mthol zhing bshags par spro'o zhes smra bar bya'o / /phyogs cig shos na rjodage slong gnas brtan gnas brtan gang yang rung ba/ shes nyen can shes nyen ducan gang yang rung ba/ gtso bo gtso bo gang yang rung ba yod pa gang yin pa des kyang rang gi phyogs kyi drung du song ste tshig 'di skad ces/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag cag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung nas 'thab 0par gyur cing mtshang 'dru ba dang /'thab mo dang / 'gyed par gyur pa ni bdag cag gis rnyed pa rnyed pa ma yin te/nyes pa rnyed kyis tshulegs pa ma rnyed pas/ tshe dang ldan pa dag dugazhi 'di la kho bo dang khyed kyi ltung ba byung ba gang yin pa las kha na ma tho ba sbom po'am/ khyim na gnas pa las ⑨brten pa ma gtogs par tsokho bos bdag dang khyed kyi yiched du tshe dang ldan pa de dag gi drung du mi bcab par mthol phyezhing bshags phyepar spro'o zhes smra bar bya'o/ /gal te dge slong de la rang gi phyogs nas dge slong gcig gis kyang smras pa ma bzlog cing mi gshe na/ de nas dge slong des 8phyogs cig shos kyi drung du song nas bla gos phrag pa 8gcig tu gzar te rgan rims ⑩ji lta ba bzhin du 'dud pa byas la tsog tsog por 'dug ste tshig 'di skad ces/ tshe dang ldan pa dag kho bo cag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung nas 3—613

'thab ①par gyur cing mtshang 'dru ba dang / 'thab mo dang / 'gyed par gyur pa ni kho bo cag gis rnyed pa rnyed pa ma yin te/ nyes pa rnyed kyis ②legs pa ma rnyed pas gzhi 'di la kho bo dang tshe dang ldan pa de dag gi lhung ba byung ba gang yin pa las kha na ma tho ba sbom po'am/ khyim na gnas pa la ①brten pa ma gtogs par dukho bos bdag dang tshe dang ldan pa de dag gi ched du khyed kyi drung du mi 'chab par mthol zhing bshags par spro'o zhes smra bar bya'o/ /gang gi tshe phyogs cig shos kyis ⑤cig shos la'am/ cig shos kyis cig shos la spu sa rjol ltung ba lta bur byed/ 'byung bar skyong ⑦/ mtshungs par sgre bar ston par byed ⑤kyi phan tshun du ltung ba sgrogs par 0gleng bar mi byed na de ltar na rtsod pa de 'di lta ste/ rtswa bkram pa lta bur 'os pas zhi ba yin te/ dge slong dag de ltar na rtswa ⑩bkram pa lta bur 'os pa ni rtsod pa zhi bar byed pa yin zhing / de ltar na 'di na kha cig gi rtsod pa rnams 'di lta ste/ rtswa 0bkram pa lta bur 'os pa'i rtsod pa zhi bar byed pas dul ba dang zhi ba dang nye bar zhi ba yin no/ /dge slong dag ltung ba'i rtsod pa ni 8zhi bar byed pa'i chos bzhi po 'dis dul bar bya/zhi bar bya/ nye bar zhi bar bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ khas blang bar 'os 0pa dang /mngon sum du 'dul bar 'os pa dang / de'i ngo bo nyid tshol du gzhug ④par 'os pa dang / rtswa bkram pa lta bur 'os pas so//dge slong dag tsobya ba'i rtsod pa ni dge 'dun mthun pas zhi bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gnas gang na dge slong zhig (9gnas pa de na 'thab pa med/mtshang ⑩'dru ba med/ 'thab mo med/ 'gyed pa med do/ /gang na gnyis yod pa de na yang 'thab pa med/ mtshang 'dru ba med/ 'thab mo med/3—614

'gyed pa med do/ /gang na gsum yod pa de na yang 'thab pa med/ mtshang 'dru ba med/ 'thab mo med/ 'gyed pa med do/ /gang na dge slong bzhi'am lhag pa gnas pa de na ni 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru ba dang /'thab mo dang / 'gyed pa yod do/ /dge slong dag /tshangs pa ji ①bzhin gcig de bzhin/ /brgya byin ji bzhin gnyis de bzhin/ /rgyal po ji bzhin gsum de bzhin/ /de las lhag pa 'khrug par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na rjes su gnang ste/ tshig ②bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig 'dzin pa gang yin pa de la yang chos kyi rnyed pa sbyin par bya zhing /des kyang longs spyad ②par bya ste/ 'di la ni du'agyod par ni mi bya'o/ /rtsod pa'i gzhi ⑤rdzogs sorjo// //'dul ba gzhiX/ bam po brgyad bcu pa/ dge 'dun dbyen dugyi bsdus pa'i sdom ni/ mang pos bkur ⑨dang lha g.yos dang / /ba gam rnyings ⑩dang bzang po dang / /'khor dang kauṇḍin 0rdzu 'phrul dang / / kau shi ka 0zos dang ba dang / /mnar med lhag gyur phyi ma'o// //sdom ni/ mang pos bkur dang seng ge'i 'gram/ /legs par rab sad de bzhin du/ /dga' ldan 'dod pa'i ris tsodang ni/ /'dun pas 'dug dang gzhong pa dang / /srin bu go cha ④bzang len dang / /lhar tsobacas pa dang de bcu'o/ /yangs pa can du bstan pa dang / /rab sbyin dang ni ⑩grags 'dzin dang / /dang ba dang ni mkhas pa byadang / /sa 'tsho ma ni bstan pa dang / /'dzam bu ri dgas nang skyes dang / /rigs bdun ngan spong bu 3—615

dang ni/ /rgyal po'i ①khab dang dka' thub dang / /ring ②'phur dka' spyod dga' bo dang / /nag po bkra shis de bzhin du/ /bdud gzhom pa ni byas pa dang / /'khor ni mdo ru bsdus pa'o/ /gru 'dzin du dgra 'dul dang brgya tham pa'o/ /dmag gis mi tshugs su ma rgyal ba las rgyal dang lnga khri bzhi stong ngo //bā rā ṇa sīr bzod dka' dang drug khri sum stong ngo / /kyim pi lar tshangs sbyin dang brgyad khri bzhi stong ngo / /glang po che'i grong du glang pos sbyin dang sum khri nyis stong ngo / /rdo 'jog tu bal bu can dang lnga stong ngo / /brang ②gis nyal du tshan po che 'dul dang sum khri nyis stong ngo / /ma rgyal ba las rgyal du rgyal dubyin dang sum khri nyis dustong ngo / / ka n+ya 0kub dzar ⑦rgyal sde dang sum 0khri nyis stong ngo / /tsam ⑨par klu'i lha dang khri brgyad stong ngo / /ta la'i phreng du mi'i ⑩lha dang nyi 0khri lnga stong ngo / /ta ma lir rgya mtsho'i lha dang khri nyis stong ngo / /ba so'i grong du 7blo gros bzang po dang khri brgyad stong ngo / /rgyal po'i khab tu mun sel tidang nyi khri lnga stong ngo / /bā rā ṇa srir dbang phyug chen po'i sde dang brgya tham pa'o/ /rtswa ④can du rgya mtsho'i 8sde dang brgyad khri ⑩bzhi stong ngo / /gru ⑩'dzin du dka' thub spyod tsodang stong ngo / /rtswa bcan du sa'i gdong dang brgyad khri bzhi stong ngo / /bā rā ṇa sīr sa'i bdag po dang 'bum mo/ /dmag gis mi tshugs par sa pya 'dzin dang 'bum mo/ /mi thi lar lha chen po dang brgyad khri bzhi stong ngo / /yang mi thi lar lha 0chen po nas bzung ste mu khyud nas shing rta sra phyeba'i bar brgyad khri bzhi stong ngo / /kun du snang bar nam mkha'i bdag po dang /klu mnyam 3skyong dang bdun khri bdun stong ngo / /bā rā ṇa sīr kṛ khri dang legs skyes dang brgya tham pa'o/ /gru 'dzin du rna ba can dang bu ram shing pa dang brgya 3wa 616

tham pa'o/ /gru 'dzin du 'phags skyes po ①dang bu ram shing pa la sogs pas khyim gyi bar brgya tham pa'o/ /ser skya'i gzhir shing rta bcu pa nas bzung ste lnga khri lnga stong byung ba la seng ge'i 'gram ②las bzhi ste/ bzhi po de rnams las gnyis gnyis so//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yul ser skya'i gzhi n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ①ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de nas ④ser skya'i gzhi na gnas pa'i shākya rab tu mang po 'dun khang du tshogs shing 'dus nas bar skabs kyi gtam 'di lta bu dag gleng bar byed de/ shes ldan dag shākya rnams ni gang las skyes/ thog ma ni gang yin / rgyu ni ci zhig yin/ shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud 0ni gang yin/gal te bdag cag gi drung du 'ga' zhig 'ongs nas 'di skad 'dri ste/ shes ldan dag shākya rnams ni gang las skyes/ thog ma ni gang yin/ rgyu 0ni ci zhig yin / shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud ⑦ni gang yin ⑧zhes de skad du 'dri ⑨na bdag cag gis ni shākya rnams ⑩gang las skyes pa dang / thog ma gang yin pa dang / rgyu ni ci zhig yin pa dang / shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud yigang yin pa yang mi shes na ji skad du lung bstan/ tshur bdag cag bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong la lhags pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la don 'di nyid zhus nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag la ji skad du lung bstan pa de bzhin du gzung 4)bar bya'o/ /de nas ser skya'i gzhi na gnas pa'i shākya rab tu mang po bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la ser skya'i gzhi'i shākya rnams kyis 3—617

'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa 'dir bdag cag ser skya'i gzhi'i shākya rab tu mang po 'dun khang du tshogs shing 'dus ①nas bar skabs kyi rgyabaka' mchid 'di lta bu dag gleng ste/ shākya rnams ni gang las skyes/ thog ma ni gang yin / rgyu ni ci zhig yin/ shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud ③ni gang yin/gal te bdag cag gi drung du 'ga' zhig 'ongs nas 'di skad ces du'adri ste/shes ldan dag shākya rnams ni gang las skyes/ thog ma ni gang yin/ rgyu ni ci zhig yin/0 shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud ༷ni gang yin zhes de ⑦skad 'dri ⑧na / bdag cag gis ni 0shākya rnams ni gang las skyes/ thog ma ni gang yin/rgyu ni ci zhig yin/ shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud 0ni gang yin pa yang mi shes na ji skad du lung bstan/ tshur bdag cag bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong la lhags pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la don de (7nyid zhus te/bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag la ji skad du lung bstan pa de bzhin du gzung ⑫bar bgyi'o snyam nas/ de'i slad du bcom ldan 'das la bdag cag don 'di nyid zhu (sprelags na/ bcom ldan 'das shākya rnams ni gang las skyes lags/thog ma ni gang lags/ rgyu ni ci zhig lags④/ shākya rnams kyi 8sngon gyi rigs rgyud ni gang lags/ de nas bcom ldan 'das tso'adi snyam du dgongs te/gal te ngas shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud las 0brtsams te 8chos kyi gtam glengs yin mu stegs can dang kun du rgyu gzhan dag 'di skad ces dge sbyong gi ta ma ni ci 'dod pa de lta bu duston pas bdag nyid la stod ⑥par byed do zhes smra ba gang yin pa'i gnas 'di yod pas nga'i nyan thos las shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi ⑫rigs rgyud las brtsams nas chos kyi gtam gleng bar nus pa su yod snyam mo/ /3—618

de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po 'khor de nyid du 'dus shing 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu nga rgyab bsnyung ①bas re zhig de bsal gyis②/ khyod kyis shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud las brtsams nas dge slong rnams la chos kyi gtam bya bar spobs par gyis shig /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos bcom ldan 'das la cang mi smra bas khas blangs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos cang mi smra bas khas blangs par thugs su chud nas/ snam sbyar bltab ste sngas phangs su bcug nas glo g.yas pa ③phab ste/ zhabs kyi steng du zhabs bzhag nas snang ba'i 'du shes dang / dran pa dang / shes bzhin dang ldang ba'i 'du shes kho na yid la mdzad pas dumanal to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po 'di snyam du sems te/ ma la bdag gis sems ji ltar mnyam par gzhag na shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud shākya rnams gang las skyes pa dang / thog ma gang yin pa dang / rgyu ni duci zhig yin pa dang / shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud gang yin pa mthong bar 'gyur ba 0de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug par bya'o/ /snyam nas/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos sems ji ltar mnyam par gzhag na shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud mthong bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i ting nge ⑦'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud shākya rnams gang las skyes pa dang / thog ma gang yin pa dang / rgyu ni ci zhig yin pa dang /shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud ni gang yin pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas ting 3—619

nge 'dzin de las langs te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la stan bshams pa nyid la 'dug go/ /'dug nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos ser skya'i gzhi'i shākya rnams la smras pa/ gi ta ma dag 'jig rten 'di 'jig cing 'jig rten zhig na sems can phal cher 'od gsal gyi lha'i ①ris su skye bar 'gyur te/ de rnams de na yid las byung ba'i ②gzugs phun sum tshogs pa dbang po ma nyams shing ma tshang ba med pa/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa/ kha dog bzang pos gnas pa/ rang gi 'od can/ nam mkha' la 'gro ba/ dga' ba za zhing dga' ba'i ⑧zas kyis tshe ring zhing yun ring du gnas so/ /de'i tshe sa chen po 'di chu 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur zhing mtsho ④gcig tu 'gyur ro/ /sa chen po 'di chu 'ba' zhig gi mtsho gcig tu gyur pa'i steng du rlung gis pris ⑤ma chags pa dang / mkhregs pa dang / khebs par byed do/ /dper na 'o ma bskol ba grangs par 0gyur pa'i steng du rlung gis pris ⑦ma chags pa dang / mkhregs pa dang / khebs pa de bzhin du/ sa chen po 'di chu 'ba' zhig gi mtsho gcig tu gyur pa'i steng du rlung gis bris dum chags pa dang / mkhregs pa dang / khebs par byed do/ /sa'i bcud de ni kha dog phun sum tshogs pa/ dri phun sum tshogs pa dang ⑨/ ro phun sum tshogs pa yin zhing kha dog phun sum tshogs pa ⑩ni 'di lta bu yin te/ dper na mar sar ⑪lta bu'o/ /ro ni 'di lta bu yin te/ dper na sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi 8btsir ba lta bu'i dus gang yin pa 0de yod do/ /gi ta ma dag 'jig rten cigang yin pa de ⑫'chags shing 'jig rten chags na de na ⑩sems can kha cig tshe zad/ las zad/bsod nams zad nas 'od gsal gyi lha'i ris nas shi 'phos nas 'di lta bur 3—620

mi rnams dang / skal ba ①mnyam par 'ong zhing de rnams 'di na yid las byung ba'i gzugs phun sum tshogs pa dbang po ma nyams shing ma tshang ba med pa/yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan zhing kha dog bzang pos gnas pa/rang gi 'od can/ nam mkha' la 'gro ba/ dga' ba za zhing dga' ba'i zas kyis tshe ring zhing yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe nyi ma dang zla ba yang 'jig rten du mi 'byung ste/ rgyu skar rnams kyang med/ skad cig dang /thang cig dang / yud tsam yang med/ mtshan mo dang nyin mo yang med/ zla ba dang / zla ba phyed dang / dus tshigs dang / lo rnams kyang 'jig rten du 'byung ba med do/ /skyes pa dang bud med du mngon pa yang med kyi/gzhan du na sems can sems can zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o/ /de nas ②sems can brkam ②chags kyi rang bzhin can zhig gis mdzub ④mo'i rtse mos sa'i bcud myong ⑤bar byed do/ /ji lta ji ltar myangs pa dude lta de ltar sred do/ /ji lta ⑦ji ltar sred pa de lta de ltar kham gyi zas rim gyis za'o/ /sems can gzhan dag gis kyang sems can de mdzub lamo'i rtse mos sa'i bcud myong ⑨bar byed de/ ji lta ji ltar myangs pa de lta de ltar sred la/ ji lta ji ltar sred pa de lta de ltar kham gyi zas rim gyis za ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas de rnams kyis kyang mdzub tsomo'i rtse mos sa'i bcud myong 0bar rtsom ste/ ji lta ji ltar myangs pa de lta de ltar sred do/ /ji lta ji ltar sred pa de lta de ltar kham gyi 8zas rim gyis za'o / /gang gi tshe sems can de rnams kyis sa'i bcud la kham gyi 0zas rim gyis zos pa de'i tshe de rnams kyi ④lus la mkhrang ba dang lci ba tsozhugs par gyur to//de rnams kyi kha dog bzang po gsal ba gang yin pa de yang nub par gyur pas 3—621

'jig rten du mun pa byung bar gyur to/ /gi ta ma dag chos nyid kyis 'jig rten du mun pa byung na nyi ma dang zla ba gnyis 'jig rten du 'byung ①bar 'gyur ro//rgyu skar dang / skad cig dang / thang cig dang / yud tsam ②dang /mtshan mo dang / nyin mo dang / zla ba dang / zla ba phyed dang / dus tshigs dang / lo 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de rnams de za zhing zas su za ba la ①tshe ring zhing yun ring du gnas so/ /de rnams las kha zas la ches nyung zad du rjoza ba gang yin pa de ni kha dog dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /kha zas la ches mang du za ba gang yin pa de ni kha dog ngan par 'gyur ⑤te/ kha zas kyi tshad gnyis la brten ༷nas kha dog rnam pa gnyis mngon te/ kha dog rnam pa gnyis yod pas/ kye sems can kho bo ni kha dog dang ldan no/ /khyod ⑦ni kha dog ngan pa can ⑧yin no zhes sems can gyis ⑨sems can la khyad du gsod par byed ⑩do/ /kha dog gi mngon pa'i nga rgyal can de rnams sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos de dag nyid blangs pa'i rgyus sa'i bcud de nub par gyur to/ /gi ta ma dag sa'i bcud de nub pa na sems can de rnams tshogs shing 'dus nas 'di skad ces kyi hud bro ba kyi hud bro ba zhes smra zhing smre sngags 'don la mya ngan dang sdug bsngal bar gyur to/ /dper na da ltar gyi 0mi rnams kyis zas zhim po cung zad cig zos nas sngon gyi yi ge dang / tshig dang / tshig 'bru de nyid rjes su dran nas 'di skad ces kyi hud bro ba kyi hud bro ba zhes smra ba 8de bzhin du sems can de rnams sa'i bcud de nub 0pa na tshogs shing 'dus nas 'di skad ces kyi hud bro ba kyi hud bro ba zhes smra zhing smre sngags rdzi'adon la mya ngan dang sdug bsngal bar gyur kyang smras pa 'di'i don ni 'di yin/ smras pa 'di'i don ni 3—622

'di yin no zhes de'i don ni mi shes so/ /gi ta ma dag sems can de rnams kyi sa'i bcud de nub pa nas zhag kha dog phun sum tshogs pa/ dri phun sum tshogs pa/ ro phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur te/ kha dog ni 'di lta bu yin te/ dper na dong ku'i ①me tog lta bu'o/ /ro ni 'di lta bu ②yin te/dper na sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi btsir ba lta bu'o②/ /de rnams de za zhing zas su za ba la 0tshe ring zhing ⑤yun ring du gnas so/ /de rnams las dukha zas la ①ches nyung du za ba gang yin pa de ni kha dog dudang ldan par gyur to/ /kha zas la ches mang du za ba gang yin pa de ni kha dog ngan par gyur to/ /zas kyi tshad gnyis la brten nas kha dog rnam pa gnyis mngon te/ kha dog rnam pa gnyis yod pas kye sems can kho bo ni kha dog dang ldan la①/ khyod ni kha dog ngan pa yin no zhes sems can gyis sems can la khyad du gsod par byed do/ /kha dog gi mngon pa'i nga rgyal can de rnams sdig pa 0mi dge ba'i chos de dag nyid blangs pa'i rgyus sa zhag 0nub par gyur to/ /gi ta ma dag sa zhag de nub par gyur pa na sems can de rnams tshogs shing 'dus nas 'di skad ces kyi hud bro ba kyi hud bro ba zhes smra zhing smre sngags 'don la mya ngan gyis ⑤sdug bsngal bar byed do/ /dper na da ltar mi rnams sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba 'ga' zhig gis reg pa na sngon gyi yi ge dang / tshig dang / tshig 'bru de 0nyid rjes su dran nas 'di skad ces e ma'o kyi hud e ma'o kyi hud ces smra ba de bzhin du/sems can de rnams sa zhag de nub pa na tshogs shing 'dus nas 'di skad ces kyi hud bro ba kyi hud bro ba zhes smra zhing smre sngags 'don la mya ngan dang sdug bsngal bar gyur kyang smras pa'i 8'di'i don 8'di yin/ smras pa ⑩'di'i don ni 'di 3—623

yin no zhes bya bar de'i don ni mi shes so/ /sga ta ma dag sems can de rnams kyi ①sa zhag de nub pa na myu gu'i tshal kha dog phun sum tshogs pa/ dri phun sum tshogs pa/ ro phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ②zhing kha dog ni 'di lta bu yin te/ dper na shing ka dam pa ku'i me tog lta bu'o/ /ro ni 'di lta bu yin te / dper na sbrang ma'i sbrang ②rtsi btsir ba lta bu'o/ /de rnams de za zhing de ④zas su za ba las ①tshe ring zhing yun ring du gnas so/ /de rnams las kha zas la ches nyung bar za ba gang yin pa de ni kha dog dang ldan par gyur to/ /kha zas la ches mang du za ba gang yin pa de ni kha dog ngan par gyur to/ /zas kyi tshad gnyis la brten nas kha dog rnam pa gnyis yin duno/ /kha dog rnam pa gnyis yod pas kye sems can kho bo ni kha dog dang ldan la/ khyod ni kha dog ngan pa yin no zhes sems can gyis sems can la khyad du gsod par byed do/ /kha dog gi mngon pa'i nga rgyal can de rnams sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos de dag nyid blangs pa'i rgyus myu gu'i tshal de nub par gyur to/ /gi ta ma dag myu gu'i tshal de nub par gyur pa na sems can de rnams ⑦tshigs shing 'dus nas 'di skad ces/mdun nas phar song mdun nas phar song zhes smra zhing smre sngags 'don la mya ngan dang sdug bsngal bar gyur to/ /dper na da ltar mi rnams 'ga' zhig la tshig ⑧drag po'i tshar gcad ⑨pas tshar gcad 6) par 'dod pa na sngon gyi yi ge dang /tshig dang / tshig tho)'bru de dag nyid rjes su bzlas 4)shing 'di skad ces/mdun nas phar song mdun nas phar song zhes smra ba de bzhin du sems can de rnams myu gu'i tshal nub pa dang tshogs shing 'dus nas 'di skad ces/ mdun nas phar song mdun nas phar song zhes smra zhing smre sngags 'don la mya ngan dang 3—624

sdug bsngal bar gyur kyang smras pa'i ①'di'i don ni 'di yin/ smras pa 'di'i don ni 'di yin no zhes bya bar de'i don ni ②mi shes so/ /gi ta ma dag sems can de rnams kyi myu gu'i tshal nub nas ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sā lu'i 'bras bu tshon bzhi pa phub ma med pa ②kun ma dumed pa shun pa med pa dag pa dugatsang dum skyes te/ de nub brngas na nang skye zhing smin par 'gyur/ nang brngas na nub ⑦skye zhing smin par 'gyur bas brngas shing brngas kyang slar skyes pas ⑧brngas par yang mi mngon no/ /de rnams de za zhing de zas su za ba la ⑨tshe ring zhing yun ring du gnas so/ /gang nas 0sems can de dag ⑩rnams kyis ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sā lu'i 8'bras bu la kham gyi 0zas su rim gyis zos pa de nas de rnams kyis ④dbang po tha dad pa byung bar gyur to8/ /kha cig la ni skyes pa'i dbang po'o/ /kha cig la ni bud med kyi dbang po'o/ /de na bud med kyi dbang po can gang yin pa rnams dang / skyes pa'i dbang po can gang yin pa rnams gcig la gcig mig gis mig tshugs su lta'ohunye/ /ji lta ji ltar gcig la gcig mig gis mig tshugs su lta ⑩ba de lta de ltar kun du chags so//ji lta ji ltar kun du chags pa de lta de ltar zhen to8/ /ji lta ji ltar zhen pa de lta de ltar log par zhugs so/ /sems can gzhan dag gis kyang sems can gyis yisems can la log par 0zhugs pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang sa dang /bong ba dang / gseg ma dang / gyo mos gtor nas 'di skad ces sems can ngan pa tha chad 0rnams ni ⑤bya ba ma yin pa byed do/ /sems can ngan pa tha chad durnams ni bya ba ma yin pa 'byed pa yin gyis ⑤/ kwa'i sems can khyod kyis da (nyeji ltar sems can sun dbyung ( nyezhes smra'o/ /dper na da ltar mi rnams 3—625

bag ma blangs pa na phye ma dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang / gos dang /'bras yos kyis gtor nas 'di skad ces bag ma bde bar gyur cig ces zer ba de bzhin du sems can rnams kyis sems can gyis sems can la log par zhugs pa mthong nas ①sas gtor zhing ②bong ba dang / gseg ①ma dang / gyo mo rnams kyis kyang gtor nas 'di skad ces sems can ngan pa tha chad ①rnams ni bya ba ma yin pa byed do/ /sems can ngan pa tha chad ①rnams ni bya ba ma yin pa byed pa yin gyisaX/ kwa'i sems can khyod ⑦kyis da ji ltar sems can sun dbyung zhes smra ba'i dus gang yin pa de yod do/ /gi ta ma dag de ltar na sngon chos ma yin par 'dod pa gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi 'dul ba ma yin par 'dod pa gang yin pa de ni da ltar chos su 'dod/ /'dul bar 'dod do/ /sngon smad ⑧par bya bar 'dod pa gang yin pa de ni da ltar bsngags par bya bar 'dod do/ /de rnams kyis de ⑨zhag gcig ()spangs pa nas zhag gnyis dang /gsum dang / bdun du ⑩yang spangs so/ /gang nas sems can de rnams sdig pa can dam pa ma yin pa'i chos de la lhag 8par sdig pa can gyi brtul zhugs spyod pa de nas de rnams khang pa rtsig pa la brtson par byed de/ 'dir bdag cag bya ba ma yin pa spyad ⑩do/ /'dir bdag cag bya ba ma yin pa spyad do zhes zer bas khyim khyim zhes bya bar 8grags te/ gau ta ma dag 'di ni 'jig rten du khang pa'i las kyi mtha' rnams byung ba'i rtsom pa dang po yin no/ /de yang chos kyis yin gyi 8chos ma yin pas ma yin te/ de la rgyal ba'i dbang po'i chos la 'di ni gtso bo yin no/nye/ /de rnams nub bza' ba don du gnyer ba yang dgongs tsunyeka sā lu'i ched du 'dong bar byed do(nye/ /nang bza' ba (7don du 3—626

gnyer ba yang nang par sā lu'i ched du 'dong ①bar byed do/ /de nas sems can snyom ②las kyi rang bzhin can zhig gis nang par gyi sā lu ①nub mo dublangs sol/ /de nas sems can zhig gis sems can de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye sems can khyod tshur sā lu'i phyir 'dong ⑤/ de nas sems can des sems can rjode la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye sems can khyod rang gi sā lu la soms shig /kho bos ni nang par gyi sā lu do ⑦nub blangs so/ /de nas sems can de 'di snyam du sems te/ 0kye ma de ni legs so/ /kye ma de ni shin tu legs kyisal/ ma la bdag gis zhag gnyis kyi dang / zhag gsum gyi dang /zhag bdun gyi bar gyi sā lu blang ngo snyam du sems ⑩nas/ des zhag gnyis kyi dang / zhag gsum gyi dang / zhag bdun gyi bar gyi 0sā lu blangs so/ /de nas sems can zhig gis sems can de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye sems can khyod tshur sā lu'i phyir 'dong ⑫/ de nas sems can des sems can de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye sems can khyod rang gi sā lu la soms shig /kho bos ni zhag gnyis kyi dang / tsogasum gyi dang / zhag bdun gyi bar gyi sā lu blangs zin no0/ /de nas sems can de 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma de ni legs so/ /kye ma de ni shin 8tu legs kyis0/ ma la bdag gis zla ba phyed dang / zla ba gcig gi sā lu blang ngo snyam nas/ des zla ba phyed dang / zla ba gcig gi sā lu blangs so/ /gang nas sems can de rnams kyis ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sā lu'i 'bru sogs tho)'jog gi 4)yongs su longs spyad pas zos pa de nas sā lu yide'i 'bras 0bu phub ma dang / spun pa dang / shun pas yog ⑥par gyur to/ /brngas shing brngas na yang phyir mi skye bas brngas par yang 3—627

mngon la/ sā lu yang sbubs sam yal ga'i sbubs la yod par gyur to/ /de nas sems can de rnams tshogs shing 'dus nas shes ldan dag bdag cag sngon yid las byung ba'i gzugs phun sum tshogs pa/ dbang po ma nyams shing ma tshang ba med pa①/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa/ kha dog bzang pos gnas pa/ rang ②gi 'od dang ldan pa/ nam mkha' la 'gro zhing dga' ba za zhing dga' ba'i zas kyis tshe ring zhing yun ring du gnas la/bdag cag sa'i bcud kha dog phun sum tshogs pa/ dri phun sum tshogs pa/ro phun sum tshogs pa byung bar gyur to/ /bdag ①cag sa'i bcud la kham gyi zas kyi ④rim gyis zos te/ gang gi tshe bdag ⑤gis yisa'i bcud la kham gyi zas kyi 0rim gyis zos pa de'i tshe bdag cag gi nilus la rtsub pa nyid dang lci ⑨ba nyid dag 0zhugs par gyur te⑩/ kha dog bzang po'i gsal ba gang yin pa de nub par gyur pas 'jig rten du mun pa byung bar gyur to/ /bdag cag de za zhing ⑫zas su za ba la tsotshe ring zhing byayun ring du gnas par gyur to8/ /bdag cag las kha zas ches nyung ngu za ba gang yin pa de ni kha dog bzang por gyur/ kha zas ches mang du za ba gang yin pa de ni kha dog ngan par gyur te/ kha zas kyi tshad gnyis la brten nas kha dog rnam pa gnyis mngon te/ kha dog rnam pa gnyis yod pas kwa'i ⑩sems can kho bo ni kha dog dang ldan la/ khyod ni kha dog ngan pa yin no zhes sems can gyis sems can la khyad du gsod par byed do/ /bdag cag kha dog gi mngon pa'i nga rgyal can rnams sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos de dag nyid blangs pa'i rgyus sa'i bcud de nub par gyur to/ /sa'i bcud de nub pa na sa zhag kha dog phun sum tshogs pa/ dri phun 0sum tshogs pa/ ro phun 3—628

sum tshogs pa byung bar gyur te/ bdag cag de za zhing de zas su za ba la ①tshe ring zhing yun ring du gnas so/ /bdag cag las kha zas ches nyung ngu za ba gang yin pa de ni kha dog dang ldan par gyur/ kha zas ches mang du za ba gang yin pa de ni kha dog ngan par gyur te/ zas kyi tshad gnyis la brten nas kha dog gi ②rnam pa gnyis mngon no/ /kha dog rnam pa gnyis yod pas kwa'i sems can kho bo ni kha dog dang ldan la/ khyod ni kha dog ngan pa yin no zhes sems can gyis sems can la khyad du gsod par byed do/ /bdag cag kha dog gi mngon pa'i nga rgyal can rnams sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos de dag nyid blangs pa'i rgyus sa zhag de nub par gyur to/ /sa ①zhag de nub pa na myu gu'i tshal kha dog phun sum tshogs pa/ dri phun sum tshogs pa/ ro phun sum tshogs pa byung bar gyur te/ bdag cag de za zhing de 0zas su za ba la 0tshe ring zhing yun ring du gnas so/ /bdag cag rnams las kha zas ches nyung ngu za ba gang yin pa de ni kha dog dang ldan par gyuraX/ kha zas ches mang du za ba gang yin pa de ni kha dog ngan par gyur te/ zas kyi tshad gnyis la brten nas kha dog ⑦rnam pa gnyis mngon no/ /kha dog rnam pa gnyis yod pas kwa'i sems can kho bo ni kha dog dang ldan la/ khyod ni kha dog ngan pa yin no zhes sems can gyis sems can la khyad du gsod par byed do/ /bdag cag kha dog gi mngon pa'i nga rgyal can rnams sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos de dag nyid blangs pa'i rgyus myu gu'i tshal de nub par gyur tol/ /myu gu'i tshal de nub pa na ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sā lu'i 'bru tshon bzhi pa phub ma med pa/ sbun pa med pa/ shun pa med pa/ dag pa / gtsang ma skyes te⑨/ de nub brngas na nang skye zhing smin ⑩par 'gyur/ nang 3—629

brngas na nub skye zhing smin ①par 'gyur bas brngas shing brngas ①kyang slar yang skye bas brngas par yang mi mngon te/ bdag cag de za zhing zas su za ba la ③tshe ring zhing yun ring du gnas so/ /gang nas bdag cag gis ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sā lu'i 'bru sog du'ajog gis duyongs su longs spyad ༷pas zos pa de nas sā lu de'i 'bras bu phub ma dang / sbun pa dang / shun pas yog ⑦par gyur tol/ /brngas shing brngas pa yang slar mi skye bas brngas par yang mngon la/ sā lu yang sbubs sam yal ga'i sbubs la yod par gyur pas ma ⑨la bdag cag tshogs shing 'dus la zhing gzhal te mtshams bcad la 'di ni khyed kyi'o / /'di ni nga'i'o zhes mu thug bre bar bya'o zhes de rnams tshogs shing 'dus nas zhing dgod de ⑩mtshams bcad mu thug bres so/ /go ta ma dag 'di ni 'jig rten du mu thug bre (nyeba'i las kyi mtha' rnams byung ba'i rtsom pa dang po yin no/ /de yang chos kyis yin gyi 8chos ma yin pas ma yin te0/ de la rgyal ba'i dbang po'i chos la 'di ni chos kyi gtso bo yin no/ /de nas sems can zhig gis rang gi sā lu yod bzhin du gzhan gyi sā lu tsom byin par blangs so/ /sems can gzhan zhig gis kyisems can des rang gi 0sā lu yod bzhin du gzhan gyi sā lu la ⑩ma byin par blangs pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas sems can de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kwa'i sems can khyod rang gi sā lu yod bzhin du gzhan gyi sā lu la ma byin par ci'i phyir blang / kwa'i tu)sems can song la khyod phyin cad 4)de ltar ma byed cig /sems can des lan gnyis lan gsum du yang rang gi sā lu yod bzhin du gzhan gyi sā lu la 0ma byin par blangs so/ /sems can des sems can de lan gnyis lan gsum du yang rang 0gi sā lu yod bzhin 3—630

du gzhan gyi sā lu la ①ma byin par len pa ②mthong ngo / /mthong nas sems can de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kwa'i sems can khyod rang gi sā lu yod bzhin du gzhan gyi sā lu la ①ma byin par ci'i phyir blang zhes des de phar drangs tshur drangs nas/ ci ④tsam na 'khor gyi nang du yang khrid de/ shes ldan dag sems can 'di rang gi sā lu yod bzhin du lan gnyis sam dugasum gyi bar du gzhan gyi sā lu la dum byin par len to zhes spyos so/ /de nas sems can de rnams kyis sems can de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kwa'i sems can khyod rang gi sā lu yod bzhin du gzhan gyi sā lu la ⑦ma byin par ci'i phyir blang / kwa'i sems can song la khyod phyin cad ⑧de ltar ma byed cig /de nas sems can des sems can de rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /shes ldan dag sems can 'dis bdag la 0sā lu'i phyir phar drangs 0tshur drangs te/ ji 7tsam na 'khor gyi nang du yang byung tsonas spyos so/ /de nas sems can de rnams kyis sems can de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kwa'i sems can khyod kyis sems can la sā lu'i phyir phar drangs tshur drangs nas/ ji tsam na 'khor gyi nang du yang byung tsonas ci'i phyir spyo/ /kwa'i sems can khyod song la phyin chad de ltar ma byed cig /de nas sems can de rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ shes ldan dag sā lu'i zur phar 'dren 8tshur 'dren zhing ji tsam na 'khor gyi nang du spyo ba yang snang bas/ ma la bdag cag tshogs shing 'dus 8la bdag cag gi nang na sems can lhag ⑩par gzugs bzang ba/ lhag par blta na sdug pa/ lhag par mdzes pa/ lhag par bsod nams che bar grags pa gang yin pa de bdag cag gi zhing rnams kyi ⑫bdag por bskos dang / des bdag cag chad pas gcad 8par bya ba yirnams 3—631

la ni chad pas gcod par 'gyur/ phan gdags ①par bya ba rnams la ni phan 'dogs par 'gyur te/ bdag cag gi ②zhing dag las 'khrungs ③pa gang yin pa de la 0chos bzhin du thog shas sbyin par bya'o snyam nas/ de rnams tshogs ⑤shing 'dus te de rnams kyi nang nas sems can lhag ①par gzugs bzang ba/lhag par blta na sdug pa/ lhag par mdzes pa/ lhag par bsod nams 0che bar grags pa gang yin pa de zhing rnams kyi bdag por bskos te 'di skad ces kye sems can khyod tshur shog /kho bo cag la 0chad pas gcad ⑨par bya ba rnams la ni chad pas chod cigatu ) /phan gdags par bya ba rnams (sprel ni phan thogs shig /kho bo cag gi zhing dag las 'khrungs pa gang yin pa de las khyod la kho bo ⑫cag gis chos bzhin du thog shas sbyin no/ /de de rnams la chad pas gcad ⑫par bya ba rnams la ni chad pas gcod/ phan gdags 8par bya ba rnams la ⑫phan 'dogs par byed cing / de la de rnams kyi ⑩zhing dag las 'khrungs pa gang yin pa de las chos bzhin du thog 4)shas 'bul te/ skye bo'i tshogs chen pos bkur cing mang tsopos bkur bas mang pos bkur ba mang pos bkur ba zhes grags so/ /zhing rnams kyi bdag por gyur pa na nyams pa las skyob par byed pas rgyal rigs rgyal rigs zhes bya bar grags so/ /chos kyis skye dgu mgu bar byed cing tshul khrims nyams su blangs te gnas/ shes rab nyams su blangs te gnas pas rgyal po rgyal po zhes bya bar grags so/ /gau ta ma dag rgyal po mang pos bkur gyi tshe mi rnams kyi ming ⑨sems can sems can zhes bya bar gyur to/ /gi ta ma dag ⑥ rgyal po mang pos bkur ba'i bu 'od mdzes zhes bya ste/ gi ta ma dag rgyal po 'od byamadzes kyi tshe mi rnams kyi ming tshur shog tshur shog ces bya bar 3—632

gyur to/ /'od mdzes kyi bu dge ba zhes bya ste/ gi ta ma dag rgyal po dge ba'i tshe mi rnams kyi ming sme ba can sme ba can zhes bya bar gyur to/ /go ta ma dag rgyal po ①dge ba'i bu dge mchog ces bya ste/ gi ta ma dag rgyal po dge mchog gi ③tshe mi rnams kyi ming sprin mgrin sprin mgrin zhes bya bar gyur to/ /dge mchog gi bu gso sbyong 'phags zhes bya ste/ gi ta ma ①dag rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags kyi tshe mi rnams kyi ming ta la'i rkang ta la'i rkang ①zhes bya bar gyur to/ /rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags kyi spyi bor sha rmen zhig skyes pa 'jam zhing shin tu mnyen ⑤te / dper na shing bal gyi 'dab ma'amadu/ ras bal gyi 'dab ma ⑦bzhin du cung zad kyang gnod pa mi skyed do/ /de smin nas brtol ba dang khye'u gzugs bzang ba/ blta na sdug pa/ mdzes pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan pa zhig byung ste/ spyi bo las skyes pas spyi bo skyes spyi bo skyes zhes ⑧bya bar gyur to/ /gzhon nu byung ma thag tu rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags kyi khyabatsun mo drug khri'i nang du bkri skyab dang / de thams cad kyi nu ma skyelas 'o ma zags nas re res nga las nu nga tsolas nu 0zhes smras pas nga las nu nga las nu zhes bya bar grags so/ /gi ta ma dag rgyal po nga las ④nu gang gi tshe rgyal srid byed pa de'i tshe mi rnams sems par byed/ 'jal bar byed/ nye bar rtog par byed do/ /de rnams bsams/ gzhal/ nye bar brtags nas bzo'i gnas dang las kyi gnas tha dad pa dag byed du 'jug pas des 8na/ de rnams yid las skyes yid las skyes ⑩zhes bya bar grags so/ /gau ta ma dag rgyal po drug po 'di dag ni tshe tshad med cing tshe ⑩dpag tu med pa yin no0/ /bar sdom la/sems can tshur shog sme ba can/ /sprin mgrin dang ni de bzhin du/ /ta la'i rkang 3—633

dang yid las skyes/ /sngon gyi de drug bsdus pa yin//gi ta ma dag rgyal po nyung las nu'i brla ②g.yas par sha rmen zhig skyes pa 'jam zhing shin tu mnyen te/ dper na shing bal gyi 'dab ma'amacha ras bal gyi 'dab ma dubazhin du cung zad kyang gnod pa mi skyed do/ /de smin nas brtol ba dang khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug pa mdzes pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis kun du ⑤brgyan pa zhig byung ste/ brla rjogayas pa las skyes pas ming mdzes pa mdzes pa zhes bya bar gyur to①/ /gzhon nu de rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin pas da dung yang gling bzhi la rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du 'jug go/ /go ta ma dag rgyal po mdzes pa'i brla ⑧g.yon par sha chen cig skyes pa 'jam zhing shin tu mnyen te/ dper na shing bal gyi 'dab ma'amatshu/ ras bal gyi 'dab ma ⑩bzhin du cung zad kyang gnod pa mi skyed do/ /de smin nas brtol ba dang khye'u gzugs bzang zhing 0blta na sdug pa mdzes pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan pa zhig byung ste/ brla 8g.yon pa las skyes pas ming nye mdzes nye mdzes zhes bya bar gyur to/ /gzhon nu de rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin pas da ⑫dung yang gling gsum la rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du 'jug go/ /gi ta ma dag rgyal po nye mdzes kyi rkang pa g.yas par sha then zhig skyes pa 'jam zhing shin tu mnyen te/ dper na shing bal gyi 'dab ma'amatso/ ras bal gyi 'dab ma byabazhin du cung zad kyang gnod pa mi skyed do/ /de smin nas brtol ba dang khye'u gzugs bzang btso/ blta na sdug pa/ mdzes pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis kun nas brgyan pa zhig byung ⑩ste/ rkang pa 3—634

g.yas pa las skyes pas ming mdzes ldan mdzes ldan zhes bya bar gyur to/ /gzhon nu de rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin pas da dung yang gling gnyis la rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du 'jug go/ /gi ta ma dag rgyal po mdzes ldan gyi rkang pa g.yon par sha then zhig skyes pa ①'jam zhing shin tu mnyen te/dper na shing bal gyi 'dab ma'amadu/ ras bal gyi 'dab ma ⑧bzhin du cung rjozad kyang gnod pa mi skyed do/ /de smin nas brtol ba dang / khye'u gzugs bzang brgya/ blta na sdug pa/ mdzes pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis kun dunas brgyan ⑦pa zhig byung ste/ rkang pa g.yon pa las skyes ⑧pas ming nye mdzes ldan nye mdzes ldan zhes bya bar gyur to/ /gzhon nu de rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin pas da dung yang gling gcig la rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du 'jug go/ /gi ta ma dag de ltar na rgyal po mang pos bkur ba'i 0bu 'od mdzes so/ /'od mdzes kyi dge ba'o/ /dge ba'i dge mchog go/ /dge mchog gi gso sbyong 'phags so0/ /gso sbyong 'phags kyi nga las yina'o/ /nga las 8nu'i mdzes pa'o/ /mdzes pa'i nye mdzes so/ /nye ⑫mdzes kyi mdzes ldan dang / mdzes ldan kyi thostenye mdzes ldan dang / bzang po dang / legs byabazang dang / btang ba dang /tso btang bzung ⑩dang /yan lag dang / yan lag shing rta dang / ngan 0spong dang / skal ldan shing rta dang / rgya mtsho dang / rgya mtsho'i bu dang / rgya mtsho ②chen po dang / sha ku 0ni dang / sha ku ⑥ni chen po dang / ku sha dang / nye ba'i ku sha dang /ku sha chen po dang / legs mthong dang / legs mthong chen po dang / rab thob dang / rab thob chen po dang / rab tu sgra bsgrags dang / rab tu sgra 3—635

bsgrags ①chen po dang / 'od byed pa ②dang / rtul phod dang / lhun po ldan dang / lhun po yod dang / 'od zer dang / 'od zer ldan dang /'od zer yod dang / kun nas 'od zer ro/ /gi ta ma dag kun nas 'od zer gyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po brgya tham pa yul gru 'dzin du byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po dgra ③'dul zhes bya ba byung ste/ dgra 'dul bar byed pas dgra 'dul dgra 'dul zhes bya bar gyur to/ /gi ta ma dag rgyal po dgra 'dul gyi bu dang / tsha bo dang /yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po lnga khri bzhi stong yul dmag gis mi tshugs par byung ngo / /de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba zhes bya ba byung 0ste/ ma rgyal ba las rgyal bar byed pas na ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba 0zhes bya bar grags so/ /gi ta ma dag rgyal po ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po drug khri sum stong yul bā rā ṇa sīr dubyung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po ⑦bzod dka' ⑧zhes bya ba ⑨byung ngo / /gi ta ma dag rgyal po bzod dka'i bu dang /tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po brgyad khri bzhi stong skam pi ⑩la'i grong khyer du byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po tshangs byin yizhes bya ba byung ngo / /go ta ma dag rgyal po tshangs byin 4)gyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po sum khri nyis stong glang po che'i grong khyer du byung ste / de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po glang pos sbyin zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma dag rgyal po glang pos sbyin gyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po lnga stong yul rdo 'jog tu byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po 3—636

bal bu can zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma dag rgyal po bal bu can gyi bu dang /tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po sum khri nyis stong grong khyer brang gis nyal du byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po tshan ①po che 'dul zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma dag rgyal po tshan ③po che 'dul gyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po sum khri nyis stong grong khyer ma rgyal ba las rgyal bar byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po rgyal byin zhes bya ba byung ngo / /go ta ma dag rgyal po rgyal byin gyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po sum khri nyis stong grong khyer ku n+ya kub dzar byung ste/de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po rgyal sde ③zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma dag rgyal po rgyal sde'i dubu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po khri brgyad stong grong khyer tsam par byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po klu'i lha zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gau ta ma dag rgyal po klu'i lha'i bu dang / tsha bo dang /yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po nyi khri lnga stong grong khyer ta la'i phreng ⑤du byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po mi'i lha zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gau ta ma dag rgyal po mi'i lha'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po khri nyis stong grong khyer ta ma lir byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po rgya mtsho'i lha zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma dag rgyal po rgya mtsho'i dulha'i bu dang /tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud ⑦rgyal po khri brgyad stong grong khyer ba so'i grong du byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po blo gros bzang po zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma dag rgyal po blo gros bzang po'i bu dang / tsha bo dang /yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po nyi khri lnga stong grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu 3—637

byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po mun sel zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma dag rgyal po mun sel gyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po brgya tham pa yang grong khyer bā rā ṇa sīr ①byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po dbang phyug chen po'i sde zhes bya ba byung ngo / /go ta ma dag rgyal po dbang phyug chen po'i sde'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po brgyad khri bzhi stong grong khyer rtswa can du byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po rgya mcho3re sde zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma dag rgyal po ②rgya mchoX) sde'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po stong yang grong khyer gru 'dzin du byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po dka' ②thub spyod ①ces bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma dag rgyal po dka' thub spyod kyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po brgyad khri bzhi stong yang grong khyer rtswa ⑤can du byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po sa'i gdong zhes bya ba rjobyung ngo / /gi ta ma dag rgyal po sa'i gdong gi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po 'bum yang grong khyer bā rā ṇa sīr byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po sa'i bdag po zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma dag rgyal po sa'i bdag po'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po 'bum yang ༷grong khyer dmag gis mi tshugs par byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po sa 'dzin zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma dag rgyal po sa 'dzin gyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po brgyad khri bzhi stong grong khyer mi thi lar byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po lha chen po zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma dag rgyal po lha chen po'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang 3—638

tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po brgyad khri bzhi stong yang grong khyer mi thi lar drang srong gi tshangs par spyod pa la spyad ①de/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po mu khyud ces bya ba byung ngo / /mu khyud las 'bying ba ②dang / sra ba'i mu khyud dang /rko ba dang / nye bar rko ba dang / rko ba yod pa ③dang / kun nas rko rjodang /gya nom snang dang / mnyam snang dang / thos pa'i sde dang / chos kyi sde dang /rtogs pa dang / rtogs pa chen po dang / rtogs pa'i sde dang / mya ngan med dang / mya ngan bral dang / brtan ⑤pa'i sde dang / dga' bas sbyar dang / glen gsal rjodang / skya reng ⑦dang / phyogs kyi bdag po dang /rngul can dang / bde byed dang / kun dga' rjodang / me long gdong dang /skyed pa dang / kun nas skyed pa dang / skye bo'i khyu mchog dang / bza' btung can dang / bza' btung mang po can dang / mi thub pa dang /gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang / gnas pa dang / shin tu gnas pa dang /stobs chen dang / stobs chen zhon dang / legs pa'i blo gros dang / brtan pa 0zhon dang / gzhu bcu pa dang / gzhu brgya pa dang / gzhu dgu bcu pa dang / gzhu rgyal dang /tunye gzhu bkra dang / gzhu sra dang /shing rta bcu pa dang / shing rta brgya pa dang / shing rta dgu bcu pa dang /shing rta khra bo dang / shing rta rgyal dang / shing rta sra ba'o/ /go ta ma dag rgyal po shing rta sra ba'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po bdun khri bdun stong grong khyer kun du snang bar byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po nam mkha'i bdag po zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma dag rgyal po nam mkha'i bdag po'i bu klu mnyam skyong ngo / /gi ta ma dag rgyal po klu mnyam 3—639

skyong gi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po brgya tham pa yang grong khyer bā rā ṇa sīr byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po ①yo tī zhes bya ba byung ngo ②/ /de'i tshe ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur dub/ ca bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de'i spyan sngar rjobacom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpas dum 'ongs pa na byang chub par bya ba'i phyir sngon dusmon lam btab nas tshangs par spyod pa spyad de/ dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris su skyes so/ /gau ta ma dag rgyal po kṛ khri'i bu legs skyes so/ /gi ta ma dag rgyal po legs skyes kyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po brgya tham pa yang grong khyer gru 'dzin du byung ste/ de rnams kyi tha ma ni rgyal po rna ba can zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta ma dag rgyal po rna ba can la bu gnyis te/ gi ta ma dang / ba ra dwa ⑦dza'o/ /de gnyis las gau ta ma ni mngon par 'byung bar dga'o/ / ba ra dwa dza duni rgyal srid la mngon par dga'o/ /des pha chos dang chos ma yin pas rgyal srid byed pa mthong nas/ des bsams pa/ bdag yab 'das nas rgyal por gyur khyate/ bdag gis kyang chos dang chos ma yin pas rgyal srid byas nas ⑩sems can dmyal bar gzhol bar 'gyur bas 'dir ci'i dus la bab ce na/khyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung bar bya'o snyam du bsams nas/ rgyal po rna ba can gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang rkang pa gnyis la gtugs 0te gsol ba btab pa/ yab mkhyen par mdzod cig /bdag ni dad pas khyim nas khyim 3—640

ma mchis par rab tu 'byung ngo / /des smras pa/ bu gang gi phyir mchod sbyin mchod par byed pa dang / sbyin sreg sreg par byed pa dang / dka' thub spyod pa de dag ni 'di'i ched yin te/ nga 'das na ①rgyal srid lag mthil du 'ongs te rgyal po byed par 'gyur na ci'i phyir rab tu 'byung / des smras pa/ yab bdag gis chos dang chos ma yin pas rgyal srid bgyid rngo mi thog go②/ /de lta bas na mkhyen par mdzod cig rab tu 'byung ngo / /de nas rgyal pos ③gal gyis gcu dubar shes nas gnang ngo / /de'i tshe bsti gnas zhig na drang srong mdog gnag ⑤ces bya ba gnas so/ /de nas gzhon nu gi ta ma rgyal pos gnang nas dga' zhing mgu la rjodaga' ba rgya ༅chen po dang yid bde ba skyes nas drang srong mdog gnag ⑧gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang spyod lam dul bas rkang pa gnyis la phyag byas nas smras pa/ drang srong chen po bdag rab tu 'byung bar 'dod kyis ⑨bdag rab tu phyung shig /des de rab tu phyung ngo / /drang srong mdog gnag ⑩ni 'bras bu dang / rtsa ba dang / chu 'thung bas de yang drang srong gi ta ma drang srong gi ta ma 0zhes bya bar gyur to/ /ji tsam 4)dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po rna ba can shi nas/ gzhon nu ba ra dwa tho)dza pa'i rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du bcug 8go/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na drang srong go ta mas mkhan po la smras pa/ mkhan po dgon pa'i 8zas kyis 'tsho bar rngo mi thog gis grong 'dab tu (9gnas par bgyi'o4)/ /des smras pa/ bu rung gis 4)grong ngam dgon pa na gnas pa'i drang srong gis ni mdor na dbang po bsrung yib yin gyis 0 / khyod song la gru 'dzin gyi nye 'khor du lo ma'i spyil bo ⑥byos la 'dug shig /mkhan po bka' bzhin 'tshal ༷zhes smras nas/ drang 3—641

srong gi ta ma gru 'dzin gyi nye 'khor du lo ma'i spyil bu byas te gnas so/ /de'i tshe grong khyer gru 'dzin na smad 'tshong ①ma bzang mo zhes bya ba dang / skyes bu g.yon can pad ma'i rtsa lag ces bya ba zhig gnas te/ des de la dga' mgur spyad ②pa'i phyir gos dang rgyan dag ③bskur ro/ /des gos dang rgyan dag thogs nas chas pa las/ yang mi gzhan zhig kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya thogs pa zhig 'ongs nas bzang mo dga' mgur spyod kyis getshur shog /des bsams pa/ gal te bdag phyisong na kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya yang mi 'thob 0la khyim du 'ongs pa spangs te gzhan du 'gro ba 'di ni legs pa ma yin no snyam nas des bu mo mngag gzhug ma la smras pa song la pad ma'i rtsa lag la jo mo'i mchid nas re zhig bdag la ⑦skabs ma mchis te slad kyis mchi'o zhes smros shig /des de'i gan du song nas smras so//mi de ⑧yang bya ba mang po zhig yin pas de dang de dga' mgur spyad nas thun dang po nyid la song ngo / /des bsams pa/ nam tshod ring du yod pas de'i sems kyang ⑨bdag gis bsrung bar nus so snyam nas des yang bu mo de la bsgo ba/pad ma'i rtsa lag gi gan du song la jo mo'i mchid nas sta gon bgyis lags na/skyed mos tshal gang du mchi ⑩zhes smros shig /des de'i gan du song nas smras pa dang / des smras pa/ khyod kyi jo mo skad cig la skabs med skad cig la skabs yod ce'am/ bu mo de de dang rigs mi 'phrod pa zhig pas des smras pa/ rje'i sras skabs ma mchis pa ni ma lags mod kyis de khyod ⑩kyi gos dang rgyan dag gis skyes pa gzhan dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad do/ /de'i 'dod chags kyi kun nas dkris 8pa gang yin pa de dang bral bar gyur cing gnod sems kyi kun nas dkris phonyepa skyes te/ de mi bzod pa skyes nas smras pa/ bu mo song la 3—642

bzang mo ①pad ma'i rtsa lag na re skyed mos tshal ga ge mo zhig tu shog ces byos shig/des song nas bzang mo la smras pa dang / de nas de skyed mos tshal du song ba dang skyes bu g.yon can pad ma'i rtsa lag gis ②smras pa/ khyod kho bo'i gos dang rgyan gyis skyes pa gzhan dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad par ①rigs sam/des smras pa/ rje'i sras de ni bdag gis nongs te/ 'on kyang bud ④med ni rtag tu skyon can lags pas bzod par mdzod cig / de nas de ⑤mi bzod pa skyes nas ral gri shubs nas phyung ste dubasad do/ /de nas bu mo mngag gzhug mas jo mo bsad do/ /jo mo bsad do zhes ku co'i sgra chen po bton pa skye bo'i tshogs kun gyis thos nas brgyugs pa dang / de ji ①tsam na bste gnas de nyid na drang srong gi ta ma gnas so/ /de nas skyes bu g.yon can pad ma'i rtsa lag de skrag nas ral gri khrag can drang srong gi ta ma'i mdun du bor nas skye bo'i tshogs chen po de nyid kyi nang du zhugs so/ /skye bo'i tshogs chen pos de ⑧ral gri khrag can mthong nas ⑨rab tu byung ba 'dis bzang mo bsad do zhes de nas drang srong gau ta ma de bskor te mi bzod pa skyes nas smras pa/ kwa'i rab tu byung ba drang srong gi rgyal mtshan thogs yinas 'di 'dra ba'i las byed dam/ des smras pa/ci byas/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ bzang mo dang khyod lhan cig dga' mgur spyad nas de bsad do/ /des smras pa/ kho bo'i sdig pa zhi bas las de mi byed do zhes des zhi ba ⑩smras kyang skye bo'i tshogs chen po des lag pa phying ka 8log tu dam du bcings nas rgyal po la phul te/ lha rab tu byung ba 'dis bzang mo dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad nas de bkum lags so/ /rgyal po rnams ni mi rtog pa yin pas des smras pa/ gal te de ltar gyur tson rab tu byung ba 'di 3—643

ngas spangs kyis ①gsal shing la shon cig /de nas rab tu byung ba de ②me tog ka ra bī ③ra'i phreng ba mgul du btags shing skyes pa gos sngon po gyon pa/lag na mtshon thogs pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor nas lam po che dang / tshong dus ④dang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo rnams su bsgrags pa'i sgor bsgrags te / grong khyer gyi lho phyogs kyi sgor phyung phyinas gson po nyid du gsal shing la gshon no/ /de'i mkhan po mdog nag ⑥de dus dus su de'i bste gnas su 'gro ba yin pas/ ji tsam du dus gzhan zhig na song ba las ma mthong ⑦nas des phan tshun du btsal bar brtsams pa dang / ji tsam na de dugasal shing la gshon par mthong nas de skad mi gsal zhing mig mchi mas gang la snying rje ba'i tshig gis dal bu dal bus smras pa/ kyi hud bu 'di ci zhig /des 0kyang skad mi gsal zhing yi spre )chad la gnad du bab pa'i gnod pa'i tsotshor ba skyes shing gdungs pas ⑫smras pa/ mkhan po gzhan ci lags/ las lags mod/ des smras pa/ bu rma phyung 0ba'am/ gnod pa zhig ma byas grang mkhan po bdag gi 8lus kyis rma phyung gi sems kyis ni ma yin no/ /bu ji ltar shes/ mkhan po bden pa gsol gyis 8gson cig /bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis bdag gi tsolus kyis rma phyung gi sems kyis ⑩ma yin na/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des mkhan po'i pags 8pa'i mdog nag po gang yin pa 'di 6)gser gyi kha dog tu gyur cig /bdag nyid chen po de lhag pa'i bsam pa goms pa yin pas tshig smras ma thag tu drang srong mdog gnag pya gi pags 0pa nag po mi snang zhing gser gyi kha dog tu gyur to/ /kun du drang srong mdog nag gser gyi kha dog tu gyur to zhes sgra grags phyepas de'i ming gser mdog ces bya bar gyur to me/ /de ngo mtshar mchog tu gyur 3—644

to / /de nas drang srong gau ta mas smras pa/ mkhan po bdag ni 'di nas shi 'phos nas ①'gro ba ni gang / skye ba ni gang /0 tshe phyi ma ni gang zhig lags/des smras pa/ bram ze rnams na re bu med pa rnams nil 'gro ba med do/ /zhes zer na khyod kyis bu 'ga' dubaskyed pa lta yod dam/ mkhan po yab kyis rgyal srid kyi slad du spro ba bskyed pa na bdag gzhon nu nyid du tshurab tu byung bas bud med kyi rgyus kyang ma 'tshal na/ bdag gis bu bskyed 0pa lta ga la mchis/bu gal te de lta na sngon yul la spyad pa rjes su dran par gyis shig /mkhan po tshor ba drag pos nyen pas da ༅ni bdag gi gnad rnams chad cing tshigs ⑧rnams bye ⑨ste/ 'gum pa gcig pu dran par bas na/ ji ltar sngon gyi yul la spyad pa rjes su dran par 'gyur/ de'i mkhan po mngon par shes pa thob 0pa yin pas des rdzu 'phrul gyis rdzi char chen po sprul nas char pa'i thigs (nyepas de'i lus la phog pa dang / de nas char pa dang rlung grang 8mos reg pas sdug bsngal rnam par mnan nas/ des sngon gyi yul la spyad pas 0rjes su dran par bya bar brtsams so/ /gang gi tshe des 'khrig ④pa'i 'dod chags rjes su dran par byas pa las khu ba'i thigs pa gnyis khrag dang lhan cig lhung yingo / /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas ni bzhi ste/ bdag sems pa dang / 'jig rten sems pa dang / sems can rnams kyi las kyi rnam 4)par smin pa sems pa dang /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi yul sems pa'o/ /khu ba'i thigs ⑩pa de gnyis sgo mang gnyis su gyur nas nyi ma shar ba'i dus kyi tshe nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis smin yinas rdol ba dang khye'u gnyis shig byung nas/ de dang ha cang yang mi ring ba'i bu ram shing gi tshal gseb der de gnyis zhugs du so// //3—645

'dul ba gzhi/① bam po brgyad bcu ②gcig pa/ de nas nyi ma'i 'od zer shin tu tsha ba byung ste/ nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis drang srong gi ta ma gdungs nas shi'o/ /de nas drang srong gser mdog 'ongs nas ①shi ba mthong nas des gsal shing gi nye 'khor du bltas na sgo dung rdol ba'i khog pa gnyis shig 'dug ⑤nas de phan tshun rjes gcod cing bu ram shing gi tshal gseb tu zhugs pa las ji tsam na khye'u gnyis shig mthong ngo / /des 'di gnyis su'i bu yin zhes bsam pa la zhugs pa dang / drang srong gi ta ma'i yin par gyur nas/ de nas de lhag par sdug pa skyes te/ des de gnyis bste ⑥gnas su khrid nas bsnun bstod de/ de gnyis kyi ⑦ming btags pa/ nyi ma shar ba'i tshe nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis smin ⑧par byas pa las 'di gnyis skyes par gyur pas de bas na nyi ma'i rigs yin pas nyi ma'i rigs nyi ma'i rigs ⑨zhes bya bar gyur to/ /drang srong gi ta ma'i bu yin pas ming gnyis pa gi ta ma go ta ma ⑩zhes bya bar gyur to/ /rang gi yan lag las skyes pas ming gsum pa yan lag skyes yan lag skyes zhes ⑩bya bar gyur to/ /bu ram shing gi tshal gseb nas rnyed pas ming bzhi pa bu ram shing pa bu ram shing pa ⑩zhes bya bar gyur to/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po ba ra dwa 8dza bu med par shi 8nas blon po rnams 'dus nas gros bya bar brtsams pa/ shes ldan dag da su zhig rgyal por dbang bskur bar bya/ gzhan dag gis smras pa/ de'i ⑫gcen gi ta ma drang srong rnams kyi nang du rab tu byung ste/ rgyal srid 'di ni de'i rigs rgyud du 'os 4)pa yin pas de dbang bskur ro/ /de nas de rnams kyis gros byas nas drang srong gser mdog gi drung du song ste son pa chadang /rkang pa gnyis la gtugs nas smras pa/ drang srong chen po gau ta ma gang yidu 3—646

mchis / des smras pa/ khyed cag kho nas bsad do/ /de ①rnams kyis smras pa / drang srong chen po bdag cag gis de mthong bar yang ②mi dran na ji ltar bsad/ kho bos khyed cag ②dran par bya'o/ /ma nongs soX/ /des de rnams dran par byas pa dang / smras pa/ drang srong chen po gal te de lta na sdig pa spyod pa de ming tsam smos pa yang bsgrags pa ma yin gyis duzhog shig /des sdig pa'i las ci byas/ 'di dang 'di'o/ /skyon med pa gnod pa mi byed pa des sdig pa'i las ma byas par rjokhyed cag gis bsad do/ /de ltar ci mngon/des ji ltar gyur pa rgyas par smras pa dang / de rnams yid mi bde ba skyes nas smras pal/ drang srong chen po gal te de lta na des ma lags kyi bdag cag nigis sdig pa'i las bgyis so zhes de rnams de skad du gtam smra bar byed pa na/ khye'u de gnyis kyang drang srong gi drung du 'ongs so/ /blon po rnams kyis smras pa/drang srong chen po khye'u 'di gnyis su'i lags/ des smras pa/ de kho na'i bu'o//de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'di gnyis ji ltar skyes/ 'di gnyis kyi ming ci lags/ des byung ba dang bcas pa 0rgyas par smras pa/ blon po rnams kyis thos te mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes nas de rnams kyis drang srong de la gsol ba btab nas de gnyis las gzhon nu phu bo shos rgyal srid kyi dbang bskur bas 0dbang bskur ba las de yang bu med par shi'o/ /de nas cig shos nu bo dbang bskur nas/ de'i ming rgyal po bu ram shing pa zhes bya bar gyur to/ /go ta ma dag rgyal po bu ram shing pa'i bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po bu ram shing pa brgya yang grong khyer gru 'dzin du byung ste/ de rnams kyi yitha ma ni rgyal po bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes po zhes bya ba byung ngo / /gi ta 3—647

ma dag rgyal po bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes po la bu bzhi ste/ skar mda' gdong dang / lag rna dang / glang po che 'dul dang / rkang gdub can no/ /dus gzhan zhig na de'i btsun mo dam pa shi nas de lag pa ①'gram pa la ②gtad de sems khong du ②chud cing 'dug go/ /blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha ④ci'i slad du phyag la zhal gtad nas ⑤thugs mi dgyes ⑥shing bzhugs/ des smras pa/ nga'i btsun mo dam pa shi na ci'i phyir sems khong du rtsichud cing mi 'dug /lha gal te de lta nin nyi 'og gi rgyal po rnams la bu mo mchis na/ 0ci'i slad du rje'i ⑩btsun mo dam pa mi btsal/ rgyal pos smras pa/ gzhon nu 'di dag ni rgyal srid mngon par 'dod pas phyir rgol ba 'di dag yod na nga la su zhig bu mo ster bar 'gyur lha yidagongs shig dang / bdag cag gis btsal lo/ /ji tsam na rgyal po gzhan zhig gi tsobu mo gzugs bzang ba/ blta na sdug pa/ mdzes pa btsun mo dam par 'tsham pa 0yod pa de 8de rnams kyis brtags te rgyal po de'i drung du dong nas de rnams kyis gcig nas gcig tu brgyud 6)de rgyal po la rig par byas pa dang / rgyal pos bsgo ba khug shig /de nas de rnams rgyal po'i spyan sngar dong nas rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te thog ⑩mar gtam byas nas ⑩'dug go/ /gtam gyi skabs rnyed cing rgyal po'i zhal mthong nas smras pa/ lha bkra shis par gyur cig /bkra shis par gyur cig /rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed ci 8gsol/ rgyal po bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes po'i btsun tsomo dam pa gum nas de'i ched du sras mo slong ngo / /rgyal pos smras pa/ 'thab rir bab pa'i mchog yin pas rung na 'on kyang dam zhig bca' ste/ gal te nga'i bu mo la khye'u zhig yod par gyur (3 na de gal te rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la gzhag pa lta na 3—648

sbyin no/ /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal/ mchis la lha la snyan du gdags ①par gsol lo zhes de rnams dong nas rgyal po bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes po la ji ltar gyur pa smras pa dang rgyal pos ②smras pa/ shes ldan dag gzhon nu ches phu bor gyur pa rgyal srid la mngon par dga' ba rnams spangs te/ nu bo rgyal srid la 'jog pa de ni 'os pa ma yin no/ /lha don de snol nges pa ma mchis te/ re zhig btsun mo blangs la lha de dang lhan cig rtsed mo dang / dgyes pa dang dgyes dgur spyod par dumadzod cig dang / de la khye'u btsa' bar 'gyur ram/ 'on te bu mor 'gyur ram/ ci ma mchis par 'gyur sus ⑤'tshal/ rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag gal te de lta na deng la long 0shig /de rnams dong nas bsu ste0/ ji tsam na rgyal po'i dpal gyi 'byor pa chen pos blangs nas de yang rgyal pos mngon par 'dod par gyur ②te/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed / dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /de rtse bar byed/dga' bar byed/⑨ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las dus gzhan zhig na btsun mo sems can dang ldan par gyur to/ /de zla ba brgyad dam dgu ⑩'das pa dang / khye'u gzugs bzang ba/ blta na sdug pa/ mdzes pa zhig btsas sol/ /btsas nas de'i btsas pa'i btsas ston rgya cher byas te/ khye'u 'di'i ming cir gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de⑩/ blon po rnams kyis smras pa/lha 'di ltar ma skyes pa nyid nas rgyal srid la mngon par dga' bas de'i slad du khye'u'i ming rgyal srid dga' zhes bya bar btags so8/ /khye'u rgyal srid dga' ma ma brgyad la rjes su gtad de zhes bya ba nas rdzing na gnas pa'i pad ma bzhin ⑫du myur du skyed par byed do zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de rgyal tshab 3—649

kyi rgyal srid la ma bzhag pa de ①de'i zhang po rgyal pos thos nas/ /des de la pho nya btang ste/ tshig rtsub mo ②dang bcas ③pa'i spring yig spring ba khyod kyis sngon khas blangs shing dam bcas pa bzhin gal te byed na de lta na legs/ gal te de ltar ma byas na khyod kyi mthu dang brtson 'grus kyi dus rol gnon pa gang yin pa des sdod cig /kho bo der ⑤'ongs nas yul 'khor bur mar brlag yigo/ /rgyal po de mthu chen po dang ༅ldan pa des thos nas skrag ste blon po rnams bsogs ⑧nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag nga la rgyal po des 'di skad ces spring ⑨na de la ji ltar bsgrub par bya/ de ⑩rnams kyis smras pa/ lha rgyal srid dga' rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur lags med/ des smras pa/ shes ldan dag gzhon nu ches phu ⑫bor gyur pa rgyal srid la mngon par dga' ba rnams spangs te nu bo rgyal srid kyi dbang bskur ba 'di ni 'os pa ma yin no/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha ⑫rgyal po de ni stobs dang bzhon 0pa rgya che bas yigal te 'dir mchis na gdon mi 'tshal bar yul bur mar rlog 0pa gang lags pa'i gnas de mchis pas rgyal srid dga' rgyal tshab kyi dbang phyug la tsodabang bskur la gzhon nu de rnams ni sgyug tu gsol/ rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag skyon med cing gnod pa ma ⑩byas pa'i gzhon nu rnams ji ltar snag /lha bdag cag ni blon po lags te/ lha la sman par bgyi ba lhur len pa lags pas skyon ma mchis pa dang / nongs pa ma bgyis 8pa yang sgyug la/ skyon mchis pa dang nongs pa bgyis pa ni bzhag yigo/ /rgyal pos dubatang snyoms su bzhag nas cang 0mi smra bar 'dug go/ /blon po rnams tshogs nas phan tshun du gros bya bar brtsams pa/ shes ldan dag thabs shig bsham par bya ste/ des na rgyal po ri )gzhon nu rnams la thugs byung bar 3—650

gyur pa zhig bya'o zhes de nas de rnams kyis skyed mos tshal byi dor byas pa 'i mo sna tshogs bris par shin tu dri zhim po'i pog por ①nye bar bzhag /dar gyi chun phyang ②mang po btags/ me tog sna tshogs kyis dga' dga' ltar byas pa zhig byed du bcug go/ /de nas de rnams kyis blon po rnams kyis skyed ①mos tshal de byi dor byed pa rgyang ring po nas mthong nas gzhon nu rgod bag can de rnams skyed mos tshal gyi phyogs su dong ngo ⑦/ /blon po rnams 0skyed mos tshal byi dor byas nas sgor byung ba dang / gzhon nu rnams kyis dris pa/ 'di su'i skyed mos tshal/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha'i lags so/ /de rnams 0slar log par brtsams pa dang / blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ gzhon nu rnams nang du zhugs shig /ci'i phyir slar ldog⑦ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha'i skyed mos tshal yin na 'dir 'jug ⑤tu ga la rung / blon po rnams kyis smras pa/lha'am gzhon nu rnams rol pa 'di ⑨'gal ba ci mchis de rnams nang du zhugs te rtse bar brtsams so/ /blon po rnams kyis rgyal po la smras pa/ lha skyed mos tshal ⑩legs par byi dor bgyis lags kyis7/ lha gzigs pa'i dus la bab lags so/ /rgyal po chas pa dang skyed mos tshal na ku tsoco'i sgra thos so/ /thos nas kyang blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag skyed mos tshal na ku co'i sgra grag tson 'di na su zhig 'dug /blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha gzhon nu rnams so/ /gal te de lta na ngas gzhon nu rnams spangs so/ /blon po rnams kyis rkang pa gnyis la gtugs te smras pa/ lha bzod par mdzad cing gzhon nu rnams mi spang bar tsogasol/ rgyal pos smras pa/ de bzhin du bya'o zhes gzhon nu de rnams spyug par chas pa dang / rgyal po'i rkang pa gnyis la gtugs nas 3—651

smras pa/ lha gal te de lta na bdag cag 'khor gyi nyuskye bo mang po ②dang lhan cig mchi na de ci nas kyang mi dgag pa de ltar bka' stsal pa'i ③rigs so/ /rgyal pos bsgo nas de rnams chas pa na/ de rnams la dga' ba'i pho brang 'khor gyi mi skye bo'i tshogs chen po dang de rnams lhan cig chas te zhag bdun ④grong khyer gru 'dzin gyi sgo phye nas skye bo'i tshogs rgyus so/ /blon po rnams kyis rgyal po la smras pa/ lha gal te grong khyer gyi sgo ma bkum ⑤na ring po mi thogs par gru 'dzin stongs par 'gyur ro/ /gal te de lta na sgo chod cig /de nas gzhon nu de rnams rang rang gi sring ⑥me khrid nas mthar gyis ri bo gangs ri dang nye ba chu bo ⑦skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram/ drang srong ser skya'i bste gnas ⑧dang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig tu phyin nas/ de rnams kyis der lo ma'i spyil po ⑨dag byas te gnas btab ste ri dgas bsad cing bsad nas 'tsho bar byed cing dus gsum du drang srong ⑩ser skya'i bsti gnas su dong yibar byed do/ /lang tsho dang dar la bab pa'i dregs pas zin pas 'dod chags kyis shin tu nyen te sha bri ⑫ngan pa skya tsobo bseng bseng ④por gyur to/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na drang srong ser skyas de lta bu mthong nas dris pa/ khyed cag ci'i phyir skya 'bo bseng bseng 0por gyur/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ drang srong chen po bdag cag 'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyis shin 0tu nyen pas so/ /des smras pa/ rang rang gi sring mo spongs 8la/ mas dben gyi sring mo rnams dang lhan cig 'dug shig /drang srong chen po bdag cag gis de lta bu bgyir rung ngamacha/ shes ldan dag 'di ltar rgyal rigs rgyal srid stor ba rnams kyis rung ngo / /de na de rnams drang srong gi tshig ni tshad ma yin cino snyam nas 'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyis 3—652

nyen pas dga' ba dang mgu ba skyes te mas dben gyi sring ①mo rnams dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /de rnams dang de dag lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa na bu pho dang bu mo dag btsas te de rnams chen por gyur pa dang /bsam gtan gyi tsher ma ni sgra yin pas drang srong ser skya'i ②sems rtse gcig pa nyid du ma btub nas des smras pa/ shes ldan dag mthong zin gyis ③kho bo gzhan du 'gro'o/ /drang srong chen po ci'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi tsher ma ni sgra yin pas sems rtse gcig pa nyid du mi btub pas 0so/ /drang srong chen po khyod 'di nyid na bzhugs shig /bdag cag gzhan du mchi dun 'on kyang sa'i phyogs shig bdag dul phog gshig /shes ldan dag rung ngo / /drang srong bdag nyid chen po de rnams ni 'dod pa bzhin yid la re ba 'grub pa yin pas des gser gyi bya ma bum blangs te chu'i rgyun gyis grong khyer gyi rnam pa dag bris nas de rnams kyis grong khyer brtsigs so/ /drang srong ser skyas de rnams kyi gnas kyi phyir gzhi yongs su btang bas ser skya'i gzhi ser skya'i gzhi zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de rnams der 'phel bar gyur pas skye bo'i tshogs chen por gyur ②te dog pas 'phel che bar ma gyur to/ /lha rnams kyi ⑨sems kyis de rnams kyi sems shes nas phyogs gzhan zhig bstan pa dang / de rnams der song ⑩ste grong khyer cig shos brtsigs nas lhas bstan lhas bstan zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de nas de rnams tshogs shing 'dus nas phan tshun gros bya bar brtsams pa/ shes ldan dag gang gi phyir bdag cag sgyugs 0pa ni rigs mnyam pa las chun tsom blangs pa de las gyur gyis4)/ de lta (sngebs na bdag cag las sus kyang rigs mnyam pa las ci 3—653

chun ma blang bar ①mi bya ste/ gcig kho nas chog shes par bya'o/ /de rnams rigs mnyam pa gcig kho na las chung ma gcig len gyi rigs mnyam pa las chung ma gnyis pa ②ni mi len to/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po 'phags skyes po ③bu sdug pa rnams rjes su dran te ①blon po rnams la smras pa/ kye grong ba dag gzhon nu de rnams da lta gang ⑤na 'dug /de rnams kyis rgyal po la 0smras pa/lhas nongs pa 'ga' gzhig las snags pa las de rnams rang rang gi sring mo khrid de 'di nas mchis pa na nigangs ri dang 0nye ba chu bo skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram/drang srong ser skya'i bste gnas dang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig tu gnas btab ste/rang rang gi sring mo spangs te mas dben gyi sring mo rnams dang lhan cig rtse 0bar bgyid / dga' bar bgyid/⑫ dga' mgur spyod par bgyid do/ /de rnams rtse bar bgyid/ dga' bar bgyid/8 dga' mgur spyod par bgyid pa na bu pho dang bu mo dag btsas so/ /grong pa dag gzhon nu rnams kyis de ltar byed phod dam/ lha rngo thog tsolags so/ /de nas rgyal po bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes pos ro stod bsrang tsonas lag pa g.yas pa brgyang ste 8ched du brjod ⑫pas ched du ⑩brjod pa/ kye ma gzhon nu rnams ni phod pa yin no/ /kye ma gzhon nu rnams ni shin tu phod pa yin no zhes sems can dbang chen pos tshig tu phyung ste/ kye ma gzhon nu rnams ni phod pa yin no/ /kye ma gzhon nu rnams ni shin tu phod pa yin no zhes byas pas de rnams shākya shākya 8zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na rgyal po bu ram shing pa 'phags skyes po shi nas rgyal srid dga' rgyal srid la dbang bskur to/ /de yang bu med par shi nas skar mda' gdong yirgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du bcug go/ /de yang bu 3—654

med par shi nas lag rna rgyal por gyur to/ /de yang bu med par shi nas glang po che 'dul rgyal por gyur to/ /de yang bu med par shi nas rkang gdub can rgyal por gyur te①/ de'i bu gnas 'jog go/ /gi ta ma dag gnas 'jog gi bu sa khyim mo/ /go ta ma dag rgyal pos khyim gyi bu dang / tsha bo dang / yang tsha dang / sum tsha'i rgyud rgyal po lnga khri lnga stong grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir byung ste/de rnams kyi ②tha ma ni shing rta bcu pa dang / shing rta brgya pa dang / shing rta dgu bcu pa dang / shing rta khra bo dang / shing rta rgyal dang / brtan pa'i shing rta dang / gzhu bcu pa dang / gzhu brgya pa dang / gzhu dgu bcu pa dang / gzhu rgyal dang / gzhu bkra dang / gzhu brtan no/ /go ta ma dag gzhu brtan la bu gnyis te/ seng ge'i ni'agram dang / seng ge'i sgra'o/ /gau ta ma dag 'dzam bu'i 0gling gi gzhu thogs ji snyed yod pa de rnams kyi nang na ni seng ge'i 'gram mchog tu grags so/ /gi ta ma dag seng ge'i 'gram la bu bzhi ste/ zas gtsang dang / zas dkar dang / bre bo zas dang / tshad med zas so/ /bu mo gtsang ma dang / dkar mo dang / bre bo ⑤ma dang /tshad med ma'o/ /zas gtsang la bu gnyis te/ bcom ldan 'das dang / tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo'o/ /zas dkar la bu gnyis te/ tshe dang ldan pa rgyal dang / shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan no/ /bre bo zas la bu gnyis te/ ming chen dang / tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags 0pa'o/ /tshad med zas la bu gnyis te/tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang / lha ༅sbyin no/ /gtsang ma'i bu ni legs par rab sad ⑧do/ /dkar mo'i bu ni phreng ba can no/ /bre mo stima'i bu ⑩ni bzang len no/ /tshad med ma'i bu yidage 'phel 8lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi 3—655

sras ni sgra can ①zin yin te/ gi ta ma dag mang pos bkur ba'i ②rgyud tshe dang ldan pa sgra can ①zin du rdzogs/ srid pa'i breng ①rgyun chad/ skye ba'i 'khor ba ⑤zad de / da 0ni yang srid pa med do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i gtam rdzogs par mkhyen nas/ bzhengs te bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/ mod gal gyi bu legs so/ /legs so/ /mod gal gyi bu khyod kyis dge slong rnams kyi ⑦mdun du shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud las brtsams nas chos kyi gtam smras pa yang khyod legs so/ /mod gal gyi bu yang khyod kyis shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud las brtsams te chos kyi gtam rtag tu smos shig dang /des na ⑧de rnams la yun ring po'i don dang / phan pa dang / bde bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag khyed 0kyis sngon gyi 0shākya rnams kyi 0rigs rgyud las brtsams pa'i chos kyi gtam chongs shig /zung 0shig /lhogs shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/dge slong dag shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud las brtsams pa'i chos kyi gtam ni don dang ldan/ chos dang ldan pa nas/ tshangs par spyod pa'i bar dang ldan pa yin te/ dge slong dag rigs kyi bu dad pas rab tu byung bas shākya rnams kyi sngon gyi rigs rgyud las brtsams pa'i chos kyi gtam gzung 0zhing bklag ⑫pa'i rigs so/ /de nas ser skya'i gzhi'i shākya rnams bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga' ste rjes su yi rangs tsonas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas dong ngo //de'i tshe grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi na rgyal po seng ge'i 'gram zhes bya ba rgyal srid 3—656

byed du 'jug ste/ 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs panyu/ skye bo dang / mi mang pos gang ba/ 'thab pa dang / 'thab mo dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa dang / chom rkun med cing nad rab tu zhi bar gyur pa/ 'bras dang bu ram shing gi phreng ba dang ba lang dang / ma he phun sum tshogs pa na bu gcig pa la sdug pa bzhin du rgyal srid skyong bar byed do//grong khyer lhas bstan du rgyal po legs par rab sad ②ces bya ba rgyal srid byed du 'jug ste/ 'byor pa dang rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa /skye bo dang / mi mang pos gang ba/ 'thab pa dang / 'thab mo dang /rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa dang / chom rkun med cing nad rab tu zhi bar gyur pa/ 'bras dang / bu ram ④shing gi phreng ba dang / ba lang dang / ma he phun sum tshogs pa na bu gcig pa la sdug pa bzhin du rgyal srid skyong bar byed do//rgyal po legs par rab sad kyi btsun mo dam pa gzugs bzang ba/ blta na sdug pa/ mdzes pa yul gyi bzang mo lum bi ni zhes bya ba yod do/ /lhas bstan na khyim bdag phyug cing nor mang ba longs spyod che ba yongs su gzung dub yangs ①shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu la ⑦nor gyis 'gran 0pa zhig gnas pa de'i kun dga' ra ba me tog phun sum tshogs pa dang / 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa dang / 0chu phun sum tshogs pa dang /bya sna tshogs skad 'byin pas de'i kun dga' ra ba dga' dga' ltar 'dug pa der rgyal po dus dus su btsun mo'i 'khor dang lhan cig lhags nas de na tho)dga' ba'i rtsed 0mo nyams su myong bar byed do/ /lum bi nis 8de mthong nas 'dod pa skyes te/ des smras pa/ lha kun dga' ra ba 'di bdag la stsal du 3—657

gsol / rgyal pos smras pa/ kun dga' ra ba 'di khyim bdag gi yin ①na ji ltar sbyin/ gal te khyod la kun dga' ra ba dgos na khyod kyi phyir de bas lhag par bzang ba gzhan zhig bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po legs par rab sad kyis lum bi ni'i ched du de bas khyad par du 'phags pa'i kun dga' ra ba zhig byed du bcug nas de'i ming lum bi ni'i tshal zhes bya bar gyur to/ /rgyal po seng ge'i 'gram la yun ring po nas kye ma'o bdag gi rgyud la 'khor los sgyur ba skye bar gyur ②kyang ci ma rung snyam pa'i bsam pa 'di yod do/ /rgyal po legs par rab sad la yang ③yun ring po nas kye ma'o bdag ni seng ge'i 'gram dang lhan cig gnyen du gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pa'i bsam pa 'di yid do/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na de btsun mo dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las dus gzhan zhig na btsun mo sems can dang ldan par gyur nas de zla ba brgyad dam dgu 'das pa na bu mo gzugs bzang zhing rjobalta na sdug pa/ mdzes pa/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa zhig btsas so/ /btsas pa de'i gzugs bzang pos rgyal po legs par rab sad btsun mo 'khor dang bcas pa dang / lhas bstan na gnas pa'i skye bo'i ⑤tshogs rnams mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes te/ the tshom du gyur nas ci 'di bu mo yin nam / 'on te las sna tshogs 0sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul yin snyam mo/ /de'i btsas pa'i btsas ston nyi ma bdun gsum nyi shu ⑦gcig tu rgya cher byas nas bu mo 'di'i ming cir gdags ⑧zhes ming 'dogs par byed do/ /blon po rnams kyis smras pa/lha lhas bstan na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs lam po che dang / tshong dus ⑨dang /bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo rnams su gleng ba kha cig gi mchid nas ni 'di bu mo 3—658

kho na lags te sngon gyi las kyi ①rnam par smin pas gzugs bzang zhing kha dog phun sum tshogs par gyur to zhes mchi'o/ /gzhan dag gi mchid nas ni 'di bu mo ma lags kyi/ 'o na ci zhe na/ las sna tshogs pas sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul lags so zhes mchi lags pas de ②bas na bu mo'i ming sgyu 'phrul zhes gdags so zhes de'i ming sgyu 'phrul zhes btags so/ /bu mo sgyu 'phrul ma ma brgyad la rjes su gtad de zhes bya ba nas chen mor gyur to zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o//de la mtshan mkhan rnams kyis lung bstan pa mtshan ②phun sum tshogs pa du ma dang 0ldan pa'i bu zhig btsa' bar 'gyur zhing stobs kyi ⑤'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes bstan to/ /yang de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las bu mo gzugs bzang ba/ blta na sdug pa/mdzes pa/ kha dog bzang mo ①rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa zhig btsas so/ /de btsas pa na grong khyer de dag thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos snang bar byas te/sgyu 'phrul la ⑦ji lta ba bzhin du de'i gzugs bzang ba rnam ⑧pa thams cad du dpyad par mi nus so/ /de'i btsas pa'i btsas ston yang rgya cher byas nas bu mo 'di'i ming cir gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de0/ /blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ sgyu 'phrul pas 'di lhag par gzugs bzang bas de bas na sgyu 'phrul chen mo zhes bgyi bar gdags so zhes btags 0so/ /de yang bskyed bsrings nas chen mor gyur pa dang de la mtshan mkhan rnams kyis lung bstan pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa zhig btsa' bar 'gyur 0te/de ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes bstan to/ /rgyal po legs par rab sad kyis rgyal po seng ge'i 'gram la pho nya btang ste/ bdag la bu mo 3—659
