gnyis shig btsa' ba 0)ni sgyu 'phrul dang / sgyu 'phrul chen mo ②lags te/ de la gcig la ni mtshan thams cad phun sum tshogs pa'i bu zhig btsa' bar 'gyur zhing de ni stobs kyi ③'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to//cig shos la ni skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa'i bu zhig btsa' bar 'gyur zhing de ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan gyis0/ 'di gnyis las gang bzhed pa gzhon nu zas gtsang gi chung mar snoms shig seng ge 'gram ⑤gyis slar rjospring ba/ gnyis ka yang gzhon nu la dgos mod kyi⑦/ 'on kyang chung ma 'dra ba gnyis gcig dul gzhag par mi bya bas gang la skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa'i bu ⑨btsa' bar 'gyur zhing de yang 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa re ⑩zhig 'dod do/ /cig shos kyang tshogs la brtag par bya'o/ /des de 'khor lnga brgya dang bkri'o0/ /de'i tshe shākya rnams kyi phyir rgol ba skya bseng 8zhes bya ba ri khrod pa dag cig yod nas shākya rnams 'dus te rgyal po seng ge 'gram gyi drung du song nas lha skya bseng tho)ri khrod pa bdag cag la gnod pa bgyid kyis ④grogs mdzad du gsol/ des smras pa/ shes ldan dag kho bo rgas pas de rnams dang lhan cig g.yul sprad par mi nus so/ /lha gzhon nu zas gtsang gtang du gsol/ dam zhig bca' ste/ gal te gzhon nu ji lta bu ⑫'dod pa'i dam pa gcig bslangs ⑩pa de sbyin pa lta na gtong ngo / /de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha bka' bzhin 'tshal stsal bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal pos dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa gzhon nu zas gtsang la gtad nas/ des ri khrod pa de ⑩rnams bcom rab tu bcom ste meg chubata'o/ /de nas shākya rnams mgu nas 3—660

rgyal po seng ge ①'gram gyi drung du dong ste/ lha gzhon nus ri khrod pa rnams bcom rab tu bcom ste rmeg bta' lags pas bdag cag glo ba dga' na ②gzhon nu mchog ci bzhed gsung ①shig dbul lo/ /shes ldan dag shākya rnams kyi khrims su bca' ba dusus kyang mnyam pa las chun ma gzhag par mi bya'o zhes bcas so/ /lha ci khrims dral lam/ des smras pa/ lhag par shin tu bsdam gyi dral bar dumi bya na/ 'on kyang gzhon nu'i dam pa cig slong ba ni mnyam pa las chun ma blang ba 0yin no/ /lha rung gis ⑦de bzhin du mdzod cig /de nas seng ge ⑧'gram gyis legs par rab sad la pho nya btang nas kho bos tshogs la brtags zin gyisal/ bu mo cig shos 0kyang bkri 0shig /des de yang 'khor lnga brgya dang bkri 8ste gzhon nu zas gtsang gis gnyis ka 0blangs so/ /ji tsam na tsodus gzhan zhig na rgyal po seng ge phye'agram shi nas ser skya'i gzhi na rgyal po zas gtsang rgyal srid byed du 'jug ste/ 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang /bde ba dang / lo legs pa/ skye bo dang / mi ⑩mang pos gang ba/ 'thab pa dang / 0rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa dang /'a chom 0rkun med cing nad rab tu zhi bar gyur paX/ 'bras dang / bu ram shing gi phreng ba dang / ba lang dang / ma he phun sum tshogs pa na bu gcig pa la sdug pa bzhin 0rgyal srid skyong bar byed do/ /des phyedus gzhan zhig na btsun mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo ⑫dang / lhan cig steng gi khang bzangs kyi cigazhi skyes pa med par dong nas rol mos rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /'di ni chos nyid yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs ④pa na 'jig rten la phyagazigs pa lngas gzigs par mdzad de/ rigs la gzigs pa 3—661

dang / yul la gzigs pa dang / dus la gzigs pa dang / rgyud la gzigs pa dang / bud med la ①gzigs pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams rgyu gang gis rigs la gzigs par mdzad ce na/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa ni 'di snyam du dgongs te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams rigs ji lta bu zhig tu nying mtshams sbyor ba len snyam na/ bram ze'i rigs sam/rgyal rigs kyi rigs su yin la/ de la ②re 'ga' ni bram ze'i rigs btsun par bkur/ res 'ga' ni rgyal rigs te/ da ③lta ni rgyal rigs btsun par bkur bar gzigs nas/ ma la bdag la gzhan dag byang chub sems dpas ③rigs ngan par nying mtshams sbyor ba blangs so zhes gzhi ⑤'dis kha zer bar mi 'gyur bar bdag gis rgyal rigs su nying mtshams sbyor ba blang bar bya'o snyam mo//'di ltar byang chub sems dpas thog dum med pa'i dus nas/ smad par mi 'gyur ba'i las byas shing bsags pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos bshad pa 'bras bu med pa ma yin pas rgyu 'dis na byang chub sems dpa' ⑦rnams rigs la gzigs par mdzad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams rgyu gang gis yul la gzigs par mdzad ce na/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa ni 'di snyam du dgongs te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams yul ji lta bu zhig tu nying mtshams sbyor ba len dusnyam na/'bras dang / bu ram shing dang / ba lang dang / ma ho phun sum tshogs pa/slong ⑨me pa brgya 'du ba/ mtha' 'khob kyi skye bo med pa/ dbus pa'i skye bo gnas pa'i yul 4) yin par gzigs nas 'di snyam du dgongs te/ yul dbus ⑩'di ni bu ram shing gi phreng ba 8deng / 'bras dang / bu ram shing 3—662

dang /① ba lang dang / ma he phun sum tshogs pa/ slong ②mo pa brgya 'du ba/mtha' 'khob ③kyi skye bo med pa/ dbus pa'i skye bo gnas pa yin gyis dum la bdag la gzhan dag byang chub sems dpa' yul 'tha' 'khob durnams su nying mtshams sbyor ba blangs so rjozhes gzhi 'dis kha zer bar mi 'gyur bar bdag gis yul dbus su nying mtshams sbyor ba blang bar bya ④snyam mo/ /'di ltar byang chub sems dpas ⑧thog ma med pa'i dus nas 0smad par mi 'gyur ba'i las byas ⑩shing bsags pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos bshad pa 'bras bu med pa ma yin pas rgyu 'dis na byang chub sems dpa' rnams yul la gzigs par yimadzad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams rgyu gang gis dus la gzigs par mdzad ce na/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa ni ti'adi snyam du dgongs te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dus ji ⑫lta bu zhig tu 'dzam bu'i gling du nying mtshams sbyor ba len snyam tson/ skye dgu'i tshe lo yar skye ba tson brgyad khri thub pa yan chad nying mtshams sbyor ba mi len la mi rnams kyi tshe lo mar 'grib pa na brgya thub pa man chad nying mtshams sbyor ba mi len no/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyu gang gis mi rnams kyi tshe lo brgyad khri thub pa yan chad nying mtshams sbyor ba len par mi mdzad ce na/ mi rnams tshe lo brgyad khri thub pa na yid 'byung bar dka' zhing skyo tsobar bya bar dka' la/blun zhing dbang po tunyertul ba dang / bag med cing bde ba mang bas bden pa rnams kyi snod du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /mar 'grib pa lo brgya man chad du yang snyigs ma lnga po 'di lta ste/ tshe'i tsosnyigs ma dang / nyon mongs pa'i snyigs ma dang / sems can gyi snyigs ma dang / lta ba'i snyigs ma dang /3—663

dus kyi snyigs ma shas che ba yin pas bdag la gzhan dag byang chub sems dpas snyigs ma lnga shas che ba'i dus su nying mtshams sbyor ba blangs so zhes gzhi 'dis kha zer bar mi 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /'di ltar byang chub sems dpas ①thog ma med pa'i dus nas smad par mi 'gyur ba'i las byas shing bsags pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos bshad pa 'bras bu med pa ma yin pas rgyu 'dis na byang chub sems dpa' rnams dus la gzigs pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' ②rgyu gang gis rgyud la gzigs par mdzad ce na/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa ni 'di snyam du dgongs te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams rgyud ci 'dra ba ③zhig tu nying mtshams sbyor ba len snyam na/rigs gang zhig btsun par bkur zhing ma mes dang pha mes zung bdun gyi bar spyod pa la skyon med pa yin par gzigs nas de 'di snyam du dgongs te/ shākya'i rigs brgyud du'adi ni btsun par bkur ba yin ⑤zhing mang pos bkur ba nas bzung ste spyod pa skyon med pa yin gyis ⑥ma la bdag la gzhan dag byang chub sems dpas rgyud ngan pa las nying mtshams sbyor ba blangs so zhes gzhi 'dis kha zer bar mi 'gyur bar bdag gis rgyal po zas gtsang gi rgyud du nying mtshams sbyor ba blang ngo ④snyam mo/ /'di ltar byang chub sems dpas thog ma med pa'i dus nas smad par mi 'gyur ba'i las byas shing bsags pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos bshad pa 'bras bu med pa ma yin pas rgyu 'dis na byang chub sems dpa' rnams rgyud la gzigs par mdzad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams rgyu ⑧gang gis bud med la gzigs par mdzad ce na/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa na ⑨'di snyam du dgongs te/3—664

byang chub sems dpa' rnams bud med ci 'dra ba zhig gi ①rum du nying mtshams sbyor ba len snyam na/ bud med gang zhig gzugs bzang mo dang ldan pa/tshul dang ldan pa/ rigs dang ldan pa/ rgod bag can ma yin la rigs 'phel bar 'gyur zhing sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams la kye ma ②bdag sangs rgyas kyi yum du gyur cig ces smon lam btab pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rum du ③zla ba bcur du'adzin nus pa dang / rang gi don yang nyams 0par mi byed pa yin par gzigs nas ⑥'di snyam du dgongs te/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo 'di ni ma mes dang / pha mes zung bdun gyi bar spyod pa la skyon med cing gzugs dang ldan pa dang / tshul dang ldan pa dang / rgod bag can ma yin pa dang /rigs 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rum du zla ba bcur 'dzin nus pa dang / rang gi don yang mi nyams pa yin lanya/ 'di ltar sgyu ⑧'phrul chen mos sngon sangs rgyas rnams la kye ma bdag sangs rgyas kyi yum du gyur cig ces smon lam btab pa yang yin pas bdag la gzhan dag byang chub sems dpa' mtshan ngan pa dang ldan pa'i bud med kyi rum du nying mtshams sbyor ba blangs so zhes gzhi ⑨'dis kha zer bar mi 'gyur ro snyam motho )/ /'di ltar byang chub sems dpas 0smad par mi 'gyur ba'i las byas shing bsags pa dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos bshad pa 'bras bu med pa ma yin pas rgyu 'dis na byang chub sems dpa' rnams bud med la gzigs par mdzad do//de nas byang chub sems dpas ⑫ gzigs pa lnga tho)gzigs nas 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i ris drug la ④lan gsum du bsgrags patso/ grogs po dag dga' ldan gyi lha'i 8ris 'di nas nga shi 'phos te mi rnams kyi nang du rgyal po zas gtsang gi 3—665

chung ma dam pa'i rum du nying mtshams sbyor ba blangs la de'i bur gyur te bdud rtsi rtogs par byas/ khyod ①cag las gang dag bdud rtsi don du gnyer ba de phal cher yul dbus kyi mi rnams ②su nying mtshams sbyor ba longs ①shig /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / dga' ldan gyi ris kyi lha rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhyen par mdzod cig /da ltar 'jig rten ni sdig pas gos pa/ skye dgu duni dum rungs pa'i dubasam pa can/ 'dzam bu'i 0gling durtog ge pa drug dang / rjes su sgrogs ⑨pa drug dang / snyoms par 'jug pa drug gis dkrugs pa lags so/ /de la rtog ge pa drug gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'od srung rdzogs byed dang / kun du rgyu gnag lhas kyi bu dang / smra 'dod kyi bu mo'i bu yang dag rgyal ba can dang /mi 'pham 7skra'i la ba can dang / ka tya'i yibu nog can dang / gcer bu pa gnyen gyi bu'o/ /rjes su sgrogs 8pa drug gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bram ze rgyus rgyal tsodang / bram ze gnas 8deg dang / bram ze bzang ldan dang /bram ze tshangs pa'i tshe dang / bram ze pad ma'i snying po dang / bram ze dmar po'obya/ /snyoms par 'jug pa drug gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rangs byed kyi bu lhag spyod dang / sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring du 4)'phur dang / kun du rgyu legs bzang dang / bram ze'i khye'u kun ⑩rgyal dang / drang srong ma bcings pa dang / lteng rgyas 'od srung tsoral ba can no/ /'dir ni chos mnyan pa'i slad du byang chub sems dpa'i gdan dpag tshad bcu gnyis pa bsham par bgyi zhing bdag cag 'di snyam du bdag cag la dga' ldan gyi gnas na byang chub sems dpa' bzhugs pas chos bshad de/ chos de bdag cag gis thos nas ci 3—666

nas kyang bdag cag gi yun ring ①po'i don dang / sman pa dang / bde bar 'gyur ba de lta de ltar bsgrub par bgyi bar②sems lags ①so/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpas dudaga' ldan gyi ris kyi lha rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ grogs po dag de'i phyir rol mo'i cha byad thams cad rdungs ⑤shig /dga' ldan gyi ris kyi lha rnams kyis rol mo'i cha byad thams cad brdungs pa dang byang chub sems dpas kyang dung bus te smras pa/ grogs po dag 'di la sgra lhag par gang che/ bcom ldan 'das dung gi sgra lags so/ /grogs po dag ji ltar dung gi sgras durol mo'i cha byad thams cad zil gyis mnan te/ gnas pa de bzhin du ngas kyang 'dzam bu'i gling du song la rtog ge pa drug dang / rjes su sgrogs ⑦pa drug dang / snyoms par 'jug pa drug zil gyis mnan nas bdud rtsi rtogs par byas te ⑧bdud rtsis 'gro ba tshim par ⑨bya'o/ /mi rtag ⑩pa'i dung 'bud yipar bya'o/ /stong pa nyid kyi rnga brdung bar bya'o/ /bdag med pa'i seng ge'i sgra bsgrags 8par bya'o zhes smras nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ seng ge gcig gis gcan gzan tsotshogs ni du ma 'joms/ /rdo rje gcig gis brag gi rtse mo du ma 'jigatso /brgya byin gcig gis lha ma yin dbang du ma 'joms/ /nyi ma gcig gis mun pa du ma rnam par sel/ /grogs po dag khyed cag las gang bdud rtsi don du gnyer ba de yul dbus kyi grong khyer chen po drug tu nying mtshams sbyor ba long 8shig /de nas ⑩lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du sems te/ byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das 'di ni btsun mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i lhums su nying mtshams sbyor ba len par bzhed kyis0/ma la bdag gis de la gzi brjid bsgrub par bya/ lhums kyang sbyang bar bya'o 3—667

snyam nas/ lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis btsun mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo la gzi brjid bsgrubs shing lhums kyang gtsang mar ①byas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas na ②bzhugs pa gzigs pa lngas gzigs te/'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha drug la lan gsum du bsgrags nas nam gyi gung thun la glang po cher bstan te/ btsun mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i lhums su zhugs so/ /smras pa/ 'gro ba yongs su bskyab phyir dam bzhes nasani/ /lha rnams la bsgo de nas shi 'phos te/ /nang par sprin rum nyi ma gsar 'char ltar/ /de ni bu ram shing pa'i lhums su zhugs④/ /'di ltar sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i 0mi lam bzhi rmis pa/ glang po che dam pa dkar po mche ba drug pa zhig bdag gi rum dral nas zhugs pa dang / steng gi nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / ri brag chen po la 'dzeg pa dang / bdag la skye bo'i tshogs chen po phyag byed pa'o/ /des rgyal po zas gtsang la smras pa dang / rgyal pos blon po rnams la bsgo ba/shes ldan dag rmi lam ston dumakhan dang / mtshan mkhan gyi bram ze rnams khug shig/de dag gis rmi lam ston ⑦mkhan dang / mtshan mkhan gyi bram ze rnams bkug pa dang / de nas rgyal pos de rnams la mi lam bsnyad pa las/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha bstan bcos 6)las ji ltar g.yar sngar bab pa dang sbyar na ⑨sras skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa zhig bltam ⑩par 'gyur te/ gal te khyim pa khyim na yiganas par gyur na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /gal te spa dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur tsosprig bgos te dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung bar gyur na/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya 3—668

bar 'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags par 'gyur ro// //bar sdom la/ 'chi 'pho lha dang rin po che/ /zur brgyad dub dang brtul ①thugs brtan/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi 0tshe byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris nas shi 'phos te yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa de'i tshe sa chen po 'di shin tu g.yos par gyur/ 'jig rten 'di thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos gsal bar gyur cing 'jig rten na 'jig rten gyi bar gyi ⑤mun pa mun gnag stismag tu gyur pa gang du nyi ma rjodang zla ba 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba/ 'di ltar mthu che ba dag gis kyang 'od kyis rjosnang bar mi nus pa de dag kyang de'i tshe snang ba rgya chen pos gsal bar gyur to/ /der sems can gang dag skyes pa de dag rang gi lag pa brkyang ba yang mi mthong ba las de rnams snang ba des sems can gcig gis gcig mthong nas shes ldan dag sems can gzhan yang 'dir skyes so/ /shes ldan dag sems can gzhan yang 'dir skyes so zhes bya bar shes sol/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa de'i tshe lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis de la mi'am mi ma yin pa sus kyang 'tshe bar mi 'gyur bar lha'i bu bzhi yum gyi sung ⑦mar 'jog pa ni lag na ral gri dang / lag na mdung dang / lag na mdung thung dang /lag na mda' bo che'o/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums na zhugs ⑧pa ni mdzod kyi nang du rdzas bzhag pa bzhin du mngal gyi dri ma dang / sha ma'i dri ma dang / khrag gi dri ma dang / mi gtsang ba gang yang rung ba sna tshogs kyis ma sbags 0so/ /dper na nor bu rin po che tsoka shi'i ras kyis mi gos pa dang / ka shi'i ras kyang nor bu rin po ches mi gos pa de bzhin du/3—669

gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums na bzhugs pa na mdzod kyi nang du rdzas bzhag pa bzhin du mngal gyi dri ma dang / sha ma'i ⑨dri ma dang / khrag gi dri ma dang / mi gtsang ba gang yang rung ba sna tshogs pas ②ma sngags so/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das yum gyi lhums su zhugs ②pa de'i tshe yum gyi lhums na de dag ④thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas bzhugs pa mthong ngo / /dper na nor bu rin po che ni ༷bee ḍūrya zur brgyad pa bzang po'i yirigs dang ldan pa/ dang ba/ gsal ba/ dri ma med pa tshon skud sna lnga sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /dkar po dang / le brgan la brgyus pa ⑦de skyes bu mig dang ldan pas mthong na 'di ni skud pa'o/ /'di ni nor bu'o/ /skud pa 'di la nor bu brgyus pa yin no zhes shes pa de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das gang gi tshe yum gyi lhums na bzhugs pa de'i tshe yum gyi lhums na de thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas dubazhugs pa mthong ngo / /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das yum gyi lhums na bzhugs pa de'i tshe de'i yum 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa' 'dzin pas langal ba'am lus dub par 'gyur ba med do/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das yum gyi lhums na bzhugs pa de'i tshe yum deng 0phan chad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du brtul yizhugs lnga'i gzhi blangs par gyur te/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa spangs te/srog gcod pa las slar ldog go/ /ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang / brdzun du smra ba dang / sbyar ba'i chang dang / 'bru'i chang myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas spangs te/ sbyar ba'i chang dang 'bru'i 3—670

chang myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas ①las slar ldog par byed do/ /srog mi gcod dang ma byin mi len dang / /brdzun du mi smra chang la mi brkam dang //'khrig pa'i mi tshangs spyod pa spong ba 'di/ /'di ni don grub yum gyi chos nyid yin / chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das yum gyi lhums su ②bzhugs pa de'i tshe de'i yum 'di lta ste/ skyes pa rnams la 'dod pa dang ldan pa'i yid gtod pa med do/ /nyon mongs rnams la chags par mi 'gyur zhing / /de ni 'dod rgyus sems gdungs mi 'gyur la/ /de yum ⑧'dod pa'i yon tan ldan pa yi/ /skyes pa rnams la sems ni gtod pa med/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo 'dod pa skyes pa/ kye ma bdag gis rgya mtsho chen po bzhi'i chu btung ngo snyam nas des rgyal po zas gtsang la smras pa dang / rgyal po zas gtsang gis mtshan mkhan rnams la smras pa/ ci'i phyir btsun mo 'di 'di lta ④bu'i 'dod pa skye/ mtshan mkhan rnams kyis smras pa⑤/ lha btsun mo la sras skyes bu 0chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyis sku brgyan pa zhig bltam ⑦par 'gyur te / de rab tu byung nas shes bya'i mtsho mtha' dag 'thung bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gal te 'di la mtsho chen po'i chu ma blud na cir 'gyur/ sras yan lag ma tshang ba zhig btsas par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ nga ming zas gtsang ma 0zhes bya ba'i bu yan lag ma tshang bar bya'amal / de'i tshe grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi na kun du rgyu mig dmar zhes bya ba mig 'phrul la byang ba zhig 'dug pa de rgyal pos bkug nas bsgo ba dang / des de steng gi khang bzangs kyi 0gzhi na 'dug pa la rgya mtsho chen po bzhi bstan te chu blud ⑩pa dang / de'i 'dod pa skyes pa gang yin pa de dang bral bar gyur to/ /3—671

gzhan yang de'i 'dod pa skyes pa/ kye ma btson thams cad thar bar bya'o①/ /snyam pa dang / rgyal pos btson thams cad thar bar byas nas/ de'i 'dod pa skyes pa chagang yin pa de dang bral bar gyur to(snye/ /gzhan yang de'i 'dod pa skyes pa/ kye ma sbyin pa dag sbyin/ bsod nams dag bya'o snyam pa dang /rgyal pos sbyin pa dag byin/ bsod nams dag byas nas de'i 'dod pa skyes pa gang yin pa de dang bral bar gyur to/ /gzhan yang de'i 'dod pa skyes pa/kye ma bdag gis bskyed mos tshal blta'o snyam pa dang / rgyal pos skyed mos tshal bstan nas de'i 'dod pa skyes pa gang yin pa de dang bral bar gyur to/ /gzhan yang de'i 'dod pa skyes pa/ kye ma bdag skyed mos tshal du 'dug par bya'o snyam pa dang / rgyal po legs par rab sad la lum bi ni'i tshal zhes bya ba'i skyed mos tshal yod nas de la rgyal po zas ⑤gtsang gis spring ba/ khyod kyi bu mo skyed mos tshal du 'gro bar 'dod kyis yiskyed mos tshal 0byi ⑧dor byos shig /des ⑨zho shas 'tsho ba dag la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag skyed mos tshal ⑩byi dor byos shig /de rnams kyis 0skyed mos tshal 8byi dor byas so/ /de nas de hunye'akhor rnams dang lhan cig dong tho )ngo / /de nas des lum bi ni'i tshal du 'chag (nyepa na shing mya ngan 'tshang me tog shin tu rgyas pa zhig mthong ste/ de bltam par 'dod nas de la bzung ste 'dug pa dang / lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis bsams pa/byang chub sems dpa'i yum ni ngo tsha shes pa dang ldan pas skye bo'i tshogs chen pos bskor na bltam mi phod kyis yithabs shig bsham par bya'o snyam nas des rlung dang char drag po rtso tshocig sprul nas des skye bo'i tshogs de kun du bros so/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya (/nyebyin gyis bdag nyid ma ma rgan mo'i cha byad du mngon 3—672

par sprul nas btsun mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i mdun du bsdad pa dang / des bltam par brtsams so/ /byang chub sems dpa' brtsam pa dang / brgya byin gyis pags pa'i sleb ①mos bzung ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te/ brgya byin 'di bdag gis byang chub sems dpa' blangs so zhes dregs par 'gyur bar mkhyen nas bdag nyid rdo rje'i skur byin gyis brlabs pa dang / lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin 'dar bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpas ②bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka nga thong shig /thong shig /phar thong ②shig/chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das bltam 0pa de'i tshe yang sa chen po 'di yang dugayos par gyur zhes bya ba nas shes ldan dag sems can gzhan yang 'dir skyes so/ /shes ldan dag sems can gzhan yang 'dir skyes so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o// //'dul ba gzhi0/ bam po brgyad bcu ⑦gnyis pa/ chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das yum gyi lhums nas bltam pa na ral gri shubs ⑧nas byung ba bzhin du mngal gyi dri ma dang / sha ma'i dri ma dang / khrag gi dri ma dang / mi gtsang ba gzhan dang gzhan sna tshogs kyis ma gos so/ /chos nyid kyis ⑨gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das yum gyi lhums nas bltam pa de'i tshe de'i yum mi 'dug mi nyal 0'greng bzhin du rgyal rigs ma des rgyal rigs bltam par byed do/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' bltam pa'i mod la sus kyang ma bzung bar phyogs bzhir yigazigs nas gom pa bdun bdun 'dor zhing tshig tu yang gsungs pas/ 'di ni shar phyogs yin te/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i thog mar 'gro bar bya'o/ /'di ni lho 3—673

phyogs yin te/ 'gro ba mtha' dag gi yon gnas su gyur par ①bya'o/ /'di ni nub phyogs yin te/ nga'i skye ba tha ma ni 'di yin par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni byang phyogs yin te/ srid pa'i mtsho las brgal ②bar bya'o/ /de'i dbu'i steng nas lha rnams gdugs dkar po dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can dag 'dzin to / /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' bltam pa'i mod la bar snang las chu bsil ba gcig dang / chu dron po ③gcig ste chu gnyis kyi rgyun spyi gtsug gi steng du 'bab cing des byang chub sems dpa' khrus mdzad do/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' bltam pa'i mod la bskrun 0pa'i yum gyi mdun du chu mig chen po byung nas 'bab par gyur ①te/ de la de'i yum chus chu'i bya ba byed do/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' bltam pa'i mod la lhas bar snang las lha'i utpa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da rjodang / pad ma dkar po dang / a ga ⑦ru'i phye ma dang / rgya spos kyi phye ma dang / tsan dan gyi phye ma dang ta ma la'i 'dab mas 'thor ⑧ro/ /lha'i me tog man dā ⑨ra bas kyang 'thor ro/ /lha'i sil snyan rnams kyis byakyang sgra 'byin to7/ /gos dag kyang 'thor bar byed do// //bar sdom la/ bltam dang bzhengs dang gom pa bdun/ /chu rgyun gnyis dang chu mig lha/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa bltam pa de nyid kyi tshe rgyal po bzhi ⑩yang bu 0btsas te/ mnyan yod du rtsibs kyis 'phur tshangs byin 8gyi bu btsas pa na de 'di snyam du sems te/bdag gi bu btsas pa na yul gsal ba gsal ba bzhin du snang bas de bas na 'di'i ming gsal rgyal zhes bya bar gdags so zhes btags tsoso/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer na rgyal po pad ma chen po'i bu btsas pa na de 'di snyam du sems 3—674 ci

te/ bdag gi bu btsas pa na 'jig rten nyi ma'i gzugs shar ba ltar snang zhing gzugs can ma'i bu ①yin pas 'di'i ②ming gzugs can snying po zhes bya bar gdags so zhes btags so/ /kau shāsbyi na rgyal po dmag brgya pa'i bu btsas pa na de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi bu btsas ③pa na 'jig rten nyi ma shar ba ltar snang bar gyur pas du'adi'i ming shar ba zhes bya bar gdags so zhes btags so/ /grong khyer 'phags rgyal du rgyal po mu khyud dumatha' yas kyi bu btsas pa na de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi bu btsas pa na 'jig rten sgron ma ltar snang bar dugyur pas 'di'i ming rab snang zhes bya bar gdags so zhes btags te de ni de lta ma yin no/ /'on kyang de thams cad ni byang chub sems dpa'i mthu yin no/ /ri bo kun 'dzin la drang srong nyon mongs med ces bya ba 'jig pa la mkhas ⑦'chags pa la mkhas pa zhig gnas te/ de'i tsha bo ni mes ②byin zhes bya'o/ /des de la dus dus su 'jig pa'i gtam dang 'chags pa'i gtam smras pas de de las rab tu byung ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das bltam pa na 'jig rten thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos gsal bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe mes byin phug tu zhugs te bsam gtan byed pa na des snang ba de mthong nas nyon mongs med la smras pa/ mkhan po/ 'dir ni nyi ma thams cad dag /cig char byung ⑨bar gyur tam ci/ /'di ltar ri ni phug bcas pa/ /'di ni 'od kyis gsal bar gyur/ /nyon mongs med kyis de la smras pa/ nyi ma'i 'od ni rgyun du rno0/ /bu gcig snang ba 'di dag ni/ /yan lag reg na 'od 0bsil bas/ /nges par thub pa de yi spre)'od/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od chen yinati/ /nges par lhums nas bltam gyur la/ /3—675

bltam nas sems dpa' chen po de'i/ /'od zer gser dang 'dra ba ni/ /dri ma med pa 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten gsum ni snang bar byas/ /mes ①byin gyis smras pa/ mkhan po bdag byang chub sems dpa' ltar snomachi'o/ /des smras pa/ bu da ltar ③byang chub sems dpa' dbang che ba dang du/ dbang che ba'i lha rnams kyis bskor zhing bzhugs pas gang yang bdag cag gis skabs mi rnyed pa'i gnas 'di yod do/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gzhir byon dunas de'i ming 'dogs pa de'i tshe bdag cag blta ba'i phyir 'dong ngo/ /gang gi nyi ma kho na la byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das bltam pa de nyid kyi nyi ma kho na la rgyal po zas gtsang gi rim gro ba rnams las 'dun pa la sogs te lnga brgya dang / rim gro ma yirnams las 'dun ma la sogs te lnga brgya btsas so/ /bal 0glang mo lnga brgya dang / rta rgod ma lnga brgya la yang ⑧'brangs so/ /gter lnga brgya'i kha yang nye bar snang ngo / /khams kyi ⑨rgyal phran rnams kyis kyang dpya phul te/ blon po rnams kyis rgyal po zas gtsang la ji ltar gyur pa ⑩smras pa dang / rgyal pos bsams pa/ bdag gi bu btsas pa na 0don thams cad dang / las kyi mtha' thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pas gzhon nu'i ming don thams cad grub pa zhes gdags so zhes de na byang chub sems dpa' la ming 'di thog mar btags 8te/ 'di lta ste don thams cad grub pa zhes bya'o/ /grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi na gnod sbyin shākya 'phel zhes bya ba zhig gnyug mar gnas so/ /shākya rnams kyi kun du spyod pa ni shākya su yang rung ba la khye'u'am bu mo btsas pa gang yin pa de gnod sbyin shākya 'phel gyi rkang pa la phyag 'tshal du gzhug 0pa'i phyir khrid 8pa yin pas rgyal pos blon po rnams 3—676

la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag deng ①la gzhon nu gnod sbyin shākya 'phel gyi rkang pa la phyag 'tshal du chug shig /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes blon po rnams kyis rgyal po zas gtsang la mnyan nas rin po che sna bzhi las byas pa'i khyogs kyi steng du byang chub sems dpa' bzhag nas grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir 'jug par brtsams pa na/ ser skya'i gzhi'i shākya gtum po gzu lums can/ rtsub pa/ btsam pa med pa de rnams byang chub sems dpa' nang du zhugs pa na thub pa bzhin ②du gnas pa blon po rnams kyis rgyal po la smras pa dang / rgyal po zas gtsang gis bsams pa/ ser skya'i gzhi'i shākya 'di rnams ni gtum po gzu lums ③can btsam pa med pa yin na gzhon nu nang du zhugs pa na thub pa bzhin du gnas pas gzhon nu'i ming shākya thub pa zhes dugadags so zhes de na byang chub sems dpa'i ming gnyis pa btags ⑤pa 'di lta ste shākya thub pa zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' gnod sbyin shākya 'phel gyi yiganas dang nye ba zhig tu byon pa dang /gnod sbyin shākya 'phel gyis ༅byang chub sems dpa' gnas dang nye bar phyin pa mthong ⑧ngo / /mthong nas kyang phyir byung nas lus thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa'i rkang pa gnyis la gtugs pa skye bo'i tshogs kyis rgyal po zas gtsang la smras pa/ lha gnod sbyin shākya 'phel gyis ⑨byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs gnyis la gtugs lags so/ /rgyal pos thos nas smras ⑩pa/ shes ldan dag lhas kyang gzhon nu'i rkang pa gnyis la gtugs pas 'di ni lha'i yang lha yin pas/de bas na gzhon nu'i ming lha'i yang lha zhes gdags (nyeso zhes de na byang chub sems dpa'i ming gsum pa btags pa 'di lta ste lha'i yang lha zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' bltam pa'i med la yab dang yum gyis ma ma rnams la gtad ⑫3—677

nas ma ma khyod kyis gzhon nu la ①dus dus su bsku ②mnye byos shig /dus dus su khrus byos shig /dus dus su zas ①byin cig /dus dus su yang dag pa'i bde bas bsnyen bkur byos shig /ma ma dga' ba'i lag pa gnyis kyis dude blangs nas dus dus su bsku mnye byed/ dus dus su khrus byed/ dus dus su zas byin⑤/ dus dus su yang dag pa'i bde bas bsnyen bkur byed do/ /yang de'i tshe dri shin tu yid du 'ong ba'i ngo bo nyid dugang yin pa de rnams kyis byugs ①shing / rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas yab zas gtsang la phul ba dang / rgyal po zas gtsang gis de blangs te pang du bzhag nas yang dang yang du rtog cing dga' ba skyed do/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' bltam pa'i mod la yab dang yum gyis mtshan mkhan dang ltas mkhan gyi bram ze rnams la nye bar ston pa yin pas shes ldan dag ji ga gzhon nu gang dag dang ldan pa'i skyes bu chen po'i 'gro ba gnyis su 'gyur gyi dugazhan du ni ma yin te/ gal te khyim pa khyim na gnas par gyur na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po mtha' bzhir rnam par rgyal ba chos kyi rgyal po chos dang ldan pa rin po che sna bdun dang ldan par 'gyur te/ de'i rin po che sna bdun ni 'di lta bu dag 'byung ⑨ste 'di lta ste/'khor lo rin po che dang / glang po rin po che dang / rta rin po che dang /nor bu rin po che dang / bud med rin po che dang / khyim bdag rin po che dang / bdun pa ni blon po rin po che'o0/ /bu dpa' brtul phod pa yan lag mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pa/ pha rol gyi sde rab tu 'joms 47pa/ de rgya mtsho la thug pa'i sa chen po ma lus par gnod par sdo 4)ba med cing 'tshe ba med pa 'di 0nyid chad pa med cing mtshon gyis bda' ba med la/ chos dang 3—678

mthun pas legs par phab ste gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gal te skra ①dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig bgos ②te/ dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung dun/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya bar 'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags par 'gyur ba skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis dang ldan nam/ shes ldan dag gang dag dang ldan pa'i skyes bu chen po'i 'gro ba gnyis su 'gyur gyi gzhan du ①ni ma yin zhes bya ba nas snga ma bzhin du 'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags par 'gyur ro ⑤zhes bya ba'i bar gyi 0skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis po ⑦gang dag yin/ lha gzhon nu'i zhabs shin tu gnas pa lags so/ /zhabs gnyis shin tu gnas pa nyid kyis sa la mnyam par 'bab ste/ lha 'di ni gzhin nu'i skyes bu chen po'i dumatshan lags so/ /de'i ⑨zhabs kyi mthil gyi ngos gnyis las 'khor lo rtsibs stong pa lte ba dang mu khyud du bcas pa rnam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa mchis te/ lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i 0mtshan lags so / /lha gzhon nu ni 0sor mo ring ba dang / zhabs kyi rting pa yangs pa dang /de'i phyag dang zhabs 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags pa lags te/ phyag dang zhabs 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags pa ni dper na shing bal gyi 'dab tsoma'am ras bal gyi 'dab ma bzhin tsono/ /lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu ni phyag dang zhabs dra bas 'brel pa lags te/ de'i phyag dang zhabs dra bas 'brel ba ni dper na ngang pa'i rgyal po gzhon nu'i bzhin no/ /lha 'di ni 8skyes bu chen po'i mtshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu tsodi zhabs long mo'i tshigs mi mngon pa dang / byin pa ri dgas e na ya'i lta bu dang / sku 3—679

mdud pa dang / sku bzhengs bzhin du ma btud ①par phyag pus mo'i lha nga gnyis slebs ②shing reg pa ste/ lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i dumatshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu ④ni mdoms ⑤kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa lags te/de'i mdoms ⑥kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa ni dper na glang po cang shes kyi'am rta cang shes byung ba dag gi bzhin no/ /lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i ⑦skyes bu chen po'i skyes bu chen po'i dumatshan lags so/ / sgolha gzhon nu ni sku ji srid par 'dom ⑨yang de srid la 'dom ji srid par sku yang de srid pas shing n+ya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab pa lags te/ lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i ⑩ skyes bu chen po'i tsunyematshan lags so/ /74)lha gzhon nu ni sku ro stod 8spu re re nas skye zhing de'i sku la spu re re nas skye ba yang mthing ga phonyel g.yas phyogs su 'khyil par skye lags te/ lha 'di ni gzhin nu'i skyes bu chen po'i tsunyematshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu ni mdog gser dang sngona'adra ba dang / 'od 'dom tu)gang ba dang /pags phonyepa srab cing thamadog gser 'dra ba lags te/ pags ①pa srab pa nyid ⑥kyis rdul dang dri mas sku la mi gos pa ste/ lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i (9mtshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu'i sku ni bdun ( nyamatho ba ste/ sku bdun ⑥mtho bar 'khrungs pa ni phyag gnyis dang / zhabs gnyis dang / dpung mgo gnyis dang / ltag pa lags te/ lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i skyes bu chen po'i shu snyematshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu 0ni thal gong rgyas pa dang / sku ro stod seng ge'i 'dra ba dang / sku drang zhing kho lag che ba dang / dpung mgo shin tu skum 0pa dang / tshems bzhi bcu mnga' ba dang / tshems mnyam pa dang / tshems thags bzang ba dang / mche ba shin tu dkar ba dang / 'gram pa 3—680

seng ge'i 'dra ba dang / ro bro ①ba'i mchog dang ldan pa lags te/ lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i ②mtshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu ni ljags shin tu ring zhing srab pa lags te/ ljags shin tu ring ba nyid dang srab pa nyid kyi phyir ljags zhal nas phyung bas skra dumatshams nas bzung ste/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bar du yog ༷par mdzad pa ste/ lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i dumatshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu'i gsung ⑥ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang / ka la ⑦ming ku'i skad ltar yid du 'ong ba dang / rnga'i dbyangs can lags te/ lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i ⑧mtshan lags so/ /lha gzhon nu ni spyan mthon mthing ⑨la ba'i rdzi ma lta bu dang / dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa dang / smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu tho) dung ltar dkar zhing g.yas su 'khyil ba lags nye/ lha 'di ni gzhon nu'i skyes bu chen po'i yimatshan lags so/ /lha 'di dag ni gang dag dang ldan pa'i 'gro ba gnyis su 'gyur gyi gzhan du ni ma lags pa zhes bya ba nas snga ma bzhin du 'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gyi skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis lags so//gal te gzhon nu rab tu ma byung bar gyur na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa bltam nas zhag bdun lon pa dang / de bskrun 8pa'i yum nongs par 'gyur te/ nongs ma thag tu sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i 4)lha'i ris gya rnam par 8skye bar 'gyur ro/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa ni gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa/ mi'i kha dog las 'das la 8lha'i kha dog ma thob pa skyes pa dang bud med rnams kyis bltas pa na yingoms 3—681

mi shes shing dga' ba 'thob ①ste/ dper na 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser las ②mgar ba mkhas ③pas rgyan brdungs pa la ba dkar po sar ༷pa'i steng du bzhag na shin tu gsal zhing 'bar la rnam par 'tsher ba de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa/ mi'i kha dog las 'das shing lha'i ⑤kha dog ni ma thob pa yin no/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa skye bo'i tshogs chen po'i snying du sdug pa dang /yid du 'ong bar 'gyur te/ skye bo'i tshogs chen pos de phrag pa nas phrag par sbed pa ni dper na ston ku'i pad ma ni nyeskye bo'i tshogs chen po'i snying du sdug cing yid du 'ong bas skye bo'i ⑥tshogs chen pos de lag pa nas dulag par brgyud par byed pa bzhin te snga ma bzhin no// //bar sdom la/ mig 0mi 'dzums tshudang rnam smin dang / /gsung snyan 'jebs pa mkhas pa bsdus/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' bltam pa'i mod nas spyan mi 'dzums 0par gzugs rnams la blta spre)ste/ de spyan tsomi 'dzums 8pa ni dper na sum bcu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams bzhin no/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' bltam pa'i mod nas sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa las skyes pa'i lha'i spyan dang ldan pas des na de nyin dang skematshan du dpag tshad gcig kho ra khor yug tu gzigs so/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' bltam pa'i mod nas gsung snyan zhing 'jibs pa dang / gsung snyan pa dang /gsung yid du 'ong ba yin te/ dper na gangs can gyi bya skad snyan zhing 'jibs pa dang / skad snyan pa dang / yid du 'ong ba de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' bltam pa'i mod nas gsung snyan zhing 'jebs pa dang / gsung 3—682

snyan pa dang / gsung yid du 'ong ba yin no/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' ①bltam pa'i med nas mkhas pa gsal ba yid gzhungs ②pa rgyud las 'byung ba'i shes rab dpyod pa dang ldan pa yin te/ de'i tshe rgyal po zas gtsang gi dgos pa'i ched la 'dug nas don zab mo'i tshig dang yi ge dang ③shes rab kyis so sor 'byed par byed rjodo/ /de nas mes 0byin gyis smras pa/mkhan po byang chub sems dpa' ser skya'i gzhir byon nas de'i mtshan yang gsum btags kyisaX/ da ni byang chub sems dpa' ⑦blta ba'i phyir bzhud do// des smras pa/⑧ de bzhin ⑨bya'o/ /⑩de gnyis chas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mthus rdzu 'phrul nyams nas rkang pa kho nas grong khyer ser skya'i gzhir zhugs (sprenas rgyal po zas gtsang gi khyim gyi sgor son pa ()dang / drang srong nyon mongs med kyis sgo srung gi 8mi la smras pa/ kye nang rje song la rgyal po zas gtsang la drang srong nyon mongs med lha zhal mthong bar 'tshal nas sgo na tsosdod cing mchis so zhes gsol cig /de song nas rgyal po la rig par byas pa dang / rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan nyon mongs med la su zhig 'gog nang du zhugs shig /de zhugs pa dang / rgyal po zas gtsang gis bkur ste sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod yon zang bas mchod nas stan bstabs te 'dug pa dang /rgyal po zas gtsang gis bshes pa'i gtam gyis kun du dga' bar byas nas smras pa/ drang srong chen po dgos pa ci zhig la 'ongs/ des smras pa/ rgyal chen bdag cag 'dir mchis pa/ /khyod kyi sras ni mthong bar 'tshal /'jig rten gtso bo rnam 8'dren pa/ /thub pa de ni mthong bar 'tshal/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gal te de lta na gzhon nu nyal gyis 4)ma sad kyi bar du re zhig 3—683

skad cig sdod cig /des smras pa/ lha mnal log pa nyid blta'o/ /de bzhin gyis shig /des ①ji tsam na byang chub sems dpa' mig ma btsums ②par gzugs rnams ③la blta ①ba mthong nas des tshigs su bcad de smras pa/rigs dang ldan pa'i rta rnams ni/ /mtshan mo'i bzhi cha nyal ba ltar/ /dgos pa don gnyer rnams kyi gnyid/ /mig la yun ring mi gnas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' bltam pa'i mod kyi ma mas pang du blangs nas drang srong la byin pa dang / drang srong nyon mongs med kyis lag pa gnyis kyis blangs nas yud tsam zhig brtags te smras pa/ lha gzhin nu dumatshan mkhan dang dultas mkhan gyi bram ze rnams la bstan lags sam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ bstan to/ /de rnams kyis ji skad du lung bstan/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes bya ba nas 'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas drang srong nyon mongs med kyis byang chub sems dpa' mthong nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ sa bdag rtog pa po rnams blo 'khrul te/ /rtsod pa'i dus na 'khor los sgyur mi 'byung / /bsod nams mchog gi chos kyi mdzod 'di ni/ /nyes las rnam par rgyal nas sangs rgyas 'gyur / /mtshan mi gsal dang ldan na mi dbang po/ /gling bzhi rnams kyi bdag po dbang phyug 'gyur/ /thub dbang mtshan ni shin tu gsal bas na/ /mi mchog sangs rgyas chos kyi 'khor los sgyur0/ /zhes smras nas bdag nyid kyi tshe'i mtha' dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par byang chub pa la brtag pa la zhugs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' lo nyi shu rtsa dgu pa zhes nas khab nas byung nas lo drug tu dka' ba spyod par 'gyur te/ de nas bdud rtsi thob ⑧3—684

par 'gyur bar mthong ngo / /bdag ni bar skabs der shi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur bar mthong nas de mig mchi mas gang ste 'dug pa rgyal po zas gtsang gis mthong nas sngang nas nyutshigs su bcad de smras pa/ skyes pa bud med rnams kyis gang snomathong na/ /ngoms par mi 'gyur dga' ba thob 'gyur ba/ /lus bzang dge byed de ni 'dir mthong nas/ /drang srong chen po ci slad ngu bzhin gyur/ /ga dulas bdag gi gzhon ④nu 'jigs pa 'am/ /tshe zad 'gyur ba nye bar mi gnas grang / /de ni myur du legs par bdag la smos/ /khyod kyi ⑤mchi mas bdag ni 'dar bar 'gyuraX/ /drang srong nyon mongs med kyis kyang tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gal te 'di yi steng du nam mkha' lasal/ /rdo rje ⑧ser drag 'phangs pa bab gyur kyang / /thub pa chen po'i sku las ⑨ba spu ni/ /nyag ma gcig kyang g.yo bar ⑩mi nus so/ /me chen rlung gi shugs 0kyis bdas ⑫pa dang / /mtshon cha rnon po shin tu mi bzad dang / /drag po'i dug dang sbrul gyi dug rnon dgatso /gzhon nu la bab skad cig 'jig par 8'gyur/ /thugs rje ⑫nyid la gnas gyur gang lags pa/ /'jigs pas phonyenyen pa rnams la mi 'jigs stsol/ /de ni 'jig rten kun gyi 'jigs 'joms na/ /mi dbang 'di la 'jigs pa ga la 'byung / /'jig rten na ni bdag nyid che rnams kyi/ /rgetsor gyur bdag nyid chen po gang zhig la/ /tshangs bcas lha yang rtag tu srung ⑫byed pa/ /mi dbang de la 'jigs 8pa ga la 'byung / /mi dbang bdag gi rgud pa mthong nas ni/ /gang phyir zhi ba mi 'thob bdag sdug 7mod/ /chos kyi mchog mdzod 'di dang phrad du nas ni/ /don ma 0thob par bdag ni 'chi bar 'gyur / /gang dag smra ba'i dam pa mtshungs med pa/ /'di yi chos thos 3—685

'gyur zhing thos nas kyang / /rab tu zhi ba'i pha rol 'gro de dag /skyid cing bsod nams ldan la rims ①nad bral/ /drang srong nyon mongs med rgyud nyon mongs pa can gyis bsams pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i mthus bdag gi ②rtsa 'phrul nyams te gal te ③bdag gi 0rkang gis song na skye bo'i tshogs chen po dang rgyal pos ⑤'phya bar 'gyur ro snyam du rig nas smras pa/ lha khyod yun ring po nas kye ma'o drang srong nyon mongs med rkang kho nas ser skya'i gzhir zhugs par gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pa'i dudagongs pa bskyed ⑦pa/ bdag gis ⑧kang gis ser skya'i gzhir zhugs te da ni 0rkang kho nas phyir 'byung gis 0khyod kyis lam bstar ba dang / grong khyer byi dor bgyid du stsol 0cig /rgyal po zas gtsang gis blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag deng ⑩la grong khyer gyi byi dor dang lam stor du chug la lam po che dang / tshong dus yidang / bzhi mdo dang /sum mdo rnams su drang srong nyon mongs med rkang gis grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi nas phyir 'byung gisabya/ khyed cag 0gis bya ba dang byed pa gang yin pa de 'byos shig ces dril sgrogs shig /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes blon po rnams kyis rgyal po las mnyan nas grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi rdo ba dang / gseg ma dang gyo mo rnams ⑩bosal nas tsan dan gyi chus chag chag btab/ shin tu dri 8zhim po'i pog phor nye bar bzhag /dar gyi chun 'phyang mang po dpyangs yirgyal mtshan dang ba dan bsgreng nas lam po che dang / tshong dus 6)dang / bzhi mdo dang /sum mdo rnams su dril sgrogs su dubacug pa/ ser skya'i gzhi'i shākya shes ldan dag nyon cig /drang srong nyon mongs med grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi nas phyir 'byung gis3/ khyed cag gis bya ba dang byed pa gang yin pa de byos shig /de 3—686

nas de nyon mongs pa'i blo dang ngan g.yo'i spyod pas rgyal po zas gtsang blon po'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba dang / ser skya ①na gnas pa'i bram ze dang khyim bdag du ma ②rjes bzhin du 'brang zhing 'byor pa mchog gis grong khyer gyi dbus nas dbus su byung ste/ grong khyer ser skya'i sgor byung nas rgyal po slar bzlog ste ji ltar dga' ba'i spyod lam gyis song ste/ rim gyis ri bo kun 'dzin gyi drung du phyin ②pa dang / de de la 'dzegs dunas phan tshun nyul ⑤zhing ji ltar 'dod pa'i gnas shig btsal dunas phyogs zhig tu 'dug go/ /de nas de lam gyis dub pa ngal bso ste༅/ bsam gtan bskyed nas rdzu 'phrul yang bskyed do/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na drang srong nyon mongs med nad kyis thebs nas de rtsa ba dang /sdong bu dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu'i sman gyis bsnyen bkur byas na 'on kyang phyir thu bar ⑧gyur to/ /de nas mes 0byin gyis de'i lus kyi gnas rnams brtags nas smras tu) pa/ mkhan po bdag cag (nyerab tu byung ba de thams cad ni bdud rtsi'i ched dang / bdud rtsi 8btsal ba'i phyir lags na/ gal te mkhan pos bdud rtsi rtogs par gyur tson bdud rtsi de las bdag cag la ④yang bgos 8shig /des smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u kho bo yang cung zad rab tu byung ba de thams cad bdud rtsi'i ched dang / bdud rtsi btsal ⑫ba'i phyir yin na/ kho bos kyang bdud rtsi ma rtogs 0so/ /de lta mod kyi shākya rnams kyi nang du byung ba'i gzhon nu gang yin pa des bdud rtsi 8rtogs par 'gyur zhing / bdud rtsis kyang 'gro ba tshim par byed par 'gyur gyis 4)de'i drung du rab tu byung ⑥shig /khyod rab tu byung nas kyang rigs brjod par mi bya/rus brjod par mi bya/ bram ze'i khye'u 0brjod par mi bya 6ste/ rab tu byung 3—687

nas kyang tshangs par spyod pa ①'ba' zhig spyad par bya zhing / bdud rtsi rtogs ②par bya ba'i phyir brtson par bya'o/ /de nas khyed ③kyis bdud rtsi rtogs par 'gyur ro zhes smras nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshol 'dod na/ /shar gyi phyogs su khyod 'dug dang / /yang dag sangs rgyas grags ldan pa/ /rnyed par dka' ④ba mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba smras nas/ /bsags pa kun gyi mtha' 'dzad ⑤cing / /mthon po rnams kyi mtha' ltung 'gyur//phrad ⑥pa'i mtha' ni 'bral ba ste/ /gson pa'i mtha' ni 'chi ba yin/ /zhes smras te/ dus kyi chos dang ldan par gyur to/ /de nas mes 0byin gyis de'i lus la lus kyi mchod pa byas nas bā rā ṇa sīr song ste gnas so/ /de de na bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya la bram ze'i gsang tshig klog tu 'jug go/ / mes byin gyi rus ka tya ya ⑧na yin pas de'i ming ka tya'i 0bu ka tya'i tsobu zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mngon par byang chub pa na 0spyan sngar 'gro bar 'gyur tu)te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ka tya'i 0bu de la gdams byangag phog nas 'khor ba'i dgon pa las bsgral te/ shin tu mthar phyin pa'i grub pa dang bde ba mya ngan las 'das pa las 8'jog par 'gyur te/ de'i ming ni ka tya'i tsobu chen po ka tya'i bu chen po ⑩zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na byang chub sems dpa' 'khrungs nas ring po ma lon par ma ma'i pang du bzhugs ⑫nas gser gyi gzhong par 'bras dang shar bsres pa'i chan gsol ba na/ de ma mas bkag kyang ma thub par mang por gsol nas dbrog par brtsams pa dang /dbrog par tsom nus nas des rgyal po zas gtsang la sbran pa dang / rgyal pos btsun mo dang lhan cig gis dbrog par brtsams pa dang des kyang ma nus so/ /3—688

de nas rgyal pos blon po rnams dang ser skya na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs rnams la bsgo ba ①na de rnams kyis kyang dbrog par ma nus so/ /de nas glang po che lnga brgya la btags ②pa dang / byang chub sems dpas bsams pa/ 'di rnams kyis bdag gi stobs nyams na mi rung gis③/ ma la bdag gi mdzub ④mo bkug pas gser gyi gzhong pa nas bzung ⑤ngo snyam nas des mdzub 0mo bkug pas gser gyi gzhong pa bzung nas drangs pa dang / glang po che lnga brgya po de dag kha phyir bsgyur te drangs nas de dag gis kyang gser gyi gzhong pa dbrog par ma nus so/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis bsams pa/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpa'i lag pa g.yon pas glang po che lnga brgya drangs 0pa dang sbyar na/ gdon mi za bar lag pa gnyis kyis ni glang po che stong thub kyis rjode bas na gzhon nu'i ming glang po che stong gi stobs can zhes gdags so zhes btags so// //bar sdom la/ khye'u dang rtsed ①mo dag dang ni/ /rig pa khang bzangs nyid ⑩dang ni/ /ngang pa mtshon cha dge ba'i snying / /dmag dang btsun mo rnams yin no/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' yishākya thub pa 'khor lnga brgya dang yi ge'i slob dpon srin bu go cha la yi ge slob par gtad nas8/ yi ge'i slob dpon srin bu go chas byang chub sems dpa' la yi ge 'bris nas phog pa dang / byang chub sems dpas 0smras pa/ 'di ni ngas shes so/ /de nas de ⑫yi ge gnyis dang / gsum nas de bzhin du lnga brgya'i bar bris nas phog pa dang /byang chub sems dpas (nyesmras pa/ 'di dag kyang ngas shes kyis 6)gzhan dag smras shig /srin bu go chas smras pa/ 'jig rten na ni yi ge 'di tsam spyod kyi gzhan ni bdag gis ma 'tshal to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyis yi 3—689

ge bris te srin bu go cha la byin nas gsungs pa/ yi ge 'di'i ming ci yin smos shig /des smras pa/ ma 'tshal to/ /byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/'jig rten du gnyis shig byung na yi ge 'di mngon par 'gyur te①/ byang chub sems dpa' 'am ②'khor los sgyur ba'o/ /nam mkha'i ngos la gnas pa'i tshangs pas smras pa/ srin bu go cha byang chub sems dpas ②ji skad gsungs pa de de bzhin te/ yi ge 'di shes pa ④ni 'jig rten du gnyis shig byung na mngon par 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' 'am 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'o/ /byang chub sems dpas yi ge de tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis bklags pa ⑤la nam mkha'i ngos la gnas pa'i tshangs pas dbang byas pas tshangs pa'i yi ge tshangs pa'i yi ge zhes bya bar gyur to/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' yi ge'i mthar phyin pa de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa'i zhang po bzang len zhes bya ba ①des glang po che'i gnya' bar zhon pa bslabs ⑦nas 'phong gi slob dpon lhar bcas zhes bya ba des 'khor lnga brgya dang spyod ⑧pa slob pa la zhugs pa na bzang len gyis lhar bcas la smras pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dang de bzhin du gzhon nu gzhan dag ni snying rje can yin pas bslab par bya ba thams cad slobs shig / lhas byin ⑨'di ni gdug pa'i las byed pa yin gyis 0'jig rten thams cad la gnod par gyur na ⑩mi rung gis ⑩'di la gnad du snun 8pa ma bstan 0cig /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bslab pa thams cad la 0legs par bslabs ⑫pas gnas lnga po 'di lta ste/ rgyang nas phog pa dang / sgra grag ⑩par phog pa dang / gnad du phog pa dang / mi 'chor tsobar phog pa dang / tshabs che ba dag la yang byang bar gyur pa 8de'i tshe phyogs kun du sgra grags pa shākya rnams kyi 3—690

nang du byung ba'i gzhon nu zhes bya ba nas 'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de'i tshe yangs pa can gyi litstsha bī rnams kyis glang po che ①mtshan dang ldan pa zhig rnyed nas de rnams kyis bsams pa/ rgyal po zas gtsang gi sras mtshan mkhan rnams kyis 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa de'i mthus glang po rin po che 'di byung gis ③dong la de kho na la dbul lo snyam nas/ de rnams kyis glang po rin po ③che de rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas khrid de dong ba las rim gyis ser skya'i gzhir phyin nas rgyal po'i pho brang gi sgor glang po che dam pa bzhag nas sdod 0pa dang / ma stes 0te gdug pa'i las can lhas byin duphyir byung ba des glang po che dam pa de de ltar rgyan gyis brgyan pa mthong nas de des phrag dog chen po skyes te/de phrag dog dang mi bzod pa skyes pas ⑥dris pa/ glang po ⑧dam pa 'di su'i yin/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ gzhon nu shākya thub pa mtshan mkhan rnams kyis 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lung bstan pa de la yangs pa can gyi 0tshogs rnams kyis glang po rin po che 'di skyes su phul lo/ / lhas byin ⑩lhag par mi bzod pa skyes nas smras pa/ re zhig de 0'khor los sgyur bar ma gyur par je ⑫khyed cag de la glang po 8rin po che 'bul lam zhes smras nas thal lcag gis glang po che bsad do/ /ji tsam na phyogs der dga' bo bya'ongs pa des de mthong nas dris pa/ shes ldan dag glang po che bzang po 'di sus bsad/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ lhas byin thogegyis so/ /des bsams pa/ gdon mi za bar 'di la lhas byin gyi ⑩mthu sad kyis ⑩ma la bdag gis kyang 'di la mthu sad par bya'o snyam nas mjug tsom nas bzung ste dri mi zhim par mi 'gyur bar bya bar mtha' 3—691

gcig tu bor ro/ /ji tsam na byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa phyir byung ba des de gzigs nas dris pa/ glang po che 'di gang nas 'ongs/ de rnams kyis ji ltar gyur pa smras so/ /sus ①bsad/ lhas byin gyis so/ /mgron ②rnams la mgron ②gyi mchod pa bya ba yin na ④ma legs pa zhig byas so/ /phyogs gang du bsad/ 'o nir ro⑤/ /'di sus 'dir khyer te 'ongs/ dga' bos so/ /des dgongs pa/ gdon mi za bar de gnyis kyis 'di la mthu sad kyis⑥/ ma la ngas kyang 'di la mthu sad par bya'o snyam du dgongs nas/mjug ma nas bzung ste ra ba'i khar 'phangs pa las ra ba rim pa bdun dang /'obs rim pa rjobadun las bzlas te bor ro/ /de lhung bas gshong btod pa glang po che'i gshong glang lapo che'i gshong zhes bya bar gyur to/ /der bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis mchod rten brtsigs pas deng sang du yang dge slong mchod rten la phyag byed pa dag phyag byed do/ /'dir smras pa/ lhas byin 6)gyis ni glang chen dbang po bsad/ /dga' bos de ni gom pa bdun du khyer/ /byang chub sems dpas phyag 0gis bar snang la/ /rdo ba bzhin du phyi rol rgyang rings 0'phangs/ /gzhon nu rnams kyis smras 0pa/ gcod 0pa byed du 'dong ④ngo zhes de rnams 8phyir byung ba byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pas kyang gsan nas 'khor lnga brgya dang gcod pa (9byed du phyir byung ngo / /gzhon nu rnams 'bras rnga ba spre)bzhin du gcod par byed de/ de rnams kyis shing bcad cing bcad pa rnams 8'gyel to/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni bre'i kha gcod ⑩pa bzhin du gcod par mdzad do/ /des shing bcad cing bcad pa rnams ma 'gyel te/ de bzhin du 'dug pa dang / gzhon nu rnams kyis smras 3—692

pa/ shes ldan dag byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa stobs dang ldan zhing gnas lnga la byang ngo ①zhes thos na 'di gcod par byed pa yang mi shes pa las na/'di bdag cag bas stobs dang ldan pa ni ma yin te/ 'di ltar bdag cag gis shing gang dag bcad pa de thams cad ni 'gyel la/ 'dis gang dag bcad pa de dag ni de bzhin du 'dug go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' shākya ②thub pa la mngon par dad pa'i lha gang yin pa de 'di snyam du sems te/ shākya 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa'i mthu dang bzo dul byang ba ma shes pas byang chub sems dpa' la brnyas 0shing mthu la yang smod par 'gyur gyis ⑤de la thabs shig bsham par bya'o snyam nas/ des de dang dumathun pa'i rlung zhig btang bas des shing de dag thams cad chem chem 0zer nas 'gyel te/ shākya rnams kyis mthong nas mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes so/ /de rnams tshabs byed pa la zhugs te/de rnams kyis de na 'ben du lcags kyi ta la bdun dang / rnga dang / phag btsugs ⑧so/ / lhas byin 0gyis rkang thabs byas te lcags mda' 'phangs pa dang / lcags kyi shing ta tshul gcig thags so/ /dga' bos yiganyis la'o⑩/ /byang chub sems dpas ()lcags mda' 'phangs pa dang shing ta tsol bdun dang /rnga dang / phag las thal nas lcags kyi tsomada' de sa la zug pa klus phyung ⑩ba dang chu ro phun sum tshogs pa zhig byung nas de la skye bo'i tshogs chen pos 'thung bar brtsams so/ /bram ze dang khyim bdag dad pa can ⑩rnams kyis der mchod rten brtsigs te/ deng sang du yang dge slong dag tsomachod rten la phyag 'tshal ba dag phyag byed do/ /gzhon ()nu rnams shing (3 rtar zhugs nas ser skya'i gzhir zhugs pa dang / mtshan mkhan grong khyer nas phyir byung ba de rnams 3—693

kyis gzhon nu shākya thub pa shing rtar zhugs pa ①nas/ nang du zhugs pa la lung bstan pa/ gal te 'di lo bcu gnyis su rab tu ma byung bar gyur na/gdon mi za bar 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis gzhon nu mtshan ②mkhan rnams kyis lung bstan to zhes bya ba ①thos so /thos nas kyang dga' ba dang mgu ba skyes te shākya rnams bsogs dunas smras pa/shes ldan dag mtshan mkhan rnams kyis gal te gzhon nu lo bcu gnyis su rab tu ma byung bar gyur na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa kho bos thos so/ /gzhon nu 'di gal te lo bcu gnyis su rab tu ma byung ste 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por gyur na/ bdag cag nam mkha'i ngos la rgyu zhing gling bzhir phyi bzhin 'dong gis 'di khyim phub cig⑤ /blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ lha gzhon nu 'dod pa rnams don du mi gnyer 0ro/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa/ gzhon nu la bud med thams cad bstan la ⑦'di gang la dga' bar gyur pa de chung mar blang bar ⑧bya'o/ /de nas kha cig gis smras pa/ lha gzhon nu ni sbyin pa la dga' bas rgyan rnams bud med la stsol du stsal la/de gang la mgu bar skyed par gyur pa de btsun mor 0blang bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa/ de bzhin du gyis shig /blon po rnams kyis rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs rin po ches spras pa'i phung po spungs so/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis ⑨ khyim dang grong khyer phyag dar dang byi dor byed du bcug nas rgyu skar dang / tshes grangs dang / yud tsam dag bstun 7te gdan ⑩seng ge'i khri bshams pa la gzhon nu shākya thub pa bzhag nas seng ge'i khri dang nye bar rgyan sna tshogs kyi phung po spungs te blon po rnams dang / gzhan yang ser skya'i gzhi'i skye 3—694

bo'i ①tshogs gtso bor bkur ba rnams nang du zhugs so/ /de nas bud med thams cad rang gi khyim gyi 'byor pa dang mthun pa'i cha byad dang / rgyan dang gos gyon nas zhugs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa la dga' bas rgyan de dag de rnams la byin no/ /shākya ②lag na dbyug pa can gyi bu mo grags 'dzin ma zhes bya ba gzugs bzang ba dudang / lang tsho dul bab pa/ de ma song nas shākya ⑤lag na dbyug pa can gyis smras pa/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa' rgyan sbyin gyis ⑥song shig /des smras pa/ yab ci 'o skol cag la rgyan ma mchis sam/ bu mo rgyan rtsimed pa ni ma yin mod kyi/ byang chub sems dpa' bud med gang bzhed pa de 'dam ⑧par mdzad do/ /yab 'dam yang rung mi 'dam yang rung / de kho na bdag gi sdum thab ⑨lags so/ /bu mo yigal te de lta na shin tu 'gro dgos pas song shig /de nas grags 'dzin ma na tshod gzhon zhing cha lugs bzang ba/ skye bo'i tshogs chen po'i yid dang mig 'phrog pa/bud med thams cad kyi nang na lha'i bu mo bzhin du gzi brjid dang ldan pas nang du zhugs nas spyod lam dul bas byang chub sems dpa'i spyan sngar 'dug go/ /byang chub sems dpas ⑩rgyan thams cad byin nas sor gdub brgya 'kho na lus pa byang chub sems dpas de la bstan pa dang / des 8thog ma med pa'i dus nas mchog tu mnyes pa byas pa des seng ge'i khri'i skas la 'dzegs (stenas byang chub sems dpa'i phyag nas rang gis phyung ngo / /blon po rnams dang ser skya'i gzhi'i skye bo'i tshogs gtso bor bkur ba rnams kyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'di ni bud med thams cad las khyad par du tso'aphags pa yin te/ 'dis gzhon nu'i thugs dang bstun par nus pas 'di blang ⑩bar bya'o/ /de ⑩nas rgyal po zas 3—695

gtsang gis grags 'dzin ma bud med kyi 'khor nyi khri dang gzhon nu shākya thub pa'i btsun mor blangs so/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'jig rten du byung ba de'i tshe shing dge ba'i snying po zhes bya ba skye bar 'gyur te/ de nyi ma gcig cing khru brgyar skye bar 'gyur la/ ji tsam nyi ma ma shar ba de srid du ni sen mos kyang gcad ①du rung la/ nyi ma shar nas ni mtshon gyis kyang mi chod cing mes kyang mi tshig pa zhig ser skya'i gzhi dang lhas bstan gyi bar na 'bab chu ro hi ka zhes bya ba'i 'gram na skyes te/ dus dus su chu phrug ②pas de'i rtsa ba brus ③nas rlung gi shugs kyis 'gyel te gags bzhin du chu bcad de 'dug go/ /de nas chus rgyal po legs par rab sad kyi yul ni chu med pas ma rung la/ zas gtsang gi yang chus ma rung ste/ ④rgyal po legs par rab sad kyis rgyal po zas gtsang la spring ba/ shing dge ba'i snying po 'gyel nas 'bab chu ro hi ku'i gags su gyur te mchis na gzhon nu mthu dang ldan zhes thos kyis de btang duba'i rigs so/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis smras pa/ kho bo gzhon nu dul bka' mi stsol ༅lo/ /'dun pas smras pa/ lha bdag la gnang ⑧ba 'ba' 0zhig stsol ⑨ cig0 /ci nas kyang gzhon nu la yang bka' ma stsal ⑫bzhin du rang nyid gshegs par 'gyur ba de ltar bgyi'o/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gis khas blangs so/ /'dun pas 'bab chu ro nyi ku'i 'gram du gzhon nu rnams kyi skyed mos tshal re re brtsigs 4)nas smras pa/ gzhon nu dag skyed mos tshal du 'dong / de rnams so so'i shing rtar zhugs nas skyed mos tshal du dong 8ba las lhas byin tunyegyi skyed mos tshal gyi steng nas ngang pa zhig 'phur ba de lhas byin ⑫gyis mdas bsnun nas byang chub sems dpa'i skyed mos tshal du lhung 4)ba dang /3—696

byang chub sems dpas ①bzung nas mda' phyung ste sman gyis glan ②nas sos so/ / lhas byin ②gyis byang chub sems dpa' la spring ba/ ngang pa 'o ni sngar ngas bzung ba yin gyis ④skur cig /byang chub sems dpas slar spring ba/ ngas gang gi ①tshe kho na sems can thams cad la phan pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pas byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de kho na'i tshe ngas sems can thams cad bzung ba yin no//der byang chub sems dpa' dang lhas byin dulhan cig srid pa tha ma la thog mar sha khon de byung ste/ srid pa gzhan rnams su ni phal mo che zhig kyang byung ngo / /legs par rab sad kyis gzhon nu rnams shing dge ba'i snying po dbyung ba'i phyir lhags so zhes thos nas des skye bo'i tshogs chen po mngags te/ ⑦skye bo'i tshogs chen po'i sgra chen po dang sgra mthon po grag dunas byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ shes ldan dag skye bo'i tshogs chen po'i sgra chen po dang ⑨/ sgra mthon po grag ⑩pa 'di ci zhig /'dun pas ji ltar gyur pa gsol ba dang / byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ gal te de lta na 'byin du 'dong ngo zhes byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nu rnams dang lhan cig dong ba dang / ji tsam na khung nas sbrul gdug pa zhig byang chub sems dpa'i ⑩mdun du byung ba dang 'char gas ⑫byang chub sems dpa' thal bar brlags 0su 'gyur du 'ong zhes mtshon rnon pos rked du bcad pa las de'i tsodabugs kyis 'char ka la phog pas bya'achar ka nag por gyur nas/ de'i ming 'char ka nag po 'char ka nag po zhes bya bar gyur to//de nas gzhon nu rnams kyis shing dge ba'i snying po 'byin pa la zhugs pa na lhas byin 0gyis 'bad pa dang cung zad cig g.yos so/ /dga' bos ni cung 0zad cig bteg go/ /byang chub sems dpas tho)ni thams cad kyi 0 thams cad du 3—697

steng gi nam mkha' la 'phangs te dum bu gnyis su chag nas 'bab chu ro nyi ku'i tshu rol gyi 'gram du dum bu gcig /pha rol gyi 'gram du sem bu gcig lhung ①bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpas ②skye bo'i tshogs la gsungs ③pa/ shes ldan dag shing dge ba'i snying po 'di ni bsil ba'i rang bzhin can 0yin pas mkhris pa'i nad dang / shu ba dang / phol mig byung ba la byugs na zhi bar 'gyur gyis⑤/ dum bu dum bur byos la khyer 0cig /gzhon nu rnams rang rang gi shing rtar zhugs te skyed mos tshal gyi sa nas ser skya'i ⑦gzhir dong nas grong khyer du zhugs pa na byang chub sems dpa' shing rtar zhugs pa la mtshan mkhan rnams kyis gal te 'di lo bdun durab tu ma byung bar gyur na/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan no/ /shākya ⑨dril bu sgra'i bu mo sa 'tsho ma zhes bya ba steng gi khang bzangs kyi ⑨ gzhi la 'dug pa byang chub sems dpas gzigs so/ /gzigs ma thag tu zhabs kyi yimathe bos shing rta mnan nas mi g.yo bar gyur pa dang / byang chub sems dpas chas 'tsho ma la brtag 0par btsams so/ /sa 'tsho ④mas kyang byang chub sems dpa' la'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sa 'tsho ma la rtog pa na phyag tson lcags kyi mda' bsnams pa de phyer brlags 0so/ /sa 'tsho ma yang byang chub sems dpa' la rtog pa na rkang pa'i mthe bos khang bzangs kyi ⑩gzhi brtol to/ /skye bo'i tshogs chen pos byang chub sems dpa' dang sa 'tsho ma la 'phan tshun du rtog par byed cing lhag pa'i bsam pa skyes par gyur pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang smras pa/ bud med 'di 'dra ba 'dis ni byang chub sems dpa'i thugs dang yibastun par nus sol/ /gtam de rgyal po zas gtsang gis thos nas de 'khor ⑥ nyi khri dang byang chub 3—698

sems dpa'i btsun mor blangs so/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir gshegs par ①bzhed par gyur pa de'i tshe kha lo sgyur ba la kye kha lo sgyur ba re zhig bzhin ②pa bzang po myur du shoms shig dang /der nga zhugs ninas skyed mos tshal gyi dugazhir 'gro'o zhes gsung bar 'gyur bas/de nas byang chub sems dpas dus lo sgyur ba la bsgo ba/ kye kha lo sgyur ba dure zhig bzhin ⑦pa bzang po myur du shoms shig dang / der nga zhugs nas skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir 'gro'o/ /lha bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes kha lo sgyur bas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa'i ltar mnyan nas bzhin ⑧pa bzang po myur du bshams te/ byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa gang na ba der song nas phyin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha bcibs pa bzang po bshams lags kyis 0lha da 0de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa bzhon 0pa bzang por zhugs nas skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir byung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pas mi rgas 'khogs gtugs pa sgur po phyam dgu bo tu)ltar spyar kyor can/mdun nas 'khar 0ba la rten 0cing 8'dar zhing 'gro ba/ de'i skra se ba/ ji ltar yang mi gzhan dag dang mi 'dra ba cig gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang kha lo sgyur ba la gsungs pa/ kha lo sgyur ba mi rgas 'khogs gtugs pa/ sgur po phyam dgu bo tunyeltar kyar kyor can/ mdun nas 'khar tho)ba la rten tunyecing /lus 'dar zhing 'gro la de'i skra se yib/ ji ltar yang ⑥mi gzhan dang mi 'dra ba 'di ci yin/ lha mi 'di ni rgas pa zhes bya'o(nya/ /kha lo sgyur ba rgas pa zhes bya ba 'di ci yin/ lha mi 'di ring po mi thogs pa kho nar 'gum par 'gyur bas 3—699

de ①rgas pa zhes bgyi'o/ /kha lo sgyur ba nga yang rgas pa'i ②chos dang / rgas pa'i nichos nyid las ma 'das sam/ lha yang rgas pa'i ④chos dang / rgas pa'i 0chos nyid las ma 'das so/ /kha lo sgyur ba de'i phyir shing rta phyir sgyur cig/pho brang nyid du 'dong ngo / /'di ltar nga pho brang nyid yidu phyin nas/ nga rgas pa ⑦las ma 'das zhes grag ⑧pa'i don de nyid bsam par bya'o/ /kha lo sgyur bas shing rta phyir bsgyur nas pho brang nyid du chas te/ der byang chub sems dpa' shākya thub pa pho brang gi nang du byon nas/ nga yang rgas pa ⑨las ma 'das pa lta zhig ces mi dgyes shing thugs ngan dgongs so/ /'dir smras pa/ dar yol tshurgas shing skur la mgo skya ba/ /lag na 'khar yib thogs pa'i mi gzigs nas / /'di bdag rgas las ma 'das zhes grag ces/ /de nas mi dgyes thugs ngan dgongs par mdzad/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang gis kha lo sgyur ba la smras pa/ kha lo sgyur ba ci gzhon nu yid dga' ba dang mgu bas skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir byung ngamatho)/ skyed mos tshal la mngon par dga' 'am lha ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ lha gzhon nu skyed mos tshal gyi gzhir gshegs pa na/ mi rgas 'khogs gtugs pa/ sgur po phyam dgu bo 0ltar kyar kyor can/ mdun nas 'khar ba la rten ④cing lus 'dar zhing mchis tshul de'i skra se ba/ ji ltar yang mi gzhan dag dang mi 'dra ba zhig gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang bdag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kha lo sgyur ba mi rgas 'khogs gtugs pa/ sgur po phyam dgu bo ⑩ltar kyar kyor can/ mdun na 'khar ⑩ba la rten 8cing / lus 'dar zhing 'gro la de'i skra se ba/ ji ltar yang mi gzhan dag dang mi yi'adra ba 'di ci yin/ de la bdag gis 'di skad 3—700 ——
